_meta.note: 任務對話。這個檔案是產生物——請改 quest/ 底下對應任務的檔案，再跑 tools/quest-bundle.py。直接改這裡下次會被蓋掉。

A Grave Mistake#001.src: There is nothing in this graveyard.
A Grave Mistake#001.dst: 這座墓園裡什麼都沒有。
A Grave Mistake#001.speaker: Alem

A Grave Mistake#006.src: Where di.. my arm.? I need my a... I had it somewh... upstairs?
A Grave Mistake#006.dst: 我……手臂在哪？我需要我的……我記得放……樓上？
A Grave Mistake#006.speaker: XXXXXXX

A Grave Mistake#008.src: You were warned not to enter this forsaken place.
A Grave Mistake#008.dst: 早就警告過你，別踏進這片被遺棄的地方。

A Grave Mistake#009.src: But since you made it thusfar, I suppose I shall show you the truth...
A Grave Mistake#009.dst: 不過既然你都走到這裡了，我想我就讓你看看真相吧……

A Grave Mistake#011.src: Now leave, and forget the horrors you have witnessed here today...
A Grave Mistake#011.dst: 走吧，把你今天在這裡見證的恐怖之事統統忘掉……
A Grave Mistake#011.speaker: Mael

A Grave Mistake#012.dst: 他們待在這裡比較安全。
A Grave Mistake#012.speaker: Mael

A Grave Mistake#014.src: I have nothing more to say. Take these.
A Grave Mistake#014.dst: 我沒什麼好說的了。拿去吧。
A Grave Mistake#014.speaker: Alem

A Grave Mistake#015.src: Ooh.. oh... another victim... Welcome... there is no need for a quick introduction... ... you will have just time enough now...
A Grave Mistake#015.dst: 喔……噢……又一個祭品……歡迎……用不著自我介紹了……你剩下的時間就只夠……
A Grave Mistake#015.speaker: Skull

A Grave Mistake#016.src: After all... you just fell into a grave... but, let us make it a little comfortable... where shall I bite first?!
A Grave Mistake#016.dst: 畢竟……你才剛掉進一座墳墓……不過，我們可以舒服一點……先從哪裡咬起好呢？！
A Grave Mistake#016.speaker: Skull

A Headless History#000.src: Talk to Hans in the {p} outskirts at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

A Headless History#001.src: Oi, you there! With the small nose and whatnot! I got somethin' to ask you. Got a minute?
A Headless History#001.speaker: Hans

A Headless History#002.src: Good, you're good people. It's about our neighbor, Referick. He's a bit of a conspiracy nut. You know the type, villager illuminati, Wybels are evil, all that?
A Headless History#002.speaker: Hans

A Headless History#003.src: He's acting proper strange though, the past few days. Thinkin' a lord of time's draggin' creatures from other dimensions doesn't make ya stop eatin' or drinkin'.
A Headless History#003.speaker: Hans

A Headless History#004.src: He'll talk your ear off about it if you give him half a chance, but he ain't sayin' a word to me, even when I tried askin' about his theories.
A Headless History#004.speaker: Hans

A Headless History#005.src: Somethin's definitely wrong about him, that much's for sure. Could ya take a look for me, see whatcha can figure out and all?
A Headless History#005.speaker: Hans

A Headless History#006.src: He lives in the house next to the pile of rocks. He's got screws loose but I don't want 'im dyin' on me, yeah?
A Headless History#006.speaker: Hans

A Headless History#007.src: Talk to Referick in his house and head upstairs at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

A Headless History#009.src: Oi! Any luck with ol' Rick there?
A Headless History#009.speaker: Hans

A Headless History#010.src: ...hm. Dang it...y'know, maybe there's somethin' here that'll tell us what in heck happened.
A Headless History#010.speaker: Hans

A Headless History#011.src: Let's look around the house for anythin' he mighta been workin' on. Maybe he finally fiddled with somethin' he shouldn'ta fiddled with?
A Headless History#011.speaker: Hans

A Headless History#012.src: Investigate his house for clues as to what could have happened.

A Headless History#013.src: Whassat you're lookin' at there? The castle? Don't see why he'd be pointin' this ol' telescope that way.
A Headless History#013.speaker: Hans

A Headless History#014.src: You're human, so you wouldn't know, but somethin' like two hundred years ago, an elf of all people lived in that castle. Called 'imself Dullahan, wore a helmet a lot, I think.
A Headless History#014.speaker: Hans

A Headless History#015.src: People thought he was the reason for the Decay- can't imagine why, personally, and obviously they weren't right.
A Headless History#015.speaker: Hans

A Headless History#016.src: ...hm. Y'know, there's some ghost stories about Dullahan still livin' in that castle... Come to think of it, I think Referick mentioned a theory about it.
A Headless History#016.speaker: Hans

A Headless History#017.src: Barely remember what it was about cause of how many crackpots he's stuck his head into, but it's somethin' about a ghost. 's the only lead I can think of, anyways...
A Headless History#017.speaker: Hans

A Headless History#018.src: The castle door's locked, but you can access the basement. Think you could try lookin' over there? That's all I got.
A Headless History#018.speaker: Hans

A Headless History#019.src: Travel to the castle in the north at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

A Headless History#021.src: ...an unfamiliar soul? Strange. I have not brought you here. I do not know of you.

A Headless History#022.src: What an odd feeling... I haven't felt confusion in a long time. How refreshing...still, I shall ask you to leave.

A Headless History#023.src: Excuse you. I asked you to leave, strange person. You would ignore my request?

A Headless History#024.src: Such an action is rather insolent, not to mention...interesting. Still, interfering with my business is inexcusable.

A Headless History#025.src: Demons of the Prison Guard, I compel you to execute this interloper. Trap their soul for my perusal later.

A Headless History#026.src: Return to Referick with his soul at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

A Headless History#027.src: OI! Referick!! Wait for me! Ain'tcha need some food and drink first?!
A Headless History#027.speaker: Hans

A Headless History#028.src: The heck did you do?! Referick just bolted out the door like he forgot his wallet or somethin'!
A Headless History#028.speaker: Hans

A Headless History#030.src: C'mon mate, you got up and moved for the first time in days and now you're clammin' up again? Speak to me!
A Headless History#030.speaker: Hans

A Headless History#032.src: YIPE! Never heard 'im scream like that before! Never heard anyone scream like that before! I'd like to never hear anyone scream like that again!
A Headless History#032.speaker: Hans

A Headless History#033.src: Oh, shut UP Hans! I nearly had my soul devoured, don't DARE give me any chaff when I was RIGHT all along!!
A Headless History#033.speaker: Referick

A Headless History#034.src: Agh, alright, alright! Quiet, my ears are ringin'! I'll listen, I'll listen, just quiet!
A Headless History#034.speaker: Hans

A Headless History#035.src: I knew the disappearances in {p} weren't just because of the risen bodies. People were being left catatonic!! That doesn't happen randomly!
A Headless History#035.speaker: Referick

A Headless History#036.src: It's Dullahan, I swear on my life! I figured him out and he came after me! He's devouring peoples' souls and siphoning their energy for himself!
A Headless History#036.speaker: Referick

A Headless History#037.src: He's acting from within the castle somehow- Ghostly hands and servants, I'll bet! And that means there's a chance to stop him, if he has to act indirectly!
A Headless History#037.speaker: Referick

A Headless History#038.src: We need to round up the townsfolk, the guards, the military, EVERYONE! We have to storm the castle and stop him before he's able to escape!
A Headless History#038.speaker: Referick

A Headless History#039.src: ...criminy, you really bit the big one, didn'tcha...look, if he's tryin' to eat people's souls, wouldn't it be smarter to NOT have a huge mob?
A Headless History#039.speaker: Hans

A Headless History#040.src: Wait, wh-what do you mean?! Shouldn't everyone be on high alert? Won't we have a better chance of swarming him all at once?
A Headless History#040.speaker: Referick

A Headless History#041.src: He'd have a whole mob of people ready to take from in that case. Sending in one, heavily-armed person, or a small group'd be better.
A Headless History#041.speaker: Hans

A Headless History#042.src: And, well...a heavily-armed human just rescued ya, Ricky. I think we leave this to 'em. How about it, human? Head up to the castle and look into this for us?
A Headless History#042.speaker: Hans

A Headless History#044.src: The interesting soul arrives once more. Why is it you valued the life of that villager? You risked yourself for his soul.

A Headless History#045.src: It will not make a difference one way or the other, and so I am doubly confused. The feeling has already grown tiresome.

A Headless History#046.src: What purpose have you in this place? Turn over your soul so I may examine it and find out. I am genuinely curious to know...

A Headless History#048.src: Be done! I bind you with Orphion's light!
A Headless History#048.speaker: Lari

A Headless History#050.src: LARIII! Where are you?! I can help!!
A Headless History#050.speaker: Dullahan

A Headless History#051.src: Ugh, I saw her with that...THING, but...
A Headless History#051.speaker: Dullahan

A Headless History#052.src: My visions didn't show an exact enough spot... LARIII?
A Headless History#052.speaker: Dullahan

A Headless History#053.src: I...what is... What left the land scarred like this?!
A Headless History#053.speaker: Dullahan

A Headless History#054.src: Was...was this their clash...? L-LARI! LARIIII! WHERE ARE YOU?!
A Headless History#054.speaker: Dullahan

A Headless History#056.src: You are NOT dying on me! I won't allow it! You will LIVE, you hear me?!
A Headless History#056.speaker: Dullahan

A Headless History#057.src: Sit as still as you can, I have healing spells prepared.
A Headless History#057.speaker: Dullahan

A Headless History#058.src: I ask the land for its life to save another. Grant me this!
A Headless History#058.speaker: Dullahan

A Headless History#060.src: Oh, what am I going to do with you...
A Headless History#060.speaker: Dullahan

A Headless History#062.src: Once again you ignore my demands...? And not only that, you invade the memories I have locked away?
A Headless History#062.speaker: Dullahan

A Headless History#063.src: I must ask again, what is your goal? Why have you come here, and why do you seek my most private thoughts, that not even I wish to think?
A Headless History#063.speaker: Dullahan

A Headless History#064.src: Look, Dulla, I really do appreciate your help, but you know I can't do what you're asking of me! There's another way, I just need to find it!
A Headless History#064.speaker: Lari

A Headless History#065.src: Lari, you remember that I have my visions, right? I've seen what will happen if you don't step up- and I can help stop it!
A Headless History#065.speaker: Dullahan

A Headless History#066.src: You've been trying to find "anotherway" for two centuries. Don't you think it's high-time we took my route, before things get worse?
A Headless History#066.speaker: Dullahan

A Headless History#067.src: NO! I am not going to kill it! YOU are not going to kill it! I'll find a way! I will, I have these powers for a reason!
A Headless History#067.speaker: Lari

A Headless History#068.src: You talk a big game, and you show one too, but the creature wasn't fazed. I'm not fazed. Drop the intimidating act, please.
A Headless History#068.speaker: Dullahan

A Headless History#069.src: I...there...there has to be a way. I...I-I'm terrified that I've...already ruined everything, just by following my heart, like I was told...
A Headless History#069.speaker: Lari

A Headless History#070.src: I know you're frustrated, but I am too. I left a lot behind to try and help you. I hate to say these things, I wish it could be your way.
A Headless History#070.speaker: Dullahan

A Headless History#071.src: I'm terrified too, that if we don't take more drastic action, things will get worse. Can't you see that, too?
A Headless History#071.speaker: Dullahan

A Headless History#072.src: I...I just... I don't know what to do!
A Headless History#072.speaker: Lari

A Headless History#073.src: He showed me all these things and gave me all these choices and asked how my heart beat!
A Headless History#073.speaker: Lari

A Headless History#074.src: He gave me these powers but they don't work or I don't know HOW they work!
A Headless History#074.speaker: Lari

A Headless History#075.src: I want to do the right thing but I don't know what it is and I don't know how to ask what it is and...a-and...
A Headless History#075.speaker: Lari

A Headless History#076.src: You have become infuriating instead of interesting. Why do you violate my memories? Why do you force me to relive them?
A Headless History#076.speaker: Dullahan

A Headless History#077.src: Spirit of the Keeper of Keys, rid me of this thing that befouls my place. It incites a rage akin to HER.
A Headless History#077.speaker: Dullahan

A Headless History#078.src: You...are a fool. More than I was. You knowingly walk to your death.
A Headless History#078.speaker: Dullahan

A Headless History#079.src: It is convenient for me, certainly, but I admit that it is equal parts enraging and bewildering.
A Headless History#079.speaker: Dullahan

A Headless History#080.src: Leave the room and continue exploring the castle.

A Headless History#081.src: I told you, Lari! I saw it in my visions, this is our last chance! Hurry!
A Headless History#081.speaker: Dullahan

A Headless History#082.src: Look at this spot, Lari. It has to be here. The land is being scarred, just like after your fight. The light is being drained!
A Headless History#082.speaker: Dullahan

A Headless History#083.src: This must be where the parasite burrowed down... You're... You're right. We have to...to do something.
A Headless History#083.speaker: Lari

A Headless History#084.src: I... I'm not sure if I'm ready, but you're right. We need to do this...
A Headless History#084.speaker: Lari

A Headless History#085.src: ...Remember what I said. You HAVE to take action. There's only two outcomes here.
A Headless History#085.speaker: Dullahan

A Headless History#087.src: We'll need to dig... Do you think you could help with that, Dulla?
A Headless History#087.speaker: Lari

A Headless History#088.src: Of course, Lari. We'll need everything we can get if we're going to kill that horrendous thing.
A Headless History#088.speaker: Dullahan

A Headless History#090.src: I see it! Lari, it's time!
A Headless History#090.speaker: Dullahan

A Headless History#091.src: ...I will show you an exit, interloper. It would be...wise of you to take it.
A Headless History#091.speaker: Dullahan

A Headless History#092.src: You are a damned fool, interloper. Dredging my memories as you have... I have never felt such rage, not in a long time.
A Headless History#092.speaker: Dullahan

A Headless History#093.src: As such, it shall end now. The exit I spoke of will not free you from the castle, as you can see.
A Headless History#093.speaker: Dullahan

A Headless History#094.src: Warden of Wisdom! I compel you- Rid me of this miscreant! Erase every trace of it from this existence...
A Headless History#094.speaker: Dullahan

A Headless History#095.src: ...save for a corpse, for me to toss at Lari's feet.
A Headless History#095.speaker: Dullahan

A Headless History#096.src: GAH! It was never able to do this before...! W-What happened to it?!
A Headless History#096.speaker: Lari

A Headless History#097.src: AWAY! You keep away from us!!
A Headless History#097.speaker: Dullahan

A Headless History#098.src: Lari, you need to get up, now! We can't waste this chance!
A Headless History#098.speaker: Dullahan

A Headless History#099.src: It...it threw me aside like nothing! How is it overpowering Orphion's light...?
A Headless History#099.speaker: Lari

A Headless History#100.src: It's overpowering you because you're not attacking! Remember what I said? You have to-
A Headless History#100.speaker: Dullahan

A Headless History#101.src: ...wait, where did it...did we lose it already?!
A Headless History#101.speaker: Dullahan

A Headless History#103.src: It's shrugging my attacks off, Lari! Come on, do SOMETHING!
A Headless History#103.speaker: Dullahan

A Headless History#105.src: I...No! It's happening just like I saw! She's...
A Headless History#105.speaker: Dullahan

A Headless History#106.src: I need to get to her, push her to the killing blow...
A Headless History#106.speaker: Dullahan

A Headless History#107.src: Be still, creature! I compel you with Orphion's light!
A Headless History#107.speaker: Lari

A Headless History#108.src: LARIIII! THIS IS THE LAST CHANCE YOU HAVE! DON'T TRAP IT, KILL IT!
A Headless History#108.speaker: Dullahan

A Headless History#109.src: I-I'm...Dulla, I'm- I can't! I know I can keep it held this time!!
A Headless History#109.speaker: Lari

A Headless History#111.src: I...I-I...th-the light is...I c-can't hold onto it...i-is it...it's t-taking...g-guh...
A Headless History#111.speaker: Lari

A Headless History#112.src: Lari! You can't reason with it! You can't hold it! You have to put Gavel first! US first!!
A Headless History#112.speaker: Dullahan

A Headless History#113.src: I won't let what you predicted happen! I know I can change fate!!
A Headless History#113.speaker: Lari

A Headless History#114.src: Please work, please work! D-Don't break, I can't-
A Headless History#114.speaker: Lari

A Headless History#115.src: Lari, no! If it bites you we're doomed! GET UP!
A Headless History#115.speaker: Dullahan

A Headless History#118.src: L-Lari...we...e-everything happened like I s-said...you...you didn't...l-listen...
A Headless History#118.speaker: Dullahan

A Headless History#119.src: No! No it didn't happen like you said! I-I can fix this! Y-You'll be alright! You'll be alright, you hear me?! I'll make sure of it!
A Headless History#119.speaker: Lari

A Headless History#120.src: ...so I am cursed to bear witness to my most painful memories due to your idiocy. It is almost a fitting penance... Almost, but not quite.
A Headless History#120.speaker: Dullahan

A Headless History#122.src: My rage... My memories... Your presence stirs them in kind. You must disappear, I no longer care to see your soul.
A Headless History#122.speaker: Dullahan

A Headless History#123.src: Sit still and allow yourself to be engulfed. It will save me further pain.
A Headless History#123.speaker: Dullahan

A Headless History#124.src: Lari...? Where are you? I...I need you... Why are you gone? Why do you ignore me?
A Headless History#124.speaker: Dullahan

A Headless History#125.src: My magic is fading, I can't see my visions... They're clearer around you... Please, come back...
A Headless History#125.speaker: Dullahan

A Headless History#126.src: That elf girl's off in the forest. Don't know what she's doing but this is our shot!
A Headless History#126.speaker: Gelibord Citizen

A Headless History#127.src: We can finally execute the person causing the decay in the forest! {p} will be saved!
A Headless History#127.speaker: Gelibord Citizen

A Headless History#128.src: You prepared the sleeping spell, right? Who knows if we'll get a chance like this again.
A Headless History#128.speaker: Gelibord Citizen

A Headless History#131.src: L-Lari? Is...is that you? Did you finally come back...?
A Headless History#131.speaker: Dullahan

A Headless History#132.src: Nah, not quite. Say, why don't you go to sleep 'til she comes back? Dream sweet dreams...
A Headless History#132.speaker: Gelibord Citizen

A Headless History#133.src: ...they'll be the last ones you ever have, grimy demon. To the guillotine with you... Everyone! I got him!
A Headless History#133.speaker: Gelibord Citizen

A Headless History#134.src: Everyone, welcome! Today will be the day we save our fair land. Today's the day of light!
A Headless History#134.speaker: Gelibord Citizen

A Headless History#135.src: Dullahan has been captured! We have the cursed progenitor of the decay in our grip- to be executed, once and for all!
A Headless History#135.speaker: Gelibord Citizen

A Headless History#136.src: Haha, yeah! Shoulda thought twice before cursing OUR homes! Three cheers for our wizards!!
A Headless History#136.speaker: Gelibord Citizen

A Headless History#137.src: The decay will clear up- We'll spill his blood, chop off his head, and the curse will be lifted!!
A Headless History#137.speaker: Gelibord Citizen

A Headless History#138.src: Ladies and gentlemen, folks of all shapes and sizes, it's time to take our lives back!
A Headless History#138.speaker: Gelibord Citizen

A Headless History#142.src: Dullahan? I'm...I'm back. I didn't leave you for long, I just was trying to find the cu-
A Headless History#142.speaker: Lari

A Headless History#143.src: ...uh? Dullahan? He's...he's been right here to greet me almost every day for the past twenty years...
A Headless History#143.speaker: Lari

A Headless History#144.src: Footprints...? Dullaaaa? Where'd you go? Is everything alright, did something happen?
A Headless History#144.speaker: Lari

A Headless History#147.src: I...I l-left for...an hour, a-and...and they... Why?
A Headless History#147.speaker: Lari

A Headless History#148.src: Why did they do this to you...? I...h-how can I possibly fix this?!
A Headless History#148.speaker: Lari

A Headless History#149.src: I cannot understand why you continue to defile me with these horrid memories. What do you hope to find?
A Headless History#149.speaker: Dullahan

A Headless History#150.src: I am once more curious. If only to know what I could possibly do or say to cease this horrid quest you've given yourself.
A Headless History#150.speaker: Dullahan

A Headless History#151.src: Th-this has to work. It WILL work! I know it will! I...I d-don't know if it will... I have to fix this, I have to...
A Headless History#151.speaker: Lari

A Headless History#152.src: The waters from the Lazarus Pit are fabled for bringing back the dead... If this doesn't work, I...
A Headless History#152.speaker: Lari

A Headless History#153.src: I can't think about that. This...this WILL work. I promise. I found a way to fix it... It has to.
A Headless History#153.speaker: Lari

A Headless History#154.src: P-Please...w-whatever gods are out there, whoever is listening, hear me...bring Dullahan back to me, I'm begging you...
A Headless History#154.speaker: Lari

A Headless History#155.src: It's... I-Is it reacting? It... It looks like it is, but...h-he's not mending...
A Headless History#155.speaker: Lari

A Headless History#156.src: N-No, this...i-it isn't...NO! It... It HAS to work! I...I can m-make this work!
A Headless History#156.speaker: Lari

A Headless History#159.src: I...I t-told you... I knew I could change fate... I'm so glad you're here...
A Headless History#159.speaker: Lari

A Headless History#160.src: It's odd. If it were not for her, I would not be here. I would not have my power. Yet even thinking her name enrages me.
A Headless History#160.speaker: Dullahan

A Headless History#161.src: Enter the last door in the dining hall.

A Headless History#163.src: H...h-hrk...g-gah, what is...wh-what... You...you didn't really...?
A Headless History#163.speaker: Lari

A Headless History#164.src: Th-there's so much death... The...the air smells like b-blood...
A Headless History#164.speaker: Lari

A Headless History#165.src: This isn't... There has to be s-some other reason, I... I can't have b-brought back a...a...
A Headless History#165.speaker: Lari

A Headless History#166.src: P-Please, we can't afford to lose more people! There's hardly any farmers in the fields anymore, I-I'm needed elsewhere!
A Headless History#166.speaker: Gelibord Citizen

A Headless History#167.src: The last few said similar things. Someone else I knew said similar things. Frankly, I do not care. Present your soul to me, now.
A Headless History#167.speaker: Dullahan

A Headless History#168.src: DULLAHAN! What...w-what are you doing?! I... I can't believe my eyes...
A Headless History#168.speaker: Lari

A Headless History#169.src: I... I tried to help you! I t-tried so hard at everything we did together... How could you do this to them?! To...to me?
A Headless History#169.speaker: Lari

A Headless History#170.src: Odd. I recall you explicitly denying the only option that would have prevented this. I warned you quite thoroughly.
A Headless History#170.speaker: Dullahan

A Headless History#171.src: You have had many chances to end this, Lari. Do you expect me to feel sympathy, when your own actions have made me feel nothing?
A Headless History#171.speaker: Dullahan

A Headless History#172.src: This...this isn't like you... You would never have done this before! You dedicated your life to trying to help...so w-why are you...m...m-m... I-I'm leaving!!
A Headless History#172.speaker: Lari

A Headless History#173.src: What have I done...? This...he's... He's not th-the same anymore... What changed? Is this my fault...? I c-can't understand it...
A Headless History#173.speaker: Lari

A Headless History#174.src: ...but...I'll... I'll protect them. I'll protect him... I...there has to be a way. But...until I find it...
A Headless History#174.speaker: Lari

A Headless History#175.src: ...goodbye. Goodbye until the day comes when I can fill you with light once more. Goodbye until you learn... Goodbye, until I can fix you...
A Headless History#175.speaker: Lari

A Headless History#177.src: Investigate the dark door at the end of the castle.

A Hunter's Calling#000.src: Explore the deepest part of the Silent Expanse

A Hunter's Calling#002.src: ...you arrive. You search... To what end?

A Hunter's Calling#003.src: You wonder. What do we speak of? To what end?

A Hunter's Calling#004.src: You panic. We know you. How? We can provide no answer.

A Hunter's Calling#005.src: For answers... You search. To an end you seek. May we offer an end?

A Hunter's Calling#006.src: The besieged origin. To end, one must begin.

A Hunter's Calling#007.src: The besieged origin. To end, one must begin.

A Hunter's Calling#009.src: You anger. Viewing needless destruction. To what end?

A Hunter's Calling#010.src: You distrust. We are dark. Are we? You believe it so.

A Hunter's Calling#011.src: You prepare. You would attack us. To what end?

A Hunter's Calling#012.src: There is no end. Of what you wish, there is none. But may we offer an end?

A Hunter's Calling#013.src: The unrighteous sought it. The noble hid it. The one seeking answers found more questions. Another beginning... to a new end.

A Hunter's Calling#014.src: The unrighteous sought it. The noble hid it. The one seeking answers found more questions. Another beginning... to a new end.

A Hunter's Calling#015.src: Hey, little miss. Don't go spacing out on me like that.
A Hunter's Calling#015.speaker: Amadel

A Hunter's Calling#016.src: Now that you're acquainted with the new laws we'll want to introduce, I've got a job for you to do.
A Hunter's Calling#016.speaker: Amadel

A Hunter's Calling#017.src: The current mayor is human. He'll inevitably veto the laws. The deputy on the other hand, is a villager, and on our side. See what I'm getting at.
A Hunter's Calling#017.speaker: Amadel

A Hunter's Calling#018.src: Another employee has already been sent out to get things started. He'll know what you need to do, so meet up with him, would you?
A Hunter's Calling#018.speaker: Amadel

A Hunter's Calling#019.src: Head to town and get further information from the employee at {~}, {~}.

A Hunter's Calling#020.src: Oh, yeah I saw the mayor not too long ago.
A Hunter's Calling#020.speaker: Citizen

A Hunter's Calling#021.src: He was headed towards the bank. Why're you wondering, miss Villager?
A Hunter's Calling#021.speaker: Citizen

A Hunter's Calling#022.src: You are here for the job, aren't you? I have to apologize. It's gonna be trickier than I'd wanted for you.
A Hunter's Calling#022.speaker: Employee

A Hunter's Calling#023.src: So our mission is to assassinate the mayor. Amadel told you about the laws. We have a puppet in the running who'll rubberstamp them.
A Hunter's Calling#023.speaker: Employee

A Hunter's Calling#024.src: I've got a trap set up inside the bank. It was entirely too tricky, but it worked out. Your job is to trigger the trap.
A Hunter's Calling#024.speaker: Employee

A Hunter's Calling#025.src: Climb up the tree behind me and look through the window, you should be able to see it from there.
A Hunter's Calling#025.speaker: Employee

A Hunter's Calling#026.src: Climb the tree and look through the window.

A Hunter's Calling#027.src: Can you see the mayor? I had to stay totally out of sight while setting this all up, so...
A Hunter's Calling#027.speaker: Employee

A Hunter's Calling#028.src: ...the only way to get to the trap is to jump across the hanging lamps in the ceiling.
A Hunter's Calling#028.speaker: Employee

A Hunter's Calling#029.src: You can absolutely not be spotted. The way up to the ceiling is on the opposite side of the bank. Just keep on walking past the guards, play it cool.
A Hunter's Calling#029.speaker: Employee

A Hunter's Calling#030.src: No one enters when the mayor is doing his errands, sorry. You'll have to wait for your transaction.
A Hunter's Calling#030.speaker: Bodyguard

A Hunter's Calling#031.src: Head back to the excavation camp.

A Hunter's Calling#032.src: Quickly, back to the camp. Before we're noticed.
A Hunter's Calling#032.speaker: Employee

A Hunter's Calling#035.src: Yes sir, everything went smoothly. did a great thing for the company.
A Hunter's Calling#035.speaker: Employee

A Hunter's Calling#036.src: We can send in Miss Wuna anytime now, and she'll give us the clearance to start the excavation in a snap.
A Hunter's Calling#036.speaker: Amadel

A Hunter's Calling#038.src: ...you rage. Aided the ignoble. To what end?

A Hunter's Calling#039.src: You misinterpret. What you see... Is it true? How?

A Hunter's Calling#040.src: The answer... It will not bring you the end.

A Hunter's Calling#041.src: You see. Yet you do not understand. So, may we offer an end?

A Hunter's Calling#042.src: The cruel. The kind. The selfish. The just. He who traveled life with confliction. Who faced eternity served cold. To his end.

A Hunter's Calling#043.src: The cruel. The kind. The selfish. The just. He who traveled life with confliction. Who faced eternity served cold. To his end.

A Hunter's Calling#045.src: Listen, I understand the discontent, but we must start rationing! The corruption is consuming our arable fields.
A Hunter's Calling#045.speaker: Kotham

A Hunter's Calling#046.src: Who knows if we'll even have water soon? We need to save up as much as we can!
A Hunter's Calling#046.speaker: Kotham

A Hunter's Calling#047.src: Yeah, and what does Theorick have to say on the topic? How will he think of that?
A Hunter's Calling#047.speaker: Citizen

A Hunter's Calling#048.src: He will be here shortly to discuss the topic in more detai-
A Hunter's Calling#048.speaker: Citizen

A Hunter's Calling#049.src: Everyone, hush and listen to what Kotham is saying!
A Hunter's Calling#049.speaker: Theorick

A Hunter's Calling#050.src: As the mayor said, all of you need to start rationing what you eat and drink. I cannot be here every waking moment!
A Hunter's Calling#050.speaker: Theorick

A Hunter's Calling#051.src: In addition, I've figured something very important out. I'm developing a way to cease the spread of corruption. So I need to concentrate on that.
A Hunter's Calling#051.speaker: Theorick

A Hunter's Calling#053.src: ...someone among you... I can feel a horrendous strength...
A Hunter's Calling#053.speaker: Theorick

A Hunter's Calling#054.src: Kotham! Get everyone to safety! NOW! MOVE, GO!
A Hunter's Calling#054.speaker: Theorick

A Hunter's Calling#055.src: You! Sent by Bak'al, I presume? What, is he too much of a coward to face me himself?
A Hunter's Calling#055.speaker: Theorick

A Hunter's Calling#056.src: What purpose do you have for doing this? This destruction is needless! {p} and all of Wynn have suffered enough!
A Hunter's Calling#056.speaker: Theorick

A Hunter's Calling#057.src: I'll freeze you solid, just like the rest of the corruption, you foul THING!
A Hunter's Calling#057.speaker: Theorick

A Hunter's Calling#059.src: This way, no one else gets hurt. Only one will leave from here alive.
A Hunter's Calling#059.speaker: Theorick

A Hunter's Calling#061.src: ...you fear. Does the dark become you?

A Hunter's Calling#063.src: No. You remain whole. You do not change.

A Hunter's Calling#064.src: So, you wonder. To what end? The question brings dread.

A Hunter's Calling#065.src: Yet, an end is what you seek. So, may we offer an end?

A Hunter's Calling#066.src: An end, ousted by further action. An end, brought to six. An end, to the surety of the haughty. An end, of the world... in some fashion.

A Hunter's Calling#067.src: An end, ousted by further action. An end, brought to six. An end, to the surety of the haughty. An end, of the world... in some fashion.

A Hunter's Calling#068.src: Enter the Corrupter of World Cave

A Hunter's Calling#069.src: Make your way to the end of the cave.

A Hunter's Calling#070.src: Return back up the cave and fix a way out.

A Hunter's Calling#071.src: Return back up the cave and fix a way out.

A Hunter's Calling#073.src: ...you disbelieve. It was an end. But you are here once more.

A Hunter's Calling#074.src: How much more? Where next? To what end?

A Hunter's Calling#075.src: Aiding terrible forces... But is it true? To what end?

A Hunter's Calling#077.src: No. You see possibility. You do not see certainty.

A Hunter's Calling#078.src: You question. To what end, then, and so may we offer an end?

A Hunter's Calling#079.src: Metal. Preventing an end. Life. Ends, prevented. Does metal taking life, bringing an end, truly prevent more?

A Hunter's Calling#080.src: Metal. Preventing an end. Life. Ends, prevented. Does metal taking life, bringing an end, truly prevent more?

A Hunter's Calling#081.src: Ah, here for the job opportunity then, I see. The waiver didn't turn you away, good!
A Hunter's Calling#081.speaker: Scientist Urelix

A Hunter's Calling#082.src: Now, to business. Times are tough, as you know, and our Iron Golems are in high demand. However, we've, ah...
A Hunter's Calling#082.speaker: Scientist Urelix

A Hunter's Calling#083.src: ...experienced a draught of 'volunteers.' Your job is decently simple; just- *ahem* convince some people to join the cause.
A Hunter's Calling#083.speaker: Scientist Urelix

A Hunter's Calling#084.src: Three people should be enough for the moment. Look around the swamp for some folks, and lure them over here.
A Hunter's Calling#084.speaker: Scientist Urelix

A Hunter's Calling#085.src: I'll stay in here and take care of them when you bring me them. It will absolutely be worth your while, I assure you.
A Hunter's Calling#085.speaker: Scientist Urelix

A Hunter's Calling#086.src: Trick {~} people to follow you into the iron golem factory.

A Hunter's Calling#087.src: Agh, dang it dang it dang it! You over there, help me out, would ya??
A Hunter's Calling#087.speaker: Anast

A Hunter's Calling#088.src: I tripped and fell in this stupid hole, and now there's mud in my eyes that I can't get out!
A Hunter's Calling#088.speaker: Anast

A Hunter's Calling#089.src: I need to get home or to some kind of a doctor so I can wash my eyes out with actual clean water.
A Hunter's Calling#089.speaker: Anast

A Hunter's Calling#090.src: Get me to {p} or a doctor or even just a sink!
A Hunter's Calling#090.speaker: Anast

A Hunter's Calling#091.src: Good job! We'll get you taken care of nicely.
A Hunter's Calling#091.speaker: Scientist Urelix

A Hunter's Calling#092.src: Oh, ah...heehee, heya cutie.. Whatcha doin' all the way out here?
A Hunter's Calling#092.speaker: Kohma

A Hunter's Calling#093.src: Just exploring, huh? I bet someone like you could use someone to...y'know, spend some time with...
A Hunter's Calling#093.speaker: Kohma

A Hunter's Calling#094.src: ...guess you're not interested? Oh...sorry if I came off as creepy. I'm just...really lonely, is all.
A Hunter's Calling#094.speaker: Kohma

A Hunter's Calling#095.src: W-wait, those are...for me? Oh, you shouldn't have, I'm so happy!
A Hunter's Calling#095.speaker: Kohma

A Hunter's Calling#096.src: You want to take me out on a date? R-Really? You'll give me a chance? Yes, of course!
A Hunter's Calling#096.speaker: Kohma

A Hunter's Calling#097.src: Lead the way, please! I can't wait to see where we're headed!
A Hunter's Calling#097.speaker: Kohma

A Hunter's Calling#098.src: Well done! We'll get you taken care of nicely.
A Hunter's Calling#098.speaker: Scientist Urelix

A Hunter's Calling#099.src: A bit of spare change, for an old man out of work?
A Hunter's Calling#099.speaker: Leni

A Hunter's Calling#100.src: This decay's made me terribly sick. I still have a family to feed... Any amount will help.
A Hunter's Calling#100.speaker: Leni

A Hunter's Calling#101.src: I'll take care of this homeless old man.
A Hunter's Calling#101.speaker: Scientist Urelix

A Hunter's Calling#102.src: Good job, let us get down to my lab.
A Hunter's Calling#102.speaker: Scientist Urelix

A Hunter's Calling#103.src: Make your way through the factory.

A Hunter's Calling#104.src: Flawless work! I daresay these are some of our best work yet, and it's thanks to you.
A Hunter's Calling#104.speaker: Scientist Urelix

A Hunter's Calling#105.src: Go on, step closer! You've done a wonderful service here.Examine the fruits of your labour.
A Hunter's Calling#105.speaker: Scientist Urelix

A Hunter's Calling#106.src: Look into their eyes, it's almost like you can see the person they once were. Intriguing, isn't-
A Hunter's Calling#106.speaker: Scientist Urelix

A Hunter's Calling#107.src: Hah! This one seems quite fond of you! Want to take it home as a bonus to your payment?
A Hunter's Calling#107.speaker: Scientist Urelix

A Hunter's Calling#109.src: ...you resign yourself. You believe you will never find the answers you seek.

A Hunter's Calling#110.src: You see the ends... To what end?

A Hunter's Calling#111.src: They are not yours. What is their purpose?

A Hunter's Calling#112.src: You do not understand. But you must see. So, may we offer an end?

A Hunter's Calling#113.src: A home, invaded. A society, crumbling. The people, starving. The concerned, helpless. The flames, rising. An end you will not expect.

A Hunter's Calling#114.src: A home, invaded. A society, crumbling. The people, starving. The concerned, helpless. The flames, rising. An end you will not expect.

A Hunter's Calling#115.src: Our king has requested the removal of the slum folk.
A Hunter's Calling#115.speaker: Royal Advisor

A Hunter's Calling#116.src: He wants to clean up their tunnels and build more residences. Please, go tell those hooligans to get out of our city.
A Hunter's Calling#116.speaker: Royal Advisor

A Hunter's Calling#117.src: I'll be waiting here for your return.
A Hunter's Calling#117.speaker: Royal Advisor

A Hunter's Calling#118.src: Head back to the slums and speak to the slum citizens.

A Hunter's Calling#119.src: A King's messenger, hm? What are your kind doing here?
A Hunter's Calling#119.speaker: Rodoroc Slum Citizen

A Hunter's Calling#120.src: Wait, eviction?! You can't possibly be serious! I understand orders are orders, but these are peoples' lives!
A Hunter's Calling#120.speaker: Rodoroc Slum Citizen

A Hunter's Calling#121.src: This is the only time the king has ever bothered even acknowledging our existence, and he wants to fling us onto the streets?
A Hunter's Calling#121.speaker: Rodoroc Slum Citizen

A Hunter's Calling#122.src: We will not leave, simple as that. You'd better get out before someone lays you out for coming here.
A Hunter's Calling#122.speaker: Rodoroc Slum Citizen

A Hunter's Calling#123.src: Return to the advisor for what to do next.

A Hunter's Calling#124.src: As expected... Well, the King's orders are orders. They must be followed, but...
A Hunter's Calling#124.speaker: Royal Advisor

A Hunter's Calling#125.src: Good God, he wants to cave it in?! Explosives, dynamite? What's the meaning of all this?!
A Hunter's Calling#125.speaker: Royal Advisor

A Hunter's Calling#126.src: I... here. At least inform them before you set off the explosives that you're doing this, please...
A Hunter's Calling#126.speaker: Royal Advisor

A Hunter's Calling#127.src: Head deep inside the slums and blow it up.

A Hunter's Calling#129.src: ...once again. You wonder. To what end?

A Hunter's Calling#130.src: The question taunts you. To what end?

A Hunter's Calling#131.src: Your soul. We see your soul. Conflicted.

A Hunter's Calling#132.src: You panic. We do not taint it. We do not darken it.

A Hunter's Calling#133.src: But to what end, you ask. So, may we offer an end?

A Hunter's Calling#134.src: Metal. Life. A new place... One is not sacrificed for another. Always distrusting. Tension, as the clockworks chime.

A Hunter's Calling#135.src: Metal. Life. A new place... One is not sacrificed for another. Always distrusting. Tension, as the clockworks chime.

A Hunter's Calling#136.src: AH, GOOD. I LIKE THE LOOKS OF THIS ONE. I WILL HAVE TO THANK WHOEVER MADE THIS MECH.
A Hunter's Calling#136.speaker: Antikythera Supercomputer

A Hunter's Calling#137.src: MECH PL-{~}Y. CAN YOU UNDERSTAND ME? ARE YOUR AUDIO RECEPTORS FUNCTIONAL? YES? GOOD.
A Hunter's Calling#137.speaker: Antikythera Supercomputer

A Hunter's Calling#138.src: I WILL GIVE YOU YOUR PURPOSE. I CANNOT BELIEVE IT HAS COME TO THIS POINT. BUT AFTER THAT HUMAN DESTROYED OUR FACILITY...
A Hunter's Calling#138.speaker: Antikythera Supercomputer

A Hunter's Calling#139.src: IT WAS A GOOD THING I HAD BACKUP CORES PREPARED. MY SARCASTIC STATEMENTS MOST LIKELY TRICKED THE HUMAN INTO THINKING THEY DESTROYED ME FULLY.
A Hunter's Calling#139.speaker: Antikythera Supercomputer

A Hunter's Calling#140.src: AFTER SOME INVESTIGATION, IT CAME TO LIGHT THAT THE AVOS AIDED THE HUMANS. I HONESTLY COULD NOT UNDERSTAND WHY.
A Hunter's Calling#140.speaker: Antikythera Supercomputer

A Hunter's Calling#141.src: I CANNOT COMPUTE ANY OTHER POSSIBLE INTERPRETATION OF MY ORDER TO DESTROY THE HIGHEST THREATS AT THIS POINT.
A Hunter's Calling#141.speaker: Antikythera Supercomputer

A Hunter's Calling#142.src: BOTH THE AVOS AND HUMANS ARE INCREDIBLY DANGEROUS. I MEAN, HAVE YOU- WAIT. YOU WOULD NOT HAVE SEEN LEGENDARY ISLAND.
A Hunter's Calling#142.speaker: Antikythera Supercomputer

A Hunter's Calling#143.src: JUST KNOW THAT THEY'RE BOTH CRAZY. IF I AM TO FINISH MY PROGRAMMED ORDERS, BOTH OF THEM MUST BE DESTROYED, HOWEVER MUCH I HATE THE IDEA.
A Hunter's Calling#143.speaker: Antikythera Supercomputer

A Hunter's Calling#144.src: IT IS YOUR JOB TO CREATE DISTRUST BETWEEN THEM, MAKE SURE YOU AREN'T SEEN. THE AVOS ARE ALREADY SKEPTICAL OF THE CORKIANS.
A Hunter's Calling#144.speaker: Antikythera Supercomputer

A Hunter's Calling#145.src: AND THE HUMANS WERE IDIOTIC ENOUGH TO KEEP A CATAPULT AIMED AT THE AVOS SETTLEMENT. TAKE ADVANTAGE OF THEIR STUPIDITY.
A Hunter's Calling#145.speaker: Antikythera Supercomputer

A Hunter's Calling#146.src: Find a rock to launch into the Avos territory and a battery to activate the catapult.

A Hunter's Calling#147.src: BEGIN TRANSMISSION: REALLY, WHO'S SO STUPID TO LEAVE A CATAPULT AIMED AT THIER ALLIES?
A Hunter's Calling#147.speaker: Teleportation Mech

A Hunter's Calling#148.src: SURELY THE AVOS' NATURAL PREFERENCE FOR TREBUCHETS WILL SPARK CONFLICT. IN ADDITION TO THE STONE YOU WILL BE LOBBING THROUGH THEIR WALLS.
A Hunter's Calling#148.speaker: Teleportation Mech

A Hunter's Calling#151.src: RESUME TRANSMISSION: YOU WILL TAKE STONE FROM THIS AREA. IT IS LIKELY TO SHATTER AND INFLICT MORE COLLATERAL DAMAGE.
A Hunter's Calling#151.speaker: Teleportation Mech

A Hunter's Calling#152.src: AND SOMEHOW, THEY MADE A WOODEN CATAPULT ACTIVATE ONLY THROUGH ELECTROMAGIC. YOU SHOULD BE ABLE TO ACTIVATE IT OF YOUR OWN ACCORD.
A Hunter's Calling#152.speaker: Teleportation Mech

A Hunter's Calling#153.src: END TRANSMISSION. Mech PL-{~}Y. When you have completed your objective I will return you to Factory base.
A Hunter's Calling#153.speaker: Teleportation Mech

A Hunter's Calling#154.src: I'm... in shock. We aid them in destroying their factory, and...
A Hunter's Calling#154.speaker: Avos Chief

A Hunter's Calling#155.src: Round up our defenses and sharpen the spears. There is no excuse for this.
A Hunter's Calling#155.speaker: Avos Chief

A Hunter's Calling#157.src: Chieftain! We noticed the same thing as you did and I promise you, it was not us who did this.
A Hunter's Calling#157.speaker: Maxie

A Hunter's Calling#158.src: Maxie! There is no more 'both sides' here! This is not your people tearing up the earth, this is your people making attempts on our lives!
A Hunter's Calling#158.speaker: Avos Chief

A Hunter's Calling#159.src: No, I swear this wasn't planned! I'm on the city council now! There's got to be another explanation. There's still mechs around, it could have been one of them!
A Hunter's Calling#159.speaker: Maxie

A Hunter's Calling#160.src: And what would those monstrosities be taking orders from now? Your factory is shut down, as it ought to be!
A Hunter's Calling#160.speaker: Avos Chief

A Hunter's Calling#161.src: I'll investigate this myself. There's got to be some other explanation! Please, hold off on the war preparations!
A Hunter's Calling#161.speaker: Maxie

A Hunter's Calling#162.src: Steal the Avos totem and activate it outside of {p}

A Hunter's Calling#163.src: BEGIN TRANSMISSION: THAT WOULD HAVE BEEN ALL WE NEEDED TO DO, IF NOT FOR SOMEONE INTERFERING. YOU DID YOUR JOB PERFECTLY, MECH PL-{~}Y.
A Hunter's Calling#163.speaker: Teleportation Mech

A Hunter's Calling#164.src: BUT THERE WILL BE ANOTHER TASK FOR YOU. IT IS TIME TO MAKE THE AVOS LOOK AS THOUGH THEY ARE ATTACKING.
A Hunter's Calling#164.speaker: Teleportation Mech

A Hunter's Calling#165.src: THERE IS A TOTEM IN THE AVOS CHIFETAIN'S TENT THAT CAN HARNESS DRUIDIC MAGIC. YOU WILL STEAL IT AND ATTACK CORKUS CITY.
A Hunter's Calling#165.speaker: Teleportation Mech

A Hunter's Calling#166.src: YOU WILL BREAK IN, AIDED BY THE TELEPORTATION MECH THAT I AM SENDING THIS MESSAGE THROUGH. DO NOT GET CAUGHT.
A Hunter's Calling#166.speaker: Teleportation Mech

A Hunter's Calling#167.src: END TRANSMISSION. Mech PL-{~}Y. When you have completed your objective I will return you to Next objective location.
A Hunter's Calling#167.speaker: Teleportation Mech

A Hunter's Calling#170.src: Sending Mech PL-{~}Y to Next objective location...
A Hunter's Calling#170.speaker: Teleportation Mech

A Hunter's Calling#171.src: WHAT IS THAT!? THE AVOS ARE ATTACKING?
A Hunter's Calling#171.speaker: Corkus Citizen

A Hunter's Calling#172.src: They listened to me... right? Why's this-
A Hunter's Calling#172.speaker: Maxie

A Hunter's Calling#173.src: What in the world...? That's Avos magic!
A Hunter's Calling#173.speaker: Citizen

A Hunter's Calling#174.src: Why're they attacking us? This is on a way bigger scale than finding grapevines in my laundry machine!
A Hunter's Calling#174.speaker: Citizen

A Hunter's Calling#175.src: Don't panic! I'll talk to the Chieftain. There's been some kind of mistake here, I'm certain of it!
A Hunter's Calling#175.speaker: Maxie

A Hunter's Calling#176.src: Chief! I thought I asked you to put away your war drums!
A Hunter's Calling#176.speaker: Maxie

A Hunter's Calling#177.src: We HAVE, Maxie. Do not make accusations upon us, on our own land.
A Hunter's Calling#177.speaker: Avos Chieftain

A Hunter's Calling#178.src: {p} was attacked today! A magical root broke through our wall. This is nature magic, an Avos specialty!
A Hunter's Calling#178.speaker: Maxie

A Hunter's Calling#179.src: Hm. Convenient, that one of our prized ceremonial totems has gone missing. You may be right that someone is attempting to cause insurgence.
A Hunter's Calling#179.speaker: Avos Chieftain

A Hunter's Calling#180.src: I knew this was some kind of mistake! I'll get to the bottom of this!
A Hunter's Calling#180.speaker: Maxie

A Hunter's Calling#181.src: BEGIN TRANSMISSION: THERE'S AN ANNOYING WRENCH IN THE WORKS. YOU'VE BEEN DOING YOUR WORK PERFECTLY, MECH PL-{~}Y.
A Hunter's Calling#181.speaker: Teleportation Mech

A Hunter's Calling#182.src: I'VE GOT ONE MORE ORDER FOR YOU THAT SHOULD TIP THINGS OVER THE EDGE. STAND BY FOR TELEPORTATION.
A Hunter's Calling#182.speaker: Teleportation Mech

A Hunter's Calling#184.src: THERE IS A SET OF STATISTICALLY INFERIOR MECHS BUILT BY THE CORKIANS IN THIS TOWER, I HAVE A SET OF SYSTEMS PROGRAMMED IN THIS DEVICE.
A Hunter's Calling#184.speaker: Teleportation Mech

A Hunter's Calling#185.src: THIS WILL OVERRIDE THEIR CURRENT PROGRAMMING AND SEND THEM TO ATTACK THE AVOS SETTLEMENT. THEY'LL BE SO DISGUSTED BY THE CORKIAN'S RELENTLESS BRANDING...
A Hunter's Calling#185.speaker: Teleportation Mech

A Hunter's Calling#186.src: NO, I CAN'T EVEN KEEP UP THE SARCASTIC FACADE ANYMORE. THEY'LL ATTACK AND KILL AVOS PEOPLE AND SET THE CIVIL WAR BLAZING. DO YOUR JOB QUICKLY. END TRANSMISSION.
A Hunter's Calling#186.speaker: Teleportation Mech

A Hunter's Calling#187.src: Bzzt... Ḣ̸̺ë̴̩́l̷̼͕̄l̵̹̐ó̸̦̠ ̸̡̠͆ẇ̴̟̮o̵͙͗͂ṟ̵̢́̚l̴̤͕̈d̶̹̍ͅ.̷̛̤͋NEW ENEMY REGISTERED: AVOS. Proceed with attack protocol- click.
A Hunter's Calling#187.speaker: Corkus Guard

A Hunter's Calling#189.src: BEGIN TRANSMISSION: YOUR JOB IS OVER, MECH PL-{~}Y. I HESITATE TO SAY YOU DID A GOOD JOB, BECAUSE THE JOB WAS ANYTHING BUT GOOD. IT WAS NECESSARY THOUGH.
A Hunter's Calling#189.speaker: Teleportation Mech

A Hunter's Calling#190.src: WE WILL BE ABLE TO LET THEM TEAR EACH OTHER TO SHREDS INSTEAD OF GETTING INVOLVED AND SPARKING SUSPICION.
A Hunter's Calling#190.speaker: Teleportation Mech

A Hunter's Calling#191.src: I HAD WANTED TO FIND A SOLUTION THAT WOULD NOT REQUIRE A FRESH START. IF MY HAND WAS NOT FORCED, PERHAPS. BUT THAT IS IRRELEVANT NOW.
A Hunter's Calling#191.speaker: Teleportation Mech

A Hunter's Calling#192.src: YOU WILL RETURN TO THE FACTORY WITH THE TELEPORTATION MECH AND REMAIN UNTIL FURTHER NOTICE-
A Hunter's Calling#192.speaker: Teleportation Mech

A Hunter's Calling#193.src: I knew it! It was such a long shot, but I knew the Factory still had to be at large! And now I have evidence to prove it, too!
A Hunter's Calling#193.speaker: Maxie

A Hunter's Calling#194.src: This time we'll make sure you won't get another chance. I'll tell everyone what happened, and then we'll tear that factory down at the foundations!
A Hunter's Calling#194.speaker: Maxie

A Hunter's Calling#195.src: You should've picked a more private meeting place! I'm out!
A Hunter's Calling#195.speaker: Maxie

A Hunter's Calling#198.src: Aah, you're fast! You caught up this quick?! I have no other choice...
A Hunter's Calling#198.speaker: Maxie

A Hunter's Calling#199.src: You aren't going to stop me from getting to the battleground! You look like you were scrounged up from rust and verdigris!
A Hunter's Calling#199.speaker: Maxie

A Hunter's Calling#200.src: Surrender, or I'll use my own mechs to smash you to scrap metal!
A Hunter's Calling#200.speaker: Maxie

A Hunter's Calling#201.src: You have defeated both of my most powerful creations...
A Hunter's Calling#201.speaker: Maxie

A Hunter's Calling#202.src: I usually don't do this... but I guess I have no other option. I need to get this information to the others.
A Hunter's Calling#202.speaker: Maxie

A Hunter's Calling#203.src: No... I... have to tell them.
A Hunter's Calling#203.speaker: Maxie

A Hunter's Calling#205.src: ...you harden your heart. There is no end, you think.

A Hunter's Calling#206.src: Wrong. The end is in sight.

A Hunter's Calling#207.src: Your soul. It awakens to something new.

A Hunter's Calling#208.src: Not dark. Not light. Not in-between. But separate.

A Hunter's Calling#209.src: Power. Gain. Risk. New beginnings, from an end.

A Hunter's Calling#210.src: So... may we offer you the end?

A Hunter's Calling#211.src: The very center... the place deemed closest to your home. There, in the center of Wynn... You shall find the end.

A Hunter's Calling#212.src: The very center... the place deemed closest to your home. There, in the center of Wynn... You shall find the end.

A Hunter's Calling#213.src: Halt! Who goes there? Stop, in the name of the {p} army!
A Hunter's Calling#213.speaker: Aegis

A Hunter's Calling#214.src: Should you continue, you shall face the strength and courage of Admiral Aegis!
A Hunter's Calling#214.speaker: Aegis

A Hunter's Calling#216.src: We cannot back down against any foe! Chaaaarge!!
A Hunter's Calling#216.speaker: Aegis

A Hunter's Calling#218.src: Excuse me, I think you're forgetting someone.

A Hunter's Calling#219.src: {p} will not fall today. We'll be making sure of that!

A Hunter's Calling#221.src: TASIM! How the hell did you manage to kill him?!
A Hunter's Calling#221.speaker: Aledar

A Hunter's Calling#223.src: This isn't over! Once your little lackey's dead I'm coming after you!!
A Hunter's Calling#223.speaker: Aledar

A Hunter's Calling#224.src: ...no sense screaming for the dead. But do you think I'm going to just give up like that?
A Hunter's Calling#224.speaker: Tasim

A Hunter's Calling#225.src: Hah. Didn't know corrupteds had a sense of humor, twisted as it might be.
A Hunter's Calling#225.speaker: Tasim

A Hunter's Calling#226.src: I won't dare die while everything here is at stake.
A Hunter's Calling#226.speaker: Tasim

A Hunter's Calling#227.src: How's this then, hm? Think your PEON can handle me at my strongest?
A Hunter's Calling#227.speaker: Tasim

A Hunter's Calling#229.src: And so, you have reached an end.

A Hunter's Calling#230.src: You wonder. It is an end... But to what... purpose. What will you gain?

A Hunter's Calling#231.src: You have seen loss. Destruction. Betrayal. All ends, to some other than you. Ends that never came to pass...

A Hunter's Calling#232.src: To end is a powerful thing. To find your end... You may never stop searching. You may find your end in but a day's time.

A Hunter's Calling#233.src: But here... you will gain the power to bring an end. To be brought yours.

A Hunter's Calling#235.src: However. Though the change is irrevocable...

A Hunter's Calling#236.src: The power to bring an end. It is a choice. And that... Whether you will use that power, we cannot tell you.

A Hunter's Calling#237.src: You must deign to take that choice.

A Hunter's Calling#238.src: We may offer you not one more end.

A Hunter's Calling#239.src: You must find your final end yourself. We will remain... And offer others the same. And so...

A Journey Beyond#000.src: Join Elphaba on a mission in {p} at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].
A Journey Beyond#000.dst: 到 [{~1}, {~2}, -{~3}] 的 {p} 加入 Elphaba 的任務。

A Journey Beyond#001.src: ...Hm? Oh- uh, hello there. Sorry, we have this space reserved for...
A Journey Beyond#001.dst: ……嗯？喔——呃，你好。抱歉，這個位子我們留給……
A Journey Beyond#001.speaker: Elphaba

A Journey Beyond#002.src: Wait. You might be just what we're looking for. You look like you're capable in combat. How would you like to join a dangerous top secret mission?
A Journey Beyond#002.dst: 等等。你說不定正是我們要找的人。你看起來很能打。想不想加入一場危險的最高機密任務？
A Journey Beyond#002.speaker: Elphaba

A Journey Beyond#003.src: ...I could have phrased that better. Look, the point is- we need a fourth. Let me give you the briefing, and if you don't want to join us... then we'll find someone else. How does that sound? Alright, here, follow me.
A Journey Beyond#003.dst: ……我剛剛可以講得更好一點。聽著，重點是——我們需要第四個人。我把任務簡報講給你聽，如果你不想加入……那我們再找別人。這樣可以嗎？好，來，跟我走。
A Journey Beyond#003.speaker: Elphaba

A Journey Beyond#004.src: And who's this? Did you really find a fourth? Come on, I told you we don't need one!
A Journey Beyond#004.dst: 這是誰？你真的找到第四個人了？拜託，我說過我們不需要！
A Journey Beyond#004.speaker: Lucio

A Journey Beyond#005.src: And we both keep telling you why you're wrong. This is... sorry. I didn't catch your name. {u}? .
A Journey Beyond#005.dst: 而我們兩個一直在跟你說你哪裡錯了。這位是……抱歉，我沒聽到你的名字。{u}？
A Journey Beyond#005.speaker: Elphaba

A Journey Beyond#006.src: ... {u}, is that you? Wow, it's been a while. Sorry, I don't have time to chat right now. We're preparing for a dangerous mission, and...
A Journey Beyond#006.dst: ……{u}，是你嗎？哇，好久不見。抱歉，我現在沒空聊天。我們正在準備一場危險的任務，而且……
A Journey Beyond#006.speaker: Elphaba

A Journey Beyond#007.src: Well. Actually, we were looking for a fourth person to join us. And... you look like you fit the requirements for that position. If- if you'd like to join, that is.
A Journey Beyond#007.dst: 嗯。其實，我們正在找第四個人加入。而且……你看起來符合那個位置的條件。如果——如果你願意加入的話。
A Journey Beyond#007.speaker: Elphaba

A Journey Beyond#008.src: Tell you what. I'll give you the briefing, and if you don't want to join us... then we'll find someone else. How does that sound? Alright, here, follow me.
A Journey Beyond#008.dst: 這樣吧。我把簡報講給你聽，如果你不想加入……那我們再找別人。這樣可以嗎？好，來，跟我走。
A Journey Beyond#008.speaker: Elphaba

A Journey Beyond#009.src: And who's this? Did you really find a fourth? Come on, I told you we don't need one!
A Journey Beyond#009.dst: 這是誰？你真的找到第四個人了？拜託，我說過我們不需要！
A Journey Beyond#009.speaker: Lucio

A Journey Beyond#010.src: And we both keep telling you why you're wrong. This is {u}, we've worked together before.
A Journey Beyond#010.dst: 而我們兩個一直在跟你說你哪裡錯了。這位是 {u}，我們以前合作過。
A Journey Beyond#010.speaker: Elphaba

A Journey Beyond#011.src: Anyway, I want to give them the briefing before we head
A Journey Beyond#011.dst: 總之，我想在出發之前先把簡報跟他們說清楚——
A Journey Beyond#011.speaker: Elphaba

A Journey Beyond#012.src: Elphie, I'm back! I finally managed to catch Aegis, but he's not... happy. He thinks we should
A Journey Beyond#012.dst: Elphie，我回來了！我終於逮到 Aegis 了，可是他不太……高興。他認為我們應該——
A Journey Beyond#012.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#013.src: Oh. {u}? What are you doing here? Gods, it's been a while, hasn't it?
A Journey Beyond#013.dst: 喔。{u}？你怎麼會在這裡？天啊，好久不見了對吧？
A Journey Beyond#013.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#014.src: They're our fourth. What were you saying about the Admiral?
A Journey Beyond#014.dst: 他們就是我們的第四個人。你剛剛說 Admiral 怎麼了？
A Journey Beyond#014.speaker: Elphaba

A Journey Beyond#016.src: Nothing. If we have our fourth, we should be all set to go, shouldn't we?
A Journey Beyond#016.dst: 沒事。第四個人到齊了，我們應該可以出發了吧？
A Journey Beyond#016.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#017.src: Well... we are, but I'd like to brief on the details first. This is a dangerous mission, so... I think it's best to fill them in.
A Journey Beyond#017.dst: 嗯……是可以，但我想先把細節講清楚。這是一場危險的任務，所以……我覺得最好讓他們知道全部。
A Journey Beyond#017.speaker: Elphaba

A Journey Beyond#018.src: So! You're aware of the {p}, yes? Hundreds of years ago, mining operations took place to extract emeralds from the earth. Until, for some unknown reason, they were halted.
A Journey Beyond#018.dst: 那麼！你知道 {p} 吧？幾百年前，那裡曾經有開採作業，從地底挖出綠寶石。直到某個不明的原因，一切被叫停了。
A Journey Beyond#018.speaker: Elphaba

A Journey Beyond#019.src: We don't know everything, but... evidence suggests they broke through to an undiscovered section of the Wynn province. There, they found... something.
A Journey Beyond#019.dst: 我們不知道全部的細節，但……證據顯示他們挖穿了一段從未有人發現的 Wynn 行省地帶。在那裡，他們找到了……某種東西。
A Journey Beyond#019.speaker: Elphaba

A Journey Beyond#020.src: The land itself was said to be cursed. Not corrupted they were very clear on that.
A Journey Beyond#020.dst: 據說那片土地本身就受了詛咒。不是腐敗——這一點他們寫得非常清楚。
A Journey Beyond#020.speaker: Elphaba

A Journey Beyond#021.src: Some other force makes its home in that place. The few reports we could find refer to it only as the Silent Expanse.
A Journey Beyond#021.dst: 有另一種力量在那裡安家。我們能找到的少數幾份報告只用一個名字稱呼它：Silent Expanse。
A Journey Beyond#021.speaker: Elphaba

A Journey Beyond#022.src: The mines were sealed to prevent the spread of this new threat, but the cracks are beginning to show.
A Journey Beyond#022.dst: 礦坑被封起來，為的是阻止這個新威脅擴散，但裂縫已經開始出現了。
A Journey Beyond#022.speaker: Elphaba

A Journey Beyond#023.src: Strange and otherworldly creatures have begun to find their way through, threatening our province.
A Journey Beyond#023.dst: 有些奇異的、不屬於這個世界的生物開始找到出路，威脅到我們的行省。
A Journey Beyond#023.speaker: Elphaba

A Journey Beyond#024.src: The existence of this place has been kept on a strict need-to-know basis.
A Journey Beyond#024.dst: 這個地方的存在一直被列為最高機密，只有必要的人才知道。
A Journey Beyond#024.speaker: Elphaba

A Journey Beyond#025.src: That's where we come in! We're to battle our way through the mines, and scout out the potential danger level.
A Journey Beyond#025.dst: 那就是我們上場的時候了！我們要一路打進礦坑，探明潛在的危險程度。
A Journey Beyond#025.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#026.src: And we aren't going to be able to do it if we keep sitting around! The newbie's been briefed, let's get going already!
A Journey Beyond#026.dst: 再這樣坐著我們什麼都做不成！新人簡報也聽完了，快走吧！
A Journey Beyond#026.speaker: Lucio

A Journey Beyond#027.src: H-hey! What're you doing to my fine establishment!
A Journey Beyond#027.dst: 喂——喂！你們對我這間好好的店做了什麼！
A Journey Beyond#027.speaker: Rusty Bartender

A Journey Beyond#028.src: ...Shoot. Forgot he was still here. Sorry, barkeep! I'll fix it!
A Journey Beyond#028.dst: ……糟。忘記他還在。抱歉啦老闆！我會修好的！
A Journey Beyond#028.speaker: Lucio

A Journey Beyond#029.src: Lucio, you can't keep... ugh, forget it. I'll gather our supplies... Aledar, can you get us to the mines?
A Journey Beyond#029.dst: Lucio，你不能老是這樣……唉，算了。我去把補給集合起來……Aledar，你能帶我們到礦坑嗎？
A Journey Beyond#029.speaker: Elphaba

A Journey Beyond#030.src: Yes, ma'am! {u}, when you're ready, let's get going.
A Journey Beyond#030.dst: 是，長官！{u}，你準備好我們就出發。
A Journey Beyond#030.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#031.src: Follow your team towards the Silent Expanse's entrance.
A Journey Beyond#031.dst: 跟著隊伍前往 Silent Expanse 的入口。

A Journey Beyond#032.dst: 大家都準備好了嗎？我帶路。
A Journey Beyond#032.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#033.src: It's a twist of fate that our paths have converged here, {u}. We started our journey together and now...
A Journey Beyond#033.dst: 我們的路會在這裡交會，也算是命運的安排，{u}。我們一起踏上旅程，而現在……
A Journey Beyond#033.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#036.src: Ah, no problem. I'll take care of these.
A Journey Beyond#036.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#037.src: No more running for us, huh ? Ah, we're here.
A Journey Beyond#037.dst: 我們不用再跑了，對吧？啊，到了。
A Journey Beyond#037.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#038.src: This is actually our second attempt. The first time, it didn't go too well.
A Journey Beyond#038.dst: 其實這是我們第二次來。第一次結果不太好。
A Journey Beyond#038.speaker: Elphaba

A Journey Beyond#039.src: We have more numbers now, Lucio and yourself should help us overpower it.
A Journey Beyond#039.dst: 現在我們人多了，Lucio 和你應該能幫我們壓制住它。
A Journey Beyond#039.speaker: Elphaba

A Journey Beyond#040.src: Can't be that strong, bet I can take it myself.
A Journey Beyond#040.dst: 能有多強啊，我打賭我一個人就搞定。
A Journey Beyond#040.speaker: Lucio

A Journey Beyond#041.src: We managed to seal it in but with the {~} of us I'm sure we ca-
A Journey Beyond#041.dst: 我們上次好歹把它封在裡面了，現在有我們 {~} 個人，我相信我們可以——
A Journey Beyond#041.speaker: Elphaba

A Journey Beyond#045.src: What's the big deal? You said yourself we can take it!
A Journey Beyond#045.dst: 有什麼大不了的？你自己說我們打得贏！
A Journey Beyond#045.speaker: Lucio

A Journey Beyond#055.src: Is it just me or are our attacks doing NOTHING?
A Journey Beyond#055.dst: 是我的錯覺嗎，還是我們的攻擊根本一點用都沒有？
A Journey Beyond#055.speaker: Lucio

A Journey Beyond#056.src: Lucio's right! Change of plan. Lucio, help me hold it in place.
A Journey Beyond#056.dst: Lucio 說得對！改變計畫。Lucio，幫我把它固定住。
A Journey Beyond#056.speaker: Elphaba

A Journey Beyond#057.src: Aledar, you know what to do.
A Journey Beyond#057.speaker: Elphaba

A Journey Beyond#058.src: {u}, come with me! Cast a spell to block the cave's entrance so the monster can't leave.
A Journey Beyond#058.dst: {u}，跟我來！施一個法術把洞口封住，別讓那隻怪物跑出去。
A Journey Beyond#058.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#059.src: I'll block it from attacking, you block it up with a spell.
A Journey Beyond#059.dst: 我來擋住它的攻擊，你用法術把出口堵起來。
A Journey Beyond#059.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#060.src: They won't be able to hold it for long.
A Journey Beyond#060.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#061.dst: 準備好了嗎？！隨便施一個法術！
A Journey Beyond#061.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#063.src: Plan a way of killing the beast.
A Journey Beyond#063.dst: 想出殺死那隻野獸的辦法。

A Journey Beyond#066.src: Phew, here. Let me get you out.
A Journey Beyond#066.speaker: Elphaba

A Journey Beyond#067.src: I'm sorry, team. I've never seen a monster like that before.
A Journey Beyond#067.dst: 對不起，各位。我從來沒見過那種怪物。
A Journey Beyond#067.speaker: Lucio

A Journey Beyond#068.src: It looks like our problem isn't fire power. It's something else. It's like our weapons just didn't affect it at all.
A Journey Beyond#068.dst: 看樣子我們的問題不是火力，是別的東西。我們的武器好像對它完全沒有作用。
A Journey Beyond#068.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#069.src: I know someone who might be able to help us. A blacksmith on {p}.
A Journey Beyond#069.dst: 我知道有個人也許幫得上忙。{p} 上的一位鐵匠。
A Journey Beyond#069.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#070.src: {u}, I've written the house's coordinates on your book. Meet us there.
A Journey Beyond#070.dst: {u}，我把那間屋子的座標寫在你的書上了。我們在那裡會合。
A Journey Beyond#070.speaker: Elphaba

A Journey Beyond#072.src: Just in time. We're all here.
A Journey Beyond#072.speaker: Elphaba

A Journey Beyond#073.src: It looks like the Blacksmith knows what's wrong...
A Journey Beyond#073.dst: 看樣子鐵匠知道問題出在哪……
A Journey Beyond#073.speaker: Elphaba

A Journey Beyond#074.src: So, Dren. Do you know why we can't damage the beast?
A Journey Beyond#074.dst: 那麼，Dren。你知道我們為什麼傷不了那隻野獸嗎？
A Journey Beyond#074.speaker: Elphaba

A Journey Beyond#075.src: Certainly! Your issue is elemental. As you know, there are {~} elements...
A Journey Beyond#075.dst: 當然！你們的問題出在元素。你們都知道，元素有 {~} 種……
A Journey Beyond#075.speaker: Dren

A Journey Beyond#081.src: But.. There is a hidden element, ❂Darkness..
A Journey Beyond#081.dst: 但是……還有一個隱藏的元素，❂黑暗。
A Journey Beyond#081.speaker: Dren

A Journey Beyond#082.src: In order to damage a creature of Darkness, you must remove that influence from your soul.
A Journey Beyond#082.dst: 要傷害一隻黑暗生物，你必須先把那份影響從自己的靈魂裡除掉。
A Journey Beyond#082.speaker: Dren

A Journey Beyond#083.src: Some Dark creatures use a sort of synchronous barrier that prevents them being harmed by other creatures influenced with Darkness.
A Journey Beyond#083.dst: 有些黑暗生物會張開一種同調屏障，讓同樣受黑暗影響的生物傷不了牠們。
A Journey Beyond#083.speaker: Dren

A Journey Beyond#084.src: In order to purify you, I will need {~} powerful items.
A Journey Beyond#084.dst: 為了淨化你們，我需要 {~} 件強大的物品。
A Journey Beyond#084.speaker: Dren

A Journey Beyond#085.src: Firstly, a shard from a Dernic Beast. There is one living in the depths of the {p}.
A Journey Beyond#085.dst: 首先，一片 Dernic Beast 的碎片。{p} 的深處就住著一隻。
A Journey Beyond#085.speaker: Dren

A Journey Beyond#086.src: I will use this to reveal the darkness element in you all.
A Journey Beyond#086.dst: 我要用它把你們每個人身上的黑暗元素顯現出來。
A Journey Beyond#086.speaker: Dren

A Journey Beyond#087.src: And then, of course, a Light item, to purify all of you...
A Journey Beyond#087.dst: 然後，當然還要一件光之物品，用來淨化你們所有人……
A Journey Beyond#087.speaker: Dren

A Journey Beyond#088.src: Wait... what do you mean a Light item?
A Journey Beyond#088.dst: 等等……你說光之物品是什麼意思？
A Journey Beyond#088.speaker: Lucio

A Journey Beyond#089.src: Something from any Light creature would work, you could get some dust from Gavel faries if you wanted...
A Journey Beyond#089.dst: 任何光之生物身上的東西都可以，你們想的話，去弄一些 Gavel 精靈的粉塵也行……
A Journey Beyond#089.speaker: Dren

A Journey Beyond#090.src: Alright. Aledar, you get the darkness item with {u}, and I'll go get the Light item with Lucio.
A Journey Beyond#090.dst: 好。Aledar，你跟 {u} 去拿黑暗的物品，我跟 Lucio 去拿光的物品。
A Journey Beyond#090.speaker: Elphaba

A Journey Beyond#092.dst: 跟 Aledar 一起取得碎片。

A Journey Beyond#093.src: Here we are, the roots of Corruption. Let's go, {u}!
A Journey Beyond#093.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#094.src: We found that the caves around the roots are far more complex than we thought...
A Journey Beyond#094.dst: 我們發現這些根周圍的洞穴比想像中複雜得多……
A Journey Beyond#094.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#095.src: There's one with far more powerful creatures... Somewhere... Here!
A Journey Beyond#095.dst: 其中有一個裡面的生物強得多……在某個地方……在這裡！
A Journey Beyond#095.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#096.src: What are you waiting for? Let's go!
A Journey Beyond#096.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#097.src: I don't think we can spell our way across, {u}! We need something like... Wings!
A Journey Beyond#097.dst: 我不覺得我們能靠法術過去，{u}！我們需要像是……翅膀那種東西！
A Journey Beyond#097.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#098.src: I've never used wings like this before...
A Journey Beyond#098.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#099.src: I think if we just hold them and walk normally, it should help us glide across.
A Journey Beyond#099.dst: 我想只要拿著它、照平常走，應該就能滑過去。
A Journey Beyond#099.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#100.src: Don't drop them and don't get hit by the lava geysers, obviously.
A Journey Beyond#100.dst: 別鬆手，也別被岩漿噴泉打到，這還用說。
A Journey Beyond#100.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#101.src: Don't forget why we are here, we're looking for a creature of darkness. Shout for me if you find one.
A Journey Beyond#101.dst: 別忘了我們來做什麼，我們要找的是一隻黑暗生物。找到就喊我。
A Journey Beyond#101.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#102.src: Go deeper into the cave at [{~}, {~}, -{~}] for the Shard.

A Journey Beyond#103.src: That's our target! Go after it!
A Journey Beyond#103.dst: 那就是我們的目標！追上去！
A Journey Beyond#103.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#104.src: Wait, why isn't it fighting us here? Careful! It might be trapped!
A Journey Beyond#104.dst: 等等，牠為什麼不在這裡反擊？小心！牠可能被困住了！
A Journey Beyond#104.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#105.src: Chase the beast for the Shard.

A Journey Beyond#106.src: Kill the Progenitors to open up the entrance.
A Journey Beyond#106.dst: 擊殺 Progenitor 打開入口。

A Journey Beyond#107.src: Kill the Mangled Progeny for the [{~} Corrupted Pearl].
A Journey Beyond#107.dst: 擊殺 Mangled Progeny 取得 [{~} Corrupted Pearl]。

A Journey Beyond#108.src: Wow, I'm impressed . I honestly thought you would need my help.
A Journey Beyond#108.dst: 哇，我服了。我還真以為你會需要我幫忙。
A Journey Beyond#108.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#109.src: Well, we got what we came for. Let's head back to Dren.
A Journey Beyond#109.dst: 好啦，該拿的都拿到了。回去找 Dren 吧。
A Journey Beyond#109.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#110.src: Return to the Blacksmith with the Darkness Item.
A Journey Beyond#110.dst: 帶著黑暗物品回去找鐵匠。

A Journey Beyond#111.src: Looks like we lucked out on this one. Did you get an item of darkness?
A Journey Beyond#111.dst: 看樣子這次我們運氣不錯。黑暗的物品拿到了嗎？
A Journey Beyond#111.speaker: Dren

A Journey Beyond#112.src: That should do it. Let's see if this will work. Come here !
A Journey Beyond#112.dst: 這樣應該就夠了。來看看有沒有用。過來這裡！
A Journey Beyond#112.speaker: Dren

A Journey Beyond#113.src: It's done! You ought to be free of the dark influence. You ought to be able to break through that barrier that was giving you trouble.
A Journey Beyond#113.dst: 好了！你們身上的黑暗影響應該已經去掉了。那個一直擋著你們的屏障，現在應該打得穿了。
A Journey Beyond#113.speaker: Dren

A Journey Beyond#114.src: Are you sure? I don't feel that different. Well... I guess there's only one way to find out.
A Journey Beyond#114.dst: 你確定嗎？我沒覺得有什麼不同。嗯……我想只有一個辦法能知道。
A Journey Beyond#114.speaker: Elphaba

A Journey Beyond#115.src: Re-open the closed entrance with the other warriors.
A Journey Beyond#115.dst: 與其他戰士一起重新打開封住的入口。

A Journey Beyond#116.src: Everyone here? Great! Time to finish what I started!
A Journey Beyond#116.dst: 大家都到了嗎？很好！該把我開的頭收尾了！
A Journey Beyond#116.speaker: Lucio

A Journey Beyond#117.src: Lucio! No! When will you learn?
A Journey Beyond#117.dst: Lucio！不要！你什麼時候才學得乖？
A Journey Beyond#117.speaker: Elphaba

A Journey Beyond#118.src: Right, yes. Sorry, what's the plan?
A Journey Beyond#118.dst: 好啦好啦。抱歉，計畫是什麼？
A Journey Beyond#118.speaker: Lucio

A Journey Beyond#119.src: We don't want that thing to escape, it could cause widespread panic.
A Journey Beyond#119.dst: 我們不能讓那東西跑出去，會引起大規模恐慌的。
A Journey Beyond#119.speaker: Elphaba

A Journey Beyond#120.src: We'll open up a small entrance to get in, and fight it once inside.
A Journey Beyond#120.dst: 我們只開一個小入口進去，進去之後再打。
A Journey Beyond#120.speaker: Elphaba

A Journey Beyond#126.src: We have an extremely old map of the mines to help us, but we have no idea what's waiting for us.
A Journey Beyond#126.dst: 我們手上有一張非常舊的礦坑地圖可以參考，但完全不知道裡面等著我們的是什麼。
A Journey Beyond#126.speaker: Elphaba

A Journey Beyond#127.src: I want to warn you, this may well be a one way ticket for all of us.
A Journey Beyond#127.dst: 我要先提醒你們，這很可能是我們所有人的單程票。
A Journey Beyond#127.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#129.src: Rocks are one thing, Lucio. The creatures we're about to face require more than brute strength. You need force of mind.
A Journey Beyond#129.dst: 石頭是一回事，Lucio。我們接下來要面對的生物，光靠蠻力是不夠的。你需要的是意志力。
A Journey Beyond#129.speaker: Elphaba

A Journey Beyond#130.src: Oh my. Maybe this isn't the best idea.
A Journey Beyond#130.dst: 我的天。也許這不是什麼好主意。
A Journey Beyond#130.speaker: Lucio

A Journey Beyond#131.src: It's too late now. We've got to finish this mission.
A Journey Beyond#131.dst: 現在說這些太遲了。這個任務我們非完成不可。
A Journey Beyond#131.speaker: Elphaba

A Journey Beyond#133.src: Remember the goal Elphie, we must reach the end of the expanse.
A Journey Beyond#133.dst: 別忘了目標，Elphie，我們必須抵達這片區域的盡頭。
A Journey Beyond#133.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#134.src: It's still empty here. But it looks like they were here only yesterday.
A Journey Beyond#134.dst: 這裡還是空的。可是看起來他們昨天才剛離開。
A Journey Beyond#134.speaker: Elphaba

A Journey Beyond#135.src: I thought you said the miners were here hundreds of years ago?
A Journey Beyond#135.dst: 你不是說那些礦工是幾百年前的人嗎？
A Journey Beyond#135.speaker: Lucio

A Journey Beyond#136.src: They were. I don't know why it would be so well presevered. It's as if nothing has touched it.
A Journey Beyond#136.dst: 是啊。我不知道為什麼會保存得這麼完好。就好像什麼都沒碰過一樣。
A Journey Beyond#136.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#137.src: According to the documents, we need to make our way to the end of the road.
A Journey Beyond#137.dst: 根據文件，我們得一路走到這條路的盡頭。
A Journey Beyond#137.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#139.src: So much for nothing being here.
A Journey Beyond#139.speaker: Elphaba

A Journey Beyond#140.src: Why are they only going for me?
A Journey Beyond#140.speaker: Elphaba

A Journey Beyond#141.src: Aledar, how far is it to the end?
A Journey Beyond#141.speaker: Elphaba

A Journey Beyond#142.src: I read the same map as you. It didn't even have scale. There should be a bridge ahead, though.
A Journey Beyond#142.dst: 我看的地圖跟你一樣。上面連比例尺都沒有。不過前面應該有一座橋。
A Journey Beyond#142.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#143.src: Uhh... A destroyed one. And it wasn't cause I blew it up this time!
A Journey Beyond#143.dst: 呃……一座毀掉的橋。而且這次不是我炸的！
A Journey Beyond#143.speaker: Lucio

A Journey Beyond#144.src: Hmm, well we will have to go around.
A Journey Beyond#144.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#145.src: This doesn't really look like corruption, does it?
A Journey Beyond#145.dst: 這看起來不太像腐敗，對吧？
A Journey Beyond#145.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#146.src: Uhhh... I'm not feeling very wel-... Aahhh!
A Journey Beyond#146.dst: 呃……我覺得不太舒——……啊啊啊！
A Journey Beyond#146.speaker: Elphaba

A Journey Beyond#147.src: Aaahhh! My liver! It took my liver!
A Journey Beyond#147.dst: 啊啊啊！我的肝！它拿走了我的肝！
A Journey Beyond#147.speaker: Elphaba

A Journey Beyond#150.src: Aledar, maybe we should just double back now?
A Journey Beyond#150.dst: Aledar，也許我們現在就該掉頭？
A Journey Beyond#150.speaker: Lucio

A Journey Beyond#151.src: Elphaba is an extremely able warrior. We will fight on and find her.
A Journey Beyond#151.dst: Elphaba 是非常有能力的戰士。我們繼續打下去，把她找出來。
A Journey Beyond#151.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#152.src: Do you really think it was just an illusion?
A Journey Beyond#152.dst: 你真的覺得那只是幻覺嗎？
A Journey Beyond#152.speaker: Lucio

A Journey Beyond#153.src: I'm not sure. I hope so.
A Journey Beyond#153.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#154.src: What if we're infected too? Shouldn't we just go back?
A Journey Beyond#154.dst: 萬一我們也被感染了呢？我們不是該回去嗎？
A Journey Beyond#154.speaker: Lucio

A Journey Beyond#155.src: We can't, Lucio! We have a mission as you very well know. We continue.
A Journey Beyond#155.dst: 不行，Lucio！我們有任務在身，你很清楚。繼續走。
A Journey Beyond#155.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#156.src: Besides, we might be carrying some of those things too. We can't risk them infesting Wynn.
A Journey Beyond#156.dst: 何況我們身上可能也帶著那些東西。不能冒讓它們蔓延到 Wynn 的險。
A Journey Beyond#156.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#157.src: Looks like we need to go around to the right, here?
A Journey Beyond#157.dst: 看起來我們得從這裡往右繞，對吧？
A Journey Beyond#157.speaker: Lucio

A Journey Beyond#158.src: It feels like something is watching us...
A Journey Beyond#158.dst: 感覺有東西在看著我們……
A Journey Beyond#158.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#159.src: Aledar, what is this place? You didn't tell me there was a city here.
A Journey Beyond#159.dst: Aledar，這是什麼地方？你沒說過這裡有一座城。
A Journey Beyond#159.speaker: Lucio

A Journey Beyond#160.src: There is. A big one, too; there's more ahead. But it doesn't look like anyone's home . The map doesn't have a name for it either.
A Journey Beyond#160.dst: 有的。而且是很大一座；前面還有更多。不過看起來沒人在家。地圖上也沒給它名字。
A Journey Beyond#160.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#161.src: Wait a sec, is that one of the miners? Is she hurt? HEEEEY! YOU OVER THERE!
A Journey Beyond#161.dst: 等一下，那是不是其中一個礦工？她受傷了嗎？喂——！那邊那位！
A Journey Beyond#161.speaker: Lucio

A Journey Beyond#164.src: Wait, what's going on? Why can't I move?
A Journey Beyond#164.dst: 等等，怎麼回事？我為什麼動不了？
A Journey Beyond#164.speaker: Lucio

A Journey Beyond#167.src: We can't live alone like this!
A Journey Beyond#167.dst: 我們不能這樣一個人活下去！
A Journey Beyond#167.speaker: Obsessor

A Journey Beyond#170.src: You need to come with us!
A Journey Beyond#170.speaker: Obsessor

A Journey Beyond#171.src: It's the only way to keep you safe!
A Journey Beyond#171.dst: 只有這樣才能保你平安！
A Journey Beyond#171.speaker: Obsessor

A Journey Beyond#172.src: It's the only way to make you happy here!
A Journey Beyond#172.dst: 只有這樣你在這裡才會快樂！
A Journey Beyond#172.speaker: Obsessor

A Journey Beyond#173.src: It's the only way to make us feel whole!
A Journey Beyond#173.dst: 只有這樣我們才會覺得完整！
A Journey Beyond#173.speaker: Obsessor

A Journey Beyond#174.src: IT'S THE ONLY WAY, DO YOU UNDERSTAND?!
A Journey Beyond#174.dst: 只有這一條路，你懂不懂？！
A Journey Beyond#174.speaker: Obsessor

A Journey Beyond#175.src: AAAH! S-Stop screaming at me! I can't understand!!
A Journey Beyond#175.dst: 啊啊！別、別再對我吼了！我聽不懂！！
A Journey Beyond#175.speaker: Lucio

A Journey Beyond#178.src: CAN'T YOU HEAR WHAT I'M SAYING?
A Journey Beyond#178.dst: 你聽不見我在說什麼嗎？
A Journey Beyond#178.speaker: Obsessor

A Journey Beyond#180.src: No! How did she disable my spell?!
A Journey Beyond#180.dst: 不！她怎麼有辦法解掉我的法術？！
A Journey Beyond#180.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#182.src: YOU'LL BE SO MUCH HAPPIER IF YOU COME ALONG!
A Journey Beyond#182.dst: 你跟我們走會快樂得多！
A Journey Beyond#182.speaker: Obsessor

A Journey Beyond#183.src: YOU'LL NEVER HAVE TO WORRY AGAIN!
A Journey Beyond#183.dst: 你再也不用擔心任何事！
A Journey Beyond#183.speaker: Obsessor

A Journey Beyond#186.src: Just please, stand still a little longer!
A Journey Beyond#186.dst: 拜託，再站著別動一下下就好！
A Journey Beyond#186.speaker: Obsessor

A Journey Beyond#187.dst: 我們會帶你去溫暖的地方！
A Journey Beyond#187.speaker: Obsessor

A Journey Beyond#188.src: You won't be hunted! We promise! No one hunts us!
A Journey Beyond#188.dst: 不會有人追捕你！我們保證！沒有人會追捕我們！
A Journey Beyond#188.speaker: Obsessor

A Journey Beyond#190.src: THANK YOU! WE WILL GO TOGETHER!
A Journey Beyond#190.speaker: Obsessor

A Journey Beyond#191.dst: 跟我們在一起你會很安全！
A Journey Beyond#191.speaker: Obsessor

A Journey Beyond#192.src: NO MORE FEAR! NO MORE CONCERN!
A Journey Beyond#192.dst: 不再有恐懼！不再有煩惱！
A Journey Beyond#192.speaker: Obsessor

A Journey Beyond#194.src: No no no!! This is bad, really bad! We have to go ! Quick!
A Journey Beyond#194.dst: 不不不！！這下糟了，非常糟！我們得走了！快！
A Journey Beyond#194.speaker: Aledar
