A Journey Beyond#197.src: Wait, you're just one of the miners. This doesn't feel like an illusion...
A Journey Beyond#197.dst: 等等，你只是個礦工。這感覺不像幻覺……
A Journey Beyond#197.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#198.src: Look, you need to get out of here. It's not safe- Wait, what's that noise...?
A Journey Beyond#198.dst: 聽著，你得離開這裡。這裡不安全——等等，那是什麼聲音……？
A Journey Beyond#198.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#201.src: Find Aledar, Lucio and Elphaba in the Fallen City.
A Journey Beyond#201.dst: 在 Fallen City 找到 Aledar、Lucio 和 Elphaba。

A Journey Beyond#202.src: {u}! She was completely right. You ought to come with us...
A Journey Beyond#202.dst: {u}！她說得完全沒錯。你也應該跟我們走……
A Journey Beyond#202.speaker: Lucio

A Journey Beyond#203.src: Find Aledar and Elphaba in the Fallen City.
A Journey Beyond#203.dst: 在 Fallen City 找到 Aledar 和 Elphaba。

A Journey Beyond#204.src: Find Aledar in the Fallen City.
A Journey Beyond#204.dst: 在 Fallen City 找到 Aledar。

A Journey Beyond#206.src: I think my leg is broken. I have a potion to fix it, but I dropped it back up there.
A Journey Beyond#206.dst: 我的腿好像斷了。我有藥水可以治，但掉在上面了。
A Journey Beyond#206.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#207.src: I feel a bit better.. But something is still wrong.
A Journey Beyond#207.dst: 感覺好一點了……但還是有哪裡不對勁。
A Journey Beyond#207.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#208.src: Let's just get out of here, soldier on. There's only one way out.
A Journey Beyond#208.dst: 我們先離開這裡，撐著點。出去只有一條路。
A Journey Beyond#208.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#211.src: Urrrgh. {u}, this hasn't gone to plan. According to my map we aren't even half way.
A Journey Beyond#211.dst: 唔……{u}，事情完全脫離計畫了。照我的地圖看，我們連一半都還沒走到。
A Journey Beyond#211.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#212.src: I can't walk. But equally we can't stay here.
A Journey Beyond#212.dst: 我走不動了。可是我們也不能待在這裡。
A Journey Beyond#212.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#213.src: The mission must be carried out. The plan has changed but it's imperative we get to the end of the expanse, together.
A Journey Beyond#213.dst: 任務一定要完成。計畫變了，但我們非得一起走到這片區域的盡頭不可。
A Journey Beyond#213.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#214.src: There has to be a way.. Even if you have to push me in this thing!
A Journey Beyond#214.dst: 一定有辦法的……就算你得用這台東西把我推過去也一樣！
A Journey Beyond#214.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#215.src: No, I'm not joking. You guard the cart, I'll lead the way.
A Journey Beyond#215.dst: 不，我沒在開玩笑。你顧著推車，我來指路。
A Journey Beyond#215.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#216.src: Escort Aledar through the {p} to {p} at ({~}, -{~}).
A Journey Beyond#216.dst: 護送 Aledar 穿過 {p} 前往 ({~1}, -{~2}) 的 {p}。

A Journey Beyond#217.src: According to the map, the miners started a town a little ahead.
A Journey Beyond#217.dst: 照地圖看，礦工在前面不遠處建了一個小鎮。
A Journey Beyond#217.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#218.src: Who knows what's left, but it's got to be safer than here.
A Journey Beyond#218.dst: 誰知道還剩下什麼，但總比這裡安全。
A Journey Beyond#218.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#219.src: I think the Small Monsters will try to Kill me.
A Journey Beyond#219.dst: 我猜小型怪物會想殺我。
A Journey Beyond#219.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#220.src: While the Big Monsters will try to Kill you.
A Journey Beyond#220.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#221.src: It's going to be on you to make sure we both get through this.
A Journey Beyond#221.dst: 能不能讓我們兩個都活著過去，就看你了。
A Journey Beyond#221.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#222.src: The fate of the mission relies on the two of us working together.
A Journey Beyond#222.dst: 任務的成敗，就靠我們兩個配合。
A Journey Beyond#222.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#223.src: Are those... Eyes on the trees?
A Journey Beyond#223.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#225.src: Watch out, the small monsters are coming for me! I can't fight in this thing!
A Journey Beyond#225.dst: 注意，小型怪物往我這邊來了！我坐在這東西上沒辦法打！
A Journey Beyond#225.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#227.src: Great job! It looks like they've stopped coming. Let's keep going.
A Journey Beyond#227.dst: 幹得好！看起來牠們不來了。繼續走吧。
A Journey Beyond#227.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#229.src: Let's keep going! Before they come back.
A Journey Beyond#229.dst: 趁牠們回來之前，我們繼續走！
A Journey Beyond#229.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#230.src: A lot of those small ones are coming for me!
A Journey Beyond#230.dst: 好多小的往我這邊衝過來了！
A Journey Beyond#230.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#231.src: This one was close! We're getting close to the town.
A Journey Beyond#231.dst: 這隻好險！我們快到鎮上了。
A Journey Beyond#231.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#232.src: We'll have to stop again! We can't go past so many monsters.
A Journey Beyond#232.dst: 我們得再停一次！怪物太多了，過不去。
A Journey Beyond#232.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#233.src: We're almost there! I can see the town from here!
A Journey Beyond#233.dst: 快到了！我從這裡看得到那個鎮！
A Journey Beyond#233.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#235.src: Great job! It looks like they've stopped coming. Let's keep going.
A Journey Beyond#235.dst: 幹得好！看起來牠們不來了。繼續走吧。
A Journey Beyond#235.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#236.src: Ouch! I got hit! Be careful, {u}!
A Journey Beyond#236.dst: 唉唷！我被打到了！小心點，{u}！
A Journey Beyond#236.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#237.src: Finally, we've arrived... It's not exactly the town on the map.
A Journey Beyond#237.dst: 總算到了……跟地圖上的那個鎮不太一樣。
A Journey Beyond#237.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#238.src: The lost miners are here... How? they must be hundreds of years old!
A Journey Beyond#238.dst: 失蹤的礦工都在這裡……怎麼可能？他們應該是幾百年前的人了！
A Journey Beyond#238.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#239.src: What is this obelisk? It's.. comforting. I recognise this feeling from my time in Gavel.
A Journey Beyond#239.dst: 這個方尖碑是什麼？它……讓人安心。我在 Gavel 的時候感受過這種感覺。
A Journey Beyond#239.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#240.src: Maybe.. It's been touched by the light? If so.. It could heal me.
A Journey Beyond#240.dst: 說不定……它被光碰觸過？如果是的話……它也許能治好我。
A Journey Beyond#240.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#241.src: Let's see if it does anything to me...
A Journey Beyond#241.dst: 來看看它對我有沒有用……
A Journey Beyond#241.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#242.src: It worked... Kind of. I feel at least {~}.. We still have a ways to go.
A Journey Beyond#242.dst: 有用……算是吧。我至少覺得 {~}……我們還有一段路要走。
A Journey Beyond#242.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#243.src: Let's take some time to gather ourselves before we press on. I'll meet you on the other side of town.
A Journey Beyond#243.dst: 在繼續之前，我們花點時間整頓一下。我在鎮的另一頭等你。
A Journey Beyond#243.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#001.src: Alright, let’s go. I’ll tell you more about our journey on the way.
A Journey Further#001.dst: 好，走吧。路上我再多跟你說說這趟任務的事。
A Journey Further#001.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#002.dst: 跟著 Aledar 繼續前進。

A Journey Further#003.src: We should try to follow the path as closely as we can. You lead, I'll follow.
A Journey Further#003.dst: 我們盡量沿著這條路走。你帶頭，我跟著。
A Journey Further#003.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#008.src: Good work. Seems that killing the king made the other creatures run off. We’re lucky about that-
A Journey Further#008.dst: 幹得好。看樣子首領一死，其他東西就跑光了。這算我們走運——
A Journey Further#008.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#009.src: Wait, {u}, what's going on? Are you alright?
A Journey Further#009.dst: 等等，{u}，怎麼回事？你還好嗎？
A Journey Further#009.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#010.src: Oh, no no! I have a potion for this, where is it, where is it, aha! Here, drink!
A Journey Further#010.dst: 噢，不不不！我有藥水可以治這個，放哪去了、放哪去了，啊哈！來，喝下去！
A Journey Further#010.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#011.src: One of those things must have infected your wounds... Everything in this area looks completely hazardous and sickening.
A Journey Further#011.dst: 一定是那些東西感染了你的傷口……這一帶的東西看起來全都又毒又髒。
A Journey Further#011.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#012.src: I expected the worst, so I tried to bring anything and everything that might help. Let's keep moving.
A Journey Further#012.dst: 我早就做了最壞的打算，所以能帶的東西我全帶上了。繼續走吧。
A Journey Further#012.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#013.src: Continue on the main path with Aledar.
A Journey Further#013.dst: 跟著 Aledar 沿主路前進。

A Journey Further#016.src: I'm... I'm going to lead us for now. At least for a little...while... I can't have you g-getting-
A Journey Further#016.dst: 我……我先帶路吧。至少撐一……一段路……我不能讓你再受——
A Journey Further#016.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#018.src: ...urgh... I...sorry. I just... I need a moment.
A Journey Further#018.dst: ……唔……我……抱歉。我只是……需要緩一下。
A Journey Further#018.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#019.src: {u}, you just... you have to realize, I can't have you getting hurt.
A Journey Further#019.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#020.src: I want to stress this... We NEED to get to the end of this path, together.
A Journey Further#020.dst: 我要把話講清楚……我們必須一起走到這條路的盡頭。
A Journey Further#020.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#022.src: Okay. I'm as good as I can get right now. Let's move.
A Journey Further#022.dst: 好了。我現在能好的就這樣了。走吧。
A Journey Further#022.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#023.src: Ah? What... What just... Why do I...
A Journey Further#023.dst: 啊？什麼……剛剛那是……我怎麼會……
A Journey Further#023.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#024.src: I'll be fine, I just...why did I feel so empty all of the sudden... ?
A Journey Further#024.dst: 我沒事，只是……為什麼突然覺得整個人空了一塊……？
A Journey Further#024.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#025.src: Oh no, I think something is coming... {u}! Fight it off, I don't think I can defend myself right now!
A Journey Further#025.dst: 糟了，好像有東西過來了……{u}！你擋一下，我現在連自己都護不住！
A Journey Further#025.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#026.src: Defend Aledar from the Radiated Spiders.
A Journey Further#026.dst: 保護 Aledar，擊退 Radiated Spider。

A Journey Further#027.src: Huff... Not feeling totally better, but... At least I can still defend myself.
A Journey Further#027.dst: 呼……還沒完全恢復，不過……至少我還能自保。
A Journey Further#027.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#028.src: My stomach is empty, I can't even vomit... Why so I still feel so dizzy? Maybe a potion will help...
A Journey Further#028.dst: 胃裡空空的，想吐都吐不出來……為什麼還是這麼暈？也許喝點藥水會好一些……
A Journey Further#028.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#030.src: Urgh, pfft! My vomit tasted better than that coming up...
A Journey Further#030.dst: 嘔，呸！這味道比我吐出來的還難喝……
A Journey Further#030.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#031.src: Hah...that's the ticket. Which potion was this anyways... ... hair loss treatment? Why did THAT work?
A Journey Further#031.dst: 哈……這瓶對了。話說回來這到底是什麼藥水……生髮水？這東西為什麼會有效？
A Journey Further#031.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#032.src: Though, you saw what happened to that beast I attacked? Follow me.
A Journey Further#032.dst: 對了，你剛剛看到我打飛的那隻怪物怎麼了嗎？跟我來。
A Journey Further#032.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#033.src: This, from what I recall of the mission statements, is referred to as a "Void Hole." It's a sort of portal.
A Journey Further#033.dst: 照我記得的任務簡報，這東西叫「Void Hole」，是一種傳送門。
A Journey Further#033.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#034.src: They connect to each other in odd ways, but we saw the beast come out of that one when I knocked it in, so...
A Journey Further#034.dst: 它們彼此之間連接的方式很怪，不過我把那隻怪物打進去之後，牠是從那一頭出來的，所以——
A Journey Further#034.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#035.src: Watch. I'll come out the other side.
A Journey Further#035.dst: 看好。我會從另一頭出來。
A Journey Further#035.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#036.src: Alright, good! It does connect up consistently, at least. You try now.
A Journey Further#036.dst: 好，很好！至少連接的位置是固定的。換你試試。
A Journey Further#036.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#038.src: Continue on the trail with Aledar.
A Journey Further#038.dst: 跟著 Aledar 沿小徑前進。

A Journey Further#039.src: I bring this up because if we're seeing one, we'll be seeing more soon. You'll need to adjust yourself to the sight of them.
A Journey Further#039.dst: 我會提這件事，是因為既然看到了一個，接下來一定還會看到更多。你得先習慣它們的樣子。
A Journey Further#039.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#041.src: We grossly underestimated the difficulties we would have here. And, by that, I mean myself, Elphie, and Lucio did...
A Journey Further#041.dst: 我們嚴重低估了這裡的難度。而且我說的「我們」，是指我、Elphie 和 Lucio……
A Journey Further#041.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#042.src: We were each unprepared and cocky. If it weren't for you, I'd be dead now, for what it's worth.
A Journey Further#042.dst: 我們每一個都準備不足又自以為是。要不是有你，我現在早就死了，這話我說得出口。
A Journey Further#042.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#043.src: I wasn't certain at first about you coming along, but you've more than shown you were the right one for the job.
A Journey Further#043.dst: 一開始我對你同行這件事沒什麼把握，但你已經證明得夠多了——這趟就該是你來。
A Journey Further#043.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#044.src: ...I had to figure this map was outdated. This wall of spikes isn't listed on it, and the path goes through here!
A Journey Further#044.dst: ……我早該想到這張地圖過時了。上面根本沒標這道尖刺牆，而路就是從這裡穿過去的！
A Journey Further#044.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#045.src: I'll have to assume they're new...and if they're new, I might be able to bash through them.
A Journey Further#045.dst: 只能當作是新長出來的……既然是新的，也許我能把它砸開。
A Journey Further#045.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#046.src: {u}, try throwing a spell at the same time! Let's crack through these things!
A Journey Further#046.dst: {u}，你同時丟一個法術過來！我們把這些東西轟破！
A Journey Further#046.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#048.src: ...aagh... I... H-how are these so resilient...?
A Journey Further#048.dst: ……啊啊……我……這、這些東西怎麼會這麼硬……？
A Journey Further#048.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#049.src: I'm an idiot... I nearly killed myself trying that. I nearly ruined the mission...
A Journey Further#049.dst: 我真是個白痴……剛剛差點把自己弄死。差點毀了整個任務……
A Journey Further#049.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#050.src: I'm sorry, but you'll have to go without me. I can't move another step for now.
A Journey Further#050.dst: 抱歉，接下來你得自己走了。我現在連一步都動不了。
A Journey Further#050.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#051.src: There's a lot of void holes around here, remember my warning... You can probably get past these spikes with one.
A Journey Further#051.dst: 這一帶有很多 Void Hole，記得我剛才說的……你大概可以靠它繞到尖刺後面。
A Journey Further#051.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#052.src: If I'd been thinking I would have suggested it earlier... Once you're past, we'll... uh. We'll do something.
A Journey Further#052.dst: 我要是早點想到就好了……等你過去之後，我們再……呃。再想辦法。
A Journey Further#052.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#053.src: Just...be careful where you go. The void holes could lead anywhere. They might lead you someplace very, very dangerous, too dangerous even for you. I pray they won't...
A Journey Further#053.dst: 只是……小心你要去的地方。Void Hole 可能通往任何地方，也可能把你送到非常、非常危險的地方，危險到連你都應付不來。我只能祈禱不會……
A Journey Further#053.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#054.src: There's a void hole right there to try out first. Get going, now. You have to do this.
A Journey Further#054.dst: 那邊就有一個 Void Hole，先拿它試試。快去吧。這件事非你不可。
A Journey Further#054.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#055.src: Use Void Holes to try and get behind the spike barrier
A Journey Further#055.dst: 利用 Void Hole 設法繞到尖刺屏障後方

A Journey Further#056.src: Find a way to help Aledar get to the other side of the spike barrier.
A Journey Further#056.dst: 想辦法幫 Aledar 到尖刺屏障的另一邊。

A Journey Further#057.src: ...wait, {u}? You got to the other side then...? Good...
A Journey Further#057.dst: ……等等，{u}？你已經到另一邊了……？太好了……
A Journey Further#057.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#058.src: I don't know what you did, but whatever it was, it's made cracks in the spikes that I can see from this side.
A Journey Further#058.dst: 我不知道你做了什麼，但不管是什麼，尖刺上出現的裂痕從這一側都看得見。
A Journey Further#058.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#059.src: I've got some of my energy back...let's try spellcasting again. If we do it at the same time, we might make some headway.
A Journey Further#059.dst: 我恢復了一點力氣……再試一次法術吧。如果我們同時施法，也許能打開一個缺口。
A Journey Further#059.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#060.src: I won't crack my skull open on the spikes again though. Promise.
A Journey Further#060.dst: 這次我不會再拿頭去撞尖刺了。我保證。
A Journey Further#060.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#061.src: You lead. I'll cast my spell as soon as I hear yours.
A Journey Further#061.dst: 你先動手。我一聽到你的法術就跟上。
A Journey Further#061.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#062.src: Thank god it worked... That's our destination there, the Eldritch Outlook.
A Journey Further#062.dst: 謝天謝地，成功了……那裡就是我們的目的地，Eldritch Outlook。
A Journey Further#062.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#063.src: Now comes the hardest part... Come along. I'll need you there for it.
A Journey Further#063.dst: 最難的部分來了……跟我來。這一段我需要你在場。
A Journey Further#063.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#064.src: That blade there...it's made for sacrifice. See how that gate is shut?
A Journey Further#064.dst: 那邊那把劍……是用來獻祭的。看到那道門是關著的嗎？
A Journey Further#064.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#065.src: In order to open the doors to the Outlook, we need to sacrifice a powerful soul.
A Journey Further#065.dst: 要打開通往 Outlook 的門，我們得獻祭一個強大的靈魂。
A Journey Further#065.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#066.src: We... we should have told you from the start. You and Lucio. Elphie and I, we knew. We knew this would be here.
A Journey Further#066.dst: 我們……我們一開始就該告訴你的。你和 Lucio 都不知道。Elphie 和我知道。我們早就知道這裡有這個。
A Journey Further#066.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#067.src: We didn't have... we didn't have a sacrifice in mind. We decided that it would be best decided once we reached that point. And I think we both knew it would have to be one of us.
A Journey Further#067.dst: 我們沒有……我們心裡沒有預定的人選。我們說好等真的走到這一步再決定。而我想我們兩個都清楚，最後一定是我們其中一個。
A Journey Further#067.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#068.src: ...I think she would have insisted it be her. Even though both of us had something we would be le...
A Journey Further#068.dst: ……我想她會堅持由她來。即使我們兩個都還有放不下的……
A Journey Further#068.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#069.src: It doesn't matter now. It's just us left. And I've been mulling it over since we got to the town... you'll sacrifice me. I won't take no for an answer.
A Journey Further#069.dst: 現在說這些也沒意義了。只剩我們了。從進到那座鎮上開始我就一直在想這件事……由你來獻祭我。這件事我不接受拒絕。
A Journey Further#069.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#070.src: I mean... look at the state I'm in, {u}! I'm on death's door already, and you've proven yourself far stronger than I am even at my best.
A Journey Further#070.dst: 你看看我現在這副樣子，{u}！我已經站在鬼門關前了，而你早就證明自己遠比全盛時期的我還強。
A Journey Further#070.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#071.src: Here. You can take everything I had on me. My emeralds, and the key to the dungeon. I certainly won't be able to use them anymore.
A Journey Further#071.dst: 拿去。我身上的東西你全帶走。我的綠寶石，還有地城的鑰匙。反正我也用不到了。
A Journey Further#071.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#072.src: Upon the top of the tower is... Well, something. We don't know for certain what it is, but it will prevent you from passing through.
A Journey Further#072.dst: 塔頂上有……嗯，某個東西。我們不確定那究竟是什麼，但它會擋住你的去路。
A Journey Further#072.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#073.src: You'll have to kill it to break the barrier. But... find other soldiers who can help you. It will be impossible to defeat alone.
A Journey Further#073.dst: 你得殺了它才能破除屏障。不過……去找其他能幫你的士兵。一個人是打不贏的。
A Journey Further#073.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#074.src: ...no more putting it off, then. I'm bleeding out.
A Journey Further#074.dst: ……那就別再拖了。我血快流乾了。
A Journey Further#074.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#076.src: Right click to grab the blade in the altar.

A Journey Further#077.src: Now...strike me down. My soul will unlock the gate...
A Journey Further#077.dst: 現在……砍下來吧。我的靈魂會打開那道門……
A Journey Further#077.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#080.src: You...can do this. I know y-you can.
A Journey Further#080.dst: 你……做得到的。我知道你、你可以。
A Journey Further#080.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#082.dst: 那隻一直在看著我們的怪物……
A Journey Further#082.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Home#001.src: Explore near where you originally arrived in Wynn.
A Journey Home#001.dst: 在你當初抵達 Wynn 的地方附近探索。

A Journey Home#003.src: Continue back down the path to Fruma.

A Journey Home#004.src: This job is impossible!! Why am I even here?!
A Journey Home#004.dst: 這活根本做不完！！我到底為什麼會在這裡？！
A Journey Home#004.speaker: Paxon

A Journey Home#005.src: Ah! You're a soldier, right? Look, I It's, it's just a really difficult time right now.
A Journey Home#005.dst: 啊！你是士兵吧？聽我說，我——現在真的是非常難熬的時候。
A Journey Home#005.speaker: Lieutenant Tolv

A Journey Home#006.src: This, this whole situation is definitely above my paygrade! I don't know how I'm going to deal with this...
A Journey Home#006.dst: 這、這整件事絕對超出我的職權範圍了！我不知道該怎麼處理……
A Journey Home#006.speaker: Lieutenant Tolv

A Journey Home#007.src: Enough of that, I, ah, I suppose. What is it you need?
A Journey Home#007.dst: 算了，我、呃，我想也夠了。你需要什麼？
A Journey Home#007.speaker: Lieutenant Tolv

A Journey Home#008.src: Oh. Oh no. Ah, I, you see, that'll be a problem, I think. What do you even need to do at the border anyway?
A Journey Home#008.dst: 噢。噢不。呃，我，你看，那恐怕會有點問題。話說回來，你去邊境到底要做什麼？
A Journey Home#008.speaker: Lieutenant Tolv

A Journey Home#009.src: I can't really imagine what you could need there, but, whatever it is, it'll need to wait! This Corkian drill won't work, and Paxon's stuck, and
A Journey Home#009.dst: 我實在想不出你在那裡能有什麼事，但不管是什麼，都得等！這台 Corkian 鑽機不動了，Paxon 又困在裡面，還有——
A Journey Home#009.speaker: Lieutenant Tolv

A Journey Home#010.src: Look, I'm...I'm sorry for snapping at you. I'm trained for military operation, not for cave-in clearance, but no one else was available!
A Journey Home#010.dst: 抱歉，我……我不該對你發脾氣。我受的是軍事行動訓練，不是清塌方的訓練，可是沒有別人能來！
A Journey Home#010.speaker: Lieutenant Tolv

A Journey Home#011.src: Even the demolitions expert I hired is stuck, so it's all just, it's all going wrong and I don't know what to do.
A Journey Home#011.dst: 連我雇來的爆破專家都困住了，所以事情全亂了，我根本不知道該怎麼辦。
A Journey Home#011.speaker: Lieutenant Tolv

A Journey Home#012.src: You see that new entrance over there? The expert, Paxon, has been in there for almost as long as I was trying this dud machine.
A Journey Home#012.dst: 看到那邊那個新開的洞口了嗎？那位專家，Paxon，進去的時間差不多跟我搞這台廢鐵一樣久了。
A Journey Home#012.speaker: Lieutenant Tolv

A Journey Home#013.src: If you think you can do a job better than an expert, go ahead and talk with them, but I'm pretty sure you'll have to cancel whatever plans you had.
A Journey Home#013.dst: 如果你覺得自己比專家更行，那就去跟他們談吧，不過我很確定你原本的計畫是得取消了。
A Journey Home#013.speaker: Lieutenant Tolv

A Journey Home#014.src: Talk to the Demolition Mage at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
A Journey Home#014.dst: 跟 Demolition Mage 說話，座標 [-{~1}, {~2}, -{~3}]。

A Journey Home#015.src: If you really need to get to the border, your best bet is to talk to Paxon in the new cave entrance.
A Journey Home#015.dst: 如果你真的非去邊境不可，最好的辦法是去新洞口找 Paxon 談。
A Journey Home#015.speaker: Lieutenant Tolv

A Journey Home#016.src: But, they're an expert, so I think your business will have to wait. Really, really sorry about all this!
A Journey Home#016.dst: 但他們是專家，所以我想你的事還是得等。這一切真的、真的很抱歉！
A Journey Home#016.speaker: Lieutenant Tolv

A Journey Home#017.src: Oh no, not another one I don't care what rank you are, what you're asking is impossible! Even for me, it
A Journey Home#017.dst: 噢不，又來一個——我不管你是什麼階級，你要的事情根本辦不到！就算是我也——
A Journey Home#017.speaker: Paxon

A Journey Home#018.src: Wait, you aren't part of the... You're just a regular soldier. You're just trying to get through here, aren't you?
A Journey Home#018.dst: 等等，你不是那邊的……你只是個普通士兵。你只是想從這裡過去，對吧？
A Journey Home#018.speaker: Paxon

A Journey Home#019.src: May as well give up now! Not happening. No way. You're wasting your time, and let me tell you exactly why.
A Journey Home#019.dst: 現在放棄還來得及！不可能。門都沒有。你在浪費時間，我把原因一條條講給你聽。
A Journey Home#019.speaker: Paxon

A Journey Home#020.src: You see that blue rock over there? It's a break point. If I could set off explosives at it, it'd open a path.
A Journey Home#020.dst: 看到那邊那塊藍色的岩石了嗎？那是斷點。只要能在那裡引爆炸藥，就能炸出一條路。
A Journey Home#020.speaker: Paxon

A Journey Home#021.src: But apparently all these structures set up are so important that any of it being damaged, or MOVED, is unacceptable!
A Journey Home#021.dst: 但這裡搭的每一個東西顯然都重要到不得了，只要有任何一樣被弄壞、或是被「移動」，就是不行！
A Journey Home#021.speaker: Paxon

A Journey Home#022.src: And to make sure I'm 'supervised' while the lieutenant is working on the drill, the detonator HAS to be here.
A Journey Home#022.dst: 而且為了在中尉忙著修鑽機的時候還能「監督」我，起爆器非得放在這裡不可。
A Journey Home#022.speaker: Paxon

A Journey Home#023.src: So I have to daisy-chain a limited amount of explosives all the way over to the stone, without blasting any structures!
A Journey Home#023.dst: 所以我得用有限的炸藥一路串接到那塊石頭，中途還不能炸壞任何一個建物！
A Journey Home#023.speaker: Paxon

A Journey Home#024.src: I've been trying for hours and gotten absolutely nowhere! I'm one of the best in my field, even! It's ridiculous!!
A Journey Home#024.dst: 我搞了好幾個小時，一點進展都沒有！我可是這行數一數二的人！這太荒謬了！！
A Journey Home#024.speaker: Paxon

A Journey Home#025.src: If you feel like wasting your time, here's my stock of explosives. Feel free to try your hand at it, but you really should just go.
A Journey Home#025.dst: 如果你想浪費時間，這是我的炸藥存貨。你儘管試，不過你真的該走了。
A Journey Home#025.speaker: Paxon

A Journey Home#026.src: Use the TNT to open up a path through the cave.
A Journey Home#026.dst: 用 TNT 在洞穴中炸出一條路。

A Journey Home#027.src: Still at it? What, do you need a reminder? I've got nothing better to do.
A Journey Home#027.dst: 還在弄？怎麼，要我再講一次嗎？反正我也沒別的事做。
A Journey Home#027.speaker: Paxon

A Journey Home#028.src: So the blue rock is soft enough to crack with the explosives. But the detonator's stuck here.
A Journey Home#028.dst: 藍色的岩石夠脆，炸藥可以炸開。但起爆器卡在這裡。
A Journey Home#028.speaker: Paxon

A Journey Home#029.src: So we need to use the TNT Placer to daisy-chain blasts from the detonator, without blasting any tents, crates, or walls.
A Journey Home#029.dst: 所以我們得用 TNT Placer 從起爆器一路串接爆炸，而且不能炸到任何帳篷、木箱或牆。
A Journey Home#029.speaker: Paxon

A Journey Home#030.src: You can look at placed TNT to see its blast radius, as well.
A Journey Home#030.dst: 放好的 TNT 你可以看一下，能看到它的爆炸範圍。
A Journey Home#030.speaker: Paxon

A Journey Home#031.src: But given how tight the squeeze between some of those structures is, there's just no way it's happening.
A Journey Home#031.dst: 不過有幾個建物之間的縫隙那麼窄，這根本不可能成功。
A Journey Home#031.speaker: Paxon

A Journey Home#032.src: Like I said, you really should just mosey on back to the castle. If I can't get anywhere, I don't think you'll fare better.
A Journey Home#032.dst: 我說了，你真的該乖乖回城堡去。連我都弄不出結果，我不覺得你會比較行。
A Journey Home#032.speaker: Paxon

A Journey Home#035.src: Halt! Where did you come from? There was a cave-in past here, wasn't there?
A Journey Home#035.dst: 站住！你從哪來的？這後面不是塌方了嗎？
A Journey Home#035.speaker: Guard

A Journey Home#036.src: A new path, huh? I didn't think you'd have things to be doing back here, though I won't say I'm ungrateful.
A Journey Home#036.dst: 新的路，是嗎？我沒想到你在這後頭還有事要辦，不過我也不能說不感激。
A Journey Home#036.speaker: Guard

A Journey Home#037.src: It even crushed the grook's nest there. I've been working off field rations for a few days. So where are you headed?
A Journey Home#037.dst: 連那邊 grook 的巢都被壓垮了。我已經吃了好幾天的野戰口糧。所以你要去哪？
A Journey Home#037.speaker: Guard

A Journey Home#038.src: The border? I suppose if you're headed there, it must be important, official business. Although, it might have to wait.
A Journey Home#038.dst: 邊境？我想你既然要去那裡，一定是重要的公務。不過，恐怕得等一等。
A Journey Home#038.speaker: Guard

A Journey Home#039.src: The bridge repair was something of a hackjob. It may not bear up your weight. Now that the cave-in's clear, we might be able to get it fixed proper...
A Journey Home#039.dst: 那座橋修得相當草率。它未必撐得住你的重量。既然塌方清掉了，也許我們能好好把它修一修……
A Journey Home#039.speaker: Guard

A Journey Home#040.src: But that'll take time. I'd just as soon turn back whatever business you have isn't worth your life, after all.
A Journey Home#040.dst: 但那要時間。我倒寧願你掉頭回去——不管你有什麼事，都不值得拿命去換。
A Journey Home#040.speaker: Guard

A Journey Home#042.src: Say, I think I recognize you, actually. That's a rarity for this line of work.
A Journey Home#042.dst: 說起來，我好像認得你。幹這行的能碰到熟面孔可不容易。
A Journey Home#042.speaker: Guard

A Journey Home#043.src: Are you sure that what you have to do is worth it? That bridge is awful rickety. Wouldn't want to lose you.
A Journey Home#043.dst: 你確定你要做的事值得嗎？那座橋搖得厲害。我可不想失去你這樣的人。
A Journey Home#043.speaker: Guard

A Journey Home#044.src: Continue back down the path to Fruma.

A Journey Home#045.src: Hey, you there! Come talk to me before you pass through.
A Journey Home#045.dst: 喂，那邊那位！過去之前先過來跟我說話。
A Journey Home#045.speaker: Soldier

A Journey Home#046.src: Hey, you! Come talk to me first, recruit!
A Journey Home#046.dst: 喂，你！先過來跟我說話，新兵！
A Journey Home#046.speaker: Soldier

A Journey Home#047.src: Coming or going, I'm under strict orders to intercept soldiers and make sure they're equipped before heading on.
A Journey Home#047.dst: 不管是要進還是要出，我接到的命令很明確：攔下士兵，確認裝備齊全才能放行。
A Journey Home#047.speaker: Soldier

A Journey Home#048.src: No exceptions, not for any reason. Especially not since the cave-in across the river!
A Journey Home#048.dst: 沒有例外，什麼理由都不行。尤其是河對岸塌方之後！
A Journey Home#048.speaker: Soldier

A Journey Home#049.src: Nothing's more important than your life, and moving on without being suited up could cost you it!
A Journey Home#049.dst: 沒有什麼比你的命更重要，沒穿好裝備就上路，可能會要了你的命！
A Journey Home#049.speaker: Soldier

A Journey Home#050.src: Well, let me take a look and see if this stuff is up to regulation.
A Journey Home#050.dst: 好，我看看這身行頭合不合規定。
A Journey Home#050.speaker: Soldier

A Journey Home#051.src: Hmm... Ah, yep, signs of wear all over... Armor not polished... Weapon looks liable to fall apart any second...
A Journey Home#051.dst: 唔……啊，對，到處都是磨損的痕跡……護甲沒擦亮……武器看起來隨時會散開……
A Journey Home#051.speaker: Soldier

A Journey Home#052.src: I'm surprised you made it ten feet out here with those rusty trinkets! This is no way to protect yourself!
A Journey Home#052.dst: 帶著這些生鏽的破爛還能走這麼遠，我真是佩服！這樣根本保護不了自己！
A Journey Home#052.speaker: Soldier

A Journey Home#053.src: Look, there's a loot chest in the cave just there, so you need to head in and get yourself some proper equipment.
A Journey Home#053.dst: 聽著，就在那邊的洞穴裡有個寶箱，你得進去弄一套像樣的裝備。
A Journey Home#053.speaker: Soldier

A Journey Home#054.src: ...that so, huh? Well, I think you should take a second look up ahead.
A Journey Home#054.dst: ……是這樣嗎？那我想你該再往前面看一眼。
A Journey Home#054.speaker: Soldier

A Journey Home#055.src: See? Now no more guff about levels you either gear up properly, or you don't pass! I won't have you risking your life.
A Journey Home#055.dst: 看到沒？別再拿等級當藉口了——要嘛好好換裝，要嘛別想過去！我不會讓你拿命去賭。
A Journey Home#055.speaker: Soldier

A Journey Home#056.src: You can find good stuff in caves, like the one just next to me, so hop to it.
A Journey Home#056.dst: 洞穴裡常有好東西，就像我旁邊這個，快去吧。
A Journey Home#056.speaker: Soldier

A Journey Home#057.src: Like I said, coming or going. No matter what, you should gear up by looting the cave here before heading onwards.
A Journey Home#057.dst: 我說了，進出都一樣。不管怎樣，繼續上路之前你都該先把這邊的洞穴搜一搜、換上裝備。
A Journey Home#057.speaker: Soldier

A Journey Home#058.src: Good stuff. There's a loot chest in that cave there, so you should find everything you need. Get to it!
A Journey Home#058.dst: 好東西。那個洞穴裡有個寶箱，你要的應該都找得到。快去！
A Journey Home#058.speaker: Soldier

A Journey Home#059.src: Explore the cave to find some loot.

A Journey Home#060.src: Enter the cave and open the loot chest.
A Journey Home#060.speaker: Soldier

A Journey Home#061.src: Continue back down the path to Fruma.

A Journey Home#062.src: That looks like the stuff. You can take that armor to an Item Identifier right there, and then you can wear it once identified.
A Journey Home#062.dst: 看起來就是那種東西。你可以把那件護甲拿去那邊的 Item Identifier 鑑定，鑑定完就能穿了。
A Journey Home#062.speaker: Soldier

A Journey Home#063.src: Though... since you seem to be heading back to the border... I have to ask why. It's pretty unusual. Probably best you head back to {p}.
A Journey Home#063.dst: 不過……既然你看起來是要往邊境回去……我還是得問一句為什麼。這很不尋常。你最好還是回 {p} 去。
A Journey Home#063.speaker: Soldier

A Journey Home#064.src: If other recruits see you coming the other way, they might get confused, or discouraged. Wouldn't want to risk that, right?
A Journey Home#064.dst: 要是其他新兵看到你反方向走，他們可能會困惑，或是灰心。你也不想冒這個險吧？
A Journey Home#064.speaker: Soldier

A Journey Home#065.src: Are you sure whatever you're doing is worth it? Maybe you should just head back to town.
A Journey Home#065.dst: 你確定你要做的事值得嗎？也許你該直接回鎮上。
A Journey Home#065.speaker: Soldier

A Journey Home#066.src: Avoid the Fruman recruits on the path.

A Journey Home#067.src: ...been recruiting Fruman soldiers for the war effort. Apparently things are really bad over there. Makes me nervous...
A Journey Home#067.dst: ……一直在為戰事招募 Fruma 的士兵。聽說那邊情況真的很糟。搞得我很不安……
A Journey Home#067.speaker: Fruman Recruit

A Journey Home#068.src: Walking corpses aren't anything I'm going to underestimate, but it can't be all doom and gloom, right?
A Journey Home#068.dst: 會走的屍體我可不敢小看，不過總不會全都是壞消息吧？
A Journey Home#068.speaker: Fruman Recruit

A Journey Home#069.src: I suppose we'll see once we pass this gate. It marks the border... Deep breaths, deep breaths...
A Journey Home#069.dst: 我想過了這道門就知道了。那裡就是邊境……深呼吸，深呼吸……
A Journey Home#069.speaker: Fruman Recruit

A Journey Home#070.src: ...know anything about Wynn? I didn't get any debriefing.
A Journey Home#070.dst: ……你知道 Wynn 的事嗎？我完全沒收到任何簡報。
A Journey Home#070.speaker: Fruman Recruit

A Journey Home#071.src: I remember rumors... Something about a great hero. Name started with...and R?
A Journey Home#071.dst: 我記得有些傳聞……好像有個了不起的英雄。名字是 R 開頭的？
A Journey Home#071.speaker: Fruman Recruit

A Journey Home#072.src: We'll make it a point to ask as soon as we can. Information's key to fighting wars.
A Journey Home#072.dst: 找到機會就一定要問清楚。打仗最重要的就是情報。
A Journey Home#072.speaker: Fruman Recruit

A Journey Home#073.src: ...rotten driver. I feel for the man, but he said he always hits that boulder. Sounds like his own fault to me.
A Journey Home#073.dst: ……那個爛車夫。我是同情他啦，但他自己說每次都會撞到那顆石頭。聽起來就是他自己的問題。
A Journey Home#073.speaker: Fruman Recruit

A Journey Home#074.src: I'm thinking about meals more than wheels. I feel like I haven't eaten in days. Hope the walk's short...
A Journey Home#074.dst: 比起輪子我更想著吃的。我覺得我好幾天沒吃東西了。希望這段路不長……
A Journey Home#074.speaker: Fruman Recruit

A Journey Home#075.src: Well, if he was a more competent driver you wouldn't have to walk so far on an empty stomach! Let's hurry so we can get you a feast, huh?
A Journey Home#075.dst: 要是他開車再像樣一點，你就不用餓著肚子走這麼遠了！我們快點走，好讓你飽餐一頓，好嗎？
A Journey Home#075.speaker: Fruman Recruit

A Journey Home#076.src: Wait, who's that? Why are they coming from the border??
A Journey Home#076.dst: 等等，那是誰？他們為什麼從邊境那邊過來？？
A Journey Home#076.speaker: Fruman Recruit

A Journey Home#078.src: ...and that's the last of them for today.
A Journey Home#078.speaker: Caravan Driver

A Journey Home#079.src: Lots of pairs today. Eight more in the wings... But that's for tomorrow.
A Journey Home#079.dst: 今天成雙成對的還真多。還有八個在候著……不過那是明天的事了。
A Journey Home#079.speaker: Caravan Driver

A Journey Home#080.src: Same darn boulder... Same darn line, too. Wonder if they'll let me shake it up one day. This is always a pain...
A Journey Home#080.dst: 又是那顆該死的石頭……又是那句該死的台詞。不知道哪天他們會不會讓我換點花樣。每次都煩死人……
A Journey Home#080.speaker: Caravan Driver

A Journey Home#081.src: And that's that about that. And now, to be off...to the home I choose. And there's no troubles to follow me there.
A Journey Home#081.dst: 這件事就這樣了。那麼，該走了……回我自己選的家。到了那裡，就沒有麻煩追得上我。
A Journey Home#081.speaker: Caravan Driver

A Journey Home#082.dst: 探索 Fruma Gate 的另一頭。

A Journey Home#083.src: Just couldn't take the hint, huh?
A Journey Home#083.speaker: Caravan Driver

A Journey Home#084.src: Bet you think you're slick. Didn't even notice me hang back to watch, huh? I wasn't born yesterday.
A Journey Home#084.dst: 你以為自己很高明吧。連我留下來盯著都沒發現，對吧？我可不是昨天才出生的。
A Journey Home#084.speaker: Caravan Driver

A Journey Home#085.src: Listen, this isn't the first time something like this has happened Y'know. Someone gets curious, retraces their steps.
A Journey Home#085.dst: 聽著，這種事不是第一次發生了。你知道的，總有人好奇，回頭去查自己走過的路。
A Journey Home#085.speaker: Caravan Driver

A Journey Home#086.src: If you couldn't tell, this whole thing's meant to be a one way trip. The bridge, the cave-in, everyone trying to discourage you.
A Journey Home#086.dst: 如果你還看不出來，這整件事本來就是單程的。那座橋、那場塌方、每一個勸你回頭的人。
A Journey Home#086.speaker: Caravan Driver

A Journey Home#087.src: It's not wise to be here After all, you weren't the one out of your group of three that got permission to stay. Yeah, I heard about the tournament results.
A Journey Home#087.dst: 待在這裡不明智——畢竟你們三個人裡，拿到留下許可的並不是你。沒錯，比賽的結果我聽說了。
A Journey Home#087.speaker: Caravan Driver

A Journey Home#088.src: So...you got two choices, buddy. We can let this slide between us. We can. You can go marching back to {p} and my lips will be sealed.
A Journey Home#088.dst: 所以……你有兩個選擇，朋友。這件事我們可以當作沒發生過。真的可以。你乖乖走回 {p}，我就閉緊嘴巴。
A Journey Home#088.speaker: Caravan Driver

A Journey Home#089.src: Or, you can live life dangerously and follow me on the train to {p}. Better make your choice quick, though it's leaving soon.
A Journey Home#089.dst: 或者，你也可以活得刺激一點，跟我上開往 {p} 的列車。不過最好快點決定，車快開了。
A Journey Home#089.speaker: Caravan Driver

A Journey Home#090.src: If I see you in the passenger cabin, well...that'll be that, and you'll just have to wait and see what comes of it.
A Journey Home#090.dst: 要是我在客車廂裡看到你，那……那就是那樣了，接下來會發生什麼，你就自己等著看吧。
A Journey Home#090.speaker: Caravan Driver

A Journey Home#091.src: Join the Caravan Driver in the passenger car at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
A Journey Home#091.dst: 到 [-{~1}, {~2}, -{~3}] 的客車廂與 Caravan Driver 會合。

A Journey Home#092.src: Last chance to back out. This your choice?
A Journey Home#092.dst: 最後一次退出的機會。這是你的選擇？
A Journey Home#092.speaker: Caravan Driver

A Journey Home#093.src: Well, you better get headed on the long walk back to {p} then.
A Journey Home#093.dst: 那你最好開始走那段回 {p} 的長路了。
A Journey Home#093.speaker: Caravan Driver

A Journey Home#097.src: You know what they say about curiosity, and how it killed the cat. You the type to believe satisfaction'll bring it back?
A Journey Home#097.dst: 你聽過那句話吧，好奇心殺死貓。你是那種相信滿足了好奇心貓就會活過來的人嗎？
A Journey Home#097.speaker: Caravan Driver

A Journey Home#098.src: Well, 'kittycat,' you didn't find the cream just the hound dogs.
A Journey Home#098.dst: 那麼，「小貓咪」，你找到的不是鮮奶油——是獵犬。
A Journey Home#098.speaker: Fruman Guard

A Journey Home#099.src: Intruder to Fruma, you are under arrest! Now march!
A Journey Home#099.dst: 闖入 Fruma 者，你被捕了！走！
A Journey Home#099.speaker: Fruman Guard

A Journey Home#100.src: You really thought the Driver was on your side, intruder? What a fool you are. We gave you every chance to quit this endeavor, but here you are. Let's go.
A Journey Home#100.dst: 你真以為那個 Driver 站在你這邊嗎，闖入者？你真是個蠢貨。我們給了你每一次收手的機會，你卻還是來了。走吧。
A Journey Home#100.speaker: Commander Lilles

A Journey Home#101.dst: 指揮官！我們必須立刻談談！
A Journey Home#101.speaker: Guard Captain

A Journey Home#102.src: I have urgent news to report from the gate.
A Journey Home#102.dst: 我有從門那邊來的緊急消息要報告。
A Journey Home#102.speaker: Guard Captain

A Journey Home#103.src: If it is truly so urgent, let's speak.
A Journey Home#103.dst: 如果真的這麼緊急，那就說吧。
A Journey Home#103.speaker: Commander Lilles

A Journey Home#104.src: Soldiers! Keep the intruder still. I've every faith in you.
A Journey Home#104.dst: 士兵們！看住這個闖入者。我完全信得過你們。
A Journey Home#104.speaker: Commander Lilles

A Journey Home#108.src: Anythin' I can help you with?
A Journey Home#108.dst: 有什麼我幫得上忙的嗎？
A Journey Home#108.speaker: Kaio

A Journey Home#109.src: Hm. Suppose there's no harm. But watch yourself, alright?
A Journey Home#109.dst: 嗯。我想是沒什麼壞處。不過你自己小心點，好嗎？
A Journey Home#109.speaker: Kaio

A Journey Home#110.src: This here's our home. I wouldn't take too kindly to you messin' anything up, understand?
A Journey Home#110.dst: 這裡是我們的家。你要是弄壞了什麼，我可不會給你好臉色，懂嗎？
A Journey Home#110.speaker: Kaio

A Journey Home#111.src: ...doin' alright, all things considered. Weather's nice, I suppose. Festival comin' up.
A Journey Home#111.dst: ……整體來說還過得去。天氣不錯吧，我想。慶典也快到了。
A Journey Home#111.speaker: Kaio

A Journey Home#112.src: But that ain't none of our business, really. If you didn't need anythin' else, I'll kindly ask you to take your leave.
A Journey Home#112.dst: 不過那真的不關我們的事。如果你沒別的事，我就請你離開了。
A Journey Home#112.speaker: Kaio

A Journey Home#113.src: Hm. Good. Have a nice day, now.
A Journey Home#113.speaker: Kaio

A Journey Home#114.src: Hmm? And who may you be?
A Journey Home#114.speaker: Mora

A Journey Home#115.src: Hoh, oh well. Might I help you with something?
A Journey Home#115.dst: 喔，好吧。有什麼我能幫忙的嗎？
A Journey Home#115.speaker: Mora

A Journey Home#116.src: Ah, completing some assorted metalworking projects. There always seems to be something to replace or maintain around here...
A Journey Home#116.dst: 啊，就是在做一些零零星星的金工活。這裡總是有東西要換、要保養……
A Journey Home#116.speaker: Mora

A Journey Home#117.src: Though, I certainly am no expert! But I can handle the tools well enough, and that is all that is needed for the task.
A Journey Home#117.dst: 不過我當然算不上什麼專家！但工具我還算拿得動，做這些事這樣就夠了。
A Journey Home#117.speaker: Mora

A Journey Home#118.src: Farewell, stranger! I hope that you will return home safely.
A Journey Home#118.dst: 再會了，陌生人！希望你能平安回家。
A Journey Home#118.speaker: Mora

A Marauder's Dues#001.src: ...ugh. Disgusting. Utterly disgusting. I've had just about enough of your kind here. Humans...
A Marauder's Dues#001.dst: ……唉。噁心。徹頭徹尾的噁心。我受夠你們這種東西了。人類……
A Marauder's Dues#001.speaker: Norsten

A Marauder's Dues#002.src: Dreadfully drab, always getting in the way, wriggling through our province like worms! You're no heroes, you're pretenders!!
A Marauder's Dues#002.dst: 醜得要命，永遠擋在路上，像蟲一樣在我們的行省裡鑽來鑽去！你們不是英雄，你們是冒牌貨！！
A Marauder's Dues#002.speaker: Norsten

A Marauder's Dues#003.src: Oh, you want through here? Well, I'm the gatekeeper. Let's call my toll...the abandonment of your ridiculous little heroics...and all your money besides. Sound fair?
A Marauder's Dues#003.dst: 喔，你想從這裡過去？巧了，我就是守門的。我的過路費就定為……放棄你那可笑的英雄扮演……外加你身上所有的錢。很公道吧？
A Marauder's Dues#003.speaker: Norsten

A Marauder's Dues#004.src: Aha, Norsten my boy! We've been worried sick, it's been a week. What is it you're doing so far out into the canyon?
A Marauder's Dues#004.dst: 啊哈，Norsten 我的孩子！我們擔心死了，都一個禮拜了。你跑到峽谷這麼深的地方做什麼？
A Marauder's Dues#004.speaker: Peli

A Marauder's Dues#005.src: Wha- Who are you, and who gave you permission to use my toll road?! And can't you see I'm busy?
A Marauder's Dues#005.dst: 什——你是誰，誰准你走我的收費道路的？！沒看到我在忙嗎？
A Marauder's Dues#005.speaker: Norsten

A Marauder's Dues#006.src: Norsten?? Don't you recognize your own grandfather? What's that strange look in your eyes, and what's this about a toll road?
A Marauder's Dues#006.dst: Norsten？？你連自己的爺爺都認不出來了？你眼神怎麼那麼奇怪，還有什麼收費道路？
A Marauder's Dues#006.speaker: Peli

A Marauder's Dues#007.src: You're nothing to me at your age. I only care about what the young can do for me...and about the fee you're neglecting, you shriveled old fruit!
A Marauder's Dues#007.dst: 你這把年紀對我來說什麼都不是。我只在乎年輕人能為我做什麼……還有你欠我的過路費，你這顆乾癟的老水果！
A Marauder's Dues#007.speaker: Norsten

A Marauder's Dues#008.src: What's gotten into you? Such a polite man, acting this way to your elders... Human, have you any idea what's-
A Marauder's Dues#008.dst: 你是怎麼了？這麼有禮貌的孩子，居然這樣對長輩……人類啊，你知不知道發生了什麼——
A Marauder's Dues#008.speaker: Peli

A Marauder's Dues#009.src: ...oh no. Oh, say it isn't so, is that what's happening? Is it HIS fault?
A Marauder's Dues#009.dst: ……噢，不會吧。噢，別告訴我是真的，是那件事嗎？是「他」搞的鬼？
A Marauder's Dues#009.speaker: Peli

A Marauder's Dues#010.src: Up there, on the cliff- that tower! The scourge of the canyon...has he truly returned? Has he...taken my grandson?!
A Marauder's Dues#010.dst: 上面，懸崖上——那座塔！峽谷的禍害……他真的回來了嗎？他……把我孫子拿走了？！
A Marauder's Dues#010.speaker: Peli

A Marauder's Dues#012.src: My reputation, even after all this time, still precedes me!! Indeed, old man, I have taken your grandson as my puppet!
A Marauder's Dues#012.dst: 過了這麼久，我的名聲居然還走在我前面！！沒錯，老頭，我把你孫子變成我的傀儡了！
A Marauder's Dues#012.speaker: Norsten

A Marauder's Dues#013.src: What should I care about the facade? For a hundred and fifty years I've stolen the vitality of others to maintain my beauty, and your grandson will be no different.
A Marauder's Dues#013.dst: 我幹嘛在乎這副皮囊？一百五十年來我一直靠竊取別人的生命力維持我的美貌，你孫子也不會例外。
A Marauder's Dues#013.speaker: Norsten

A Marauder's Dues#014.src: Miserable dastard!! Cold-water eel!! Human, you must help, you MUST! I beg you, please, seek the sorcerer and save my poor Norsten!!
A Marauder's Dues#014.dst: 卑鄙的惡棍！！冷水裡的鰻魚！！人類，你一定要幫忙，你「一定」要！我求求你，去找那個術士，救救我可憐的 Norsten！！
A Marauder's Dues#014.speaker: Peli

A Marauder's Dues#015.src: The southwest mountains have a shortcut past the bandits, time is of the essence!
A Marauder's Dues#015.dst: 西南邊的山裡有一條可以繞過強盜的捷徑，時間緊迫！
A Marauder's Dues#015.speaker: Peli

A Marauder's Dues#016.src: A veritable army fell before my magic! The bandits pay their tribute to my grace and obey my orders! You're as mad as I am called if you think one human can get through.
A Marauder's Dues#016.dst: 一整支軍隊都倒在我的魔法之下！那些強盜向我的威儀進貢、聽我的號令！你要是以為區區一個人類闖得過去，那你跟我一樣瘋。
A Marauder's Dues#016.speaker: Norsten

A Marauder's Dues#017.src: I'll leave you a corpse, a husk! A withered pile of dust- or perhaps I'll take YOU as a slave too, human! So what will it be? Run...or face me?
A Marauder's Dues#017.dst: 我會留給你一具屍體、一具空殼！一堆枯萎的塵土——又或者，我乾脆也把「你」收作奴隸，人類！那你要選哪一邊？跑……還是面對我？
A Marauder's Dues#017.speaker: Norsten

A Marauder's Dues#018.src: Go up the path to the wizard's tower, at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].

A Marauder's Dues#019.src: Hoho... The worm comes wriggling in, it seems. What a horrid thing you are. Mismatched armor, courage of a fool all over your face... Inelegant and UGLY!!
A Marauder's Dues#019.dst: 呵呵……看樣子小蟲子扭著身子爬進來了。你這東西真是難看。護甲配得亂七八糟，滿臉都是蠢貨才有的勇氣……粗俗，而且醜！！

A Marauder's Dues#020.src: At least the last ones to face me had some coordination, and the sense to hide themselves. Come further and you'll share their fate!!
A Marauder's Dues#020.dst: 上一批來找我的至少還懂得配合，也懂得把自己藏好。再往前走，你就跟他們一個下場！！

A Marauder's Dues#021.src: ..rrgh! The tunnels! Once again, humans try so hard to spoil my fun... But do you really think you've evaded me?
A Marauder's Dues#021.dst: ……唔！那些坑道！人類又一次這麼賣力地來壞我的興致……可是你真以為自己躲得掉我嗎？

A Marauder's Dues#022.src: You can never understand. The beauty of one like myself cannot be transient, it must be everlasting! I will never succumb to my mortality!
A Marauder's Dues#022.dst: 你們永遠不會懂。像我這樣的美是不能短暫的，它必須是永恆的！我絕不會向凡人的宿命低頭！

A Marauder's Dues#023.src: As a matter of fact...you humans ARE good for one thing. Drab as you are, you're lively. So consider this an honor!
A Marauder's Dues#023.dst: 說起來……你們人類「確實」有一個用處。你們雖然醜，卻很有活力。所以這算是你的榮幸！

A Marauder's Dues#024.src: HAAAAAhahahaha!! Instead of destruction, I'll leave you trapped in this illusion, and chip away at your ugly mind until nothing remains. You'll join the rest who've prolonged my life!
A Marauder's Dues#024.dst: 哈啊啊啊哈哈哈哈！！我不打算毀掉你，我要把你困在這場幻覺裡，一點一點削掉你那醜陋的心智，直到什麼都不剩。你會加入那些延長了我壽命的人。

A Marauder's Dues#026.src: I'll take pleasure in peeling away your most formative memories first- W-wait, what's this giant blank spot? It's interfering with my spell...!!
A Marauder's Dues#026.dst: 我要先從你最重要的那些記憶開始剝——等、等等，這一大片空白是什麼？它在干擾我的法術……！！

A Marauder's Dues#027.src: Ugh, barely any memories to remove, hardly any personality... How much of a dull gray slate are you...and how is that making this more difficult?!
A Marauder's Dues#027.dst: 唔，幾乎沒有記憶可以拿走，個性也少得可憐……你到底是有多空白的一塊灰板子……又為什麼這樣反而更難搞？！

A Marauder's Dues#028.src: Run away and confront the wizard.

A Marauder's Dues#029.src: You escaped?! ...hmph. I suppose that trick works better for blinding a platoon than a person. When you only need to focus on what YOU see...rrgh.
A Marauder's Dues#029.dst: 你逃出來了？！……哼。我想這一招用來蒙蔽一整個排比對付一個人有效多了。當你只需要專注在「你自己」看到的東西上……唔。

A Marauder's Dues#030.src: Fine...you've forced my hand. I must sweep you aside, you so-called hero! Never darken my door again! Cease to exist!!
A Marauder's Dues#030.dst: 好吧……是你逼我的。我必須把你掃到一邊去，你這個所謂的英雄！別再玷汙我的門前！給我消失！！

A Marauder's Dues#032.src: Ugh, what was it that raisin of a man said- Miserable runt?! Cold-water eel?! More fitting names for you than me!!
A Marauder's Dues#032.dst: 唔，那顆葡萄乾一樣的老頭剛剛說什麼來著——卑鄙的小東西？！冷水裡的鰻魚？！這些名字用在你身上比我合適多了！！
A Marauder's Dues#032.speaker: Dramele

A Marauder's Dues#033.src: ...fine. The defenses of my tower were absolute enough that I never needed to defend myself inside. I should have taken you more seriously from the start.
A Marauder's Dues#033.dst: ……好吧。我這座塔的防禦向來嚴密到我根本不需要在裡面自衛。我從一開始就該更認真看待你。
A Marauder's Dues#033.speaker: Dramele

A Marauder's Dues#034.src: It's been so long since I've faced a threat, and now that you're here- RRGH! How could a HUMAN get the best of me?
A Marauder's Dues#034.dst: 我已經好久沒遇到威脅了，結果你就出現了——唔啊！一個「人類」怎麼可能佔我上風？
A Marauder's Dues#034.speaker: Dramele

A Marauder's Dues#035.src: Me, who holds control over every bandit in the canyon...! How dare you embarrass me so!
A Marauder's Dues#035.dst: 我，掌控著這座峽谷裡每一個強盜的我……！你竟敢這樣讓我難堪！
A Marauder's Dues#035.speaker: Dramele

A Marauder's Dues#036.src: Well, fine. You've got me dead to rights. I'll give up the blasted binding gem. Who knows if most of the bandits will return to normal, after so long...
A Marauder's Dues#036.dst: 好吧，好吧。你確實抓到我的把柄了。那顆該死的束縛寶石我交出來就是。過了這麼久，也不知道那些強盜還有多少能恢復正常……
A Marauder's Dues#036.speaker: Dramele

A Marauder's Dues#037.src: ...but Norsten? He'll barely be affected. Bring it to him and he'll be freed, loath as I am to let him go.
A Marauder's Dues#037.dst: ……不過 Norsten 嗎？他受的影響很淺。把寶石帶去給他，他就會自由——雖然我一百個不情願。
A Marauder's Dues#037.speaker: Dramele

A Marauder's Dues#039.src: HA! I still get the last laugh! Even at my most vulnerable I have gracefully outwitted you! As if I would really surrender to a human.
A Marauder's Dues#039.dst: 哈！最後笑的還是我！就算在我最脆弱的時候，我照樣優雅地把你玩弄在股掌之間！我怎麼可能真的向一個人類投降。
A Marauder's Dues#039.speaker: Dramele

A Marauder's Dues#040.src: Those souls are mine to control, you hear me? Mine to bind!! Mine to drain dry of vitality!! Mine to OWN!! HehehaHAAAAA!!
A Marauder's Dues#040.dst: 那些靈魂是我的，聽到沒有？我的，任我束縛！！任我榨乾生命力！！全都是我的！！嘿嘿哈啊啊啊！！
A Marauder's Dues#040.speaker: Dramele

A Marauder's Dues#041.src: And if you jump in after it? You'll be truly trapped- a dimension of my own making, filled with volatile magical waste! You'll never be seen again!
A Marauder's Dues#041.dst: 如果你要跳下去追它？那你就真的被困住了——一個我親手造出來的空間，裡面塞滿了不穩定的魔法廢料！再也沒有人會見到你！
A Marauder's Dues#041.speaker: Dramele

A Marauder's Dues#043.src: Find a way out of the strange dimension.
A Marauder's Dues#043.dst: 找出離開這個奇異空間的方法。

A Marauder's Dues#044.src: Find a way out of the strange dimension.
A Marauder's Dues#044.dst: 找出離開這個奇異空間的方法。

A Marauder's Dues#046.src: H-how did you survive? How did you get OUT?! That pocket dimension has a one-way entrance!! I- You- I'LL DRAIN AWAY NORSTEN BEFORE YOUR VERY EYES!!
A Marauder's Dues#046.dst: 你、你怎麼可能活著出來？你怎麼「出來」的？！那個口袋空間的入口是單向的！！我——你——我要當著你的面把 Norsten 榨乾！！
A Marauder's Dues#046.speaker: Norsten

A Marauder's Dues#047.src: The scourge is angry!! Human, quickly, for him to be this upset you must have found something! Save my grandson, please!!
A Marauder's Dues#047.dst: 那個禍害在發火！！人類，快，他氣成這樣，你一定是找到什麼了！救救我孫子，拜託！！
A Marauder's Dues#047.speaker: Peli

A Marauder's Dues#048.src: I'LL FLING YOU TO THE ENDS OF THE CANYON!! FILTHY HUMAN, LOWLY WORM NOT FIT TO BE DUST-
A Marauder's Dues#048.dst: 我要把你甩到峽谷的盡頭！！骯髒的人類，連塵土都不配當的低賤蟲子——
A Marauder's Dues#048.speaker: Norsten

A Marauder's Dues#049.src: Aguh...w-where am I? My...my throat hurts...was I screaming?
A Marauder's Dues#049.dst: 啊咕……我、我在哪裡？我的……喉嚨好痛……我剛剛在尖叫嗎？
A Marauder's Dues#049.speaker: Norsten

A Marauder's Dues#050.src: Oh, my poor grandson...my little Norsten is back to us! Oh, joyous day!!
A Marauder's Dues#050.dst: 噢，我可憐的孫子……我的小 Norsten 回來了！噢，真是大喜的日子！！
A Marauder's Dues#050.speaker: Peli

A Marauder's Dues#051.src: Back to...did something happen? I remember coming this way after a thief...and then...
A Marauder's Dues#051.dst: 回來……發生什麼事了嗎？我記得我追一個小偷追到這邊來……然後……
A Marauder's Dues#051.speaker: Norsten

A Marauder's Dues#052.src: That terrible wizard captured you in his spell when you did. It was terrible, it was- Such a hard look you had in your eyes...
A Marauder's Dues#052.dst: 你追過來的時候，那個可怕的巫師用法術把你抓住了。那真的很可怕，那真是——你當時的眼神好凶……
A Marauder's Dues#052.speaker: Peli

A Marauder's Dues#053.src: But this human, this hero... They have bested the scourge of the canyon! They managed to save you from such evil!
A Marauder's Dues#053.dst: 但是這位人類，這位英雄……他們打敗了峽谷的禍害！他們把你從那樣的邪惡裡救了回來！
A Marauder's Dues#053.speaker: Peli

A Marauder's Dues#054.src: ...I barely remember anything. Just...feelings of anger, and...disgust, I suppose, but... You wouldn't lie to me Grand-Peli.
A Marauder's Dues#054.dst: ……我幾乎什麼都不記得。只有……憤怒的感覺，還有……大概是厭惡吧，可是……Peli 爺爺你不會騙我的。
A Marauder's Dues#054.speaker: Norsten

A Marauder's Dues#055.src: Thank you, human- Hm? What's all this money doing in my pockets? I didn't bring my pouch out with me to chase the thief, but...! So much money!
A Marauder's Dues#055.dst: 謝謝你，人類——嗯？我口袋裡這些錢是怎麼回事？我追小偷的時候根本沒帶錢袋出來，可是……！這麼多錢！
A Marauder's Dues#055.speaker: Norsten

A Marauder's Dues#056.src: Ill-gotten gains from the scourge's sham of a toll-road scheme, no doubt. I think that human could put that money to fine use, what say you, my boy?
A Marauder's Dues#056.dst: 毫無疑問是那個禍害搞的假收費道路撈來的黑心錢。我想那位人類會把這些錢用在更好的地方，你說呢，孩子？
A Marauder's Dues#056.speaker: Peli

A Marauder's Dues#057.src: Of course! Here. And don't worry about the gate. It's supposed to be open for anyone, so use it as you like.
A Marauder's Dues#057.dst: 當然！拿去。還有那道門你不用擔心。它本來就該對所有人開放，你想走就走。
A Marauder's Dues#057.speaker: Norsten

A New Beginning#001.src: Halt! I'll need to see some form of identification.
A New Beginning#001.dst: 站住！我需要看一下你的身分證明。
A New Beginning#001.speaker: Espren Border Guard

A New Beginning#002.src: New policy, sorry for the inconvenience. We're heightening security around here.
A New Beginning#002.dst: 新規定，不好意思麻煩你了。我們最近在加強這一帶的戒備。
A New Beginning#002.speaker: Espren City Guard

A New Beginning#003.src: It shouldn't take too much of your time, don't worry! Just show us your citizen identification papers, and we'll let you on through.
A New Beginning#003.dst: 不會耽誤你太久的，別擔心！把公民身分文件拿出來給我們看看，我們就放你過去。
A New Beginning#003.speaker: Espren City Guard

A New Beginning#006.src: What's taking so long? It can't be that hard to find those. You should have them on your person at all times.
A New Beginning#006.dst: 怎麼拖這麼久？那東西應該不難找吧。你本來就該隨身帶著。
A New Beginning#006.speaker: Espren Border Guard

A New Beginning#007.src: It’s a very new restriction. There was some incident nearby. I’m not sure on the details, but-
A New Beginning#007.dst: 這是很新的限制。附近出了點事。詳情我也不太清楚，可是——
A New Beginning#007.speaker: Espren City Guard

A New Beginning#008.src: Enough stalling. Where are your papers?
A New Beginning#008.speaker: Espren Border Guard

A New Beginning#009.src: If you don’t present identification, I’m going to need to take you in for questioning.
A New Beginning#009.dst: 你要是拿不出身分證明，我就得把你帶回去問話了。
A New Beginning#009.speaker: Espren Border Guard

A New Beginning#010.src: O-oh, hey, th-there you are! Gosh, I was w-wondering where you'd gotten off to!
A New Beginning#010.dst: 哦、哦，嘿，你、你在這裡啊！天啊，我還在、還在想你跑到哪去了呢！

A New Beginning#011.src: Ha... d-don't tell me you forgot your papers again! I k-keep telling you to keep th-them with you...
A New Beginning#011.dst: 哈……別、別跟我說你又忘了帶文件！我一、一直跟你說要隨、隨身帶著的……

A New Beginning#012.src: One of th-these days, you'll remember! F-for sure...
A New Beginning#012.dst: 總、總有一天你會記得的！一、一定會……

A New Beginning#013.src: You d-didn’t forget our conversation too, d-did you? S-s-sorry for my friend, sir!
A New Beginning#013.dst: 你該不會連我們剛才、剛才在講什麼也忘了吧？不、不好意思啊長官，我朋友就這樣！

A New Beginning#014.src: Ahem. I'll still need to see identification if you want to enter the city.
A New Beginning#014.dst: 咳咳。你們要進城，我還是得看身分證明。
A New Beginning#014.speaker: Espren Border Guard

A New Beginning#015.src: Oh! O-o-of course! L-let me just...
A New Beginning#015.dst: 哦！當、當然！讓我找、找一下……

A New Beginning#016.src: ...They're a-around here s-s-somewhere, I'm s-sure... I think they m-might be
A New Beginning#016.dst: ……應該就在這、這附近……我想它可、可能是——

A New Beginning#017.src: Aha! Here! Identification p-papers, just for y-you!
A New Beginning#017.dst: 啊哈！在這！身、身分文件，專程給你看的！

A New Beginning#018.src: ...What even is this? I can barely read the handwriting... Is that Sovereign Selium's signature? The previous sovereign?
A New Beginning#018.dst: ……這到底是什麼東西？我幾乎看不懂這字跡……那是 Selium 統領的簽名嗎？上一任統領的？
A New Beginning#018.speaker: Espren Border Guard

A New Beginning#019.src: I've had enough of these games. The two of you are under
A New Beginning#019.dst: 我受夠這種把戲了。你們兩個現在——
A New Beginning#019.speaker: Espren Border Guard

A New Beginning#022.src: We've received more information about the incident at {p}. There's a new cursed one to look out for. Dozens of soldiers were killed in an attempt to capture them.
A New Beginning#022.dst: 我們收到更多關於 {p} 那起事件的消息。又出現一個受詛者要留意。為了抓他，死了幾十名士兵。
A New Beginning#022.speaker: Espren Guard Captain

A New Beginning#023.src: We're taking reinforcements to the fort, but I need you to remain at your posts. Keep a watchful eye on any suspicious individuals.
A New Beginning#023.dst: 我們要調增援到堡壘去，但你們留在崗位上。任何可疑人物都給我盯緊。
A New Beginning#023.speaker: Espren Guard Captain

A New Beginning#024.src: ...Th-this might be a good time to run. While they're distracted! Quick, f-follow me!
A New Beginning#024.dst: ……現、現在跑正好。趁他們分心的時候！快、快跟我來！

A New Beginning#025.src: Understood. Now, back to where did they go?!
A New Beginning#025.dst: 明白。好了，回到——他們人呢？！
A New Beginning#025.speaker: Espren Border Guard

A New Beginning#027.src: Phew... G-glad we got out of there...
A New Beginning#027.dst: 呼……還、還好我們溜出來了……

A New Beginning#028.src: A-anyway. What were you th-thinking? Trying to enter the city without p-papers...
A New Beginning#028.dst: 總、總之。你在想什麼啊？沒帶文、文件就想進城……

A New Beginning#029.src: You're n-new around here, right? Transferred in f-from elsewhere. Y-you're interesting, though.
A New Beginning#029.dst: 你是剛、剛來這一帶的吧？從別的地方轉、轉過來的。不過你、你這個人挺有意思的。

A New Beginning#030.src: Um. The thing at T-Torann... you w-wouldn't happen to... n-n-nevermind. I don't need to know!
A New Beginning#030.dst: 呃。T-Torann 那件事……你該不會、不會是……算、算了。我不需要知道！

A New Beginning#031.src: But, if y-you're interested... The military k-keeps records of these sorts of things! Th-they want a paper trail... or s-something.
A New Beginning#031.dst: 不過，如、如果你有興趣的話……軍方會把這、這類事情都記錄下來！他們要留紙、紙本存底……之類的。

A New Beginning#032.src: You d-didn't hear this from me... but the l-leaves have whispered something about th-the location of a record storage. Here, hand me that b-book of yours...
A New Beginning#032.dst: 這、這話不是我說的……不過葉子低語過一個檔、檔案庫的位置。來，把你那本書給、給我……

A New Beginning#033.src: Well, good luck s-stranger! If anyone asks, we never m-met. But, um... y-you can call me Zeph.
A New Beginning#033.dst: 那、那就祝你好運了，陌生人！有人問起的話，我們從、從來沒見過。不過，呃……你可以叫我 Zeph。
A New Beginning#033.speaker: Zeph

A New Beginning#034.src: Find your report in the storage at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

A New Beginning#036.src: HALT! Intruder! For trespassing on restricted property, you are under
A New Beginning#036.dst: 站住！入侵者！擅闖管制區域，你現在——
A New Beginning#036.speaker: Nixeph Watchman

A New Beginning#037.src: Wait, a suspicious person in the region is this the cursed one?! Get them!!
A New Beginning#037.dst: 等等，本區出現的可疑人物——這就是那個受詛者？！抓住他！！
A New Beginning#037.speaker: Nixeph Watchman

A New Beginning#038.dst: 他們是衝著……Zhiraok 統領來的……別……你……你……
A New Beginning#038.speaker: Nixeph Watchman

A New Beginning#039.src: Well? You've crunched the numbers. Give me the report.
A New Beginning#039.dst: 如何？數字你都算過了。把報告給我。
A New Beginning#039.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

A New Beginning#040.src: Sovereign, sir. It seems {p} was not directly prepared to face a cursed one. Dozens of soldiers are dead.
A New Beginning#040.dst: 統領大人。看來 {p} 並沒有真正做好面對受詛者的準備。幾十名士兵陣亡。
A New Beginning#040.speaker: Espren Guard Captain

A New Beginning#041.src: ...of all the possibilities. How could that have factored out...? Hm. Who was the commanding officer? Their take on the problem would help fill the gaps.
A New Beginning#041.dst: ……這麼多種可能性裡面。怎麼會因式分解成這樣……？嗯。當時的指揮官是誰？他對這道題的看法可以幫我把缺項補上。
A New Beginning#041.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

A New Beginning#042.src: Well... it seems it was Commander Lilles, sir. But he was one of the casualties of the incident, and a replacement has yet to be promoted.
A New Beginning#042.dst: 這個……看來是 Lilles 指揮官，大人。但他也是那場事件的傷亡之一，接替的人選還沒升上來。
A New Beginning#042.speaker: Espren Guard Captain

A New Beginning#043.src: Naturally... I'll need to get hold of his family later and break the news. What else do you have on the Cursed One?
A New Beginning#043.dst: 當然是這樣……我晚點得聯絡他的家屬告知消息。關於那名受詛者，你還掌握到什麼？
A New Beginning#043.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

A New Beginning#044.src: I've heard reports that they're... from outside. Possibly one of the ones who were invited into our province recently, though nobody seems certain on that.
A New Beginning#044.dst: 我聽說他們……是外面來的。可能是最近受邀進入本行省的那批人之一，不過沒有人敢確定。
A New Beginning#044.speaker: Espren Guard Captain

A New Beginning#045.src: We've already raised security in {p}, and we have forces moving to Torann.
A New Beginning#045.dst: 我們已經提高了 {p} 的戒備，並且正在調兵前往 Torann。
A New Beginning#045.speaker: Espren Guard Captain

A New Beginning#046.src: One positive in a sea of negatives, I suppose. Good work. File the report in the records room, and then we'll go view the damages for ourselves.
A New Beginning#046.dst: 一堆負數裡總算有一個正的。做得好。把報告歸檔進資料室，然後我們親自去看看損害狀況。
A New Beginning#046.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

A New Beginning#047.src: One more thing. Since Torann is compromised, we've taken the liberty of storing the cursed one's report here, so
A New Beginning#047.dst: 還有一件事。既然 Torann 已經失守，我們擅自把那名受詛者的檔案存放在這裡，所以——
A New Beginning#047.speaker: Espren Guard Captain

A New Beginning#048.src: Do we not have a higher priority right now?!
A New Beginning#048.dst: 我們現在沒有更高優先的事要處理嗎？！
A New Beginning#048.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

A New Beginning#049.src: ...N-n-no, sir. My- my apologies. I simply thought
A New Beginning#049.dst: ……沒、沒有，大人。我——我很抱歉。我只是想——
A New Beginning#049.speaker: Espren Guard Captain

A New Beginning#050.src: I have a dozen and a half other problems to solve that need to be pushed back oh, would you put away the key already?
A New Beginning#050.dst: 我還有一打半的問題得往後挪——哦，你到底要不要把鑰匙收起來？
A New Beginning#050.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

A New Beginning#051.src: We haven't got time to sit around like this when there's a tragedy of that value to look into! We need to get to {p}, yesterday!
A New Beginning#051.dst: 有那種量級的慘劇要查，我們沒空在這裡耗！我們昨天就該到 {p} 了！
A New Beginning#051.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

A New Beginning#052.src: Locate the key inside the eastern tower and retrieve your report.
A New Beginning#052.dst: 到東側塔樓找出鑰匙，取回你的檔案。

A New Beginning#053.src: * Subject brought to {p} by the Driver. (Note: Interrogate Driver for reasoning.)
A New Beginning#053.dst: * 對象由 the Driver 帶往 {p}。（註：需就其理由訊問 the Driver。）
A New Beginning#053.speaker: "Unknown Cursed One"

A New Beginning#055.src: Someone's been here... search the outpost, quickly!
A New Beginning#055.dst: 有人來過這裡……快，搜查整座哨站！

A New Beginning#056.src: Find a way out of Nexiph Outpost.
A New Beginning#056.dst: 想辦法離開 Nexiph 哨站。

A New Beginning#058.src: H-hey again, at the w-window! Tough s-situation, huh?
A New Beginning#058.dst: 嘿、嘿，又見面了，窗、窗戶這邊！情況很棘、棘手吧？
A New Beginning#058.speaker: Zeph

A New Beginning#059.src: I f-figured you could use a hand... Stand back a m-moment.
A New Beginning#059.dst: 我想你大、大概需要幫手……退、退開一點。
A New Beginning#059.speaker: Zeph

A New Beginning#061.src: I-I'll be down in a bit. Just h-hold on tight to the rope, and you'll be f-fine!
A New Beginning#061.dst: 我等、等一下就下去。你抓緊繩子就、就沒事了！
A New Beginning#061.speaker: Zeph

A New Beginning#062.src: Talk to Rex and Zeph at .
A New Beginning#062.dst: 到 跟 Rex 和 Zeph 談話。

A New Beginning#063.src: Phew! W-we got you out. G-good work back there, though!
A New Beginning#063.dst: 呼！我、我們把你弄出來了。不過你剛才表、表現得很好！
A New Beginning#063.speaker: Zeph

A New Beginning#065.src: D-don't mind her, she's just like that. Rex, this is
A New Beginning#065.dst: 別、別理她，她就是那個樣子。Rex，這位是——
A New Beginning#065.speaker: Zeph

A New Beginning#066.src: The stranger you found trying to get into {p} without identification, I know. Do you really need me here still?
A New Beginning#066.dst: 就是你發現那個想沒身分證明混進 {p} 的陌生人，我知道。我還有必要待在這裡嗎？
A New Beginning#066.speaker: Rex

A New Beginning#067.src: ...I-I-I'd like it if you s-stayed, yes.
A New Beginning#067.dst: 我、我、我希望你留、留下來，是的。
A New Beginning#067.speaker: Zeph

A New Beginning#069.src: Um... I- I don't think I c-c-caught your name.
A New Beginning#069.dst: 呃……我、我好像還沒聽、聽到你的名字。
A New Beginning#069.speaker: Zeph

A New Beginning#070.src: {u}... so, wh-where are you from? Y-you must've transferred in from an-another region, right?
A New Beginning#070.dst: {u}……那，你是哪、哪裡人？你一定是從別、別的地區轉過來的吧？
A New Beginning#070.speaker: Zeph

A New Beginning#071.src: Another... um... wh-what do you-... you d-don't know?
A New Beginning#071.dst: 別的……呃……你說什、什麼——你不、不知道？
A New Beginning#071.speaker: Zeph

A New Beginning#072.src: Obviously they're not from here, Zeph! Remember that thing I told you about? The big spectacle event they had with people from beyond the gates?
A New Beginning#072.dst: 他們顯然不是這裡的人啊，Zeph！記得我跟你講過的那件事嗎？他們辦的那場大排場，來的人是從城門外面來的。
A New Beginning#072.speaker: Rex

A New Beginning#073.src: You w-w-what?! But, there’s- th-that’s not possible...
A New Beginning#073.dst: 你、你說什麼？！可是，那——那不、不可能……
A New Beginning#073.speaker: Zeph

A New Beginning#074.src: Possible or not, they’re obviously from outside the province! They’re probably involved with that big spectacle event with people from beyond the gates that I was telling you about.
A New Beginning#074.dst: 可不可能不重要，他們顯然是從行省外面來的！他們八成就跟我跟你講過的那場大排場有關，那些從城門外來的人。
A New Beginning#074.speaker: Rex

A New Beginning#075.src: …I th-thought you were m-making things up again.
A New Beginning#075.dst: 我、我還以為你又在編、編故事。
A New Beginning#075.speaker: Zeph

A New Beginning#076.src: Excuse you? I don’t make things up! You can ask Mora, he saw it too.
A New Beginning#076.dst: 你這什麼意思？我才不編故事！你可以去問 Mora，他也看到了。
A New Beginning#076.speaker: Rex

A New Beginning#077.src: If you s-say so… I just- I-I-I thought there were no p-people left out there. The c-crown keeps a whole g-garrison stationed to f-fight off… um… m-m-monsters.
A New Beginning#077.dst: 你說是就、就是吧……我只是——我、我、我一直以為外面已經沒、沒有人了。王、王室不是派了一整支駐、駐軍在那邊擋……呃……怪、怪物嗎。
A New Beginning#077.speaker: Zeph

A New Beginning#079.src: Wh- I d-don’t know! It s-s-sounded believable to me!
A New Beginning#079.dst: 我——我怎、怎麼知道！聽、聽起來很有說服力啊！
A New Beginning#079.speaker: Zeph

A New Beginning#080.src: Ugh, whatever! I don’t have time for this. Zeph, I have work to do. Just… stay on your guard. I don’t trust whatever’s going on with this stranger.
A New Beginning#080.dst: 唉，算了！我沒空跟你耗。Zeph，我有事要做。你就……小心點。這個陌生人身上的事我一件都不信。
A New Beginning#080.speaker: Rex

A New Beginning#082.src: She's- um... she's n-not normally like this. S-sorry about that.
A New Beginning#082.dst: 她、她……呃……她平常不是這樣的。不、不好意思。
A New Beginning#082.speaker: Zeph

A New Beginning#083.src: O-Oh! I f-followed you, of course.
A New Beginning#083.dst: 哦！我當、當然是跟著你來的啊。
A New Beginning#083.speaker: Zeph

A New Beginning#084.src: A s-stranger comes to our region without p-papers and is supposedly a c-cursed one? I wasn't letting you go th-that easily!
A New Beginning#084.dst: 一個沒帶文、文件的陌生人來到我們這一帶，還可、可能是受詛者？我哪、哪可能就這樣讓你走！
A New Beginning#084.speaker: Zeph

A New Beginning#085.src: O-Oh! N-no problem! It was... it w-was nothing. Y-you did most of the work.
A New Beginning#085.dst: 哦！沒、沒什麼！那……那沒什麼。大部分都是你自、自己做的。
A New Beginning#085.speaker: Zeph

A New Beginning#086.src: N-Nixeph is... n-not an easy place to break into! I g-guess all the guards were gone.
A New Beginning#086.dst: Nixeph 是……不、不容易闖進去的地方！我、我猜是衛兵都調走了。
A New Beginning#086.speaker: Zeph

A New Beginning#087.src: But, um... y-you got what you needed, and I got what I- what I needed, s-so...
A New Beginning#087.dst: 不過，呃……你拿到你要的，我也拿、拿到我要的，所、所以……
A New Beginning#087.speaker: Zeph

A New Beginning#088.src: B-besides! I had s-something I needed to get from... f-from the outpost, anyway.
A New Beginning#088.dst: 再、再說了！我本來也有東、東西要從哨站拿。
A New Beginning#088.speaker: Zeph

A New Beginning#089.src: Um... th-there is someone you should meet. I was told to pass on a m-message...
A New Beginning#089.dst: 呃……有、有個人你應該見一見。有人要我轉、轉達一句話……
A New Beginning#089.speaker: Zeph

A New Beginning#090.src: And- and you'll be on y-your own this time. N-no help from me!
A New Beginning#090.dst: 而、而且這次你要自己去。我、我不會幫你！
A New Beginning#090.speaker: Zeph

A New Beginning#091.src: The m-message is: w-westward, the giant lays its roots. As the wind blows, they s-sing along.
A New Beginning#091.dst: 訊息是這樣的：西、西方，巨人扎下它的根。風起時，他們隨、隨之而歌。
A New Beginning#091.speaker: Zeph

A New Beginning#092.src: "Westward, the giant lays its roots. As the wind blows, they sing along."
A New Beginning#092.dst: 「西方，巨人扎下它的根。風起時，他們隨之而歌。」

A New Beginning#093.src: The m-message is: w-westward, the giant lays its roots. As the wind blows, they s-sing along.
A New Beginning#093.dst: 訊息是這樣的：西、西方，巨人扎下它的根。風起時，他們隨、隨之而歌。
A New Beginning#093.speaker: Zeph

A New Beginning#094.src: Talk to the woman in the cave.

A New Beginning#095.src: Well, well. If it isn't a fresh breeze dancing in the leaves...
A New Beginning#095.dst: 哎呀。這不是一陣在葉間起舞的清風嗎……

A New Beginning#096.src: You must be the Cursed One who caused such a stir at Torann, yes? News has spread quickly of your actions.
A New Beginning#096.dst: 你就是在 Torann 掀起那場風波的受詛者吧？你的事蹟傳得很快。

A New Beginning#097.src: I'm impressed you found your way to me.
A New Beginning#097.dst: 你能找到我這裡，我很佩服。

A New Beginning#098.src: So let's get to the business at hand. I'll start with this you're from the Wynn Province, aren't you?
A New Beginning#098.dst: 那我們就談正事。我先從這句開始——你是 Wynn 行省來的，對吧？

A New Beginning#099.src: I thought so... You're certainly not from around here. Though, I would recommend you keep that information close to your chest.
A New Beginning#099.dst: 我猜也是……你顯然不是這一帶的人。不過，我會建議你把這件事藏好。

A New Beginning#100.src: Very few people have knowledge of the outside world, and those that do... they're the ones who will be looking for you. Best to avoid drawing their attention.
A New Beginning#100.dst: 知道外面世界的人非常少，而知道的那些人……正是會來找你的人。最好別引起他們注意。

A New Beginning#101.src: But I should introduce myself. My name is Syndra, leader of the Leaves in the Wind resistance group.
A New Beginning#101.dst: 不過我該自我介紹一下。我叫 Syndra，「風中之葉」反抗組織的領導者。
A New Beginning#101.speaker: Syndra

A New Beginning#102.src: Call it something of a gamble. Given your... shall we say, explosive entrance into the province, I find it unlikely you're with the crown.
A New Beginning#102.dst: 就當是一場豪賭吧。以你進入本行省的方式——姑且說是「轟轟烈烈」——我不認為你是王室那邊的人。
A New Beginning#102.speaker: Syndra

A New Beginning#103.src: Even if you chose to reveal my secrets and if anyone even believed you you'd have no guarantee of your own safety.
A New Beginning#103.dst: 就算你選擇把我的祕密說出去，而且真的有人相信你，你自己的安全也一樣沒有保障。
A New Beginning#103.speaker: Syndra

A New Beginning#104.src: Yes. You haven’t been here long, but you’ve felt it, haven’t you? The crown has its roots buried deep in this province, and it certainly isn’t kind to all.
A New Beginning#104.dst: 是的。你來這裡沒多久，但你已經感覺到了吧？王室的根在這個行省扎得很深，而它對所有人絕不是一樣仁慈的。
A New Beginning#104.speaker: Syndra

A New Beginning#105.src: Those it sees as disposable… they don’t often make it far. That is why I have taken my role. I’d like to see a day where none are left behind.
A New Beginning#105.dst: 那些被它視為可拋棄的人……大多走不遠。這就是我擔起這個角色的原因。我想看到一個沒有人被拋下的日子。
A New Beginning#105.speaker: Syndra

A New Beginning#106.src: But that's enough about me. On to you. Why are you here, cursed one? For what purpose have you come to Fruma?
A New Beginning#106.dst: 不過我的事說夠了。換你。你為什麼會在這裡，受詛者？你來 Fruma 的目的是什麼？
A New Beginning#106.speaker: Syndra

A New Beginning#107.src: Interesting. A sense that something isn't right...
A New Beginning#107.dst: 有意思。一種「哪裡不對勁」的感覺……
A New Beginning#107.speaker: Syndra

A New Beginning#108.src: To tell you the truth, it's one I've had myself for quite some time. Though, likely for a different reason to you.
A New Beginning#108.dst: 老實說，那種感覺我自己也有很久了。只是原因大概跟你不一樣。
A New Beginning#108.speaker: Syndra

A New Beginning#109.src: A noble cause… It is one I can wholeheartedly support.
A New Beginning#109.dst: 高尚的理由……那是我可以全心支持的。
A New Beginning#109.speaker: Syndra

A New Beginning#110.src: In a world like this, the most we can do sometimes is hold on to those we care for. Take care not to lose that drive.
A New Beginning#110.dst: 在這樣的世界裡，我們有時候能做的，也就是牢牢抓住自己在乎的人。小心別把那股動力弄丟了。
A New Beginning#110.speaker: Syndra

A New Beginning#111.src: Then, I would ask of you one more thing. A test, in a way...
A New Beginning#111.dst: 那麼，我還想請你做一件事。算是一場試煉……
A New Beginning#111.speaker: Syndra

A New Beginning#112.src: The power you carry the curse you bear. I have seen such things before, yet always at a distance. Never up close.
A New Beginning#112.dst: 你身上帶著的力量——你背負的詛咒。這種東西我以前見過，但一直是遠遠地看。從來沒有近距離看過。
A New Beginning#112.speaker: Syndra

A New Beginning#113.src: I would ask for a duel. Nothing dangerous, or lethal... I have safeguards in place for myself, so do not test my limits. When I call it, we stop.
A New Beginning#113.dst: 我想跟你決鬥一場。不危險，也不致命……我這邊有保命的手段，所以別去試我的極限。我喊停，我們就停。
A New Beginning#113.speaker: Syndra

A New Beginning#114.src: I would simply like to see the strength of a cursed one in battle firsthand. So, then. Let us begin!
A New Beginning#114.dst: 我只是想親眼看看一個受詛者在戰鬥中的強度。那麼——開始吧！
A New Beginning#114.speaker: Syndra

A New Beginning#117.src: Impressive. Very impressive. I have never seen a cursed one with such control and technique...
A New Beginning#117.dst: 了不起。非常了不起。我從沒見過控制力與技巧這麼好的受詛者……
A New Beginning#117.speaker: Syndra

A New Beginning#118.src: If I did not know better, I would believe you to have been blessed by the crown itself.
A New Beginning#118.dst: 若不是我知道得清楚，我會以為你是受了王室本身的賜福。
A New Beginning#118.speaker: Syndra

A New Beginning#119.src: Your power, your spells. The ability to bend the world to your whim, to wield the elements for your own gain.
A New Beginning#119.dst: 你的力量、你的法術。那種讓世界順你心意彎折、驅使元素為己所用的能力。
A New Beginning#119.speaker: Syndra

A New Beginning#120.src: Eons ago, so the stories say, the world was pure and balanced. Our people lived with the land, content with what we had.
A New Beginning#120.dst: 故事說，久遠以前，這個世界是純淨而平衡的。我們的人與土地共生，安於所有。
A New Beginning#120.speaker: Syndra

A New Beginning#121.src: And yet, an evil force lurked within us, a malice which despised our peace and happiness. One day, it burst forth, granting unimaginable power to those it deemed worthy...
A New Beginning#121.dst: 然而有一股邪惡潛伏在我們之中，它憎恨我們的和平與幸福。有一天它爆發出來，把難以想像的力量賜給它認為配得上的人……
A New Beginning#121.speaker: Syndra

A New Beginning#122.src: Its power could not be controlled. Those cursed by its touch went on to tear apart the land, destroying cities and towns... fear overtook the land, none were safe.
A New Beginning#122.dst: 那份力量無法被控制。被它碰過而受詛的人，開始撕裂大地、摧毀城鎮……恐懼籠罩整片土地，沒有人是安全的。
A New Beginning#122.speaker: Syndra

A New Beginning#123.src: Until she arrived, a force of good to counter the evil. She granted her own blessings to the people of Fruma, power which could be controlled and wielded to banish the cursed.
A New Beginning#123.dst: 直到她出現，一股與邪惡抗衡的良善之力。她把自己的祝福賜給 Fruma 的人民，那是可以被控制、可以被駕馭、用來放逐受詛者的力量。
A New Beginning#123.speaker: Syndra

A New Beginning#124.src: She saved our province, and became our immortal Queen. Always looking out for the people, always alert for the presence of evil... for it could not be killed, only staved off.
A New Beginning#124.dst: 她拯救了我們的行省，成為我們不朽的女王。永遠照看著人民，永遠對邪惡的氣息保持警覺……因為那東西殺不死，只能擋著。
A New Beginning#124.speaker: Syndra

A New Beginning#125.src: The cursed ones never left. They only grew smarter, more capable of hiding from the crown's watchful eye.
A New Beginning#125.dst: 受詛者從未離去。他們只是變得更聰明，更懂得躲開王室的眼睛。
A New Beginning#125.speaker: Syndra

A New Beginning#126.src: And so, it tells the people, always be aware. Always be looking for the cursed ones. It is only a matter of time before they hurt you.
A New Beginning#126.dst: 於是王室告訴人民，要時時警醒。要時時提防受詛者。他們傷害你，只是時間問題。
A New Beginning#126.speaker: Syndra

A New Beginning#127.src: ...I have a different perspective on this story, you might imagine. The crown has wronged me, and many others. Yet, the stories hold truths to them, to an extent.
A New Beginning#127.dst: ……你大概想得到，我對這個故事有不同的看法。王室虧欠我，也虧欠許多人。但那些故事，在某個程度上仍有它的真實。
A New Beginning#127.speaker: Syndra

A New Beginning#128.src: That is why your control over your power has interested me. It bears more traits of the crown's blessings than of the evil's curses, and yet...
A New Beginning#128.dst: 這就是為什麼你對力量的控制讓我感興趣。它更像王室的賜福，而不像那股邪惡的詛咒，然而……
A New Beginning#128.speaker: Syndra

A New Beginning#129.src: Magic... yes, that term has been used in higher studies at the University.
A New Beginning#129.dst: 魔法……是的，大學裡的高階研究用過這個詞。
A New Beginning#129.speaker: Syndra

A New Beginning#130.src: But a land filled with cursed ones... and it isn't destroyed? I suppose I have had no reason to believe the crown's reports about it, but...
A New Beginning#130.dst: 可是一整片土地都是受詛者……卻沒有毀滅？我想我本來也沒有理由相信王室對那邊的報告，只是……
A New Beginning#130.speaker: Syndra

A New Beginning#131.src: I need time to process this information. But I would like to discuss it with you further, at a later date, if you would be willing.
A New Beginning#131.dst: 我需要一點時間消化這些消息。不過我希望日後能跟你再談得深一點，如果你願意的話。
A New Beginning#131.speaker: Syndra

A New Beginning#132.src: Then that leads me to my final request. Would you join our cause, and offer your help to our resistance group? Your knowledge and strength would be greatly appreciated.
A New Beginning#132.dst: 那麼，這就帶到我最後一個請求。你願不願意加入我們的目標，向我們的反抗組織伸出援手？你的知識與力量會是莫大的助力。
A New Beginning#132.speaker: Syndra

A New Beginning#133.src: Thank you. I will take you to meet with the others, then. Our home is directly to the south-west, it should be hard to miss. I'll meet you there.
A New Beginning#133.dst: 謝謝你。那我帶你去見其他人。我們的家就在西南邊，很難錯過。我們在那裡碰面。
A New Beginning#133.speaker: Syndra

A New Beginning#134.src: Follow Syndra to the resistance base at .
A New Beginning#134.dst: 跟著 Syndra 前往  的反抗軍基地。

A New Beginning#135.src: There you are, {u}. I see you found your way here alright.
A New Beginning#135.dst: 你來了，{u}。看來你順利找到路了。
A New Beginning#135.speaker: Syndra

A New Beginning#136.src: If you're going to be joining us, I should introduce you to the others.
A New Beginning#136.dst: 你既然要加入我們，我該把你介紹給其他人。
A New Beginning#136.speaker: Syndra

A New Beginning#137.src: Ahem... Children, come on out! We have a new member I'd like you to meet.
A New Beginning#137.dst: 咳咳……孩子們，都出來！有位新成員我想介紹給你們。
A New Beginning#137.speaker: Syndra

A New Beginning#138.src: We m-meet again! I knew you'd be a g-good fit!
A New Beginning#138.dst: 我、我們又見面了！我就知道你很適、適合！
A New Beginning#138.speaker: Zeph

A New Beginning#139.src: Yeah, Zeph, we know. You've been saying so for hours...
A New Beginning#139.dst: 是是是，Zeph，我們知道。你已經講了好幾個小時了……
A New Beginning#139.speaker: Rex

A New Beginning#140.src: Ah, lighten up Rex. Welcome to the Leaves, friend! No matter your origin, if Syndra believes you to be trustworthy, it must be so.
A New Beginning#140.dst: 好啦，別繃著臉，Rex。歡迎加入風中之葉，朋友！不管你從哪裡來，只要 Syndra 認為你值得信任，那就必然如此。
A New Beginning#140.speaker: Mora

A New Beginning#141.src: On that subject, {u} here is from outside of our province. They'll be joining our resistance against the crown...
A New Beginning#141.dst: 說到這個，這位 {u} 是我們行省之外來的。他們會加入我們對抗王室的行動……
A New Beginning#141.speaker: Syndra

A New Beginning#142.src: ...and, hopefully, they'll be able to help me resolve some theories I have on the nature of curses and blessings.
A New Beginning#142.dst: ……而且但願，他們能幫我釐清我對詛咒與賜福本質的一些推想。
A New Beginning#142.speaker: Syndra

A New Beginning#144.src: Yes. But they're no threat to us. We share the same enemies. And, having that power on our side could make a huge difference for our efforts.
A New Beginning#144.dst: 是的。但他們對我們沒有威脅。我們有共同的敵人。而且，把那份力量拉到我們這一邊，會讓我們的努力產生很大的差別。
