Celebrations in Smoke#490.speaker: Festival Organizer

Celebrations in Smoke#491.src: All monsters, old and new, must meet their end—
Celebrations in Smoke#491.speaker: Festival Organizer

Celebrations in Smoke#492.src: All fiends must burn! Must broil and char and melt!
Celebrations in Smoke#492.speaker: Festival Organizer

Celebrations in Smoke#493.src: Substance beside, all that remains persists...
Celebrations in Smoke#493.speaker: Festival Organizer

Celebrations in Smoke#494.src: ...as blackened corpse, no threat there can exist!
Celebrations in Smoke#494.speaker: Festival Organizer

Celebrations in Smoke#495.src: Oh, hi, I never got the chance to thank you.
Celebrations in Smoke#495.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#496.src: I'm not sure what happened after you left.
Celebrations in Smoke#496.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#497.src: The festival organizer came back and took Burick/Cerisa away with him.
Celebrations in Smoke#497.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#498.src: I'm not sure what happened but, um, I don't think it was good.
Celebrations in Smoke#498.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#499.src: So, thank you again. I wasn't really in the right mind enough to show it then.
Celebrations in Smoke#499.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#501.src: I'll see how long I can hang around here, but the locals are beginning to glare at me a bit.
Celebrations in Smoke#501.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#502.src: I might try to head deeper into the woods, see if there's anything I can find.
Celebrations in Smoke#502.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#503.src: Or join the military? I don't think I'd be very good at it and I don't even think they'd accept me, but it might be worth a shot.
Celebrations in Smoke#503.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#504.src: Otherwise, all I can do is try to live off of what I can find. I, uh, don't like my chances with that.
Celebrations in Smoke#504.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#505.src: I am! I'm always a, uh, little nervous. But a lot less than I was.
Celebrations in Smoke#505.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#506.src: It felt like the axe that had been pressed against my neck was lifted, thanks to you.
Celebrations in Smoke#506.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#507.src: There's still a lot of uncertainty, but I no longer feel like I'm scrambling like a rabbit in a cage.
Celebrations in Smoke#507.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#508.src: I was still in a bit of a daze, so not really, sorry.
Celebrations in Smoke#508.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#509.src: She left pretty quick though, she must have been in a hurry to get somewhere
Celebrations in Smoke#509.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#511.src: Hello. Please try not to come too close.
Celebrations in Smoke#511.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#512.src: We can talk from a distance.
Celebrations in Smoke#512.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#513.src: Apologies for the coolness, your help was appreciated.
Celebrations in Smoke#513.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#514.src: But I cannot be sure you are who you say you are.
Celebrations in Smoke#514.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#516.src: Since our run in at the festival, I have been laying lower than usual.
Celebrations in Smoke#516.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#517.src: My life has not been much different than it usually is.
Celebrations in Smoke#517.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#518.src: It was a horrific mistake to even attend the festival.
Celebrations in Smoke#518.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#519.src: I allowed myself to be controlled by my own humanity; that is a mistake the {p} rarely lets off easily.
Celebrations in Smoke#519.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#520.src: I will not make the same mistake again. Loneliness will hurt, but trust will kill.
Celebrations in Smoke#520.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#521.src: Last I saw, they were still in {p}.
Celebrations in Smoke#521.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#522.src: They don't seem cut out for the life of a scavenger, if they can't find any other way to live outside a clan they'll be dead within the week.
Celebrations in Smoke#522.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#524.src: Yes, while everyone else was watching the wickerman burn she rustled through as many abandoned stalls, bags, and houses as she could.
Celebrations in Smoke#524.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#525.src: I left before she was finished, but this morning I saw a figure walking south out of {p}, carrying several large bags.
Celebrations in Smoke#525.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#526.src: Wherever she's headed, she's prepared for a long trek.
Celebrations in Smoke#526.speaker: Burick

Clearing the Camps#000.src: Talk to Captain Kymer outside {p} at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
Clearing the Camps#000.dst: 到 {p} 外面找 Captain Kymer，座標 [-{~1}, {~2}, -{~3}]

Clearing the Camps#001.src: Aha, another {p} soldier, eh? Well, a warm welcome to you.
Clearing the Camps#001.dst: 啊哈，又一個 {p} 的兵，是吧？歡迎歡迎。
Clearing the Camps#001.speaker: Captain Kymer

Clearing the Camps#002.src: Did you hear about the requests from the Villagers we've gotten? They say these "Orcs" and "Goblins" are threatening their towns and cities.
Clearing the Camps#002.dst: 你聽說村民那邊送來的請求了嗎？他們說這些「Orcs」和「Goblins」正在威脅他們的城鎮。
Clearing the Camps#002.speaker: Captain Kymer

Clearing the Camps#003.src: Primitive, brutal creatures, apparently little better than the zombies we're used to, at least according to the {p} military.
Clearing the Camps#003.dst: 照 {p} 軍方的說法，那是些原始又粗暴的東西，大概比我們慣見的殭屍好不了多少。
Clearing the Camps#003.speaker: Captain Kymer

Clearing the Camps#004.src: So, we figure if might makes right with them, then defeating their leaders should scare them into submission.
Clearing the Camps#004.dst: 所以我們判斷，既然牠們信奉拳頭大就是道理，那把首領打趴應該就能嚇得牠們安分。
Clearing the Camps#004.speaker: Captain Kymer

Clearing the Camps#005.src: Our scouts have identified three "chief" orcs in the area- Elisu, Ceifko and Veltu. Though, strangely Veltu is always surrounded by goblins...
Clearing the Camps#005.dst: 斥候在這一帶認出了三個「酋長」級的獸人——Elisu、Ceifko 和 Veltu。不過奇怪的是，Veltu 身邊永遠圍著一群哥布林……
Clearing the Camps#005.speaker: Captain Kymer

Clearing the Camps#006.src: Well, whatever the case, we're needed to defend {p} here. Can you handle the chiefs? They seem to hide in the camps with green flags- search the plains, return once they're dealt with!
Clearing the Camps#006.dst: 算了，不管怎樣，我們得留在這裡守 {p}。那幾個酋長交給你行嗎？牠們好像躲在插著綠旗的營地裡——去平原上找找，解決了再回來！
Clearing the Camps#006.speaker: Captain Kymer

Clearing the Camps#007.src: Find and kill Orc Chieftains Elisu, Veltu, and Ceifko in the camps around {p}- look for green flags
Clearing the Camps#007.dst: 在 {p} 周圍的營地找出並擊殺獸人酋長 Elisu、Veltu 和 Ceifko——找插著綠旗的地方

Clearing the Camps#008.src: Report back to Captain Kymer once you have the three heads.
Clearing the Camps#008.dst: 取得三顆首級後回報 Captain Kymer。

Clearing the Camps#009.src: Ah, the soldier from earlier! You're back, I see. Any luck defeating those- ...yeesh. Are those their heads?
Clearing the Camps#009.dst: 啊，剛才那個兵！你回來啦。那幾個傢伙有沒有——……唔。那些是牠們的頭嗎？
Clearing the Camps#009.speaker: Captain Kymer

Clearing the Camps#010.src: That's...harsher than I intended, but it works... Not like the Villagers care if they're dead of alive, as long as they're dealt with. I have your share of the reward here.
Clearing the Camps#010.dst: 這……比我原本想的血腥了點，不過有用就好……反正村民也不在乎死活，解決了就行。這是你那份獎賞。
Clearing the Camps#010.speaker: Captain Kymer

Clearing the Camps#011.src: This kind of surgical strike should help prevent an all-out war with the Orcs. Not sure we'd want a full-scale war to deal with in each province, hah!
Clearing the Camps#011.dst: 這種精準打擊應該能避免跟獸人全面開戰。可不希望每個省都得應付一場大戰，哈！
Clearing the Camps#011.speaker: Captain Kymer

Clearing the Camps#012.src: You saw that the creatures in Gavel aren't akin to Wynnic fare while you were out, yes? They're a bit, ah...livelier than usual. Better get used to it.
Clearing the Camps#012.dst: 你在外面也看到了吧，Gavel 的生物跟 Wynn 那邊不是同一個檔次？牠們稍微……嗯，有活力得多。習慣一下比較好。
Clearing the Camps#012.speaker: Captain Kymer

Clearing the Camps#013.src: The next major settlement is {p}, in the swamp up north, but I hear the swamp ogres are a lot tougher than the plains' fare. I'd stick around here and train up, first.
Clearing the Camps#013.dst: 下一個大聚落是北邊沼澤裡的 {p}，不過我聽說沼澤食人妖比平原上的難纏得多。我會建議先留在這附近練一練。
Clearing the Camps#013.speaker: Captain Kymer

Cluck Cluck#001.src: Hey, you aren't a chicken! Wait, you're a human! You can help me! Maybe you are the guy who helped my brother Yahya, but who knows, you humans all look the same to me.
Cluck Cluck#001.dst: 喂，你不是隻雞啊！等等，你是個人類，你能幫我！也許你就是幫助了我兄弟 Yahya 的人，但誰知道呢，對我來説你們人類看起來都差不多。
Cluck Cluck#001.speaker: Nohno

Cluck Cluck#002.src: I really love my chickens, but there is one that I just cannot control...
Cluck Cluck#002.dst: 我超愛我的雞們！但裏面有那麽一隻雞我制衡不了...
Cluck Cluck#002.speaker: Nohno

Cluck Cluck#003.src: His name is Cluckles, he was given to me by a man named Bob before he went to war, but when Bob never came back, Cluckles got angry...
Cluck Cluck#003.dst: 他的名字叫 Cluckles ，是一個叫 Bob 的人去打仗前給我的。但是 Bob 再也沒有回來， Cluckles 就森七七了...
Cluck Cluck#003.speaker: Nohno

Cluck Cluck#004.src: He's really dangerous to keep on my lovely island, so I keep him in my basement...
Cluck Cluck#004.dst: 他對於我美麗的小島實在是個大威脅，我逼不得已把他關進了地下室...
Cluck Cluck#004.speaker: Nohno

Cluck Cluck#005.src: I want to take care of him, but my wife says it's too dangerous. Where's my wife you say? Oh, I think she's around here eating some grain.
Cluck Cluck#005.dst: 我也很想關照一下他，但我老婆說太危險了。你說我的老婆在哪裏？噢，我覺得她大概在附近吃穀物呢。
Cluck Cluck#005.speaker: Nohno

Cluck Cluck#006.src: Anyway, I need you to go down there and... Take care of him for me. I would really appreciate it.
Cluck Cluck#006.dst: 所以呢，我需要你下去地下室，然後...幫我關照一下他。我會很感激的。
Cluck Cluck#006.speaker: Nohno

Cluck Cluck#007.src: Bring back [{~} Cluckles' Favourite Feather] to Nohno.
Cluck Cluck#007.dst: 帶回 [[Cluckles' Favourite Feather|[{~} Cluckles' Favourite Feather]]] 給予 Nohno 。

Cluck Cluck#008.src: What is this?! His feather? What did you do to Cluckles?! I wanted you to take care of him, not kill him!
Cluck Cluck#008.dst: 這是什麽？他的羽毛？你對 Cluckles 做了什麽？！我只是要你照顧一下他，不是殺了他啊！
Cluck Cluck#008.speaker: Nohno

Cluck Cluck#009.src: You monster! Leave this place now, and keep that feather to remind you of your hideous crime!
Cluck Cluck#009.dst: 你這個禽獸！帶著這個羽毛離開這裏，讓你好好記住你幹的差勁罪行！
Cluck Cluck#009.speaker: Nohno

Cook Assistant#000.src: Talk to the Cook in {p} at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Cook Assistant#001.src: I can't believe what is happening to me.
Cook Assistant#001.dst: 我真不敢相信我怎麼這麼倒楣。
Cook Assistant#001.speaker: The Cook

Cook Assistant#002.src: The King ordered me to bake cakes for all those new recruits!
Cook Assistant#002.dst: 國王下令要我為那些新兵烤蛋糕！
Cook Assistant#002.speaker: The Cook

Cook Assistant#003.src: Unfortunately, a Grook took my last cake, and I ran out of ingredients!
Cook Assistant#003.dst: 偏偏有隻 Grook 叼走了我最後一個蛋糕，材料還剛好用完！
Cook Assistant#003.speaker: The Cook

Cook Assistant#005.src: That's the Grook! Go chase it down and get my cake back!
Cook Assistant#005.dst: 就是那隻 Grook！快去追，把我的蛋糕搶回來！
Cook Assistant#005.speaker: The Cook

Cook Assistant#007.src: The Grook got away! Return to the Cook at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] to figure out what to do.
Cook Assistant#007.dst: Grook 跑掉了！回去 [-{~1}, {~2}, -{~3}] 找 the Cook 想想辦法。

Cook Assistant#008.src: What are you doing? Go after the Grook...
Cook Assistant#008.dst: 你在做什麼？快去追那隻 Grook 啊……
Cook Assistant#008.speaker: The Cook

Cook Assistant#010.src: Well, I guess you are going to have to help me find the ingredients and bake another...
Cook Assistant#010.dst: 唉，看來你只好幫我把材料找齊，再烤一個了……
Cook Assistant#010.speaker: The Cook

Cook Assistant#011.src: There he is again! After him!
Cook Assistant#011.speaker: The Cook

Cook Assistant#012.src: Find out where the Grook flew up to at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Cook Assistant#012.dst: 查清楚那隻 Grook 飛上哪裡去了，座標 [-{~1}, {~2}, -{~3}]。

Cook Assistant#013.src: Return to the cook at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]. Use a Scroll to get there faster.

Cook Assistant#015.src: I can't thank you enough! Here, take these emeralds and armour for all your trouble.
Cook Assistant#015.dst: 真是感激不盡！來，這些綠寶石和防具給你，就當是補償。
Cook Assistant#015.speaker: The Cook

Cook Assistant#016.src: You should explore around to become stronger. I hear there might be work to do in {p}.
Cook Assistant#016.dst: 你該到處走走、練得更強一點。我聽說 {p} 那邊好像有活可以幹。
Cook Assistant#016.speaker: The Cook

Corrupted Betrayal#001.src: Hey, soldier! Yeah, you! Got some spare time to lend a hand?
Corrupted Betrayal#001.dst: 喂，士兵！對，就是你！有空幫個忙嗎？
Corrupted Betrayal#001.speaker: Lanu

Corrupted Betrayal#002.src: We've got a major issue with this old fortress. It keeps spewing out all these damned slimes, and their proximity to {p} is causing issues.
Corrupted Betrayal#002.dst: 我們這座老要塞出了個大問題。裡頭一直冒出一堆該死的史萊姆，而且離 {p} 太近，已經開始造成麻煩了。
Corrupted Betrayal#002.speaker: Lanu

Corrupted Betrayal#003.src: Soldiers are spending half their guard duty slicing the critters into sludge. Ideally we'd raid the cave, cut out the source, but...
Corrupted Betrayal#003.dst: 士兵們執行警戒任務時，有一半時間都在砍這些傢伙，把牠們剁成爛泥。理想上是直接攻進洞穴，把源頭處理掉，可是...
Corrupted Betrayal#003.speaker: Lanu

Corrupted Betrayal#004.src: This place has some history. Nasty stuff. I'd prefer not to head in blind, so I've been checking for any clues to what we might find inside.
Corrupted Betrayal#004.dst: 這地方可是有些不太光彩的歷史。我不太想在什麼都不知道的情況下就直接闖進去，所以一直在找裡面到底會有什麼的線索。
Corrupted Betrayal#004.speaker: Lanu

Corrupted Betrayal#005.src: Haven't found much... except this verse, 'scribed into the wall over there. Go on, check it out and let me know what you think.
Corrupted Betrayal#005.dst: 沒找到多少東西...除了那邊牆上刻著的這首詩。去看看吧，告訴我你覺得那是什麼意思。
Corrupted Betrayal#005.speaker: Lanu

Corrupted Betrayal#006.src: Nonsense, if you ask me. Most likely kids from {p} messing about. But we haven't found anything else, so... if you've got any time, fancy checking it out for me?
Corrupted Betrayal#006.dst: 在我看來，這詩毫無意義。大概只是 {p} 的小孩在胡鬧。不過我們也沒找到其他線索，所以...你要是有空，能不能幫我去看看？
Corrupted Betrayal#006.speaker: Lanu

Corrupted Betrayal#007.src: The first line is obviously talking about the Great Bridge, but I've no clue what the rest means. Head over there, take a look around, and tell me if you find anything interesting.
Corrupted Betrayal#007.dst: 第一行顯然是在說Great Bridge，但剩下的我就完全看不懂了。你去那邊四處看看，找到什麼有意思的東西就回來告訴我。
Corrupted Betrayal#007.speaker: Lanu

Corrupted Betrayal#008.src: Found anything interesting around the riddle yet? Do you need to hear it again?
Corrupted Betrayal#008.dst: 謎語中有什麼有趣的東西嗎？要不要我再念一遍？
Corrupted Betrayal#008.speaker: Lanu

Corrupted Betrayal#009.src: Near a corrupted bridge, a ruin past its prime..
Corrupted Betrayal#009.dst: 腐化大橋旁，破敗遺跡邊...
Corrupted Betrayal#009.speaker: Lanu

Corrupted Betrayal#010.src: Lives a cursed sheep, with the color of lime...
Corrupted Betrayal#010.dst: 受詛咒之羊，綠如青檸鮮...
Corrupted Betrayal#010.speaker: Lanu

Corrupted Betrayal#011.src: Lead it down the trail, headed to the slime...
Corrupted Betrayal#011.dst: 引牠沿小徑，走向那片污泥中...
Corrupted Betrayal#011.speaker: Lanu

Corrupted Betrayal#012.src: Sacrifice its soul, in the blood and the grime.
Corrupted Betrayal#012.dst: 獻祭牠的靈魂，在血與污泥中長眠。
Corrupted Betrayal#012.speaker: Lanu

Corrupted Betrayal#013.src: The first line is obviously talking about the Great Bridge, but I've no clue what the rest means. Head over there, take a look around, and tell me if you find anything interesting.
Corrupted Betrayal#013.dst: 第一行顯然是在說Great Bridge，但剩下的我就完全看不懂了。你去那邊四處看看，找到什麼有意思的東西就回來告訴我。
Corrupted Betrayal#013.speaker: Lanu

Corrupted Betrayal#014.src: Alrighty. Let me know what when you've got something then.
Corrupted Betrayal#014.dst: 好吧。有什麼發現再告訴我一聲。
Corrupted Betrayal#014.speaker: Lanu

Corrupted Betrayal#015.src: Use the Mage's riddle to figure out where it leads
Corrupted Betrayal#015.dst: 根據法師的謎語，找出它指向的地方。

Corrupted Betrayal#016.src: If you are heading towards the Great Bridge, be cautious in the plains around the jungle entrance.
Corrupted Betrayal#016.dst: 如果你要前往Great Bridge，經過叢林入口附近的平原時務必小心。
Corrupted Betrayal#016.speaker: Troms Guard

Corrupted Betrayal#017.src: I have received reports of a strange cursed sheep taking refuge in one of the more fortified ruins around there.
Corrupted Betrayal#017.dst: 我收到消息，說附近一座防禦工事遺址裡有一隻奇怪的受詛咒綿羊躲在裡面。
Corrupted Betrayal#017.speaker: Troms Guard

Corrupted Betrayal#018.src: As far as I know, it is trapped in the ruins by some jungle growth, though if it was cut down it might escape...
Corrupted Betrayal#018.dst: 據我所知，牠被遺址裡的叢生植物困住了，不過要是把那些植物砍掉，牠或許就會逃出去……
Corrupted Betrayal#018.speaker: Troms Guard

Corrupted Betrayal#019.src: Explore the temple for a way to break the barrier.
Corrupted Betrayal#019.dst: 探索神殿，尋找突破屏障的方法。

Corrupted Betrayal#020.src: Go to Slykaar's residence at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] to find out what is hidden there.
Corrupted Betrayal#020.dst: 前往 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] Slykaar的住所，調查那裡隱藏著什麼。

Corrupted Betrayal#021.src: By order of the city of {p}, I am here to keep other citizens from entering this house.
Corrupted Betrayal#021.dst: 奉 {p} 城市之令，我在此阻止其他市民進入這棟房子。
Corrupted Betrayal#021.speaker: Troms Guard

Corrupted Betrayal#022.src: From past experiences, everyone who has entered this house has vanished from existence...
Corrupted Betrayal#022.dst: 根據過去的經驗，進入這棟房子的人都從這個世界上消失了...
Corrupted Betrayal#022.speaker: Troms Guard

Corrupted Betrayal#023.src: I would advise not going inside unless you know what you are doing.
Corrupted Betrayal#023.dst: 除非你知道自己在做什麼，否則我勸你最好別進去。
Corrupted Betrayal#023.speaker: Troms Guard

Corrupted Betrayal#024.src: Well, I guess you must know who I am.
Corrupted Betrayal#024.dst: 嗯，我想你肯定知道我是誰。

Corrupted Betrayal#025.src: Welcome to my domain. I am the hero of {p}, Slykaar.
Corrupted Betrayal#025.dst: 歡迎來到我的領地。我就是 {p} 的英雄——Slykaar。

Corrupted Betrayal#026.src: Well, I used to be. Banished by the very people who asked for my help. Pathetic.
Corrupted Betrayal#026.dst: 嗯，曾經是。 被那些向我求助的人親手放逐。可悲。
Corrupted Betrayal#026.speaker: Slykaar

Corrupted Betrayal#027.src: They couldn't give me a few peasants for their safety? Weak.
Corrupted Betrayal#027.dst: 連幾個平民都不願交給我保護？真是懦弱。
Corrupted Betrayal#027.speaker: Slykaar

Corrupted Betrayal#029.src: I experimented my shamanism for many years underground to create the perfect mix of monster.
Corrupted Betrayal#029.dst: 我在地下鑽研薩滿巫術多年，只為創造出最完美的怪物。
Corrupted Betrayal#029.speaker: Slykaar

Corrupted Betrayal#030.src: Most ended in horrific slimes. Aggressive and powerful, but alas, just slimes.
Corrupted Betrayal#030.dst: 絕大多數實驗最後都變成了可怕的史萊姆。既兇猛又強大，但終究只是史萊姆。
Corrupted Betrayal#030.speaker: Slykaar

Corrupted Betrayal#031.src: Then I found this place. A dark land. A dark god. A source of power.
Corrupted Betrayal#031.dst: 然後，我找到了這個地方。一片黑暗的大地。一位黑暗的神明。一股強大的力量源泉。
Corrupted Betrayal#031.speaker: Slykaar

Corrupted Betrayal#032.src: You mediocre wielders of magic have no idea what this world holds.
Corrupted Betrayal#032.dst: 你們這些平庸的魔法使用者根本不知道這個世界藏著什麼。
Corrupted Betrayal#032.speaker: Slykaar

Corrupted Betrayal#033.src: You all strive to be that hero of heroes, “Bob”, but here's the truth. He's lost. You're lost.
Corrupted Betrayal#033.dst: 你們所有人都渴望成為那個「英雄中的英雄」——Bob。但讓我告訴你真相吧。他迷失了。你也一樣。
Corrupted Betrayal#033.speaker: Slykaar

Corrupted Betrayal#034.src: No one in the Wynn province is willing to make the sacrifices I am to gain power.
Corrupted Betrayal#034.dst: 整個Wynn省中沒有人願意像我一樣，付出這種代價來換取力量。
Corrupted Betrayal#034.speaker: Slykaar

Corrupted Betrayal#035.src: If you want power, you have to give some. Sacrifice a few to save many.
Corrupted Betrayal#035.dst: 想要力量，就得付出代價。犧牲少數人，拯救更多人。
Corrupted Betrayal#035.speaker: Slykaar

Corrupted Betrayal#036.src: They were willing to give me a few peasants in {~}, when the hordes crossed the bridge.
Corrupted Betrayal#036.dst: {~} 年那群大軍越過橋時，他們可是願意交給我幾個平民。
Corrupted Betrayal#036.speaker: Slykaar

Corrupted Betrayal#037.src: The king was happy to throw away lives to save his. But then the hero of Wynn waltzed in a few years later.
Corrupted Betrayal#037.dst: 國王很樂意犧牲別人的性命來保住自己的命。可幾年後，Wynn的英雄卻大搖大擺地出現了。
Corrupted Betrayal#037.speaker: Slykaar

Corrupted Betrayal#038.src: They banished me like a rotten fruit. Their hero, their protector. So what if a few hundred nobodies died for it.
Corrupted Betrayal#038.dst: 他們就像丟掉爛水果一樣把我放逐了。明明我是他們的英雄，是他們的守護者。那又怎樣？不過就是死了幾百個無名小卒而已。
Corrupted Betrayal#038.speaker: Slykaar

Corrupted Betrayal#039.src: Looks like we have a Bob aspirer. Pale imitation.
Corrupted Betrayal#039.dst: 看來我們這裡來了個想成為Bob的傢伙。只不過是個拙劣的仿冒品。
Corrupted Betrayal#039.speaker: Slykaar

Corrupted Betrayal#040.src: So. Feel free to visit me down below, bring the entire might of the {p} army upon me. It will not be enough.
Corrupted Betrayal#040.dst: 那麼，儘管來下面找我吧。即使全 {p} 軍隊的力量來對付我。那也遠遠不夠。
Corrupted Betrayal#040.speaker: Slykaar

Corrupted Betrayal#041.src: I am ready. Soon, {p} will be in ruins. And I shall have my revenge.
Corrupted Betrayal#041.dst: 我已經準備好了。很快，{p} 就會化為廢墟。而我也將大仇得報。
Corrupted Betrayal#041.speaker: Slykaar

Corrupted Betrayal#042.src: Go have fun in while you can. It's not like you have much of a life to live, anyways.
Corrupted Betrayal#042.dst: 趁還能玩的時候好好玩吧。反正你的人生也所剩無幾了。
Corrupted Betrayal#042.speaker: Slykaar

Corrupted Betrayal#043.src: Report back to Lanu about what you've learned.
Corrupted Betrayal#043.dst: 將你查到的情報回報給Lanu。

Corrupted Betrayal#044.src: Ah, you're back. Find anything interesting? I've just been knocking back the occasional slime that pops up out of this cave.
Corrupted Betrayal#044.dst: 啊，你回來了。找到什麼有趣的東西嗎？我剛才也只是偶爾收拾一下從這洞穴裡冒出來的史萊姆。
Corrupted Betrayal#044.speaker: Lanu

Corrupted Betrayal#045.src: You... saw Slykaar? In another dimension?!
Corrupted Betrayal#045.dst: 你...見到Slykaar了？還是在另一個次元裡？！
Corrupted Betrayal#045.speaker: Lanu

Corrupted Betrayal#046.src: This is bad. If he can materialise outside of this cave, even psychoactively... he's getting stronger. It explains the slimes, the attacks on {p}...
Corrupted Betrayal#046.dst: 這下糟了。如果他能離開這座洞穴，甚至能以某種精神上的形態出現在外面...那就表示他正在變得越來越強。這也就能解釋那些史萊姆，以及對 {p} 的襲擊了...
Corrupted Betrayal#046.speaker: Lanu

Corrupted Betrayal#047.src: He's an incredibly powerful shaman, {u}. He has to be stopped, but it would take forever for {p} to mobile a force against him.
Corrupted Betrayal#047.dst: 他是個力量極其強大的薩滿，{u}。我們必須阻止他，但 {p} 恐怕得花上很長的時間才能集結一支部隊去對付他。
Corrupted Betrayal#047.speaker: Lanu

Corrupted Betrayal#048.src: If you can, you should head in there and... finish him off. Gear up first, though, and find some friends watch your back.

Cowfusion#191.src: Into the elevator now, come on! You need a key to get in anyway, and I definitely don't have one laying around!
Cowfusion#191.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#192.src: ...You're worrying me. Come on, let's get going. Into the elevator, let's get you back to normal.
Cowfusion#192.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#194.src: Uh. Do you- do you understand what I'm saying?
Cowfusion#194.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#195.src: ...This is stupid. I'm talking to a cow. Of course you can't...
Cowfusion#195.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#197.src: Well I guess I could- talk at you. For a bit. If that's, heh, fine with you!
Cowfusion#197.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#198.src: It's been tough, recently. Working towards a goal I know is important, but still feels... out of reach.
Cowfusion#198.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#199.src: And it doesn't seem like anybody else can see that! That this is important! They look at me like I'm going crazy, and-
Cowfusion#199.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#200.src: I'm not. I know I'm not. We need to find the ship. If we don't, who knows what...
Cowfusion#200.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#201.src: Anyway! Here's the elevator! Just step on in, and we can head on up to the laboratory.
Cowfusion#201.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#202.src: Hrrgh- You're- you're not a cow?! Why would you... I just said all that, and you could...
Cowfusion#202.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#203.src: D-Don't worry about the door. It's... It's nothing. Maintenance. That- that's what it is.
Cowfusion#203.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#204.src: Er... come on, into the elevator! You want to get back to normal, right? Besides, you'd need a key to get in there, and I don't know where you'd find one of those, haha!
Cowfusion#204.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#205.src: ...Moo. Yep. I agree. Come on, let's get going. Into the elevator.
Cowfusion#205.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#206.src: So... here we are. The lab!
Cowfusion#206.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#207.src: Just... follow me, for now. The machine is this way.
Cowfusion#207.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#208.src: There it is! If you step into the machine, real quick, it should... it should work!
Cowfusion#208.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#210.src: Look at you! As good as new!
Cowfusion#210.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#212.src: Heh... Well, there you are! Good as new! I hope...
Cowfusion#212.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#213.src: And- to, uh, compensate you for... you know... Here! One liquid emerald. I feel terrible for how our reunion ended up going... I hope you won't hold it against me?
Cowfusion#213.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#214.src: Uh... I really should get back to work. But- hey! Feel free to visit whenever you want! You'll be able to use the entrance at Ranol's farm.
Cowfusion#214.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#215.src: Maybe I can tell you more about what I've been up to! That'd be nice.
Cowfusion#215.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#216.src: There you are! Back to norm...-
Cowfusion#216.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#217.src: {u}?! What are you- that was you the whole time?! Why didn't you tell me!
Cowfusion#217.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#218.src: Oh gosh, this has been... An awful reunion. I can't believe I dropped you into the Pit...
Cowfusion#218.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#219.src: I'm so sorry for- for all of that. You should have told me! Oh...
Cowfusion#219.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#220.src: Okay, uh... Here, take this. As- as compensation for- for all of that.
Cowfusion#220.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#221.src: I... I need to get back to work. But- uh, if you ever want, feel free to visit sometime? You'll be able to use the entrance at Ranol's farm.
Cowfusion#221.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#222.src: Maybe I can tell you more about what I've been up to! Heh...
Cowfusion#222.speaker: Drale

Creeper Infiltration#001.src: Anyone! Can anyone- oh, hello. You look strong enough to help me.
Creeper Infiltration#001.dst: 有人嗎！有沒有人可以——哦，你好。你看起來夠強壯，應該幫得上我。
Creeper Infiltration#001.speaker: Thomas

Creeper Infiltration#002.src: I am Thomas, and I help manage the supplies for a village in the Pigman Ravine. Though, I have a bit of a problem...
Creeper Infiltration#002.dst: 我叫 Thomas，負責替豬人峽谷裡一座村子管理物資。不過，我遇到了一點麻煩……
Creeper Infiltration#002.speaker: Thomas

Creeper Infiltration#003.src: We're running low on ravine grains, which is our main staple we use for our food.
Creeper Infiltration#003.dst: 我們的峽谷穀快用完了，那是我們主要的糧食。
Creeper Infiltration#003.speaker: Thomas

Creeper Infiltration#004.src: We usually get it ourselves but recently an angry group of pigmen took over the tunnel to the top of the ravine, where the grain grows.
Creeper Infiltration#004.dst: 平常我們都自己去採，可是最近一群兇暴的豬人佔據了通往峽谷頂端的隧道，穀子就長在那上面。
Creeper Infiltration#004.speaker: Thomas

Creeper Infiltration#005.src: The last time we entered, I heard an explosion from the top. I fear the pigmen are blowing up our grain supply with TNT...
Creeper Infiltration#005.dst: 上次我們進去的時候，我聽到上面傳來爆炸聲。我怕那些豬人正在用 TNT 把我們的糧食炸掉……
Creeper Infiltration#005.speaker: Thomas

Creeper Infiltration#006.src: I came here to {p} to see if I could find help here, but I've had no luck. Until now, that is. Would you be willing to help?
Creeper Infiltration#006.dst: 我來 {p} 是想看看能不能找到幫手，可是一直沒有著落。直到現在。你願意幫忙嗎？
Creeper Infiltration#006.speaker: Thomas

Creeper Infiltration#007.src: You would? You're a life saver. I'll meet you at the village, just follow the path out of town and take the northern-most entrance to the ravines.
Creeper Infiltration#007.dst: 你願意？你真是救星。我們村子見，你順著鎮外那條路走，從最北邊那個入口進峽谷就是了。
Creeper Infiltration#007.speaker: Thomas

Creeper Infiltration#008.src: Once you get there, keep to the right wall of the ravine and climb up the stairs to reach the entrance. Also, be careful in the tunnel, as the pigmen throw rocks as a weapon.
Creeper Infiltration#008.dst: 到了之後沿著峽谷右側的岩壁走，爬上樓梯就能抵達入口。還有，隧道裡要小心，那些豬人會拿石頭當武器丟。
Creeper Infiltration#008.speaker: Thomas

Creeper Infiltration#009.src: Oh, finally, someone has come to this hidden village!
Creeper Infiltration#009.dst: 哦，終於有人來到這座隱密的村子了！
Creeper Infiltration#009.speaker: Thomas

Creeper Infiltration#010.src: I am Thomas, and I help manage the supplies for this ravine village. Though, I have a bit of a problem...
Creeper Infiltration#010.dst: 我叫 Thomas，負責替這座峽谷村子管理物資。不過，我遇到了一點麻煩……
Creeper Infiltration#010.speaker: Thomas

Creeper Infiltration#011.src: We're running low on ravine grains, which is our main staple we use for our food.
Creeper Infiltration#011.dst: 我們的峽谷穀快用完了，那是我們主要的糧食。
Creeper Infiltration#011.speaker: Thomas

Creeper Infiltration#012.src: We usually get it ourselves but recently an angry group of pigmen took over the tunnel to the top of the ravine, where the grain grows.
Creeper Infiltration#012.dst: 平常我們都自己去採，可是最近一群兇暴的豬人佔據了通往峽谷頂端的隧道，穀子就長在那上面。
Creeper Infiltration#012.speaker: Thomas

Creeper Infiltration#013.src: The last time we entered, I heard an explosion from the top. I fear the pigmen are blowing up our grain supply with TNT...
Creeper Infiltration#013.dst: 上次我們進去的時候，我聽到上面傳來爆炸聲。我怕那些豬人正在用 TNT 把我們的糧食炸掉……
Creeper Infiltration#013.speaker: Thomas

Creeper Infiltration#014.src: You appear to be much stronger than I am, so maybe you could get past the tunnel pigmen and eliminate the explosions at the top.
Creeper Infiltration#014.dst: 你看起來比我強壯得多，或許你能突破隧道裡的豬人，把上面的爆炸源解決掉。
Creeper Infiltration#014.speaker: Thomas

Creeper Infiltration#015.src: Just keep to the right wall of the ravine and climb up the stairs to reach the entrance. Also, be careful in the tunnel, as the pigmen throw rocks as a weapon.
Creeper Infiltration#015.dst: 沿著峽谷右側的岩壁走，爬上樓梯就能抵達入口。還有，隧道裡要小心，那些豬人會拿石頭當武器丟。
Creeper Infiltration#015.speaker: Thomas

Creeper Infiltration#016.src: Enter the tunnel at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] and reach the top of the ravine

Creeper Infiltration#017.src: Bring back the [Creeper Skin] to Thomas at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
Creeper Infiltration#017.dst: 把 [Creeper Skin] 帶回 [-{~1}, {~2}, -{~3}] 給 Thomas

Creeper Infiltration#018.src: I didn't expect you to fall out of the sky like that. Are you okay, or should I go get the potion merchant to heal you?
Creeper Infiltration#018.dst: 我沒想到你會這樣從天上掉下來。你還好嗎？還是我去找藥水商人來替你療傷？
Creeper Infiltration#018.speaker: Thomas

Creeper Infiltration#019.src: You're fine? Oh, good to hear. Did you manage to get rid of the pigmen and their explosives?
Creeper Infiltration#019.dst: 你沒事？哦，那太好了。豬人跟他們的炸藥都解決了嗎？
Creeper Infiltration#019.speaker: Thomas

Creeper Infiltration#020.src: A green creature? A "creeper"? No such thing exists in this world, especially with the pigmen all around!
Creeper Infiltration#020.dst: 綠色的生物？「苦力怕」？這世上根本沒有那種東西，何況這裡到處都是豬人！
Creeper Infiltration#020.speaker: Thomas

Creeper Infiltration#021.src: Oh, you brought a piece of skin back. How odd, I've seen this skin before...
Creeper Infiltration#021.dst: 哦，你帶了一塊皮回來。真奇怪，這種皮我以前見過……
Creeper Infiltration#021.speaker: Thomas

Creeper Infiltration#022.src: There's a large cave over to the south. I tried to enter it, but I got ambushed by green creatures...
Creeper Infiltration#022.dst: 南邊有個大洞窟。我試過要進去，結果被一群綠色的生物伏擊……
Creeper Infiltration#022.speaker: Thomas

Creeper Infiltration#023.src: I thought I was just dreaming, but these "creepers" you talk about...they might live in that cave.
Creeper Infiltration#023.dst: 我本來以為那只是我在作夢，可是你說的這些「苦力怕」……牠們可能就住在那個洞窟裡。
Creeper Infiltration#023.speaker: Thomas

Creeper Infiltration#024.src: I have an idea. I need to know for sure that they live there. A merchant can make you a mask with the skin and another material.
Creeper Infiltration#024.dst: 我有個主意。我得確定牠們真的住在那裡。有位商人可以用這塊皮加上另一種材料幫你做一副面具。
Creeper Infiltration#024.speaker: Thomas

Creeper Infiltration#025.src: There's a Pigman Overlord that sometimes hangs in a cave nearby. If you can kill it, you can get a pigman hide strong enough to make the mask.
Creeper Infiltration#025.dst: 附近的洞窟裡偶爾會出現一隻豬人霸主。你要是能殺了牠，就能取得夠堅韌的豬人皮來做面具。
Creeper Infiltration#025.speaker: Thomas

Creeper Infiltration#026.src: If you continue on the western path past the tunnel entrance, you should find a camp where the Overlord is located.
Creeper Infiltration#026.dst: 從隧道口沿著西邊那條路一直走，應該就能找到霸主所在的營地。
Creeper Infiltration#026.speaker: Thomas

Creeper Infiltration#027.src: Go get the pigman hide, and then come back to me so I can tell you what to do next.
Creeper Infiltration#027.dst: 去把豬人皮弄來，再回來找我，我再告訴你下一步。
Creeper Infiltration#027.speaker: Thomas

Creeper Infiltration#028.src: Retrieve [{~} Pigman Hide] from the Pigman Overlord near [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] and return to Thomas
Creeper Infiltration#028.dst: 從 [-{~1}, {~2}, -{~3}] 附近的豬人霸主身上取得 [{~4} Pigman Hide]，並回去找 Thomas

Creeper Infiltration#029.src: I see you have the hide. This skin will work perfectly for my plan.
Creeper Infiltration#029.dst: 我看到你把皮拿來了。這塊皮拿來執行我的計畫再適合不過。
Creeper Infiltration#029.speaker: Thomas

Creeper Infiltration#030.src: There is a Mask Merchant in this village. He can make you a mask with the two materials I have.
Creeper Infiltration#030.dst: 這座村子裡有位面具商人。他可以用我手上這兩種材料幫你做一副面具。
Creeper Infiltration#030.speaker: Thomas

Creeper Infiltration#031.src: With the mask, you can put it on and go undetected into the cave with these "creepers". Only then will we know the truth.
Creeper Infiltration#031.dst: 戴上那副面具，你就能不被察覺地走進那些「苦力怕」的洞窟。到那時我們才會知道真相。
Creeper Infiltration#031.speaker: Thomas

Creeper Infiltration#032.src: To get to the creeper cave, follow the western path and turn left at the pigman camps.
Creeper Infiltration#032.dst: 要去苦力怕的洞窟，沿著西邊那條路走，到豬人營地那裡左轉。
Creeper Infiltration#032.speaker: Thomas

Creeper Infiltration#033.src: Also, if you somehow lose the mask, the merchant can make you another one if you bring him another piece of skin and hide.
Creeper Infiltration#033.dst: 還有，萬一你把面具弄丟了，只要再帶一塊皮和一塊獸皮給那位商人，他可以再幫你做一副。
Creeper Infiltration#033.speaker: Thomas

Creeper Infiltration#034.src: Here are the materials. Be careful out there. Who knows what those green monsters could do to you...
Creeper Infiltration#034.dst: 材料在這裡。外面小心點。誰知道那些綠色怪物會對你做什麼……
Creeper Infiltration#034.speaker: Thomas

Creeper Infiltration#035.src: Buy the creeper mask from the merchant and enter the creeper hideout at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
Creeper Infiltration#035.dst: 跟商人買下苦力怕面具，並進入 [-{~1}, {~2}, -{~3}] 的苦力怕巢穴

Creeper Infiltration#036.src: Bring Thomas [{~} Creeper Powder] to prove him creepers exist in Wynn at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
Creeper Infiltration#036.dst: 把 [{~4} Creeper Powder] 帶到 [-{~1}, {~2}, -{~3}] 給 Thomas，證明 Wynn 真的有苦力怕

Creeper Infiltration#037.src: So, what was in the cave? Were there really creepers in there?
Creeper Infiltration#037.dst: 所以，洞窟裡有什麼？裡面真的有苦力怕嗎？
Creeper Infiltration#037.speaker: Thomas

Creeper Infiltration#038.src: What's this? It smells like gunpowder...but more earthy. And this came from the cave?
Creeper Infiltration#038.dst: 這是什麼？聞起來像火藥……可是土味更重。這是從那個洞窟拿出來的？
Creeper Infiltration#038.speaker: Thomas

Creeper Infiltration#039.src: This powder is definitely not native to this area. It has to have come from those creepers.
Creeper Infiltration#039.dst: 這種粉末絕對不是這一帶會有的東西。一定是那些苦力怕身上來的。
Creeper Infiltration#039.speaker: Thomas

Creeper Infiltration#040.src: I guess for now we'll leave them at peace. If they do exist, they don't need to be hunted down to extinction.
Creeper Infiltration#040.dst: 我想現在就先別去打擾牠們吧。就算牠們真的存在，也不該被獵到滅絕。
Creeper Infiltration#040.speaker: Thomas

Creeper Infiltration#041.src: Besides, if they are composed of gunpowder, they could easily blow this ravine to pieces.
Creeper Infiltration#041.dst: 而且，如果牠們是由火藥構成的，牠們大可以把這整條峽谷炸成碎片。
Creeper Infiltration#041.speaker: Thomas

Creeper Infiltration#042.src: Thank you for your help. I guess you deserve some sort of reward, considering you helped solve the ravine's big mystery.
Creeper Infiltration#042.dst: 謝謝你的幫忙。你解開了峽谷的大謎團，我想你值得某種獎賞。
Creeper Infiltration#042.speaker: Thomas

Creeper Infiltration#043.src: Feel free to come back to our village any time. By then our food supply should be stable.
Creeper Infiltration#043.dst: 歡迎隨時再回我們村子來。到那時我們的糧食應該就穩定了。
Creeper Infiltration#043.speaker: Thomas

Crop Failure#001.dst: 嘖...那個沒良心的、滿口謊言、卑鄙無恥、偷雞摸狗的...啊啊啊！
Crop Failure#001.speaker: Anast

Crop Failure#002.src: You! Help me out over here! You aren't doing anything important right now, and this is urgent!
Crop Failure#002.dst: 你！過來幫我一下！你沒在做什麼重要的事，而且這事可急了！
Crop Failure#002.speaker: Anast

Crop Failure#003.src: I got a few questions for you, see? Question one: D'you think crops are supposed to look like THIS?
Crop Failure#003.dst: 我問你幾個問題，聽著啊？第一個：你覺得莊稼本來就該長成這鬼樣子嗎？
Crop Failure#003.speaker: Anast

Crop Failure#004.src: Look at them. I don't think there's a way for 'em to look any more sorry than this.
Crop Failure#004.dst: 看看它們。我想它們也不可能再變的更慘了。
Crop Failure#004.speaker: Anast

Crop Failure#005.src: Wha- You think the Oats over there look fine?! Pff. Yeah, right.
Crop Failure#005.dst: 什——你說那邊的Oats看起來沒問題？！哼。最好是這樣。
Crop Failure#005.speaker: Anast

Crop Failure#006.src: If that's the case, go grab a scythe and try harvesting those Oats yourself!!
Crop Failure#006.dst: 既然你這麼說，那就拿把鐮刀，自己去把那些Oats收了啊！！
Crop Failure#006.speaker: Anast

Crop Failure#007.src: Go on, do it! I dare you! See how good they really are!!
Crop Failure#007.dst: 去啊，動手啊！我倒要看看！看看它們到底有多好！！
Crop Failure#007.speaker: Anast

Crop Failure#009.src: See? What'd I tell ya? Rotten to the roots! Nothing here is ANY good!!
Crop Failure#009.dst: 看吧？我說什麼來著？根都爛了！這裡的東西沒一樣是好的！！
Crop Failure#009.speaker: Anast

Crop Failure#010.src: They were growing pretty slow this year, all my crops, and then some salesman walks into town with some "MiracleCure" fertilizer.
Crop Failure#010.dst: 今年我所有的莊稼都長得特別慢，結果有個推銷員進了鎮，帶來了什麼「奇蹟肥料」。
Crop Failure#010.speaker: Anast

Crop Failure#011.src: I shoulda known it was too good to be true, but he said everyone else tried it too, so I bought some and tried to salvage this mess.
Crop Failure#011.dst: 我早該知道這種好事不可能是真的，但他說大家都試過了，所以我就買了一些，試著把這爛攤子救回來。
Crop Failure#011.speaker: Anast

Crop Failure#012.src: And here we are- me out half my savings and my fields as smelly and dead as an actual CORPSE!
Crop Failure#012.dst: 結果你看——我的積蓄少了一半，田地還臭得跟真正的屍體一樣！
Crop Failure#012.speaker: Anast

Crop Failure#013.src: Just to prove this ridiculous phony Doubiss is a fraud- Here. I see some roots over here. Watch this, and tell me if this is a "miracle!"
Crop Failure#013.dst: 只為了證明那個叫Doubiss的荒唐騙子就是個騙子——來。這邊有些根，你看好後告訴我這到底算不算「奇蹟」！
Crop Failure#013.speaker: Anast

Crop Failure#014.src: Here we go, here comes the big phenomenal growth he promised me!
Crop Failure#014.dst: 來了來了——這就是他向我保證的非凡的生長速度！
Crop Failure#014.speaker: Anast

Crop Failure#015.src: WOW, INCREDIBLE! AMAZING! It's almost like this is actual poison or something!!
Crop Failure#015.dst: 哇！不可思議！太驚人了！這簡直就像真正的毒藥一樣！！
Crop Failure#015.speaker: Anast

Crop Failure#016.src: That Doubiss won't budge for my refund. I spent... so many emeralds... on this tripe! So that's where YOU come in.
Crop Failure#016.dst: Doubiss死活都不肯退錢。我可是花了...那麼多綠寶石...買這堆垃圾！所以你就派上用場了。
Crop Failure#016.speaker: Anast

Crop Failure#017.src: He's in that blue and gray tent by the bank. I don't care how you do it, but get my money back and we'll split it half-and-half, deal?
Crop Failure#017.dst: 他就在銀行旁邊那頂藍灰色的帳篷裡。我不管你用什麼方法，總之把我的錢拿回來，我們一人一半，成交？
Crop Failure#017.speaker: Anast

Crop Failure#018.src: Find Doubiss the salesman in {p} near the bank at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Crop Failure#018.dst: 在 {p} 銀行附近的 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] 找到推銷員Doubiss。

Crop Failure#019.src: Good day to ya! What is it ye be needin' from ol' Doubiss' stock?
Crop Failure#019.dst: 日安啊！想從老Doubiss的貨裡買點什麼呀？
Crop Failure#019.speaker: Doubiss

Crop Failure#020.src: Oh. Oh, goodie. That idiot farmer's sendin' ya to get his money back, ain't he? Sweet baby bovine, this is ridiculous...
Crop Failure#020.dst: 哦。哦，原來如此。那個蠢農夫派你來要回他的錢，是吧？天啊，這也太荒唐了...
Crop Failure#020.speaker: Doubiss

Crop Failure#021.src: Since he obviously ain't gonna be listenin' to me anytime soon, lemme tell ya what the issue is with my fertilizer...
Crop Failure#021.dst: 既然他現在也不會想聽我的解釋，那我就跟你說說我的肥料到底有什麼問題吧...
Crop Failure#021.speaker: Doubiss

Crop Failure#022.src: Nothing! My fertilizer really does work! He probl'ly exaggerated how good I said it'd work, too! What'd he say, twice, three times the growth? More?
Crop Failure#022.dst: 沒問題！我的肥料真的有效！搞不好是他把我說的效果誇大了！他說什麼？兩倍、三倍的生長速度？還是更多？
Crop Failure#022.speaker: Doubiss

Crop Failure#023.src: All the other farmers are usin' it right now and look at their fields! Heck, the only reason these crops ain't dead is because of my product!
Crop Failure#023.dst: 其他農夫現在都在用，看看他們的田！哼，要不是有我的產品，這些莊稼早就死光了！
Crop Failure#023.speaker: Doubiss

Crop Failure#024.src: Y'know why? Next time ya' pass a farm, take a good whiff o' the water, maybe a sip or two if you can manage. It'll be smelly and bitter.
Crop Failure#024.dst: 你知道為什麼嗎？下次經過農場時，好好聞聞水的味道，能的話喝上一兩口。那水又臭又苦。
Crop Failure#024.speaker: Doubiss

Crop Failure#025.src: The crops, when I got here, were lookin' as pathetic as ya get. I ain't a gamblin' man, but I'd be willing ta bet something's up with the water here.
Crop Failure#025.dst: 我剛來這裡的時候，那些莊稼已經慘得不能再慘了。我雖然不是個愛賭的人，但我敢打賭，這裡的水肯定有問題。
Crop Failure#025.speaker: Doubiss

Crop Failure#026.src: The smell gets worse the closer ya get to the crypts in town, and while I ain't a native Oluxer, I've heard enough to know the wellspring is in the cave hear there.
Crop Failure#026.dst: 越靠近鎮上的墓穴，味道就越重。而且我雖然不是Olux本地人，但也聽過一些消息，知道那附近的洞穴裡有個水源。
Crop Failure#026.speaker: Doubiss

Crop Failure#027.src: It'll prob'ly be best fer everyone if ya took a looksee. Maybe if ya find some evidence, ya can show that to the crazy farmer, have 'im quit pesterin' me, eh?
Crop Failure#027.dst: 你最好去看看，這對大家都有好處。說不定你能找到什麼證據，拿給那個瘋農夫看，讓他別再來煩我，怎麼樣？
Crop Failure#027.speaker: Doubiss

Crop Failure#028.src: The cave is on a little hill, next to the crypt. Careful ya don't go trippin' over a gravestone, now!
Crop Failure#028.dst: 那個洞穴就在一座小山丘上的墓穴旁邊。小心點，可別被墓碑絆倒了啊！
Crop Failure#028.speaker: Doubiss

Crop Failure#029.src: Search the aquifer at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] for the problem with the water.
Crop Failure#029.dst: 在 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] 的地下水層尋找水源污染的原因。

Crop Failure#030.src: Oi, bucko! Took my advice, eh? I'd figured I'd join ye, 'n see for myself what was goin' on.
Crop Failure#030.dst: 喂，小夥子！聽我的建議啦？我想說跟你一起來看看，親自瞧瞧到底出了什麼事。
Crop Failure#030.speaker: Doubiss

Crop Failure#031.src: And boy am I glad I bring me water in bottles. This stuff's rancid, full a' swamp slimes. No idea why they're here, though.
Crop Failure#031.dst: 哎呀，我真該慶幸自己帶的是瓶裝水。這水可真夠噁心的，裡面全是沼澤史萊姆。我也不知道牠們怎麼會跑到這裡來。
Crop Failure#031.speaker: Doubiss

Crop Failure#032.src: The buggers stick to mountain caves. They don't come down this far, usually... suppose there's an exception fer everything.
Crop Failure#032.dst: 這些鬼東西平常都待在山上的洞穴裡，可不會跑到這麼深的地方來...不過嘛，什麼事都有例外。
Crop Failure#032.speaker: Doubiss

Crop Failure#033.src: 's no wonder that Anast's crops ain't growin'. This is right under his farm! But we got some clear proof now, ain't we?
Crop Failure#033.dst: 難怪Anast的莊稼長不出來。這地方就在他的農場正下方！不過現在我們可是有明確的證據了，對吧？
Crop Failure#033.speaker: Doubiss

Crop Failure#034.src: Howzabout ya take care o' this? I ain't a fighter, but if ya mulch these slimes the water oughta clear up, I figure.
Crop Failure#034.dst: 這個就交給你處理，怎麼樣？我不會打架，不過我想，只要你把這些史萊姆剁碎，水應該就會變乾淨了。
Crop Failure#034.speaker: Doubiss

Crop Failure#035.src: Kill the slimes in the aquifer and bring back [Polluted Slime] to Anast.
Crop Failure#035.dst: 消滅地下水層中的史萊姆，並將[受污染的史萊姆]帶回給Anast。

Crop Failure#036.src: Pyyyyeww! Yeesh, kid! You smell worse than a pig's sty! What the heck happened to you, where've you been?!
Crop Failure#036.dst: 呸——！噁！小子！你聞起來比豬圈還臭！你到底怎麼搞的？跑哪兒去了？！
Crop Failure#036.speaker: Anast

Crop Failure#037.src: Ugh, eww! I don't want any of this sludge! I demand an explanation, now!!
Crop Failure#037.dst: 呃，噁！我才不要這些爛泥！現在就給我一個解釋！！
Crop Failure#037.speaker: Anast

Crop Failure#038.src: ...mhm, mhm...you went into the well cave...and found what, slimes?! Why would SLIMES be there?
Crop Failure#038.dst: ...嗯，嗯...你進了洞穴...然後發現了什麼，史萊姆？！史萊姆為什麼會在那裡？！
Crop Failure#038.speaker: Anast

Crop Failure#039.src: I wouldn't believe you if you weren't... well, uh... covered in the stuff. But that's definitely rancid.
Crop Failure#039.dst: 要不是你...呃...整個人都沾滿這些東西，我才不會相信你。但這東西確實臭得要命。
Crop Failure#039.speaker: Anast

Crop Failure#040.src: So... that means I've been... oh dear lord I'm an idiot.
Crop Failure#040.dst: 所以...這代表我一直都...天啊，我真是個白痴。
Crop Failure#040.speaker: Anast

Crop Failure#041.src: I guess I owe you some thanks anyway for trying to clear the sludge out. Suppose this year's harvest is just a bust.
Crop Failure#041.dst: 不管怎麼說，你至少也幫忙清掉了那些爛泥，我還是得謝謝你。今年的收成看來是徹底泡在臭湯裡了。
Crop Failure#041.speaker: Anast

Crop Failure#042.src: Can't sell what little I have, so I figure you can take it, and a bit of cash too, since you basically did an exterminator's job.
Crop Failure#042.dst: 我這點收成也賣不出去，所以你就拿去吧，再給你一點現金。畢竟你基本上替我幹了除蟲公司的活。
Crop Failure#042.speaker: Anast

Crop Failure#043.src: Just... do me a favor and use that money to buy some good soap and wash up. I'm thankful and all, but you stink to high heaven!
Crop Failure#043.dst: 只是...幫我個忙，拿那些錢去買點好一點的肥皂，好好洗個澡。雖然我是很感謝你啦，但你真的臭到熏天了！
Crop Failure#043.speaker: Anast

Dearly Departed#000.dst: 與農夫 Cevalus 交談，位置在

Dearly Departed#001.src: Ah, looks like a fresh recruit! Did you see my posting? Good, good.
Dearly Departed#001.dst: 啊，看起來是個新兵！你看到我貼的告示了？很好，很好。
Dearly Departed#001.speaker: Farmer Cevalus

Dearly Departed#002.src: You see, my dear father-in-law recently passed, and I had to bury him hastily out back. Couldn't get a priest here in time to bury him all properly...
Dearly Departed#002.dst: 是這樣的，我親愛的岳父最近過世了，我只好匆匆把他葬在後面。來不及請神父過來好好安葬他……
Dearly Departed#002.speaker: Farmer Cevalus

Dearly Departed#003.src: Unfortunately, it so happens that my wedding ring might have slipped off as I was putting him to rest...
Dearly Departed#003.dst: 不巧的是，我把他安置好的時候，結婚戒指似乎滑掉了……
Dearly Departed#003.speaker: Farmer Cevalus

Dearly Departed#004.src: I need you to go back there and, well, recover the ring.
Dearly Departed#004.dst: 我需要你回那邊去，嗯，把戒指找回來。
Dearly Departed#004.speaker: Farmer Cevalus

Dearly Departed#005.src: It's nothing I couldn't handle myself, of course, but the wife already suspects something, and with her dear father passing so recently...
Dearly Departed#005.dst: 這種事我自己當然應付得來，只是我太太已經起疑了，而她父親又剛走沒多久……
Dearly Departed#005.speaker: Farmer Cevalus

Dearly Departed#006.src: Well, you see the situation I'm in? Help a poor fellow out, just go and grab that [Muddy Shovel] over there, and then come back to me.
Dearly Departed#006.dst: 你看得出我的處境吧？幫幫可憐人，去把那邊那把 [Muddy Shovel] 拿來，然後回來找我。
Dearly Departed#006.speaker: Farmer Cevalus

Dearly Departed#008.src: The [Muddy Shovel] is just over there. I'd really appreciate the help, recruit.
Dearly Departed#008.dst: 那把 [Muddy Shovel] 就在那邊。真的很感謝你幫忙，新兵。
Dearly Departed#008.speaker: Farmer Cevalus

Dearly Departed#009.dst: 回去找農夫 Cevalus，位置在

Dearly Departed#010.src: You've got the shovel? Great! You've got some sturdy armour and a weapon too, I presume?
Dearly Departed#010.dst: 鏟子拿到了？太好了！我猜你也有堅固的護甲和武器吧？
Dearly Departed#010.speaker: Farmer Cevalus

Dearly Departed#011.src: Good, good. Better safe than sorry... As I always say! Always, ha ha...
Dearly Departed#011.dst: 很好，很好。有備無患……我一向這麼說！一向如此，哈哈……
Dearly Departed#011.speaker: Farmer Cevalus

Dearly Departed#012.src: Oh, no reason really! Just making sure, ha ha... Should be perfectly safe back there, perfectly safe.
Dearly Departed#012.dst: 噢，真的沒什麼原因！只是確認一下，哈哈……那後面應該非常安全，非常安全。
Dearly Departed#012.speaker: Farmer Cevalus

Dearly Departed#013.src: You've used your Skill Points too, right? They come in handy, should something happen.
Dearly Departed#013.dst: 你的技能點數也用掉了吧？萬一出什麼事，那些是很派得上用場的。
Dearly Departed#013.speaker: Farmer Cevalus

Dearly Departed#014.src: Well, they're Skill Points! You gain them as you level up, then you can assign them to get bonuses in combat. Look, I'm no soldier, but even I know you really should be using them...
Dearly Departed#014.dst: 就是技能點數啊！升級的時候會拿到，然後可以分配到各項上面，在戰鬥中取得加成。聽著，我又不是軍人，但連我都知道那東西你真的該用……
Dearly Departed#014.speaker: Farmer Cevalus

Dearly Departed#015.src: There's five of them. Strength, Dexterity, Intelligence, Defence, and Agility, each with different bonuses.
Dearly Departed#015.dst: 總共有五項。力量、靈巧、智慧、防禦和敏捷，各自提供不同的加成。
Dearly Departed#015.speaker: Farmer Cevalus

Dearly Departed#016.src: You get it, or do you want me to tell you what they are?
Dearly Departed#016.dst: 你懂了嗎，還是要我一項一項說給你聽？
Dearly Departed#016.speaker: Farmer Cevalus

Dearly Departed#017.src: is handy if you're having a tough time taking down enemies. It makes your attacks hit harder, simple as.
Dearly Departed#017.dst: 在你打不動敵人的時候很有用。它讓你的攻擊更痛，就這麼簡單。
Dearly Departed#017.speaker: Farmer Cevalus

Dearly Departed#018.src: 's a bit of a tricky one. The more of it you've got, the higher the likelihood is that your attacks will deal double damage. Neat, right?
Dearly Departed#018.dst: 這一項有點微妙。點得越多，你的攻擊造成雙倍傷害的機率就越高。不錯吧？
Dearly Departed#018.speaker: Farmer Cevalus

Dearly Departed#019.src: is for the spellcasters, it lowers the cost to cast spells and increases your max amount of mana.
Dearly Departed#019.dst: 這一項是給施法者的，它降低施法的消耗，並提高你的魔力上限。
Dearly Departed#019.speaker: Farmer Cevalus

Dearly Departed#020.src: is your best bet if you're struggling with staying alive. Decreases the damage you take, 's about all.
Dearly Departed#020.dst: 如果你老是活不下來，這一項是你最好的選擇。減少你受到的傷害，大致就是這樣。
Dearly Departed#020.speaker: Farmer Cevalus

Dearly Departed#021.src: Agility, now that one is for the risktakers. The more you have, the likelier you are to dodge incoming attacks, negating most of their damage.
Dearly Departed#021.dst: 敏捷，這一項是給敢冒險的人。點得越多，你越有機會閃過來襲的攻擊，抵銷掉大部分傷害。
Dearly Departed#021.speaker: Farmer Cevalus

Dearly Departed#022.src: Best part is, you can combine them however you want, no matter your class or style of fighting.
Dearly Departed#022.dst: 最棒的是，不管你是什麼職業、什麼打法，這些都可以隨你怎麼搭配。
Dearly Departed#022.speaker: Farmer Cevalus

Dearly Departed#023.src: Just open your compass to assign your Skill Points. Then, when you're ready, head in there and get my ring.
Dearly Departed#023.dst: 打開你的羅盤就能分配技能點數。準備好之後，就進去把我的戒指拿回來。
Dearly Departed#023.speaker: Farmer Cevalus

Dearly Departed#025.src: Go on then, soldier! Show us the might of {p}'s army! Uh, I mean... get me that ring!
Dearly Departed#025.dst: 去吧，士兵！讓我們見識 {p} 軍隊的威風！呃，我是說……幫我把戒指拿回來！
Dearly Departed#025.speaker: Farmer Cevalus

Dearly Departed#026.src: What's going on in there, soldier? Have you found the ring yet?
Dearly Departed#026.dst: 裡面怎麼樣了，士兵？戒指找到了嗎？
Dearly Departed#026.speaker: Farmer Cevalus

Dearly Departed#027.src: You really should hurry, before... nevermind! Just find the ring and get out of there!
Dearly Departed#027.dst: 你真的該快一點，趁還沒……沒事！總之找到戒指然後離開那裡！
Dearly Departed#027.speaker: Farmer Cevalus

Dearly Departed#028.src: Holy Bovine! It's... it's... he's back! Kill it, quickly!
Dearly Departed#028.dst: 我的老天牛啊！他……他……他回來了！快，殺了它！
Dearly Departed#028.speaker: Farmer Cevalus

Dearly Departed#030.src: You did it! Come back here now, so I can finally get my ring back.
Dearly Departed#030.dst: 你辦到了！快回來這裡，我終於能把戒指拿回來了。
Dearly Departed#030.speaker: Farmer Cevalus

Dearly Departed#031.dst: 回去找農夫 Cevalus，位置在

Dearly Departed#032.src: Goodness, that was a little more exciting than I anticipated, hmph. Still, good work! I'm glad we were able to get rid of that monster...
Dearly Departed#032.dst: 天啊，這比我預料的刺激了一點，哼。不過幹得好！我很慶幸我們把那頭怪物解決掉了……
Dearly Departed#032.speaker: Farmer Cevalus

Dearly Departed#033.src: I mean... poor father-in-law! I don't know how I'll explain this to the wife...
Dearly Departed#033.dst: 我是說……可憐的岳父！我不知道該怎麼跟我太太解釋這件事……
Dearly Departed#033.speaker: Farmer Cevalus

Dearly Departed#034.src: I'll take the ring now, it's rather precious to me...
Dearly Departed#034.dst: 戒指我收下了，那對我來說相當珍貴……
Dearly Departed#034.speaker: Farmer Cevalus

Dearly Departed#035.src: Anyhow, take this well-deserved reward for the, well, actions you took today. Perhaps, if you keep it up, you could even become a hero like Ragnar one day.
Dearly Departed#035.dst: 總之，這是你今天那些，嗯，行動應得的報酬。也許你繼續這樣下去，有一天也能成為像 Ragnar 那樣的英雄。
Dearly Departed#035.speaker: Farmer Cevalus

Dearly Departed#036.src: Hello there, stranger. Was there something you wanted to speak to me about?
Dearly Departed#036.dst: 你好啊，陌生人。你有什麼事要跟我說嗎？
Dearly Departed#036.speaker: Farmer Kelri

Dearly Departed#037.src: I should be angry but... I can't pretend to be surprised. He's always been such a forgetful oaf.
Dearly Departed#037.dst: 我應該要生氣的，但……我沒辦法裝作很意外。他一直都是這麼糊塗的大個子。
Dearly Departed#037.speaker: Farmer Kelri

Dearly Departed#038.src: But, it explains a lot... He's been acting weird lately, ever since dad passed. That must've been what happened, so thank you for telling me.
Dearly Departed#038.dst: 不過，這就說得通了……他最近怪怪的，從我爸走了以後就這樣。原來是這麼回事，謝謝你告訴我。
Dearly Departed#038.speaker: Farmer Kelri

Dearly Departed#039.src: That's right. The one and only, ha ha...
Dearly Departed#039.speaker: Farmer Kelri

Dearly Departed#040.src: We're just simple farmers, trying to get by. We were taking care of my dad until... well... yeah...
Dearly Departed#040.dst: 我們只是普通的農民，過日子而已。我們一直照顧著我爸，直到……嗯……對……
Dearly Departed#040.speaker: Farmer Kelri

Dearly Departed#041.src: Thank you... It all happened so suddenly. On the day I left for {p}, dad was as healthy as ever, but when I came back he was already buried. The sickness must have come so fast...
Dearly Departed#041.dst: 謝謝你……那一切發生得太突然了。我動身去 {p} 的那天，我爸還健康得很，等我回來他已經下葬了。那病一定來得非常快……
Dearly Departed#041.speaker: Farmer Kelri

Dearly Departed#042.src: But at his age, I'm not surprised... It's just regrettable that we couldn't get a priest out here in time, dad was such a pious man.
Dearly Departed#042.dst: 不過以他的年紀，我也不算意外……只可惜我們沒能及時請到神父，我爸是那麼虔誠的人。
Dearly Departed#042.speaker: Farmer Kelri

Dearly Departed#043.src: Dad... Above all, he was kind and always generous. He left us this entire farm. And very pious too, a true believer. Maybe that's why he lived so long...
Dearly Departed#043.dst: 我爸……最重要的是，他心地好，而且總是很慷慨。他把整座農場留給了我們。他也非常虔誠，是真正的信徒。也許那就是他活得這麼久的原因……
Dearly Departed#043.speaker: Farmer Kelri

Dearly Departed#044.src: Oh, dear... If I don't stop, I'm gonna start crying again.
Dearly Departed#044.dst: 噢，天啊……再說下去，我又要哭出來了。
Dearly Departed#044.speaker: Farmer Kelri

Death Whistle (Quest)#001.src: Hello! Hmm, armour, weapon, look of grim despair... You must be from the Wynn province!
Death Whistle (Quest)#001.dst: 你好！嗯，盔甲、武器、一臉憂鬱……你八成是從 Wynn 來的！
Death Whistle (Quest)#001.speaker: Voer

Death Whistle (Quest)#002.src: My name is Voer, and I'm an exotic plant merchant. I sell all kinds of, uh, perfectly legal goods to the magicians of Gavel.
Death Whistle (Quest)#002.dst: 我叫 Voer，是個異國植物商人。我賣各式各樣的，呃，完全合法的貨給 Gavel 的魔法師們。
Death Whistle (Quest)#002.speaker: Voer

Death Whistle (Quest)#003.src: Lately, this Decay has been making business rather tough. The magical plants that used to grow here are dying.
Death Whistle (Quest)#003.dst: 最近暗蝕把生意搞得很難做。以前長在這裡的魔法植物都在枯死。
Death Whistle (Quest)#003.speaker: Voer

Death Whistle (Quest)#004.src: The need for magic has never been as big as it is now, and without supplies, the magicians of the swamp simply cannot operate!
Death Whistle (Quest)#004.dst: 對魔法的需求從來沒有像現在這麼大過，可是沒有原料，沼澤的法師們根本沒辦法做事！
Death Whistle (Quest)#004.speaker: Voer

Death Whistle (Quest)#005.src: I need Death Whistle in particular. It's not as deadly as it sounds, I promise- the name's just archaic, if I recall that from that- er, my book.
Death Whistle (Quest)#005.dst: 我特別需要 Death Whistle。它沒有名字聽起來那麼致命，我保證——那名字只是很古老而已，如果呃——，我的那本書上沒記錯的話。
Death Whistle (Quest)#005.speaker: Voer

Death Whistle (Quest)#006.src: It is a rather rare plant with all sorts of mystical properties, so much so that it can animate objects around it!
Death Whistle (Quest)#006.dst: 那是一種相當稀有的植物，帶著各種神祕的特性，甚至能讓周圍的東西活起來！
Death Whistle (Quest)#006.speaker: Voer

Death Whistle (Quest)#007.src: Look for the highest mountain in the swamp south-east from here. The Decay hasn't reached the peaks yet, you see!
Death Whistle (Quest)#007.dst: 往這裡東南方的沼澤找最高的那座山。暗蝕還沒到山頂上，你懂吧！
Death Whistle (Quest)#007.speaker: Voer

Death Whistle (Quest)#008.src: Find the mountain at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] and a way up on it.
Death Whistle (Quest)#008.dst: 前往 [-{~1}, {~2}, -{~3}] 找到那座山，並想辦法登上去。

Death Whistle (Quest)#009.src: Go to the top of the mountain and get {~} Black Whistle Leaf.
Death Whistle (Quest)#009.dst: 登上山頂，取得 {~} 片 Black Whistle Leaf。

Death Whistle (Quest)#010.src: Return to Voer at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] with [{~} Death Whistle Leaf].
Death Whistle (Quest)#010.dst: 帶著 [{~} Black Whistle Leaf] 回到 [-{~1}, {~2}, -{~3}] 找 Voer。

Death Whistle (Quest)#011.dst: 你，Voer！你這個沒良心的小偷！
Death Whistle (Quest)#011.speaker: Lari

Death Whistle (Quest)#012.src: You've no idea what you even have done, do you? Your thoughtless actions will cost lives!
Death Whistle (Quest)#012.dst: 你根本不知道自己做了什麼，對吧？你這種不經大腦的行為是會出人命的！
Death Whistle (Quest)#012.speaker: Lari

Death Whistle (Quest)#013.src: Uhm... Excuse me? What do you want, elf girl? We're in the middle of a deal here?
Death Whistle (Quest)#013.dst: 呃……不好意思？你想幹嘛，精靈小姐？我們正在談生意呢？
Death Whistle (Quest)#013.speaker: Voer

Death Whistle (Quest)#014.src: You sold Pink Pelulite! Have you forgotten its enraging properties? Or shall I read from that herbology book you "found" in my camp?
Death Whistle (Quest)#014.dst: 你賣掉了 Pink Pelulite！你忘了它會讓人狂暴嗎？還是要我把你「撿到」的那本從我營地裡撿到的草藥學—念給你聽？
Death Whistle (Quest)#014.speaker: Lari

Death Whistle (Quest)#015.src: Wait, wh-what? A Pink PELULITE!? I sold that woman a Pink PELUTE for her luck charms! How dare- wait... wait, Pink Pelute has rounder petals... Oh no.
Death Whistle (Quest)#015.dst: 等等，什、什麼？Pink PELULITE！？我賣給那位女士的是 Pink PELUTE，給她做幸運符用的！你怎麼——等等……等等，Pink Pelute 的花瓣比較圓……糟了。
Death Whistle (Quest)#015.speaker: Voer

Death Whistle (Quest)#016.src: You can't even say for certain. This kind of carelessness has no place! If you refuse to exercise the proper thought and caution, then those around you suffer.
Death Whistle (Quest)#016.dst: 你自己都說不準。這種粗心不應該發生！你如果不願意好好的、謹慎的思考，受苦的就是你身邊的人。
Death Whistle (Quest)#016.speaker: Lari

Death Whistle (Quest)#017.src: I must... make a difficult choice, and leave this job to you. I've other things to tend to, though it pains me to leave a life in another's hands. Remember this, villager!
Death Whistle (Quest)#017.dst: 我必須……做個艱難的決定，把這件事交給你。我還有別的事要處理，儘管把一條人命交到別人手上讓我很難受。記住這件事，村民！
Death Whistle (Quest)#017.speaker: Lari

Death Whistle (Quest)#018.src: Aaah, this is a disaster! Human, please, Pink Pelulite acts quickly and intensely... Follow the pink trail on the ground, the flowers shed their petals. Get it back before something bad happens!
Death Whistle (Quest)#018.dst: 啊啊，這下慘了！人類，拜託你，Pink Pelulite 發作得又快又猛……順著地上那道粉紅色的痕跡走，那種花會一路掉花瓣。在出事之前把它拿回來！
Death Whistle (Quest)#018.speaker: Voer

Death Whistle (Quest)#019.src: Follow the path of residue to the buyer’s cave.
Death Whistle (Quest)#019.dst: 順著殘留的痕跡找到買家的洞窟。

Death Whistle (Quest)#020.src: Ah, um, come back later please! Something strange is happening!
Death Whistle (Quest)#020.dst: 啊，呃，請你等一下再來！有很奇怪的事正在發生！
Death Whistle (Quest)#020.speaker: Witch

Death Whistle (Quest)#021.src: My body is a bit, um, not-in-my-control right now! I'd rather not hurt anyone!
Death Whistle (Quest)#021.dst: 我的身體現在有點、呃，不太受我控制！我不想傷到任何人！
Death Whistle (Quest)#021.speaker: Witch

Death Whistle (Quest)#022.src: Remove the flower from the woman in the cave.
Death Whistle (Quest)#022.dst: 把那朵花從洞窟裡的女子身上取下。

Death Whistle (Quest)#023.src: You're back, I see... and you're shedding petals! You got the Pink Pelulite back?
Death Whistle (Quest)#023.dst: 你回來啦……而且你身上還一路掉花瓣！你把 Pink Pelulite 拿回來了？
Death Whistle (Quest)#023.speaker: Voer

Death Whistle (Quest)#024.src: And what of the woman who bought it? Was she...?
Death Whistle (Quest)#024.dst: 那買下它的那位女士呢？她有沒有……？
Death Whistle (Quest)#024.speaker: Voer

Death Whistle (Quest)#025.src: Oh, thank goodness! You got in there in time. She's a regular of mine- and a bit of a looker, too. That Lari was right, to some extent, at least...
Death Whistle (Quest)#025.dst: 哦，謝天謝地！你趕上了。她是我的老主顧——長得也挺好看的。那個 Lari 說的，至少有一部分是對的……
Death Whistle (Quest)#025.speaker: Voer

Death Whistle (Quest)#026.src: I did take her book, and I should be more careful in the future, regarding this... but I can't just quit selling the herbs.
Death Whistle (Quest)#026.dst: 我確實拿走了她的書，這方面我以後應該更小心一點……可是我不能就這樣不賣草藥了。
Death Whistle (Quest)#026.speaker: Voer

Death Whistle (Quest)#027.src: I need an income, and the swamp isn't exactly the most resource-rich region here! Especially not any more.
Death Whistle (Quest)#027.dst: 我得有收入，而這片沼澤在這裡實在算不上什麼物產豐饒的地方！尤其現在更不是了。
Death Whistle (Quest)#027.speaker: Voer

Death Whistle (Quest)#028.src: And how dare she just walk away like that! It's a good thing you were around, human, otherwise... well, I would not think about it.
Death Whistle (Quest)#028.dst: 還有她怎麼敢就這樣一走了之！幸好有你在，人類，不然……唉，我不敢想。
Death Whistle (Quest)#028.speaker: Voer

Death Whistle (Quest)#029.src: Regardless, you helped me greatly. Got me my supplies and saved the life of a regular of mine, so I've got a gift for you!
Death Whistle (Quest)#029.dst: 總之，你幫了我一個大忙。既弄到了我要的貨，又救了我一位老主顧的命，所以我有份禮物要送你！
Death Whistle (Quest)#029.speaker: Voer

Death Whistle (Quest)#030.src: I'll offer you a sampler of my stock. Everything here is pre-primed to be safe for brewing, so there won't be any mishaps like today!
Death Whistle (Quest)#030.dst: 我給你一份我店裡的試用品。這裡的每一樣都已經預先處理過，非常的安全，不會再出今天這種事了！
Death Whistle (Quest)#030.speaker: Voer

Deja Vu#001.src: Well well well, look who decided to come back with their tail between their legs.
Deja Vu#001.dst: 哎呀哎呀，看看是誰灰溜溜地回來了。
Deja Vu#001.speaker: Asher

Deja Vu#002.src: Two weeks now and you still haven't found it? Ugh, I can't believe I ever trusted you with such a simple task.
Deja Vu#002.dst: 都兩週了你還是沒找到？老天，真不敢相信你連這麼簡單的事都做不到。
Deja Vu#002.speaker: Asher

Deja Vu#003.src: Who am I? WHAT DO YOU MEAN WHO AM I? You offered to help find my shovel, and I've been waiting two weeks!
Deja Vu#003.dst: 我是誰？你什麼意思？！你問我「我是誰」？！你答應要幫我找到我的鏟子，而我已經為此等了兩週了！
Deja Vu#003.speaker: Asher

Deja Vu#004.src: Forget about your payment. Unless you either pay me back or get my shovel right now!
Deja Vu#004.dst: 別想拿你的報酬了！你要嘛現在賠償我，要嘛就把我的鏟子找回來！
Deja Vu#004.speaker: Asher

Deja Vu#005.src: My shovel? That's why I sent you out in the first place! It's somewhere in {p}. I lost it while following a trail of flowers.
Deja Vu#005.dst: 我的鏟子？我就是為了它才叫你去的！它在{p}的某處。我沿著花朵留下的蹤跡走時把它弄丟了。
Deja Vu#005.speaker: Asher

Deja Vu#006.src: I think it was south west of the large ruined gate. Now go get it!
Deja Vu#006.dst: 我想它應該在那個大型廢墟的大門西南方處。滾去把它拿來！
Deja Vu#006.speaker: Asher

Deja Vu#007.dst: 在 [-{~1}, {~2}, -{~3}] 附近找到Asher的鏟子

Deja Vu#009.src: Well hello there, stranger! Welcome to {p}! Always nice to see a new face around here.
Deja Vu#009.dst: 你好啊，陌生人！歡迎來到{p}！見到新面孔總是很開心。
Deja Vu#009.speaker: Asher

Deja Vu#010.src: Mad at you? Why would I be mad at you? We've never met.
Deja Vu#010.dst: 對你生氣？我怎麼會對你生氣？我們根本沒見過面。
Deja Vu#010.speaker: Asher

Deja Vu#011.src: I know this a bit forward, but I need to ask for your help with-
Deja Vu#011.dst: 我知道這樣有點唐突，但我想請你幫個忙—
Deja Vu#011.speaker: Asher

Deja Vu#012.src: Wait, is that-? It is! You've found my shovel! I recognize those markings anywhere.
Deja Vu#012.dst: 等等，那難道是──？真的是！你找到了我的鏟子！那把鏟子化成灰我都認得出它的標記。
Deja Vu#012.speaker: Asher

Deja Vu#013.src: But why is it so rusty? Ah, no matter. Give that to me and I'll head inside to get you a nice reward.
Deja Vu#013.dst: 但它怎麼都生鏽了？算了沒差，把它給我，我去拿個好獎勵給你。
Deja Vu#013.speaker: Asher

Deja Vu#014.src: Thank you. Now, about that reward-
Deja Vu#014.dst: 謝謝你。現在關於你的獎勵──
Deja Vu#014.speaker: Asher

Deja Vu#016.src: Oh dear, there he goes again. Poor fool ignored my warnings and touched that shovel.
Deja Vu#016.dst: 哎呀，他又消失了。那可憐的傢伙總是無視我叫他別碰那把鏟子的警告。
Deja Vu#016.speaker: Old Man Martyn

Deja Vu#017.src: He's gone and got himself stuck in a loop.
Deja Vu#017.dst: 他又讓自己困在循環裡了。
Deja Vu#017.speaker: Old Man Martyn

Deja Vu#018.src: Head inside, soldier, and I'll explain what's happening here.
Deja Vu#018.dst: 進去吧，士兵，我會解釋他發生了什麼事。
Deja Vu#018.speaker: Old Man Martyn

Deja Vu#020.src: Without Asher, his house has vanished from time.
Deja Vu#020.dst: 沒了Asher，他的房子已從時間裡消失了。
Deja Vu#020.speaker: Old Man Martyn

Deja Vu#022.src: Let me explain why Asher disappeared...
Deja Vu#022.speaker: Old Man Martyn

Deja Vu#023.src: {p} was built many years ago by a long-lost civilization.
Deja Vu#023.dst: {p}是多年前由一個早已消失的文明建造的。
Deja Vu#023.speaker: Old Man Martyn

Deja Vu#024.src: They had odd powers. They ended up distorting time itself.
Deja Vu#024.dst: 他們擁有異常的力量，最後甚至扭曲了時間本身。
Deja Vu#024.speaker: Old Man Martyn

Deja Vu#025.src: The tools they used to make these structures are imbued with their power.
Deja Vu#025.dst: 用於建造這些建築的工具被灌輸了他們的力量。
Deja Vu#025.speaker: Old Man Martyn

Deja Vu#026.src: Asher found one of these tools: the shovel.
Deja Vu#026.dst: Asher找到了其中一把工具：那把鏟子。
Deja Vu#026.speaker: Old Man Martyn

Deja Vu#027.src: The shovel is tethering its time of influence to today. It keeps sending Asher back.
Deja Vu#027.dst: 鏟子將它影響的時間固定在今天，不斷把Asher送回過去。
Deja Vu#027.speaker: Old Man Martyn

Deja Vu#028.src: The issue is, Asher died in the past. This creates a paradox.
Deja Vu#028.dst: 問題是，Asher早就死了。這就產生了一個悖論
Deja Vu#028.speaker: Old Man Martyn

Deja Vu#029.src: We can save him if I send you back to prevent his death. Go through this rift to join him in the past.
Deja Vu#029.dst: 只要我把你送回過去阻止他的死亡，我們就能救他。穿過這道裂隙，回到過去找他。
Deja Vu#029.speaker: Old Man Martyn

Deja Vu#030.src: Find a way to save Asher from his death.

Deja Vu#032.src: Usually this place is filled with workers.
Deja Vu#032.dst: 通常這地方總是有許多工人。
Deja Vu#032.speaker: Asher

Deja Vu#033.src: But no one's here. And this place is clearly not done.
Deja Vu#033.dst: 可是這裡根本沒有人。而且這地方明顯還沒完工。
Deja Vu#033.speaker: Asher

Deja Vu#034.src: Whatever the case, I should probably find my shovel.
Deja Vu#034.dst: 管他的，我應該去找我的鏟子。
Deja Vu#034.speaker: Asher

Deja Vu#035.src: If I were a shovel, where would I be?
Deja Vu#035.dst: 如果我是一把鏟子，我應該會在哪？
Deja Vu#035.speaker: Asher

Deja Vu#037.src: This place... There's so much going on but no one here.
Deja Vu#037.dst: 這地方...明明一切都在運作，卻一個人都沒有。
Deja Vu#037.speaker: Asher

Deja Vu#038.src: What I don't understand, though, is why this place looks brand new.
Deja Vu#038.dst: 讓我不理解的地方是，為何這地方看起來跟全新的一樣。
Deja Vu#038.speaker: Asher

Deja Vu#039.src: This place looks like it's just being built!
Deja Vu#039.dst: 看起來像是剛建造完成一樣！
Deja Vu#039.speaker: Asher

Deja Vu#040.src: This must be something to do with the valley's magic. Wouldn't be the first time.
Deja Vu#040.dst: 一定和山谷的魔法有關。這種事以前也不是沒發生過。
Deja Vu#040.speaker: Asher

Deja Vu#042.src: In fact, whenever I hold that shovel, this kind of stuff seems to happen.
Deja Vu#042.dst: 事實上，每當我拿著那把鏟子時，似乎總會發生這種事。
Deja Vu#042.speaker: Asher

Deja Vu#043.src: Maybe it's sent me way back. Back to the construction of this place.
Deja Vu#043.dst: 也許它把我送回了很久以前。回到了這個地方剛建造之初。
Deja Vu#043.speaker: Asher

Deja Vu#044.src: Then why is no one here?
Deja Vu#044.dst: 那為什麼這裡一個人都沒有？
Deja Vu#044.speaker: Asher

Deja Vu#045.src: Woah, that tree looks like it might fall over!
Deja Vu#045.dst: 哇，那棵樹看起來快倒了！
Deja Vu#045.speaker: Asher

Deja Vu#047.src: Uhf! How do they have a cannon? These guys must be super advanced.
Deja Vu#047.dst: 呃！他們怎麼有大砲？這些傢伙的科技一定非常先進。
Deja Vu#047.speaker: Asher

Deja Vu#048.src: I think I'm close now. I can just feel that shovel close by.
Deja Vu#048.dst: 我想我離得很近了。我可以感覺到鏟子就在附近。
Deja Vu#048.speaker: Asher

Deja Vu#050.src: My my, a crushing defeat to be sure. You'll have to find a way to stop that.
Deja Vu#050.dst: 哎呀，真是「壓倒性」的慘敗啊。你得想辦法避免這件事發生。
Deja Vu#050.speaker: Old Man Martyn

Deja Vu#051.src: Go back through the rift and make sure Asher doesn't become a pancake this time.
Deja Vu#051.dst: 穿過裂隙回去，確保Asher這次不會被壓成煎餅。
Deja Vu#051.speaker: Old Man Martyn

Deja Vu#053.src: Well that was quite the explosive end to our friend there. There must be a way to prevent that.
Deja Vu#053.dst: 哎呀，我們這位朋友有了個「爆炸性」的結局。一定有辦法阻止這件事發生。
Deja Vu#053.speaker: Old Man Martyn

Deja Vu#054.src: Head back in there. This time with less explosions.
Deja Vu#054.dst: 回去一趟吧。這次少放點煙火。
Deja Vu#054.speaker: Old Man Martyn

Deja Vu#055.src: Oh, so close on that try. Who could've guessed that was how our friend met his end?
Deja Vu#055.dst: 哎，這次差一點就成功了。誰能想到，我們這位朋友竟會以這種方式送命？
Deja Vu#055.speaker: Old Man Martyn

Deja Vu#056.src: I'm sure you'll nail it this time. Not sure how you will stop a cosmic event, though.
Deja Vu#056.dst: 我非常確定你這次可以成功的。但我不太確定你要怎麼阻止一顆隕石。
Deja Vu#056.speaker: Old Man Martyn

Deja Vu#057.src: Oh there it is! My shovel!
Deja Vu#057.speaker: Asher

Deja Vu#058.src: I'm surprised it took me back this far this time.
Deja Vu#058.dst: 沒想到這次竟然跑了這麼遠才找到。
Deja Vu#058.speaker: Asher

Deja Vu#059.src: Well, time to head on back-
Deja Vu#059.speaker: Asher

Deja Vu#062.src: Asher, you remember when I allowed you to live in the valley, I told you not to touch any odd objects.
Deja Vu#062.dst: Asher，還記得當時我允許你在山谷生活時，告訴過你不要碰任何奇怪的東西吧。
Deja Vu#062.speaker: Old Man Martyn

Deja Vu#064.src: You got yourself stuck hundreds of years ago. If it wasn't for this guard, you'd be removed from existence.
Deja Vu#064.dst: 你把自己困在幾百年前了。要不是這位守衛，你早就從世上消失了。
Deja Vu#064.speaker: Old Man Martyn

Deja Vu#065.src: Oh... So that's where I am. I am so sorry Martyn. Please don't kick me out of the valley.
Deja Vu#065.dst: 喔...原來我真的回到這裡了。我很抱歉。求你別把我趕出山谷。
Deja Vu#065.speaker: Asher

Deja Vu#066.src: I know time travel can be tempting. But it's far more dangerous than you can ever understand.
Deja Vu#066.dst: 我知道時間旅行很誘人。但它的危險遠超出你的理解與想像。
Deja Vu#066.speaker: Old Man Martyn

Deja Vu#067.src: The valley is banned for most citizens. I watch over this timeline because of poor souls like Asher.
Deja Vu#067.dst: 山谷禁止大多數居民進入。我守護這條時間線，就是為了像Asher這樣的人。
Deja Vu#067.speaker: Old Man Martyn

Deja Vu#071.src: How did you get these powers? Are you even human?
Deja Vu#071.dst: 你怎麼得到這些能力的？你還是人類嗎？
Deja Vu#071.speaker: Asher

Deja Vu#072.src: Oh you know. I've read a book or two in my time.
Deja Vu#072.dst: 哦，你知道的。我這輩子也讀過幾本書。
Deja Vu#072.speaker: Old Man Martyn

Deja Vu#073.src: {u}, I'm sorry I got you dragged into this. I wish I could have done it myself.
Deja Vu#073.dst: {u}，很抱歉把你也牽扯進來。我真希望這件事能由我自己完成。
Deja Vu#073.speaker: Old Man Martyn

Deja Vu#074.src: I probably could have gotten myself out...
Deja Vu#074.dst: 我自己應該也能脫身的...
Deja Vu#074.speaker: Asher

Deja Vu#075.src: You died in the past. Multiple times.
Deja Vu#075.speaker: Old Man Martyn

Deja Vu#077.src: Yes. In some surprising ways too.
Deja Vu#077.dst: 沒錯。而且死法都挺出人意料的。
Deja Vu#077.speaker: Old Man Martyn

Deja Vu#078.src: {u}, I'm sure we will meet again... in time.
Deja Vu#078.dst: {u}，我相信我們還會再見面的……來日方長。
Deja Vu#078.speaker: Old Man Martyn

Deja Vu#082.src: I don't understand Martyn. He seems to know everything about the past. Here, come closer, I want to whisper something.
Deja Vu#082.dst: 我真搞不懂Martyn。他好像知道過去所有發生的事。靠近點，我想跟你說件事。
Deja Vu#082.speaker: Asher

Deja Vu#084.src: I think he might have known Bob. I saw some letters in his house.
Deja Vu#084.dst: 我覺得他可能認識Bob。我在他家裡看到了一些信件。
Deja Vu#084.speaker: Asher

Deja Vu#085.src: Weird, right? Bob was a hard guy to know.
Deja Vu#085.dst: 很奇怪吧？Bob可不是個容易相處的人。
Deja Vu#085.speaker: Asher

Deja Vu#086.src: Anyway, take this. It's the least I can do to pay you for saving me.
Deja Vu#086.dst: 總之，這個給你。你救了我，這點東西就當作是我的一點心意。
Deja Vu#086.speaker: Asher

Desperate Metal#003.src: A bunch of stupid mechs came here and just started ransacking!
Desperate Metal#003.dst: 一群蠢機兵跑進來，直接開始翻箱倒櫃！
Desperate Metal#003.speaker: Phinas

Desperate Metal#004.src: Looks like a bunch of despermechs. That's what we call junk mechs, trying to survive.
Desperate Metal#004.dst: 看起來像一群絕望機兵。我們是這樣叫那些為了活下去而四處撿破爛的廢棄機兵的。
Desperate Metal#004.speaker: Phinas

Desperate Metal#005.src: I count three different mech marks. Looks like they split up once they got their parts.
Desperate Metal#005.dst: 我發現三種不同的機兵標記。看樣子它們拿到零件之後就分頭跑了。
Desperate Metal#005.speaker: Phinas

Desperate Metal#006.src: You got to help me here, I'm no warrior. Look they've dropped crates on their escape. Follow them and bring me back evidence that you destroyed them and I shall reward you.
Desperate Metal#006.dst: 你得幫我一把，我不是什麼戰士。你看，它們逃跑時掉了幾個箱子。跟著追過去，把你已經摧毀它們的證據帶回來，我會給你報酬。
Desperate Metal#006.speaker: Phinas

Desperate Metal#007.src: Three trails, three thieving despermechs. Be careful, they aren't to be underestimated.
Desperate Metal#007.dst: 三條痕跡，三隻偷東西的絕望機兵。小心一點，不要小看它們。
Desperate Metal#007.speaker: Phinas

Desperate Metal#008.src: Locate the {~} mechs by following the trails of tools, return to Phinas with evidence that you destroyed the mechs.
Desperate Metal#008.dst: 順著工具留下的痕跡找出那 {~} 隻機兵，並帶著摧毀它們的證據回去找 Phinas。

Desperate Metal#009.src: You Wynn folk sure know your fights.
Desperate Metal#009.dst: 你們 Wynn 那邊的人打起架來真有一套。
Desperate Metal#009.speaker: Phinas

Desperate Metal#010.src: You found all three? Let's take a look. Hm....
Desperate Metal#010.dst: 三隻你都找到了？我們來看看。嗯……
Desperate Metal#010.speaker: Phinas

Desperate Metal#011.src: Wait. These aren't Despermechs.. The factory fell over two years ago. These are brand new. Handmade.
Desperate Metal#011.dst: 等等。這些不是絕望機兵……那座工廠兩年多前就倒了。這些是全新的，手做的。
Desperate Metal#011.speaker: Phinas

Desperate Metal#013.src: Would you look at that! Their code!
Desperate Metal#013.dst: 你看看這個！它們的代號！
Desperate Metal#013.speaker: Phinas

Desperate Metal#014.src: Here, have them back. Take a close look at the names of these parts.
Desperate Metal#014.dst: 來，還你。仔細看看這些零件上的名字。
Desperate Metal#014.speaker: Phinas

Desperate Metal#015.src: Find out where to go by looking at the pieces of junk.
Desperate Metal#015.dst: 從這些廢料上看出該去哪裡。

Desperate Metal#016.src: What are these? I have nothing to do with them!
Desperate Metal#016.dst: 這些是什麼？跟我一點關係都沒有！
Desperate Metal#016.speaker: Nettik

Desperate Metal#017.src: Ahh.. Well now that I think of it writing my location on these parts was a bit stupid.
Desperate Metal#017.dst: 啊……嗯，現在想想，把我的所在地寫在這些零件上，是有那麼點蠢。
Desperate Metal#017.speaker: Nettik

Desperate Metal#018.src: Those mechs were my creation. Corkus can still live with machines.
Desperate Metal#018.dst: 那些機兵是我造的，Corkus 還是能跟機器共存的。
Desperate Metal#018.speaker: Nettik

Desperate Metal#019.src: The factory was a disaster. That's what happens when a machine controls a machine.
Desperate Metal#019.dst: 那座工廠是一場災難，那就是讓機器去控制機器的下場。
Desperate Metal#019.speaker: Nettik

Desperate Metal#020.src: I am living proof that humans can control them. Make use of them.
Desperate Metal#020.dst: 我就是活生生的證據，證明人類控制得了它們，能好好利用它們。
Desperate Metal#020.speaker: Nettik

Desperate Metal#021.src: The metal shortage has made it difficult to make my machines... Not to mention the new laws..
Desperate Metal#021.dst: 金屬短缺讓我造機器變得很困難……更別提那些新法令了……
Desperate Metal#021.speaker: Nettik

Desperate Metal#022.src: If you want to turn me in fine. You'll find all the evidence you need under my pillow.
Desperate Metal#022.dst: 你想告發我就去吧。你需要的所有證據，都在我的枕頭底下。
Desperate Metal#022.speaker: Nettik

Desperate Metal#024.dst: 偵測到陌生目標……安全系統啟動。

Desperate Metal#027.src: I'm sorry it ended up like this, you should've just ignored that old man.
Desperate Metal#027.dst: 事情變成這樣我很遺憾，你當初不該理那個老頭的。
Desperate Metal#027.speaker: Nettik

Desperate Metal#029.src: I was made to be angry. I can't stop myself...
Desperate Metal#029.dst: 我被造出來就是為了憤怒。我停不下來……
Desperate Metal#029.speaker: Big Boss Mech-DM666

Desperate Metal#031.src: Did you find the source of those odd handmade mechs?
Desperate Metal#031.dst: 那些奇怪的手工機兵，你找到源頭了嗎？
Desperate Metal#031.speaker: Phinas

Desperate Metal#032.src: Nettik? The Light House owner? It's not overly surprising.
Desperate Metal#032.dst: Nettik？那個燈塔主人？倒也不算太意外。
Desperate Metal#032.speaker: Phinas

Desperate Metal#033.src: She always did complain about the mech ban.
Desperate Metal#033.dst: 她一直很不滿那條機兵禁令。
Desperate Metal#033.speaker: Phinas

Desperate Metal#034.src: You see, many of the Corkian people rely on their machines. Have done for years.
Desperate Metal#034.dst: 你看，Corkus 有很多人是靠機器過活的，已經過了很多年。
Desperate Metal#034.speaker: Phinas

Desperate Metal#035.src: So when the factory fell and the new laws were introduced, people's lives changed..
Desperate Metal#035.dst: 所以當工廠倒了、新法令上路，那些人的生活就變了……
Desperate Metal#035.speaker: Phinas

Desperate Metal#036.src: People don't like change. Anyway, I can't thank you enough. Have this for your troubles.
Desperate Metal#036.dst: 人是不喜歡改變的。總之，真不知該怎麼謝你，這個拿去，算是你跑這一趟的酬勞。
Desperate Metal#036.speaker: Phinas

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#000.src: Find out what's happening at the theatre.

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#001.src: Interesting to see a Human wanting to see a Dwarven play!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#001.speaker: Lozeg

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#002.src: The only play we're performing is the annual Victory Festival.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#002.speaker: Lozeg

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#003.src: The entry cost is [{~} Emerald Block]
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#003.speaker: Lozeg

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#005.src: Just take a seat and enjoy the show.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#005.speaker: Lozeg

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#006.src: Wait, is that- Hey, {u}! It's so good to see you!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#006.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#007.src: Hello, to the people of Gavel, glad to see so many here!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#007.speaker: Narrator

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#008.src: I hope you'll enjoy the play and that it'll be very educational too. I will be tonight's narrator.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#008.speaker: Narrator

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#009.src: Pheeeew. I think we outran the villagers.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#009.speaker: Babbi

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#010.src: I think we are safe here in the mountains. Oh look. Shiny ores. This is like a gold mine.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#010.speaker: Dwarfi

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#011.src: These nice minerals are very nice, let us start digging.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#011.speaker: Dwarfi

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#013.src: I am a dangerous monster and I will not let you mine these diamonds. We are the Doguns, and we will kill you!!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#013.speaker: Demon

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#014.src: Graoaoro. I will eat you all for my afternoon demon luncheon.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#014.speaker: Demon

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#018.src: MOAHAHAHA. WE WILL KILL ALL OF YOU.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#018.speaker: Demon

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#019.src: We need to forge better weapons so we can fight back.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#019.speaker: Babbi

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#020.src: Good idea! We will use our intelligence to slay the demons.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#020.speaker: Gagly

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#021.src: YOU CANNOT BEAT US, WE CAN SUMMON DRAGONS WITH OUR MAGIC.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#021.speaker: Demon

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#022.src: Dragons are no match for us?? CHARGE!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#022.speaker: Gagly

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#023.src: We have won. Hooray. And now we have established a great citadel, {p}!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#023.speaker: Gagly

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#024.src: The dwarven intellect beat the sheer power of the demons magic.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#024.speaker: Gagly

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#026.src: I hope you enjoyed the show, and learned something new today!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#026.speaker: Narrator
