Fantastic Voyage#218.src: Bring the Steering Wheel to Captain Relend.

Fantastic Voyage#219.src: Ah, thank you for helping me in my time of need. Let's maneuver through these spikes at a steady speed!
Fantastic Voyage#219.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#220.src: Although, at the last minute, there is something I have to confess. I have never captained a ship with any success.
Fantastic Voyage#220.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#221.src: I think before we get into any real danger, we should turn around. Could you man the wheel and get us back to solid ground?
Fantastic Voyage#221.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#222.src: Man the wheel of the Little Wing.

Fantastic Voyage#223.src: Now you're the captain, hope the sea's not making you nauseous. Steer this ship, but you'll have to be cautious!
Fantastic Voyage#223.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#224.src: Nice steering, although your maneuvers are a bit brash. Hey, watch out! I think we're about to-
Fantastic Voyage#224.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#225.src: Find Relend inside of the wreck of the Little Wing.

Fantastic Voyage#226.src: As you can see, my ship has become a shipwreck! Now please help me, I am trapped in the lower deck!
Fantastic Voyage#226.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#227.src: Amazing work, seems you got below deck rather quickly! You're going to have to get through this wreckage to free me!
Fantastic Voyage#227.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#228.src: Wow, so you managed to work your way through after all! Maybe to free me, you can use that cannonball?
Fantastic Voyage#228.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#229.src: Save Relend inside of the wreck of the Little Wing.

Fantastic Voyage#230.src: Thank you for freeing me, now let's leave this mess! Although, I don't know how to do that, I have not even a guess.
Fantastic Voyage#230.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#231.src: When the ship crashed, it was buried beneath the sand! But the good news is that we're finally back on land!
Fantastic Voyage#231.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#232.src: We should probably get of this place, it feels rather small. Perhaps you can try to break through that weak spot in the wall?
Fantastic Voyage#232.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#234.src: It looks like we're going to be stuck here for a while. Come and speak to me so we can find a way off of this isle!
Fantastic Voyage#234.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#235.src: Speak to Relend on the beach.

Fantastic Voyage#236.src: Gateway Island... we've finally arrived. I'm just thankful that we survived.
Fantastic Voyage#236.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#237.src: Well, all this adventuring has me hungry for stew. We'll need ingredients, whatever's on the island will have to do.
Fantastic Voyage#237.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#238.src: Meat is definitely something we need to reap, try and get [{~} Raw Mutton] from those sheep.
Fantastic Voyage#238.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#239.src: And perhaps you could get [{~} Edible Mushrooms] from the western cave, just make sure not to get the kind that will send me to my grave.
Fantastic Voyage#239.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#240.src: I feel like something is missing from this medley. Oh, how about you get [{~} Coconut] from atop that tree?
Fantastic Voyage#240.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#241.src: And if you could fetch [{~} Berries], that would just make me merry!
Fantastic Voyage#241.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#242.src: Check your quest book if you ever need a recap. And to make sure you don't get lost, take this map.
Fantastic Voyage#242.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#243.src: Give the Odd Stew to Relend.

Fantastic Voyage#244.src: Well, this stew has a rather odd flavor. But any food we can get here I shall savor.
Fantastic Voyage#244.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#245.src: What remains of my ship won't protect us very well. We'll need to find shelter, as you can clearly tell.
Fantastic Voyage#245.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#246.src: To the east, I can just barely make out a tent. Go and look for my friend there. I'm simply hellbent!
Fantastic Voyage#246.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#247.src: Check out the tent to the east.

Fantastic Voyage#249.src: So the tent was all empty and run-down? All of this bad news is making me frown.
Fantastic Voyage#249.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#250.src: Allow me to borrow your map for a second. We'll have to find him somewhere else, I reckon.
Fantastic Voyage#250.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#251.src: I know we can come up with a solution using our wits. Perhaps we can use an explosive to blow that big rock to bits!
Fantastic Voyage#251.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#252.src: Let's think of some materials we can get here. There isn't much on this island, I fear...
Fantastic Voyage#252.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#253.src: First we're going to need [{~} Gritty Sand]. Where to get it? Try the beach at the back of the island.
Fantastic Voyage#253.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#254.src: Next up is [Sawdust], you'll need three. I think the best place to search would be the largest tree.
Fantastic Voyage#254.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#255.src: Finally, [{~} Black Powder], found in a place that is very unique. You'll have to brave your way to the volcano's peak.
Fantastic Voyage#255.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#256.src: You'll need those items you craft the bomb, I just told you where to look. If you forget what you need to find, check your quest book.
Fantastic Voyage#256.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#257.src: Bring {~} Gritty Sand, {~} Saw Dust, and {~} Black Powder to the Crafting Table.

Fantastic Voyage#258.src: Use the explosive on the boulder.

Fantastic Voyage#259.src: Incredible, The explosive blew right through the stone!
Fantastic Voyage#259.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#260.src: Let us progress into this mysterious zone.
Fantastic Voyage#260.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#263.src: For adventurers like us, an incredible cave, perfect to explore.
Fantastic Voyage#263.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#264.src: Surely where my old friend ventured - just as I swore!
Fantastic Voyage#264.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#265.src: Long ago, a strong adventurer like yourself reached out to me for a wonderful sail. It truly is a gripping tale!
Fantastic Voyage#265.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#266.src: We became best friends on our quest. But then he vanished, oh how he was the best.
Fantastic Voyage#266.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#267.src: And we've finally made it to where he'd been. I can't wait to see him again, I don't know where to begin!
Fantastic Voyage#267.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#268.src: A mystical portal! This must be where my old friend got lost!
Fantastic Voyage#268.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#269.src: We must go through and find him, whatever the cost.
Fantastic Voyage#269.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#270.src: I can't believe it! I simply can't speak!
Fantastic Voyage#270.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#271.src: I always told the others I wasn't a freak. Old friend, I'll look for you until the bitter end!
Fantastic Voyage#271.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#272.src: Find Relend in the strange place

Fantastic Voyage#273.src: A foreign land filled with danger, to the brim...
Fantastic Voyage#273.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#274.src: It must be where he vanished to, regardless of how grim.
Fantastic Voyage#274.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#275.src: My friend... Where do you think we are?
Fantastic Voyage#275.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#276.src: Whatever it is, I feel that we're being overseen from afar.
Fantastic Voyage#276.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#277.src: With all this danger, I still hope my good friend is still okay.
Fantastic Voyage#277.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#278.src: My goodness! Keep your wits about, we may be in for a fray!
Fantastic Voyage#278.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#279.src: Aagh... New friend... are you there?
Fantastic Voyage#279.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#280.src: Don't...give up... we must find him, I swear...
Fantastic Voyage#280.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#281.src: I promise I'll find him, I'll do it, without a single scar!
Fantastic Voyage#281.speaker: Relend

Fate of the Fallen#000.src: Talk to Telvu the mage at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Fate of the Fallen#001.src: Ah, a member of the {p} army. We're trying to gain entry to this frozen barrow. We could use your aid.
Fate of the Fallen#001.dst: 啊，{p} 軍隊的人。我們正想辦法進入這座冰封的古墳。你的幫忙來得正好。
Fate of the Fallen#001.speaker: Telvu

Fate of the Fallen#002.src: Are you familiar with the story of Theorick and {p}?
Fate of the Fallen#002.dst: 你熟悉 Theorick 與 {p} 的故事嗎？
Fate of the Fallen#002.speaker: Telvu

Fate of the Fallen#003.src: Probably not. Well, you see, {p} was not always frozen.
Fate of the Fallen#003.dst: 大概不熟。是這樣的，{p} 並非一直都是冰封的。
Fate of the Fallen#003.speaker: Telvu

Fate of the Fallen#004.src: During Theorick's time, this place was like the Wynn plains, warm and arable.
Fate of the Fallen#004.dst: 在 Theorick 的年代，這裡就像 Wynn 的平原，溫暖而適於耕作。
Fate of the Fallen#004.speaker: Telvu

Fate of the Fallen#005.src: For some reason, Theorick Twain used his immense power to freeze the land before exiling himself here.
Fate of the Fallen#005.dst: 不知為何，Theorick Twain 動用了他龐大的力量把這片土地凍結，然後把自己流放在此。
Fate of the Fallen#005.speaker: Telvu

Fate of the Fallen#006.src: We need to find out why so we can reverse this spell. Presumably, the source of that spell's magic would lie within the barrow... but we don't want to go in empty-handed.
Fate of the Fallen#006.dst: 我們得查出原因，才能解開這道法術。照理說，法術的魔力源頭應該就在古墳裡……但我們不想空著手進去。
Fate of the Fallen#006.speaker: Telvu

Fate of the Fallen#007.src: As such...have you heard of a place called {p}? We could use it to go back in time, to try to learn more about Theorick's actions.
Fate of the Fallen#007.dst: 因此……你聽過一個叫 {p} 的地方嗎？我們可以藉它回到過去，多了解一些 Theorick 的作為。
Fate of the Fallen#007.speaker: Telvu

Fate of the Fallen#008.src: Well...in a way, at least. There are laws to this sort of magic. For one, you need an item from the specific time we want to see. Second, you can witness the past, not change it.
Fate of the Fallen#008.dst: 呃……至少某種程度上是。這類魔法有它的規矩。其一，你需要一件來自我們想看的那個年代的物品。其二，你只能目睹過去，不能改變它。
Fate of the Fallen#008.speaker: Telvu

Fate of the Fallen#009.src: One of Theorick's staves is on display in the {p} bank. Presumably, it should work for what we need. Could you retrieve it somehow?
Fate of the Fallen#009.dst: Theorick 的其中一根法杖就陳列在 {p} 的銀行裡。照理說應該合用。你有辦法把它弄來嗎？
Fate of the Fallen#009.speaker: Telvu

Fate of the Fallen#010.dst: 在 {p} 的銀行找到 Theorick 的法杖。

Fate of the Fallen#011.src: Aha, quick job. I see you've got the wand. Must've needed a sharp tongue to get the bankers to give it up.
Fate of the Fallen#011.dst: 啊哈，動作真快。看來你把法杖拿到手了。要讓那些銀行的人鬆手，想必得有一副好口才。
Fate of the Fallen#011.speaker: Telvu

Fate of the Fallen#012.src: Now, it is a long walk to {p}. Needn't take that walk, though, as I can teleport you there. Hopefully.
Fate of the Fallen#012.dst: 走去 {p} 可是一段長路。不過不必用走的，我可以把你傳送過去。但願如此。
Fate of the Fallen#012.speaker: Telvu

Fate of the Fallen#013.src: Once you're there, enter the Temple of Time. You should know what to do once you are there. Careful dealing with time travel, friend... No idea what you might find.
Fate of the Fallen#013.dst: 到了之後，進入 Temple of Time。到了那裡你就會知道該怎麼做。時光旅行要小心，朋友……誰也不知道你會碰上什麼。
Fate of the Fallen#013.speaker: Telvu

Fate of the Fallen#014.dst: 直接走進傳送門就是了。
Fate of the Fallen#014.speaker: Telvu

Fate of the Fallen#015.src: Should anything go wrong, I'll stay here to teleport you back to the temple.
Fate of the Fallen#015.dst: 萬一出了什麼差錯，我會留在這裡把你傳送回神殿。
Fate of the Fallen#015.speaker: Telvu

Fate of the Fallen#016.src: Enter the portal the mage made.
Fate of the Fallen#016.dst: 進入法師開啟的傳送門。

Fate of the Fallen#017.src: Enter the Gate of Time at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] and travel back in time.
Fate of the Fallen#017.dst: 進入 [-{~1}, {~2}, -{~3}] 的 Gate of Time，回到過去。

Fate of the Fallen#020.src: Woah, your weaponry and armour is so advanced!
Fate of the Fallen#020.dst: 哇，你的武器跟護甲好先進！
Fate of the Fallen#020.speaker: Psern

Fate of the Fallen#021.src: Are you another Twain? Only the Twains know magic like that.
Fate of the Fallen#021.dst: 你也是 Twain 嗎？只有 Twains 懂那種魔法。
Fate of the Fallen#021.speaker: Psern

Fate of the Fallen#022.dst: 喔，你是來找 Theorick 的。
Fate of the Fallen#022.speaker: Psern

Fate of the Fallen#023.src: He's busy fighting in the war, shouldn't you be doing the same?
Fate of the Fallen#023.dst: 他忙著在前線打仗，你不也該去嗎？
Fate of the Fallen#023.speaker: Psern

Fate of the Fallen#024.src: He went west. There was some kind of emergency.
Fate of the Fallen#024.dst: 他往西邊去了。好像出了什麼緊急狀況。
Fate of the Fallen#024.speaker: Psern

Fate of the Fallen#025.src: We've been fighting the corruption for years, it seems like it might finally engulf {p}.
Fate of the Fallen#025.dst: 我們跟腐化打了好幾年，看樣子它終究要把 {p} 吞掉了。
Fate of the Fallen#025.speaker: Psern

Fate of the Fallen#026.src: Find Theorick in the forest west of {p} [{~}, {~}, {~}].
Fate of the Fallen#026.dst: 在 {p} 西邊的森林裡找到 Theorick [{~1}, {~2}, {~3}]。

Fate of the Fallen#027.src: I could've sworn she had gone this way... Oh, what now, more imbeciles? This forest isn't safe to travel!
Fate of the Fallen#027.dst: 我敢發誓她是往這邊走的……喔，又怎麼了，又來一個蠢貨？這片森林不能亂走！
Fate of the Fallen#027.speaker: Theorick

Fate of the Fallen#028.src: If you need help, lodge a complaint with the guards. I'm busy and I can't exactly break away from saving this god-blessed province to chill your milk!!
Fate of the Fallen#028.dst: 要幫忙就去跟衛兵申訴。我很忙，總不能丟下拯救這個天殺的行省，跑去幫你冰牛奶吧！！
Fate of the Fallen#028.speaker: Theorick

Fate of the Fallen#029.src: Are your ears full of wax?! I said-
Fate of the Fallen#029.dst: 你耳朵塞了耳屎嗎？！我說了——
Fate of the Fallen#029.speaker: Theorick

Fate of the Fallen#030.src: Urgh, the things followed you! See what happens?! STAND ASIDE.
Fate of the Fallen#030.dst: 唔，那些東西跟著你來了！看吧，會出什麼事？！退到一邊去。
Fate of the Fallen#030.speaker: Theorick

Fate of the Fallen#031.src: As though I needed TWO people to save! Now get out of here, I have to find that woman who went missing!
Fate of the Fallen#031.dst: 好像我還嫌只救一個人不夠似的！快滾，我還得去找那個失蹤的女人！
Fate of the Fallen#031.speaker: Theorick

Fate of the Fallen#032.src: HEEEELP! I can't outrun them!!! Guards! Someone!!
Fate of the Fallen#032.dst: 救命啊——！我跑不過牠們！！！衛兵！誰來啊！！

Fate of the Fallen#033.src: Whuh! That's her voice! Where is she?! I just cleared this area!
Fate of the Fallen#033.dst: 咦！那是她的聲音！她人在哪？！我剛才才清過這一帶！
Fate of the Fallen#033.speaker: Theorick

Fate of the Fallen#035.src: Ugh, is she dragging them over from the west?! You there, If you don't want to end up frozen, GET BEHIND ME, NOW!!
Fate of the Fallen#035.dst: 唔，她是從西邊一路把牠們引過來的嗎？！你，不想被凍成冰塊的話，立刻躲到我身後！！
Fate of the Fallen#035.speaker: Theorick

Fate of the Fallen#036.src: Phew... You're out of danger now. If you hadn't left town, though, you wouldn't have been IN any danger at all!
Fate of the Fallen#036.dst: 呼……你安全了。不過你要是沒離開城裡，根本就不會有什麼危險！
Fate of the Fallen#036.speaker: Theorick

Fate of the Fallen#037.src: Don't bother apologizing to me, just get back to town. Now.
Fate of the Fallen#037.dst: 不必跟我道歉，回城裡去就是了。立刻。
Fate of the Fallen#037.speaker: Theorick

Fate of the Fallen#038.src: Next time you feel like picking flowers in the forest or whatever you were doing, remember you have a life to live, hm?!
Fate of the Fallen#038.dst: 下次想到森林裡採花還是幹嘛的時候，記得你的命只有一條，聽見沒？！
Fate of the Fallen#038.speaker: Theorick

Fate of the Fallen#039.src: Every day, more corrupteds, more deaths... There is only one thing for it. I have to tackle it myself. Cut the roots...and kill this hellish weed.
Fate of the Fallen#039.dst: 每一天，腐化物更多，死的人也更多……只剩一條路了。我得親自去處理。斬斷根源……除掉這株地獄來的雜草。
Fate of the Fallen#039.speaker: Theorick

Fate of the Fallen#040.src: Still here? Well, listen up. Myself and a few others are planning something risky. Damned be it if our minds are lost, I need to go through that portal.
Fate of the Fallen#040.dst: 還在啊？那就聽好。我和另外幾個人在籌畫一件冒險的事。就算心智因此喪失也罷，我必須穿過那道傳送門。
Fate of the Fallen#040.speaker: Theorick

Fate of the Fallen#041.src: You look heavily geared, so I'm conscripting you. Meet us at our base, immediately. Follow the river south and you'll see a house on the right side.
Fate of the Fallen#041.dst: 你裝備看起來很齊，我徵召你了。立刻到我們的據點會合。沿著河往南走，右手邊會看到一棟房子。
Fate of the Fallen#041.speaker: Theorick

Fate of the Fallen#042.src: Head to the base of the operation south of {p} [{~}, {~}, {~}].

Fate of the Fallen#043.src: Well, I'll give you this. You're prompt to listen to orders, at least. We're headed to the {p}.
Fate of the Fallen#043.dst: 好吧，這點我承認。你至少聽令很快。我們要前往 {p}。
Fate of the Fallen#043.speaker: Theorick

Fate of the Fallen#044.src: The last man that entered the portal and returned became Bak’al... But if there is even a fraction of a chance this could work, we must take it at this point.
Fate of the Fallen#044.dst: 上一個進了那道門又回來的人，變成了 Bak’al……但只要還有一絲成功的可能，事到如今我們就得賭。
Fate of the Fallen#044.speaker: Theorick

Fate of the Fallen#045.src: Let's get moving. We'll be taking no breaks on the trip, so I hope you were prepared.
Fate of the Fallen#045.dst: 出發吧。這一路不休息，希望你早有準備。
Fate of the Fallen#045.speaker: Theorick

Fate of the Fallen#046.src: Now. The sheer cold I command can stave off corruption itself. Somehow I doubt any of you can say the same. I'll go in alone.
Fate of the Fallen#046.dst: 好。我所駕馭的極寒能夠擋住腐化本身。我可不覺得你們哪個也做得到。我一個人進去。
Fate of the Fallen#046.speaker: Theorick

Fate of the Fallen#047.src: When I enter... If I had to make an assumption, corrupteds will swarm the portal after me. Your job? Slay them. I can't have distractions in there.
Fate of the Fallen#047.dst: 我進去之後……照我推測，腐化物會跟著湧向那道門。你們的任務？把牠們殺光。我不能在裡面分心。
Fate of the Fallen#047.speaker: Theorick

Fate of the Fallen#048.src: You will not be leaving your post here until I exit that portal. Understood?
Fate of the Fallen#048.dst: 在我從那道門出來之前，你不准離開崗位。聽懂了嗎？
Fate of the Fallen#048.speaker: Theorick

Fate of the Fallen#051.src: ...no, no, no no no NO!! DAMN IT ALL!!
Fate of the Fallen#051.dst: ……不、不，不不不，不要啊！！全都該死！！
Fate of the Fallen#051.speaker: Theorick

Fate of the Fallen#052.src: You know what happened?! I lost!! I will destroy the province if I turn completely! GET AWAY, NOW! DO YOU HEAR ME?! RUN!!
Fate of the Fallen#052.dst: 你知道發生什麼事了嗎？！我輸了！！我要是徹底轉化，會毀了整個行省！走開，快！聽見沒有？！快跑！！
Fate of the Fallen#052.speaker: Theorick

Fate of the Fallen#053.src: I... C-calm yourself, Theorick...don't...don't lose yourself to it...there's...yet a solution...one way...
Fate of the Fallen#053.dst: 我……冷、冷靜下來，Theorick……別……別讓它吞掉你……還有……還有辦法……有一條路……
Fate of the Fallen#053.speaker: Theorick

Fate of the Fallen#054.src: Oh...you again...the others...dead? Run off? Cowards...urgh...
Fate of the Fallen#054.dst: 喔……又是你……其他人呢……死了？跑了？一群懦夫……唔……
Fate of the Fallen#054.speaker: Theorick

Fate of the Fallen#055.src: You live...so...eyes up. Listen to me. If I turn...w-when...when I turn...n-no, can't...gaaah, I'll destr- Nggh...
Fate of the Fallen#055.dst: 你還活著……那……抬起頭來。聽我說。如果我轉化……不，是當、當我轉化的時候……不、不行……啊啊啊，我會毀——唔……
Fate of the Fallen#055.speaker: Theorick

Fate of the Fallen#056.src: I won't last, you can tell... Right now...killing me is an impossibility, you idiotic weakl- Agh, GET OUT OF MY MIND!!
Fate of the Fallen#056.dst: 我撐不了多久，你看得出來……此刻……要殺我是不可能的，你這蠢弱的——啊，滾出我的腦袋！！
Fate of the Fallen#056.speaker: Theorick

Fate of the Fallen#057.src: Gaaah... Tell...everyone. I will freeze this place. I...t-too fargone. It needs time to heal...and my powers m-must be dampened...frozen...
Fate of the Fallen#057.dst: 啊啊啊……告訴……所有人。我要把這裡凍結。我……我已經、太遲了。這片土地需要時間癒合……而我的力量，必、必須被壓下……被凍住……
Fate of the Fallen#057.speaker: Theorick

Fate of the Fallen#058.src: All worthless... Urgh, no...they yet deserve life...and this spell...it will surely claim some. Please, let them know why...
Fate of the Fallen#058.dst: 全都不值一提……唔，不……他們仍配得上活著……而這道法術……必定會奪走一些人的命。拜託，讓他們知道原因……
Fate of the Fallen#058.speaker: Theorick

Fate of the Fallen#059.src: If I have learned anything from that insufferable f- ...from Mael...deaths without reason lets spirits to linger. I would...prefer against giving him a harder time.
Fate of the Fallen#059.dst: 如果說我從那個討人厭的傢——……從 Mael 那裡學到了什麼，那就是死得不明不白會讓亡魂徘徊不去。我……不想再給他添麻煩。
Fate of the Fallen#059.speaker: Theorick

Fate of the Fallen#060.src: K-keep advancing. Your things, if everyone was as strong as you...we may stand a chance. This could end me, in time, once I am weaker.
Fate of the Fallen#060.dst: 繼、繼續前進吧。你這身裝備，要是人人都像你這麼強……我們也許還有機會。等我更虛弱了，這終有一天能了結我。
Fate of the Fallen#060.speaker: Theorick

Fate of the Fallen#061.src: Let it be known...Theorick Twain is not dead. He cannot be killed...all will burn...until future days. Here, in this accursed place. Find me...and end it all.
Fate of the Fallen#061.dst: 讓世人知道……Theorick Twain 並沒有死。他是殺不死的……一切都將焚毀……直到將來的某一天。就在這裡，在這片受詛咒的土地上。找到我……然後為這一切畫下句點。
Fate of the Fallen#061.speaker: Theorick

Fate of the Fallen#062.src: Tell Telvu the mage what happened.

Fate of the Fallen#063.src: You must have succeeded, or you would be yet in the memory of the past. I can feel some potent magic on you.
Fate of the Fallen#063.dst: 你想必是成功了，否則你此刻還困在過去的記憶裡。我感覺得到你身上帶著強大的魔力。
Fate of the Fallen#063.speaker: Telvu

Fate of the Fallen#064.src: So, you met Theorick? He was always said to have fallen from heroism after the great freezing.
Fate of the Fallen#064.dst: 這麼說，你見到 Theorick 了？一直以來的說法都是，大冰封之後他就從英雄的位置上墮落了。
Fate of the Fallen#064.speaker: Telvu

Fate of the Fallen#065.src: Were you able to figure out why it was he froze this place, at least?
Fate of the Fallen#065.dst: 至少，你查出他為什麼要把這裡凍結了嗎？
Fate of the Fallen#065.speaker: Telvu

Fate of the Fallen#066.src: What... so many revelations... ice magic staves off corruption...? It is true this palce has seen less corrupted threats than other places in the province...
Fate of the Fallen#066.dst: 什麼……這麼多真相……冰魔法能擋住腐化……？的確，這個地方遇到的腐化威脅，比行省裡其他地方都要少……
Fate of the Fallen#066.speaker: Telvu

Fate of the Fallen#067.src: Dear gods... We've had it all wrong this whole time... This was to protect everyone...but surely he would have told someone his intentions if he was of that sound a mind!
Fate of the Fallen#067.dst: 天上諸神啊……我們一直以來全都弄錯了……這是為了保護所有人……可他要是神智還那麼清楚，總該跟誰交代一聲吧！
Fate of the Fallen#067.speaker: Telvu

Fate of the Fallen#068.src: All this time, spent buried alive, wrestling with the corruption. The thought horrifies you, as well, judging by your face. Killing him would be a mercy.
Fate of the Fallen#068.dst: 這麼多年，就這樣被活埋著，與腐化搏鬥。看你的臉色，這念頭也讓你毛骨悚然吧。殺了他，反而是慈悲。
Fate of the Fallen#068.speaker: Telvu

Fate of the Fallen#069.src: Here. Use this. It may help protect you within the Ice Barrows... Please, soldier. Be Theorick's guardian angel. Free him from this torment.
Fate of the Fallen#069.dst: 來。用這個。在 Ice Barrows 裡面它或許能保護你……拜託了，士兵。當 Theorick 的守護天使吧。把他從這場折磨裡解脫出來。
Fate of the Fallen#069.speaker: Telvu

Finding the Light#001.dst: 醒來！我們需要你的指引！
Finding the Light#001.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#002.src: ...ah. {u}. So you are needed here too, then?
Finding the Light#002.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#003.src: I am... TRYING... To awaken the Guardian of the Forest to receive its guidance, but it refuses to budge! Even the voice of Orphion provides no reaction.
Finding the Light#003.dst: 我正在……努力……喚醒森林守護者，想得到它的指引，可它就是不肯動！連 Orphion 的聲音都得不到半點回應。
Finding the Light#003.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#004.src: I beg once more of you, awaken! Us two... Us two seek your wisdom!
Finding the Light#004.dst: 我再求你一次，醒來吧！我們兩個……我們兩個都在尋求你的智慧！
Finding the Light#004.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#005.src: I present you Orphion's barest light- Please, respond!
Finding the Light#005.dst: 我獻上 Orphion 最微薄的一縷光——拜託，回應我！
Finding the Light#005.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#006.src: Urgh... See? Nothing is happening. I'm at a loss of what to do. Maybe you can affect some change, considering what you've done before.
Finding the Light#006.dst: 唔……看到了吧？什麼都沒發生。我已經不知道還能做什麼了。也許你能讓事情有點轉機，畢竟你以前做過那些事。
Finding the Light#006.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#007.src: My pulse, it is time. I shall shine my light upon the roots of the Guardian. You and she must learn now.
Finding the Light#007.dst: 我的脈動，時候到了。我將把我的光照在守護者的根上。你與她，都必須在此刻學會。

Finding the Light#008.src: Read the inscription at the bottom of the big tree.

Finding the Light#009.src: An inscription! That wasn't there before! It was... That was completely instant. How did you even...?
Finding the Light#009.dst: 一段銘文！剛才根本沒有這個東西！那是……那是瞬間出現的。你到底是怎麼……？
Finding the Light#009.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#010.src: But, still! I knew I could be useful, let me translate this for you! As a stranger to Gavel you wouldn't know High Gavellian...
Finding the Light#010.dst: 不過，總算有進展了！我就知道我幫得上忙，讓我替你翻譯！你是 Gavel 的外人，不可能懂高階 Gavel 語……
Finding the Light#010.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#011.src: It says... Secrets uncovered in the oldest of libraries in {p}.
Finding the Light#011.dst: 上面寫著……祕密藏在 {p} 最古老的圖書館裡。
Finding the Light#011.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#012.src: ...of course. A place that Elves aren't allowed, but humans are. {u}, you'll have to find this library on your own, it seems.
Finding the Light#012.dst: ……當然了。一個精靈不得進入、人類卻可以的地方。{u}，看來這座圖書館得由你自己去找了。
Finding the Light#012.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#013.src: Find the Church Library in the city of {p} at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Finding the Light#014.src: Find a way up to the church bell at the top of the church.
Finding the Light#014.dst: 想辦法爬到教堂頂端的鐘那裡。

Finding the Light#015.src: Explore the secret library and find a way to wake up the tree.
Finding the Light#015.dst: 探索祕密圖書館，找出喚醒那棵樹的方法。

Finding the Light#017.src: Do you reject the light of Orphion? Waken, please!
Finding the Light#017.dst: 你要拒絕 Orphion 的光嗎？醒來，拜託你！
Finding the Light#017.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#018.src: Urgh... {u}, please tell me you were able to make some progress. The Guardian still refuses... To... WAKE!
Finding the Light#018.dst: 唔……{u}，拜託告訴我你那邊有進展。守護者還是不肯……給我……醒過來！
Finding the Light#018.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#019.src: What is this? A spell scroll- Of the Waking Forest?! In {p}, of all places? Where it would have been... Impossible for me to go...
Finding the Light#019.dst: 這是什麼？一卷法術卷軸——喚醒森林的？！而且偏偏是在 {p}？那個我根本……根本進不去的地方……
Finding the Light#019.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#020.src: So I am Orphion's chosen, yet I would not have been able to do what was asked of me. That... No, I can't dwell on that, let me see the scroll.
Finding the Light#020.dst: 所以我是 Orphion 的受選者，卻連交代給我的事都做不到。那……不，我不能糾結在這上面，讓我看看卷軸。
Finding the Light#020.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#021.src: ...hm. It says, The seeker must rest these words upon those of the Guardian.
Finding the Light#021.dst: ……嗯。上面說：求道者須將此言安放於守護者之言上。
Finding the Light#021.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#022.src: I suppose that means you need to place it by the inscription. So yet another task that you must finish...
Finding the Light#022.dst: 我想意思是你得把它放在銘文旁邊。所以，又是一件得由你完成的事……
Finding the Light#022.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#023.src: ...go on, then, do it. I'm just needed here to be a translator for you thusfar, it seems.
Finding the Light#023.dst: ……去吧。到目前為止，我在這裡好像也就只剩替你翻譯的用處了。
Finding the Light#023.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#024.src: Use the spell on the inscription under the tree.
Finding the Light#024.dst: 對樹下的銘文使用法術。

Finding the Light#025.src: Let me go ahead and read this, too. This will be tedious, I fear...
Finding the Light#025.dst: 這一段也讓我來讀吧。我想這會很費工夫……
Finding the Light#025.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#026.src: It says... Awakening the Guardian of the Forest requires more than just magic. The home of the elves will house the answers and revelations...?
Finding the Light#026.dst: 上面說……喚醒森林守護者，需要的不只是魔法。精靈的家園將藏有答案與啟示……？
Finding the Light#026.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#027.src: That... This is finally my time! I still have a hand in this!! Finally, I can do something more than just holding stasis here!
Finding the Light#027.dst: 那……這總算輪到我了！我在這件事上還有份量！！我終於可以做點什麼，而不是只在這裡撐著僵局！
Finding the Light#027.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#028.src: Listen, {u}. Achara... This is my time. I can finally help you more directly. I know the elders of {p}- They're sure to have answers!
Finding the Light#028.dst: 聽好，{u}。Achara……這是屬於我的時刻。我終於能更直接地幫上忙了。我認識 {p} 的長老們——他們一定有答案！
Finding the Light#028.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#029.src: You truly have been helpful, even through my own worries. I must thank you, but you can relax now! I will be the one this time!
Finding the Light#029.dst: 你真的幫了大忙，即使我心裡一直在彆扭。我該謝謝你，但你現在可以放鬆了！這一次換我來！
Finding the Light#029.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#030.src: You can continue doing...whatever else it is you need doing. I have seen you helping in various places- Concern yourself with those for now. I can handle this.
Finding the Light#030.dst: 你可以去忙……你其他該忙的事。我看過你在各地幫忙——先去顧那些吧。這裡我應付得來。
Finding the Light#030.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#031.src: Pursue her, my pulse. She must take dire action- Alone, her light shall illuminate nothing. You must provide her direction.
Finding the Light#031.dst: 追上她，我的脈動。她必須採取決絕的行動——僅憑她自己，她的光照不亮任何東西。你必須為她指出方向。

Finding the Light#032.src: Enter the portal Lari left behind
Finding the Light#032.dst: 進入 Lari 留下的傳送門。

Finding the Light#033.src: Go to the hut Lari entered.
Finding the Light#033.dst: 前往 Lari 進入的小屋。

Finding the Light#034.src: W-What? You- Why did you follow me? I can handle this! I can finally be useful again! Do you...not trust me?
Finding the Light#034.dst: 什——什麼？你——你為什麼要跟過來？這件事我應付得來！我終於又能派上用場了！你是……不信任我嗎？
Finding the Light#034.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#035.src: Please, just respect my wishes! If I need your help, I'll go find you- For now, just leave! You don't need to worry about this!
Finding the Light#035.dst: 拜託，就尊重我的意願一次！我需要你幫忙的話，我會去找你——現在，請你離開！這件事你不必操心！
Finding the Light#035.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#036.src: Find a way to sneak into the hut.

Finding the Light#037.src: ...if this human has truly done what you have said, then why do you spurn their aid? It is unlike you.
Finding the Light#037.dst: ……若這名人類真的做到了你所說的那些事，你又為何要推開他們的援手？這不像你。
Finding the Light#037.speaker: Elder

Finding the Light#038.src: I know, I know. I just am in disbelief. They've been contacted by Orphion himself, allowed into the Taproot, they have a symbol of Orphion's blessing!!
Finding the Light#038.dst: 我知道，我知道。我只是不敢相信。Orphion 親自與他們接觸過，他們被允許進入 Taproot，他們身上帶著 Orphion 賜福的印記！！
Finding the Light#038.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#039.src: They just...walked up, after a thousand years of my putting my entire life into trying to save this province, and do everything I couldn't, in the span of weeks at most!
Finding the Light#039.dst: 他們就這樣……走了過來，而我把整整一千年的人生都投進去、只想救這個行省，他們卻在頂多幾週之內，把我做不到的事全做完了！
Finding the Light#039.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#040.src: Do you understand how infuriating this is? Can you comprehend such a thing, not having been in my position yourself?
Finding the Light#040.dst: 你明白這有多令人抓狂嗎？你自己沒站在我的位置上，能理解這種事嗎？
Finding the Light#040.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#041.src: No. I cannot understand. But I also cannot understand how you are not grateful for this aid.
Finding the Light#041.dst: 不。我無法理解。但我同樣無法理解，你為何不對這份援手心懷感激。
Finding the Light#041.speaker: Elder

Finding the Light#042.src: I know I should be! It's all I've been able to think about. I should be ecstatic! The light will be saved, it should be everything I've dreamed of...
Finding the Light#042.dst: 我知道我應該感激！我腦子裡想的就只有這件事。我應該欣喜若狂才對！光將會得救，那本該是我夢寐以求的一切……
Finding the Light#042.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#043.src: But it makes me feel like a complete failure. Like everything I have done has been for naught, that I have somehow been doing everything wrong!
Finding the Light#043.dst: 可是這讓我覺得自己是個徹頭徹尾的失敗者。好像我做過的一切都白費了，好像我一路以來全都做錯了！
Finding the Light#043.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#044.src: I know I have made mistakes. Dullahan would still be... Still be himself, if I had taken faster action, but I can't have done nothing right. I can't accept that.
Finding the Light#044.dst: 我知道我犯過錯。要是我當初動作快一點，Dullahan 現在還會是……還會是他自己。但我不可能一件事都沒做對。我沒辦法接受那樣。
Finding the Light#044.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#045.src: This is my chance to prove I can still be useful- that Orphion choosing me wasn't a fluke! Please, the inscription said you would know where to go!
Finding the Light#045.dst: 這是我證明自己還有用的機會——證明 Orphion 選中我不是一場僥倖！拜託，銘文說您會知道該去哪裡！
Finding the Light#045.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#047.src: ...even after a millennium, there is so very much for us all to learn. Fine then.
Finding the Light#047.dst: ……即便過了一千年，我們要學的東西依然多得很。那好吧。
Finding the Light#047.speaker: Elder

Finding the Light#048.src: But promise me to accept the aid you receive. This opportunity cannot be wasted, Lari.
Finding the Light#048.dst: 但你要答應我，接受你得到的援手。這個機會不容浪費，Lari。
Finding the Light#048.speaker: Elder

Finding the Light#049.src: ...I have to do at least one thing right. I can't just keep up this holding pattern. I'll do whatever is necessary!
Finding the Light#049.dst: ……我至少得做對一件事。我不能再這樣原地打轉下去了。要做什麼我都做！
Finding the Light#049.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#050.src: You must seek the Canned Abis plant, then. It rests within a cavern shaded by giant fern leaves.
Finding the Light#050.dst: 那麼，你必須去尋找 Canned Abis 這種植物。它長在一處被巨大蕨葉遮蔽的洞窟裡。
Finding the Light#050.speaker: Elder

Finding the Light#051.src: Thank you. I can finally do what I was meant to do! I won't let anything stop me this time!!
Finding the Light#051.dst: 謝謝您。我終於能做我本該做的事了！這一次我不會讓任何東西攔住我！！
Finding the Light#051.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#052.src: ...Human, I can see you. Consider yourself lucky that she did not. Come talk to me.
Finding the Light#052.dst: ……人類，我看得見你。她沒看見，算你走運。過來說話。
Finding the Light#052.speaker: Elder

Finding the Light#054.src: So you are Orphion's new chosen, then. It is both surprising and not- Humans have an interesting reputation.
Finding the Light#054.dst: 所以你就是 Orphion 新的受選者。這既令人意外，也不令人意外——人類的名聲很有意思。
Finding the Light#054.speaker: Elder

Finding the Light#055.src: Often said as being able to get anything done, without limits, be it completing impossible tasks or breaking moral tenets.
Finding the Light#055.dst: 人們常說，人類什麼事都做得成，毫無限制——不論是完成不可能的任務，還是打破道德的戒律。
Finding the Light#055.speaker: Elder

Finding the Light#056.src: In this instance, however, you've both to do. Orphion has commanded it, has he not? And so you must, and for that I apologize.
Finding the Light#056.dst: 不過在這件事上，這兩樣你都得做。Orphion 已經下了令，不是嗎？所以你非做不可，而為此我向你致歉。
Finding the Light#056.speaker: Elder

Finding the Light#057.src: I have seen Lari's work- And she has done this land a priceless service. Alone, she has kept the Decay from creeping south, and thus the Guardian remains with us.
Finding the Light#057.dst: 我看過 Lari 的作為——她為這片土地立下了無價的功勞。是她一個人擋住了衰朽南下，守護者才得以留在我們身邊。
Finding the Light#057.speaker: Elder

Finding the Light#058.src: However, her own morals prevent the situation from progressing. She cannot kill- And the source must be exterminated for light to once again fill the land.
Finding the Light#058.dst: 然而，正是她自己的道德讓局面無法推進。她下不了殺手——而唯有根除源頭，光才能再度充滿這片土地。
Finding the Light#058.speaker: Elder

Finding the Light#059.src: Orphion's circumstances are dire- And so you must come to understand something. He is above us, in terms of morals. Such concepts do not apply to him.
Finding the Light#059.dst: Orphion 的處境已經危急——所以有件事你必須明白。祂在道德的層次上高於我們。那些概念並不適用於祂。
Finding the Light#059.speaker: Elder

Finding the Light#060.src: As the embodiment of Light itself, he has no sense of morals- Merely survival and stasis. What he asks of us, many will balk at.
Finding the Light#060.dst: 身為光本身的化身，祂沒有道德觀——只有存續與維持。祂要求我們做的事，許多人會退避三舍。
Finding the Light#060.speaker: Elder

Finding the Light#061.src: It is a matter where morals must be set aside... And such a thing is one that Lari cannot abide by, for she has stubbornly clung to them for a thousand years.
Finding the Light#061.dst: 這是一件必須把道德擱在一旁的事……而那正是 Lari 無法接受的，因為她固執地守了那些東西一千年。
Finding the Light#061.speaker: Elder

Finding the Light#062.src: To break them... I will admit, I believe there to be some other way to solve these problems, but the fact of the matter is there simply is no time left.
Finding the Light#062.dst: 要打破它們……我承認，我相信這些問題還有別的解法，但事實是，已經沒有時間了。
Finding the Light#062.speaker: Elder

Finding the Light#063.src: She must use the extent of her powers, and while she retains her pacifism that will not happen. I must ask you to follow her, as Orphion would wish.
Finding the Light#063.dst: 她必須用盡她全部的力量，而只要她還抱著那份不殺的堅持，那就不會發生。我必須請你跟著她，一如 Orphion 所願。
Finding the Light#063.speaker: Elder

Finding the Light#064.src: There is, unfortunately, no right to this. There is simply necessity- And there, you must push her to her limits. Seek the cave of the Canned Abis.
Finding the Light#064.dst: 很遺憾，這件事沒有所謂的對錯。只有不得不然——而在那裡，你必須把她逼到極限。去找 Canned Abis 的洞窟。
Finding the Light#064.speaker: Elder

Finding the Light#065.src: It is north-east from here. The entrance is shaded by giant fern leaves. I only pray that this will be enough.
Finding the Light#065.dst: 從這裡往東北方。入口被巨大的蕨葉遮著。我只能祈禱這樣就夠了。
Finding the Light#065.speaker: Elder

Finding the Light#066.src: Find the Canned Abis cave at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
Finding the Light#066.dst: 到 [-{~1}, {~2}, -{~3}] 找到 Canned Abis 洞窟。

Finding the Light#067.src: Find the plant inside the cave.
Finding the Light#067.dst: 在洞窟裡找到那株植物。

Finding the Light#069.src: ...I can't believe this. What am I doing wrong? What is it? There has to be some reason, what IS it?!
Finding the Light#069.dst: ……我不敢相信。我到底做錯了什麼？是哪裡？一定有什麼原因，到底是什麼？！
Finding the Light#069.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#070.src: There's not another inscription...it's just the same words! What does it mean by ‘’dire actions?!‘’ I've done everything I can think of!
Finding the Light#070.dst: 根本沒有新的銘文……還是同樣那幾句話！「決絕的行動」到底是什麼意思？！我想得到的我全做了！
Finding the Light#070.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#071.src: Is- Is this not dire enough? Is poring over you and putting aside my role and pride to someone else not EXTREME enough?!
Finding the Light#071.dst: 這——這樣還不夠決絕嗎？把自己剖開來檢視、把我的位置和我的驕傲都讓給別人，這樣還不夠極端嗎？！
Finding the Light#071.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#072.src: .... I. I have to know. What did Orphion tell you, exactly? I can't stand not knowing any longer. Did he really replace me?
Finding the Light#072.dst: ……我。我必須知道。Orphion 到底跟你說了什麼？我再也受不了這樣蒙在鼓裡。他真的把我換掉了嗎？
Finding the Light#072.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#073.src: I can't think of any other reason why everything for me has just...stopped working. Did he? Please, tell me-
Finding the Light#073.dst: 我想不出還有什麼別的理由，能解釋為什麼我這邊的一切就這樣……全都不管用了。是嗎？拜託，告訴我——
Finding the Light#073.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#074.src: ...wait... You... You have Canned Abis on you!! Where did you get that?!
Finding the Light#074.dst: ……等等……你……你身上有 Canned Abis！！你從哪裡拿到的？！
Finding the Light#074.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#075.src: You... There's no way you would've known that unless you... YOU! You eavesdropped on me!!
Finding the Light#075.dst: 你……你不可能會知道那個，除非你——是你！你偷聽了我說話！！
Finding the Light#075.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#076.src: You FOLLOWED ME into the cave even after I asked not to! You... After everything I said!! After you heard all those private thoughts!
Finding the Light#076.dst: 我明明叫你別跟來，你還是跟進洞窟裡了！你……在我說了那些話之後！！在你聽完那些私密的心事之後！
Finding the Light#076.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#077.src: You STILL decided it was a good idea to come after me! What are you planning to accomplish like this?!
Finding the Light#077.dst: 你居然還覺得追上來是個好主意！你這樣到底想達成什麼？！
Finding the Light#077.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#078.src: What, are you thinking ‘’oh, let's follow the funny elf girl and see her FAIL, OVER and OVER AGAIN!?‘’ IS THAT IT?!
Finding the Light#078.dst: 怎麼，你是在想「哦，跟著那個好笑的精靈女孩，看她一次又一次失敗吧」？！是這樣嗎？！
Finding the Light#078.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#079.src: You heard me then!! It's ALL out in the open! I can't succeed! You're there! You're doing everything I couldn't!
Finding the Light#079.dst: 那你都聽見了！！全都攤在陽光下了！我成不了事！你在那裡！我做不到的，你全都做到了！
Finding the Light#079.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#080.src: I'm NOT a failure! I'm not! I won't be! I refuse to be! You don't GET to watch me flounder and flail!!
Finding the Light#080.dst: 我不是失敗者！我不是！我不會是！我拒絕當那種東西！你沒資格站在那裡看我掙扎、看我出醜！！
Finding the Light#080.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#083.src: Wha- I... What just... What did I...?
Finding the Light#083.dst: 什——我……剛才怎麼……我做了什麼……？
Finding the Light#083.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#086.src: ...GRAAAAAUGH!! TELL ME HOW THIS IS ‘’ENOUGH!‘’ TELL ME, NOW!
Finding the Light#086.dst: ……啊啊啊啊——！！告訴我這樣怎麼會「夠了」！現在就告訴我！
Finding the Light#086.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#087.src: I-I NEARLY KILLED THEM! I JUST BROKE AND DEFILED EVERYTHING I'VE EVER STOOD FOR!!
Finding the Light#087.dst: 我差一點就殺了他們！我親手粉碎、玷污了我這輩子所堅持的一切！！
Finding the Light#087.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#088.src: TELL ME!! HOW COULD THIS POSSIBLY BE THE ANSWER?! HOW COULD THIS BE WHAT NEEDED TO HAPPEN?!
Finding the Light#088.dst: 告訴我！！這怎麼可能會是答案？！這怎麼可能是非發生不可的事？！
Finding the Light#088.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#089.src: WHY WOULD I BE NEEDED TO... To...
Finding the Light#089.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#090.src: T-Trying to murder them because they did what I couldn't isn't dark? How can you possibly think that?!
Finding the Light#090.dst: 因為他們做到了我做不到的事，我就想殺了他們——這不算墮入黑暗嗎？你怎麼可能這樣想？！
Finding the Light#090.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#091.src: What kind of guardian are you, permissing this kind of violence? How is anything I just did alright?
Finding the Light#091.dst: 你算什麼守護者，居然容許這種暴行？我剛才做的事，哪一點是可以的？
Finding the Light#091.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#092.src: ...you. You can't possibly be saying that what I did was the right thing to do. I refuse to accept that.
Finding the Light#092.dst: ……你。你不可能是在說我剛才做的是對的。我拒絕接受這種說法。
Finding the Light#092.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#094.src: ...then... Shouldn't I feel... I don't know. Shouldn't I feel less restrained? Less afraid? More... More free?
Finding the Light#094.dst: ……那麼……我不是應該覺得……我不知道。我不是應該覺得比較不受束縛？比較不害怕？比較……比較自由嗎？
Finding the Light#094.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#095.src: If what I've done was what needed to happen, why do I feel like the scum of the earth? Why do I feel so terrible?!
Finding the Light#095.dst: 如果我做的正是非做不可的事，為什麼我覺得自己像地上的爛泥？為什麼我這麼難受？！
Finding the Light#095.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#096.src: ...I... I need time to process this. I... Do you understand how difficult this is to hear? To bear?
Finding the Light#096.dst: ……我……我需要時間消化這件事。我……你明白這有多難聽進去嗎？有多難承受嗎？
Finding the Light#096.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#097.src: My pulse, your light is brilliant... It has shone upon Lari, and soon her light will shine my way...
Finding the Light#097.dst: 我的脈動，你的光何其燦亮……它已照在 Lari 身上，不久之後，她的光也將照向我……

Finding the Light#098.src: Enter the roots, and witness the path to my realm. And then, prepare yourself. Muster your most blinding light...
Finding the Light#098.dst: 進入根中，見證通往我領域的道路。然後，做好準備。凝聚起你最耀眼的光……

Flight in Distress#000.src: Bring your Gavellian Passport to the Airship Clerk at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Flight in Distress#001.src: Good day, soldier! Will you be flying with us today?
Flight in Distress#001.speaker: Airship Clerk

Flight in Distress#002.src: May I see your passport please?
Flight in Distress#002.speaker: Airship Clerk

Flight in Distress#003.src: It's a bit dusty! It looks very old, but the picture looks like you.
Flight in Distress#003.speaker: Airship Clerk

Flight in Distress#004.src: Well everything seems to be in order, climb aboard and I hope you have a pleasant journey.
Flight in Distress#004.speaker: Airship Clerk

Flight in Distress#006.src: Please remain seated, passengers. We'll be taking off in a moment!
Flight in Distress#006.speaker: Captain Ackbar

Flight in Distress#007.src: Speak to Captain Ackbar regarding the missing child.

Flight in Distress#008.src: Attention passengers. There has been a missing person reported aboard. If there are any volunteers to help search for them, please report to the bridge and speak to the captain.
Flight in Distress#008.speaker: Broadcast

Flight in Distress#009.src: This area is off limits to passengers during take off. Climb up to the passenger decks, there will be an attendee waiting at your cabin.
Flight in Distress#009.speaker: Ship Crew

Flight in Distress#010.src: I hope I do not get nauseous...
Flight in Distress#010.speaker: Passenger Jeremy

Flight in Distress#011.src: Greetings, young adventurer. You haven't seen my glasses, have you?
Flight in Distress#011.speaker: Baron Axol

Flight in Distress#012.src: The interior of this ship is beautiful!
Flight in Distress#012.speaker: Passenger John

Flight in Distress#013.src: Good day to you, soldier! This will be your quarters for the flight. I wish you a pleasant trip with us!
Flight in Distress#013.speaker: Attendant

Flight in Distress#014.src: You can sleep through your journey here if you have nothing else to do!
Flight in Distress#014.speaker: Attendant

Flight in Distress#015.src: The food they serve here is dreadful! As if it were meant for beasts they transport below deck.
Flight in Distress#015.speaker: Passenger Casula

Flight in Distress#016.src: *Sniff*... Have you seen my child? We were in our cabin, and then he just disappeared!
Flight in Distress#016.speaker: Passenger Nancy

Flight in Distress#017.src: I heard that a big ship was approaching from north. I saw it from the entrance deck. I wonder what they are doing.
Flight in Distress#017.speaker: Sub-engineer Akot

Flight in Distress#018.src: Are you here to volunteer to search for the missing child?
Flight in Distress#018.speaker: Captain Ackbar

Flight in Distress#019.src: We only just to set off and there is already an incident.
Flight in Distress#019.speaker: Captain Ackbar

Flight in Distress#020.src: His mother informed us that her son disappeared soon after boarding.
Flight in Distress#020.speaker: Captain Ackbar

Flight in Distress#021.src: Poor parenting, if you ask me. Alas, we must find the lad.
Flight in Distress#021.speaker: Captain Ackbar

Flight in Distress#022.src: Since we don't have any leads, it might be best to ask some of the passengers for information.
Flight in Distress#022.speaker: Captain Ackbar

Flight in Distress#023.src: Most of them will be in the dining area or in the lounge.
Flight in Distress#023.speaker: Captain Ackbar

Flight in Distress#024.src: Thank you so much for your help; I hope you find the lad soon.
Flight in Distress#024.speaker: Captain Ackbar

Flight in Distress#025.src: Try and find out where the missing child is located by speaking to the passengers.

Flight in Distress#026.src: Hey! Look at that ship over in the distance. It has been following the ship almost since we left off.
Flight in Distress#026.speaker: Missing Child

Flight in Distress#027.src: I know I shouldn't be down here but...
Flight in Distress#027.speaker: Missing Child

Flight in Distress#028.src: I love airships, and I have never seen one like that.
Flight in Distress#028.speaker: Missing Child

Flight in Distress#030.src: Okay then, I will head back right now!
Flight in Distress#030.speaker: Missing Child

Flight in Distress#032.src: Thank you so much for finding my child! He will not be leaving my side for the rest of the trip.
Flight in Distress#032.speaker: Passenger Nancy

Flight in Distress#033.src: I'm sorry I caused such a worry earlier...
Flight in Distress#033.speaker: Found Child

Flight in Distress#034.src: Hello again, did you find him?
Flight in Distress#034.speaker: Captain Ackbar

Flight in Distress#035.src: How did he get down there?! There is supposed to be someone on duty!
Flight in Distress#035.speaker: Captain Ackbar

Flight in Distress#036.src: Thank you so much for finding him. You were the only volunteer.
Flight in Distress#036.speaker: Captain Ackbar

Flight in Distress#037.src: Hopefully that is the only hiccup in the journey.
Flight in Distress#037.speaker: Captain Ackbar

Flight in Distress#038.src: What in good heavens was that? Crew, report!
Flight in Distress#038.speaker: Captain Ackbar

Flight in Distress#039.src: Sir! One of our engines blew out! We've lost all thrust on that side.
Flight in Distress#039.speaker: Airship Crewmember

Flight in Distress#040.src: Blast it all! We are sitting dead in the water without both engines.
Flight in Distress#040.speaker: Captain Ackbar

Flight in Distress#041.src: Go check on the condition of the passengers.
Flight in Distress#041.speaker: Captain Ackbar

Flight in Distress#042.src: Soldier, go report to the Engineer in the engine room and see if there is anything you can do to help us get moving once again.
Flight in Distress#042.speaker: Captain Ackbar

Flight in Distress#043.src: Look if the engineer has something for you to do in order to help.

Flight in Distress#044.src: You must be the 'uman the captain done told me.
Flight in Distress#044.speaker: Engineer Eric

Flight in Distress#045.src: We sure are havin' quite the situation down 'ere.
Flight in Distress#045.speaker: Engineer Eric

Flight in Distress#046.src: I hafta stay here and man the 'ngines, else she might damage 'erself.
Flight in Distress#046.speaker: Engineer Eric

Flight in Distress#047.src: If ye wanna help 'uman, go on up the riggin' and take a gander at the props.
Flight in Distress#047.speaker: Engineer Eric

Flight in Distress#048.src: Ye can get to 'em through the access 'atches in the bridge.
Flight in Distress#048.speaker: Engineer Eric

Flight in Distress#049.src: If'n they're stopped, just hit the breakers that are off.
Flight in Distress#049.speaker: Engineer Eric

Flight in Distress#050.src: Come back here when ye done. I need ta stay here and keep her cool.
Flight in Distress#050.speaker: Engineer Eric

Flight in Distress#051.src: Go find and fix the issue with the airship's engines. They are located on top of the balloon through the bridge.

Flight in Distress#052.src: In event of shut-down, maitenence must be performed.
Flight in Distress#052.speaker: Engine Instructions

Flight in Distress#053.src: Worker must restart all wooden switches before engine overheats.
Flight in Distress#053.speaker: Engine Instructions

Flight in Distress#054.src: DO NOT PRESS THE STONE SWITCHES
Flight in Distress#054.speaker: Engine Instructions

Flight in Distress#055.src: Report to Engineer Eric that you fixed the engines.

Flight in Distress#056.src: Thank ye! The 'ngines are back up and running!
Flight in Distress#056.speaker: Engineer Eric

Flight in Distress#057.src: I couldn't have dun this without ye.
Flight in Distress#057.speaker: Engineer Eric

Flight in Distress#058.src: You go back to yer quarters and get some rest. A passen'er like yerself shouldn' have to help the crew.
Flight in Distress#058.speaker: Engineer Eric

Flight in Distress#059.src: I hope the rest of yer journey is good. I'll let the cap'n know so he can turn her up ta max and get us movin' again.
Flight in Distress#059.speaker: Engineer Eric

Flight in Distress#063.src: All staff report to stations! This is not a drill! All staff report to stations!
Flight in Distress#063.speaker: Broadcast

Flight in Distress#064.src: Explore the lower deck and find out what caused the explosion.

Flight in Distress#065.src: Hol' togetha old girl, ye got this!
Flight in Distress#065.speaker: Engineer Eric

Flight in Distress#066.src: Men, hold her steady. We can still survive this! We just need to stop them following us.
Flight in Distress#066.speaker: Captain Ackbar

Flight in Distress#068.src: Look here girls, the meat has come to us!
Flight in Distress#068.speaker: Sky Raider

Flight in Distress#069.src: Send more in! They can't get all of us!
Flight in Distress#069.speaker: Sky Raider

Flight in Distress#070.src: The rest of you all, get in here!
Flight in Distress#070.speaker: Sky Raider

Flight in Distress#072.src: I heard fighting? Is someone there? I am in the jail cell!
Flight in Distress#072.speaker: Captured Prisoner

Flight in Distress#074.src: I heard fighting above, well done! Any chance to see those raiders get what's coming warms my old heart.
Flight in Distress#074.speaker: Captured Prisoner

Flight in Distress#075.src: I used to be the greatest locksmith in all of Gavel! I was known all over, unfortunately.
Flight in Distress#075.speaker: Captured Prisoner

Flight in Distress#076.src: These fiends captured me, years ago, and made me create hundreds of keys for their raids.
Flight in Distress#076.speaker: Captured Prisoner

Flight in Distress#077.src: I am much too old now, but I would love to see them taken down before I leave this world.
Flight in Distress#077.speaker: Captured Prisoner

Flight in Distress#078.src: My key making gear is stored down the hall, behind the staircase. You can use them to craft a way inside the Queen's quarters.
Flight in Distress#078.speaker: Captured Prisoner

Flight in Distress#079.src: Just look into the keyhole to see how to make them. Good luck!
Flight in Distress#079.speaker: Captured Prisoner

Flight in Distress#080.src: Make the key to reach the Skyraider Queen.

Flight in Distress#081.src: So you think you can just come on my ship, huh?
Flight in Distress#081.speaker: Skyraider Queen

Flight in Distress#082.src: Kill my crew? Interrupt my plunder?
Flight in Distress#082.speaker: Skyraider Queen

Flight in Distress#083.src: I know how to deal with 'problems' like you!
Flight in Distress#083.speaker: Skyraider Queen

Flight in Distress#084.src: Fight the Skyraider Queen and take one of her personal treasures with you.

Flight in Distress#085.src: Escape the ship and speak to Captain Ackbar.

Flight in Distress#086.src: Wow, You single handedly took out a skyraider invasion.
Flight in Distress#086.speaker: Captain Ackbar

Flight in Distress#087.src: And you're a passenger! It's a good job you did...
Flight in Distress#087.speaker: Captain Ackbar

Flight in Distress#088.src: We have no defense on this ship. We are a civilian carrier.
Flight in Distress#088.speaker: Captain Ackbar

Flight in Distress#089.src: What is this? A ring from the queen? It looks valuable. You should keep it.
Flight in Distress#089.speaker: Captain Ackbar

Flight in Distress#090.src: I still do not know how to thank you... We owe you so much.
Flight in Distress#090.speaker: Captain Ackbar

Flight in Distress#091.src: Wait! I know! You can have free travel from {p} to {p}!
Flight in Distress#091.speaker: Captain Ackbar

Flight in Distress#092.src: A private airship owner called Calo owes me big.
Flight in Distress#092.speaker: Captain Ackbar

Flight in Distress#093.src: I will tell him the deal. All you have to do is enter his ship and he'll take you back and forth!
Flight in Distress#093.speaker: Captain Ackbar

Flight in Distress#094.src: Oh, and you will also be rewarded kindly monetarily. I will also personally send him the ring, so that it doesn't get damaged on the way, and you will receive it there.
Flight in Distress#094.speaker: Captain Ackbar

Flight in Distress#095.src: Just head down to the entrance deck, and we are about to arrive at {p} Airbase now.
Flight in Distress#095.speaker: Captain Ackbar

Flight in Distress#097.src: Head down to the entrance deck, and get off.

Flight in Distress#098.src: Speak to Calo next to the little ship at the {p} docks.

Flight in Distress#099.src: Hey there. You must be the Human Ackbar told me about.
Flight in Distress#099.speaker: Calo

Flight in Distress#100.src: I heard what you did on the ship, very admirable. Fortunately for you, I owe Ackbar.
Flight in Distress#100.speaker: Calo

Flight in Distress#101.src: I'll take you from {p} to {p} or vice versa whenever you want.
Flight in Distress#101.speaker: Calo

Flight in Distress#102.src: All you have to do is board my ship. Oh, this was also from Ackbar.
Flight in Distress#102.speaker: Calo

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#001.src: Hey, hey, humie! Yeah, I'm talkin' to ya here..
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#001.speaker: Merchant

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#002.src: Y'see, I got a few things here... look around for a bit, they're all very rare...
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#002.speaker: Merchant

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#003.src: I see that look in yer eyes... Ya interested in something here? It's all 'fa sale...
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#003.speaker: Merchant

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#004.src: ..Say, humie... I ain't mean to alarm ya, but do ya know who that guy sneakin' up behind 'ye is?
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#004.speaker: Merchant

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#005.src: OI! Wake up, you damned miscreant!

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#006.src: Took ya long enough.. Alright, listen up, maggot!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#006.speaker: Prison Guard

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#007.src: We found ya outside of {p}, passed out near some dead body, and... Well, we had to arrest someone for that merchant's death!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#007.speaker: Prison Guard

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#008.src: So, welcome to the {p} Federal Prison. You're in here for the rest of your life, short-nose, so no use complaining about it.
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#008.speaker: Prison Guard

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#009.src: And don't think you get to just lounge around all day in your cell. You gotta do work here, or you're getting thrown in the hole.
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#009.speaker: Prison Guard

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#010.src: But for now, you’re stayin’ in your cell, understood? Now, stay here, and take a look around your cell. You'll know when it's time to work..
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#010.speaker: Prison Guard

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#012.src: GWAH! Who the hell are you?
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#012.speaker: Old Prisoner

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#013.src: Oh, thank grook, you're just another prisoner... So young, too...
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#013.speaker: Old Prisoner

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#014.src: You just got here, right? Well... I can tell you're innocent... Just like almost everyone else in this forsaken prison...
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#014.speaker: Old Prisoner

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#015.src: Listen, human... This prison... You couldn't have come to a more horrific prison in the entire world! This place is hellish!!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#015.speaker: Old Prisoner

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#016.src: The guards here, they're sadistic! They'll pluck random prisoners out of their cells, and nobody ever sees them again! They're trying to kill us all in here!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#016.speaker: Old Prisoner

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#017.src: I'm being serious, human! If you stay here, they'll kill you, too! You HAVE to escape this place, whatever it t-
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#017.speaker: Old Prisoner

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#018.src: Oi, filth! You're comin' with us. Get out of your cell, NOW!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#018.speaker: Prison Guard

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#019.src: Are you sure, uh, sir? I don't think I'm supposed to be anywhere today...
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#019.speaker: Old Prisoner

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#020.src: Oh, ya think you're smart, trying to resist?? Oi, Jon, block the entrance!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#020.speaker: Prison Guard

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#021.src: H-HEY! WHAT ARE YOU- GET OFF- AAAAAHH!! SOMEONE!! HELP ME!!! PLEASE!!!!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#021.speaker: Prisoner

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#022.src: OI! Quit starin’ off into space, maggot! Come over to your cell's bars.
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#022.speaker: Prison Guard

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#023.src: It’s work time, filth. I'll escort you to the hallways. Once you're there, someone will tell you what to do. Do as they say, and you might come back tonight.
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#023.speaker: Prison Guard

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#024.src: You got that, wretch? Alright, now get out of your cell!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#024.speaker: Prison Guard

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#025.src: Get your instructions from the guard

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#026.src: Guess you're the one on cleanin' duty, huh? Alright. Listen up, scum!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#026.speaker: Prison Guard

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#027.src: Take this sponge, and look around the hallways. If you see a mess, use the sponge to clean it up. Someone will escort you back to the cells once you're done.
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#027.speaker: Prison Guard

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#028.src: Got it? Alright. Now, get to work!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#028.speaker: Prison Guard

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#029.src: Search the hallways for messes to clean up

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#030.src: Report to the prison guard at [-{~}, {~}, {~}]

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#031.src: You're done cleaning? Alright, it's time for rollcall. You're being escorted back to the cell block. Follow me, and don't move.
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#031.speaker: Prison Guard

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#032.src: Well, well, well... Looks like the dross of society is here on time!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#032.speaker: The Warden

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#033.src: Alright. Stay in line, and don't move, maggots! It's time for roll call...
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#033.speaker: The Warden

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#035.src: You’re all here… Ha! That’s a surprise, you outcasts can actually follow orders!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#035.speaker: The Warden

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#036.src: ...Hm… Looks like we’ve got a new arrival too.. Don’t worry, peon... your soul will be well secure here for the rest of eternity.
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#036.speaker: The Warden

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#037.src: Alright. That’s it for now, you worthless menaces. It’s meal time. Head to the cafeteria, and pray that we’re not giving you your last meal.
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#037.speaker: The Warden

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#038.src: Find a place to sit in the cafeteria

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#039.src: Hi... Say, could you... do something for me...?
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#039.speaker: Starving Prisoner

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#040.src: I'm... starving to death here... those blasted guards won't... let me get any food...
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#040.speaker: Starving Prisoner

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#041.src: Please... to my right... There's some food sitting there, if you could get it for me, I'd be... eternally grateful...
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#041.speaker: Starving Prisoner

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#043.src: I... I can't thank you enough, human... I should be able to keep going with this...
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#043.speaker: Starving Prisoner

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#044.src: Say... if you ever get out of this slaughterhouse... could you go to {p}... and try and talk with my family, there? Let them know that I'm still alive...? I'd appreciate that....
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#044.speaker: Starving Prisoner

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#045.src: Hey.. It's alright, you can sit here, don't worry.
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#045.speaker: Prisoner

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#046.src: So... you're new here, right? Hah… Guessing you're innocent, just like the rest of us… and I mean that...
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#046.speaker: Prisoner

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#047.src: He's tellin' the truth, new guy. Most of us here are just average civilians. I worked at a transportation company in {p}, and was delivering some crates to {p} when they snatched me just out of town.
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#047.speaker: Prisoner

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#048.src: Me too! I don't even know why I was put here at all! I wasn't even given a trial in court, or anything! They just plucked me off the streets and threw me in here!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#048.speaker: Prisoner

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#049.src: They wanna kill you, that's why. Did ya hear about Revan? He got taken away a couple of days ago, after he accidentally stumbled during roll call. Nobody's heard or seen 'em since.
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#049.speaker: Prisoner

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#050.src: I… you're probably right... I just dont understand any of this anymore... I just want to escape this damn place for good...
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#050.speaker: Prisoner

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#051.src: ...Good luck with that.. Only way out is through that exit door, and even then you gotta get into the Control Room, as well. It's...just impossible, y'know?
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#051.speaker: Prisoner

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#052.src: Alright, meal time's over! Get to your cells, filth!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#052.speaker: Prison Guard

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#053.src: ...Well… That's this place in a nutshell for you, human. Just try not to get in anyone's way or step out of line, and you should be alright until they end up taking you.
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#053.speaker: Prisoner

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#054.src: Oi, who’s this guy right ‘ere? We don’t know ya. Move it!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#054.speaker: Mafia Prisoner

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#055.src: ‘Ey, ‘ey, let it rest, Don. They're not hurtin’ nobody.
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#055.speaker: Mafia Prisoner

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#057.src: Don’t worry about it. So... You know who we are, novello?
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#057.speaker: Mafia Prisoner

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#058.src: We’re part of the Placido Crime Family. We do business across the entire world; all parts of it, you know what I’m saying?
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#058.speaker: Mafia Prisoner

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#059.src: Almost all of us at this table got caught for running with the family-... Ah, bet you’re surprised to hear that there are some guilty people up in this slaughterhouse, yeah?
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#059.speaker: Mafia Prisoner

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#060.src: It’s alright, you don’t have to worry about us getting plucked and killed like those other piacevole here. Guards keep on sayin’ something about “our souls are too tainted”, whatever they mean.
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#060.speaker: Mafia Prisoner

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#061.src: Hah! Maybe you’ll get the same treatment too, novello. I saw it the minute I laid eyes on ya. You’re a killer too, ain't ya? Hey, gotta be one to know you're dealin' with one..
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#061.speaker: Mafia Prisoner

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#062.src: ..Anyways... You thinkin’ about staying in this prison, fratello? Word of advice: Don’t. If you can, you gotta escape. You might think it’s impossible for someone to escape here, or whatnot...
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#062.speaker: Mafia Prisoner

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#063.src: Alright, meal time’s over! Get to your cells, filth!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#063.speaker: Prison Guard

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#064.src: But no, you're different. I can see it in those eyes. You just gotta find a way into that Control Room, somehow. And hey, if you do get outta here, go and raise some hell in the Letvus Black Market for us, yeah?
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#064.speaker: Mafia Prisoner

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#066.src: Alright! Everyone, get up! Out of your cells, NOW! It's time for rollcall!

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#067.src: Alright, look straight, scum! Morning rollcall is about to start.
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#067.speaker: The Warden

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#069.src: ...you’re all here...? Hm... Disappointing, honestly. Rollcall is over. All of you, head to wherever your job is, and get to work!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#069.speaker: The Warden

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#070.src: Search the hallways for possible escape routes, and find a guard outfit

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#071.src: Report to the Prison Guard at [-{~}, {~}, {~}]

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#072.src: You're done? Alright, now follow me. Rollcall is about to start.
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#072.speaker: Prison Guard

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#073.src: What with you all, showing up late like this?? It's time for rollcall!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#073.speaker: The Warden

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#075.src: You're all here, huh? Alright then, head on to dinn-
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#075.speaker: The Warden

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#076.src: Oi! Quit steppin' on my shoes, cretino!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#076.speaker: Prisoner

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#077.src: Hey! What the hell are you talkin' about, making up something like that! I didn't do anythin'!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#077.speaker: Prisoner

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#078.src: Shut it, fat-nose! You know what you were doin'! Now stay out of my way!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#078.speaker: Prisoner

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#079.src: OI! Are you blind, or something?!? Get those lowlifes under control, guards!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#079.speaker: The Warden

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#080.src: You two got some damn nerve, fightin' during rollcall!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#080.speaker: Prison Guard

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#081.src: W-Woah, HEY! This maggot has a shank! Back up!!!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#081.speaker: Prison Guard

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#082.src: LOCKDOWN! LOCKDOWN! ALL OF YOU, IN YOUR CELLS, NOW!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#082.speaker: Prison Guard

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#083.src: You two really are stupid, huh? Fighting in the midst of all of these guards? And you got a shank, too...
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#083.speaker: The Warden

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#084.src: Well, looks like it's game over for you two outcasts. You're heading straight to the hole!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#084.speaker: The Warden

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#085.src: You, take these two cretins to the hole, and you, go to my office and get one of the spare control room keys. Now, LIGHTS OUT!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#085.speaker: The Warden

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#087.src: Alright! Everyone, get up! Out of your cells, NOW! It's time for rollcall!

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#088.src: Alright, everyone get in line, and stand straight! Don't move, or it's game over for you!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#088.speaker: The Warden

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#090.src: H-hey! Stop pushing me, mate! Seriou-
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#090.speaker: Prisoner

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#091.src: Well, well, well... Another peon thought it was wise to step off course..
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#091.speaker: The Warden

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#092.src: W-wait a minute, miss! Someone pushed me out of line! I swear!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#092.speaker: Prisoner

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#093.src: BE QUIET! I didn't say you could speak, filth!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#093.speaker: The Warden

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#094.src: Get back in line! Once this is over, you're out, slime!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#094.speaker: The Warden

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#095.src: Alright, now, the rest of you, get to work! Rollcall is over for you all!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#095.speaker: The Warden

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#096.src: Steal the key from the warden's office, and head to the control room

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#097.src: Find a way to open the exit door

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#098.src: Head through the exit door at [-{~}, {~}, {~}]

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#099.src: Sneak past the guards and find a way to the Records Room

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#101.src: Oh, thank the bovine! There's a friendly face around here..
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#101.speaker: Prisoner

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#102.src: Listen, human, you gotta get me out of here! They've been killin' people in here all day! If you don't help me out, I'll be next!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#102.speaker: Prisoner

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#103.src: Look, next to my cell, on that desk! There's a key! Grab it and hand it to me!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#103.speaker: Prisoner

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#104.src: Yes, perfect, PERFECT! That's the key, hand it to me!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#104.speaker: Prisoner

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#105.src: I can't explain the debt I owe you, human... You have no idea how grateful I am..
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#105.speaker: Prisoner

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#106.src: Say, what's your name, human? {u}? Alright, my name's Kaetan. Go on ahead and get out of here, I'll catch up. If you do get out of this chop-shop, meet me in {p}, I want to give you something there.
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#106.speaker: Prisoner

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#108.src: Huh...? Oh- HEY! The table caught on fire, someone get over 'ere and help me put it out!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#108.speaker: Prison Guard

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#109.src: Find and destroy your criminal records

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#111.src: Who are you? Can I help you, human?
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#111.speaker: Lexdale Citizen

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#112.src: WHAT?? Taron, he-he's alive?? And you... made sure he didn't starve in that prison...?
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#112.speaker: Lexdale Citizen

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#113.src: I... human, I can't thank you enough. Even if he doesn't get out of there, just knowing he's alive is... please, I know it's not a lot, but take this.
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#113.speaker: Lexdale Citizen

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#114.src: Good evening. Can I help you with anything?
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#114.speaker: Gelibord Citizen

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#115.src: M-my son? He's alive?!? Oh, sweet baby bovine, that's...! Where is he??
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#115.speaker: Gelibord Citizen

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#116.src: ...the prison, huh? Well... It's good to know that he'll be able to hold on a little longer... Thank you so much, human. Here, take this!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#116.speaker: Gelibord Citizen

From the Bottom#000.src: Find someone in {p} who wants to buy [{~} Troll Hair]. Nakoba is at {~}, {~}, -{~}

From the Bottom#001.src: Ah, hey there, human! I'm certain you've noticed the bazaar down here. It's a point of pride for the Dwarves- biggest marketplace of all the Dwarf cities!
From the Bottom#001.speaker: Nakoba

From the Bottom#002.src: Specialty items you can't find anywhere else- All sorts of strange, wonderful, unique things. I've been looking for a few sundry items myself here.
From the Bottom#002.speaker: Nakoba

From the Bottom#003.src: It's almost all barter, unlike the merchants above that deal in that shiny stuff. Which is...a little unfortunate for me, in a way.
From the Bottom#003.speaker: Nakoba

From the Bottom#004.src: You see, I'm a historian by trade, but what I'm really after now is some Troll Hair. See, I really like the sme- er. It's good and sturdy for binding books- wait a second!
From the Bottom#004.speaker: Nakoba

From the Bottom#005.src: YOU have some? Phenomenal! I can never get it myself- was never much of a fighter. Um, here! Let me trade you that, for...this!
From the Bottom#005.speaker: Nakoba

From the Bottom#006.src: A Decorative Bottlecap Set! These were hard to come by, but I've got two sets of them anyways. Check them out! You'll learn a lot. Thank you very much, by the way!
From the Bottom#006.speaker: Nakoba

From the Bottom#007.src: Find someone in {p} who wants to buy a [Decorative Bottlecap Collection]. Dobile is at {~}, {~}, -{~}

From the Bottom#008.src: Minerals for sale! Minerals for sale! Come get your rare metals! We've got Kanderstone, Wynnic Copper, genuine {p} Sandstone, real Voidstone from the {p}!
From the Bottom#008.speaker: Dobile

From the Bottom#009.src: Human, you there! If you're interested in smithing, you've found the right place! ...so long as you like drinking Dwarven drinks. I'm looking for bottlecap sets in exchange for these.
From the Bottom#009.speaker: Dobile

From the Bottom#010.src: What's that look for? Are you new here or something? Never seen a bottlecap collector before? Or is that just your face?
From the Bottom#010.speaker: Dobile

From the Bottom#011.src: Wh- That! That's! I! How did you! It...It's in pristine condition! There's not a single cap missing! There's not even any dents from the bottle openers!!!
From the Bottom#011.speaker: Dobile

From the Bottom#012.src: There's no way you got those in person! You can't possibly understand the significance of what you're holding!! I! NEED! THEM!
From the Bottom#012.speaker: Dobile

From the Bottom#013.src: Here! My rarest metal! Take them! Take them and give me those bottlecaps! I've got to complete my collection!! Give it! Give it! Give it give it give it give it NOW!
From the Bottom#013.speaker: Dobile

From the Bottom#014.src: ...er. Ahem. I got carried away there. But...those bottlecaps are from the very first Dogun Festival. It wasn't even held in Courag at the time these were made!
From the Bottom#014.speaker: Dobile

From the Bottom#015.src: I'd love to talk about them more, but I can't spend too long on the sale, or other customers might go away. But you got a good deal with that Jasplite I gave you!
From the Bottom#015.speaker: Dobile

From the Bottom#016.src: Come to think of it, some guy wanted that stuff, but he didn't even have a plain ol' sodapop cap on him! I think he's right close by. Maybe you'd have some interest in what you're selling instead.
From the Bottom#016.speaker: Dobile

From the Bottom#017.src: Find someone in {p} who wants to buy some [Molten Jasplite Ingots]. Dorroc is at {~}, {~}, -{~}

From the Bottom#018.src: Hm...a human trader? Well, I've heard of you, but I hope it isn't just the standard fare from you.
From the Bottom#018.speaker: Dorroc

From the Bottom#019.src: Yes, I've seen quite a few of your type to this bazaar- Using the community forges and smithing tables in all. You seem to have metals in bulk...
From the Bottom#019.speaker: Dorroc

From the Bottom#020.src: ...but probably ninety-eight out of a hundred of the metal ingots I've seen humans use have been trash quality! Worthless only for practice! I seek only the finest metals, you see.
From the Bottom#020.speaker: Dorroc

From the Bottom#021.src: ...so, of course, you have to prove me wrong by having MOLTEN JASPLITE?! Oh, you must have gotten that from Dobile. Wouldn't have taken you as a bottlecap collector!
From the Bottom#021.speaker: Dorroc

From the Bottom#022.src: I've been pestering him for a while about his stock. The metal of the Unseen Blade is very valuable, you see. It's fragile, yes...
From the Bottom#022.speaker: Dorroc

From the Bottom#023.src: ...but to wield it is to channel the power of Ockar the Unseen Blade himself! The wartime taskmaster who cowed a hundred demons with a mere dagger!
From the Bottom#023.speaker: Dorroc

From the Bottom#024.src: Sneaking behind the lines of the enemy, braving blistering heat! Remaining as a shadow, and cutting through sheer earth and magma without flinching!!
From the Bottom#024.speaker: Dorroc

From the Bottom#025.src: ...erm, yes. Anyways! For that, I can give you nothing less than my rarest stock. A Golemlus Power Core. If Qira found out I had this, I'd be worse off than a dead man.
From the Bottom#025.speaker: Dorroc

From the Bottom#026.src: She keeps the secrets of those creatures under lock and key- and it must be the ticket to unlocking that particular mystery. Treasure this, human! It is no mere Corkian battery.
From the Bottom#026.speaker: Dorroc

From the Bottom#027.src: Find someone in {p} who wants to buy a [Golemlus Power Cell]. Lodog is at {~}, {~}, -{~}

From the Bottom#028.src: Right chief, what can I do ya for? I got all kinds'a machines here. One of 'em's gotta catch your eye, y'hear?
From the Bottom#028.speaker: Lodog

From the Bottom#029.src: I jury-rigged this juicer! Put a lemon inside, give it some, heheh, juice, and you'll get yourself lemon juice in a jiff!
From the Bottom#029.speaker: Lodog

From the Bottom#030.src: Or how 'bout this coin-shooter? Turn the crank and this'll spit out any coin-sized object like nobody's business. Just, uh, don't aim it at any windows, unless you really hate that window.
From the Bottom#030.speaker: Lodog

From the Bottom#031.src: ...what? Oh, I see. You think you got somethin' that'll interest ME instead of the other way round. I gotcha. Well, lemme see it a sec.
From the Bottom#031.speaker: Lodog
