Heart of Llevigar#026.dst: 不過幸好你及時趕到——剛才有個冒牌貨跑來說他才是專家。很明顯他只是想騙走你的酬金……
Heart of Llevigar#026.speaker: Zenam

Heart of Llevigar#027.src: Though, I was panicking so much I probably would've believed him... Speaking of which, here's your cut of the pay, and something extra for the trouble.
Heart of Llevigar#027.dst: 不過話說回來，我當時慌成那樣，大概真的會信他……說到這個，這是你那份酬勞，還多給你一點當作補償。
Heart of Llevigar#027.speaker: Zenam

Heart of Llevigar#028.src: Here's to hoping that the system won't run into any more trouble in the future. I don't want to be faced with an impending cataclysm like that again...
Heart of Llevigar#028.dst: 希望這套系統以後別再出什麼問題了。我可不想再面對一次那種迫在眉睫的大災難……
Heart of Llevigar#028.speaker: Zenam

Heart of Llevigar#029.src: Aah, this is bad, where's the keys to my toolbox?! Zenam said it was important, I need to find them!
Heart of Llevigar#029.dst: 啊啊，糟了，我工具箱的鑰匙跑哪去了？！Zenam 說這件事很重要，我一定得找到！
Heart of Llevigar#029.speaker: Electromagic Expert

Heart of Llevigar#030.src: I still can't believe it, a human has done my job and taken my emeralds... Just because I lost my keys...
Heart of Llevigar#030.dst: 我到現在還是不敢相信，一個人類做了我的工作、拿走了我的綠寶石……就因為我把鑰匙弄丟了……
Heart of Llevigar#030.speaker: Electromagic Expert

Hollow Serenity#000.src: Something seems off in the abandoned manor at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

Hollow Serenity#005.src: Head to the forest village east of the manor at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] and ask its residents about a man named Garvan.

Hollow Serenity#006.src: Hello soldier! Welcome to this... hick village. I presume the neighbor's kid has been stealing apples again, hmm?
Hollow Serenity#006.speaker: Ann

Hollow Serenity#007.src: Oh, Ann... Your voice is so delicate, so soothing that- Ah, soldier! Are you here for something... or someone?
Hollow Serenity#007.speaker: Qunit

Hollow Serenity#011.src: We're the best couple in the entire forest! Nobody can match our love!
Hollow Serenity#011.speaker: Ann

Hollow Serenity#012.src: Do you have someone special to you like we are, human? A handsome little man? Or a pretty little woman? Or... neither? We won't judge.
Hollow Serenity#012.speaker: Qunit

Hollow Serenity#013.src: Absolutely we're married! Everyone finds it very hard to believe, but I don't blame them! It's a tough would... we... live in, yes!
Hollow Serenity#013.speaker: Ann

Hollow Serenity#014.src: Four years it has been, since we kissed under the starry sky amidst the blossoming fields near {p}. I can still see it in my dreams...
Hollow Serenity#014.speaker: Qunit

Hollow Serenity#015.src: Yeah, what Qunit said! We've been married for {~} years! And soon that number is gonna go up to infinity!
Hollow Serenity#015.speaker: Ann

Hollow Serenity#017.src: Oh! Sorry about Qunit, he doesn't like thinking about our... circumstances.
Hollow Serenity#017.speaker: Ann

Hollow Serenity#018.src: We're in heavy debt to the government. We can't afford to live anywhere else.
Hollow Serenity#018.speaker: Ann

Hollow Serenity#019.src: This forest is also safe from their prying eyes, which has inarguably caused certain... opinions to fester here...
Hollow Serenity#019.speaker: Ann

Hollow Serenity#020.src: Yeah, yeah! It doesn't matter why we're here, soldier! Haha! We're here, and we love each other! That's all that matters. Yes.
Hollow Serenity#020.speaker: Ann

Hollow Serenity#021.src: Yes, actually. There's something dark to the north. There are parasites in it. It's dangerous.
Hollow Serenity#021.speaker: Qunit

Hollow Serenity#022.src: O-oh! Don't worry about what Qunit's saying. He's been having this recurring dream of a big worm creature laying dark eggs inside of a weird cave. He won't let it go, either!
Hollow Serenity#022.speaker: Ann

Hollow Serenity#023.src: It's not a fantasy, Ann. I've told you this.
Hollow Serenity#023.speaker: Qunit

Hollow Serenity#024.src: Shh, honey... we'll talk about this later, not in front of the soldier... Who probably has much more important things to do, hah!
Hollow Serenity#024.speaker: Ann

Hollow Serenity#027.src: See? We're both on the same wavelength! Neither of us have met this person! We're... so in love, darling...
Hollow Serenity#027.speaker: Ann

Hollow Serenity#029.src: An outsider? Here? We don't get many of you people often...
Hollow Serenity#029.speaker: Aunoa

Hollow Serenity#031.src: The name's Aunoa. I'm a farmer. Not much else to say.
Hollow Serenity#031.speaker: Aunoa

Hollow Serenity#032.src: I've got a kid, but he doesn't live here. His mother took him away to live in {p} a while back. Don't have any other family.
Hollow Serenity#032.speaker: Aunoa

Hollow Serenity#033.src: This village is the only family I have.
Hollow Serenity#033.speaker: Aunoa

Hollow Serenity#034.src: It's my home. The people I know and trust live here. It's a dump, but it's still my damn home.
Hollow Serenity#034.speaker: Aunoa

Hollow Serenity#035.src: Wish I could leave, though. This forest is awful. The crops are in horrible condition. Government doesn't give a damn about us either.
Hollow Serenity#035.speaker: Aunoa

Hollow Serenity#036.src: Apparently the House of Talor has a massive crypt somewhere underneath its floors. Rich people used to be buried there.
Hollow Serenity#036.speaker: Aunoa

Hollow Serenity#037.src: There's probably some rare artifacts down there. Go take a look if you want, but everyone here has tried and failed to find it.
Hollow Serenity#037.speaker: Aunoa

Hollow Serenity#038.src: Yes, I do. But I probably can't stop you. Humans like you have a thing for invading privacy whenever you feel like it.
Hollow Serenity#038.speaker: Aunoa

Hollow Serenity#039.src: And I'm too weak to stop you. You've got all of that strong gear on you, and I barely know a lick of magic. We're not on equal footing.
Hollow Serenity#039.speaker: Aunoa

Hollow Serenity#040.src: So... don't go in, but I won't stop you if you do anyways.
Hollow Serenity#040.speaker: Aunoa

Hollow Serenity#041.src: No clue who that is. If someone like that lived here, then they're dead.
Hollow Serenity#041.speaker: Aunoa

Hollow Serenity#042.src: Ask someone else about him if you want; I don't really care about this Garvan guy you're looking for.
Hollow Serenity#042.speaker: Aunoa

Hollow Serenity#043.src: Hey, you! Got any money? If you give me {~} Liquified Emeralds, I'll give you a spot of dust from the underside of my floorboards!
Hollow Serenity#043.speaker: Bip

Hollow Serenity#046.src: I'm Bip! Yeah, Bip! The greatest guy to ever grace the entertainment industry!
Hollow Serenity#046.speaker: Bip

Hollow Serenity#047.src: Oh... I was... Man, I miss my glory days! I used to be a big time man, you know? I was living it up in {p}, but now I have to live in this dump!
Hollow Serenity#047.speaker: Bip

Hollow Serenity#048.src: Damn this world! I blame them for all of this! Everything has been nothing but trouble after trouble. Now everyone can't see how much of an honest guy I am!
Hollow Serenity#048.speaker: Bip

Hollow Serenity#049.src: B-BE QUIET! I don't like living here, so don't remind me!
Hollow Serenity#049.speaker: Bip

Hollow Serenity#050.src: I don't even truly have my own place! I've gotta live with some crony who owns the house I'm staying in right now.
Hollow Serenity#050.speaker: Bip

Hollow Serenity#051.src: One day, I'll get out of here, though! I'll be a big time man again, and I'll reclaim my status in society, just you wait!
Hollow Serenity#051.speaker: Bip

Hollow Serenity#052.src: Rumors? Do I look like a gossiper to you??
Hollow Serenity#052.speaker: Bip

Hollow Serenity#053.src: Well, human... I'm an honest entertainer, so don't worry. Good 'ole Bip will tell you a bit of something!
Hollow Serenity#053.speaker: Bip

Hollow Serenity#054.src: So, apparently there's a WITCH... living in LEXDALE! OOOOOO, spooky...
Hollow Serenity#054.speaker: Bip

Hollow Serenity#055.src: But the thing is, she's causing... the Decay... dun dun DUUUN!!! Uhh... I don't know, her house is decaying, or something.
Hollow Serenity#055.speaker: Bip

Hollow Serenity#056.src: So now, she's gonna die. The end! Didja like that story, human? Every relation to in-real life people was {~} intentional, 'cuz this is actually happening.
Hollow Serenity#056.speaker: Bip

Hollow Serenity#057.src: Oh yeah! That's the name of the guy who FIRED ME! DAMMIT!!!-
Hollow Serenity#057.speaker: Bip

Hollow Serenity#058.src: ...Oh, wait, no. Sorry human, I was thinking about Gavin. I don't know who this Garvan guy is! Ask someone else; I can't entertain you with that knowledge.
Hollow Serenity#058.speaker: Bip

Hollow Serenity#066.src: {p} apparently has something hidden inside of it.
Hollow Serenity#066.speaker: Runo

Hollow Serenity#067.src: The chains have something to do with it.
Hollow Serenity#067.speaker: Runo

Hollow Serenity#068.src: I dunno what else to say.
Hollow Serenity#068.speaker: Runo

Hollow Serenity#069.src: ...You know what? Neither do you! You've said, like, {~} sentences in the last {~} minutes!
Hollow Serenity#069.speaker: Runo

Hollow Serenity#070.src: I just don't like talking, sheesh! My voice gets way more tense if I don't keep my words short. And it hurts.
Hollow Serenity#070.speaker: Runo

Hollow Serenity#071.src: What, are you offended? Well, I am, too! You'd be mad if some random human walked into your village and egged you into damaging your vocal chords!
Hollow Serenity#071.speaker: Runo

Hollow Serenity#073.src: ...You poor soul. Go buy one. Unless you're one of those guys who owns those flying land bits.
Hollow Serenity#073.speaker: Runo

Hollow Serenity#075.src: He knows most of the things here.
Hollow Serenity#075.speaker: Runo

Hollow Serenity#076.src: Huh, weird. Whatcha doing all the way out here, human? We don't see a lot of your kind often.
Hollow Serenity#076.speaker: Vera

Hollow Serenity#078.src: My name's Vera. I'm a farmer, but you probably already guessed that. That's all this damn village is good for anyways.
Hollow Serenity#078.speaker: Vera

Hollow Serenity#079.src: I also deal with getting supplies from other towns! Pretty cool, huh?
Hollow Serenity#079.speaker: Vera

Hollow Serenity#080.src: Uhh... all my life, actually! Too damn poor to go anywhere else, so I've just hunkered down here and decided to stick it out until I'm dead.
Hollow Serenity#080.speaker: Vera

Hollow Serenity#081.src: It's bad, living out here, but once you get used to it some of the edge is taken off. This village is all I've really known, and I owe it to everyone here to stick around, you know what I mean?
Hollow Serenity#081.speaker: Vera

Hollow Serenity#082.src: Still... adventuring sounds like fun, sometimes... the furthest I've ever gone from here is halfway through {p} County.
Hollow Serenity#082.speaker: Vera

Hollow Serenity#083.src: I bet you have some pretty good stories to tell from adventuring, ain't that right human?
Hollow Serenity#083.speaker: Vera

Hollow Serenity#084.src: You know the massive prison near {p}? Yeah, the {p} Penitentiary.
Hollow Serenity#084.speaker: Vera

Hollow Serenity#085.src: So, apparently... the place is actually really corrupt. They arrest innocent people every other day, and they never come back out.
Hollow Serenity#085.speaker: Vera

Hollow Serenity#086.src: Gavel's government hasn't done anything about it, but everyone in the forest knows damn well something shady is going on there. I'd watch myself around that place if I were you!
Hollow Serenity#086.speaker: Vera

Hollow Serenity#088.src: Get to talking, human! You can't just leave off like that! Tell me, are the rumors about that place true?
Hollow Serenity#088.speaker: Vera

Hollow Serenity#091.src: Oh my word... and you saw it with your own eyes?
Hollow Serenity#091.speaker: Vera

Hollow Serenity#092.src: Human... thanks for letting me know. You gotta tell more people about this, though! You could probably publish a book about it once you spread the word! You'd be rich!
Hollow Serenity#092.speaker: Vera

Hollow Serenity#093.src: ...Well, I'm not gonna believe you if you're saying it all forced like that, you know.
Hollow Serenity#093.speaker: Vera

Hollow Serenity#094.src: I won't push it, though; it was probably just too awful to talk about, right? You don't have to go into detail if you don't wanna.
Hollow Serenity#094.speaker: Vera

Hollow Serenity#095.src: Just stay well away from that place, and make sure nobody else goes near there, alright?
Hollow Serenity#095.speaker: Vera

Hollow Serenity#096.src: Uh... no. That doesn't ring a single bell.
Hollow Serenity#096.speaker: Vera

Hollow Serenity#097.src: You could probably ask some other people, though! I'm only the youngest guy in the village, so the older people here would probably know who this Garvan guy is!
Hollow Serenity#097.speaker: Vera

Hollow Serenity#098.src: S-Sheesh! You scared me, human! Don't you know that you shouldn't walk into people's houses out of nowhere?
Hollow Serenity#098.speaker: Villager

Hollow Serenity#099.src: You know there are creepy guys out here who rob people like that? You should be more careful!
Hollow Serenity#099.speaker: Villager

Hollow Serenity#101.src: I'm nobody. No, I'm serious, I literally don't have a name. Parents just didn't bother to name me.
Hollow Serenity#101.speaker: Villager

Hollow Serenity#102.src: Apparently that's considered sacrilegious around here, so I was taken away from them and I now work for Pastor Arwes.
Hollow Serenity#102.speaker: Villager

Hollow Serenity#103.src: What do the others call me? Uhh... Big-nosed girl. Yeah, I know, a bit on the nose–
Hollow Serenity#103.speaker: Villager

Hollow Serenity#104.src: ...That sailed right over my head. But it's true, though! I have the biggest nose in the village.
Hollow Serenity#104.speaker: Villager

Hollow Serenity#105.src: What should you call me? Hm... I don't know... maybe... Eua?
Hollow Serenity#105.speaker: Villager

Hollow Serenity#106.src: I know it won't matter anymore, but sure. Call me Eua. That sounds like a nice name.
Hollow Serenity#106.speaker: Villager

Hollow Serenity#107.src: This one's not necessarily a rumor, but... have you ever heard of someone that they call the Wanderer?
Hollow Serenity#107.speaker: Villager

Hollow Serenity#108.src: He's a weird guy who just... wanders. He's completely despondent, and doesn't really interact with anyone. Even a lot of the dangerous creatures around here just tend to ignore his presence. He's almost like... a ghost.
Hollow Serenity#108.speaker: Villager

Hollow Serenity#109.src: You've probably seen him before in the forest. Hooded guy, doesn't talk at all? That's who they call the Wanderer.
Hollow Serenity#109.speaker: Villager

Hollow Serenity#110.src: Well, he doesn't really hurt anyone, so I don't really worry about him too much, but still... it's spooky...
Hollow Serenity#110.speaker: Villager

Hollow Serenity#111.src: Wait, THAT manor? Nah. No one goes near there anymore, not since it was abandoned. What, do you not know what happened there?
Hollow Serenity#111.speaker: Villager

Hollow Serenity#112.src: It used to be owned by a family of nobles called the Faltachs. Big, important people in the forest, very rich.
Hollow Serenity#112.speaker: Villager

Hollow Serenity#113.src: Well... a lot of stuff happened with them. The mistress of the family supposedly went insane and killed her husband at some point, or something like that...
Hollow Serenity#113.speaker: Villager

Hollow Serenity#114.src: There's a lot to unpack there, human. And you honestly shouldn't unpack it.
Hollow Serenity#114.speaker: Villager

Hollow Serenity#115.src: Hmm... No, can't say I have. Whoever this person is, they certainly don't live here.
Hollow Serenity#115.speaker: Villager

Hollow Serenity#116.src: And nah, it's not me, either, even if I don't have a real name. I wouldn't even be here if my parents had named me something manly like Garvan anyways.
Hollow Serenity#116.speaker: Villager

Hollow Serenity#117.src: Ask around, though! I'm sure others probably know him.
Hollow Serenity#117.speaker: Villager

Hollow Serenity#118.src: You're new... we don't see a lot of youngsters around these days... especially humans.
Hollow Serenity#118.speaker: Old Man

Hollow Serenity#120.src: Very on the nose, whippersnapper. My name is Lokno. I'm what's left of this town during its olden days...
Hollow Serenity#120.speaker: Old Man

Hollow Serenity#121.src: Mhm. This village... has definitely seen better days. This Decay stuff has ruined us, just take a look around! Nothing here has been suitable for living for over {~} years...
Hollow Serenity#121.speaker: Old Man

Hollow Serenity#122.src: Hah... well, right now, it's a crowd of shacks, but before the Decay came along, we used to do great...
Hollow Serenity#122.speaker: Old Man

Hollow Serenity#123.src: We always had enough food to go around, we could sell off what we didn't need to eat, and everything was thriving.
Hollow Serenity#123.speaker: Old Man

Hollow Serenity#124.src: My great-grandmother, Aki, always told me stories about this place. Our little village. I wish I could have been around to live in it then.
Hollow Serenity#124.speaker: Old Man

Hollow Serenity#125.src: She was always convinced though... that if the rightful rulers of Gavel returned, all of these issues could easily be squashed.
Hollow Serenity#125.speaker: Old Man

Hollow Serenity#126.src: To be honest... I believe the same. The government has abandoned us. So... why not bring back the old one?
Hollow Serenity#126.speaker: Old Man

Hollow Serenity#127.src: I may not be the most religious villager around here, but it would feel more right to be ruled by someone who has the heavens' approval.
Hollow Serenity#127.speaker: Old Man

Hollow Serenity#128.src: Nope. I don't deal with that kind of stuff, bahaha! Sorry human; you're out of luck.
Hollow Serenity#128.speaker: Old Man

Hollow Serenity#129.src: G... Garvan... yes. I know that name.
Hollow Serenity#129.speaker: Old Man

Hollow Serenity#130.src: He isn't here, though. I don't know his whereabouts, what he's doing, or if he's even alive. He's... just nonexistant.
Hollow Serenity#130.speaker: Old Man

Hollow Serenity#131.src: I don't know why you're chasing after him, but... if you want a place to start, look at the abandoned laboratory on top of that hill, just west to the of here.
Hollow Serenity#131.speaker: Old Man

Hollow Serenity#132.src: Fair warning, though... My great-grandmother is the only reason I know about him, and even then... she was always put off by him, and told me to stay away from him. I'd be wary, if I were you.
Hollow Serenity#132.speaker: Old Man

Hollow Serenity#133.src: Or don't. He sounds like a nice man. You're strong, as well. I'm sure you'll be fine.
Hollow Serenity#133.speaker: Old Man

Hollow Serenity#134.src: Investigate the contents of the abandoned laboratory at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

Hollow Serenity#136.src: Return to the Faltach Manor and find the entrance to the secret study at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Hollow Serenity#137.src: Uncover the secrets of the study.

Hollow Serenity#138.src: Investigate the unlocked room in the study.

Hollow Serenity#140.src: Dammit, Katarin! I'm not dealing with that loonie anymore! It's been years since I hired that scientist, and he STILL has nothing! If he doesn't find a cure soon, then I'll just get rid of him!
Hollow Serenity#140.speaker: Yorman

Hollow Serenity#141.src: Y-Yorman, you can't be serious! What we're asking him to do is heavily unresearched, firing him for taking time on that wouldn't be a good idea!
Hollow Serenity#141.speaker: Katarin

Hollow Serenity#142.src: Woman, have you SEEN the state that cretin is in?? Even if it does take long, he's in no damn shape to deal with it! Now, stop arguing with me, and help me get rid of him-
Hollow Serenity#142.speaker: Yorman

Hollow Serenity#144.src: This is too far, Yorman! Garvan MUST stay! You will do this if you still love me!
Hollow Serenity#144.speaker: Katarin

Hollow Serenity#145.src: ...Why do you even care so much?? Some lunatic scientist like him isn't good for anybody! We both know that we'd save more time and money by letting him run off!
Hollow Serenity#145.speaker: Yorman

Hollow Serenity#146.src: I still have faith in him, unlike you! I'll talk to him to see what's going on if I must, but I will NOT tolerate you throwing him out simply because you're too eager for results!
Hollow Serenity#146.speaker: Katarin

Hollow Serenity#147.src: Fine. But know this; I will see it to MYSELF that his head is taken off of his shoulders if that man continues to waste my time, understand??
Hollow Serenity#147.speaker: Yorman

Hollow Serenity#148.src: ...I'm leaving to take care of some matters in {p}. Ask one of the maids to make sure that Eileen goes to bed. I'll be back before midnight.
Hollow Serenity#148.speaker: Yorman

Hollow Serenity#149.src: ...That... was close... I can't have him getting between us anymore.
Hollow Serenity#149.speaker: Katarin

Hollow Serenity#150.src: I-I am here, Katarin. You wished to s- speak with me...?
Hollow Serenity#150.speaker: Garvan

Hollow Serenity#151.src: Yes, love. Yorman is becoming suspicious of you. He thinks you're not making any progress on the cure and wasting his time. Any more of this, and he may attempt to get rid of you.
Hollow Serenity#151.speaker: Katarin

Hollow Serenity#152.src: I just wanted to check on you, love. Are... you doing alright? Is your work coming along well?
Hollow Serenity#152.speaker: Katarin

Hollow Serenity#165.src: F-Fine. I am fine. I appreciate the concern, but... It truly is u-unwarranted. I'm q-quite close to finding a cure to the disease, y-yes.
Hollow Serenity#165.speaker: Garvan

Hollow Serenity#166.src: Ah! That is good to hear. Now then... How are things? We haven't had many chances to catch up recently.
Hollow Serenity#166.speaker: Katarin

Hollow Serenity#167.src: ...Wonderful. I've met... many peers. Recently. They give me the strength I need to advance my progress. Now... how is our daughter, Eileen?
Hollow Serenity#167.speaker: Garvan

Hollow Serenity#168.src: She's doing great. She takes a lot after you, actually. Intelligent, beautiful, an inquisitive mind. I just hope this Decay can be dealt with and we don't need to live in fear any longer.
Hollow Serenity#168.speaker: Katarin

Hollow Serenity#169.src: Wonderful. And... is our eternal bond safe? The gemstone? Has... Yorman found out about it?
Hollow Serenity#169.speaker: Garvan

Hollow Serenity#170.src: Yes, it has stayed hidden. As long as it's kept intact, our souls will stay bound to it. You just need to take care of your little project and we'll ride into the sunset, just like you said, mhm?
Hollow Serenity#170.speaker: Katarin

Hollow Serenity#172.src: We... I will not risk her life for our love. She has a future in {p}, Garvan! She isn't a part of this, and I don't think she-
Hollow Serenity#172.speaker: Katarin

Hollow Serenity#173.src: Eileen... She is a shining star in this world. Her noble blood and natural talent makes her something truly special.
Hollow Serenity#173.speaker: Garvan

Hollow Serenity#174.src: Do you realize, Katarin? Our daughter is a gift from the heavens! Once she has matured, she will accomplish things that Gavel has never seen! Bring back the holy and royal that was lost-
Hollow Serenity#174.speaker: Garvan

Hollow Serenity#175.src: ...Forgive me, I-I'm rambling once more. I... must leave now, research calls. Goodbye, my love. Great things will happen, sooner or later.
Hollow Serenity#175.speaker: Garvan

Hollow Serenity#177.src: Make your way to Garvan's old research outpost at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Hollow Serenity#178.src: Gather as much pieces of evidence as you can in the research outpost.

Hollow Serenity#180.src: Ah... N-now you're finally here. I... need you, my darling. We- no... I can cure this Decay with you.
Hollow Serenity#180.speaker: Garvan

Hollow Serenity#181.src: W-What do you mean...? I-I don't like this... I-I w-wanna go home. It's getting late and mother-
Hollow Serenity#181.speaker: Eileen

Hollow Serenity#182.src: Ssshhh... This will only take a moment.
Hollow Serenity#182.speaker: Garvan

Hollow Serenity#183.src: W-What is that thing?? M-Mister Garvan, I-I don't understand...
Hollow Serenity#183.speaker: Eileen

Hollow Serenity#184.src: Hush, my daughter. I-I'm doing this for your s-sake... You'll t-thank me later, once it... g-grows acclimated to you.
Hollow Serenity#184.speaker: Garvan

Hollow Serenity#186.src: Hello, my love. I-It's... been a while.
Hollow Serenity#186.speaker: Garvan

Hollow Serenity#187.src: You... G-Garvan... Why are you here? And what's happened to Eileen? She has been sick for days!
Hollow Serenity#187.speaker: Katarin

Hollow Serenity#188.src: Mmmm... I... Ha-a-have a bit of a... how should I phrase this... a confession to make.
Hollow Serenity#188.speaker: Garvan

Hollow Serenity#189.src: W-Well... I-I've done... I've...done Eileen a great service... she will live forever, just like we do. Thanks to what I have done.
Hollow Serenity#189.speaker: Garvan

Hollow Serenity#190.src: Y-you... Bound her soul?? Garvan, no, I told you she wasn't part of this!! WHY??
Hollow Serenity#190.speaker: Katarin

Hollow Serenity#191.src: No, no no no no. I've done much b-b-better. She has something now. In her brain... Don't worry about the s-sorry state she's in now. The parasite will need time to acclimate to her flesh.
Hollow Serenity#191.speaker: Garvan

Hollow Serenity#192.src: I-I realized... a cure. My work is done, love... Eileen will be cured. The Decay can be s-stopped. It's wonderful-
Hollow Serenity#192.speaker: Garvan

Hollow Serenity#193.src: WHAT DID YOU DO TO MY DAUGHTER?? WHAT IS WRONG WITH YOU??
Hollow Serenity#193.speaker: Katarin

Hollow Serenity#194.src: Aaaahhhmmmm... True... I might have stepped out of line. But it's for the best.
Hollow Serenity#194.speaker: Garvan

Hollow Serenity#195.src: OUT OF LINE?? This is too far, Garvan! What even happened to you?? You've been acting like this for so, so long! I-I can't take it anymore!
Hollow Serenity#195.speaker: Katarin

Hollow Serenity#196.src: You've changed, Garvan! I-I can't even recognize you anymore!! I'm... I'm DONE! GET OUT! STAY AWAY FROM MY FAMILY!
Hollow Serenity#196.speaker: Katarin

Hollow Serenity#197.src: You again... W-What do you want from me this time...? You've... already ruined me.
Hollow Serenity#197.speaker: Garvan

Hollow Serenity#198.src: It doesn't matter. You've accomplished what we've planned for, and that is perfect. The girl will grow into a suitale leader... Now then, we have some questions for you.
Hollow Serenity#198.speaker: Mysterious Leader

Hollow Serenity#199.src: Tell me Garvan... Where is the heir?
Hollow Serenity#199.speaker: Mysterious Leader

Hollow Serenity#200.src: I... will not tell you. I have lost Eileen and my love thanks to you. If I am to lose her... then you shall lose her as well.
Hollow Serenity#200.speaker: Garvan

Hollow Serenity#201.src: ...Lunatic. You; take him in. Keep him alive.
Hollow Serenity#201.speaker: Mysterious Leader

Hollow Serenity#203.src: Garvan. Garvan, Garvan. I think there's a misunderstanding here. You are in no place to defy us.
Hollow Serenity#203.speaker: Mysterious Leader

Hollow Serenity#204.src: Now then... You will tell us where the rightful heir to the throne is... No matter the cost.
Hollow Serenity#204.speaker: Mysterious Leader

Hollow Serenity#205.src: Return to the Manor and search for any clues as to Eileen's whereabouts at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Hollow Serenity#206.src: It seems you've arrived. F-Forgive me... I-I'm not quite used to talking anymore. It's been quite a while.

Hollow Serenity#207.src: ...Nevermind. I d-don't want your forgiveness in particular. In fact, w-why do you even care? The forest has died, generations have lived on... and yet... You just had to tear the scar open, didn't you?

Hollow Serenity#208.src: My sins... You do not need to see them... all the things I've done wrong. H-How I destroyed the bonds tying me and my love together.

Hollow Serenity#209.src: ...Y-Yes... I mean her. Katarin. She's watching us as we speak, no? A-and with that, I suppose it's obvious what lies under this veil.

Hollow Serenity#210.src: Greetings... I-I'm s-sure you're well acquainted with me, by now. I-It was me all along. Quite the- well, it was a predictable twist, I suppose...
Hollow Serenity#210.speaker: Garvan

Hollow Serenity#211.src: ...B-But... I take it you don't have the full story. So... so so so so so so... Let me explain to you, human... The bitter end to our shared tale.
Hollow Serenity#211.speaker: Garvan

Hollow Serenity#212.src: AAAAAAAGGGHHH!!!! F-FINE! I-I'll tell you... I-I'll tell y-you where Eileen is...
Hollow Serenity#212.speaker: Garvan

Hollow Serenity#213.src: S-She... is with her mother. At the Faltach Manor. T-That is all. Just s-stop...
Hollow Serenity#213.speaker: Garvan

Hollow Serenity#214.src: ...Good. This had better not be a lie. You; tell the others that we are heading there now. Kill everyone at the manor and any witnesses; leave the heir alive.
Hollow Serenity#214.speaker: Mysterious Leader

Hollow Serenity#216.src: N-NO! GET BACK HERE! DON'T YOU DARE HARM THEM! I'LL KILL YOU!! DO YOU HEAR ME???
Hollow Serenity#216.speaker: Garvan

Hollow Serenity#217.src: ...M-Mother... why d-do I have to stay here?
Hollow Serenity#217.speaker: Eileen

Hollow Serenity#218.src: It's for your own good dear. Now, remember to stay put. Garvan won't be able to use you if you're kept inside of here...
Hollow Serenity#218.speaker: Katarin

Hollow Serenity#220.src: Yorman won't be bothering us anymore, sweetheart. He wouldn't understand, so... J- just don't worry about what happened to him. It's irrelevant-
Hollow Serenity#220.speaker: Katarin

Hollow Serenity#221.src: L-LADY KATARIN! T-THERE ARE INTRUDERS- AAAAAAHHHHHH!!!
Hollow Serenity#221.speaker: Servant

Hollow Serenity#223.src: Step aside, Katarin Faltach. This will be much simpler if you just stand down and tell us where your daughter is.
Hollow Serenity#223.speaker: Mysterious Leader

Hollow Serenity#224.src: ...Come again? No. YOU WON'T TOUCH HER! GET OUT OF MY SIGHT-
Hollow Serenity#224.speaker: Katarin

Hollow Serenity#225.src: You're not the one making demands here... You all, search the house and find the child.
Hollow Serenity#225.speaker: Mysterious Leader

Hollow Serenity#226.src: There she is. Hmm... it seems that the parasite injection worked well. Garvan wasn't so useless after all.
Hollow Serenity#226.speaker: Mysterious Leader

Hollow Serenity#227.src: Oh? Too terrified to speak? Worry not, Eileen Faltach. You won't be harmed... too much. You're quite important to us, you see.
Hollow Serenity#227.speaker: Mysterious Leader

Hollow Serenity#228.src: N-NO! STAY AWAY FROM MY DAUGHTER!
Hollow Serenity#228.speaker: Katarin

Hollow Serenity#229.src: You have little choice in the matter, Miss Faltach. Stand your ground.
Hollow Serenity#229.speaker: Mysterious Leader

Hollow Serenity#230.src: GET AWAY FROM HER, DO YOU HEAR ME??? RAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAGGGGGGGGHHHHHH!!!!
Hollow Serenity#230.speaker: Katarin

Hollow Serenity#231.src: Tch... Some people will never understand what we do for the world. Thank you for protecting us from her, Aki.
Hollow Serenity#231.speaker: Mysterious Leader

Hollow Serenity#232.src: I will deal with the heir myself. You all can head back to our village. Thank you for your help today.
Hollow Serenity#232.speaker: Mysterious Leader

Hollow Serenity#233.src: ...I should have known. I-I... my love... y-you're gone.
Hollow Serenity#233.speaker: Garvan

Hollow Serenity#234.src: DAMN IT! DAMN IT DAMN IT DAMN IT AAAAALLLL!!!!
Hollow Serenity#234.speaker: Garvan

Hollow Serenity#235.src: This is... W-why did this have to happen? ...I-I can't... this can't end like this...
Hollow Serenity#235.speaker: Garvan

Hollow Serenity#236.src: T-This will be enough. You have a wonderful grave, m-my love...
Hollow Serenity#236.speaker: Garvan

Hollow Serenity#237.src: W-We won't be separated, though. I-I will leave our true selves here, as well.
Hollow Serenity#237.speaker: Garvan

Hollow Serenity#239.src: T-This is our final act of love, K-Katarin... This stone will keep us here. Eternal, and in bliss.
Hollow Serenity#239.speaker: Garvan

Hollow Serenity#240.src: I-It's like nothing ever h-happened, right?
Hollow Serenity#240.speaker: Garvan

Hollow Serenity#242.src: N-Now you understand. T-this is... all my fault. I have ruined everything. E-everything I touched, I destroyed.
Hollow Serenity#242.speaker: Garvan

Hollow Serenity#243.src: Have I not repented enough? Have I not suffered enough for decades in this god-forsaken forest?? And why did you have to-
Hollow Serenity#243.speaker: Garvan

Hollow Serenity#244.src: No... You know too much. B-But I can't kill, not again. I-I can make things right. I-I'm going to fix this. I'm going to fix this. I'm going to I'm going to I'm going to I'm going to I'm going to...
Hollow Serenity#244.speaker: Garvan

Hollow Serenity#245.src: I'm going to I'm going to I'm going to I'm going to I'm going to I'm going to I'm going to I'm going to I'm going to I'm going to I'm going to I'm going to I'm going to I'm going to I'm going to I'm going to I'm going to I'm going to-
Hollow Serenity#245.speaker: Garvan

Hollow Serenity#247.src: Get to the Master Bedroom at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Hollow Serenity#248.src: K-Katarin! My l-love... is that you?
Hollow Serenity#248.speaker: Garvan

Hollow Serenity#249.src: My word... I-It is you! I missed you, love... and I'm s-so sorry... for all of this!
Hollow Serenity#249.speaker: Garvan

Hollow Serenity#250.src: I realize n-now, thanks to this h-human's efforts. What I've done has t-torn us apart... I hurt you and our l-little girl so much...
Hollow Serenity#250.speaker: Garvan

Hollow Serenity#251.src: I-I'm so sorry, Katarin! P-Please, forgive me! Let us f-fix all of thi-
Hollow Serenity#251.speaker: Garvan

Hollow Serenity#255.src: What... What do you mean?? Speak, my love! I don't understand.
Hollow Serenity#255.speaker: Garvan

Hollow Serenity#256.src: ...Forgiveness...? You... beg for me... to forgive... you?
Hollow Serenity#256.speaker: Katarin

Hollow Serenity#257.src: I... Yes, yes! P-Please, my love! I-I know I've have spent the last century and a half running away from u-us, but...
Hollow Serenity#257.speaker: Garvan

Hollow Serenity#258.src: It was all my fault, from the beginning! I was wrong! W-We can fix this...! We can make everything go back to normal, j-just like it was before!
Hollow Serenity#258.speaker: Garvan

Hollow Serenity#259.src: Please, Katarin! A-all I ask is that you forgive me!
Hollow Serenity#259.speaker: Garvan

Hollow Serenity#260.src: ...You... You must really have a deathwish-
Hollow Serenity#260.speaker: Katarin

Hollow Serenity#261.src: ...Maybe I can... Forgive this. But I need something from you, as well...
Hollow Serenity#261.speaker: Katarin

Hollow Serenity#262.src: ...Where is the gemstone? I'd... I'd like to know. And then... I could... forgive... this.
Hollow Serenity#262.speaker: Katarin

Hollow Serenity#263.src: O-Oh! Is that all? Of course, my love, I can tell you!
Hollow Serenity#263.speaker: Garvan

Hollow Serenity#264.src: I-I placed it in the catacombs, right next to where-
Hollow Serenity#264.speaker: Garvan

Hollow Serenity#265.src: W-What... W-WHAT I-IS THISS?? I-I C-CAN'T B-BREATHE! P-PLEASE!!
Hollow Serenity#265.speaker: Garvan

Hollow Serenity#266.src: NO!! NO, NO NO NO NO. HUMAN, H-HELP ME!! KATARIN... K-KATARIIIIINNNNN!!!!
Hollow Serenity#266.speaker: Garvan

Hollow Serenity#270.src: Head to the Manor's catacombs at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Hollow Serenity#272.src: TELL ME WHERE IT IS, GARVAN! I KNOW YOU'RE STILL LISTENING!
Hollow Serenity#272.speaker: Katarin

Hollow Serenity#273.src: You knew where it was- Hmm... what did Garvan call you things...?
Hollow Serenity#273.speaker: Katarin

Hollow Serenity#274.src: Right, a human. You knew... that it was just beneath this rubble?
Hollow Serenity#274.speaker: Katarin

Hollow Serenity#275.src: There it is... Thank you... Now this eternal hell will finally end. After so long...
Hollow Serenity#275.speaker: Katarin

Hollow Serenity#276.src: Do you hear that? It's the ocean waves... The heavens... They're calling for me-
Hollow Serenity#276.speaker: Katarin

Hollow Serenity#280.src: He's gone... All of this will finally be done...
Hollow Serenity#280.speaker: Katarin

Hollow Serenity#281.src: Thank you, stranger. Thank you for... everything.
Hollow Serenity#281.speaker: Katarin

Hollow Serenity#282.src: Now I'm... finally free. But... I suppose I still have unfinished business. Before I leave, I must know something.
Hollow Serenity#282.speaker: Katarin

Hollow Serenity#283.src: ...What has become of my daughter, Eileen? Has she suffered any more? Or did she escape?
Hollow Serenity#283.speaker: Katarin

Hollow Serenity#284.src: I must know. Is she okay?
Hollow Serenity#284.speaker: Katarin

Hollow Serenity#285.src: ...I see. That is... wonderful news. Thank you, human.
Hollow Serenity#285.speaker: Katarin

Hollow Serenity#287.src: ...The pain is receding... The heavens are calling... for the final time...
Hollow Serenity#287.speaker: Katarin

Hollow Serenity#288.src: Goodbye... Thank you human, from the bottom of my heart.
Hollow Serenity#288.speaker: Katarin

Hollow Serenity#292.src: NO NO NO NO NO NO NO NOOOOO!!!!!!
Hollow Serenity#292.speaker: Katarin

Hollow Serenity#293.src: TRAITOR!! I WILL MAKE YOU ALL SUFFFEEERRRR!!! (In High Gavellian)
Hollow Serenity#293.speaker: Katarin

Hollow Serenity#294.src: Bury Garvan's body in Katarin's incomplete grave.

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#000.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#001.speaker: Cikal

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#002.speaker: Cikal

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#003.speaker: Cikal

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#004.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#004.speaker: Cikal

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#005.speaker: Cikal

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#006.speaker: Cikal

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#009.speaker: Cikal

Ice Nations#000.src: Talk to Adigard on the {p} at [{~}, {~}, -{~}]
Ice Nations#000.dst: 前往 {p} 與 Adigard 對話，座標 [{~1}, {~2}, -{~3}]

Ice Nations#001.src: Welcome traveler, to our humble island...
Ice Nations#001.dst: 歡迎你，旅人，來到我們這座簡陋的小島……
Ice Nations#001.speaker: Adigard

Ice Nations#002.src: My people and I landed here many years ago. Unfortunately, our ship didn't make it...
Ice Nations#002.dst: 我和我的族人很多年前漂到這裡。可惜的是，我們的船沒能撐過來……
Ice Nations#002.speaker: Adigard

Ice Nations#003.src: We tried to build a nation on these islands but became divided through the years.
Ice Nations#003.dst: 我們本來想在這幾座島上建立一個國家，卻在這些年裡分裂了。
Ice Nations#003.speaker: Adigard

Ice Nations#004.src: Because of this, we are fighting a useless war with our neighbours.
Ice Nations#004.dst: 也因為這樣，我們正跟鄰居打著一場毫無意義的戰爭。
Ice Nations#004.speaker: Adigard

Ice Nations#005.src: I believe we should try to pass a peace treaty, but I am afraid of getting killed if I leave the island...
Ice Nations#005.dst: 我認為我們應該試著簽下和平條約，可是我怕自己一離開這座島就會被殺……
Ice Nations#005.speaker: Adigard

Ice Nations#006.src: Would you mind helping us? Talk to Hallfred about this treaty. He lives on another ice island nearby.
Ice Nations#006.dst: 你願意幫我們嗎？去找 Hallfred 談這份條約。他住在附近另一座冰島上。
Ice Nations#006.speaker: Adigard

Ice Nations#007.src: Talk to Hallfred about the peace treaty
Ice Nations#007.dst: 找 Hallfred 談和平條約

Ice Nations#008.src: Welcome traveler! What brings you to our island?
Ice Nations#008.dst: 歡迎你，旅人！什麼風把你吹到我們島上？
Ice Nations#008.speaker: Hallfred

Ice Nations#009.src: Oh, I see that Adigard now sends strangers through his cowardice! Worried he'll get killed?
Ice Nations#009.dst: 哦，我懂了，Adigard 現在懦弱到要派陌生人來了！怕自己被殺是吧？
Ice Nations#009.speaker: Hallfred

Ice Nations#010.src: This is the last time I'll repeat it: We will sign the peace treaty the day Adigard and his nation will return to us... the treasure.
Ice Nations#010.dst: 這是我最後一次重複：等 Adigard 和他那群人把那批財寶還給我們，那天我們就簽和平條約。
Ice Nations#010.speaker: Hallfred

Ice Nations#011.src: The one that they kept and hid from us after the shipwreck.
Ice Nations#011.dst: 就是船難之後他們私吞、藏起來不給我們的那批。
Ice Nations#011.speaker: Hallfred

Ice Nations#012.src: Pure gold, very valuable and rare! Tell him I'll be waiting for it. And none of that silly story again.
Ice Nations#012.dst: 純金的，非常值錢又稀有！告訴他我等著。別再拿那套蠢故事來搪塞了。
Ice Nations#012.speaker: Hallfred

Ice Nations#013.src: Talk back to Adigard about Hallfred's response
Ice Nations#013.dst: 回去把 Hallfred 的答覆告訴 Adigard

Ice Nations#014.src: I should have expected that. Hallfred was always very greedy...
Ice Nations#014.dst: 我早該料到的。Hallfred 從來就很貪心……
Ice Nations#014.speaker: Adigard

Ice Nations#015.src: We tried to make him understand that we do not have the treasure, without much success.
Ice Nations#015.dst: 我們試著讓他明白我們手上根本沒有那批財寶，可惜沒什麼用。
Ice Nations#015.speaker: Adigard

Ice Nations#016.src: ... You see, the reason why we became shipwrecked wasn't natural cause. We were attacked...
Ice Nations#016.dst: ……你看，我們會遇上船難其實不是天災。我們是被襲擊的……
Ice Nations#016.speaker: Adigard

Ice Nations#017.src: By whom? The undead. Ghosts and demons navigating a monstrous ship. They got us by surprise.
Ice Nations#017.dst: 被誰？亡靈。駕著一艘怪物般巨船的幽魂與惡魔。他們打了我們一個措手不及。
Ice Nations#017.speaker: Adigard

Ice Nations#018.src: I believe they also stole our treasure during the attack.
Ice Nations#018.dst: 我相信那批財寶也是在那次襲擊中被他們奪走的。
Ice Nations#018.speaker: Adigard

Ice Nations#019.src: Would you help our nation come back together? Find this ship, and bring the treasure back to Hallfred so we can finally live in peace.
Ice Nations#019.dst: 你願意幫我們這個民族重新合為一體嗎？找到那艘船，把財寶帶回來給 Hallfred，我們才能真正過上太平日子。
Ice Nations#019.speaker: Adigard

Ice Nations#020.src: Sail north. That is where they attacked us many years ago. It should be easy to find, I'm sure they are anchored there in glory... Thank you.
Ice Nations#020.dst: 往北航行。多年前他們就是在那裡襲擊我們的。應該不難找，我想他們正洋洋得意地停泊在那兒……謝謝你。
Ice Nations#020.speaker: Adigard

Ice Nations#021.src: Find the ghost ship and bring back [Ancient Treasure] to Hallfred
Ice Nations#021.dst: 找到幽靈船，把 [Ancient Treasure] 帶回給 Hallfred

Ice Nations#022.src: Incredible! He actually delivered the treasure!
Ice Nations#022.dst: 難以置信！他居然真的把財寶交出來了！
Ice Nations#022.speaker: Hallfred

Ice Nations#023.src: I suppose that means the end of the war between our nations!
Ice Nations#023.dst: 那我想，我們兩族之間的戰爭就到此為止了！
Ice Nations#023.speaker: Hallfred

Ice Nations#024.src: This is a great day! Here, take this as a reward for helping our nation.
Ice Nations#024.dst: 今天是個大日子！來，這個拿去，謝謝你幫了我們這一族。
Ice Nations#024.speaker: Hallfred

Ice Nations#025.src: I'm sure you'll find a use for this helmet one day!
Ice Nations#025.dst: 我相信這頂頭盔總有一天派得上用場！
Ice Nations#025.speaker: Hallfred

Infested Plants#000.src: Meet up with Tasim at the entrance to {p} at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Infested Plants#001.src: Oh, {u}! There you are. It's good to see you. Are you ready to continue on towards {p}?
Infested Plants#001.dst: 哦，{u}！你在這。見到你真好。準備好繼續往 {p} 走了嗎？
Infested Plants#001.speaker: Tasim

Infested Plants#002.src: It seems we'll need to pass through the {p} first. I've heard the forest is crawling with spiders... But between you and me, we should be-
Infested Plants#002.dst: 看來我們得先穿過 {p}。我聽說那座森林裡到處都是蜘蛛……不過你我之間說說，我們應該——
Infested Plants#002.speaker: Tasim

Infested Plants#003.src: H-hey! You two! You're soldiers, right? I can tell from your weird fashion sense. You folk are supposed to help people! So. Help!
Infested Plants#003.dst: 喂——喂！你們兩個！你們是士兵吧？從你們那身怪品味我看得出來。你們這種人不是應該幫助別人嗎？所以——幫幫忙！

Infested Plants#004.src: Huh? Oh- yes, of course! What's your name? What do you need help with?
Infested Plants#004.dst: 啊？哦——當然！你叫什麼名字？需要什麼幫忙？
Infested Plants#004.speaker: Tasim

Infested Plants#005.src: I'm Ope! I was recently... uh... bit by a spider! And now I need your help to get a rare medicinal herb to heal me!
Infested Plants#005.dst: 我叫 Ope！我最近……呃……被蜘蛛咬了！現在我需要你們幫我拿一種稀有的藥草來治我！
Infested Plants#005.speaker: Ope

Infested Plants#006.src: It only grows in an infested cave filled with creepy crawlies. And I'm clearly in no condition to go get it myself!
Infested Plants#006.dst: 那東西只長在一個滿是爬蟲的洞窟裡。而我這副身體顯然沒辦法自己去拿！
Infested Plants#006.speaker: Ope

Infested Plants#007.src: Well, alright! We're here to help, after all, so... We'll get you that herb!
Infested Plants#007.dst: 好吧，沒問題！我們本來就是來幫忙的，所以……那株藥草我們替你拿！
Infested Plants#007.speaker: Tasim

Infested Plants#008.src: Perfect. I'll bring you to the cave, and you can do the rest from there. Follow me, soldiers!
Infested Plants#008.dst: 太好了。我帶你們到洞窟，剩下的就交給你們。跟我來，士兵們！
Infested Plants#008.speaker: Ope

Infested Plants#009.src: Follow Ope to the cave at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Infested Plants#010.src: Well, here we are! The cave's right over there - just climb up the rocks and jump into it.
Infested Plants#010.dst: 好啦，到了！洞窟就在那邊——爬上那些岩石跳進去就行。
Infested Plants#010.speaker: Ope

Infested Plants#011.src: Hm... There's two of you. Good! One of your can climb up into that cave, and the other can protect me from the crawly spiders down here!
Infested Plants#011.dst: 嗯……你們有兩個人。太好了！一個爬上去進洞窟，另一個留在下面保護我不被那些爬來爬去的蜘蛛咬！
Infested Plants#011.speaker: Ope

Infested Plants#012.src: Alright! {u}, you can go into the cave, and I can defend Ope here while you do that.
Infested Plants#012.dst: 好！{u}，你進洞窟，我在這裡護著 Ope。
Infested Plants#012.speaker: Tasim

Infested Plants#013.src: Good, good. Well, good luck up there! Try not to get bitten too much by the spiders!
Infested Plants#013.dst: 很好、很好。那麼，上面小心啊！盡量別被蜘蛛咬太多口！
Infested Plants#013.speaker: Ope

Infested Plants#014.src: Locate the medicine in the spider cave behind Ope at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Infested Plants#014.dst: 在 [-{~1}, {~2}, -{~3}] Ope 身後的蜘蛛洞窟裡找出藥草。

Infested Plants#015.src: Exit the cave at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] with the medicinal herb.

Infested Plants#016.src: There you are! It feels like we've been waiting for hours.
Infested Plants#016.dst: 你可算回來了！感覺我們等了好幾個鐘頭。
Infested Plants#016.speaker: Ope

Infested Plants#017.src: It... really hasn't been that long. Maybe ten minutes at most.
Infested Plants#017.dst: 其實……根本沒那麼久。頂多十分鐘吧。
Infested Plants#017.speaker: Tasim

Infested Plants#018.src: Well-... Anyway! Do you have the herb? It's very- uh, important! To cure me. Yep.
Infested Plants#018.dst: 呃……總之！藥草拿到了嗎？那東西非常——呃，重要！可以治好我。對。
Infested Plants#018.speaker: Ope

Infested Plants#019.src: There it is! Eheh. Thank you kindly for your work, soldiers! Now, about your payment...Let's see, what do I have...
Infested Plants#019.dst: 就是它！嘿嘿。多謝兩位辛苦了，士兵！那麼，關於你們的報酬……我看看，我身上有什麼……
Infested Plants#019.speaker: Ope

Infested Plants#020.src: Oh. I seem to be out of emeralds. Well- I can, uh, offer some advice! There's lots to find in this forest. Plenty of caves with valuables to explore! Might be worth your time.
Infested Plants#020.dst: 哦。我的綠寶石好像用完了。不過——我可以，呃，給你們一點建議！這座森林裡有很多東西可以找。有不少藏著寶物的洞窟值得探！說不定挺划算的。
Infested Plants#020.speaker: Ope

Infested Plants#021.src: Wait, are you seriously not going to-
Infested Plants#021.dst: 等等，你該不會真的不打算——
Infested Plants#021.speaker: Tasim

Infested Plants#022.src: It has been a time, soldiers, but I truly must be going! We're near {p}, you should stop on by! Just keep going east down the main road! Go and speak to the mayor! He can cover my expenses!
Infested Plants#022.dst: 時間不早了，士兵們，我真的得走了！我們離 {p} 很近，你們該過去看看！沿著大路一直往東走就到了！去找鎮長談！他可以幫我付這筆帳！
Infested Plants#022.speaker: Ope

Infested Plants#025.src: That's... frustrating. He seemed shady from the start, I should have-... Well. What's done is done. Let's go speak to that mayor.
Infested Plants#025.dst: 這實在……讓人火大。他從一開始就一副不老實的樣子，我早該——……算了。木已成舟。我們去找那位鎮長吧。
Infested Plants#025.speaker: Tasim

Infested Plants#026.src: Speak to Mayor Alvin in {p} at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Infested Plants#027.src: Ah, travelers... welcome to our humble forest town. Have you come to stay, or are you simply passing through?
Infested Plants#027.dst: 啊，旅人……歡迎來到我們這座樸實的林間小鎮。兩位是要留下來，還是只是路過？
Infested Plants#027.speaker: Mayor Alvin

Infested Plants#028.src: Probably the latter. Though, we ran into a man named Ope, who directed us to speak with you.
Infested Plants#028.dst: 大概是後者。不過，我們遇到一個叫 Ope 的人，他要我們來找您談。
Infested Plants#028.speaker: Tasim

Infested Plants#029.src: Oh, Ope... I take it your meeting with him went poorly? I must apologize for him, he is... a tough man to deal with.
Infested Plants#029.dst: 哦，Ope 啊……看來兩位跟他打交道的過程不太愉快？我得替他向兩位致歉，他是個……不太好相處的人。
Infested Plants#029.speaker: Mayor Alvin

Infested Plants#030.src: Here, I may offer you a small sum of emeralds as an apology. I hope he has not soured your opinion of our small town, here...
Infested Plants#030.dst: 來，我給兩位一小筆綠寶石當作賠罪。希望他沒有壞了兩位對我們這座小鎮的印象……
Infested Plants#030.speaker: Mayor Alvin

Infested Plants#031.src: Oh... Thank you. That's very kind of you. We'll probably stay for a while, before we continue towards {p}.
Infested Plants#031.dst: 哦……謝謝您。您真是太客氣了。我們大概會待上一陣子，再繼續往 {p} 去。
Infested Plants#031.speaker: Tasim

Infested Plants#032.src: Then feel free to make yourselves at home! We welcome all travelers here, no matter how long their stay is.
Infested Plants#032.dst: 那就請兩位把這裡當自己家！不論停留多久，我們都歡迎每一位旅人。
Infested Plants#032.speaker: Mayor Alvin

Jungle Fever#000.src: Talk to Worid in the jungle village at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
Jungle Fever#000.dst: 前往叢林村落與 Worid 對話，座標 [-{~1}, {~2}, -{~3}]

Jungle Fever#001.src: Oh, I am so happy to see you! *cough*, I caught a very bad fever, and I really need help! *cough*
Jungle Fever#001.dst: 哦，看到你真是太好了！*咳*，我得了很嚴重的熱病，真的需要幫忙！*咳*
Jungle Fever#001.speaker: Worid

Jungle Fever#002.src: The only cure against this fever is to drink Liquid Emeralds! Yes, exactly! *cough*
Jungle Fever#002.dst: 治這種熱病唯一的解藥就是喝液態綠寶石！沒錯，就是這樣！*咳*
Jungle Fever#002.speaker: Worid

Jungle Fever#003.src: Do you think you could ask the Banker at {p} if he could give me, oh I don't know, [{~} Liquified Emeralds]?
Jungle Fever#003.dst: 你能不能去問問 {p} 的銀行行員，看他願不願意給我，我也不知道，[{~} 液態綠寶石]？
Jungle Fever#003.speaker: Worid

Jungle Fever#004.src: If he has the audacity to *cough* say no... you will have to use brute force...
Jungle Fever#004.dst: 如果他膽敢 *咳* 說不……那你就只好動點粗了……
Jungle Fever#004.speaker: Worid

Jungle Fever#005.src: Break into *cough* to the emerald storage, but don't take anything... come back to me immediately after, if you make it out alive, heheh...
Jungle Fever#005.dst: 闖進 *咳* 綠寶石倉庫，但什麼都別拿……之後馬上回來找我，如果你活著出得來的話，嘿嘿……
Jungle Fever#005.speaker: Worid

Jungle Fever#007.src: Talk to {p}'s Banker about the cure for Worid at [{~}, {~}, -{~}]
Jungle Fever#007.dst: 前往 [{~1}, {~2}, -{~3}] 與 {p} 的銀行行員談 Worid 的解藥

Jungle Fever#008.src: [{~} Liquified Emeralds]? He is crazy! Liquified Emeralds cannot cure anyone from anything, except being poor!
Jungle Fever#008.dst: [{~} 液態綠寶石]？他瘋了！液態綠寶石治不了任何病，除了窮病！
Jungle Fever#008.speaker: The Banker

Jungle Fever#009.src: I will not participate in this pathetic fraud attempt!
Jungle Fever#009.dst: 我才不要參與這種可笑的詐騙！
Jungle Fever#009.speaker: The Banker

Jungle Fever#011.src: Oh no! How will I ever cure my sickness without any Liquified Emeralds?... *cough*
Jungle Fever#011.dst: 哦不！沒有液態綠寶石，我的病要怎麼治啊？……*咳*
Jungle Fever#011.speaker: Worid

Jungle Fever#012.src: We'll have to change our strategy, we won't ask for permission. It's to help me after all.
Jungle Fever#012.dst: 我們得換個策略，不問許可了。反正是為了救我嘛。
Jungle Fever#012.speaker: Worid

Jungle Fever#013.src: First, I need to make sure you can easily break into a bank. Try to enter {p}' Secret Stash.
Jungle Fever#013.dst: 首先，我得確認你有辦法輕鬆闖進銀行。試著進 {p} 的祕密倉庫看看。
Jungle Fever#013.speaker: Worid

Jungle Fever#014.src: When you're done, talk to me again. Be careful too, they might have some Guards.
Jungle Fever#014.dst: 搞定之後再來找我。也小心一點，他們可能有守衛。
Jungle Fever#014.speaker: Worid

Jungle Fever#016.src: What? You're here already. I thought you would take too long so I just went myself.
Jungle Fever#016.dst: 什麼？你已經到了。我以為你會弄很久，所以我就自己去了。
Jungle Fever#016.speaker: Worid

Jungle Fever#017.src: My sickness? RIGHT. *cough* You should feel bad for forcing a sick man to do your job.
Jungle Fever#017.dst: 我的病？對啦。*咳* 你逼一個病人幫你做事，應該覺得慚愧才對。
Jungle Fever#017.speaker: Worid

Jungle Fever#018.src: Anyway I see you proved yourself, we can start the real thing now.
Jungle Fever#018.dst: 總之我看你證明了自己，我們可以開始來真的了。
Jungle Fever#018.speaker: Worid

Jungle Fever#019.src: You see, {p} has a very well guarded emerald vault named "The Emerald Labyrinth".
Jungle Fever#019.dst: 你知道嗎，{p} 有一座守衛森嚴的綠寶石金庫，叫做「綠寶石迷宮」。
Jungle Fever#019.speaker: Worid

Jungle Fever#020.src: It is guarded with tons of well trained Guard Golem, who can easily kill any adventurer.
Jungle Fever#020.dst: 那裡有一大堆訓練有素的守衛魔像看守，隨便一台都能輕鬆殺死冒險者。
Jungle Fever#020.speaker: Worid

Jungle Fever#021.src: The Banker in the secret vault must be completely bored out of his mind, and won't mind if you find him.
Jungle Fever#021.dst: 祕密金庫裡的那個行員一定無聊到快發瘋了，你去找他，他應該不會介意。
Jungle Fever#021.speaker: Worid

Jungle Fever#022.src: Good luck with that. Haha.. I mean, *cough*.
Jungle Fever#022.dst: 祝你好運囉。哈哈……我是說，*咳*。
Jungle Fever#022.speaker: Worid

Jungle Fever#023.src: Infiltrate {p}'s Secret Emerald Labyrinth at [{~}, {~}, -{~}] underground and find the Banker in the Emerald Room
Jungle Fever#023.dst: 潛入 [{~1}, {~2}, -{~3}] 地下的 {p} 祕密綠寶石迷宮，在綠寶石室找到那名行員

Jungle Fever#024.src: Oh, uh! Somebody! It has been so long since I've seen someone!
Jungle Fever#024.dst: 哦，呃！有人！我好久好久沒見過人了！
Jungle Fever#024.speaker: Almuj Banker

Jungle Fever#025.src: Liquified Emeralds? Of course, of course! I've got tons! Here, take them.
Jungle Fever#025.dst: 液態綠寶石？當然、當然！我這裡多的是！來，拿去吧。
Jungle Fever#025.speaker: Almuj Banker

Jungle Fever#028.src: That is a lot of money, thank you very much, I will finally be able to... *cough* to cure myself!
Jungle Fever#028.dst: 這可是一大筆錢，真的很謝謝你，我終於可以……*咳* 把自己治好了！
Jungle Fever#028.speaker: Worid

Jungle Fever#029.src: Here, take this part, you deserve it. I have to use most of the... *cough* money so I can heal, so I've instead paid you with a key.
Jungle Fever#029.dst: 來，這份拿去，你應得的。錢我大部分得拿去 *咳* 治病，所以改用一把鑰匙付你。
Jungle Fever#029.speaker: Worid

Jungle Fever#030.src: I stole- *cough* I mean, borrowed it, from our tribe's leader. Apparently it was used to lock up a great evil.
Jungle Fever#030.dst: 那是我從我們部落首領那裡偷——*咳* 我是說借來的。聽說那是用來封印某個大邪惡的東西。
Jungle Fever#030.speaker: Worid

Jungle Fever#031.src: Good ridda- *cough* Er... luck. Yes, good luck, adventurer!
Jungle Fever#031.dst: 祝你早死——*咳* 呃……早日順利。對，祝你好運，冒險者！
Jungle Fever#031.speaker: Worid

King's Recruit#002.src: Hey, {u}! You alright in there? Looks like we hit something.
King's Recruit#002.dst: 嘿，{u}！你在裡面還好嗎？我們好像撞到什麼東西了。

King's Recruit#003.src: Exit the caravan and talk to the Caravan Driver at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

King's Recruit#004.src: Hm... I swear I hit this same darn boulder every time I make this trip. Sorry folks.
King's Recruit#004.dst: 唔……我發誓每次走這條路都會撞到同一顆該死的大石頭。抱歉了，各位。
King's Recruit#004.speaker: Caravan Driver

King's Recruit#005.src: Ah. Does this mean we have to walk all the way to {p} from here?
King's Recruit#005.dst: 啊。所以我們得從這裡一路走到 {p} 去？
King's Recruit#005.speaker: Tasim

King's Recruit#006.src: Unfortunately so. Luckily, it's not that far from here. Just a straight path forward.
King's Recruit#006.dst: 恐怕是的。不過還好沒多遠，一直往前走就到了。
King's Recruit#006.speaker: Caravan Driver

King's Recruit#007.src: Well, nothing to do but keep moving! Tasim, {u}, I'll race you to the gate!
King's Recruit#007.dst: 好啦，沒別的辦法，繼續走吧！Tasim、{u}，我們來比誰先到城門！
King's Recruit#007.speaker: Aledar

King's Recruit#009.src: ... He's already gone. We'll have to catch up to him. {u}, lead the way.
King's Recruit#009.dst: ……他已經跑掉了。我們得追上去。{u}，你帶路吧。
King's Recruit#009.speaker: Tasim

King's Recruit#010.src: Walk down the path towards the gate to the Wynn Province at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
King's Recruit#010.dst: 沿著這條路走向 [-{~1}, {~2}, -{~3}] 通往 Wynn 行省的大門。

King's Recruit#011.src: I don't suppose you know much about Wynn either, do you?
King's Recruit#011.dst: 我猜你對 Wynn 大概也不太了解吧？
King's Recruit#011.speaker: Tasim

King's Recruit#012.src: Of course, the King of {p}'s been recruiting Fruma soldiers, but...
King's Recruit#012.dst: 當然啦，{p} 的國王一直在招募 Fruma 的士兵，可是……
King's Recruit#012.speaker: Tasim

King's Recruit#013.src: That war of theirs must be getting pretty bad if they need this much support.
King's Recruit#013.dst: 要是他們需要這麼多支援，那場戰爭一定打得很慘。
King's Recruit#013.speaker: Tasim

King's Recruit#014.src: Oh, there's Aledar! And the gate, by the looks of it.
King's Recruit#014.dst: 喔，Aledar 在那裡！看樣子城門也到了。
King's Recruit#014.speaker: Tasim

King's Recruit#015.src: There you two are! You'll have to be faster than that if you want to stand a chance against the undead.
King's Recruit#015.dst: 你們兩個總算來了！要是想在不死族面前活下來，動作得再快一點才行。
King's Recruit#015.speaker: Aledar

King's Recruit#016.src: Yes, yes, we'll be faster next time. So, is this the gate marking the border between Wynn and Fruma?
King's Recruit#016.dst: 是是是，下次我們會快一點。所以，這就是 Wynn 和 Fruma 交界的城門？
King's Recruit#016.speaker: Tasim

King's Recruit#017.src: It looks like it, yep! Are you two ready for the start of our new lives?
King's Recruit#017.dst: 看起來是沒錯！你們兩個準備好迎接新人生了嗎？
King's Recruit#017.speaker: Aledar

King's Recruit#018.src: {u}, why don't you do the honours? Go ahead and open that gate.
King's Recruit#018.dst: {u}，這個榮幸就交給你了。去把門打開吧。
King's Recruit#018.speaker: Aledar

King's Recruit#019.src: Enter the Province of Wynn at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

King's Recruit#020.src: Well, what are we waiting for? Let's go ahead and explore this province.
King's Recruit#020.dst: 那還等什麼？我們去把這個行省好好逛一遍吧。
King's Recruit#020.speaker: Aledar

King's Recruit#021.src: Continue through the Wynn Province to the castle
King's Recruit#021.dst: 穿過 Wynn 行省，前往城堡

King's Recruit#022.src: So this is Wynn we've all been hearing about... It's beautiful.
King's Recruit#022.dst: 所以這就是我們一直聽說的 Wynn……真美。
King's Recruit#022.speaker: Tasim

King's Recruit#023.src: I guess the war hasn't made it this far. This is what we'll be fighting to protect.
King's Recruit#023.dst: 看來戰火還沒燒到這裡。這就是我們要守護的東西。
King's Recruit#023.speaker: Aledar

King's Recruit#024.src: Hey, recruits! Come over here, I have something to tell you.
King's Recruit#024.dst: 喂，新兵！過來一下，我有事要跟你們說。
King's Recruit#024.speaker: Soldier

King's Recruit#026.src: A soldier? What are you doing all the way out here?
King's Recruit#026.dst: 士兵？你怎麼會在這麼偏僻的地方？
King's Recruit#026.speaker: Tasim

King's Recruit#027.src: There's a bit of trouble up ahead. They sent me out here to intercept new recruits.
King's Recruit#027.dst: 前面出了點狀況。他們派我到這裡攔下新來的兵。
King's Recruit#027.speaker: Soldier

King's Recruit#028.src: If you want to survive out here, you're going to need this.
King's Recruit#028.dst: 想在外面活下來，你們需要這個。
King's Recruit#028.speaker: Soldier

King's Recruit#031.src: Hopefully we won't have to use these just yet.
King's Recruit#031.dst: 希望我們暫時還用不上這些。
King's Recruit#031.speaker: Tasim

King's Recruit#032.src: Good luck out there, recruits! Just follow this path, and there will be a bridge up ahead.
King's Recruit#032.dst: 外頭多保重，新兵們！沿著這條路走，前面會有一座橋。
King's Recruit#032.speaker: Soldier

King's Recruit#034.src: Ah, this must be the bridge the soldier was talking about. But it certainly looks very...
King's Recruit#034.dst: 啊，這一定就是那位士兵說的橋。不過它看起來實在很……
King's Recruit#034.speaker: Tasim

King's Recruit#035.src: Well, let's not keep the King of {p} waiting!
King's Recruit#035.dst: 別讓 {p} 的國王等太久啊！
King's Recruit#035.speaker: Aledar

King's Recruit#039.src: That's what I was trying to warn you about! Let's just get off this bridge before the rest of it collapses...
King's Recruit#039.dst: 我剛剛就是想警告你這個！趁整座橋還沒垮，先離開這裡吧……
King's Recruit#039.speaker: Tasim

King's Recruit#040.src: Well, how are we meant to get to the other side of this ravine now? Ugh. Another thing gone wrong, just like-...
King's Recruit#040.dst: 那我們現在要怎麼過這條峽谷？唉，又出狀況了，就跟那次一樣——……
King's Recruit#040.speaker: Aledar

King's Recruit#042.src: That's... weird. I was just thinking about something from before Wynn, but... it's gone. I can't remember.
King's Recruit#042.dst: 這……很奇怪。我剛剛在想 Wynn 之前的某件事，可是……不見了。我想不起來。
King's Recruit#042.speaker: Aledar

King's Recruit#043.src: Hm. I can't remember anything from Fruma either... {u}, how about you?
King's Recruit#043.dst: 嗯。我也想不起 Fruma 的任何事……{u}，你呢？
King's Recruit#043.speaker: Tasim

King's Recruit#044.src: Nothing. It can't be a coincidence we all lost our memories at the same time, right?
King's Recruit#044.dst: 什麼都沒有。我們三個同時失去記憶，不可能是巧合吧？
King's Recruit#044.speaker: Aledar

King's Recruit#045.src: No, but... We can worry about that later. For now, we need to find a way past this ravine. Aledar, {u}, you should look around for a way across. I'll keep looking here.
King's Recruit#045.dst: 是不太可能，可是……那件事晚點再煩惱。現在得先想辦法過這條峽谷。Aledar、{u}，你們去找找看有沒有路能過去，我在這邊繼續找。
King's Recruit#045.speaker: Tasim

King's Recruit#047.src: Search for another way across the ravine at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

King's Recruit#048.src: Woah! That sure did the trick, {u}. Good thinking!
King's Recruit#048.speaker: Aledar

King's Recruit#049.src: Hey, Tasim! Come over here, {u} found a way over!
King's Recruit#049.dst: 喂，Tasim！過來這邊，{u} 找到路了！
King's Recruit#049.speaker: Aledar

King's Recruit#051.src: Phew! We made it over safely this time at least.
King's Recruit#051.dst: 呼！這次總算平安過來了。
King's Recruit#051.speaker: Tasim

King's Recruit#052.src: If we just continue forward, we should make it to {p} in no time!
King's Recruit#052.dst: 只要一直往前走，很快就能到 {p} 了！
King's Recruit#052.speaker: Aledar

King's Recruit#053.src: Hmm? What's that guard doing here? We should probably talk to them if we want to pass through.
King's Recruit#053.dst: 嗯？那個守衛在這裡做什麼？想過去的話，我們大概得先跟他談談。
King's Recruit#053.speaker: Tasim

King's Recruit#057.src: A group of corrupted have sieged this underpass. I can't let you enter without any armour.
King's Recruit#057.dst: 一群腐化生物佔據了這條地道。沒有防具，我不能讓你們進去。
King's Recruit#057.speaker: Guard

King's Recruit#058.src: Then what do we do? We have to get to {p}!
King's Recruit#058.dst: 那我們該怎麼辦？我們一定得到 {p} 去！
King's Recruit#058.speaker: Aledar

King's Recruit#059.src: Do you see that cave over there? Caves such as those often contain useful loot that can help keep you alive.
King's Recruit#059.dst: 看到那邊那個洞窟了嗎？那種地方常常有能保命的好東西。
King's Recruit#059.speaker: Guard

King's Recruit#060.src: If you enter the cave, you should be able to find some armour to protect you. After that return to me.
King's Recruit#060.dst: 進洞窟裡找找，應該找得到防具保護自己。找到之後再回來找我。
King's Recruit#060.speaker: Guard

King's Recruit#061.src: What do you say {u}? Let's go see what's in that cave.
King's Recruit#061.dst: {u}，你說呢？我們去看看那個洞窟裡有什麼吧。
King's Recruit#061.speaker: Aledar

King's Recruit#062.src: Enter the cave and find some armour at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

King's Recruit#063.src: We should return to the guard to see if he'll let us through now!
King's Recruit#063.dst: 我們該回去找那個守衛，看他現在肯不肯放我們過去！
King's Recruit#063.speaker: Aledar

King's Recruit#065.src: So you found some armor, huh?
King's Recruit#065.speaker: Guard

King's Recruit#066.src: Yes, a helmet! Will you let us pass now?
King's Recruit#066.dst: 對，一頂頭盔！現在可以讓我們過去了吧？
King's Recruit#066.speaker: Aledar

King's Recruit#067.src: Hold on there, recruit. Before you can equip a piece of armor you first have to identify it.
King's Recruit#067.dst: 別急，新兵。裝備防具之前，你得先把它鑑定過。
King's Recruit#067.speaker: Guard

King's Recruit#068.src: And how do we do that?
King's Recruit#068.speaker: Tasim

King's Recruit#069.src: You can identify items at Item Identifiers. They exist in every city across the whole world, and we keep one here for convenience.
King's Recruit#069.dst: 到 Item Identifier 那裡就能鑑定物品。全世界每座城市都有，我們這裡也放了一個，方便行事。
King's Recruit#069.speaker: Guard

King's Recruit#070.src: Identify your helmet at the Item Identifier and then return to me with it equipped. After you've done that I'll let you pass.
King's Recruit#070.dst: 到 Item Identifier 把頭盔鑑定好，戴上之後再回來找我。做完我就放你們過去。
King's Recruit#070.speaker: Guard

King's Recruit#072.src: I see you have your helmet on. Fantastic, you may now pass. Let me open this door for you.
King's Recruit#072.dst: 我看到你戴上頭盔了。很好，可以過去了。我來幫你們把門打開。
King's Recruit#072.speaker: Guard

King's Recruit#073.src: Good luck in there recruits! Even with your armour it won't be so easy!
King's Recruit#073.dst: 裡面小心啊，新兵們！就算有防具，那裡也不好對付！
King's Recruit#073.speaker: Guard

King's Recruit#076.src: Wow, that guard wasn't joking. This place is crawling with the corrupt.
King's Recruit#076.dst: 哇，那個守衛不是在開玩笑。這裡到處都是腐化生物。
King's Recruit#076.speaker: Tasim

King's Recruit#077.src: Well, we've got no choice but to make it through! Finally time for us to use these weapons we got. Let's go, {u}.
King's Recruit#077.dst: 那也只能硬著頭皮闖過去了！總算輪到我們用上這些武器。走吧，{u}。
King's Recruit#077.speaker: Aledar

King's Recruit#078.src: {u}, you take the skeleton in the front. We'll handle the two zombies in the back!
King's Recruit#078.dst: {u}，前面那隻骷髏交給你。後面那兩隻殭屍我們處理！
King's Recruit#078.speaker: Aledar

King's Recruit#081.src: This path opened up, let's continue through the underpass.
King's Recruit#081.dst: 這條路通了，繼續穿過地道吧。
King's Recruit#081.speaker: Tasim

King's Recruit#083.src: Over here! You're just what I needed!
King's Recruit#083.speaker: Lieutenant

King's Recruit#085.src: Finally, some backup! Wait a second... you're straight from Fruma aren't you?
King's Recruit#085.dst: 終於有支援了！等一下……你們是剛從 Fruma 過來的吧？
King's Recruit#085.speaker: Lieutenant

King's Recruit#086.src: Oh well, this area should be clear by now. {p} is just up ahead, after all.
King's Recruit#086.dst: 算了，這一帶現在應該清乾淨了。畢竟 {p} 就在前面而已。
King's Recruit#086.speaker: Lieutenant

King's Recruit#088.src: Quick, you have to use an ability!
King's Recruit#088.speaker: Lieutenant

King's Recruit#090.src: Wait, it's running away! We have to save the Lieutenant!
King's Recruit#090.dst: 等等，牠要跑了！我們得去救中尉！
King's Recruit#090.speaker: Aledar

King's Recruit#092.src: Defeat the Goliath and free the Lieutenant.
King's Recruit#092.dst: 擊敗 Goliath 並救出中尉。

King's Recruit#093.src: That sure was close... Thanks for the save, {u}!
King's Recruit#093.dst: 那可真險……多謝出手相救，{u}！
King's Recruit#093.speaker: Lieutenant

King's Recruit#094.src: I think you three are going to make good soldiers - not many can handle themselves like you just did.
King's Recruit#094.dst: 我看你們三個會成為出色的士兵——沒幾個人能像你們剛才那樣應付得來。
King's Recruit#094.speaker: Lieutenant

King's Recruit#095.src: It seems that beast dropped something, you should check it out before heading to {p}.
King's Recruit#095.dst: 那隻野獸好像掉了什麼東西，去 {p} 之前先撿起來吧。
King's Recruit#095.speaker: Lieutenant

King's Recruit#096.src: Pick up the loot dropped by the Goliath.
King's Recruit#096.dst: 撿起 Goliath 掉落的物品。

King's Recruit#097.src: That item looks rare! Maybe there's an identifier around here.
King's Recruit#097.dst: 那件東西看起來很稀有！說不定這附近有鑑定師。
King's Recruit#097.speaker: Tasim

King's Recruit#100.src: We... we made it! We really made it! Sure was a close call at the end.
King's Recruit#100.dst: 我們……我們到了！真的到了！最後那段真是好險。
King's Recruit#100.speaker: Aledar

King's Recruit#101.src: ... Still think those corrupted don't stand a chance against you?
King's Recruit#101.dst: ……你還覺得那些腐化生物打不過你嗎？
King's Recruit#101.speaker: Tasim

King's Recruit#102.src: Ha ha. Very funny. Ah, {u}, there seems to be an identifier here for you to identify that rare helmet.
King's Recruit#102.dst: 哈哈，真好笑。啊，{u}，這裡好像有鑑定師，可以幫你鑑定那頂稀有頭盔。
King's Recruit#102.speaker: Aledar

King's Recruit#103.src: And a blacksmith too, you can sell your old helmet there for some emeralds.
King's Recruit#103.dst: 還有一位鐵匠，你可以把舊頭盔賣掉換點綠寶石。
King's Recruit#103.speaker: Tasim

King's Recruit#104.src: Here it is, the end of our journey.
King's Recruit#104.dst: 到了，這就是我們旅程的終點。
King's Recruit#104.speaker: Tasim

King's Recruit#105.src: The end of one adventure, but the beginning of another! Let's go inside and talk to the King!
King's Recruit#105.dst: 一段冒險的結束，也是另一段的開始！我們進去見國王吧！
King's Recruit#105.speaker: Aledar

King's Recruit#107.src: Welcome to the Province of Wynn! By your ragged appearance, I gather your journey here must have been quite the adventure.
King's Recruit#107.dst: 歡迎來到 Wynn 行省！看你們這一身狼狽，想必路上頗為驚險。
King's Recruit#107.speaker: King of Ragni

King's Recruit#108.src: This, recruits, is the noble fort of {p}, one of the great cities of our province!
King's Recruit#108.dst: 新兵們，這裡便是 {p} 的堅實堡壘，本行省的大城之一。
King's Recruit#108.speaker: King of Ragni

King's Recruit#109.src: As soldiers of Wynn, it is your duty to stem the tide of corrupted monsters ravaging this land.
King's Recruit#109.dst: 身為 Wynn 的士兵，你們的職責是遏止腐化怪物在這片土地上蔓延。
King's Recruit#109.speaker: King of Ragni

King's Recruit#110.src: Although, you may want to gain some experience beforehand. Many lives are tragically lost every day...
King's Recruit#110.dst: 不過，在那之前你們或許該先累積些經驗。每天都有太多人白白送命……
King's Recruit#110.speaker: King of Ragni

King's Recruit#111.src: Take this [{p} Teleportation Scroll] to aid you in your journey. Upon use, it will instantly bring you back to this city, wherever you may be.
King's Recruit#111.dst: 帶上這卷 [{p} Teleportation Scroll]，路上用得著。使用之後，不論你身在何處都會立刻回到這座城市。
King's Recruit#111.speaker: King of Ragni

King's Recruit#112.src: With that, I must bid you farewell, more recruits may arrive at any time. Good luck out there, soldiers of Wynn!
King's Recruit#112.dst: 就此別過，隨時都可能有新兵抵達。外頭保重，Wynn 的士兵們！
King's Recruit#112.speaker: King of Ragni

King's Recruit#113.src: So! Wynn, huh? It's pretty exciting to finally be here.
King's Recruit#113.dst: 所以！這就是 Wynn 啊。真的到了這裡，還挺讓人興奮的。
King's Recruit#113.speaker: Tasim

King's Recruit#114.src: I can't wait to discover what it looks like for myself!
King's Recruit#114.dst: 我等不及要親眼看看它長什麼樣子了！
King's Recruit#114.speaker: Aledar

King's Recruit#115.src: Ha, well, I think I'm going to head in the direction of {p} soon, although there seems to be something called {p} on the way...
King's Recruit#115.dst: 哈，我打算不久後往 {p} 的方向去，不過路上好像會經過一個叫 {p} 的地方……
King's Recruit#115.speaker: Tasim

King's Recruit#116.src: Enough talking already! Let's get out there and help some people!
King's Recruit#116.dst: 別再說了啦！我們出去幫幫別人吧！
King's Recruit#116.speaker: Aledar

King's Recruit#117.src: And he's gone again... Well, I'm sure we'll be seeing him soon enough. For now, let's just see what Wynn really is like.
King's Recruit#117.dst: 他又跑掉了……算了，反正很快就會再見到他。現在嘛，就先看看 Wynn 到底是什麼樣子吧。
King's Recruit#117.speaker: Tasim

King's Recruit#118.src: It's beautiful... Oh! I almost forgot to tell you, {u}.
King's Recruit#118.dst: 真美……喔！我差點忘了跟你說，{u}。
King's Recruit#118.speaker: Tasim

King's Recruit#119.src: There's this handy item we were all given on our way here, the Content Book. It displays most things you can do in this world; Quests, Caves, and much, much more.
King's Recruit#119.dst: 我們來的路上都拿到一件很方便的東西，叫做 Content Book。這個世界上大部分能做的事它都列得出來——任務、洞窟，還有很多很多。
King's Recruit#119.speaker: Tasim

King's Recruit#120.src: It also lets you track any content you want, which will create beacons for you to follow.
King's Recruit#120.dst: 它還能追蹤你想做的任何內容，會幫你標出光柱指引方向。
King's Recruit#120.speaker: Tasim

King's Recruit#121.src: Here, why don't you try it out? Use your Content Book, and click on the highlighted quest.
King's Recruit#121.dst: 來，要不要試試看？打開你的 Content Book，點那個被標示出來的任務。
King's Recruit#121.speaker: Tasim

King's Recruit#122.src: There you go! I'm going to head towards {p}, at the end of the {p}.
King's Recruit#122.dst: 就是這樣！我要往 {p} 去了，就在 {p} 的盡頭。
King's Recruit#122.speaker: Tasim

King's Recruit#123.src: You should meet me there once you've gotten a little stronger. Well, see you around, {u}.
King's Recruit#123.dst: 等你變強一點之後，來那裡找我吧。那麼，回頭見了，{u}。
King's Recruit#123.speaker: Tasim

Kingdom of Sand#001.src: A {p} soldier! I imagine you're here to investigate the tomb up the hill?
Kingdom of Sand#001.dst: {p} 的士兵！我猜你是來調查山上那座陵墓的吧？
Kingdom of Sand#001.speaker: Junes

Kingdom of Sand#002.src: It's believed to house the remains of Prince Hashr, the son of the old Desert Emperor, but it's far too dangerous for me to explore personally.
Kingdom of Sand#002.dst: 一般認為那裡安放著 Prince Hashr 的遺骸——老 Desert Emperor 的兒子——不過對我來說太危險了，我不敢親自進去。
Kingdom of Sand#002.speaker: Junes

Kingdom of Sand#003.src: Instead I've been looking into a related legend - the Emperor's Sceptre.
Kingdom of Sand#003.dst: 所以我改去追查一個相關的傳說——Emperor's Sceptre。
Kingdom of Sand#003.speaker: Junes

Kingdom of Sand#004.src: It was the source of his power, and potentially one of the most important artifacts in history.
Kingdom of Sand#004.dst: 那是他力量的來源，也可能是歷史上最重要的遺物之一。
Kingdom of Sand#004.speaker: Junes

Kingdom of Sand#005.src: When the Emperor was slain by his son, Hashr, it is said that the sceptre was lost amongst the raging sandstorm that followed.
Kingdom of Sand#005.dst: 皇帝被他兒子 Hashr 殺死之後，據說權杖就消失在隨之而來的狂暴沙暴裡了。
Kingdom of Sand#005.speaker: Junes

Kingdom of Sand#006.src: ... Until now. I believe I have been able to trace its possession to a nearby group of bandits. They probably have no idea what they're sitting on.
Kingdom of Sand#006.dst: ……直到現在。我相信我已經追查到它落在附近一群強盜手上。他們大概根本不知道自己坐擁什麼。
Kingdom of Sand#006.speaker: Junes

Kingdom of Sand#007.src: I'm not prepared to confront them myself, but... this artifact belongs in a museum, in the hands of careful and respectful researchers.
Kingdom of Sand#007.dst: 我沒有把握親自去跟他們對峙，可是……這件遺物該進博物館，交到謹慎而敬重它的研究者手裡。
Kingdom of Sand#007.speaker: Junes

Kingdom of Sand#008.src: I would be in your debt if you could try to retrieve it, for the sake of history.
Kingdom of Sand#008.dst: 如果你願意試著把它取回來，為了歷史，我會欠你一個人情。
Kingdom of Sand#008.speaker: Junes

Kingdom of Sand#009.src: Attempt to enter the bandit hideout at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Kingdom of Sand#011.src: Even if yer a crooked soldier, we can't jus let yer in.
Kingdom of Sand#011.dst: 就算你是個歪掉的兵，我們也不能隨便放你進去。
Kingdom of Sand#011.speaker: Vault Guard

Kingdom of Sand#012.src: That is, unless yer got the password?
Kingdom of Sand#012.speaker: Vault Guard

Kingdom of Sand#013.src: Didn’t think so. Now get lost, wasted enough of my t-
Kingdom of Sand#013.dst: 我就知道。快滾吧，浪費我夠多時——
Kingdom of Sand#013.speaker: Vault Guard

Kingdom of Sand#014.src: Now would you look at that... Even soldiers think they can waltz in ere.
Kingdom of Sand#014.dst: 喔喲，你看看這個……連當兵的都覺得自己可以大搖大擺走進來。
Kingdom of Sand#014.speaker: Tarek

Kingdom of Sand#015.src: Having fun thinking of a password? Sorry to spoil your lunch, but there isn’t one!
Kingdom of Sand#015.dst: 想密語想得開心嗎？很抱歉掃你的興，根本沒有密語這種東西！
Kingdom of Sand#015.speaker: Geo

Kingdom of Sand#016.src: We could use a few more officials on the roster.
Kingdom of Sand#016.dst: 我們名單上倒是可以再多幾個當官的。
Kingdom of Sand#016.speaker: Geo

Kingdom of Sand#017.src: If yer are on the liberal side of the law, talk to us outside.
Kingdom of Sand#017.dst: 如果你站在律法比較寬鬆的那一邊，出來外面跟我們談。
Kingdom of Sand#017.speaker: Tarek

Kingdom of Sand#018.dst: 到 [{~1}, {~2}, -{~3}] 跟 Geo 和 Tarek 碰面。

Kingdom of Sand#019.src: Looks like yer in. Look, there ain't a password cause we're meant to be the best thieves in the land, right?
Kingdom of Sand#019.dst: 看來你有意思。聽著，沒有密語是因為我們可是這塊土地上最厲害的賊，對吧？
Kingdom of Sand#019.speaker: Tarek

Kingdom of Sand#020.src: So what good are words? Yer gotta give the guard somethin' stolen, aintcha!
Kingdom of Sand#020.dst: 那講幾句話有什麼用？你得拿「偷來的東西」給守衛看啊！
Kingdom of Sand#020.speaker: Tarek

Kingdom of Sand#021.src: And we just so happen to have the opportunity of a lifetime for you. {p} has gone soft see, a new Mayor is cleaning things up.
Kingdom of Sand#021.dst: 而我們手上剛好有個千載難逢的機會給你。{p} 最近軟了，新來的鎮長正在整頓。
Kingdom of Sand#021.speaker: Geo

Kingdom of Sand#022.src: Well, we can't have government not under our control. {p} will always be bandit capital.
Kingdom of Sand#022.dst: 我們可不能讓政府脫離掌控。{p} 永遠都得是強盜之都。
Kingdom of Sand#022.speaker: Tarek

Kingdom of Sand#023.src: So how about we give him a taste of his own medicine, and get hold of that journal he keeps? I'm sure that’ll dig up some dirt on him.
Kingdom of Sand#023.dst: 所以不如以其人之道還治其人之身，把他寫的那本日誌弄到手？我保證那能挖出不少他的爛帳。
Kingdom of Sand#023.speaker: Geo

Kingdom of Sand#024.src: And by "we", we mean you. You'll have to sneak through the mansion and avoid guards.
Kingdom of Sand#024.dst: 而所謂的「我們」，指的是你。你得溜進宅邸、避開守衛。
Kingdom of Sand#024.speaker: Tarek

Kingdom of Sand#025.src: He keeps his journal in the highest room. Might need to distract some guards too. It's the biggest mansion in {p}, can't miss it.
Kingdom of Sand#025.dst: 他把日誌放在最高的那個房間。可能還得引開幾個守衛。那是 {p} 最大的宅邸，你不會找不到。
Kingdom of Sand#025.speaker: Tarek

Kingdom of Sand#026.src: Sneak into the highest room of the {p} Mansion at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Kingdom of Sand#026.dst: 潛入 [{~1}, {~2}, -{~3}] 的 {p} Mansion 最高層房間。

Kingdom of Sand#027.src: Arh, there's the thief I saw a-sneakin' round the Mansion! Get them!
Kingdom of Sand#027.dst: 啊哈，就是這個賊在宅邸附近鬼鬼祟祟！抓住他！
Kingdom of Sand#027.speaker: Mansion Guard

Kingdom of Sand#028.src: Yer know you could get kicked out of the army fer this.
Kingdom of Sand#028.dst: 你知道嗎，幹這種事是會被踢出軍隊的。
Kingdom of Sand#028.speaker: Tarek

Kingdom of Sand#029.src: Heh, guess yer the real thing. Hop in, lets get out of ‘ere.
Kingdom of Sand#029.dst: 呵，看來你是玩真的。上車吧，我們離開這裡。
Kingdom of Sand#029.speaker: Tarek

Kingdom of Sand#030.src: That journal is more valuable than any gem, you'll be able to get in fer sure.
Kingdom of Sand#030.dst: 那本日誌比任何寶石都值錢，你這下鐵定進得去了。
Kingdom of Sand#030.speaker: Tarek

Kingdom of Sand#031.src: Bring the journal from the {p} Mansion to the Vault Guard to enter the hideout.
Kingdom of Sand#031.dst: 把 {p} Mansion 的日誌帶去給 Vault Guard，換取進入藏身處。

Kingdom of Sand#034.src: Oh, this is quite the password, "soldier". I think this will do nicely, on you go.
Kingdom of Sand#034.dst: 喔，這密語可真夠份量，「士兵」。我看這樣就很好，進去吧。
Kingdom of Sand#034.speaker: Vault Guard

Kingdom of Sand#035.src: Look for the sceptre within the bandit hideout at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Kingdom of Sand#035.dst: 在 [{~1}, {~2}, -{~3}] 的強盜藏身處裡尋找權杖。

Kingdom of Sand#036.src: Right, then, you lot. Give me your reports.
Kingdom of Sand#036.dst: 好了，你們幾個。把報告交上來。
Kingdom of Sand#036.speaker: Bandit Leader

Kingdom of Sand#037.src: Gold relieved from Mesa travellers last week counted just over {~} bars.
Kingdom of Sand#037.dst: 上禮拜從 Mesa 旅人身上「取得」的黃金，數出來剛好超過 {~} 條。
Kingdom of Sand#037.speaker: Bandit

Kingdom of Sand#039.src: We're working on exposing that blasted {p} Mayor with a stolen journal. {p} should be back under Creden Tibus control within the week.
Kingdom of Sand#039.dst: 我們正在用偷來的日誌把那個該死的 {p} 鎮長搞下台。一週之內 {p} 就會重新回到 Creden Tibus 手上。
Kingdom of Sand#039.speaker: Bandit

Kingdom of Sand#041.src: Well... someone's been hanging around the old tomb. An archaeologist, looks like. I reckon she's lookin' for the sceptre.
Kingdom of Sand#041.dst: 呃……有人一直在那座老陵墓附近晃。看起來是個考古學家。我猜她在找那支權杖。
Kingdom of Sand#041.speaker: Bandit

Kingdom of Sand#042.src: Ah... that sceptre's too valuable for us to lose. Maybe we pay 'er a visit, persuade her to... stop lookin'.
Kingdom of Sand#042.dst: 啊……那支權杖太值錢了，不能弄丟。也許我們該去拜訪她一下，說服她……別再找了。
Kingdom of Sand#042.speaker: Bandit Leader

Kingdom of Sand#043.src: Right you are, boss. Good thing no one will think to look for it in that broken cart by the river, ey?!
Kingdom of Sand#043.dst: 沒錯，老大。還好沒人會想到去河邊那台壞掉的推車裡找它，對吧？！
Kingdom of Sand#043.speaker: Bandit

Kingdom of Sand#044.src: Shut it, you fool! What did I just say? Anyway, I'll decide what to do with this archaeologist. Dismissed!
Kingdom of Sand#044.dst: 閉嘴，你這個蠢貨！我剛剛說什麼？算了，這個考古學家怎麼處理我自己決定。解散！
Kingdom of Sand#044.speaker: Bandit Leader

Kingdom of Sand#047.src: We might be bandits, but we’re not stupid. That sceptre is left better off alone.
Kingdom of Sand#047.dst: 我們是強盜沒錯，但我們不笨。那支權杖最好別去碰。
Kingdom of Sand#047.speaker: Bandit Leader

Kingdom of Sand#050.src: Return to the tomb and give Junes the sceptre at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Kingdom of Sand#050.dst: 回到陵墓，把權杖交給 [{~1}, {~2}, -{~3}] 的 Junes。

Kingdom of Sand#051.src: Ah, {u}. I couldn't help myself - I simply had to see the tomb up close.
Kingdom of Sand#051.dst: 啊，{u}。我實在忍不住——非得靠近看看這座陵墓不可。
Kingdom of Sand#051.speaker: Junes

Kingdom of Sand#052.src: You have no idea how tempted I am to go inside, but I doubt I'd make it out alive.
Kingdom of Sand#052.dst: 你不知道我有多想進去，可是我懷疑自己出不來。
