Meaningful Holiday#091.src: All because this enormous feast was not enough. {p} bought all the food, cheap or expensive.
Meaningful Holiday#091.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#092.src: I'm here to remind you the real meaning of this day. To think of others..
Meaningful Holiday#092.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#093.src: I will return your meal tonight, but while you eat it... I want you to remember every empty mouth it could have fed.
Meaningful Holiday#093.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#094.src: Share what you have, be thankful for what you are given.
Meaningful Holiday#094.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#096.src: Well, looks like you came through yet again Nick.

Meaningful Holiday#097.src: I came to see if I could help out. But it looks like you've done it.
Meaningful Holiday#097.speaker: Santa

Meaningful Holiday#098.src: Well, I guess there is only one thing left to do to complete this scene.
Meaningful Holiday#098.speaker: Santa

Meaningful Holiday#099.src: Hope you all have a merry craftmas. Ho-ho!
Meaningful Holiday#099.speaker: Santa

Meaningful Holiday#101.src: It looks like my little speech brought the rich back down to earth.
Meaningful Holiday#101.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#102.src: They gave us half of their feast. Can you believe they still had leftovers?
Meaningful Holiday#102.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#103.src: All of that food, going straight to waste.
Meaningful Holiday#103.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#104.src: They have no idea what they have, compared to these poor folks.
Meaningful Holiday#104.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#105.src: You might be wondering why I know Santa. Well, he's my brother.
Meaningful Holiday#105.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#106.src: Me and my siblings take care of people at Craftmas. My area is the {p} desert. I guess you could call me Sanda Claus, heh.
Meaningful Holiday#106.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#107.src: It's people like you that keep the real meaning of this holiday alive. It gets harder every year as the meaning is distorted. Here is a personal gift from me. Thank you.
Meaningful Holiday#107.speaker: Nick

Memory Paranoia#001.src: Oh, a human? If I could beg your pardon a moment...could I talk to you about the mansion here?
Memory Paranoia#001.speaker: Atisun

Memory Paranoia#002.src: It was not always so dilapidated. It once stood tall, a monument to the family of Caritat, who constructed it from the ground up.
Memory Paranoia#002.speaker: Atisun

Memory Paranoia#003.src: The Caritats were unlike any other. Uncharacteristically selfless and helpful. Their wealth was everyone’s wealth as far as they were concerned.
Memory Paranoia#003.speaker: Atisun

Memory Paranoia#004.src: But... Eventually... Erm, we’re not entirely sure what happened, only rumours have surfaced over the years, but...things took a turn, shall we say.
Memory Paranoia#004.speaker: Atisun

Memory Paranoia#005.src: Because, aah...how shall I put this... One day they were all...discovered dead. Murdered. By each other.
Memory Paranoia#005.speaker: Atisun

Memory Paranoia#006.src: I am the last remaining descendant, Atisun Caritat. I was the only survivor of the... incident. I was only an infant when I was found by a passerby.
Memory Paranoia#006.speaker: Atisun

Memory Paranoia#007.src: Since, erm...since there was no one alive to report the incident, it wasn't discovered until days later when a traveller passing by took notice of the mansion.
Memory Paranoia#007.speaker: Atisun

Memory Paranoia#008.src: I do not believe that my family simply went mad, but I do not know what happened. I want to know the truth. I think this mansion still holds the answers I'm looking for.
Memory Paranoia#008.speaker: Atisun

Memory Paranoia#009.src: Yet, I am...scared of this place. It is the ruins of the life I should have had. The spirits of the dead are still there...cursed. I need someone else to uncover my heritage.
Memory Paranoia#009.speaker: Atisun

Memory Paranoia#010.src: Don't you worry, like my ancestors, I'm a generous man. If you help me, I will reward you handsomely. All you have to do, is go in there and find answers. I'm sure the past won't haunt us both.
Memory Paranoia#010.speaker: Atisun

Memory Paranoia#012.src: Learn the story of the Caritat Family.

Memory Paranoia#013.src: This check is made out to a charity for a lot of emeralds.
Memory Paranoia#013.speaker: Check

Memory Paranoia#014.src: It's so nice that the Caritats are donating all of these supplies to the struggling people in the forest.
Memory Paranoia#014.speaker: Maid

Memory Paranoia#015.src: He seems to be very engrossed in his writing.
Memory Paranoia#015.speaker: Mr. Caritat

Memory Paranoia#016.src: I've heard about weird things happening around the house. People are saying the mansion might be haunted!
Memory Paranoia#016.speaker: Maid

Memory Paranoia#017.src: Ghosts? Preposterous! This mansion isn't haunted, don't believe those silly rumors!
Memory Paranoia#017.speaker: Servant

Memory Paranoia#019.src: Mister Caritat is always writing in that book, always so intensely. I wonder what he is writing.
Memory Paranoia#019.speaker: Servant

Memory Paranoia#020.src: He won't even tell me what he's writing.
Memory Paranoia#020.speaker: Timmy

Memory Paranoia#021.src: I'll bet he's writing insults about us. He can't be as nice as he appears.
Memory Paranoia#021.speaker: Maid

Memory Paranoia#022.src: I accidentally dropped my Library Key down the drain, do you think my dad will be angry?
Memory Paranoia#022.speaker: Timmy

Memory Paranoia#023.src: No, Mister Caritat is very forgiving. I doubt he'd be upset, especially if it was an accident.
Memory Paranoia#023.speaker: Maid

Memory Paranoia#024.src: I still want to find the key though, do you know where I should look?
Memory Paranoia#024.speaker: Timmy

Memory Paranoia#025.src: Well, the drainage pipes have probably taken the key to the basement in the southeast corner of the mansion by now, that's most likely where it is.
Memory Paranoia#025.speaker: Servant

Memory Paranoia#026.src: Enter the basement and recover the Library Key.

Memory Paranoia#028.src: Enter the hole in the wall.

Memory Paranoia#029.src: Timmy, is something bothering you? You have been acting so weird lately.
Memory Paranoia#029.speaker: Mister Caritat

Memory Paranoia#030.src: You cannot command me, mortal! You and all of your inferior species will bow to the darkness!
Memory Paranoia#030.speaker: Timmy

Memory Paranoia#031.src: I don't know what game you are playing, Timmy. But I will not stand for it any longer, snap out of it!
Memory Paranoia#031.speaker: Mister Caritat

Memory Paranoia#032.src: You shall pay for your insolence, mortal!
Memory Paranoia#032.speaker: Timmy

Memory Paranoia#033.src: Dark magic? What foul books have you been reading? And what's that in your hand?
Memory Paranoia#033.speaker: Mister Caritat

Memory Paranoia#034.src: Casting spells with a black spoon? I'm going to get rid of this foul thing!
Memory Paranoia#034.speaker: Mister Caritat

Memory Paranoia#035.src: That is an item beyond you, mortal. Give it back to me this instant!
Memory Paranoia#035.speaker: Timmy

Memory Paranoia#036.src: Return the spoon to the Kitchen.

Memory Paranoia#038.src: Attention, attention everyone! I have an announcement I'd like to make!
Memory Paranoia#038.speaker: Mister Caritat

Memory Paranoia#039.src: My son, Timothy, has just turned eighteen today.
Memory Paranoia#039.speaker: Mister Caritat

Memory Paranoia#040.src: Now, there have been a few slight hiccups over the years, but we've made it through mostly in one piece.
Memory Paranoia#040.speaker: Mister Caritat

Memory Paranoia#041.src: And I'd like to say, I'm very proud of him. To Timothy, a new man!
Memory Paranoia#041.speaker: Mister Caritat

Memory Paranoia#042.src: Thank you very much, Dad, and everyone here. Here's to more years of health-
Memory Paranoia#042.speaker: Timothy

Memory Paranoia#043.src: Please, everyone stay calm. I'm sure it's just the cooks spilling something...
Memory Paranoia#043.speaker: Mister Caritat

Memory Paranoia#045.src: Oh my god... what is that thing?!
Memory Paranoia#045.speaker: Baker

Memory Paranoia#046.src: Everyone out, now! We can't fight these things!
Memory Paranoia#046.speaker: Chef

Memory Paranoia#048.src: Speak to people who haven't fled from the disaster.

Memory Paranoia#049.src: My god...what is wrong with this place? No matter what I do, what I try...
Memory Paranoia#049.speaker: Mr. Caritat

Memory Paranoia#050.src: How was any of that even possible? What are we going to tell their families?
Memory Paranoia#050.speaker: Timothy

Memory Paranoia#051.src: ...Timothy, I'm going to ask you something, and I need you to answer me honestly. Were you...were you responsible for this?
Memory Paranoia#051.speaker: Mr. Caritat

Memory Paranoia#052.src: No, of course not! I overcame that years ago, you know that, I can't believe you still suspect me of-
Memory Paranoia#052.speaker: Timothy

Memory Paranoia#053.src: Ah, sir, we did find something rather unusual in the kitchen that might interest you? Maybe?
Memory Paranoia#053.speaker: Servant

Memory Paranoia#054.src: What- Out with it! What did you find?! Please, please tell me I'm wrong!!
Memory Paranoia#054.speaker: Mr. Caritat

Memory Paranoia#055.src: We found this charred-looking black spoon. I've worked here for years, and I've never seen any spoons of this style in the mansion.
Memory Paranoia#055.speaker: Servant

Memory Paranoia#056.src: Wait, that spoon? I remember sneaking into your study that one time to get it, but how did it survive the fire?
Memory Paranoia#056.speaker: Timothy

Memory Paranoia#057.src: Wait, you got it from my STUDY?! You...you idiot! Do you have any idea what you stupidly, yet inadvertently have done?! You must NEVER go in my study!!
Memory Paranoia#057.speaker: Mr. Caritat

Memory Paranoia#061.src: Speak with the Possessed Mr. Caritat.

Memory Paranoia#062.src: IT WHICH STARTED THE WAR SHALL RISE ONCE MORE. FROM THE REALM OF SHADOWS, DECEIT AND PAIN.
Memory Paranoia#062.speaker: Mr. Caritat

Memory Paranoia#063.src: FOREVER TRAPPED, FROM WHENCE IT CAME. THROUGH THE WEAK POINT BETWEEN REALMS IT. WILL. RISE. AGAIN!
Memory Paranoia#063.speaker: Mr. Caritat

Memory Paranoia#065.src: Bring the key to Timmy's bedroom.

Memory Paranoia#068.src: Bring the key to the Master Bedroom.

Memory Paranoia#073.src: FROM THE SOILS OF DOOM THE SERVANT LAID
Memory Paranoia#073.speaker: Mr. Caritat

Memory Paranoia#074.src: BREAK THROUGH THE REALMS TO THE LAND OF TRADE.
Memory Paranoia#074.speaker: Mr. Caritat

Memory Paranoia#075.src: CORRUPT THE WORLD WITH SEEDS OF PAIN
Memory Paranoia#075.speaker: Mr. Caritat

Memory Paranoia#078.src: Escape the flaming mansion through the back door.

Memory Paranoia#081.src: No, no! I said three feet left, you absolute...
Memory Paranoia#081.speaker: Caritat Senior

Memory Paranoia#082.src: Mr. Caritat! What are you doing?!
Memory Paranoia#082.speaker: Lari

Memory Paranoia#083.src: What are you doing here, Elf? You need proper equipment to be on this site-
Memory Paranoia#083.speaker: Caritat Senior

Memory Paranoia#084.src: Mr Caritat, you can't build a house here!
Memory Paranoia#084.speaker: Lari

Memory Paranoia#085.src: I can do whatever I like here, I bought the land.
Memory Paranoia#085.speaker: Caritat Senior

Memory Paranoia#086.src: You don't understand! This is where it came... this is where the darkness invaded!
Memory Paranoia#086.speaker: Lari

Memory Paranoia#087.src: Don't be preposterous. I'm building here to show the people that there's simply nothing to worry about!
Memory Paranoia#087.speaker: Caritat Senior

Memory Paranoia#088.src: Besides, even if there was something, now that Dullahan's gone, it'll go too.
Memory Paranoia#088.speaker: Caritat Senior

Memory Paranoia#089.src: What?! He wasn't the one causing all this, it was-
Memory Paranoia#089.speaker: Lari

Memory Paranoia#090.src: Well of course you would think that. You and him had some... history, didn't you?
Memory Paranoia#090.speaker: Caritat Senior

Memory Paranoia#091.src: I... Please, Mr Caritat. You don't understand what you're doing...
Memory Paranoia#091.speaker: Lari

Memory Paranoia#092.src: I am securing some prime real-estate right here. Oh... Perhaps that is why you're here?
Memory Paranoia#092.speaker: Caritat Senior

Memory Paranoia#094.src: Trying to expand elven territories, are you?! Well, I'll be having none of that! Leave, before I have my men escort you!
Memory Paranoia#094.speaker: Caritat Senior

Memory Paranoia#095.src: Hey! Human! Are you alright?! Please, calm down, quit flailing around, you're safe!
Memory Paranoia#095.speaker: Atisun

Memory Paranoia#097.src: Oh thank goodness, you're back to us. I was so worried... er, you might not recall. Let me explain...
Memory Paranoia#097.speaker: Atisun

Memory Paranoia#098.src: It... it seemed like you were possessed. You stood in the hall for... I don't know how long. I couldn't snap you out of it, no matter what I tried.
Memory Paranoia#098.speaker: Atisun

Memory Paranoia#099.src: Voices that weren't yours, you spoke out their moments and thoughts. The maids, my father... everyone. I... you said what I needed to hear.
Memory Paranoia#099.speaker: Atisun

Memory Paranoia#100.src: My great grandfather, wanting to prove to everyone that the forest was still good, built his mansion atop the very spot that was acclaimed to be the cause of the Decay.
Memory Paranoia#100.speaker: Atisun

Memory Paranoia#101.src: My father tried to continue the traditions... but all of it was burned to ashes. I must consider myself lucky that I did not fall with them.
Memory Paranoia#101.speaker: Atisun

Memory Paranoia#102.src: And what emerged from that spot? Who knows... but, whatever it was... the darkness must have lingered, and drove them all to madness.
Memory Paranoia#102.speaker: Atisun

Memory Paranoia#103.src: I'm sorry you went through that ordeal... I would suggest seeing a healer as soon as possible.
Memory Paranoia#103.speaker: Atisun

Memory Paranoia#104.src: I will make sure no one enters this house again. It is cursed. Thank you for helping me.
Memory Paranoia#104.speaker: Atisun

Misadventure on the Sea#001.src: Hello there soldier! What can I get you?
Misadventure on the Sea#001.speaker: Barman

Misadventure on the Sea#002.src: I'll take {~} {p} Whiskeys. One for me, one for this chap.
Misadventure on the Sea#002.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#004.src: So... I've seen ya around town. I saw how happy that guy was when you brought him some journal.
Misadventure on the Sea#004.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#006.src: So... Soldier. Are ya up for sailin' the ocean with me? I got a fancier boat than that seaskipper!
Misadventure on the Sea#006.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#007.src: I figured you'd be interested in explorin' the waters!
Misadventure on the Sea#007.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#008.src: I'll wait for ya on the docks. Don't worry, ya can't miss the boat!
Misadventure on the Sea#008.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#010.src: There you are! Ready? Follow me, the boat's over here!
Misadventure on the Sea#010.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#011.src: Look at this.. Magnificent! Much better than whatever the Seaskipper is using!
Misadventure on the Sea#011.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#012.src: Well, what are you waiting for? Hop aboard!
Misadventure on the Sea#012.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#013.src: Then it's settled, we're goin' on an adventure!
Misadventure on the Sea#013.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#014.src: Buckle up, we got waves to catch.
Misadventure on the Sea#014.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#015.src: So... I should warn ya', this is actually my first time sailing...
Misadventure on the Sea#015.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#016.src: It doesn't seem too difficult though, a little to the left...
Misadventure on the Sea#016.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#017.src: Hmm, looks like we're not the only ones out on the water today.
Misadventure on the Sea#017.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#018.src: They are a bit too head on, don't you think?
Misadventure on the Sea#018.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#019.src: I'm trying to steer the ship but it's not budging...
Misadventure on the Sea#019.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#023.src: I honestly, truly can't believe you fell for that. Let me sum it up for you...
Misadventure on the Sea#023.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#024.src: Some extremely suspicious pirate comes up, offers you a drink, and leads you to his suspicious boat.
Misadventure on the Sea#024.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#025.src: Any normal person would've turned back by then. But what do you do? You hop on! Well, now you're stuck with us.
Misadventure on the Sea#025.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#026.src: Let me make this quick. This boat needs renovation, and we want you to do it.
Misadventure on the Sea#026.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#027.src: Why? You're a soldier! All you do is take orders! Anyway, we'll need you to clean our stuff. Here, get out.
Misadventure on the Sea#027.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#029.src: I told you to stay back!
Misadventure on the Sea#029.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#031.src: So, there's quite a few skeletons in there, and we never bothered throwin' them out!
Misadventure on the Sea#031.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#032.src: Go ahead, here's a sponge for the dried blood as well. Just wack the skeletons with it!
Misadventure on the Sea#032.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#033.src: If you need me, I'll be on the deck. And, uh, don't go in the hold. We've got a BIG rat problem.
Misadventure on the Sea#033.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#034.src: Also, for the sake of my crew, could you be more cooperative? I don't have an unlimited amount of these potions.
Misadventure on the Sea#034.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#035.src: Clean the bodies in the boat. Look for clues on how to escape at the same time. -Bodies cleaned: #/{~}

Misadventure on the Sea#036.src: Hey, so you're our personal guard, huh?
Misadventure on the Sea#036.speaker: Pirate

Misadventure on the Sea#038.src: That ladder leads to the hold, but right now it's locked... We've got a severe case of rats.
Misadventure on the Sea#038.speaker: Pirate

Misadventure on the Sea#039.src: Pep is just a treasure, ain't I right? I'm glad you're taking care of him too!
Misadventure on the Sea#039.speaker: Pirate

Misadventure on the Sea#040.src: Honip has a pet chicken, weird right?
Misadventure on the Sea#040.speaker: Pirate

Misadventure on the Sea#041.src: I bet he got inspiration from that weird guy on his island...
Misadventure on the Sea#041.speaker: Pirate

Misadventure on the Sea#042.src: What? You murdered that guy's most prized chicken? You're an odd one, soldier.
Misadventure on the Sea#042.speaker: Pirate

Misadventure on the Sea#043.src: Oh, uh... Don't worry about that, 'ay?
Misadventure on the Sea#043.speaker: Pirate

Misadventure on the Sea#045.src: Oh, that's my cannon! Pretty cool, right? I made it using a bunch of arm- Nevermind...
Misadventure on the Sea#045.speaker: Seth

Misadventure on the Sea#047.src: He's a strong chicken alright, trust me on that one.
Misadventure on the Sea#047.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#049.src: I'm just goin' to... Wait here... With my cannons...
Misadventure on the Sea#049.speaker: Seth

Misadventure on the Sea#050.src: Talk to Honip on the deck to get your next task

Misadventure on the Sea#051.src: Hey! The boat's lookin' real nice now!
Misadventure on the Sea#051.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#052.src: I'll probably let you rest so- hold on.
Misadventure on the Sea#052.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#053.src: Ho-Honip! One of the guys said he saw something really weird coming right for us!
Misadventure on the Sea#053.speaker: Pirate

Misadventure on the Sea#056.src: We-we don't know! We can't exactly see it, but it seems huge!
Misadventure on the Sea#056.speaker: Pirate

Misadventure on the Sea#058.src: Uh... Where am I supposed to be looking at, exactly?
Misadventure on the Sea#058.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#059.src: I swear, it felt like the whole ocean was getting crazy a second ago!
Misadventure on the Sea#059.speaker: Pirate

Misadventure on the Sea#060.src: If this is another one of your jokes...
Misadventure on the Sea#060.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#063.src: I don't know, this wasn't planned!
Misadventure on the Sea#063.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#064.src: Soldier, now's your time to shine! Scare it off with one of your spells or something!
Misadventure on the Sea#064.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#069.src: I knew you had it in ya, haha!
Misadventure on the Sea#069.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#070.src: What a show! Come, I've got some things to tell ya!
Misadventure on the Sea#070.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#071.src: I don't know where that creature came from, but thanks to you it's gone.
Misadventure on the Sea#071.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#072.src: I've got something else for you to tackle. It's about... the rats.
Misadventure on the Sea#072.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#073.src: Come to the hold, I'll explain on the way.
Misadventure on the Sea#073.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#074.src: I think we have quite a hellish problem on our hands.
Misadventure on the Sea#074.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#075.src: I'm not sure what y'all find there, but these are NOT normal rats.
Misadventure on the Sea#075.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#076.src: So please, get in there... and kill everything, alright?
Misadventure on the Sea#076.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#077.src: I've got faith in ya. Here goes nothin'!
Misadventure on the Sea#077.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#078.src: Soldier, now's your time to shine! Scare it off with one of your spells or something!
Misadventure on the Sea#078.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#079.src: Just cast one of your fancy spells!
Misadventure on the Sea#079.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#080.src: That was... Phew... That was something.
Misadventure on the Sea#080.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#081.src: Now, for an even bigger surprise...
Misadventure on the Sea#081.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#082.src: What the hell soldier?? What don't you get in the "soldier" part of your job?
Misadventure on the Sea#082.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#083.src: Come, let's figure some things out.
Misadventure on the Sea#083.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#084.src: You've been a massive disappointment, y'know?
Misadventure on the Sea#084.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#085.src: But you can still redeem yourself.
Misadventure on the Sea#085.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#086.src: Follow me, I'll explain on the way.
Misadventure on the Sea#086.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#087.src: I mentioned a rat problem earlier... It's, uh, not a small one.
Misadventure on the Sea#087.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#088.src: We've got gunpowder to retrieve, so you're the one who's gonna clear the hold.
Misadventure on the Sea#088.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#089.src: So get in there... and try to kill everything, alright?
Misadventure on the Sea#089.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#090.src: Don't be as bad as earlier. You're a soldier.
Misadventure on the Sea#090.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#093.src: I expected you to do somethin', soldier, not him!
Misadventure on the Sea#093.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#095.src: I have another task for you. It's about... the rats.
Misadventure on the Sea#095.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#096.src: See, I really don't think we have your usual type of problem.
Misadventure on the Sea#096.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#097.src: Come to the hold, I'll explain on the way.
Misadventure on the Sea#097.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#098.src: We sometimes hear unusually load footsteps, along with some really eerie squeaking...
Misadventure on the Sea#098.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#099.src: That's why we're not too fond of goin' in... But our gunpowder there! We need it, as pirates!
Misadventure on the Sea#099.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#100.src: So, I need you to get in... and kill everything, alright?
Misadventure on the Sea#100.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#101.src: Here goes nothing. Snoo, ya stay there!
Misadventure on the Sea#101.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#102.src: Explore the hold and kill the rats

Misadventure on the Sea#103.src: Defeat the Colossal Rat in the hold

Misadventure on the Sea#104.src: Use the gunpowder and the fuse to activate the cannon and escape

Misadventure on the Sea#105.src: Hey there! Ya bringin' me good news?
Misadventure on the Sea#105.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#106.src: You took care of these damn thieving rodents? A... colossal rat you say?
Misadventure on the Sea#106.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#107.src: Nicely done, I knew I could count on ya! C'mere, take these!
Misadventure on the Sea#107.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#108.src: Anyway, for now, you can go rest and do whatever you want!
Misadventure on the Sea#108.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#109.src: Hey there! Ya bringin' me good news?
Misadventure on the Sea#109.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#110.src: You took care of these damn thieving rodents? A... colossal rat you say?
Misadventure on the Sea#110.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#111.src: Well, shiver me timbers! You did redeem yourself soldier!
Misadventure on the Sea#111.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#112.src: Anyway, for now, you can go rest and do whatever you want!
Misadventure on the Sea#112.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#113.src: Hey there! Ya bringin' me good news?
Misadventure on the Sea#113.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#114.src: You took care of these damn thieving rodents? A... colossal rat you say?
Misadventure on the Sea#114.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#115.src: That sounds absolutely terrifying! And ya did that alone! You know what, her', take these.
Misadventure on the Sea#115.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#116.src: Anyway, for now, you can go rest and do whatever you want!
Misadventure on the Sea#116.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#117.src: Hey! What do you think you're doin'?!
Misadventure on the Sea#117.speaker: Pirate Guard

Misadventure on the Sea#119.src: No, but they did a great job in the hold! Some gunpowder went missing though.
Misadventure on the Sea#119.speaker: Seth

Misadventure on the Sea#123.src: Find out where you are and a way to flee the island

Misadventure on the Sea#124.src: 'ey there soldier! Looks like ya're in a bit of a pickle! How 'bout ya hop on?'
Misadventure on the Sea#124.speaker: Seaskipper Captain

Misadventure on the Sea#125.src: Well... We're headed for {p}, the heart of the ocean! Which is safer than wherever you were, heh!
Misadventure on the Sea#125.speaker: Seaskipper Captain

Misadventure on the Sea#126.src: I was casually takin' a scenic detour when I saw you and your shiny equipment on that island.
Misadventure on the Sea#126.speaker: Seaskipper Captain

Misadventure on the Sea#127.src: So, ya gotta tell me what happened!
Misadventure on the Sea#127.speaker: Seaskipper Captain

Misadventure on the Sea#128.src: Oh, kidnapped by pirates I see! How unfortunate...
Misadventure on the Sea#128.speaker: Seaskipper Captain

Misadventure on the Sea#129.src: I guess that'll show ya, tryin' to avoid using good ol' seaskipper! I'm the only trustworthy one 'round here.
Misadventure on the Sea#129.speaker: Seaskipper Captain

Misadventure on the Sea#130.src: Well, I hope they weren't too bad with ya! Here, I'll make you travel to {p} for free as compensation.
Misadventure on the Sea#130.speaker: Seaskipper Captain

Misadventure on the Sea#131.src: Anyway, I can see the shore off in the distance! Hang tight, we're almost there!
Misadventure on the Sea#131.speaker: Seaskipper Captain

Mixed Feelings#000.src: Speak to Javen at the Corkus Docks.

Mixed Feelings#001.src: Mo’in lad! We don’t get many Wynn folks round ‘ere.
Mixed Feelings#001.speaker: Javen

Mixed Feelings#002.src: Welcome to old Javen’s tavern, what can I do yer for?
Mixed Feelings#002.speaker: Javen

Mixed Feelings#003.src: Let’s see... I can give ya some of the islands “Old Cork” Brew..
Mixed Feelings#003.speaker: Javen

Mixed Feelings#004.src: Seems like you are in luck today, adventurer.

Mixed Feelings#005.src: My day's been long, and you also look like you could do with a drink or two.

Mixed Feelings#006.src: There's no need to pay by yourself. Javen, we'll have two cups of the seasonal brew.

Mixed Feelings#008.src: Everything alright, lad? Looking a bit pale...
Mixed Feelings#008.speaker: Javen

Mixed Feelings#010.src: Oh by the mighty founders, everything is ruined!
Mixed Feelings#010.speaker: Javen

Mixed Feelings#012.src: You did this! Yer mad in the head! Possessed or summet!
Mixed Feelings#012.speaker: Javen

Mixed Feelings#013.src: Yer seem fine now though. What got inter ye lad? You went berserk like!
Mixed Feelings#013.speaker: Javen

Mixed Feelings#014.src: It weren’t just here neither. You ran outta here and wrecked all sorts! You better go find the people you affected and apologise
Mixed Feelings#014.speaker: Javen

Mixed Feelings#015.src: Talk to the citizens around the docks.

Mixed Feelings#016.src: The whole aqueduct is ruined! The cities fresh water is just draining into the ocean...
Mixed Feelings#016.speaker: Corkus City Citizen

Mixed Feelings#017.src: Ah! It's you! Back to wreck the rest of the city's infrastructure?! You're meant to be a tourist!
Mixed Feelings#017.speaker: Corkus City Citizen

Mixed Feelings#018.src: Wait... Weren't your eyes red before? Were you ill? It was a bit scary.
Mixed Feelings#018.speaker: Corkus City Citizen

Mixed Feelings#019.src: Oh.. You don't even remember? Well.. If you want to help, I need it right now.
Mixed Feelings#019.speaker: Corkus City Citizen

Mixed Feelings#020.src: The system needs to be rebooted, which can only be done down in the sewers.
Mixed Feelings#020.speaker: Corkus City Citizen

Mixed Feelings#021.src: Kind of a design flaw if you ask me.. But if you go down that trap door, you will find it in the sewers!
Mixed Feelings#021.speaker: Corkus City Citizen

Mixed Feelings#022.src: You fixed it? Everything you broke? That's one hell of a twisted personality.
Mixed Feelings#022.speaker: Corkus City Citizen

Mixed Feelings#023.src: Corkus has been urging tourists and envoys from the other provinces to gain recognition.
Mixed Feelings#023.speaker: Corkus City Citizen

Mixed Feelings#024.src: There are others that blame any outsiders for the problems of the islands.. They say they are patriots.. but honestly...
Mixed Feelings#024.speaker: Corkus City Citizen

Mixed Feelings#025.src: They are just awful people. They want to do anything to make non Corkians look bad.
Mixed Feelings#025.speaker: Corkus City Citizen

Mixed Feelings#026.src: If I were you, I'd better start asking around to find out more about that!
Mixed Feelings#026.speaker: Corkus City Citizen

Mixed Feelings#027.src: Speak to the other citizens around the docks.

Mixed Feelings#028.src: It’s THEM! Someone call the authorities! It’s the one who set my house on fire.
Mixed Feelings#028.speaker: Corkus City Citizen

Mixed Feelings#029.src: How could you do this and just come back all calm like? You were screaming your head off!
Mixed Feelings#029.speaker: Corkus City Citizen

Mixed Feelings#030.src: My house is still burning! Wait… You say you don’t have any memory of any of this?
Mixed Feelings#030.speaker: Corkus City Citizen

Mixed Feelings#031.src: Look, if you’re serious, you have a chance to help make it better.
Mixed Feelings#031.speaker: Corkus City Citizen

Mixed Feelings#032.src: There are valuables in a chest in there you must save before the whole place burns to the ground, get going!
Mixed Feelings#032.speaker: Corkus City Citizen

Mixed Feelings#033.src: You did it! So you weren't lying? Ugh, I guess you might just be trustworthy.
Mixed Feelings#033.speaker: Corkus City Citizen

Mixed Feelings#034.src: You know about the 'patriots' of Corkus?
Mixed Feelings#034.speaker: Corkus City Citizen

Mixed Feelings#035.src: Well this kind of maneuver is right up their alley.. It certainly made you look bad!
Mixed Feelings#035.speaker: Corkus City Citizen

Mixed Feelings#036.src: Now that you bring it up, I did hear a group of Corkians quietly discussing something about framing tourists.
Mixed Feelings#036.speaker: Corkus City Citizen

Mixed Feelings#037.src: I have no idea how they would make you do something against your will though...
Mixed Feelings#037.speaker: Corkus City Citizen

Mixed Feelings#038.src: Talk to the final victim of your rampage.

Mixed Feelings#039.src: Came back to wreck the rest of my work have you? Why aren't you all insane looking?
Mixed Feelings#039.speaker: Corkus City Citizen

Mixed Feelings#040.src: So now your story is you were not in control? It's easy to believe. You were mad!
Mixed Feelings#040.speaker: Corkus City Citizen

Mixed Feelings#041.src: I don't know if you have some kind of condition.. but if you want to help, I need it to clean up the mess you made.
Mixed Feelings#041.speaker: Corkus City Citizen

Mixed Feelings#042.src: I need to replace all the cargo you destroyed.
Mixed Feelings#042.speaker: Corkus City Citizen

Mixed Feelings#043.src: All you gotta do is get those crates here and put them back on the boats. The limit is {~} for each boat, not more not less!
Mixed Feelings#043.speaker: Corkus City Citizen

Mixed Feelings#044.src: Some weights might not be needed, but be careful, I don't wanna go diving after you.
Mixed Feelings#044.speaker: Corkus City Citizen

Mixed Feelings#045.src: You did it? ... -I mean, at last. Eh... I guess I was too fast with my judgement for once.
Mixed Feelings#045.speaker: Corkus City Citizen

Mixed Feelings#046.src: Hmm… As it happens I have seen some strange things around here.
Mixed Feelings#046.speaker: Corkus City Citizen

Mixed Feelings#047.src: During the night I saw something moving across the cliffs.. Looked like a personal balloon.
Mixed Feelings#047.speaker: Corkus City Citizen

Mixed Feelings#048.src: It wouldn't have been out of the ordinary except there are occasional blood trails leading from the balloon...
Mixed Feelings#048.speaker: Corkus City Citizen

Mixed Feelings#049.src: If you really want to approach these people… I guess all you would need to do is follow the trail of blood.
Mixed Feelings#049.speaker: Corkus City Citizen

Mixed Feelings#050.src: Can't say I recommend it but the trail starts near the aqueduct.
Mixed Feelings#050.speaker: Corkus City Citizen

Mixed Feelings#051.src: Follow the trail of blood and board the airship.

Mixed Feelings#053.src: Why are you here? I don't mean here and now, I mean why are you on our island?
Mixed Feelings#053.speaker: Rensa

Mixed Feelings#054.src: You have of course found yourself in front of me because you were a pawn in our attempts to save this nation.
Mixed Feelings#054.speaker: Rensa

Mixed Feelings#055.src: I suppose I should apologize, but truth is you are the reason for this movement. Not you personally... but your people.
Mixed Feelings#055.speaker: Rensa

Mixed Feelings#056.src: You... Look at yourself. You fight in a war you did not cause. You come from a land you don't even remember.
Mixed Feelings#056.speaker: Rensa

Mixed Feelings#057.src: We ask ourselves why would we invite people from two lands of sin. Invite a nation of warring travellers and a nation of greedy merchants to our doors?
Mixed Feelings#057.speaker: Rensa

Mixed Feelings#058.src: The Corkian people are above such mundane capitalism and brutality. We work as a nation to better all.
Mixed Feelings#058.speaker: Rensa

Mixed Feelings#059.src: You have been a pawn your entire existence on this world. The worst part is you don't even know it.
Mixed Feelings#059.speaker: Rensa

Mixed Feelings#060.src: Do you, for example - Know the name of your ultimate enemy? The reason for the war on your land?
Mixed Feelings#060.speaker: Rensa

Mixed Feelings#061.src: No? Didn't think so. I have no time for this. You served your purpose, even if you did try and redeem your barbaric behaviour... Kill them!
Mixed Feelings#061.speaker: Rensa

Mixed Feelings#062.src: Fight and evade the waves of mobs until the timer runs out.

Mixed Feelings#063.src: Tougher than I expected. You don’t mind if I interfere a bit, do you?
Mixed Feelings#063.speaker: Rensa

Mixed Feelings#065.src: You may have won this fight, but you are still the loser in this situation.
Mixed Feelings#065.speaker: Rensa

Mixed Feelings#066.src: Your eyes are still closed to the greater picture of it all. Corkus is the only place safe from it. I will make sure of it!
Mixed Feelings#066.speaker: Rensa

Mixed Feelings#067.src: There are still greater things in motion as we speak. Plans that will secure this island's safety.
Mixed Feelings#067.speaker: Rensa

Mixed Feelings#068.src: Fruma.. Gavel.. Wynn… It’s all a joke. We all sit on the cusp of this reality, fighting only the prelude to the real war.
Mixed Feelings#068.speaker: Rensa

Mixed Feelings#069.src: This is our farewell. I must depart before the short sighted government arrive. Good Luck with your struggle.
Mixed Feelings#069.speaker: Rensa

Mixed Feelings#071.src: Now look who we got over ‘ere! We were all wondering if you'd ever wake up.
Mixed Feelings#071.speaker: Javen

Mixed Feelings#072.src: Sorry we ever doubted ye. Weren't fair of us. What you drank was a rare brew designed to enrage and berserk someone.
Mixed Feelings#072.speaker: Javen

Mixed Feelings#073.src: Basically, it weren't yer fault lad. We never knew some Corkians were so closed minded.
Mixed Feelings#073.speaker: Javen

Mixed Feelings#074.src: Anyways! Look at what we got, thanks to you I acquired this little place!
Mixed Feelings#074.speaker: Javen

Mixed Feelings#075.src: By means of reparations have this on me. Yer always welcome round here.
Mixed Feelings#075.speaker: Javen

Murder Mystery#000.dst: 到 [-{~1}, -{~2}] 找 Detective Lorias 說話。

Murder Mystery#001.src: Stand back, human! This is a crime scene, under my authority. I cannot let you inside.
Murder Mystery#001.dst: 退後，人類！這裡是犯罪現場，歸我管。我不能讓你進去。
Murder Mystery#001.speaker: Detective Lorias

Murder Mystery#002.src: Although we are in need of some... assistance... and you are fairly experienced, are you not?
Murder Mystery#002.dst: 不過……我們確實需要一些協助……而你經驗還算豐富，對吧？
Murder Mystery#002.speaker: Detective Lorias

Murder Mystery#003.src: Well, straight to the point... do you think I might be able to hire you as a private investigator?
Murder Mystery#003.dst: 好，直說了吧——你覺得我有沒有可能雇你當私家偵探？
Murder Mystery#003.speaker: Detective Lorias

Murder Mystery#004.src: To put it bluntly, the owner of this house, Eminar, was murdered a few days ago, and what few leads we had have all gone cold.
Murder Mystery#004.dst: 講白一點，這棟房子的主人 Eminar 幾天前被謀殺了，而我們僅有的幾條線索全都斷了。
Murder Mystery#004.speaker: Detective Lorias

Murder Mystery#005.src: This is acting outside protocol, of course... but if you manage to catch the killer, I'm sure I could pull some strings and pay you for your work!
Murder Mystery#005.dst: 這當然是違反規定的……但只要你能抓到兇手，我一定想辦法動用關係，付你一筆酬勞！
Murder Mystery#005.speaker: Detective Lorias

Murder Mystery#006.src: I'll make sure no one stops you inside the crime scene. Head inside the house and see if you can find anything helpful.
Murder Mystery#006.dst: 我會確保沒有人在犯罪現場裡攔你。進屋去看看能不能找到什麼有用的東西。
Murder Mystery#006.speaker: Detective Lorias

Murder Mystery#007.src: My soldiers and I will keep watch outside the house, and make sure you're not disturbed. Be careful in there!
Murder Mystery#007.dst: 我和我的士兵會在屋外看著，保證沒人打擾你。裡面小心點！
Murder Mystery#007.speaker: Detective Lorias

Murder Mystery#008.src: Investigate the crime scene at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] for clues.

Murder Mystery#009.src: Ah, a human! A refreshing sight these days. You've come to see me, I presume? What brings you here?
Murder Mystery#009.dst: 啊，一個人類！這年頭看到還挺新鮮的。我猜你是來找我的？什麼風把你吹來的？
Murder Mystery#009.speaker: Rohem

Murder Mystery#010.src: An investigation!? Eminar? That's... that's absurd. I've done nothing wrong.
Murder Mystery#010.dst: 調查？！Eminar？這……這太荒唐了。我什麼壞事都沒做。
Murder Mystery#010.speaker: Rohem

Murder Mystery#011.src: Still, the poor man. Eminar and I were good friends, you know. If it could help find his killer, I may have some information for you... strictly off-record, of course...
Murder Mystery#011.dst: 不過，那可憐人。你知道嗎，我和 Eminar 是好朋友。如果能幫忙找出兇手，我或許有些消息可以給你……當然，絕對不能留下紀錄……
Murder Mystery#011.speaker: Rohem

Murder Mystery#012.src: Well. You see, there's an underground gambling den hidden in the city's sewers. Only the elite can get in, and Eminar happened to be a frequent visitor.
Murder Mystery#012.dst: 是這樣的。城裡的下水道藏著一間地下賭場。只有上流人士進得去，而 Eminar 剛好是常客。
Murder Mystery#012.speaker: Rohem

Murder Mystery#013.src: Once, he even brought me along with him.
Murder Mystery#013.dst: 有一次，他甚至帶我一起去。
Murder Mystery#013.speaker: Rohem

Murder Mystery#014.src: Eminar, though, he often tried to cheat the other gamblers. I suppose it was only a matter of time before they had enough; most do not take cheating lightly.
Murder Mystery#014.dst: 不過 Eminar 那個人，常常想騙其他賭客。我想他們會受夠也只是遲早的事；被出老千，沒幾個人吞得下去。
Murder Mystery#014.speaker: Rohem

Murder Mystery#015.src: Back to the point, many of them, including poor Eminar, had a symbol built into the sides of their homes, shaped like a snake. A proof of membership, you could say.
Murder Mystery#015.dst: 言歸正傳，他們之中很多人——包括可憐的 Eminar——都在自家牆上砌了一個蛇形的記號。可以說是會員證明吧。
Murder Mystery#015.speaker: Rohem

Murder Mystery#016.src: If you can find it, it will show you the way to get into the sewers. I'm sorry, I would tell you more if I knew more. But good luck with your investigation, sir.
Murder Mystery#016.dst: 你要是找得到那個記號，它會指引你進下水道的路。抱歉，我知道的就這麼多。祝你調查順利，先生。
Murder Mystery#016.speaker: Rohem

Murder Mystery#017.src: Return to the victim's house at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] to find a snake symbol.

Murder Mystery#018.src: Find the gamblers in the {p} sewers.
Murder Mystery#018.dst: 在 {p} 的下水道裡找到那群賭客。

Murder Mystery#019.src: How did ya find us down 'ere? I don't remember you... you're with the police, aren't ya? Here after Eminar, I suppose?
Murder Mystery#019.dst: 你怎麼摸到我們這下面來的？我不記得你……你是警察的人吧？我猜是為了 Eminar 來的？
Murder Mystery#019.speaker: Valimare

Murder Mystery#020.src: Yeah, we've 'eard about what happened to him. Murders don't happen every day up there, ya know. And as it happened, I saw Eminar down here, not too long ago...
Murder Mystery#020.dst: 對啦，他出的事我們聽說了。上面那邊可不是每天都在死人。而且說巧不巧，我不久前才在這下面看過 Eminar……
Murder Mystery#020.speaker: Valimare

Murder Mystery#021.src: Well... as long as I get a guarantee I won't be shut down, I'll help ya. This is a very profitable place, as I'm sure ya might've guessed.
Murder Mystery#021.dst: 這樣吧……只要你保證不查封我這裡，我就幫你。你應該猜得到，這地方很賺。
Murder Mystery#021.speaker: Valimare

Murder Mystery#022.src: He was brought down here by his friend one day. Rohem, it was. A fine customer, you understand. Never failed to pay his dues...
Murder Mystery#022.dst: 有一天他被他朋友帶下來。是 Rohem。一個好客人，你懂的。從來不欠帳……
Murder Mystery#022.speaker: Valimare

Murder Mystery#023.src: But the day he brought Eminar 'round, though, it got ugly fast. Kept borrowing Rohem's emeralds and losing, till neither of em had anythin' left.
Murder Mystery#023.dst: 可是他帶 Eminar 來的那天，場面很快就難看了。他一直跟 Rohem 借綠寶石，一直輸，輸到兩個人身上都不剩什麼。
Murder Mystery#023.speaker: Valimare

Murder Mystery#024.src: It was a good day for me, for obvious reasons, don'cha see! But Rohem was furious. Dead drunk, too, but what else is new!
Murder Mystery#024.dst: 那天對我來說是好日子，原因不用我說吧！可是 Rohem 氣炸了。而且醉得不省人事，不過那也不是新鮮事！
Murder Mystery#024.speaker: Valimare

Murder Mystery#025.src: Neither of 'em has been back since, though in Eminar's case, I can see why! And I hope that's enough for ya, 'cause that's all I got.
Murder Mystery#025.dst: 從那之後兩個人都沒再來過，不過 Eminar 那邊的原因我倒是很清楚！希望這些夠你用了，因為我知道的就這些。
Murder Mystery#025.speaker: Valimare

Murder Mystery#026.src: Now get out of 'ere; there's a back exit in the wall over there. Though, if ya ever fancy a game of 'jack, come back'n we'll be happy to serve ya!
Murder Mystery#026.dst: 現在走吧；那邊牆上有個後門。不過你哪天想玩兩把二十一點，隨時回來，我們很樂意招待！
Murder Mystery#026.speaker: Valimare

Murder Mystery#027.src: Confront Rohem about the murder at house #{~} in {p}.
Murder Mystery#027.dst: 到 {p} 的 {~} 號房子當面質問 Rohem 謀殺的事。

Murder Mystery#028.src: Ah... you again! You're back. I see that. I must admit, I did not expect you to return... so soon...
Murder Mystery#028.dst: 啊……又是你！你回來了。我看到了。老實說，我沒想到你會這麼快……回來……
Murder Mystery#028.speaker: Rohem

Murder Mystery#029.src: You really did find your way down there? Oh, that's... excellent... I hope the investigation is going well. Now if you'll just leave me be-
Murder Mystery#029.dst: 你真的找到下去的路了？哦，那……太好了……希望調查進行得順利。那麼，請你別再打擾我——
Murder Mystery#029.speaker: Rohem

Murder Mystery#030.src: Valimare? Bah! Why would you trust anything he says? He's a criminal! A scam artist! I mean, I did direct you to him, but...
Murder Mystery#030.dst: Valimare？呸！你憑什麼相信他說的話？他是個罪犯！騙子！我是把你指去找他沒錯，可是……
Murder Mystery#030.speaker: Rohem

Murder Mystery#031.src: He- He's the one you should be arresting. Eminar was a danger to society, got what he deserved, the fool-
Murder Mystery#031.dst: 該——該被你抓的是他。Eminar 對社會是個威脅，他是罪有應得，那個蠢貨——
Murder Mystery#031.speaker: Rohem

Murder Mystery#032.src: Wait! No! Don't turn me in! Can't you let me finish my drink in peace? Get out, get out, you can't prove anything!
Murder Mystery#032.dst: 等等！不！別把我交出去！你就不能讓我把酒喝完嗎？出去，出去，你什麼都證明不了！
Murder Mystery#032.speaker: Rohem

Murder Mystery#033.src: Besides, have you ever heard of a little thing called evidence? You don't have any proof!
Murder Mystery#033.dst: 再說了，你有沒有聽過一個叫「證據」的小東西？你根本拿不出證據！
Murder Mystery#033.speaker: Rohem

Murder Mystery#034.src: Now, officer, if you don't have a proper warrant, I expect you to vacate my property immediately!
Murder Mystery#034.dst: 警官，如果你沒有正式的搜索令，我要求你立刻離開我的房產！
Murder Mystery#034.speaker: Rohem

Murder Mystery#035.src: Find the murder weapon around Rohem's house at house #{~} in {p}.
Murder Mystery#035.dst: 到 {p} 的 {~} 號房子，在 Rohem 家附近找出兇器。

Murder Mystery#036.src: Hi! I'm digging a hole in my garden, just like Mr. Rohem did last night!
Murder Mystery#036.dst: 嗨！我在院子裡挖洞，就跟 Rohem 先生昨天晚上一樣！
Murder Mystery#036.speaker: Child

Murder Mystery#037.src: For the last time officer, would you either show me a warrant or get out of my- what are you doing in my garden?!
Murder Mystery#037.dst: 我最後再說一次，警官，你要嘛拿搜索令給我看，要嘛滾出我的——你在我院子裡做什麼？！
Murder Mystery#037.speaker: Rohem

Murder Mystery#038.src: A... a hatchet? I don't know what you mean, I- I've never seen that before in my life!
Murder Mystery#038.dst: 一……一把手斧？我不知道你在說什麼，我——我這輩子沒見過那東西！
Murder Mystery#038.speaker: Rohem

Murder Mystery#039.src: Gah! Curse you, human! I might be headed to jail, but I can send you straight to hell!
Murder Mystery#039.dst: 啊！該死的人類！我或許要進牢裡，但我可以先送你下地獄！
Murder Mystery#039.speaker: Rohem

Murder Mystery#040.src: That's enough, Rohem! Stand down, or the guards will attack.
Murder Mystery#040.dst: 夠了，Rohem！住手，不然衛兵就要動手了。
Murder Mystery#040.speaker: Detective Lorias

Murder Mystery#041.src: Augh! Fine, you've got me. But mark my words, this won't be the last you hear of me, human!
Murder Mystery#041.dst: 啊！好吧，你抓到我了。但你記住我的話，人類，你不會是最後一次聽到我的名字！
Murder Mystery#041.speaker: Rohem

Murder Mystery#042.src: Whatever you pale-faced walking cowlick. You're headed to {p} Penitentiary with a charge of first-class murder. Guards, take him away.
Murder Mystery#042.dst: 隨便你怎麼說，你這蒼白的呆毛。你要去 {p} 監獄了，罪名是一級謀殺。衛兵，把他帶走。
Murder Mystery#042.speaker: Detective Lorias

Murder Mystery#043.src: As for you, human, please accept my immense gratitude. We probably wouldn't have caught that rat without you.
Murder Mystery#043.dst: 至於你，人類，請接受我由衷的感謝。沒有你，我們大概抓不到那隻老鼠。
Murder Mystery#043.speaker: Detective Lorias

Murder Mystery#044.src: On behalf of the city of {p}, please accept these emeralds as compensation for your services. You were a fine detective today!
Murder Mystery#044.dst: 我代表 {p} 全城，請收下這些綠寶石作為你的酬勞。你今天是位出色的偵探！
Murder Mystery#044.speaker: Detective Lorias

Murder Mystery#045.src: Heya there! Fancy a quick game of blackjack?
Murder Mystery#045.dst: 嘿，你好啊！想不想來一把二十一點？
Murder Mystery#045.speaker: Blackjack Dealer

Murder Mystery#046.dst: 好嘞，我們來玩二十一點！
Murder Mystery#046.speaker: Blackjack Dealer

Murder Mystery#047.src: Good stuff! Put ya money in the pot and I'll start the deal.
Murder Mystery#047.dst: 好東西！把你的賭注放進池子，我就開始發牌。
Murder Mystery#047.speaker: Blackjack Dealer

Murder Mystery#048.src: Not feelin' up to playin' right now? No worries, just drop by later!
Murder Mystery#048.dst: 現在沒興致玩？沒關係，之後隨時再來！
Murder Mystery#048.speaker: Blackjack Dealer

Murder Mystery#049.src: Not right now? No worries - come back another time!
Murder Mystery#049.dst: 現在不行？沒關係——改天再來！
Murder Mystery#049.speaker: Blackjack Dealer

Murder Mystery#050.src: Ah, new to the game huh? No worries, lemme tell ya all about it!
Murder Mystery#050.dst: 啊，第一次玩是吧？沒關係，我從頭跟你說！
Murder Mystery#050.speaker: Blackjack Dealer

Murder Mystery#051.src: The rules are simple! I deal two cards face up to ya both face down, and two cards to me, one face up and one face down.
Murder Mystery#051.dst: 規則很簡單！我發兩張牌給你，兩張都蓋著；我自己也拿兩張，一張翻開、一張蓋著。
Murder Mystery#051.speaker: Blackjack Dealer

Murder Mystery#052.src: Ya can hit and get another card as many times as ya want, or stand and end ya turn. The aim is to get the value of your hand as close to {~} as possible!
Murder Mystery#052.dst: 你可以要牌，想要幾張就要幾張，也可以停牌結束你的回合。目標是讓手牌點數盡量接近 {~} 點！
Murder Mystery#052.speaker: Blackjack Dealer

Murder Mystery#053.src: Number cards are worth what they say, all picture cards are worth {~}, and an ace can be worth either {~} or {~}, whichever works best for ya hand.
Murder Mystery#053.dst: 數字牌就是它的點數，所有人頭牌都算 {~} 點，A 可以算 {~} 點或 {~} 點，看哪個對你的手牌比較有利。
Murder Mystery#053.speaker: Blackjack Dealer

Murder Mystery#054.src: Go over {~} and that's it - you're bust! Stand with your current hand and it's my turn to hit or stand to try and beat your hand.
Murder Mystery#054.dst: 超過 {~} 點就完了——你爆牌了！用現在的手牌停牌，就換我要牌或停牌，看能不能贏過你。
Murder Mystery#054.speaker: Blackjack Dealer

Murder Mystery#055.src: And if ya get a blackjack - that's an ace and a picture card or a ten - ya automatically get double ya money back!
Murder Mystery#055.dst: 如果你拿到二十一點——也就是一張 A 配一張人頭牌或十——賭金自動加倍還你！
Murder Mystery#055.speaker: Blackjack Dealer

Murder Mystery#056.src: Sound fair enough? Alrighty, just right-click me again to play!
Murder Mystery#056.dst: 聽起來夠公道吧？好嘞，再右鍵點我一次就開始！
Murder Mystery#056.speaker: Blackjack Dealer

Mushroom Man#001.src: {u}, hello! This place is really nice, isn't it? I'd like to stay a while longer before moving on towards {p}, but I'll be ready soon.
Mushroom Man#001.dst: {u}，你好！這地方真不錯，對吧？我想在這裡多待一陣子再往 {p} 走，不過我很快就會準備好了。
Mushroom Man#001.speaker: Tasim

Mushroom Man#002.src: In the meantime, I've been thinking about what we could do to help this place... I've maybe got something.
Mushroom Man#002.dst: 趁這段時間，我一直在想我們能為這個地方做點什麼……我大概想到一件了。
Mushroom Man#002.speaker: Tasim

Mushroom Man#003.src: Take a look at that villager over there. He's acting a little off, like he's got something going on. I wonder...
Mushroom Man#003.dst: 你看那邊那個村民。他的樣子有點不對勁，好像有什麼事。我在想……
Mushroom Man#003.speaker: Tasim

Mushroom Man#004.src: Alright, I've decided. I'm feeling a little restless, so let's go over there and see if there's anything we can help with!
Mushroom Man#004.dst: 好，我決定了。我閒得有點發慌，我們過去看看有沒有什麼幫得上忙的！
Mushroom Man#004.speaker: Tasim

Mushroom Man#005.src: Maybe we can leave this place better off than it was when we got here!
Mushroom Man#005.dst: 說不定我們離開的時候，能讓這裡比我們剛來的時候好一點！
Mushroom Man#005.speaker: Tasim

Mushroom Man#006.src: Speak to the strange man at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Mushroom Man#007.src: G-... Hi! H-how can I help you on this... this p-perfectly fine and n-n-normal day!
Mushroom Man#007.dst: 呃——你好！今、今天這麼……這麼美好又正、正常的一天，有什麼我能幫忙的嗎！
Mushroom Man#007.speaker: Yahya

Mushroom Man#008.src: Sorry to interrupt- we're soldiers traveling through this town, and you looked like the sort of person who might need the kind of help soldiers can provide. Anything we can help with?
Mushroom Man#008.dst: 抱歉打擾——我們是路過這個鎮的士兵，你看起來像是需要士兵幫忙的那種人。有什麼我們能幫上忙的嗎？
Mushroom Man#008.speaker: Tasim

Mushroom Man#009.src: O-oh! No, t-there's nothing going on. Not a th-thing. My m-m-mushroms are... they're fine. Why are you a-asking? Ev-... everything is g-great. W-Why wouldn't it b-be?
Mushroom Man#009.dst: 哦、哦！沒有，沒、沒事。什麼事都沒有。我的蘑、蘑菇……牠們很好。你問這個做什麼？一、一切都很好。怎、怎麼可能不好？
Mushroom Man#009.speaker: Yahya

Mushroom Man#010.src: ...O-okay, fine, y-you caught me! My mushrooms... my m-mushrooms aren't fine! T-they're bad, even! A-are you hap-... happy now?
Mushroom Man#010.dst: ……好、好啦，被你抓到了！我的蘑菇……我的蘑、蘑菇不好！牠們很糟，非常糟！這、這下你滿意了？
Mushroom Man#010.speaker: Yahya

Mushroom Man#011.src: Ehm- no, but that's why we're here! Is there anything we can do to help your... uh. Your mushrooms?
Mushroom Man#011.dst: 呃——不是，可是我們就是為這個來的啊！有沒有什麼我們能幫上忙的……呃。幫你的蘑菇？
Mushroom Man#011.speaker: Tasim

Mushroom Man#012.src: Hm. One soldier, two s-soldier... Y-you look weak. I've s-seen str-... stronger. B-But- eheh, the- the s-stronger soldiers are... not here. Y-you'll be good enough. Maybe.
Mushroom Man#012.dst: 嗯。一個士兵，兩、兩個士兵……你、你看起來很弱。我見、見過更強的。不、不過——嘿嘿，那些比、比較強的士兵……不在這裡。你、你大概夠用了。也許。
Mushroom Man#012.speaker: Yahya

Mushroom Man#013.src: I- my favorite mushroom spot. I c-can't use it any-... anymore. Spiders. L-lots of spiders. They've t-t-taken over it... I can't get... mushrooms. Can y-you kill the s-s-spiders? Mushrooms.
Mushroom Man#013.dst: 我——我最愛的採菇點。我不、不能再用了。蜘蛛。好、好多蜘蛛。牠們佔、佔據了那裡……我採不到……蘑菇。你能不能殺、殺掉那些蜘、蜘蛛？蘑菇。
Mushroom Man#013.speaker: Yahya

Mushroom Man#014.src: We can kill spiders! Right, {u}? Come on, this is what we're here to do! We became soldiers to help the people of Wynn, didn't we? We'll help you get your mushrooms back sir.
Mushroom Man#014.dst: 蜘蛛我們殺得了！對吧，{u}？走吧，我們不就是來做這種事的嗎？我們當兵不就是為了幫助 Wynn 的人民嗎？先生，我們會幫你把蘑菇拿回來的。
Mushroom Man#014.speaker: Tasim

Mushroom Man#015.src: H-hm. Good. I can't m-make soup without... mushrooms. F-follow me, I'll take you to the-... the spiders. B-bad spiders.
Mushroom Man#015.dst: 嗯、嗯。很好。沒有蘑菇……我煮不出湯。跟、跟我來，我帶你們去找那些……那些蜘蛛。壞、壞蜘蛛。
Mushroom Man#015.speaker: Yahya

Mushroom Man#016.src: Follow Yahya to his infested mushroom patch at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Mushroom Man#016.dst: 跟著 Yahya 前往 [-{~1}, {~2}, -{~3}] 被侵佔的蘑菇田。

Mushroom Man#017.src: H-here we are. I- I can f-feel the m-m-mushrooms... from here. And the s-spiders! No-... no good.
Mushroom Man#017.dst: 到、到了。我從這裡就……就感覺得到蘑、蘑菇。還有蜘、蜘蛛！不、不妙。
Mushroom Man#017.speaker: Yahya

Mushroom Man#018.src: S-so! Mushrooms. Those-... those bad c-creepy c-crawly s-s-spiders... Kill them. P-please?
Mushroom Man#018.dst: 所、所以！蘑菇。那些……那些壞的、爬來爬去的蜘、蜘蛛……殺掉牠們。拜、拜託？
Mushroom Man#018.speaker: Yahya

Mushroom Man#019.src: We wouldn't have come here if we weren't planning to. Alright, {u}, let's clear out some spiders!
Mushroom Man#019.dst: 我們沒打算做的話就不會來了。好，{u}，我們去清蜘蛛！
Mushroom Man#019.speaker: Tasim

Mushroom Man#020.src: Clear out the spiders from Yahya's favorite mushroom patch at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}], then return and talk to Yahya.
Mushroom Man#020.dst: 清掉 [-{~1}, {~2}, -{~3}] Yahya 最愛的蘑菇田裡的蜘蛛，然後回去跟 Yahya 談話。

Mushroom Man#021.src: I-is it done? S-s-spiders... No m-more spiders? Is my m-m-mushroom patch cl-... cleared?
Mushroom Man#021.dst: 清、清完了嗎？蜘、蜘蛛……沒有蜘蛛了？我的蘑、蘑菇田清、清乾淨了嗎？
Mushroom Man#021.speaker: Yahya

Mushroom Man#022.src: Looks cleared to me. These are... uh... some fine mushrooms!
Mushroom Man#022.dst: 我看是清乾淨了。這些……呃……是很不錯的蘑菇！
Mushroom Man#022.speaker: Tasim

Mushroom Man#023.src: Th-thank you soldiers! Th-that was-... I mean. I-it was f-fine, I g-... guess.
Mushroom Man#023.dst: 謝、謝謝你們，士兵！那真是——我是說。還、還可以啦，我、我想。
Mushroom Man#023.speaker: Yahya

Mushroom Man#024.src: ...O-oh. Do I n-need to pay you... now? Heh. Is- is [{~} Emeralds] fine with y-you..?
Mushroom Man#024.dst: ……哦。我現在是不是得付、付你們錢了？嘿。[{~} 綠寶石] 你們可、可以接受嗎……？
Mushroom Man#024.speaker: Yahya

Mushroom Man#026.src: Oho okay, ok-... okay! It was a joke, don't get all ex-... ex-... excited. Here, just take-
Mushroom Man#026.dst: 哦哦好啦，好、好啦！開玩笑的，別那麼激、激……激動。來，拿去——
Mushroom Man#026.speaker: Yahya

Mushroom Man#027.dst: 啊——！好、好噁！爬、爬來爬去的！蜘、蜘、蜘蛛！！！
Mushroom Man#027.speaker: Yahya

Mushroom Man#030.src: I-... This is bad. This is really bad. We need to tell the Mayor, now.
Mushroom Man#030.dst: 我——……這下糟了。這下真的糟了。我們得立刻去告訴鎮長。
Mushroom Man#030.speaker: Tasim

Mushroom Man#031.src: Return to Mayor Alvin at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] with news about the spiders.
Mushroom Man#031.dst: 回到 [-{~1}, {~2}, -{~3}] 向 Alvin 鎮長回報蜘蛛的事。

Mushroom Man#032.src: Ah, hello travelers. You seem to be in a rush- has something happened?
Mushroom Man#032.dst: 啊，兩位旅人好。你們看起來很匆忙——出什麼事了嗎？
Mushroom Man#032.speaker: Mayor Alvin

Mushroom Man#033.src: Yes! Yes, something- something has happened. We went with Yahya to help him with a problem he was having with spiders-
Mushroom Man#033.dst: 是的！是的，出——出事了。我們跟 Yahya 一起去幫他處理蜘蛛的問題——
Mushroom Man#033.speaker: Tasim

Mushroom Man#034.src: Yes, yes, I know of Yahya's antics... He doesn't seem to be with you. Has he ran off on you, just as Ope did?
Mushroom Man#034.dst: 是是，Yahya 那些把戲我知道……他沒跟你們在一起。他是不是也跟 Ope 一樣，把你們丟下跑了？
Mushroom Man#034.speaker: Mayor Alvin

Mushroom Man#035.src: No- no. When we finished clearing out the spiders, we were swarmed- and they took him!
Mushroom Man#035.dst: 不——不是。我們清完蜘蛛之後，被一大群圍上來——牠們把他抓走了！
Mushroom Man#035.speaker: Tasim

Mushroom Man#036.src: ...Oh. Oh, dear. That isn't good at all. If they're making moves such as this, unprovoked...
Mushroom Man#036.dst: ……哦。天啊。這非常不妙。如果牠們無緣無故就採取這種行動……
Mushroom Man#036.speaker: Mayor Alvin

Mushroom Man#037.src: You two are soldiers, yes? I would ask you to continue your travels to {p}. Find an Admiral Aegis- tell him our little village needs aid.
Mushroom Man#037.dst: 兩位是士兵吧？我想請你們繼續往 {p} 走。去找一位 Aegis 上將——告訴他我們這座小村子需要援助。
Mushroom Man#037.speaker: Mayor Alvin

Mushroom Man#038.src: I-... of course. We'll set out immediately. Come on, {u}.
Mushroom Man#038.dst: 我——當然。我們立刻出發。走吧，{u}。
Mushroom Man#038.speaker: Tasim

Mushroom Man#039.src: Travel to {p} to request the help of their military at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Mushroom Man#042.src: Another one of these? We've fought one of them before, we can do it again!
Mushroom Man#042.dst: 又是這種東西？我們以前打過一隻，這次也可以！
Mushroom Man#042.speaker: Tasim

Mushroom Man#043.src: Phew. I think that went about as well as it could have!
Mushroom Man#043.dst: 呼。我覺得這已經是最好的結果了！
Mushroom Man#043.speaker: Tasim

Mushroom Man#044.src: We're both in one piece, the corrupted is dead... Good. That's good!
Mushroom Man#044.dst: 我們兩個都全鬚全尾，腐化物也死了……很好。這樣很好！
Mushroom Man#044.speaker: Tasim

Mushroom Man#045.src: Let's keep moving towards {p}. I don't think it's too much further, if we keep heading east from here.
Mushroom Man#045.dst: 我們繼續往 {p} 走吧。從這裡一路往東，應該不會太遠了。
Mushroom Man#045.speaker: Tasim

Mushroom Man#047.src: Why'd you just leave me there? If we couldn't fight that thing off together, what made you think I could do it alone?
Mushroom Man#047.dst: 你怎麼就把我丟在那裡？如果我們兩個一起都打不過那東西，你憑什麼覺得我一個人做得到？
Mushroom Man#047.speaker: Tasim

Mushroom Man#048.src: I managed to get away, but... still. What if I couldn't? Would you have just left me for dead?
Mushroom Man#048.dst: 我是脫身了，可是……還是一樣。萬一我脫不了身呢？你就打算丟下我等死嗎？
Mushroom Man#048.speaker: Tasim

Mushroom Man#049.src: ...Whatever. I'm alive, you're alive... that's probably good enough. Let's go find Admiral Aegis
Mushroom Man#049.dst: ……算了。我還活著，你也還活著……大概就夠了。我們去找 Aegis 上將吧。
Mushroom Man#049.speaker: Tasim

Mushroom Man#050.src: ...Oh, {u}, you're awake! I was really worried there for a bit...
Mushroom Man#050.dst: ……哦，{u}，你醒了！我剛才真的很擔心……
Mushroom Man#050.speaker: Tasim

Mushroom Man#051.src: After you went down, I managed to hold my own long enough for some nearby soldiers to arrive and help. I can't thank Lieutenant Van enough.
Mushroom Man#051.dst: 你倒下之後，我撐了一陣子，撐到附近的士兵趕來幫忙。我真是怎麼謝 Van 中尉都不夠。
Mushroom Man#051.speaker: Tasim

Mushroom Man#052.src: We, uh... brought you back here to rest up. Aledar's around here somewhere, I think.
Mushroom Man#052.dst: 我們，呃……把你帶回這裡休養。Aledar 好像也在這附近。
Mushroom Man#052.speaker: Tasim

Mushroom Man#053.src: Oh, I spoke to Admiral Aegis about the spider problem already. He said he wants to speak to you about it, too. He should be downstairs
Mushroom Man#053.dst: 哦，蜘蛛的事我已經跟 Aegis 上將說過了。他說他也想跟你談談。他應該在樓下。
Mushroom Man#053.speaker: Tasim

Mushroom Man#054.src: ...and that's how we managed to defeat that undead swarm, sir!
Mushroom Man#054.dst: ……我們就是這樣把那群不死生物解決掉的，長官！
Mushroom Man#054.speaker: Aledar

Mushroom Man#055.src: That's good to hear. Thank you for your work, Aledar. I'll speak to Lieutenant Van and see if he'd be willing to take you into his squad.
Mushroom Man#055.dst: 那真是好消息。辛苦你了，Aledar。我會跟 Van 中尉談談，看他願不願意把你收進他的小隊。
Mushroom Man#055.speaker: Admiral Aegis

Mushroom Man#056.src: Thank you for the opportunity, sir. I won't let you down-... Wait, is that- Tasim and {u}?
Mushroom Man#056.dst: 謝謝您給我這個機會，長官。我不會讓您失望的——等等，那是——Tasim 和 {u}？
Mushroom Man#056.speaker: Aledar

Mushroom Man#057.src: Aledar! We've finally made it to {p}. We've had... something of an adventure, getting here.
Mushroom Man#057.dst: Aledar！我們總算到 {p} 了。這一路上……可說是一場冒險。
Mushroom Man#057.speaker: Tasim

Mushroom Man#058.src: Ah, you two must be the recruits Aledar has been telling us all about. It's good to finally meet you, though I can't help but notice you seem to have arrived in a rush.
Mushroom Man#058.dst: 啊，兩位一定就是 Aledar 一直跟我們說的那兩位新兵。總算見到面了，不過我不得不注意到，兩位似乎是趕著來的。
Mushroom Man#058.speaker: Admiral Aegis

Mushroom Man#059.src: Right! Right. We've arrived from Nivla Town, with bad news and a request for aid. The spiders of the forest have grown hostile, and threaten the town.
Mushroom Man#059.dst: 是的！沒錯。我們從 Nivla 鎮趕來，帶著壞消息和一份求援。森林裡的蜘蛛變得有攻擊性，正在威脅那座鎮。
Mushroom Man#059.speaker: Tasim

Mushroom Man#060.src: One of their townsfolk was captured and taken away in front of our eyes. Mayor Alvin sent us here to request the aid of {p}' army.
Mushroom Man#060.dst: 鎮上有一位居民在我們眼前被抓走了。Alvin 鎮長派我們來請求 {p} 軍的援助。
Mushroom Man#060.speaker: Tasim

Mushroom Man#061.src: Bad news, indeed. Very well, we will make preparations. For the time being, the two of you should rest and hone your skills. Captain Ragon here in the barracks would gladly offer some training.
Mushroom Man#061.dst: 確實是壞消息。很好，我們會著手準備。在那之前，你們兩位應該好好休息、磨練本事。兵營裡的 Ragon 隊長很樂意提供訓練。
Mushroom Man#061.speaker: Admiral Aegis

Mushroom Man#062.src: Thank you, sir. But is there anything we could do to actually help?
Mushroom Man#062.dst: 謝謝您，長官。不過有沒有什麼我們真的能幫上忙的事？
Mushroom Man#062.speaker: Tasim

Mushroom Man#063.src: Enthusiastic, aren't you! Let me think... I believe Captain Fenor out by the west gate was looking for aid. If you're willing, I'd suggest you speak with him.
Mushroom Man#063.dst: 很有幹勁嘛！我想想……我記得西門外的 Fenor 隊長正在找人幫忙。你們願意的話，我建議去找他談談。
Mushroom Man#063.speaker: Admiral Aegis

Mushroom Man#064.src: And Lieutenant Van is planning a raid on a corrupt stronghold! I'm sure he'd be glad to have more forces with them.
Mushroom Man#064.dst: 還有 Van 中尉正在籌畫突襲一座腐化據點！我相信他一定樂意多幾個人手。
Mushroom Man#064.speaker: Aledar

Mushroom Man#065.src: Yes, yes. Well, I must be off. If the threat of Nivla's spiders is growing... we must prepare accordingly. I hope to hear of your future endeavors, all three of you.
Mushroom Man#065.dst: 是是。好了，我得走了。如果 Nivla 那邊的蜘蛛威脅正在擴大……我們就得相應地準備。期待日後聽到你們三位的事蹟。
Mushroom Man#065.speaker: Admiral Aegis

Mushroom Man#066.src: ...so, Captain, what do you think? We'll need to start training soldiers more quickly, but I hope that won't be a problem.
Mushroom Man#066.dst: ……那麼隊長，你怎麼看？我們得加快訓練士兵的速度，但願這不成問題。
Mushroom Man#066.speaker: Admiral Aegis

Mushroom Man#067.src: Of course, Admiral, I'll see what I can do.
Mushroom Man#067.speaker: Captain Ragon

Mushroom Man#068.src: Excellent. Now- ah, {u}. Good to see you're up and about again. You gave us quite a shock!
Mushroom Man#068.dst: 很好。那麼——啊，{u}。看到你又能走動真好。你可把我們嚇壞了！
Mushroom Man#068.speaker: Admiral Aegis

Mushroom Man#069.src: Van tells me that goliath the two of you faced was a dangerous foe. He was impressed you managed to damage it as much as you did, even if you ended up needing rescue.
Mushroom Man#069.dst: Van 跟我說，你們兩個對上的那隻巨獸是個危險的對手。他很佩服你能把牠打成那樣，就算最後還是得靠人救。
Mushroom Man#069.speaker: Admiral Aegis

Mushroom Man#070.src: Now, to business. We've already begun planning for our assault on the spiders, but we'll need more well-trained soldiers. Captain Ragon here should be able to help you hone your skills.
Mushroom Man#070.dst: 好了，說正事。我們已經開始籌畫突襲蜘蛛的行動，但我們需要更多受過良好訓練的士兵。這位 Ragon 隊長應該能幫你磨練身手。
Mushroom Man#070.speaker: Admiral Aegis

Mushroom Man#071.src: And if we wanted to help out, sir? I'm getting a little stir-crazy in here.
Mushroom Man#071.dst: 那如果我們想幫忙呢，長官？我在這裡待得有點發悶了。
Mushroom Man#071.speaker: Tasim

Mushroom Man#072.src: Enthusiastic, aren't you! Let me think... I believe Captain Fenor out by the west gate was looking for aid. If you're willing, I suggest you speak with him.
Mushroom Man#072.dst: 很有幹勁嘛！我想想……我記得西門外的 Fenor 隊長正在找人幫忙。你們願意的話，我建議去找他談談。
Mushroom Man#072.speaker: Admiral Aegis

Mushroom Man#073.src: In addition, Lieutenant Van was highly impressed by your fight with the goliath! He told me to pass on that he'd appreciate your help in a raid he's planning on a nearby corrupted stronghold. I believe your friend Aledar was involved.
Mushroom Man#073.dst: 另外，Van 中尉對你跟那隻巨獸的一戰印象非常深刻！他要我轉告，他正在籌畫突襲附近一座腐化據點，很希望有你幫忙。我記得你的朋友 Aledar 也有參與。
Mushroom Man#073.speaker: Admiral Aegis

Mushroom Man#074.src: With that, I must be off. We have many preparations to make, and the enemy never rests. I hope to hear of your future endeavors, both of you.
Mushroom Man#074.dst: 就這樣，我得走了。我們還有很多準備工作要做，而敵人從不休息。期待日後聽到你們兩位的事蹟。
Mushroom Man#074.speaker: Admiral Aegis

Off the Rails#001.src: Tch... Another filthy poor... No, I won't give you any money.
Off the Rails#001.speaker: Businessman

Off the Rails#002.src: I don't care if you're struggling to get by. In this world, you've gotta put in some work to make it through.
Off the Rails#002.speaker: Businessman

Off the Rails#003.src: Besides, I've talked to enough of you hobos for one day. I'll be glad to take the Subway out of here.
Off the Rails#003.speaker: Businessman

Off the Rails#004.src: ...Heh... That look on your face... You don't know about the Subway?
Off the Rails#004.speaker: Businessman

Off the Rails#005.src: Wow, I thought taking a ride on that thing was the dream of every peasant around here, what with the way my proles are always going on about it.
Off the Rails#005.speaker: Businessman

Off the Rails#006.src: Well, it's an underground transport system that goes all over the province... Not that that matters for a beggar like you, of course. You'll never be able to afford a trip! Ha!
Off the Rails#006.speaker: Businessman

Off the Rails#007.src: Now, if you'll excuse me, my train to Auburn arrives in a few minutes. I have important business there. Nothing for you to worry about. Toodles!
Off the Rails#007.speaker: Businessman

Off the Rails#008.src: Turn in your subway pass at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Off the Rails#009.src: Hey! What are you doing? The rails aren't safe! If you want to get to the other side, take the overpass!
Off the Rails#009.speaker: Ticket Collector
