Queen's Recruit#568.src: Oh, this is a disaster. We've been separated, and now we're stuck in here.
Queen's Recruit#568.dst: 哦，這下糟了。我們被拆開了，現在又被困在這裡。
Queen's Recruit#568.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#569.src: We need to come up with a plan... is there a way we could
Queen's Recruit#569.dst: 我們得想個辦法……有沒有可能我們可以——
Queen's Recruit#569.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#570.src: Tasim! Her Majesty will speak with you now.
Queen's Recruit#570.speaker: Gendarme Soldier

Queen's Recruit#572.src: Okay, wish me luck. I'll be back.
Queen's Recruit#572.dst: 好，祝我好運。我去去就回。
Queen's Recruit#572.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#573.src: Don't... stay up waiting for me. You can go rest. I'll be... fine, probably.
Queen's Recruit#573.dst: 別……別熬夜等我。你去休息吧。我會……大概不會有事的。
Queen's Recruit#573.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#578.src: It went... fine, I guess. She probably said... most of the same things to you.
Queen's Recruit#578.dst: 還算……順利吧。她跟你說的……大概也差不多。
Queen's Recruit#578.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#581.src: Could I ask you a favor?
Queen's Recruit#581.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#582.src: Could we spar? A test match, before... before tomorrow. Just like old times.
Queen's Recruit#582.dst: 我們能對練一場嗎？一場試手，在……在明天之前。就像以前那樣。
Queen's Recruit#582.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#583.src: Just, get ready and meet me at the arena. Okay?
Queen's Recruit#583.dst: 你準備好就到競技場找我。好嗎？
Queen's Recruit#583.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#584.src: I yes. I'm okay. Just... could we spar? A test match, before... tomorrow. For old times' sake.
Queen's Recruit#584.dst: 我——嗯。我沒事。只是……我們能對練一場嗎？一場試手，在……明天之前。就當是為了老交情。
Queen's Recruit#584.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#585.src: Just... get ready and meet me at the arena. Okay?
Queen's Recruit#585.dst: 你……準備好就到競技場找我。好嗎？
Queen's Recruit#585.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#588.src: It went... fine, I guess. She probably said... most of the same things to you.
Queen's Recruit#588.dst: 還算……順利吧。她跟你說的……大概也差不多。
Queen's Recruit#588.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#591.src: I was going to ask if I could ask you a favor.
Queen's Recruit#591.dst: 我本來是想問你能不能幫我一個忙的。
Queen's Recruit#591.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#592.src: Could we spar? A test match, before... before tomorrow. Just like old times.
Queen's Recruit#592.dst: 我們能對練一場嗎？一場試手，在……在明天之前。就像以前那樣。
Queen's Recruit#592.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#593.src: Just, get ready and meet me at the arena. Okay?
Queen's Recruit#593.dst: 你準備好就到競技場找我。好嗎？
Queen's Recruit#593.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#594.src: I yes. I'm okay. Just... could we spar? A test match, before... tomorrow. For old times' sake.
Queen's Recruit#594.dst: 我——嗯。我沒事。只是……我們能對練一場嗎？一場試手，在……明天之前。就當是為了老交情。
Queen's Recruit#594.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#595.src: Just... get ready and meet me at the arena. Okay?
Queen's Recruit#595.dst: 你……準備好就到競技場找我。好嗎？
Queen's Recruit#595.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#601.src: He's... what what happened? How do you know? How how could you know?
Queen's Recruit#601.dst: 他……什麼——發生什麼事了？你怎麼知道的？你——你怎麼會知道？
Queen's Recruit#601.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#609.src: I... Gods. And, you you've been tr-trying to
Queen's Recruit#609.dst: 我……天啊。而且，你——你一直在試著——
Queen's Recruit#609.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#611.src: I I need to go. I need some space. I'll I'm going to the arena. I need to... to...
Queen's Recruit#611.dst: 我——我得走了。我需要一點空間。我要——我要去競技場。我需要……需要……
Queen's Recruit#611.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#612.src: No. No, d-don't. Don't do that. Not now, not not now. If... if you need me... you'll you'll know where I am.
Queen's Recruit#612.dst: 不要。不、不要，別這樣。現在不要，現在——現在不要。如果……如果你需要我……你會——你會知道我在哪。
Queen's Recruit#612.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#613.src: Head to the arena for a training match against Tasim.
Queen's Recruit#613.dst: 到競技場與 Tasim 進行練習賽。

Queen's Recruit#614.src: Get ready and meet me at the arena. Okay?
Queen's Recruit#614.dst: 你準備好就到競技場找我。好嗎？
Queen's Recruit#614.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#615.src: It's... quiet. No guards in sight.
Queen's Recruit#615.dst: 這裡……好安靜。連一個衛兵都沒有。
Queen's Recruit#615.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#617.src: Sigh. There's no point in trying to get out of here. We have to just see it through to the end.
Queen's Recruit#617.dst: 唉。想逃出去是沒有意義的。我們只能走到最後，把它看完。
Queen's Recruit#617.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#619.src: What do you think? About what she said? About... forces destroying the world.
Queen's Recruit#619.dst: 你怎麼想？關於她說的那些。關於……那些正在毀滅世界的力量。
Queen's Recruit#619.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#620.src: She's right. I've seen it I know you've seen it. It's... getting worse.
Queen's Recruit#620.dst: 她說得對。我見過——我知道你也見過。而且……正在惡化。
Queen's Recruit#620.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#621.src: But... the recruits. The recruits. I can't get over that. It's so...
Queen's Recruit#621.dst: 可是……那些新兵。那些新兵。那件事我過不去。實在太……
Queen's Recruit#621.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#623.src: Let's just get down there and fight. Usual spots, right?
Queen's Recruit#623.dst: 我們就下去打吧。老位置，對吧？
Queen's Recruit#623.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#626.src: No words. Let's fight. Just just a training battle. To... test our skills.
Queen's Recruit#626.dst: 不必多說。開打吧。就只是——就只是一場練習賽。用來……測試我們的身手。
Queen's Recruit#626.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#630.src: I guess we know how tomorrow will turn out, then.
Queen's Recruit#630.dst: 那我想我們都知道明天會是什麼結果了。
Queen's Recruit#630.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#631.src: No don't deny it. We both know I'm right.
Queen's Recruit#631.dst: 不——別否認。我們心裡都清楚我說得對。
Queen's Recruit#631.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#633.src: She gave me a choice, you know?
Queen's Recruit#633.dst: 她給了我一個選擇，你知道嗎？
Queen's Recruit#633.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#634.src: A choice. I don't know what to do with it. And... I'm afraid of taking either option.
Queen's Recruit#634.dst: 一個選擇。我不知道該拿它怎麼辦。而且……兩邊我都害怕去選。
Queen's Recruit#634.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#635.src: I... I need to think over it some more. And we both need to rest.
Queen's Recruit#635.dst: 我……我需要再想一想。而且我們兩個都得休息了。
Queen's Recruit#635.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#636.src: Huh? I... yes. I think I am. I just have a lot on my mind.
Queen's Recruit#636.dst: 嗯？我……嗯。我想我沒事。只是心裡壓著很多事。
Queen's Recruit#636.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#637.src: I'll... tell you in the morning. I just have a lot on my mind.
Queen's Recruit#637.dst: 我……早上再告訴你。我只是心裡壓著很多事。
Queen's Recruit#637.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#638.src: Ha. You're you're good. Oof. I'll be feeling that one for... for a while.
Queen's Recruit#638.dst: 哈。你——你真行。唔。這一下我大概要痛……痛上好一陣子了。
Queen's Recruit#638.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#640.src: Why did it have to come to this? Why couldn't why couldn't we all have just been happy?
Queen's Recruit#640.dst: 為什麼事情非得走到這一步？為什麼——為什麼我們不能就這樣好好的？
Queen's Recruit#640.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#641.src: He he sent me a letter for that mission, you know. Did I tell you that? It's why I went back to Wynn.
Queen's Recruit#641.dst: 他——他為了那個任務寄了封信給我，你知道嗎。我有跟你說過嗎？那就是我回 Wynn 的原因。
Queen's Recruit#641.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#642.src: And, it turns out he was already... already gone. And you were there, and I wasn't.
Queen's Recruit#642.dst: 結果呢，他早就已經……已經走了。而你在場，我不在。
Queen's Recruit#642.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#644.src: I want to blame you for it. I want to be able to be mad, to hate you. But... I can't. I just can't.
Queen's Recruit#644.dst: 我想怪你。我想有辦法生氣，有辦法恨你。可是……我做不到。我就是做不到。
Queen's Recruit#644.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#645.src: I wish I could've been there. I wish I could've done it better. Maybe I could have or maybe it would've just gone the same way.
Queen's Recruit#645.dst: 我多希望當時我在場。我多希望我能做得更好。也許我可以——也許結果還是一樣。
Queen's Recruit#645.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#647.src: And now we're both here in the place we were all exiled from! But he's he isn't. He's gone, and and we're still here.
Queen's Recruit#647.dst: 而現在我們兩個都在這裡，在當初把我們全都流放出去的地方！可是他——他不在。他走了，而——而我們還在。
Queen's Recruit#647.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#648.src: ...what am I supposed to do? What are we supposed to do? About all of this?
Queen's Recruit#648.dst: ……我到底該怎麼辦？我們到底該怎麼辦？面對這一切。
Queen's Recruit#648.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#651.src: I asked a lot of questions. I didn't like all the answers, but... she left me with a choice.
Queen's Recruit#651.dst: 我問了很多問題。那些答案我不是每個都喜歡，但……她留給我一個選擇。
Queen's Recruit#651.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#653.src: I don't know what to do. I need to... to... I need to think.
Queen's Recruit#653.dst: 我不知道該怎麼辦。我需要……需要……我需要想一想。
Queen's Recruit#653.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#654.src: Give me some space, please. I'll see you in the morning.
Queen's Recruit#654.dst: 請給我一點空間。我們早上見。
Queen's Recruit#654.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#655.src: Return to your room and sleep for the night.

Queen's Recruit#657.src: Read the note Tasim left you before heading out.
Queen's Recruit#657.dst: 出發前讀一讀 Tasim 留給你的字條。

Queen's Recruit#658.src: Head to Her Majesty's office for her decision.
Queen's Recruit#658.dst: 前往女王陛下的辦公室聽取她的決定。

Queen's Recruit#660.src: You've already failed, you know. You did not meet her criteria for selection.
Queen's Recruit#660.dst: 你已經失敗了，你知道嗎。你沒有達到她的甄選標準。

Queen's Recruit#661.src: But is dismissing you outright an error? Certainly, you're powerful. Perhaps even more so than you should be, given the circumstances.
Queen's Recruit#661.dst: 不過，直接把你排除掉會不會是個錯誤呢？你確實很強。以你的處境來說，甚至可能強得超出應有的程度。

Queen's Recruit#662.src: Still. You lack the drive, the perspective. The dedication. The understanding.
Queen's Recruit#662.dst: 儘管如此。你缺少那股驅力、那份視野。那份投入。那份理解。

Queen's Recruit#663.src: And, most critically you're unpredictable. And that makes you dangerous.
Queen's Recruit#663.dst: 而且，最關鍵的是——你無法預測。這使你危險。

Queen's Recruit#664.src: Ah! It seems Her Majesty and I have come to the same conclusion. Wonderful.
Queen's Recruit#664.dst: 啊！看來女王陛下和我得出了同樣的結論。太好了。

Queen's Recruit#665.src: So, where does that leave you? Cast out, discarded?
Queen's Recruit#665.dst: 那麼，這讓你落到什麼境地呢？被逐出、被丟棄？

Queen's Recruit#666.src: All the unanswered questions. Will you choose to let go? Dismiss the possibilities?
Queen's Recruit#666.dst: 那麼多沒有答案的問題。你會選擇放手嗎？把那些可能性拋在腦後？

Queen's Recruit#667.src: And if not? What would you do for a glimpse of the truth? For a chance of receiving answers?
Queen's Recruit#667.dst: 如果不呢？為了瞥見真相一眼，你願意做到什麼地步？為了一次得到答案的機會？

Queen's Recruit#668.src: Hm. Whatever the case, the choice is yours. Perhaps you'll surprise me, after all! Wouldn't that be exciting?
Queen's Recruit#668.dst: 嗯。無論如何，選擇權在你。說不定你會讓我意外呢！那不是很有意思嗎？

Queen's Recruit#669.src: {u}, under order of Her Majesty, you are to be escorted out of Fruma, effective immediately.
Queen's Recruit#669.dst: {u}，奉女王陛下之命，你將即刻被護送離開 Fruma。
Queen's Recruit#669.speaker: Gendarme Commander

Queen's Recruit#670.src: Any defiance will be seen as an official threat against Fruma from the Wynn province. Comply, and no one will be hurt.
Queen's Recruit#670.dst: 任何違抗行為，都將被視為 Wynn 行省對 Fruma 的正式威脅。配合行事，就不會有人受傷。
Queen's Recruit#670.speaker: Gendarme Commander

Queen's Recruit#671.src: You hold no power here. This choice is not yours. You will follow orders, or face the consequences.
Queen's Recruit#671.dst: 你在這裡沒有任何權力。這不是你能選擇的。你要麼服從命令，要麼承擔後果。
Queen's Recruit#671.speaker: Gendarme Commander

Recipe For Disaster#000.src: Meet up with Chef Hamsey in {p} at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Recipe For Disaster#001.src: Ah, bonjour! Welcome to my restaurant, allow me to lead you to your seat-
Recipe For Disaster#001.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#002.src: Oh do my eyes deceive me? Serais-ce possible?!
Recipe For Disaster#002.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#003.src: It is you... the novice soldier turned hero of legends! Who would have thought?!
Recipe For Disaster#003.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#004.src: I have heard tales of your exploits across the lands, mon ami! Je suis honore! Someone like you sitting in my restaurant!
Recipe For Disaster#004.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#005.src: Je suis, bien sur... Le Chef Hamsey! Famed across the lands for my flavors, as you are for your weapon!
Recipe For Disaster#005.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#006.src: I boast, I boast. Je peu t'offrir un plat... but perhaps I have a different proposition for us both.
Recipe For Disaster#006.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#007.src: You may have mastered the art of battle, my friend, but what of... L'Art de la Cuisine?!
Recipe For Disaster#007.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#008.src: Follow me into the kitchen behind me, and I will tell you more.
Recipe For Disaster#008.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#009.src: Find Chef Hamsey in his kitchen.

Recipe For Disaster#010.src: Welcome to my kitchen! C'est beau, non?
Recipe For Disaster#010.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#011.src: It may be on fire, but... que serais la Cuisine sans une touche de danger, eh?!
Recipe For Disaster#011.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#012.src: So, back to the challenge. What do you say to a bit of friendly competition, hehe?
Recipe For Disaster#012.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#013.src: You can work with one of my three best chefs on a dish and present it to me once you're done!
Recipe For Disaster#013.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#014.src: I, of course, will judge your dish based on the twenty-nine Principes de Cuisine - texture, presentation, originality...
Recipe For Disaster#014.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#015.src: ... aroma, magical ability... oh, and flavour!
Recipe For Disaster#015.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#016.src: S'il te plait! Go introduce yourself to each of my chefs and return once you have decided who to work with!
Recipe For Disaster#016.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#017.src: Speak to all three chefs in Hamsey's kitchen.

Recipe For Disaster#018.src: Heya! You must be the adventurer that Hamsey told me about. You know, he was almost ecstatic, but don't tell him I said that!
Recipe For Disaster#018.speaker: Brie

Recipe For Disaster#019.src: Oh, a cook-off? How exciting! I'll gladly help you out. Maybe this way I can prove myself a bit more to the others...?
Recipe For Disaster#019.speaker: Brie

Recipe For Disaster#020.src: If we work together, we can make a Seasoned Voidroot Stew, how does that sound?
Recipe For Disaster#020.speaker: Brie

Recipe For Disaster#021.src: You need to talk to the other chefs before deciding what to make, though!
Recipe For Disaster#021.speaker: Brie

Recipe For Disaster#022.src: Good friend of Hamsey's, are you? I'll believe it when - no, if - you somehow win this competition.
Recipe For Disaster#022.speaker: Kale

Recipe For Disaster#023.src: I don't need any amateurs like yourself getting in my way when I'm cooking up a storm!
Recipe For Disaster#023.speaker: Kale

Recipe For Disaster#024.src: Are you still here? Just... go chitchat to someone else, please.
Recipe For Disaster#024.speaker: Kale

Recipe For Disaster#025.src: Yo, dawg. Name's Frank. Hamsey said you guys go waaay back. Any friend of Hamsey's is good with me, man.
Recipe For Disaster#025.speaker: Frank

Recipe For Disaster#026.src: Nothin' too sure on what we're gonna cook yet, figure I'll dream somethin' up before the time comes.
Recipe For Disaster#026.speaker: Frank

Recipe For Disaster#027.src: Thinkin' a pie, maybe? Not too much effort there, can't go far wrong, right?
Recipe For Disaster#027.speaker: Frank

Recipe For Disaster#028.src: Talk to Hamsey and choose a chef to work with.

Recipe For Disaster#029.src: Ah, you have introduced yourself to tous mes cuisiners? Who do you want to work with?!
Recipe For Disaster#029.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#030.src: Ah, Brie! An excellent chef... and an even better cheese! I jest, I jest. You will work well together, I am certain.
Recipe For Disaster#030.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#031.src: Ah, Kale. One of my most talented chefs, though he can be stubborn at times!
Recipe For Disaster#031.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#032.src: Frank! Whilst he may seem rather... relaxed, at times, I assure you he is a most capable chef!
Recipe For Disaster#032.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#033.src: Maitenant, mon ami, head over to your chef and start cooking!
Recipe For Disaster#033.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#034.src: Talk to your chosen chef about the dish.

Recipe For Disaster#035.src: Heya again! So you decided to make the Seasoned Voidroot Stew with me? Hurray!
Recipe For Disaster#035.speaker: Brie

Recipe For Disaster#036.src: It's not quite as easy as it might seem, but I think together we'll be able to handle it.
Recipe For Disaster#036.speaker: Brie

Recipe For Disaster#037.src: Like I said before, about proving myself... I'm the newest chef here at the kitchen and some of the other chefs disapprove of my ideas. This could be my chance!
Recipe For Disaster#037.speaker: Brie

Recipe For Disaster#038.src: I've been perfecting the recipe for Voidroot Stew for months now and I finally have a chance to show everyone what I'm worth!
Recipe For Disaster#038.speaker: Brie

Recipe For Disaster#039.src: The first one is some [Snail Slime] available on Snail Island! We only need one for this dish.
Recipe For Disaster#039.speaker: Brie

Recipe For Disaster#040.src: Next up, we need some [Voidroot], a super rare root found deep in the Void. I've heard someone in the {p} can take you down there.
Recipe For Disaster#040.speaker: Brie

Recipe For Disaster#041.src: Lastly, we need some [Moonsalt], which is famously hard to obtain. Luckily, self-proclaimed 'Space Wizard' Astralaus should have some, so you can just pop over to his tower and ask for some!
Recipe For Disaster#041.speaker: Brie

Recipe For Disaster#042.src: And that should do it! I'll give you a Recipe Book, just right-click to open it up and track your ingredients. Good luck!
Recipe For Disaster#042.speaker: Brie

Recipe For Disaster#043.src: Ugh. Stay out of my way, and we'll get along just fine.
Recipe For Disaster#043.speaker: Kale

Recipe For Disaster#044.src: Make yourself useful and get me everything we need. I'm not in the mood for chit-chat.
Recipe For Disaster#044.speaker: Kale

Recipe For Disaster#045.src: I don't want my reputation tarnished by the likes of you...
Recipe For Disaster#045.speaker: Kale

Recipe For Disaster#046.src: Listen up, I'm *not* going to say this again. Take notes.
Recipe For Disaster#046.speaker: Kale

Recipe For Disaster#047.src: The key ingredient in my amazing omelette is obviously the [Blue-Ring Grook Egg], which of course you didn't know.
Recipe For Disaster#047.speaker: Kale

Recipe For Disaster#048.src: Secondly what we need is some [Snail Slime], which is at Snail Island, obviously. Any seasoned chef could tell you that.
Recipe For Disaster#048.speaker: Kale

Recipe For Disaster#049.src: Lastly you need a [Talking Mushroom] which is found on the swamp Sky Island, provided you have a functioning sense of sight.
Recipe For Disaster#049.speaker: Kale

Recipe For Disaster#050.src: YOU FORGOT ALREADY?? I TOLD YOU TO TAKE NOTES!
Recipe For Disaster#050.speaker: Kale

Recipe For Disaster#051.src: Lucky for you, at least one of us here is competent. I wrote everything down in this recipe book. Right-click to open it. Now get me my ingredients and scram!
Recipe For Disaster#051.speaker: Kale

Recipe For Disaster#052.src: Thrilled to be workin' with you, dude! We'll blow Hamsey's mind.
Recipe For Disaster#052.speaker: Frank

Recipe For Disaster#053.src: Hmmm, now what kinda pie should we be bakin', here?
Recipe For Disaster#053.speaker: Frank

Recipe For Disaster#054.src: Well, I might be a lil' lazy, but when it comes to cookin', I've got the eye. And to me, dude? You look like a real Skyhigh Pie kind of guy! Heheh.
Recipe For Disaster#054.speaker: Frank

Recipe For Disaster#055.src: Welp, guess you know how to cook up a simple Skyhigh Pie, right? Off you go, I'll be waiting here when you have the ingredients.
Recipe For Disaster#055.speaker: Frank

Recipe For Disaster#056.src: Hehe, just messin' with you, man! Shoulda seen your face.
Recipe For Disaster#056.speaker: Frank

Recipe For Disaster#057.src: First, we're gonna need some kinda flour. A lil' [Sunrise Flour] aughtta do.
Recipe For Disaster#057.speaker: Frank

Recipe For Disaster#058.src: A good-sized [Blue-Ring Grook Egg] should give us a lil' kick. Not as much as those grooks'll give you a kick if they see you pilfering their eggs, though!
Recipe For Disaster#058.speaker: Frank

Recipe For Disaster#059.src: Finally, the secret ingredient - A [Skyhigh Raspberry]. Real good stuff, but it's a fair way out. Guess a lil' walking never hurt anyone, huh? Not that I've ever bothered.
Recipe For Disaster#059.speaker: Frank

Recipe For Disaster#060.src: Huh, you've got a bad memory? Yeah, me too, man. Here's a Recipe Book, just right-click to open it up and check where to grab the ingredients!
Recipe For Disaster#060.speaker: Frank

Recipe For Disaster#061.src: Return here once you've got them all. Peace out, dude!
Recipe For Disaster#061.speaker: Frank

Recipe For Disaster#062.src: Collect [{~} {Ingredient}] at [X, Y, Z] or check your recipe book.

Recipe For Disaster#063.src: Welcome to Astralus' Astral House! Can you get to the top by flipping gravity?
Recipe For Disaster#063.speaker: Astralus

Recipe For Disaster#064.src: Astronomical progress! But this is just the beginning!
Recipe For Disaster#064.speaker: Astralus

Recipe For Disaster#065.src: ...And why did you come to my tower?
Recipe For Disaster#065.speaker: Astralus

Recipe For Disaster#066.src: My Moonsalt? How absurd! I collected mine myself, you collect yours! It's only fair.
Recipe For Disaster#066.speaker: Astralus

Recipe For Disaster#067.src: Darn humans, you never listen! I said... Get. It. Yourself.
Recipe For Disaster#067.speaker: Astralus

Recipe For Disaster#068.src: What takes you here, strangeling? What namings do you have? Hu-man? We claim Humyn! Bad choose, pick elsewhere strangeling!
Recipe For Disaster#068.speaker: Regular Humyn

Recipe For Disaster#069.src: Investigating for helping? How many conveniences! Humyns requires assistancing! You observers, humyns failflies into large crater-rock!
Recipe For Disaster#069.speaker: Regular Humyn

Recipe For Disaster#070.src: Burnmilk run out and one direction to retrieve it is moonsalt! We strike lucknugget and discover moonsalt on crater-rock!
Recipe For Disaster#070.speaker: Regular Humyn

Recipe For Disaster#071.src: Refined moonsalt gives burnmilk for spacezoom! Inconveniencing, spacezoom destroyed. Humyns create miniscule Spacezoom!
Recipe For Disaster#071.speaker: Regular Humyn

Recipe For Disaster#072.src: Only singular humyn can fit in current spacezoom. If strangeling helps humyns will let strangeling in spacezoom. Humyns can create new spacezoom in given time!
Recipe For Disaster#072.speaker: Regular Humyn

Recipe For Disaster#073.src: Humyns currently residing on crater-rock, meaning waiting is not result of death!
Recipe For Disaster#073.speaker: Regular Humyn

Recipe For Disaster#074.src: Moonsalt discovered in saltcave in north, strangeling follow path!
Recipe For Disaster#074.speaker: Regular Humyn

Recipe For Disaster#075.src: Just [{~} Unrefined Moonsalt] need for burnmilk, strangeling can grab any left over!
Recipe For Disaster#075.speaker: Regular Humyn

Recipe For Disaster#076.src: When strangeling has moonsalt, refine at device beside humyn and go zoom in spacezoom!
Recipe For Disaster#076.speaker: Regular Humyn

Recipe For Disaster#077.src: Hello aaand welcome to the Racetrack of the Century!
Recipe For Disaster#077.speaker: Snail Race Supervisor

Recipe For Disaster#078.src: One winner, one loser. And Usnail Bolt eats losers for breakfast.
Recipe For Disaster#078.speaker: Snail Race Supervisor

Recipe For Disaster#079.src: Breakfast? Wait, did I have breakfast? A little breckkie could be good fo-
Recipe For Disaster#079.speaker: Snail Race Supervisor

Recipe For Disaster#080.src: Well, no matter. What do you say, adventurer? Enter the race against Usnail Bolt. The grand prize is some Snail Slime!
Recipe For Disaster#080.speaker: Snail Race Supervisor

Recipe For Disaster#082.src: Shame, could've been a great race. See you around, adventurer!
Recipe For Disaster#082.speaker: Snail Race Supervisor

Recipe For Disaster#083.src: Well well well... looks like Usnail Bolt has won this one. Again.
Recipe For Disaster#083.speaker: Snail Race Supervisor

Recipe For Disaster#084.src: Not your lucky day, human. Oh well, you know the price for losing. Guards!
Recipe For Disaster#084.speaker: Snail Race Supervisor

Recipe For Disaster#085.src: Wowee! In what turned out to be an amazing race, the human has managed to steal the lead right out from Usnail Bolt's nose!
Recipe For Disaster#085.speaker: Snail Race Supervisor

Recipe For Disaster#086.src: Here, human. Take this slime as your prize.
Recipe For Disaster#086.speaker: Snail Race Supervisor

Recipe For Disaster#087.src: ISN'T THIS JUST ABSOLUTELY FANTASTIC. A HUMAN?! WHO WOULD HAVE GUESSED.
Recipe For Disaster#087.speaker: Talking Mushroom

Recipe For Disaster#088.src: YOU'RE THE SEVENTH ONE PASSING ME TODAY AND YOU'RE NO DIFFERENT FROM THE OTHERS.
Recipe For Disaster#088.speaker: Talking Mushroom

Recipe For Disaster#089.src: EVERY SINGLE ONE WITH THAT DOPEY SHEEPISH LOOK ON THEIR FACE, AS IF A TALKING MUSHROOM IS OUT OF THE BLUE.
Recipe For Disaster#089.speaker: Talking Mushroom

Recipe For Disaster#090.src: GIVE ME A BREAK, I'VE HAD ENOUGH OF JERKS PICKING ME UP AND DISRESPECTING ME LIKE THAT. PRIVATE SPACE, EVER HEARD OF IT?
Recipe For Disaster#090.speaker: Talking Mushroom

Recipe For Disaster#091.src: WHY DO I EVEN TRY. JUST LOOK AT YOU! THE EPITOME OF CLUELESS. WHAT NOW, GONNA TAKE ME ON SOME LOONEY ADVENTURE ACROSS THE SKY ISLANDS?
Recipe For Disaster#091.speaker: Talking Mushroom

Recipe For Disaster#092.src: I HOPE NOT, IF YOU WERE THINKING THAT. I'VE ALREADY LOST A STEM TODAY BECAUSE SOME DIMWIT TRIED TAKING A BITE OUT OF ME... LIVE!
Recipe For Disaster#092.speaker: Talking Mushroom

Recipe For Disaster#093.src: DON'T TELL ME, ARE YOU TAKING ME ON SOME LOONEY ADVENTURE ACROSS THE SKY ISLANDS? HOW LOVELY.
Recipe For Disaster#093.speaker: Talking Mushroom

Recipe For Disaster#094.src: A KITCHEN YOU SAY, WELL, IF IT'LL PUT ME OUT OF MY MISERY AS SOON AS POSSIBLE, THEN WHY NOT.
Recipe For Disaster#094.speaker: Talking Mushroom

Recipe For Disaster#095.src: WAIT, WHY ARE YOU STUFFING ME INTO YOUR BAG? HOW DO YOU EXPECT ME TO BREATHE IN HERE?!
Recipe For Disaster#095.speaker: Talking Mushroom

Recipe For Disaster#096.src: Hello there! I can see you knead you some sunrise flour, don't you?
Recipe For Disaster#096.speaker: Baker

Recipe For Disaster#097.src: It's needed rye away? Well no worries, friend!
Recipe For Disaster#097.speaker: Baker

Recipe For Disaster#098.src: Well butter me up and call me toast, it seems I ran out of the stuff, there's none left.
Recipe For Disaster#098.speaker: Baker

Recipe For Disaster#099.src: I'm sorry if I see to just be loafing around, but at yeast I know how to make some more.
Recipe For Disaster#099.speaker: Baker

Recipe For Disaster#100.src: Can you see that wheat field over there, next to the bakery? You can farm up some wheat and pop it on the mill.
Recipe For Disaster#100.speaker: Baker

Recipe For Disaster#101.src: Grab a scythe from the tool merchant next dough and get to work!
Recipe For Disaster#101.speaker: Baker

Recipe For Disaster#102.src: Make as much as you want, I've made all the bread I need for today already.
Recipe For Disaster#102.speaker: Baker

Recipe For Disaster#103.src: Howdy, pal! Looking for some Skyhigh Raspberries? They work great in a pie!
Recipe For Disaster#103.speaker: Raspberry Vendor

Recipe For Disaster#104.src: If you're interested, it's just a small fee of {~} Emeralds to get access to the island.
Recipe For Disaster#104.speaker: Raspberry Vendor

Recipe For Disaster#105.src: A man's gotta make a living somehow, so I've set up a system of cannons to take you right up to the island they grow on!
Recipe For Disaster#105.speaker: Raspberry Vendor

Recipe For Disaster#106.src: So, whaddya say? Small price for a little adventure, and as many raspberries as you can eat!
Recipe For Disaster#106.speaker: Raspberry Vendor

Recipe For Disaster#107.src: Alrighty! Just head on over to that island beside me and jump in the cannon - it's perfectly safe, I promise!
Recipe For Disaster#107.speaker: Raspberry Vendor

Recipe For Disaster#108.src: Find your way up the island and grab as many raspberries as you want! When you're done just jump in the big cannon and come back to shore!
Recipe For Disaster#108.speaker: Raspberry Vendor

Recipe For Disaster#109.src: Alrighty, no worries. Feel free to come back if you're ever in the mood for some!
Recipe For Disaster#109.speaker: Raspberry Vendor

Recipe For Disaster#110.src: Present the ingredients to your chosen chef.

Recipe For Disaster#111.src: Have you got all the ingredients? Amazing!
Recipe For Disaster#111.speaker: Brie

Recipe For Disaster#112.src: Okay you set back and let me work on the cooking, just pass over the ingredients!
Recipe For Disaster#112.speaker: Brie

Recipe For Disaster#113.src: Aha! That should do it! Hopefully I've done everything correctly... but wow, would you look at the color of that soup!
Recipe For Disaster#113.speaker: Brie

Recipe For Disaster#114.src: You should bring it over to Hamsey to see what he thinks!
Recipe For Disaster#114.speaker: Brie

Recipe For Disaster#115.src: You got everything? Took you long enough.
Recipe For Disaster#115.speaker: Kale

Recipe For Disaster#116.src: Let's get started. Everyone else already finished. Stay back while I work my magic.
Recipe For Disaster#116.speaker: Kale

Recipe For Disaster#117.src: Mwah! My masterdish is finished. Present this to the chef, I'm sure he'll love it!
Recipe For Disaster#117.speaker: Kale

Recipe For Disaster#118.src: And be CAREFUL taking it over. That food could be worth HUNDREDS once I'm famous!
Recipe For Disaster#118.speaker: Kale

Recipe For Disaster#119.src: You got everything? Awesome stuff, dude.
Recipe For Disaster#119.speaker: Frank

Recipe For Disaster#120.src: I'll just take a smallll bit of this raspberry - chef's commission, eh? And let's get started!
Recipe For Disaster#120.speaker: Frank

Recipe For Disaster#121.src: And we're all done. Hamsey's gonna love this.
Recipe For Disaster#121.speaker: Frank

Recipe For Disaster#122.src: Here you go, dawg. Pleasure working with you - show this to Hamsey and we'll see what he thinks. Make sure you don't "lose" any of it on the way over - you know what they say about your own supply!
Recipe For Disaster#122.speaker: Frank

Recipe For Disaster#123.src: Talk to Hamsey with your finished dish.

Recipe For Disaster#124.src: Ah, you have finished your dish? Well, then, il est temps de goûter!
Recipe For Disaster#124.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#125.src: Let us retreat to my private dining room... this way!
Recipe For Disaster#125.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#126.src: Meet Hamsey in the dining room at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Recipe For Disaster#127.src: Welcome back, mon ami! I see you've return with a dish in hand!
Recipe For Disaster#127.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#128.src: A stew? Seems simple, but even the simplest things in life can be le meilleur!
Recipe For Disaster#128.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#129.src: Adventurer, are you sure you made this dish? It is so good I might as well close the restaurant!
Recipe For Disaster#129.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#130.src: You never fail to surprise me, friend. Here, take this apron, an essential of any true chef.
Recipe For Disaster#130.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#131.src: I cannot help but notice that your dish is ready!
Recipe For Disaster#131.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#132.src: Let me taste your dish and I will present you mine! Mon dieu, une omelette?
Recipe For Disaster#132.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#133.src: Je suis déçu, ami. I would prefer biting into a mule derrière! This thing... a Gert wouldn't touch it!
Recipe For Disaster#133.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#134.src: I see you haven't improved in the art of cuisine. Leave me be, and come back when you have learned what good food is!
Recipe For Disaster#134.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#135.src: I see you've returned, and not empty handed. Please, show me what you've created!
Recipe For Disaster#135.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#136.src: A pie? Why, you must have been helped by Frank. He always has a thing for making pie!
Recipe For Disaster#136.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#137.src: I can see that your compétences culinaires are very well developed!
Recipe For Disaster#137.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#138.src: Though I will not truly call you a chef quite yet, you are très bien! Have this reward as congratulations!
Recipe For Disaster#138.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Reclaiming the House#000.src: Join Elphaba on a mission in the Temporary Camp at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
Reclaiming the House#000.dst: 到 [-{~1}, {~2}, -{~3}] 的 Temporary Camp 加入 Elphaba 的任務

Reclaiming the House#001.src: Oh, a Wynnic soldier out here in the boondocks? Honestly, you're just what we need- I could use your help, if you're able?
Reclaiming the House#001.dst: 喔，這種鳥不生蛋的地方居然有 Wynn 的士兵？說真的，你正是我們需要的人——如果你有空的話，能不能幫我一個忙？
Reclaiming the House#001.speaker: Elphaba

Reclaiming the House#002.src: Good, thank you. Let me lock down the camp before I give you the briefing, though.
Reclaiming the House#002.dst: 太好了，謝謝。不過在講簡報之前，先讓我把營地封鎖起來。
Reclaiming the House#002.speaker: Elphaba

Reclaiming the House#003.src: My name is Elphaba. I've been working with the Gavellian army for a good few years now.
Reclaiming the House#003.dst: 我叫 Elphaba。我在 Gavel 的軍隊裡待了好幾年了。
Reclaiming the House#003.speaker: Elphaba

Reclaiming the House#004.src: I'm the commander of the {p} Outpost down ahead. It's a strategic fortress, placed to monitor the Orcish capital.
Reclaiming the House#004.dst: 我是前面那座 {p} Outpost 的指揮官。那是一座戰略要塞，位置就是用來監視獸人首都的。
Reclaiming the House#004.speaker: Elphaba

Reclaiming the House#005.src: It was safe for a long while, but especially in the past while the Orcs have gotten far bolder, more aggressive.
Reclaiming the House#005.dst: 有很長一段時間都很安全，但最近這陣子獸人變得大膽多了，也更有攻擊性。
Reclaiming the House#005.speaker: Elphaba

Reclaiming the House#006.src: They overwhelmed the outpost- we had to retreat and set up this camp to watch over the place we used to watch over them with!
Reclaiming the House#006.dst: 他們把哨站攻陷了——我們只好撤退，在這裡紮營，反過來監視那個我們原本用來監視他們的地方！
Reclaiming the House#006.speaker: Elphaba

Reclaiming the House#007.src: I need more firepower if I'm going... to get...
Reclaiming the House#007.dst: 如果我要……奪回……我需要更多火力……
Reclaiming the House#007.speaker: Elphaba

Reclaiming the House#008.src: ...oh no. See, this is what I mean! The orcs are coming!
Reclaiming the House#008.dst: ……噢不。你看，我說的就是這個！獸人來了！
Reclaiming the House#008.speaker: Elphaba

Reclaiming the House#009.src: Brace yourself, soldier! Protect the camp!
Reclaiming the House#009.speaker: Elphaba

Reclaiming the House#010.src: Kill the mobs raiding the Camp.

Reclaiming the House#011.src: This is the third attack in three days! How many reinforcements have they got?!
Reclaiming the House#011.dst: 這是三天內第三次進攻了！他們到底有多少援軍？！
Reclaiming the House#011.speaker: Elphaba

Reclaiming the House#012.src: Gah! Their casters are strong, careful!
Reclaiming the House#012.dst: 咳啊！他們的施法者很強，小心！
Reclaiming the House#012.speaker: Elphaba

Reclaiming the House#013.src: Talk to Elphaba for information on the upcoming attack.
Reclaiming the House#013.dst: 跟 Elphaba 談談接下來的攻擊。

Reclaiming the House#014.src: Ugh, I think that was all of them... Come here now, I'll start up where we left off.
Reclaiming the House#014.dst: 唔，我想應該全解決了……過來吧，我們接著剛才的講。
Reclaiming the House#014.speaker: Elphaba

Reclaiming the House#015.src: Not sure I could have done that myself. I'm lucky you came around when you did, soldier.
Reclaiming the House#015.dst: 這場我一個人恐怕撐不下來。你來得正是時候，士兵，算我走運。
Reclaiming the House#015.speaker: Elphaba

Reclaiming the House#016.src: Anyway, it's clear I'm going to need more firepower if I'm going to have a shot at reclaiming that outpost.
Reclaiming the House#016.dst: 總之，很明顯，我要有機會奪回那座哨站，就需要更多火力。
Reclaiming the House#016.speaker: Elphaba

Reclaiming the House#017.src: You've certainly got the fighting chops, so I'd appreciate the aid, but we've got to come up with a plan, fast.
Reclaiming the House#017.dst: 你的身手沒話說，有你幫忙我很感激，但我們得盡快想出一個計畫。
Reclaiming the House#017.speaker: Elphaba

Reclaiming the House#018.src: There's an old tower near the outpost- some old storage silo. It was built taller than the fort, so we might be able to spy on them from there.
Reclaiming the House#018.dst: 哨站附近有一座舊塔——是個老倉庫塔。它蓋得比堡壘還高，也許我們可以從那裡偵察他們。
Reclaiming the House#018.speaker: Elphaba

Reclaiming the House#019.src: It's a risk though, since it's so close by, but we have no other options. Meet me at the tower southeast of here so we can survey the situation.
Reclaiming the House#019.dst: 不過這很冒險，因為離得太近了，可是我們沒有別的選擇。到這裡東南方的那座塔跟我會合，我們去看看情況。
Reclaiming the House#019.speaker: Elphaba

Reclaiming the House#020.src: Go to the watch tower at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] to plan the attack.

Reclaiming the House#021.src: Soldier! I'm right behind you. You can see our outpost- and the tower I mentioned.
Reclaiming the House#021.dst: 士兵！我就在你後面。你看得到我們的哨站——還有我剛才說的那座塔。
Reclaiming the House#021.speaker: Elphaba

Reclaiming the House#022.src: We need to find a way in. A lot of soldiers were caught unaware during the Orcs' assault, too.
Reclaiming the House#022.dst: 我們得找到進去的路。獸人突襲的時候，很多士兵都措手不及。
Reclaiming the House#022.speaker: Elphaba

Reclaiming the House#023.src: If there's any survivors in there, we should make rescuing them a priority.
Reclaiming the House#023.dst: 如果裡面還有生還者，救出他們應該是第一優先。
Reclaiming the House#023.speaker: Elphaba

Reclaiming the House#024.src: After all, it means more manpower for us. We can't count on that being the case, though...
Reclaiming the House#024.dst: 畢竟那代表我們多了人手。不過我們也不能指望真的有……
Reclaiming the House#024.speaker: Elphaba

Reclaiming the House#025.src: Come on, hurry inside before one of the orcs spots us!
Reclaiming the House#025.dst: 來吧，趁獸人發現我們之前趕快進去！
Reclaiming the House#025.speaker: Elphaba

Reclaiming the House#026.src: Enter to the watch tower at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] to plan the attack.

Reclaiming the House#027.src: Alright, this is a pretty clear view. Let's see what's going on in there...
Reclaiming the House#027.dst: 好，這裡視野很清楚。來看看裡面是什麼情況……
Reclaiming the House#027.speaker: Elphaba

Reclaiming the House#028.src: Wh- I'm shocked! In the middle there- they just caged the soldiers instead of killing them? That's... kind of a relief.
Reclaiming the House#028.dst: 什——我很意外！正中間那裡——他們把士兵關起來，沒有殺掉？這……算是鬆一口氣。
Reclaiming the House#028.speaker: Elphaba

Reclaiming the House#029.src: There's definitely too many orcs in the plaza for us to take down on our own...
Reclaiming the House#029.dst: 廣場上的獸人絕對多到我們兩個吃不下……
Reclaiming the House#029.speaker: Elphaba

Reclaiming the House#030.src: ...but that cage is held up by those ropes. If we can cut them, the other soldiers should be able to help!
Reclaiming the House#030.dst: ……可是那個籠子是靠那幾條繩子吊著的。只要我們能割斷它們，其他士兵應該就能幫上忙！
Reclaiming the House#030.speaker: Elphaba

Reclaiming the House#031.src: Alright, now I just need to figure out how we can both get in... There's sentries on the perimeter, so going over may no be an option...
Reclaiming the House#031.dst: 好，現在我只要想出我們兩個要怎麼進去……外圍有哨兵，翻過去大概行不通……
Reclaiming the House#031.speaker: Elphaba

Reclaiming the House#032.src: Maybe we can keep an eye out on their sentry patterns and look for an opening-
Reclaiming the House#032.dst: 也許我們可以盯著他們的巡邏規律，找一個空檔——
Reclaiming the House#032.speaker: Elphaba

Reclaiming the House#033.src: Humans on old tower! Junhur will shoot! This our place now, get out!!
Reclaiming the House#033.dst: 舊塔上有人類！Junhur 要開砲了！這裡現在是我們的地盤，滾出去！！
Reclaiming the House#033.speaker: Orc

Reclaiming the House#034.src: Aw, not now! I knew this was a risk, no time to get out... Brace for impact!!
Reclaiming the House#034.dst: 唉，怎麼偏偏是現在！我就知道這很冒險，來不及出去了……準備撞擊！！
Reclaiming the House#034.speaker: Elphaba

Reclaiming the House#035.src: Old tower fall! Junhur is best cannon shooter!!
Reclaiming the House#035.dst: 舊塔倒了！Junhur 是最厲害的砲手！！
Reclaiming the House#035.speaker: Orc

Reclaiming the House#036.src: Agh, soldier!! Are you alright, where'd you fall?!
Reclaiming the House#036.dst: 咳啊，士兵！！你還好嗎，你摔到哪裡去了？！
Reclaiming the House#036.speaker: Elphaba

Reclaiming the House#037.src: Ah... Wow. You barely look scratched, you must've gotten really lucky.
Reclaiming the House#037.dst: 啊……哇。你身上幾乎連擦傷都沒有，運氣一定很好。
Reclaiming the House#037.speaker: Elphaba

Reclaiming the House#038.src: Not so much here... I'm pretty battered after that. At least one of us is in good condition...
Reclaiming the House#038.dst: 我這邊就沒那麼好了……剛剛那下把我摔得不輕。至少我們有一個人狀況還行……
Reclaiming the House#038.speaker: Elphaba

Reclaiming the House#039.src: Unfortunately, that means figuring a way in is up to you. We can't examine their sentry patterns from down here.
Reclaiming the House#039.dst: 很不巧，那代表想辦法進去這件事得靠你了。從這下面看不到他們的巡邏規律。
Reclaiming the House#039.speaker: Elphaba

Reclaiming the House#040.src: I'll survive, sure, but I won't be able to walk around and defend myself for a while.
Reclaiming the House#040.dst: 我死不了，這點我確定，但接下來一段時間我沒辦法走動、也沒辦法自保。
Reclaiming the House#040.speaker: Elphaba

Reclaiming the House#041.src: I hate leaving you on your own like this, but if it's any consolation, you should be tough enough, or lucky enough, to get through.
Reclaiming the House#041.dst: 把你一個人丟在這裡我很過意不去，不過說句安慰的話——你應該夠強，或者夠幸運，撐得過去。
Reclaiming the House#041.speaker: Elphaba

Reclaiming the House#042.src: Explore the perimeter of the outpost. Try to find a way in, but be careful, okay?
Reclaiming the House#042.dst: 去探查哨站的外圍。想辦法找到進去的路，但要小心，好嗎？
Reclaiming the House#042.speaker: Elphaba

Reclaiming the House#043.src: Explore the outpost's surroundings to find another way in.
Reclaiming the House#043.dst: 探查哨站周圍，找出另一條進去的路。

Reclaiming the House#044.src: Follow the trail of mud left by the orc. It leads to the cave at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
Reclaiming the House#044.dst: 跟著獸人留下的泥痕走。它通往 [-{~1}, {~2}, -{~3}] 的洞穴

Reclaiming the House#045.src: Enter the outpost while covered in mud.

Reclaiming the House#046.dst: 又是滿身泥的獸人？快進去！
Reclaiming the House#046.speaker: Orc Guard

Reclaiming the House#047.src: Cut the ropes to free the guards from the cage.
Reclaiming the House#047.dst: 割斷繩子，把衛兵從籠子裡放出來。

Reclaiming the House#049.src: Good thinking with the mud disguise, soldier! They never suspected a thing, now come help us out over here!
Reclaiming the House#049.dst: 用泥巴偽裝，這一招高明，士兵！他們完全沒起疑，快過來幫我們！
Reclaiming the House#049.speaker: Soldier

Reclaiming the House#050.src: Kill the Orcish Overtakers, we'll help keep the other ones off you!
Reclaiming the House#050.dst: 去殺 Orcish Overtaker，其他的我們幫你擋住！
Reclaiming the House#050.speaker: Soldier

Reclaiming the House#051.src: Open the gate with a spell

Reclaiming the House#052.src: The Overtakers are down, the other Orcs are flailing! Open the outpost's entrance with a spell now, we've got this under control!
Reclaiming the House#052.dst: Overtaker 倒了，其他獸人亂成一團！現在用法術打開哨站的入口，這裡我們控制得住！
Reclaiming the House#052.speaker: Soldier

Reclaiming the House#054.src: Phew... That's some fine work there, soldier! The outpost is back under our control!
Reclaiming the House#054.dst: 呼……幹得漂亮，士兵！哨站回到我們手上了！
Reclaiming the House#054.speaker: Elphaba

Reclaiming the House#055.src: Glad to see some more capable Wynnic hands over here. Though, I didn't catch your name. Would you mind?
Reclaiming the House#055.dst: 很高興這裡多了一雙能幹的 Wynn 人的手。不過，我還沒請教你的名字。方便告訴我嗎？
Reclaiming the House#055.speaker: Elphaba

Reclaiming the House#056.src: {u}, huh? I'll remember that. You barely even needed my help, heh... Wish I hadn't been such a burden, but at least it worked out.
Reclaiming the House#056.dst: {u}，是吧？我記住了。你根本幾乎不需要我幫忙，呵……真希望我沒變成累贅，不過至少結果是好的。
Reclaiming the House#056.speaker: Elphaba

Reclaiming the House#057.src: Here- it's some of my own personal spending money, as a thank-you gift.
Reclaiming the House#057.dst: 拿去——這是我自己的一點私房錢，當作謝禮。
Reclaiming the House#057.speaker: Elphaba

Reclaiming the House#058.src: Alright everyone, let's get this place ship-shape! Everything needs to be repaired in case of another attack!!
Reclaiming the House#058.dst: 好了各位，我們把這裡整頓好！所有東西都要修復，以防他們再來一次！！
Reclaiming the House#058.speaker: Elphaba

Recover the Past#000.dst: 到  跟 Picard 博士談話。

Recover the Past#001.src: Success! Success, success, SUCCESS! I'm a genius, the smartest man alive!
Recover the Past#001.dst: 成功了！成功、成功、成——功！我是天才，是世上最聰明的人！
Recover the Past#001.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#002.src: You there, random bystander! You have witnessed a magical marvel! I have just successfully restored my memories from years ago!
Recover the Past#002.dst: 那邊那位，隨機的路人！你剛才見證了一項魔法奇蹟！我剛剛成功復原了自己多年以前的記憶！
Recover the Past#002.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#003.src: You look to be from Fruma, yes? So you know just as well as I that your memories of your life before have vanished. Poof. Gone!
Recover the Past#003.dst: 你看起來也是 Fruma 來的吧？那你跟我一樣清楚，你過去的人生記憶已經消失了。噗。沒了！
Recover the Past#003.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#004.src: But with this device... we can change that! Restore what has been lost! Recover the you get the point.
Recover the Past#004.dst: 但有了這個裝置……我們可以改變這件事！把失去的東西找回來！復原那個——你懂我的意思。
Recover the Past#004.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#005.src: Now, I'm in great need of test subjects... You would do well as one, yes, but I need to be more certain this thing works.
Recover the Past#005.dst: 現在，我極度需要受試者……你當一個是不錯，不過我得更確定這東西真的有效。
Recover the Past#005.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#006.src: Listen here! I have a proposition to make. You'd like your memories back, yes? Bring me enough test subjects, and I can show you what you've lost!
Recover the Past#006.dst: 聽好了！我有個提議。你想把記憶拿回來吧？帶足夠的受試者來給我，我就讓你看看你失去了什麼！
Recover the Past#006.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#007.src: Let's see, let's see... We need individuals originally from Fruma. There are a few of those around here.
Recover the Past#007.dst: 我看看、我看看……我們需要原本來自 Fruma 的人。這一帶有幾個。
Recover the Past#007.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#008.src: You can start with the would-be sailor, Caid. You'll find him just past {p} follow the path until you reach the river.
Recover the Past#008.dst: 你可以先從那個自稱水手的 Caid 開始。他就在 {p} 過去一點——沿著路走到河邊就會看到他。
Recover the Past#008.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#009.src: In the meantime, I'll be making adjustments here... It's not perfect just yet. I'm still missing large portions of my memory... Hm? You're still in here? Get going!
Recover the Past#009.dst: 在那之前，我會在這裡繼續調整……它還不算完美。我自己還有很大一部分的記憶是空的……嗯？你怎麼還在這裡？快去啊！
Recover the Past#009.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#010.src: Recover the sailor Caid near his boat at .
Recover the Past#010.dst: 到  的船邊找到水手 Caid。

Recover the Past#011.src: Well? I've given you an assignment, what are you still doing here? Go find the sailor Caid. You'll find him just past {p} follow the path until you reach the river.
Recover the Past#011.dst: 怎麼？我都把任務交給你了，你還待在這裡做什麼？去找那個水手 Caid。他就在 {p} 過去一點，沿著路走到河邊。
Recover the Past#011.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#012.src: Huh? Oh! I ah, nothing to see here! Just... just taking a look at my good old ship!
Recover the Past#012.dst: 啊？哦！我——呃，這裡沒什麼好看的！只是……只是在看看我這艘老船！
Recover the Past#012.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#013.src: Picard sent you? The guy cooped up in the tower? Huh. Good to know he's finally finished his work. But what could he want me for?
Recover the Past#013.dst: Picard 派你來的？那個窩在塔裡的傢伙？哦。真高興知道他總算把東西弄完了。可是他找我做什麼？
Recover the Past#013.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#014.src: ... Look at my memories from Fruma, huh? I'm not so sure 'bout that. If they're missing, they must be missing for a reason. I'm-I'm happy here! Don't need to know nothin' about...
Recover the Past#014.dst: ……看我在 Fruma 的記憶？這我可就不太確定了。既然那些記憶不見了，那一定有它不見的理由。我——我在這裡過得很好！用不著知道什麼……
Recover the Past#014.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#015.src: ... Yeah, alright. I'll come with you to get my memory checked out. Just, do me a solid first, alright?
Recover the Past#015.dst: ……好啦，行。我跟你去讓人檢查我的記憶。不過你得先幫我一個忙，行吧？
Recover the Past#015.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#016.src: I'm something of a builder. Figured I'd try my hand at making a ship, and, here it is! Pretty good, right?
Recover the Past#016.dst: 我算是個會蓋東西的人。想說來試試造艘船，然後，就是這艘啦！挺不錯的吧？
Recover the Past#016.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#017.src: That's what I'm talking about, take that Reynauld! I knew someone would like it!
Recover the Past#017.dst: 這就對了嘛，Reynauld 你聽到沒！我就知道會有人喜歡！
Recover the Past#017.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#018.src: Hey! Heh, well you're not wrong. I cobbled it together using mostly junk I found laying around. Still, it's pretty impressive for a scrap heap, don't you think?
Recover the Past#018.dst: 喂！嘿嘿，好吧，你說得也沒錯。這是我用四處撿來的廢料東拼西湊的。不過對一堆廢鐵來說，還挺像樣的吧？
Recover the Past#018.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#019.src: You'll have to promise me you won't tell Reynauld but... Some of the more exotic components have been comin' from the guard's quarters. Nothing big! Just some stuff skimmed off the top...
Recover the Past#019.dst: 你得答應我不會跟 Reynauld 說……有些比較稀有的零件是從衛兵的營房來的。沒什麼大不了的！就是從上面撈個一點……
Recover the Past#019.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#020.src: I only need one more part to finish it off, and well, you see... A shipment just arrived from the blacksmith's... You see where I'm going with this?
Recover the Past#020.dst: 我只差最後一個零件就完工了，然後，你看……鐵匠鋪剛好到了一批貨……你懂我的意思了吧？
Recover the Past#020.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#021.src: Get me the part from the blacksmith's and I'll come with you to Picard's tower. I could hardly leave my baby alone unfinished like this now, could I?
Recover the Past#021.dst: 幫我從鐵匠鋪把那個零件弄來，我就跟你去 Picard 的塔。我總不能把我的寶貝就這樣丟著不完工吧？
Recover the Past#021.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#022.src: Steal the box from the Blacksmith's house at .
Recover the Past#022.dst: 從  的鐵匠家偷出那個箱子。

Recover the Past#023.src: Have you gotten the box yet? It's at the blacksmith's, a short walk away from here in {p}. Just, don't get spotted!
Recover the Past#023.dst: 箱子拿到了嗎？就在鐵匠那裡，離這裡不遠，在 {p} 裡面。記住，別被發現了！
Recover the Past#023.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#024.src: Bring the package to Caid at .
Recover the Past#024.dst: 把包裹帶到  給 Caid。

Recover the Past#025.src: ... You're back! How did it go? Here, I'll take the goods.
Recover the Past#025.dst: ……你回來了！怎麼樣？來，東西給我。
Recover the Past#025.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#026.src: The blacksmith didn't see anything right? I'm a bit worried Reynauld is on my trail...
Recover the Past#026.dst: 鐵匠沒看到什麼吧？我有點擔心 Reynauld 已經盯上我了……
Recover the Past#026.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#027.src: Ah, whatever! Finally, time to finish this ol' boat of mine!
Recover the Past#027.dst: 啊，管他的！總算能把我這艘老船收尾了！
Recover the Past#027.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#028.src: There we go! Ta da! How's it look?
Recover the Past#028.dst: 搞定！鏘鏘！看起來怎麼樣？
Recover the Past#028.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#029.src: That's right! Every ship worth its salt's got to have a bell. Wouldn't be the same without one.
Recover the Past#029.dst: 沒錯！像樣的船都得有一口鐘。少了它就不對味了。
Recover the Past#029.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#030.src: What's with the attitude! Every ship worth its salt's got to have a bell, you know? Do you think the Seaskipper'd be caught dead without one? Didn't think so!
Recover the Past#030.dst: 你那什麼態度！像樣的船都得有一口鐘，你知道吧？你以為渡船會沒有鐘嗎？我想也是！
Recover the Past#030.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#031.src: Anyway... I guess you've fulfilled your end of the bargain, so I've got no choice but to fulfil mine!
Recover the Past#031.dst: 總之……我猜你那邊的條件是履行了，那我也只好履行我這邊的！
Recover the Past#031.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#032.src: Lead the way to Picard's tower! Let's see what's hiding in this big head o' mine.
Recover the Past#032.dst: 帶路去 Picard 的塔吧！來看看我這顆大腦袋裡藏了什麼。
Recover the Past#032.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#033.src: Bring Caid to Dr. Picard in his tower at .
Recover the Past#033.dst: 帶 Caid 到  的塔裡找 Picard 博士。

Recover the Past#035.src: Aha! You've returned! Good, good, this'll be a good test of my changes...
Recover the Past#035.dst: 啊哈！你們回來了！好、好，這正好可以測試我做的那些調整……
Recover the Past#035.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#036.src: ... Right. And this is the doctor we're trusting with my memories?
Recover the Past#036.dst: ……好喔。所以我們要把我的記憶交給這位博士？
Recover the Past#036.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#037.src: Now, now, don't underestimate my genius. You'll be fine! Probably. I'd give it a ninety-five, well, ninety percent chance. Now, step up here.
Recover the Past#037.dst: 好了好了，別小看我的天才。你不會有事的！大概啦。我給它九成五——嗯，九成的成功率。來，站上來這裡。
Recover the Past#037.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#038.src: Alright... I trust you know what you're doing, doctor...
Recover the Past#038.dst: 好吧……我相信您知道自己在做什麼，博士……
Recover the Past#038.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#039.src: And now, all I need to do is... Activate the spell here, hit the switch there, and...
Recover the Past#039.dst: 接下來，我只要……在這裡啟動法術，按下那邊的開關，然後……
Recover the Past#039.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#041.src: Right, let's see what we've got here... Edwin, can you check that other crate over there?
Recover the Past#041.dst: 好，來看看我們有什麼……Edwin，你能不能檢查一下那邊另一個板條箱？
Recover the Past#041.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#042.src: Sure thing. Say Caid. How do you keep getting ahold of these things? There's expensive parts in these, and that seems a bit out of your price range.
Recover the Past#042.dst: 沒問題。欸 Caid。你到底是怎麼一直弄到這些東西的？裡面有些零件很貴，感覺不太是你買得起的價位。
Recover the Past#042.speaker: Edwin

Recover the Past#043.src: Well... Let's just say the latest resupply package for the guards is slightly lighter than it might otherwise be.
Recover the Past#043.dst: 這個嘛……就說衛兵那批最新的補給包，比原本應該有的重量輕了一點點吧。
Recover the Past#043.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#044.src: Wait what? Caid, please tell me you haven't been stealing from the guards. You know they won't
Recover the Past#044.dst: 等等你說什麼？Caid，拜託告訴我你沒有在偷衛兵的東西。你知道他們不會——
Recover the Past#044.speaker: Edwin

Recover the Past#045.src: Edwin, relax. I'm barely skimming off the top of their supplies. They won't notice one or two missing packages out of thirty.
Recover the Past#045.dst: Edwin，放輕鬆。我只是從他們的補給上面撈一點。三十包裡少個一兩包，他們不會發現的。
Recover the Past#045.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#046.src: 'sides, I'm not scared of them. They're here to protect us, aren't they? I figure they'll just let me off with a warning, like they have all those other times.
Recover the Past#046.dst: 再說了，我又不怕他們。他們不就是來保護我們的嗎？我看他們頂多口頭警告我一下，就像前面那幾次一樣。
Recover the Past#046.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#047.src: If... if you say so. I guess you're right. They don't need all those supplies, really. And we can make much better use of these than they would!
Recover the Past#047.dst: 如果……你這麼說的話。我想你說得對。他們其實也用不著那麼多補給。而且我們比他們更懂得怎麼用！
Recover the Past#047.speaker: Edwin

Recover the Past#048.src: Exactly! I'm glad you agree. So, have you found anything goo
Recover the Past#048.dst: 就是這樣！很高興你同意。那麼，你有沒有找到什麼好——
Recover the Past#048.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#049.src: You two! Hold still, you're under arrest!
Recover the Past#049.dst: 你們兩個！別動，你們被捕了！
Recover the Past#049.speaker: Royal Captain

Recover the Past#051.src: E-Edwin! Get back here, you cowa
Recover the Past#051.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#052.src: That's enough out of you. You two, track down the accomplice.
Recover the Past#052.dst: 你夠了。你們兩個，把同夥追出來。
Recover the Past#052.speaker: Royal Captain

Recover the Past#055.src: Caid, you are being placed under arrest for repeated counts of theft of imperial property.
Recover the Past#055.dst: Caid，你因多次竊取帝國財產遭到逮捕。
Recover the Past#055.speaker: Royal Captain

Recover the Past#056.src: Your record shows you have received multiple warnings for previous acts. This was your final chance, and you have thoroughly wasted it.
Recover the Past#056.dst: 你的紀錄顯示，你先前的行為已經收過多次警告。這是你最後一次機會，而你把它徹底浪費掉了。
Recover the Past#056.speaker: Royal Captain

Recover the Past#057.src: Take him to the prison for further questioning, and decide what shall be done with him.
Recover the Past#057.dst: 把他押到監獄進一步訊問，再決定該怎麼處置他。
Recover the Past#057.speaker: Royal Captain

Recover the Past#058.src: Hey! Hello? Bystander-turned-assistant! Get yourself out of that trance, we need to talk.
Recover the Past#058.dst: 喂！哈囉？路人升格的助手！從你那個恍神狀態裡出來，我們得談談。
Recover the Past#058.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#059.src: Hm. Hm hm hm. The memory cut off there...I wonder what we'd see if we could
Recover the Past#059.dst: 嗯。嗯嗯嗯。記憶在那裡斷掉了……我很好奇，要是我們能——
Recover the Past#059.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#061.src: Yes, it appears so... But perhaps, if I can increase the power, then... Yes! I'm a geniu
Recover the Past#061.dst: 是的，看來是如此……不過也許，只要我能把功率提高，那麼……對了！我真是天——
Recover the Past#061.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#062.src: That's all I am?! Just some thief... Is that all I'm good for?
Recover the Past#062.dst: 我就只是這樣？！一個賊……我就只配當這種東西？
Recover the Past#062.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#065.src: Ah! Bystander-turned-assis you know what, I'll just call you my assistant. Finally out of your trance, I see.
Recover the Past#065.dst: 啊！路人升格的助——算了，我就直接叫你助手吧。我看你總算從恍神裡出來了。
Recover the Past#065.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#066.src: But that's of no importance now! What, however, is important is what we've just seen! Memories relived in vivid detail! Truly, this device will change the world!
Recover the Past#066.dst: 不過那現在不重要了！重要的是我們剛才看到的東西！記憶以栩栩如生的細節重現！這個裝置真的會改變世界！
Recover the Past#066.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#067.src: ... Though, I will say. I am a little lost as to the timeline of events. Caid was arrested so how did he find himself here in Wynn, as a soldier?
Recover the Past#067.dst: ……不過我得說。事情的時間順序讓我有點迷惑。Caid 被逮捕了——那他後來怎麼會出現在 Wynn，還當了士兵？
Recover the Past#067.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#068.src: We are in need of more subjects if we are to find out the truth of it! There is a Scout Reynauld on duty today, he is also from Fruma originally, just like yourself.
Recover the Past#068.dst: 要弄清楚真相，我們需要更多受試者！今天有一位偵察兵 Reynauld 在值勤，他原本也是 Fruma 人，跟你一樣。
Recover the Past#068.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#069.src: Yes, hm. You'll find him near the bridge to the {p}. I'm counting on you to convince him to join our experiment. In the name of science!
Recover the Past#069.dst: 對，嗯。你會在通往 {p} 的橋附近找到他。我就靠你去說服他加入我們的實驗了。以科學之名！
Recover the Past#069.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#070.src: Find Scout Reynauld near the bridge to the {p} at .
Recover the Past#070.dst: 到  通往 {p} 的橋附近找到偵察兵 Reynauld。

Recover the Past#071.src: Hm... Where does this barrier lie? Is this magic not strong enough to break through it? Maybe if I increase the power, then...
Recover the Past#071.dst: 嗯……這道屏障究竟在哪裡？是這個魔法還不夠強、突破不了嗎？也許我把功率再提高，那麼……
Recover the Past#071.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#072.src: Gah! Assistant! What are you doing here? Have you spoken to Scout Reynauld yet? You'll find him near the bridge to the {p}.
Recover the Past#072.dst: 啊！助手！你怎麼還在這裡？你跟偵察兵 Reynauld 談過了嗎？他就在通往 {p} 的橋附近。
Recover the Past#072.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#073.dst: 就……讓我一個人靜一靜，行嗎？
Recover the Past#073.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#074.src: Ah, hello. What seems to be the matter? You look like you want something from me.
Recover the Past#074.dst: 啊，你好。有什麼事嗎？你看起來像是有事要找我。
Recover the Past#074.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#075.src: Hm? The strange doctor wants to see me? To restore my memories? I can't say I really trust the man... but I am curious to see if it'll really work.
Recover the Past#075.dst: 嗯？那個奇怪的博士要見我？要復原我的記憶？我不能說我有多信任那個人……不過我確實好奇它到底管不管用。
Recover the Past#075.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#076.src: Unfortunately, however, I must decline. I couldn't leave my station unattended. What if a corrupted assault were to appear? {p} would be left defenseless.
Recover the Past#076.dst: 可惜我得婉拒。我不能讓崗位無人看守。萬一腐化物來襲怎麼辦？{p} 會毫無防備。
Recover the Past#076.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#077.src: Hm, well. If it's only for a little while, that might work. As long as you promise to help out if an attack does occur.
Recover the Past#077.dst: 嗯，這樣啊。如果只是離開一小段時間，那或許可行。前提是你答應我，真的發生襲擊的時候你要幫忙。
Recover the Past#077.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#078.src: Then it's settled. I'll go with you to meet the doctor. However, first we'll need someone to keep the watch. Did you have someone in mind?
Recover the Past#078.dst: 那就這麼說定了。我跟你去見那位博士。不過我們得先找個人來守著。你心裡有人選嗎？
Recover the Past#078.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#079.src: Caid? That... crook. He's been stealing supplies, I know it. I just can't prove it. But, if you think he'll do. I'm sure it will be fine.
Recover the Past#079.dst: Caid？那個……小偷。他一直在偷補給，我知道。我就是拿不出證據。不過，如果你覺得他行的話。應該沒問題吧。
Recover the Past#079.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#080.src: I saw him heading to the temple not very long ago. Perhaps he's had a change of heart. You lead the way to Caid, I'll be right behind you.
Recover the Past#080.dst: 我不久前看到他往神殿那邊走。說不定他回心轉意了。你帶路去找 Caid，我跟在你後面。
Recover the Past#080.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#082.src: Perhaps Caid's had a change of heart. You lead the way to him, I'll be right behind you.
Recover the Past#082.dst: 說不定 Caid 回心轉意了。你帶路去找他，我跟在你後面。
Recover the Past#082.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#083.src: Convince Caid to keep watch over the bridge at .
Recover the Past#083.dst: 到  說服 Caid 幫忙看守橋。

Recover the Past#084.src: Oh, it's you again. What do you want?
Recover the Past#084.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#085.src: It's us, and we'd like to ask something of you. Our mutual friend here is attempting to recruit me for some sort of experiment.
Recover the Past#085.dst: 是我們，我們有事想拜託你。這位我們共同的朋友想拉我去參加某種實驗。
Recover the Past#085.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#086.src: Only, my participation would leave {p} undefended. So we're asking if you'd be willing to keep a watch over things while I'm otherwise preoccupied.
Recover the Past#086.dst: 只是我一參加，{p} 就會無人防守。所以我們想問你願不願意在我抽不開身的時候，幫忙看著這邊。
Recover the Past#086.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#087.src: Really? You're asking me to guard {p}?
Recover the Past#087.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#088.src: Don't get me wrong, I'd rather not leave the security of {p} in the hands of a thie... someone like you. You weren't my first choice to say the least, or second, or third
Recover the Past#088.dst: 別誤會，我寧可不要把 {p} 的安危交在一個賊……交在你這種人手上。你絕對不是我的第一人選，第二、第三也不是——
Recover the Past#088.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#091.src: You will? Well, that was easier than I expected. Remember if you see any signs of an imminent attack, run to that doctor's tower and alert us immediately. Leave the fighting to the professionals.
Recover the Past#091.dst: 你願意？這比我想的容易多了。記住——只要看到有任何襲擊的徵兆，立刻跑去那位博士的塔通知我們。打鬥的事交給專業的。
Recover the Past#091.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#092.src: I wouldn't dream of anything else! But, consider Reynauld, that maybe the past is forgotten for a reason.
Recover the Past#092.dst: 我想都不會想別的！不過 Reynauld，你也想想，說不定過去被遺忘，是有它的理由的。
Recover the Past#092.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#093.src: Well, that settles it. Let's hurry to the doctor, I don't want leave {p}'s safety in that man's slippery fingers for any longer than I have to.
Recover the Past#093.dst: 好，那就這樣。我們快去找博士，我一分鐘都不想多把 {p} 的安危留在那個手腳不乾淨的人手上。
Recover the Past#093.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#094.src: Bring Reynauld to Dr. Picard in his tower at .
Recover the Past#094.dst: 帶 Reynauld 到  的塔裡找 Picard 博士。

Recover the Past#095.src: Let's hurry to the doctor, I don't want to leave {p}'s safety in that man's slippery fingers for any longer than I have to.
Recover the Past#095.dst: 我們快去找博士，我一分鐘都不想多把 {p} 的安危留在那個手腳不乾淨的人手上。
Recover the Past#095.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#097.src: Ah, assistant! Welcome back, and I see you've brought our next subject! Wonderful!
Recover the Past#097.dst: 啊，助手！歡迎回來，而且我看你把下一位受試者帶來了！太好了！
Recover the Past#097.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#099.src: Now, now, step forward. Don't be shy! Just step right up over here! Look directly into the orb, and concentrate on remembering.
Recover the Past#099.dst: 好了好了，往前站。別害羞！就站到這邊來！直視那顆球，然後專心回想。
Recover the Past#099.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#101.src: Yes, yes! Not to worry, the device has been extensively tested on Caid. Very quickly, I just need to activate this... cast a spell here... and...
Recover the Past#101.dst: 當然當然！別擔心，這個裝置已經在 Caid 身上做過大量測試了。很快的，我只要啟動這個……在這裡施個法……然後……
Recover the Past#101.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#103.src: H-huh? Hey, who's there? Why are you knocking at this hour
Recover the Past#103.dst: 啊——？欸，誰啊？這種時間敲什麼門——
Recover the Past#103.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#105.src: Yes, it's me. Mind if I step inside?
Recover the Past#105.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#106.src: N-no, of course not Uh. It would have been nice if, you know, you warned me you would be coming!
Recover the Past#106.dst: 不——不介意，當然不——呃。你要是，你知道的，先通知我一聲會比較好啊！
Recover the Past#106.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#107.src: You know that isn't how this works. Now, where are the goods?
Recover the Past#107.dst: 你知道規矩不是這樣的。好了，東西呢？
Recover the Past#107.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#108.src: Right... always straight to business with you. Never, oh, how was your week? Always just...
Recover the Past#108.dst: 是是……你這人永遠都是直接談正事。從來不會哦，這禮拜過得如何？永遠都只是……
Recover the Past#108.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#109.src: Fine. It's up and over here.
Recover the Past#109.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#110.src: I salvaged some parts from... uh, one of the nearby factories. I hope it's... it's probably what you need.
Recover the Past#110.dst: 我從……呃，附近一家工廠弄了一些零件。我希望這是……這大概就是你要的。
Recover the Past#110.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#111.src: ... Hm. One of the factories, you say? And you're sure you weren't spotted doing it? If I were caught speaking to a known criminal, you know the consequences for both of us.
Recover the Past#111.dst: ……嗯。你說是其中一家工廠？你確定你動手的時候沒被看到？要是我被人抓到跟一個有案底的罪犯講話，你知道我們兩個會有什麼下場。
Recover the Past#111.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#112.src: N-no. I wasn't spotted. I, uh... took precautions. Went in at night. You know.
Recover the Past#112.dst: 沒、沒有。我沒被看到。我，呃……有做防範。半夜進去的。你懂的。
Recover the Past#112.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#114.src: S-so... is that enough? I've gotten you what you've asked for.
Recover the Past#114.dst: 那、那麼……這樣夠了嗎？你要的我都弄來了。
Recover the Past#114.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#115.src: Well... it is that, yes. But, Caid, you know the risk I take every time I come out here to speak with you. I'll need more than just the bare minimum to guarantee your safety.
Recover the Past#115.dst: 嗯……東西是弄來了沒錯。可是 Caid，你知道我每次出來跟你見面要冒多大的風險。光是最低限度，還不足以保證你的安全。
Recover the Past#115.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#116.src: I hmph. Okay, okay, fine, I'll- I'll add in some emeralds. To sweeten the deal.
Recover the Past#116.dst: 我——哼。好、好，好啦，我——我再加一些綠寶石。讓這筆交易好看一點。
Recover the Past#116.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#117.src: Excellent. A pleasure doing business, as always. I'll be back in a few weeks.
Recover the Past#117.dst: 很好。一如既往，合作愉快。我過幾週再來。
Recover the Past#117.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#119.src: Ah, Reynauld. Good to see you. Come in, come in.
Recover the Past#119.dst: 啊，Reynauld。見到你真好。進來、進來。
Recover the Past#119.speaker: Royal Captain

Recover the Past#120.src: Might I ask what this meeting is for, sir?
Recover the Past#120.dst: 請問這次召見是為了什麼，長官？
Recover the Past#120.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#121.src: Oh, nothing too special. I just wanted to have a quick chat about your performance.
Recover the Past#121.dst: 哦，沒什麼特別的。我只是想跟你稍微聊一下你的表現。
Recover the Past#121.speaker: Royal Captain

Recover the Past#122.src: You understand that those of us who serve Her Majesty in such well regarded positions have a certain... strict code of honor we must follow, yes?
Recover the Past#122.dst: 你明白，我們這些在如此受敬重的職位上侍奉女王陛下的人，必須遵守一套……嚴格的榮譽準則，對吧？
Recover the Past#122.speaker: Royal Captain

Recover the Past#123.src: Otherwise, how could we be certain our ranks are pure of any misdeeds? We must set an example for the people of our great province.
Recover the Past#123.dst: 否則，我們怎麼能確定自己的隊伍裡沒有任何不端？我們必須為這個偉大行省的人民立下榜樣。
Recover the Past#123.speaker: Royal Captain

Recover the Past#124.src: Now, what do you think might happen if one of our own happened to...bend, or break that code of honour? What sort of a precedent would that set?
Recover the Past#124.dst: 那麼，你覺得，如果我們自己人裡面有誰……扭曲、或是打破了那套榮譽準則，會發生什麼事？那會開什麼樣的先例？
Recover the Past#124.speaker: Royal Captain

Recover the Past#126.src: It is with no great pleasure that I inform you that you, Reynauld, are to be stripped of your rank and arrested under charges of dishonour and conspiracy against Her Majesty.
Recover the Past#126.dst: 我很遺憾地通知你，Reynauld，你將被剝奪軍階，並以不名譽及密謀對抗女王陛下的罪名遭到逮捕。
Recover the Past#126.speaker: Royal Captain

Recover the Past#127.src: Your accomplice, the supplier, was caught the other day. I'm told he spent very little time grappling with the thought before choosing to spill your own secrets.
Recover the Past#127.dst: 你的共犯，那個供貨的，前幾天被抓到了。我聽說他幾乎沒怎麼掙扎，就選擇把你的祕密全招了。
Recover the Past#127.speaker: Royal Captain

Recover the Past#128.src: There is no place for your spot in our ranks, Reynauld. A shame it had to come to this.
Recover the Past#128.dst: 我們的隊伍裡容不下你了，Reynauld。走到這一步真是可惜。
Recover the Past#128.speaker: Royal Captain

Recover the Past#129.src: Assistant! Snap out of it! There's more to discuss.
Recover the Past#129.dst: 助手！清醒點！還有得談呢。
Recover the Past#129.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#131.src: Marvelous! Assistant, you've done very well so far! We're closer than ever to uncovering the mystery of Fruma!
Recover the Past#131.dst: 太精采了！助手，你到目前為止表現得非常好！我們比以往任何時候都更接近揭開 Fruma 的謎團！
Recover the Past#131.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#133.src: {u}!? Didn't think I'd stumble upon you all the way out here!
Recover the Past#133.dst: {u}？！沒想到會在這麼遠的地方碰上你！
Recover the Past#133.speaker: Tasim

Recover the Past#134.src: There's time for pleasantries later. Tasim? Why are you here? Where's Caid?
Recover the Past#134.dst: 寒暄的事晚點再說。Tasim？你怎麼會在這裡？Caid 呢？
Recover the Past#134.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#135.src: The Admiral sent me to bolster {p}'s defenses. I was expecting to meet you at the bridge, but all I found was Caid.
Recover the Past#135.dst: 上將派我來加強 {p} 的防務。我本來以為會在橋邊見到你，結果只找到 Caid。
Recover the Past#135.speaker: Tasim

Recover the Past#136.src: He said there was an assault on {p} gathering and that you were here, then he ran away.
Recover the Past#136.dst: 他說有一支部隊正在集結、要襲擊 {p}，還說你在這裡，然後他就跑掉了。
Recover the Past#136.speaker: Tasim

Recover the Past#137.src: That damned thief! I knew I shouldn't have left... This was all a mistake... Damn.
Recover the Past#137.dst: 那個該死的賊！我就知道我不該離開……這整件事都是個錯誤……可惡。
Recover the Past#137.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#138.src: There's no time to waste now. Let's go, Tasim and {u}. We need to save {p}.
Recover the Past#138.dst: 現在沒時間浪費了。走吧，Tasim、{u}。我們得去救 {p}。
Recover the Past#138.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#139.src: That Tasim, he must be from Fruma as well? If he's a companion of yours, you should recruit him to this little experiment of ours. For science of course! Now, now, be off. {p} needs saving!
Recover the Past#139.dst: 那位 Tasim，他一定也是 Fruma 來的吧？既然是你的同伴，你應該把他也拉進我們這個小實驗。當然是為了科學！好了好了，快去。{p} 等著人救呢！
Recover the Past#139.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#140.src: Rush to defend {p} from the incursion at .
Recover the Past#140.dst: 趕到  防守 {p}，擋下入侵。

Recover the Past#141.src: Assistant! What are you still doing here? Your friends seem to be in need of your assistance!
Recover the Past#141.dst: 助手！你怎麼還在這裡？你的朋友們好像很需要你幫忙！
Recover the Past#141.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#142.src: Besides, this might be an opportunity to recruit that Tasim to our experiment! Hm, yes, he would certainly be an interesting specimen to examine!
Recover the Past#142.dst: 再說，這說不定正是把那位 Tasim 拉進我們實驗的好機會！嗯，沒錯，他絕對會是個有意思的觀察對象！
Recover the Past#142.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#143.src: They'll be coming for this bridge any minute now. We will need to stand ready.
Recover the Past#143.dst: 他們隨時會攻上這座橋。我們得做好準備。
Recover the Past#143.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#145.src: Good answer, soldier. We'll take them down, no matter how many they throw at us!
Recover the Past#145.dst: 回答得好，士兵。不管他們丟多少過來，我們都會把他們解決掉！
Recover the Past#145.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#146.src: Do whatever you have to first, but be quick. The enemy might arrive at any moment.
Recover the Past#146.dst: 你要做什麼就先去做，不過動作要快。敵人隨時可能到。
Recover the Past#146.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#147.dst: 抵禦腐化物對 {p} 的入侵！

Recover the Past#148.src: Tasim, you take the front, I'll provide cover from behind.
Recover the Past#148.dst: Tasim，你顧前面，我在後方掩護。
Recover the Past#148.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#149.src: It would be my pleasure, Reynauld!
Recover the Past#149.speaker: Tasim

Recover the Past#150.src: Shouldn't be much longer now... If only Aledar was here, it'd be like old times again. Don't you think?
Recover the Past#150.dst: 應該快了……要是 Aledar 也在就好了，那就跟以前一樣了。你不覺得嗎？
Recover the Past#150.speaker: Tasim

Recover the Past#151.src: I have eyes on the target! Corrupted forces incoming!
Recover the Past#151.dst: 我看到目標了！腐化部隊來襲！
Recover the Past#151.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#153.src: Damn it. That leader looks shielded! How do we take it down?
Recover the Past#153.dst: 可惡。那個首領好像有護盾！我們要怎麼把牠打下來？
Recover the Past#153.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#154.src: The spikes must be its weak point!
Recover the Past#154.dst: 那些尖刺一定是牠的弱點！
Recover the Past#154.speaker: Tasim

Recover the Past#155.src: You're right! Tasim, {u}. As long as you can keep the enemy away from me, I can line up a good shot at the spikes. That's our only chance at taking this thing down.
Recover the Past#155.dst: 你說得對！Tasim、{u}。只要你們能把敵人擋在我外面，我就能瞄準那些尖刺開一記好的。那是我們唯一能解決這東西的機會。
Recover the Past#155.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#156.src: ... Ah. Turns out this might be a little tougher than expected. But, let's give it our all!
Recover the Past#156.dst: ……啊。看來這會比預期的難一點。不過，我們全力以赴吧！
Recover the Past#156.speaker: Tasim

Recover the Past#157.src: Just... a little more... to the right...
Recover the Past#157.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#158.src: That's it! It's got to be...
Recover the Past#158.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#159.src: Reynauld! What do we do now? We can't beat it like this...
Recover the Past#159.dst: Reynauld！我們現在怎麼辦？這樣打不贏牠……
Recover the Past#159.speaker: Tasim

Recover the Past#160.src: I'm trying to think but... I've never...
Recover the Past#160.dst: 我正在想辦法，可是……我從來沒有……
Recover the Past#160.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#161.src: Tasim, {u}, you continue to hold them off. I'll think of something, anything...
Recover the Past#161.dst: Tasim、{u}，你們繼續擋住他們。我會想出辦法的，什麼辦法都好……
Recover the Past#161.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#162.src: We can't give up now, not while {p} is still in danger!
Recover the Past#162.dst: 我們現在不能放棄，{p} 還在危險之中！
Recover the Past#162.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#163.src: Reynauld, it's not working! They just keep coming we... have to do something... else, or we won't last!
Recover the Past#163.dst: Reynauld，這樣行不通！他們一直湧上來——我們……得換個做法，不然撐不住了！
Recover the Past#163.speaker: Tasim

Recover the Past#164.src: You're right. We'll have to retreat, call for aid from {p}. Three men alone can't defeat this!
Recover the Past#164.dst: 你說得對。我們只能撤退，向 {p} 求援。三個人是打不贏這東西的！
Recover the Past#164.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#165.dst: 可是，你們不是只有三個人！
Recover the Past#165.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#167.src: Caid, what are you doing here!? It's too dangerous, leave this one to the professionals!
Recover the Past#167.dst: Caid，你來這裡做什麼？！太危險了，這種事交給專業的！
Recover the Past#167.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#168.src: I'm done, I'm done letting my future slip out of my fingers!
Recover the Past#168.dst: 我受夠了，我受夠讓自己的未來從指縫間溜走！
Recover the Past#168.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#172.src: Now, Reynauld! Shoot! For goodness' sake, shoot! While it's distracted!
Recover the Past#172.dst: 就是現在，Reynauld！開槍！拜託你開槍啊！趁牠分心！
Recover the Past#172.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#173.src: It-It's coming down! Now's our chance!
Recover the Past#173.speaker: Tasim

Recover the Past#174.src: We did it... We really did it!
Recover the Past#174.dst: 我們做到了……我們真的做到了！
Recover the Past#174.speaker: Tasim

Recover the Past#178.src: Caid! You made it! You're a hero!
Recover the Past#178.speaker: Tasim

Recover the Past#179.src: That's all well and good but, what about your boat?
Recover the Past#179.dst: 那都很好，可是——你的船怎麼辦？
Recover the Past#179.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#180.src: I can always build another one, can't I?
Recover the Past#180.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#181.src: Ha. But not using my belongings this time.
Recover the Past#181.dst: 哈。不過這次別再拿我的東西了。
Recover the Past#181.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#182.src: Well, Caid seems to be fine enough, considering the circumstances. I'll take him to get checked out, just in case. Thank you for your help, Tasim and {u}. And Caid too...
Recover the Past#182.dst: 好了，考慮到剛才的狀況，Caid 看起來還算沒事。我帶他去檢查一下，以防萬一。謝謝你們幫忙，Tasim、{u}。還有 Caid 也是……
Recover the Past#182.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#183.src: You must be wanting to take Tasim with you for your experiment. After all you've done today, I can hardly object. But, Tasim...
Recover the Past#183.dst: 你大概是想把 Tasim 也帶去做那個實驗吧。今天你做了這麼多，我實在不好反對。不過，Tasim……
Recover the Past#183.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#184.src: Think carefully before looking into that crystal. For some, the past is filled with things they'd rather forget.
Recover the Past#184.dst: 看那顆水晶之前，好好想清楚。對某些人來說，過去裝的都是他們寧可忘掉的東西。
Recover the Past#184.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#185.src: Recovering memories from Fruma, huh... That's definitely something I'd be interested in. I've had a strange feeling about it, ever since we first realized we lost them.
Recover the Past#185.dst: 復原在 Fruma 的記憶啊……那確實是我會感興趣的事。從我們第一次發現記憶不見的時候，我心裡就一直怪怪的。
Recover the Past#185.speaker: Tasim

Recover the Past#186.src: You were there, remember? We'd just barely entered Wynn and... Aledar was with us, and he almost went and died on his first day! I hope he's being more careful, out there...
Recover the Past#186.dst: 你當時也在場，記得吧？我們才剛踏進 Wynn，然後……Aledar 也跟我們在一起，他第一天差點就死了！但願他在外頭有小心一點……
Recover the Past#186.speaker: Tasim

Recover the Past#187.src: Ah, anyway. Please, lead the way to the doctor. I'm intrigued to see what it's all about.
Recover the Past#187.dst: 啊，總之。請帶路去博士那裡吧。我很想知道那到底是怎麼回事。
Recover the Past#187.speaker: Tasim

Recover the Past#188.src: Bring Tasim to Dr. Picard in his tower at .
Recover the Past#188.dst: 帶 Tasim 到  的塔裡找 Picard 博士。

Recover the Past#190.src: ... Oh, {u}, you're back with yet another subject I see! Excellent, excellent. Please, step up to the orb.
Recover the Past#190.dst: ……哦，{u}，你又帶了一位受試者回來！太好了、太好了。來，請站到球前面。
Recover the Past#190.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#191.src: So, doctor. You're certain this is safe? Reynauld warned me that
Recover the Past#191.dst: 那麼，博士。您確定這安全嗎？Reynauld 警告過我說——
Recover the Past#191.speaker: Tasim

Recover the Past#192.src: Oh, yes, yes. We've tested it with two subjects before, haven't we, {u}? Besides, I've done the calculations! They all work out fine!
Recover the Past#192.dst: 哦，當然當然。我們之前已經在兩位受試者身上測試過了，對吧，{u}？再說，我算過了！數字全都沒問題！
Recover the Past#192.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#193.src: There's only the tiniest bit of instability. Hmph. Maybe it just needs more power... If I increase the amount of mana I'm able to put into the spell, then
Recover the Past#193.dst: 只有極其微小的一點不穩定。哼。也許它只是需要更多功率……只要我把灌進法術的魔力再提高，那麼——
Recover the Past#193.speaker: Dr. Picard
