Recover the Past#194.src: Hold on. You want to put more magic into this, when it's already unstable?
Recover the Past#194.dst: 等一下。它已經不穩定了，你還想再灌更多魔法進去？
Recover the Past#194.speaker: Tasim

Recover the Past#195.src: Don't you want to know what your life was like before? Even if it's not what you want to see, isn't it better to know?
Recover the Past#195.dst: 難道你不想知道自己以前的人生是什麼樣子嗎？就算那不是你想看到的，知道總比不知道好吧？
Recover the Past#195.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#196.src: Fine. We can look at my memories. I don't know that I necessarily agree... but I'll do it.
Recover the Past#196.dst: 好吧。可以看我的記憶。我不確定我真的同意這個說法……但我做。
Recover the Past#196.speaker: Tasim

Recover the Past#197.src: Excellent, I'm glad to hear that! Now. Activating in three... two... one... go!
Recover the Past#197.dst: 太好了，聽到這句話我真高興！那麼。三……二……一……啟動！
Recover the Past#197.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#198.src: All hands on deck! Arrest that insurgent!
Recover the Past#198.dst: 全員就位！逮捕那個叛亂分子！
Recover the Past#198.speaker: Royal Captain

Recover the Past#200.src: Grr... He couldn't have gotten far. All of you, search the city! Leave no corner unturned! Don't let him get away!
Recover the Past#200.dst: 嘖……他跑不遠。你們所有人，搜遍整座城！每個角落都不許放過！別讓他跑了！
Recover the Past#200.speaker: Royal Captain

Recover the Past#201.src: I- oh, this is bad... What can I...
Recover the Past#201.dst: 我——哦，這下糟了……我能怎麼……
Recover the Past#201.speaker: Tasim

Recover the Past#202.src: ...Damn it. Damn it all. I can't just let the man bleed out, even if he's...
Recover the Past#202.dst: ……該死。全都該死。我不能就這樣看著一個人流血流到死，就算他是……
Recover the Past#202.speaker: Tasim

Recover the Past#204.src: It's fine, you'll be fine... I know what to do, even if I really shouldn't...
Recover the Past#204.dst: 沒事的，你會沒事的……我知道該怎麼做，就算我其實不該做……
Recover the Past#204.speaker: Tasim

Recover the Past#205.src: G-gah! Wh-where am I? Who are you? I need to get
Recover the Past#205.dst: 啊——！我、我在哪裡？你是誰？我得走——

Recover the Past#207.src: He's in here! And he has an accomplice! Arrest them both!
Recover the Past#207.dst: 他在這裡！而且他有同夥！兩個都抓起來！
Recover the Past#207.speaker: Royal Captain

Recover the Past#208.src: My magic is struggling to keep hold... but it's clear there's more to see! Increasing power...
Recover the Past#208.dst: 我的魔法快抓不住了……但顯然還有東西可以看！提高功率——
Recover the Past#208.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#209.src: So, what? I should have just let you bleed out in my home? Don't be ridiculous.
Recover the Past#209.dst: 所以呢？我當時就該讓你在我家裡流血流到死？別說傻話了。
Recover the Past#209.speaker: Tasim

Recover the Past#210.src: Yes! You should have! Because now, not only have I been arrested for crimes against the crown, but you've also been outed as one of the cursed. Wouldn't have happened if you had just... stood by.
Recover the Past#210.dst: 對！你就該！因為現在，我不只因為對王室犯罪被捕，連你也被揪出來是受詛者之一。你當初要是……袖手旁觀，這一切都不會發生。
Recover the Past#210.speaker: Aledar

Recover the Past#211.src: ...It was the right thing to do. I couldn't just stand by when there was something I could do to help.
Recover the Past#211.dst: ……那是對的事。我有能力幫忙的時候，沒辦法袖手旁觀。
Recover the Past#211.speaker: Tasim

Recover the Past#212.src: Well, a lot of good that's done us. You know no one gets out of here, right? When they take you, you're never heard from again! So, that's where we're at.
Recover the Past#212.dst: 是啊，結果對我們幫助可大了。你知道沒有人能從這裡出去吧？他們一旦把你帶走，就再也沒人聽過你的消息！所以，我們現在就是這個處境。
Recover the Past#212.speaker: Aledar

Recover the Past#214.src: Tasim. It's your time. Follow me.
Recover the Past#214.speaker: Royal Guard

Recover the Past#215.src: Good luck out there, Tasim. You'll need it.
Recover the Past#215.speaker: Aledar

Recover the Past#216.src: See you on the other side, Aledar.
Recover the Past#216.speaker: Tasim

Recover the Past#217.src: Ahem. We're ready for the process. Prepare the Adjustor.
Recover the Past#217.dst: 咳咳。程序準備好了。啟動調律器。
Recover the Past#217.speaker: Inquisitor

Recover the Past#218.src: The- the what? What are you going to do to
Recover the Past#218.dst: 那——那是什麼？你們要對我做什——
Recover the Past#218.speaker: Tasim

Recover the Past#219.src: Silence. Before we begin, I want to make one thing clear. We do not need your ilk in Fruma. We do not want your ilk in Fruma.
Recover the Past#219.dst: 安靜。在我們開始之前，我要把一件事講清楚。Fruma 不需要你們這種人。Fruma 不想要你們這種人。
Recover the Past#219.speaker: Inquisitor

Recover the Past#220.src: What we will do with you today is a kindness, a mercy. If the world were to have its way, you would be far worse off. Remember that as we continue.
Recover the Past#220.dst: 我們今天對你所做的，是一份仁慈、一份寬容。若讓這個世界照它的方式來，你的下場會慘得多。接下來的過程中，請記住這一點。
Recover the Past#220.speaker: Inquisitor

Recover the Past#222.src: You are a new recruit, being sent to the Wynn Province to fight in their war. You enlisted because you thought your unique... talents would be useful.
Recover the Past#222.dst: 你是一名新兵，即將被派往 Wynn 行省，為他們的戰爭作戰。你之所以入伍，是因為你認為自己獨特的……才能會派上用場。
Recover the Past#222.speaker: Inquisitor

Recover the Past#223.src: Fruma is nothing but a speck in your history. A fact set in stone, with details lost to the hypothetical past. You think of it fondly, but remember nothing.
Recover the Past#223.dst: Fruma 在你的過去裡不過是一個小點。一件已成定局的事實，細節都遺落在假設性的過去裡。你對它懷有好感，卻什麼都記不得。
Recover the Past#223.speaker: Inquisitor

Recover the Past#224.src: You will fight in their war. You will live for it, you will die for it. You will be of Wynn forever, and Fruma will be glad to be rid of you.
Recover the Past#224.dst: 你會為他們的戰爭作戰。你會為它而活，為它而死。你將永遠屬於 Wynn，而 Fruma 會很樂意擺脫你。
Recover the Past#224.speaker: Inquisitor

Recover the Past#227.src: Must I repeat myself? Do you understand?
Recover the Past#227.dst: 要我再說一次嗎？你明白了嗎？
Recover the Past#227.speaker: Inquisitor

Recover the Past#228.src: I will ask once more. Is your directive understood?
Recover the Past#228.dst: 我再問一次。你的指令，明白了嗎？
Recover the Past#228.speaker: Inquisitor

Recover the Past#230.src: Wonderful. Take this one to the caravan. It looks like we'll be able to fit in two more for today's batch.
Recover the Past#230.dst: 很好。把這個帶去馬車隊。看來今天這一批還塞得下兩個。
Recover the Past#230.speaker: Inquisitor

Recover the Past#235.src: Assistant! Snap out of it! You've gone in too deep, the memory is sucking you in!
Recover the Past#235.dst: 助手！清醒過來！你陷得太深了，那段記憶正在把你吸進去！
Recover the Past#235.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#236.src: Good grief there you are! Do you understand how dangerous that was?!
Recover the Past#236.dst: 天啊——你總算回來了！你知道剛才有多危險嗎？！
Recover the Past#236.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#237.src: What do you think happens to me if one of my assistants gets trapped in their memories forever! Nothing good!
Recover the Past#237.dst: 你以為我的助手要是永遠被困在自己的記憶裡，我會有什麼下場？沒好事！
Recover the Past#237.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#238.src: ... Fine, fine. It did give us more information. Don't do it again, though! Come on, come over here, we have much to discuss.
Recover the Past#238.dst: ……好啦，好啦。那確實給了我們更多資訊。不過別再這樣了！來，過來這邊，我們有很多要談的。
Recover the Past#238.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#239.src: ... Hmph. I'll admit, I'm... I'm not sure what to do with this information.
Recover the Past#239.dst: ……哼。我承認，我……我不確定該拿這些資訊怎麼辦。
Recover the Past#239.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#240.src: The memory restorification orb worked as well as I could expect for a single use... but, good grief, that was upsetting to watch.
Recover the Past#240.dst: 以單次使用來說，記憶復原化球的表現已經達到我能期待的水準了……可是老天，那看起來實在讓人難受。
Recover the Past#240.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#241.src: It stands to reason both Caid and Reynauld also experienced this... and my magic couldn't break through that wall...
Recover the Past#241.dst: 照理說，Caid 和 Reynauld 也經歷過同樣的事……而我的魔法穿不透那道牆……
Recover the Past#241.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#242.src: Is this what they're doing to their criminals out there, in Fruma? Casting them out to fight in Wynn's war?
Recover the Past#242.dst: 這就是他們在外面、在 Fruma 對待罪犯的方式嗎？把他們丟出來替 Wynn 打仗？
Recover the Past#242.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#243.src: ... I'll have to think on how much I want to delve into memories. In any case! At the very start of this, I promised you we could view your memories.
Recover the Past#243.dst: ……我得想想自己還要往記憶裡挖多深。總之！這件事一開始，我答應過讓你看你自己的記憶。
Recover the Past#243.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#244.src: The offer still stands, if you'd like to take it. Just step up to the orb, like the others did.
Recover the Past#244.dst: 那個承諾依然算數，你想要的話。就像其他人那樣站到球前面就行了。
Recover the Past#244.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#245.src: Well? The offer still stands, if you'd like to take it. Simply step up to the orb, just like the others did.
Recover the Past#245.dst: 怎麼樣？那個承諾依然算數，你想要的話。就像其他人那樣站到球前面。
Recover the Past#245.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#246.src: H-huh?! The orb! My beautiful memory restorification orb! It's ruined!
Recover the Past#246.dst: 啊——？！那顆球！我那顆美麗的記憶復原化球！它毀了！
Recover the Past#246.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#247.src: ... Oh, whatever. I have the blueprints stored somewhere around here. I can always make another... but still.
Recover the Past#247.dst: ……哦，算了。設計圖我還存在這附近某個地方。再做一顆就是了……不過還是很心痛。
Recover the Past#247.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#249.src: Oh! Oh, right! My apologies, I completely forgot to check in with you! Are you alright?
Recover the Past#249.dst: 哦！哦對！抱歉，我完全忘了關心你！你還好嗎？
Recover the Past#249.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#250.src: None of the other test subjects experienced this powerful a reaction... strange. It's almost like we're accessing memories that didn't exist.
Recover the Past#250.dst: 其他受試者都沒有出現這麼強烈的反應……奇怪。這幾乎像是我們讀取到了本來不存在的記憶。
Recover the Past#250.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#251.src: ... Well. Ehem. In any case, I'll need to continue my research. There's more to learn, I'm sure...
Recover the Past#251.dst: ……嗯。咳咳。總之，我得繼續我的研究。我確信還有更多可以學的……
Recover the Past#251.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#252.src: As thanks for your help. Here, a reward. Ah, also... I believe your friend is just outside the tower. You might want to check in on him.
Recover the Past#252.dst: 這是謝謝你幫忙的酬謝。來，收下。啊，還有……我想你的朋友就在塔外面。你或許該去看看他。
Recover the Past#252.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#253.src: Find Tasim outside Dr. Picard's tower at .
Recover the Past#253.dst: 到 Picard 博士的塔外找 Tasim。

Recover the Past#255.src: Cursed. He called me cursed. What does that mean for me...?
Recover the Past#255.dst: 受詛的。他說我是受詛的。那對我來說代表什麼……？
Recover the Past#255.speaker: Tasim

Recover the Past#256.src: And the Inquisitor... I don't know what to think. All of us what we thought we knew when we arrived in Wynn... None of it was true.
Recover the Past#256.dst: 還有那個審訊官……我不知道該怎麼想。我們所有人——我們抵達 Wynn 時以為自己知道的那些事……沒有一件是真的。
Recover the Past#256.speaker: Tasim

Recover the Past#257.src: ...Did the two of us really meet through sheer random luck? He was running from something, and... fell straight into my life.
Recover the Past#257.dst: ……我們兩個真的只是憑純粹的偶然遇上的嗎？他當時在逃，然後……直接摔進了我的人生。
Recover the Past#257.speaker: Tasim

Recover the Past#258.src: I- I need some space to think. To... reflect. Can you... please don't tell Aledar about any of this.
Recover the Past#258.dst: 我——我需要一點空間想一想。需要……沉澱。你可以……拜託你別把這些事告訴 Aledar。
Recover the Past#258.speaker: Tasim

Recover the Past#259.src: He doesn't need to know about all of this. He's he's better off not knowing.
Recover the Past#259.dst: 他不需要知道這一切。他——他不知道比較好。
Recover the Past#259.speaker: Tasim

Recover the Past#260.src: ... I'm going to head for the Gavel Province, I think. It's across from the ocean, far enough from... From all of this.
Recover the Past#260.dst: ……我想我會前往 Gavel 行省。它在海的另一邊，離……離這一切夠遠。
Recover the Past#260.speaker: Tasim

Recover the Past#261.src: When you get stronger, you should go there too. Maybe we'll run into each other, eventually.
Recover the Past#261.dst: 等你變強了，你也該去那裡看看。說不定我們總有一天會再遇上。
Recover the Past#261.speaker: Tasim

Recover the Past#262.src: I guess this is goodbye for now, then. Not forever but for now. I'll see you around, {u}.
Recover the Past#262.dst: 那麼，就先在這裡道別了。不是永別——只是暫時。我們有緣再見，{u}。
Recover the Past#262.speaker: Tasim

Recover the Past#263.src: ... I'm just resting here, a little. I'll be on my way soon.
Recover the Past#263.dst: ……我只是在這裡歇一下。我很快就會上路。
Recover the Past#263.speaker: Tasim

Redbeard's Booty#000.src: Talk with Marston in the ocean at [-{~} {~} -{~}]
Redbeard's Booty#000.dst: 在海上與 Marston 交談，座標 [-{~} {~} -{~}]

Redbeard's Booty#001.src: Ah, ahoy matey! Are ye here to get a glimpse of ol' Redbeard's sunken galleon as well?
Redbeard's Booty#001.dst: 啊，嗨呀，夥計！你也是來瞧瞧老 Redbeard 那艘沉船的嗎？
Redbeard's Booty#001.speaker: Marston

Redbeard's Booty#002.src: A fine ship it once was, aye? Accordin' to the stories, it sank in one o' the greatest sea battles in history! The cap'n sank beneath the waves, ne'er to be seen again!
Redbeard's Booty#002.dst: 那可曾是艘好船，是吧？照傳說講，它沉在史上最大的一場海戰裡！船長沉進浪底，從此再沒人見過他！
Redbeard's Booty#002.speaker: Marston

Redbeard's Booty#003.src: ...Say. Have ye ever wanted to go on a real treasure hunt? Ye look like someone with an eye for treasure, aye?
Redbeard's Booty#003.dst: ……說起來。你有沒有想過來一趟真正的尋寶？瞧你這模樣，像是識貨的人，是吧？
Redbeard's Booty#003.speaker: Marston

Redbeard's Booty#004.src: Good for ye then! I bought meself a real treasure map on Pirate Cove, a fine deal if ye ask me. And, if the jack wasn't fibbing, it leads to the feared Redbeard's real treasure!
Redbeard's Booty#004.dst: 那可太好了！俺在海盜灣買到一張真的藏寶圖，要俺說是筆划算的買賣。而且，要是那小子沒唬人，這圖通往的就是那個令人聞風喪膽的 Redbeard 的真寶藏！
Redbeard's Booty#004.speaker: Marston

Redbeard's Booty#005.src: I ventured 'round, spied some fine jacks at the island, and I collected a crew to join me on me grand, fantastic voyage!
Redbeard's Booty#005.dst: 俺四處跑了一趟，在島上看中幾個好手，湊了一支船員隊，要跟俺一起踏上這趟壯闊又了不起的航程！
Redbeard's Booty#005.speaker: Marston

Redbeard's Booty#006.src: O' course, there always be room for another! Ye joinin'? We could use another hand.
Redbeard's Booty#006.dst: 當然啦，總還有一個位子！你加入嗎？俺們正缺人手。
Redbeard's Booty#006.speaker: Marston

Redbeard's Booty#007.src: Aye! Let's find the booty and bring back some doubloons! Here be that map I snagged. Swim or whatever you landlubbers do to get to Pirate Cove. It'll be the first house to the right when ye arrive.
Redbeard's Booty#007.dst: 好啊！咱去把寶藏挖出來，帶一船金幣回來！這就是俺弄到的那張圖。用游的還是你們旱鴨子那套隨便你，去海盜灣。到了以後，右手邊第一間房子就是。
Redbeard's Booty#007.speaker: Marston

Redbeard's Booty#008.src: Find Marston's crew on Pirate Cove at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
Redbeard's Booty#008.dst: 到海盜灣找到 Marston 的船員，座標 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

Redbeard's Booty#009.src: And that be when ye will...
Redbeard's Booty#009.speaker: Martim

Redbeard's Booty#010.src: Cor lad...ye don' look like a pirate ta me, and I be but a young lass!
Redbeard's Booty#010.dst: 哎唷小子……你看起來哪像海盜，而俺不過是個年輕姑娘！
Redbeard's Booty#010.speaker: Karkun

Redbeard's Booty#011.src: 's right, bucko. Who be ye, bargin' into our home in yer fancy armour 'n whatnot?
Redbeard's Booty#011.dst: 說得對，老兄。你是誰啊，穿著花俏盔甲什麼的闖進俺們家？
Redbeard's Booty#011.speaker: Martim

Redbeard's Booty#012.src: Ah, ye be accompanyin' Marston, eh? Well if ye insist on that, where be the man 'himself?
Redbeard's Booty#012.dst: 啊，你是跟 Marston 一起的？既然你這麼堅持，那人本尊在哪？
Redbeard's Booty#012.speaker: Argus

Redbeard's Booty#013.src: Comin' later? Hm. Well, more hands always be helpful. Let us go down to me ship, the Black Ring.
Redbeard's Booty#013.dst: 晚點才來？嗯。好吧，多雙手總是好的。咱下去俺的船，黑環號。
Redbeard's Booty#013.speaker: Karkun

Redbeard's Booty#014.src: So he told ye about the plan? We'll bathe in doubloons when we get back! Ah, me fair lass will be so happy.
Redbeard's Booty#014.dst: 這麼說他跟你講過計畫了？等咱們回來，那可是要泡在金幣裡的！啊，俺那位好姑娘會樂壞的。
Redbeard's Booty#014.speaker: Martim

Redbeard's Booty#015.src: Hop aboard the Black Ring down at the dock of Pirate Cove.
Redbeard's Booty#015.dst: 到海盜灣的碼頭登上黑環號。

Redbeard's Booty#017.src: Aha, quick on yer feet, lad! Ye got 'ere before us!
Redbeard's Booty#017.dst: 哈，你腳程真快，小子！比俺們還早到！
Redbeard's Booty#017.speaker: Karkun

Redbeard's Booty#018.dst: 還是沒 Marston 的影子？
Redbeard's Booty#018.speaker: Argus

Redbeard's Booty#019.src: How's about we wait up fer him? He's the one who's givin us the opportunity fer this hunt, anyways.
Redbeard's Booty#019.dst: 不如咱們等等他？畢竟這趟尋寶的機會是他給的。
Redbeard's Booty#019.speaker: Martim

Redbeard's Booty#020.src: I be getting impatient... The whole crew is 'ere, 'cept fer him!
Redbeard's Booty#020.dst: 俺快沒耐性了……全船的人都到齊了，就差他一個！
Redbeard's Booty#020.speaker: Argus

Redbeard's Booty#021.src: Argh! Where be our mate? It be getting dark out! We will have to leave Marston at land.
Redbeard's Booty#021.dst: 呸！咱們那位夥計到底跑哪去了？天都快黑了！只好把 Marston 丟在岸上。
Redbeard's Booty#021.speaker: Karkun

Redbeard's Booty#022.src: Do ya have the map Marston bought?
Redbeard's Booty#022.dst: Marston 買的那張圖在你身上嗎？
Redbeard's Booty#022.speaker: Karkun

Redbeard's Booty#023.src: Let us take a looksie at the map and see where to go.
Redbeard's Booty#023.dst: 咱們來瞧瞧這圖，看看該往哪去。
Redbeard's Booty#023.speaker: Martim

Redbeard's Booty#024.src: It seems like one of these islands have the treasure... A'ight, yer in charge, landlubber! Set us on a course fer an island!
Redbeard's Booty#024.dst: 看樣子寶藏是在這幾座島的其中一座……好啦，旱鴨子，你來作主！給咱們指一座島！
Redbeard's Booty#024.speaker: Argus

Redbeard's Booty#025.src: Ahoy, this must be the booty. Fret not, Argus is keepin' the ship prepared so we can leave.
Redbeard's Booty#025.dst: 嗨呀，一定就是這批寶了。別擔心，Argus 顧著船，隨時能開走。
Redbeard's Booty#025.speaker: Karkun

Redbeard's Booty#026.src: A'ight, let's us dig it up, jacks!
Redbeard's Booty#026.dst: 好啦，咱們把它挖出來，夥計們！
Redbeard's Booty#026.speaker: Martim

Redbeard's Booty#027.src: Aha, I see somethin' gleaming in there! Methinks we hit gold, lads.
Redbeard's Booty#027.dst: 哈，俺看見裡頭有東西在發亮！小子們，俺想咱們挖到金子了。
Redbeard's Booty#027.speaker: Karkun

Redbeard's Booty#028.src: Now Martim, knock the lubber out.
Redbeard's Booty#028.speaker: Karkun

Redbeard's Booty#029.src: What? Another clue! The be just a wild grook hunt, where be the real booty?! No one ever got rich off a heap o' keys!! Maybe this 'ere jewel attached will sell...
Redbeard's Booty#029.dst: 什麼？又一條線索！這根本是白忙一場，真正的寶藏到底在哪？！沒人靠一堆鑰匙發過財！！也許這上頭鑲的寶石還能賣點錢……
Redbeard's Booty#029.speaker: Karkun

Redbeard's Booty#030.src: Wait, there be a clue on the key! Presented to the ruined Galleon, a true path forward will arise.
Redbeard's Booty#030.dst: 等等，鑰匙上有線索！將其呈於沉沒的大帆船之前，真正的道路便會顯現。
Redbeard's Booty#030.speaker: Martim

Redbeard's Booty#031.src: Garh...I be losin' my patience. Argus arrived, let's ditch the lubber before they awake, hm? This island be hidden by magic, ain't no way they're gettin' found.
Redbeard's Booty#031.dst: 唔……俺快沒耐性了。Argus 到了，趁這旱鴨子醒來之前把人丟下吧，嗯？這座島有魔法遮著，沒人找得到的。
Redbeard's Booty#031.speaker: Martim

Redbeard's Booty#032.src: Arright! This key... We might be able to bring Redbeard 'imself back to life... He'll strike terror in the seas again, and we will be 'is crew!
Redbeard's Booty#032.dst: 好極了！這把鑰匙……咱們說不定能讓 Redbeard 本人活過來……他會再度讓大海聞風喪膽，而咱們就是他的船員！
Redbeard's Booty#032.speaker: Karkun

Redbeard's Booty#033.src: Leave the hidden island and stop the pirates from stealing Redbeard's Booty.
Redbeard's Booty#033.dst: 離開這座隱藏的島嶼，阻止海盜偷走 Redbeard 的寶藏。

Redbeard's Booty#034.src: Talk to Marston about his crew at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Redbeard's Booty#034.dst: 和 Marston 談談他的船員，座標 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]。

Redbeard's Booty#035.src: Can't say I expected all that... Those dogs are quick, eh?
Redbeard's Booty#035.dst: 這一切俺可沒料到……那幫傢伙動作真快，嗯？
Redbeard's Booty#035.speaker: Marston

Redbeard's Booty#036.src: Fer a landlubber, ye sure are quick. When I got ta Pirate Cove, ye were already but a speck on the horizon.
Redbeard's Booty#036.dst: 以一個旱鴨子來說，你腳程真快。俺趕到海盜灣的時候，你已經是海平線上的一個小點了。
Redbeard's Booty#036.speaker: Marston

Redbeard's Booty#037.src: Speakin' of, what'n the name o' Davy Jones' Locket happened out there?!
Redbeard's Booty#037.dst: 說到這個，外頭到底發生了什麼鬼事？！
Redbeard's Booty#037.speaker: Marston

Redbeard's Booty#038.src: Ye look a bit bruised! Reckon ye ran aground o' trouble with 'em too, eh?
Redbeard's Booty#038.dst: 你看起來有點傷！想必你也跟他們碰上麻煩了，是吧？
Redbeard's Booty#038.speaker: Marston

Redbeard's Booty#039.src: Well, lad! Methinks ye oughta go in after 'em! We may be a rowdy lot, but a mutiny's somethin' ye don't tolerate.
Redbeard's Booty#039.dst: 好啦，小子！俺看你該追上去才是！咱們這幫人是吵鬧了點，可叛變是絕對不能忍的。
Redbeard's Booty#039.speaker: Marston

Redbeard's Booty#040.src: They don't deserve that treasure, lad! It ain't be mine either, since I missed ye. That gold be yours fer the takin...so take it!
Redbeard's Booty#040.dst: 那批寶藏他們不配拿，小子！那也不是俺的——俺沒趕上你嘛。那些金子是你的，儘管拿去吧……去拿！
Redbeard's Booty#040.speaker: Marston

Redbeard's Booty#041.src: Speakin' of...I ain't got much a penny ta my name, but I found this fish while ye were gone. I hear it sells for a decent haul, so here.
Redbeard's Booty#041.dst: 說到這個……俺身上沒剩幾個子兒，不過你不在的時候俺撈到這條魚。聽說能賣個好價錢，拿去吧。
Redbeard's Booty#041.speaker: Marston

Reincarnation#000.src: Talk to Batelu in Bob's Tomb.
Reincarnation#000.dst: 前往 Bob 的墓中與 Batelu 對話。

Reincarnation#001.src: Hello adventurer! I see you want to solve the mystery of Bob's tomb also? Glad to meet you.
Reincarnation#001.dst: 你好，冒險者！看來你也想解開 Bob 之墓的謎團？很高興認識你。
Reincarnation#001.speaker: Batelu

Reincarnation#002.src: My name is Batelu. Lately, I've been studying these strange symbols on the walls.
Reincarnation#002.dst: 我叫 Batelu。最近我一直在研究牆上這些奇怪的符號。
Reincarnation#002.speaker: Batelu

Reincarnation#003.src: It's about Bob. Hopefully you do not believe the stories of his death, right? Bob couldn't have died so easily. Not to something so mundane as a wolf.
Reincarnation#003.dst: 這跟 Bob 有關。你該不會相信他死掉的那些說法吧？Bob 不可能死得那麼輕易。更不可能敗給一頭狼那種平凡的東西。
Reincarnation#003.speaker: Batelu

Reincarnation#004.src: He wasn't only strong, he was absolutely un-killable, a master in almost every skill.
Reincarnation#004.dst: 他不只是強，他根本是殺不死的，幾乎樣樣技藝都精通。
Reincarnation#004.speaker: Batelu

Reincarnation#005.src: I believe he knew he was about to die. How? What of? Nobody knows, but he left this world prepared.
Reincarnation#005.dst: 我相信他知道自己即將死去。怎麼知道的？死於什麼？沒有人曉得，但他離開這個世界時是有準備的。
Reincarnation#005.speaker: Batelu

Reincarnation#006.src: You see, it says here Bob had three loyal animals. Before dying, he scattered them across the ocean.
Reincarnation#006.dst: 你看，這裡寫著 Bob 有三隻忠心的動物。臨死前，他把牠們分散到大海各處。
Reincarnation#006.speaker: Batelu

Reincarnation#007.src: I think those animals are the key to accessing his real tomb...
Reincarnation#007.dst: 我想那三隻動物就是進入他真正墓室的關鍵……
Reincarnation#007.speaker: Batelu

Reincarnation#008.src: You see that little gap right there? It's the entrance...
Reincarnation#008.dst: 你看到那邊那道小縫了嗎？那就是入口……
Reincarnation#008.speaker: Batelu

Reincarnation#009.src: Unfortunately, nobody was able to remove the spell blocking it.
Reincarnation#009.dst: 可惜的是，從來沒有人解得開封住它的法術。
Reincarnation#009.speaker: Batelu

Reincarnation#010.src: But I do. I know how to open the passage to Bob. This is where the animals come in useful...
Reincarnation#010.dst: 但我解得開。我知道怎麼打開通往 Bob 的路。這就是那些動物派上用場的地方了……
Reincarnation#010.speaker: Batelu

Reincarnation#011.src: I believe Bob did something to those animals. I think if we could reunite them in some way, we could open the passage.
Reincarnation#011.dst: 我相信 Bob 對那些動物做了什麼。我想只要能用某種方式把牠們重新聚在一起，就能打開通道。
Reincarnation#011.speaker: Batelu

Reincarnation#012.src: Bring me {~} Cluckles' Favourite Feather, {~} Baab's Wool & {~} Mooington's Skin if you can find them.
Reincarnation#012.dst: 如果你找得到，請帶 {~1} 根 Cluckles 最愛的羽毛、{~2} 份 Baab 的羊毛，還有 {~3} 塊 Mooington 的皮給我。
Reincarnation#012.speaker: Batelu

Reincarnation#013.src: I am sure that together, we can open the passage. Good luck.
Reincarnation#013.dst: 我相信我們一起就能打開那道通道。祝你好運。
Reincarnation#013.speaker: Batelu

Reincarnation#014.src: Bring back {~} Cluckles' Favourite Feather, Baab's Wool, and Mooington's Skin to Batelu.
Reincarnation#014.dst: 把 {~} 份 Cluckles 最愛的羽毛、Baab 的羊毛與 Mooington 的皮帶回給 Batelu。

Reincarnation#015.src: Wonderful! We can now open the passage to the true tomb of Bob...
Reincarnation#015.dst: 太好了！我們現在可以打開通往 Bob 真墓的路了……
Reincarnation#015.speaker: Batelu

Reincarnation#016.src: I am not worthy enough to enter it. I did not complete the task of the animals, merely read it. You shall go alone, be careful.
Reincarnation#016.dst: 我不夠格進去。動物的試煉不是我完成的，我只是把它讀出來而已。你得自己進去，小心一點。
Reincarnation#016.speaker: Batelu

Reincarnation#017.dst: 擊殺 Bob 的轉世之身。

Reincarnation#018.src: I am Bob, master of the arts of Wynn.
Reincarnation#018.dst: 我是 Bob，Wynn 諸般技藝的宗師。
Reincarnation#018.speaker: Bob

Reincarnation#019.src: Let me explain why you are here.
Reincarnation#019.dst: 讓我告訴你，你為何會來到這裡。
Reincarnation#019.speaker: Bob

Reincarnation#020.src: My animals, were my greatest allies in my travels through the world.
Reincarnation#020.dst: 我的動物，是我行遍世間時最好的夥伴。
Reincarnation#020.speaker: Bob

Reincarnation#021.src: I travelled too far, mined too deep, and of course challenged what should not be challenged. My time in Wynn was coming to an end.
Reincarnation#021.dst: 我走得太遠、挖得太深，當然也挑戰了不該挑戰的東西。我在 Wynn 的時日將盡。
Reincarnation#021.speaker: Bob

Reincarnation#022.src: I knew so, too. But I refused to leave without giving the power i had attained to those worthy of it.
Reincarnation#022.dst: 我心裡明白。但我不願就這樣離開，不願不把我所得到的力量交給配得上它的人。
Reincarnation#022.speaker: Bob

Reincarnation#023.src: Using what ability I had left to me, I transferred my power to my animals, in three pieces. In the hope that those worthy to harness it will seek them out.
Reincarnation#023.dst: 我用剩下的能力，把我的力量分成三份，轉移到我的動物身上。希望配得上駕馭它的人會去尋找牠們。
Reincarnation#023.speaker: Bob

Reincarnation#024.src: The spell I placed on the door to this realm will only break to the one who collects my power. But it cannot have escaped your notice, you do not have my power.
Reincarnation#024.dst: 我下在這座領域門上的法術，只會為集齊我力量的人而破。但你不會沒注意到——你身上並沒有我的力量。
Reincarnation#024.speaker: Bob

Reincarnation#025.src: The truth is, you must pass a test, the ultimate test. Hone your skills you have learnt throughout your travels, and face me. Face me, and earn your place amongst soldiers of Wynn.
Reincarnation#025.dst: 事實是，你必須通過一場試煉，最終極的那一場。磨利你一路上習得的本事，然後面對我。面對我，贏得你在 Wynn 戰士之列的位置。
Reincarnation#025.speaker: Bob

Reincarnation#026.src: Bring back {~} Bob's Seal of Approval to Batelu.
Reincarnation#026.dst: 把 {~} 枚 Bob 的認可印記帶回給 Batelu。

Reincarnation#027.src: Ah! You have returned! Tell me, what did you find within?
Reincarnation#027.dst: 啊！你回來了！告訴我，你在裡面看到了什麼？
Reincarnation#027.speaker: Batelu

Reincarnation#028.src: ...You faced Bob himself in combat? And you triumphed? That's quite remarkable!
Reincarnation#028.dst: ……你跟 Bob 本人交手了？而且你贏了？這實在了不起！
Reincarnation#028.speaker: Batelu

Reincarnation#029.src: And he gave you his Seal of Approval... Hm. If that is the case, then there is something I may do for you.
Reincarnation#029.dst: 而且他還給了你他的認可印記……嗯。既然如此，那我或許可以為你做一件事。
Reincarnation#029.speaker: Batelu

Reincarnation#030.src: Before Bob passed, he left his mythical weapons with a trusted friend. They were, so he said, to be kept for one who would be worthy to wield them...
Reincarnation#030.dst: Bob 過世前，把他的神話武器託付給一位信得過的朋友。他說那些武器要留給配得上使用它們的人……
Reincarnation#030.speaker: Batelu

Reincarnation#031.src: Yes... Yes, I am certain. You have proven yourself worthy. Take this relic, the Stone of Myths, and bring it to the Temple of the Legends.
Reincarnation#031.dst: 沒錯……沒錯，我很確定。你已經證明了自己配得上。拿著這件聖物，神話之石，把它帶到傳說神殿去。
Reincarnation#031.speaker: Batelu

Reincarnation#032.src: Within, you will find a merchant who will offer you a weapon in exchange for it. I wish you luck with your future travels.
Reincarnation#032.dst: 在那裡面，你會找到一位商人，他會用一件武器跟你交換。祝你往後的旅程一路順風。
Reincarnation#032.speaker: Batelu

Revelations in Fall#000.src: Attend the meeting in the resistance camp at .

Revelations in Fall#001.src: Hello, everyone. Thank you for being here today.
Revelations in Fall#001.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#002.src: It has been growing increasingly clear that there is very little we can do here to make a larger impact on Fruma.
Revelations in Fall#002.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#003.src: We have been doing good for the people of Auburn! But our resources are limited, and our opportunities to take action are even more so.
Revelations in Fall#003.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#004.src: Additionally, the risks of our operation grow by the day. I do not regret taking in {u} as a member, but it's no secret that we risk more scrutiny by having them here.
Revelations in Fall#004.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#005.src: Zeph and {u} learned yesterday that an Inquisitor is arriving in the area. We don't know what for exactly, but their presence further endangers our cause.
Revelations in Fall#005.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#006.src: At the festival, I received word from a contact in the Roughworks. There's a group similar to ours there, run by an old friend of mine they're called the Steel Feather.
Revelations in Fall#006.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#007.src: They have resources we don't, and are situated in a much more favorable position. If we're able to cross through to the Roughworks, they've agreed to host us and help plan our next moves.
Revelations in Fall#007.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#008.src: So, what are our next moves? I don't know what you expect us to do there that we're not already able to do here.
Revelations in Fall#008.speaker: Rex

Revelations in Fall#009.src: I'm still workshopping ideas, but they involve the Crown Festival. If we move quickly, we'll be able to catch it in the Roughworks.
Revelations in Fall#009.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#010.src: Of course, traveling to a different district presents its own risks and dangers... if any of you wish to stay here, I will respect that decision.
Revelations in Fall#010.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#011.src: Ha! And leave you to strategize all on your own? I had foreseen something along these lines, so I have already made arrangements with my work. I will join you, miss.
Revelations in Fall#011.speaker: Mora

Revelations in Fall#012.src: An I'm definitely not sitting this one out, are you kidding? I'll follow you wherever you go, Syndra.
Revelations in Fall#012.speaker: Rex

Revelations in Fall#013.src: I- I'll go too! Wh- what's the point of hav- having magic if I don't use it for our c- c- cause?
Revelations in Fall#013.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#014.src: Eh. Don't see myself bein' much use out there, to tell you the truth, Synny. And I figure you need someone to hold down the fort while you're gone, anyhow. So I'll stay.
Revelations in Fall#014.speaker: Kaio

Revelations in Fall#015.src: That would be appreciated, Kaio. I'll feel more comfortable leaving, knowing the LEaves in the Wind is safe in your care.
Revelations in Fall#015.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#018.src: You'll... need my medicine. So I'll go...
Revelations in Fall#018.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#019.src: Sui... you can stay, if you want. I don't want to force you
Revelations in Fall#019.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#020.src: N-no! I want to go with you! I just... I need to say goodbye to some people. Before we leave.
Revelations in Fall#020.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#023.src: I'm forver in your debt. Thank you, again, for offering your help.
Revelations in Fall#023.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#024.src: Sigh... I wish I could disagree. But you're right, I need you to join us.
Revelations in Fall#024.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#025.src: I still need to make preparations before we leave namely, arranging passage across the border. I have a contact that I can... hopefully convince to help.
Revelations in Fall#025.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#026.src: You- you can't pos- possibly mean
Revelations in Fall#026.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#027.src: Yes, Zeph, I do. It will be fine.
Revelations in Fall#027.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#028.src: As for the rest of you, you should make your own preparations. I don't know how long the window of opportunity will be, so make the most of the time left.
Revelations in Fall#028.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#029.src: Hmn... Zeph, why the concern? We all know miss Syndra knows what she's doing! If she claims to have the situation covered, then I see no reason to doubt her!
Revelations in Fall#029.speaker: Mora

Revelations in Fall#031.src: Ah, no matter! Come now, other children... and {u} of course! Let us all take some time to say our goodbyes. We don't know when we'll be back, after all!
Revelations in Fall#031.speaker: Mora

Revelations in Fall#032.src: If we'll be back at all...
Revelations in Fall#032.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#033.src: Sui... we will be back. I'll make sure of it! And you know I always keep my word for matters such as these.
Revelations in Fall#033.speaker: Mora

Revelations in Fall#034.src: We'll be fine, Sui. We always are.
Revelations in Fall#034.speaker: Rex

Revelations in Fall#036.src: Talk with Zeph outside the base at .

Revelations in Fall#038.src: I don't know if I- I'm ready for this.
Revelations in Fall#038.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#039.src: But I have to be! I... I have to.
Revelations in Fall#039.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#041.src: So... I r- really don't trust the Sovereign, and I- I- I'm afraid he might do s- so- something to Syndra.
Revelations in Fall#041.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#042.src: It- it's silly, but... if y- you and I can fi- find a way over the wall without having to ask him d- directly, we could avoid a- a potential con- conflict.
Revelations in Fall#042.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#043.src: And besides, it's not like I have a- any- anything better to do...
Revelations in Fall#043.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#044.src: So! L- let's head into town, and s- s- see if we can
Revelations in Fall#044.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#045.src: Um... excuse me, s-sorry to interrupt I overheard you were... going into town?
Revelations in Fall#045.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#046.src: Sui! Y- yeah, we were pl- planning on it.
Revelations in Fall#046.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#047.src: If... if it wouldn't be too much trouble... could I maybe go with you? I, ah... have some people I want to... say goodbye to.
Revelations in Fall#047.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#048.src: Oh... the people at the R- Re- the Red Fox?
Revelations in Fall#048.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#049.src: It's... a restaurant I, um, frequent. The owners are... nice. I wanted to thank them, for, ha, everything.
Revelations in Fall#049.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#050.src: It's built atop one of th- the tallest tr- trees in {p}, too... so it'll w- wo- work for my idea too. It's jus- just outside {p}'s gates.
Revelations in Fall#050.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#051.src: Head to the Red Fox treetop café at .

Revelations in Fall#052.src: L- let's all meet up at the Re- Red Fox café. It's just ou- out- outside the {p} Gates.
Revelations in Fall#052.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#054.src: So, wh- what do you think? It's a n- nice view from up here, is- isn't it?
Revelations in Fall#054.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#055.src: I... bring the others here quite often. They, um, serve the best food in {p}...
Revelations in Fall#055.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#056.src: Yeah... I'll m- mi- miss our late-night snack runs. Heh.
Revelations in Fall#056.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#058.src: S- Sui, do you... want us t- to stay? We can
Revelations in Fall#058.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#059.src: N-no! No, no, it's... fine. I'll go find Chen on my own. You two, um, hand something you were going to do, right?
Revelations in Fall#059.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#060.src: We did... uh, if y- you're sure, Sui. We'll see you l- la- later?
Revelations in Fall#060.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#061.src: Y... yes. Um, good... good luck!
Revelations in Fall#061.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#062.src: ...okay. Well, {u}, the re- reason we came here... from up h- he- from up here, we have good access to the r- roof- rooftops.
Revelations in Fall#062.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#063.src: I w- w- I want to see if we can ge- get over the wall. If we st- stick to the roofs, we should be able to av- avoid suspicion...
Revelations in Fall#063.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#065.src: Follow Zeph to the tree branch at .

Revelations in Fall#066.src: Ah, Sui! What a pleasure to see you as always!
Revelations in Fall#066.speaker: Red Fox Owner

Revelations in Fall#067.src: Hi, Chen... is, um, business going well?
Revelations in Fall#067.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#068.src: Hum, as well as one can hope, I would say! The Festival does always bring a rush of customers. So, should I prepare the usual for you?
Revelations in Fall#068.speaker: Red Fox Owner

Revelations in Fall#069.src: Oh. Um... that's very kind of you, but, no, not today. Thank you.
Revelations in Fall#069.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#070.src: Very well, very well. Well, since you're here, might I ask if you've had a thought about my job offer?
Revelations in Fall#070.speaker: Red Fox Owner

Revelations in Fall#071.src: You basically know our menu inside and out by this point, so I do truly think you'd be a great fit.
Revelations in Fall#071.speaker: Red Fox Owner

Revelations in Fall#073.src: Okay, so... just f- fo- follow the green trails!
Revelations in Fall#073.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#074.src: If you g- get lost, meet me back here.
Revelations in Fall#074.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#075.src: Travel across the roof tops of {p} starting from .

Revelations in Fall#077.src: Do you, uh, w- want to take a break?
Revelations in Fall#077.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#078.src: Alright, g- good luck! Just re- remember to follow the green trail.
Revelations in Fall#078.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#079.src: I- I'll follow you soon, I'm just w- war- warming up a bit first.
Revelations in Fall#079.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#081.src: Just re- return here when you're ready to st- start again.
Revelations in Fall#081.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#082.src: Ha, I- I guess you got here b- be- before me this time!
Revelations in Fall#082.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#085.src: Aah! I... I... th- that was... c- cl- close.
Revelations in Fall#085.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#086.src: That was... th- that was m- magic, wasn't it...? It was l- li- it was like my whole body was... w- was en- engulfed by a, a g- ge- gentle breeze...
Revelations in Fall#086.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#087.src: I... ha. Th- that was- e- e- exhilarating, but... b- but... Th- there- there's no way we c- ca- we can get across these r- ro- rooftops... one c- cl- one close call is enough f- for me.
Revelations in Fall#087.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#088.src: Ugh... l- let's just... get back to the R- Red Fox...
Revelations in Fall#088.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#089.src: Return to The Red Fox and talk to Zeph at .

Revelations in Fall#090.src: I just... I- I- I don't like it. I don't like that S- Syn- Syndra's putting herself in- in danger like that!
Revelations in Fall#090.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#091.src: I... I owe her a lot. If it weren't for her, I- I- I'd still be st- stuck on the... the st- str- streets. It's thanks to her that I'm still... here.
Revelations in Fall#091.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#092.src: Yeah... I, uh, grew up in a- a small village. S- someone was accused of being c- cursed, and... my people refused to h- ha- hand them over without a- a- wi- without a fight.
Revelations in Fall#092.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#093.src: ...actually, wh- where is she? I th- thought she'd wait for us before...
Revelations in Fall#093.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#094.src: Ah, Zeph, is that you I hear?
Revelations in Fall#094.speaker: Red Fox Owner

Revelations in Fall#095.src: Oh, h- hey Chen. I need to get going, but have you seen Sui? We were g- go- going to meet up here.
Revelations in Fall#095.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#096.src: Yes, Sui... she left not long ago. The poor girl, clearly something is weighing on her...
Revelations in Fall#096.speaker: Red Fox Owner

Revelations in Fall#097.src: I believe she would have gone to the pond to the southeast... that is where she usually goes when she needs some air.
Revelations in Fall#097.speaker: Red Fox Owner

Revelations in Fall#098.src: Oh, I s- see. Th- thank you for the help!
Revelations in Fall#098.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#099.src: Of course, anything for you children. Stop by again soon, would you? I'll make you all the family platter, on the house.
Revelations in Fall#099.speaker: Red Fox Owner

Revelations in Fall#100.src: I... y- yeah, we... we will! Thanks for the off- offer.
Revelations in Fall#100.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#102.src: {u}, can I ask you a f- fa- favour?
Revelations in Fall#102.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#103.src: Could you ch- check on Sui for me, p- please? I... I don't know h- how to help her, right now...
Revelations in Fall#103.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#104.src: S- some- something's on her mind, but... b- but she won't tell me about it. I've tr- tried asking, but...
Revelations in Fall#104.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#105.src: ...but if you ask, ma- maybe she'll tell you? I- I don't know. It's worth a try, at- at least, r- r- right?
Revelations in Fall#105.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#106.src: Th- thanks, {u}. Chen said she w- was at the pond to the southeast.
Revelations in Fall#106.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#107.src: Meet up with Sui near the pond at .

Revelations in Fall#109.src: O-oh, {u}! I didn't... um, expect to see you here.
Revelations in Fall#109.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#110.src: Oh... right. I just... needed some air. It's, hah, kind of a lot. L-leaving Auburn, I mean! I've never... known anywhere else.
Revelations in Fall#110.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#112.src: Can I... tell you something? I was... I wanted to talk to you, earlier, but, um, I... I couldn't build up the courage.
Revelations in Fall#112.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#114.src: S-sorry, I should just... go for it. It- it might be easier if I just, show you, hah...
Revelations in Fall#114.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#115.src: You're the first, um, cursed one I've ever... seen. And- and everyone being so kind, about, all of it...
Revelations in Fall#115.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#116.src: And, I thought, maybe... maybe you could... help. Me. W-with figuring it all out.
Revelations in Fall#116.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#118.src: But... I don't use, um, a focus. To... to control water. S-so, that means I'm, one of the... d-dangerous ones. That's... th-that's what Mora said, um, earlier.
Revelations in Fall#118.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#122.src: Oh... g-good. That's- that's good. I'm glad.
Revelations in Fall#122.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#123.src: Oh... that's, ha, a big thing for someone. B-breaking into a province? I can't imagine, um, doing something like that...
Revelations in Fall#123.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#125.src: I'm just... scared. I'm scared that- that if I try to use it, then, I'll h-hurt someone...
Revelations in Fall#125.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#126.src: I'm... not very brave, haha. I didn't, really, join the resistance because... because I wanted to stand up against the crown!
Revelations in Fall#126.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#127.src: Something like that, it feels... impossible.
Revelations in Fall#127.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#128.src: ... I'm only here because I followed Mora. He's the brave one! N-not- not me. I just, ha, had nowhere else to go.
Revelations in Fall#128.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#129.src: And- and everyone else is so, excited about m-ma-magic! Even, um, Mora. And here I am, too afraid to- to even try!
Revelations in Fall#129.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#131.src: Yeah, but... it- it wouldn't feel, um, right. If the rest of my family is going, then, ha, how could I not go with them?
Revelations in Fall#131.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#132.src: WHat if... something happened to them to you and, and, and- and I wasn't, there? I'd... I'd never f-forgive myself!
Revelations in Fall#132.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#133.src: So... s-so, even if I'm scared... I can't stay behind.
Revelations in Fall#133.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#134.src: ...I'm, um, not much of a fighter. But I'm still good with m-medicine, and healing. So... I can help.
Revelations in Fall#134.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#135.src: Let's... get back home. I should tell Zeph I'm alright.
Revelations in Fall#135.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#136.src: Return to the Leaves in the Wind at .

Revelations in Fall#137.src: Thank you for listening to me.
Revelations in Fall#137.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#138.src: I... I want to help. I'm just... scared.
Revelations in Fall#138.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#139.src: Hrm... ah, {u}, just the leaf I was looking to find!
Revelations in Fall#139.speaker: Mora

Revelations in Fall#140.src: I am nearly finished with preparations for our expedition. Supplies packed, goodbyes said, and so on and so forth.
Revelations in Fall#140.speaker: Mora

Revelations in Fall#141.src: There is... one last thing, however. If I may ask you for a favor?
Revelations in Fall#141.speaker: Mora

Revelations in Fall#142.src: Excellent! I thank you for your time.
Revelations in Fall#142.speaker: Mora

Revelations in Fall#143.src: ...ah, a busy day, I take it? I promise it will be quick, if you would hear me out.
Revelations in Fall#143.speaker: Mora

Revelations in Fall#144.src: I had mentioned previously, your words on magic had resonated with me! I have been taking some time to practice, with the aid of cursory knowledge of military blessings.
Revelations in Fall#144.speaker: Mora

Revelations in Fall#145.src: But such training will do me little good in a true combat scenario. So, in the interest of improvement, I would ask for a sparring match against you!
Revelations in Fall#145.speaker: Mora

Revelations in Fall#146.src: It will help me to spot and shore up my weaknesses. Perhaps it will do the same for you!
Revelations in Fall#146.speaker: Mora

Revelations in Fall#147.src: Come, follow me to our sparring arena!
Revelations in Fall#147.speaker: Mora

Revelations in Fall#150.src: Oof... you are very talented, I must say!
Revelations in Fall#150.speaker: Mora

Revelations in Fall#151.src: No wonder miss Syndra is so invested in you, having battled you herself!
Revelations in Fall#151.speaker: Mora

Revelations in Fall#152.src: Now, tell me, how did I perform?
Revelations in Fall#152.speaker: Mora

Revelations in Fall#153.src: Really! In the moment, it did not feel like I stood much of a chance, but I suppose I am still learning to wield it!
Revelations in Fall#153.speaker: Mora

Revelations in Fall#154.src: It is odd, though. I have only learned of it recently, yet it fels as though the magic has been with me all along! It is like... muscle memory, I suppose? Much to think about.
Revelations in Fall#154.speaker: Mora

Revelations in Fall#155.src: Ha! No need to sugarcoat it. I have always specialized in heavy attacks, so I struggle against swift opponents. Rarely have I managed to best Zeph in a spar!
Revelations in Fall#155.speaker: Mora

Revelations in Fall#156.src: Perhaps therein lies the value of this magic... finding methods to raise area of effect, or slow targets down? Much to think about.
Revelations in Fall#156.speaker: Mora

Revelations in Fall#157.src: An excellent question, though I have no true answers. Perhaps some of what I had learned from military sources has stuck with me?
Revelations in Fall#157.speaker: Mora

Revelations in Fall#158.src: I do trust it will come to Zeph with time. He is persistent! That trait will serve him well for these purposes.
Revelations in Fall#158.speaker: Mora

Revelations in Fall#159.src: Hey, Mora! Have you seen oh, there you are. I've been looking for you.
Revelations in Fall#159.speaker: Rex

Revelations in Fall#160.src: Alright, {u}, come with me. We are SORTING through our problems before we leave.
Revelations in Fall#160.speaker: Rex

Revelations in Fall#161.src: Come on, come on! To the giant tree stump, I don't have all day!
Revelations in Fall#161.speaker: Rex

Revelations in Fall#162.src: ... Ah. Oh dear. She appears to be in a mood today! I suppose that would make sense, given...
Revelations in Fall#162.speaker: Mora

Revelations in Fall#163.src: Hmm, how should I put it...? Ah, nevermind. You'd best follow her to the tree, see what she wants.
Revelations in Fall#163.speaker: Mora

Revelations in Fall#164.src: Keep an eye on her for me, would you? Make sure she gets home safely.
Revelations in Fall#164.speaker: Mora

Revelations in Fall#165.src: Find Rex at the old tree stump at .

Revelations in Fall#166.src: Keep an eye on Rex, would you? I haven't seen her this worked up in a while...
Revelations in Fall#166.speaker: Mora

Revelations in Fall#167.src: Good, you came. Took you long enough!
Revelations in Fall#167.speaker: Rex

Revelations in Fall#168.src: So, here's the deal! You are a problem.
Revelations in Fall#168.speaker: Rex

Revelations in Fall#169.src: Sure, you've proven yourself a hundred times over! Over and over and over again, you've shown you're on our side.
Revelations in Fall#169.speaker: Rex

Revelations in Fall#170.src: And that's great! That's great and all! But. But but but but but! You're still. From. Wynn.
Revelations in Fall#170.speaker: Rex

Revelations in Fall#171.src: Or... originally from Fruma, whatever. That's actually the problem! If you were just from Wynn, maybe it wouldn't be so bad!
Revelations in Fall#171.speaker: Rex

Revelations in Fall#172.src: There's oh so many people from Fruma who were shipped off to Wynn! They really like sending off the problem children whenever they can't deal with them anymore.
Revelations in Fall#172.speaker: Rex

Revelations in Fall#173.src: So I get it! I do! It makes sense! But still... still, why, why... why does it get to be YOU here, and not not...!
Revelations in Fall#173.speaker: Rex

Revelations in Fall#176.src: Oh, don't look at me like that.
Revelations in Fall#176.speaker: Rex

Revelations in Fall#177.src: So I had a brother, right? And sure, he was an idiot sometimes, but but he was the only one there who really understood me.
Revelations in Fall#177.speaker: Rex

Revelations in Fall#178.src: He's the one who carved my bow for me. He heard I was interested in archery, so he... when everyone else told me to just focus on schoolwork, he helped me learn.
Revelations in Fall#178.speaker: Rex

Revelations in Fall#179.src: He really hated all the rules we had up there. So he liked to break them. A lot. And eventually, the crown got sick of it. Packed him up, sent him to the Roughworks.
Revelations in Fall#179.speaker: Rex

Revelations in Fall#180.src: The worst part was, our parents agreed to it! Said it'd be good for him, to get some real hard work!
Revelations in Fall#180.speaker: Rex

Revelations in Fall#181.src: I never liked it there anyway. It took me a while to build up the courage, but eventually I stole some of our money and bought a ticket to take me there.
Revelations in Fall#181.speaker: Rex

Revelations in Fall#182.src: I didn't pack a whole lot. I guess I expected to find him and live with him! Stupid. Should've thought ahead more.
Revelations in Fall#182.speaker: Rex

Revelations in Fall#183.src: He wasn't there, obviously. Heard from some of his friends that he kept being stupid over there. Got caught by the crown, and they decided to stop giving him second chances.
Revelations in Fall#183.speaker: Rex

Revelations in Fall#184.src: So, he's gone! He promised he'd see me again someday, and and of course he didn't follow through. I guess I wasn't important enough to remember.
Revelations in Fall#184.speaker: Rex

Revelations in Fall#185.src: Yes, I know. I just... I guess I just hoped I'd be an exception.
Revelations in Fall#185.speaker: Rex

Revelations in Fall#187.src: I haven't been very fair to you, have I? It's not your fault you're here and he isn't.
Revelations in Fall#187.speaker: Rex

Revelations in Fall#189.src: So... sorry. For all of that.
Revelations in Fall#189.speaker: Rex

Revelations in Fall#191.src: Give me some time, would you? I need to... I don't know. I just need some space.
Revelations in Fall#191.speaker: Rex

Revelations in Fall#193.src: Okay. I... won't take too long. Nobody ever comes here, anyway.
Revelations in Fall#193.speaker: Rex

Revelations in Fall#194.src: Return to the camp and finish packing up at .

Revelations in Fall#196.src: I just hope he's still out there, somewhere...
Revelations in Fall#196.speaker: Rex

Revelations in Fall#197.src: Th- there you are! We, uh, got worried s- some- something bad might've happened.
Revelations in Fall#197.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#198.src: I... I mean... th- they got worried.
Revelations in Fall#198.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#200.src: We were just talking. Gods, you guys and your overeager imaginations...
Revelations in Fall#200.speaker: Rex

Revelations in Fall#202.src: I am afraid not. We have heard nothing since the meeting this morning.
Revelations in Fall#202.speaker: Mora

Revelations in Fall#204.src: Let us just continue to place our trust in Syndra, as we have done many times before! She can handle herself.
Revelations in Fall#204.speaker: Mora

Revelations in Fall#205.src: Ugh! I knew t- tr- trusting the Sovereign w- was a mistake! We n- n- need to go
Revelations in Fall#205.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#206.src: Excuse me the Sovereign? What do you mean the S
Revelations in Fall#206.speaker: Rex

Revelations in Fall#208.src: Sigh... I'm just a little too late, I see.
Revelations in Fall#208.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#209.src: Well, since it's out in the open, I might as well explain myself. Firstly, I owe you all an apology for this.
Revelations in Fall#209.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#211.src: Mora, it's alright. I was going to reveal this secret anyway.
Revelations in Fall#211.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#212.src: The contact I mentioned earlier today it's the Sovereign Zhiraok.
Revelations in Fall#212.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#214.src: What?! How long have you been wait, Mora, you knew?
Revelations in Fall#214.speaker: Rex

Revelations in Fall#215.src: It was a secret kept out of necessity. As for how long... let's say a while, and leave it at that. But we're leaving the {p}, so I see no need to keep it hidden anymore.
Revelations in Fall#215.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#216.src: I know you all worry about me... and I did not want to add another variable to stress over today. I apologize.
Revelations in Fall#216.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#218.src: Yes, I have them. Zhiraok provided me with enough for all of us. We'll need to move fast, though I want to cross into the Roughworks before he suspects what's going on.
Revelations in Fall#218.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#219.src: ...s- so you're safe? It all w- went fine?
Revelations in Fall#219.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#220.src: Yes, Zeph, I am safe. Are you all packed? Crossing the border will take some time, so we need to start going to {p} now.
Revelations in Fall#220.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#221.src: Come on, let's hurry. Let us leave this chapter behind.
Revelations in Fall#221.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#222.src: Walk through the gate to the Roughworks at in {p}.

Revelations in Fall#224.src: I-I a-am ready for this. I have to be.
Revelations in Fall#224.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#225.src: I guess this is really happening...
Revelations in Fall#225.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#227.src: Let's meet up at the gate to the Roughworks and walk through together!
Revelations in Fall#227.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#228.src: Oh... there you are. The, um, line was really long when we got here, so, we... started queuing.
Revelations in Fall#228.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#229.src: Everything's... fine, so far. I think. I... hope.
Revelations in Fall#229.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#234.src: All good. Keep it moving. NEXT!
Revelations in Fall#234.speaker: Passport Officer

Revelations in Fall#239.src: We're through. That went... smoothly enough.
Revelations in Fall#239.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#243.src: Enough of that, children. Miss Syndra, we've reached the Roughworks, yes?
Revelations in Fall#243.speaker: Mora

Revelations in Fall#244.src: We have. We'll follow the plan regroup outside {p}, the city in the region. We need to move quickly, I don't know how much time we have before
Revelations in Fall#244.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#245.src: Zero, Syndra. You've got zero time.
Revelations in Fall#245.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Revelations in Fall#246.src: ... Sovereign. Fast and efficient as always, I see.
Revelations in Fall#246.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#247.src: Naturally, you completely miscalculated, thinking you could sneak by like this. An unwanted variable isn't an unexpected one.
Revelations in Fall#247.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Revelations in Fall#248.src: It was worth a shot, even if unlikely.
Revelations in Fall#248.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#249.src: What garbage. Translating yourself into the Roughworks completely nulls the crown's pact... As if you wouldn't be spotted.
Revelations in Fall#249.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Revelations in Fall#250.src: I'm the one who really miscalculated though! Your angle was so obvious, but I just kept overlooking it. Kept trusting you. Kept hoping you'd settle, you'd terminate this sequence.
Revelations in Fall#250.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Revelations in Fall#251.src: And here you are...associating with a mass murderer! The cursed that caused the Torann massacre!! What kind of lowest-order logic is this?! What were you THINKING?!
Revelations in Fall#251.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Revelations in Fall#253.src: Isn't it obvious, Sovereign? I was Her Majesty dethroned. I want her empire to crumble.
Revelations in Fall#253.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#254.src: Your job was to infiltrate, not sum to the resistance!! Since when did you switch to the other side of the equation?! You're subtracting your only chance, you're You're wasting everything I've done for you!
Revelations in Fall#254.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Revelations in Fall#255.src: So after everything She did to me, you expected me to just go along with it?! To accept the scraps I was left with, to forgive and forget?!
Revelations in Fall#255.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#256.src: Maybe you were the fool all along, Zhiraok, for believing it.
Revelations in Fall#256.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#258.src: ...so it was all imaginary? Nothing real? I cared about you, as a friend. A confidant. Did you? Or...was I just a convenient tool for you?
Revelations in Fall#258.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Revelations in Fall#260.src: Does it...matter. ...ha. Does it matter!! Do you know how much weight you carried in my day to day operations? I wonder how much I carried in yours!!
Revelations in Fall#260.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Revelations in Fall#261.src: It doesn't make me happy to do this. Your resistance is under arrest for the crime of conspiracy against the crown and your cursed, slated for execution.
Revelations in Fall#261.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Revelations in Fall#262.src: I can still pull some strings, Syndra. Round this all out. I might be able to keep you as part of the remainder if you turn yourself in. We can still
Revelations in Fall#262.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Revelations in Fall#263.src: We won't give in without a fight!
Revelations in Fall#263.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#264.src: ...why...do I even bother. A cursed compared to me...absolute trash. Let's get this over with.
Revelations in Fall#264.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Revelations in Fall#267.src: S- Syndra, are- are y- you
Revelations in Fall#267.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#273.src: Let's move. Everyone, remember the meeting point, just
Revelations in Fall#273.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#274.src: Are we really glossing over you killing a Sovereign????
Revelations in Fall#274.speaker: Rex

Revelations in Fall#275.src: Yes, Rex, because he won't stay down for long that's why we need to move, now!
Revelations in Fall#275.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#276.src: Split up, stay safe, don't get caught. We meet in three days now, GO!
Revelations in Fall#276.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#277.src: Sovereign Zhiraok, sir! You have a visitor here!
Revelations in Fall#277.speaker: Xao

Revelations in Fall#278.src: Send them in, and if you could process these files, please-and-thank-you? I need the inquisitor to weigh in on the problem.
Revelations in Fall#278.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Revelations in Fall#279.src: I have a finite value of time for this, so let's keep this short
Revelations in Fall#279.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Revelations in Fall#281.src: Hello, Sovereign. Sorry to interrupt you during your working hours once again.
Revelations in Fall#281.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#282.src: I'll add it to the tally! Bringing the trouble straight to my office, too You've got me nervous with the number of times it's happened recently.
Revelations in Fall#282.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Revelations in Fall#283.src: Let's cut to the chase, then. Tell me what your angle Ugh. What your request is.
Revelations in Fall#283.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Revelations in Fall#284.src: Don't hold it in, you'll get an ulcer. I'll make this quick I need passage to the Roughworks. For myself and five others.
Revelations in Fall#284.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#285.src: ...you're really asking me to square the circle here. Why do you need to do this, go there? And so suddenly? Why?
Revelations in Fall#285.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Revelations in Fall#286.src: I... I need to find her. I don't know how much more time I'll have to try.
Revelations in Fall#286.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#287.src: I know, I know!! Quit being obtuse, you know the consequences if you break the mandate, for both of us!!
Revelations in Fall#287.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Revelations in Fall#289.src: ...Is that all I get? What about the other five?
Revelations in Fall#289.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Revelations in Fall#291.src: Of course. You and your strays. Why can't you just... There has to be another solution, if we If you I
Revelations in Fall#291.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Revelations in Fall#293.src: ...why do I even bother. Fine. You want it so badly, fine!! You know what this will take. Just... Remember. Remember what I've done for you.
Revelations in Fall#293.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Revelations in Fall#294.src: Thank you, Zhiraok. I won't let your kindness go to waste.
Revelations in Fall#294.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#295.src: Sovereign Zhiraok! Inquisitor Renn has some concerns
Revelations in Fall#295.speaker: Xao

Revelations in Fall#296.src: Xao, I need you to clear my schedule. There's a higher priority now, he can wait.
Revelations in Fall#296.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Revelations in Fall#297.src: Oh! Um, of course! If you insist, sir!! Inquisitor Renn won't be happy, but your orders are top
Revelations in Fall#297.speaker: Xao

Revelations in Fall#298.src: No, you're right, I'm being irrational. You're always right. Clear everything but that, it's fine. I'll get back to it later. Unexpected variables, extenuating circumstances...
Revelations in Fall#298.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Revelations in Fall#299.src: Sov ...Zhi-Zhi? Is everything okay? You...you look rattled, was it something she said? Should I have not brought her
Revelations in Fall#299.speaker: Xao

Revelations in Fall#300.src: You didn't do anything wrong. She gave me a prime opportunity anyway. A warning before throwing my sequence out of line.
Revelations in Fall#300.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Revelations in Fall#301.src: Xao, I trust you. I need to leave Auburn in your care for a bit while I solve this. Please. Can you handle that?
Revelations in Fall#301.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Revelations in Fall#302.src: ...oh my, I... It's an honor! I won't let you down, sir!! I'll keep things ship-shape! But, why do you need me for this?
Revelations in Fall#302.speaker: Xao

Revelations in Fall#303.src: ...I need to converge at the Roughworks, handle her work for a while. That, and the next Crown Festival is soon. I feel like...it'd be a disservice to miss it.
Revelations in Fall#303.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Rise of the Quartron#001.src: Shipment {~}A and {~}B, fully accounted for... shipments {~}C and {~}A...missing {~} of quartz content?!
Rise of the Quartron#001.speaker: Nasea

Rise of the Quartron#002.src: Agh, this is getting worse! There's never been so much loss...whoever this is, thy're getting bold...
Rise of the Quartron#002.speaker: Nasea

Rise of the Quartron#003.src: Ugh, go AWAY! Quit hovering over my shoulder like that- wait, a Human? Since when did you get here?
Rise of the Quartron#003.speaker: Nasea

Rise of the Quartron#004.src: What, you like listening to the melodious sound of my voice or something? Or do you intend to help out?
Rise of the Quartron#004.speaker: Nasea

Rise of the Quartron#005.src: Well, I'm flattered either way, and I could certainly use the help. Quartz is going missing from my shipments.
Rise of the Quartron#005.speaker: Nasea

Rise of the Quartron#006.src: Obviously one of the laborers is siphoning it to someplace, and I can't have that happening. So, be a private eye, humie.
Rise of the Quartron#006.speaker: Nasea

Rise of the Quartron#007.src: This is actually pretty dire- quartz has some magicality to it, see. It likes to soak up magic power, which means it can be weaponized.
Rise of the Quartron#007.speaker: Nasea

Rise of the Quartron#008.src: We tend not to use it for weapons since it can overcharge, but that's neither here nor there, is it?
Rise of the Quartron#008.speaker: Nasea

Rise of the Quartron#009.src: Every siphoned shipment has gone through Dado. Interrogate him! He hangs out past the big red tent, near the house with red flags.
Rise of the Quartron#009.speaker: Nasea

Rise of the Quartron#010.src: Talk to Dado and see if he is the culprit.

Rise of the Quartron#011.src: Okay, these go to division P, and...look, I'm busy allocating these deliveries to {p}. Go pester someone else, okay?
Rise of the Quartron#011.speaker: Dado

Rise of the Quartron#012.src: ...what. You...think I... Pfff... Pffhahaaaah! Ohhh, that's RICH coming from a human of all things!
Rise of the Quartron#012.speaker: Dado

Rise of the Quartron#013.src: "Oh, me, the hired gun species that kills for money, will accuse you, a storied worker of seven years, of illegal activity!" Wow, you HYPOCRITE!
Rise of the Quartron#013.speaker: Dado

Rise of the Quartron#014.src: I'm hardly even angry about this! But, yeah, you freak. You got the wrong guy, surprise! Your brain workin' right in there?
Rise of the Quartron#014.speaker: Dado

Rise of the Quartron#015.src: I bet you got some wires crossed in there, huh? Go scuttle on back to town and kill someone's Wybel for pocket change or something.
Rise of the Quartron#015.speaker: Dado

Rise of the Quartron#016.src: Go back to Nasea and tell her about Dado’s response.

Rise of the Quartron#017.src: I'm just going to take a wild guess and say that asking him nicely whether he committed theft didn't bring up any answers.
Rise of the Quartron#017.speaker: Nasea

Rise of the Quartron#018.src: What, he brushed you off like THAT? Jeez, I knew he was a jerk, but really? That's just uncalled for.
Rise of the Quartron#018.speaker: Nasea

Rise of the Quartron#019.src: We have to make him talk...if shipments keep going missing, my contractors are going to look elsewhere!
Rise of the Quartron#019.speaker: Nasea

Rise of the Quartron#020.src: We need to prove that he's guilty...wait, you came to ME for ideas? This is why I asked you for help! Am I really back to square one?
Rise of the Quartron#020.speaker: Nasea

Rise of the Quartron#022.src: I...what are you doing here, uh...Larry? Were you missing quartz too??
Rise of the Quartron#022.speaker: Nasea

Rise of the Quartron#023.src: Ah, it's...Lari. No, the quartz shipment found its way fine...
Rise of the Quartron#023.speaker: Lari

Rise of the Quartron#024.src: But, there was hardly an effect. Your idea was, unfortunately, a dead end.
Rise of the Quartron#024.speaker: Lari

Rise of the Quartron#025.src: Well, I did warn you that it was only an idea. I manage the mine, I don't practice purification magic. Don't pin anything on me for that.
Rise of the Quartron#025.speaker: Nasea

Rise of the Quartron#026.src: I did not intend to imply that. Your help was appreciated, fate simply had opposing plans...
Rise of the Quartron#026.speaker: Lari

Rise of the Quartron#027.src: ...is this human a part of your operations, miss?
Rise of the Quartron#027.speaker: Lari

Rise of the Quartron#028.src: Well, in a sense. Someone's siphoning quartz, but our suspect wasn't intimidated by the ten tons of armor, so we're at a loss. Any ideas?
Rise of the Quartron#028.speaker: Nasea

Rise of the Quartron#029.src: ...as a matter of fact, I do have a solution. Elven botany describes a flower that grows decently close by, the "Tattytale" flower.
Rise of the Quartron#029.speaker: Lari

Rise of the Quartron#030.src: It weakens the will of those who catch a whiff of its petals, making them pliable to questions. It's...unpleasant, but if it is needed, I suppose.
Rise of the Quartron#030.speaker: Lari

Rise of the Quartron#031.src: There is a cave infested with spiders, and covered with webs in the western mountain. It is the only place it grows outside of {p}, unfortunately.
Rise of the Quartron#031.speaker: Lari

Rise of the Quartron#032.src: Nasea, since it didn't help, I've returned the quartz. I thank you for your help...and I shall bid you both adieu.
Rise of the Quartron#032.speaker: Lari

Rise of the Quartron#034.src: Make Dado confess by using the Tattytale Flower.

Rise of the Quartron#035.src: Hey, everyone's least-favorite attack dog! Here boy! You want the emerald? Go kill all the flies in my house! Come on boy!
Rise of the Quartron#035.speaker: Dado

Rise of the Quartron#036.src: Aw, flowers. How sweet of you! Sorry, but I don't cave to psychopaths or flattery, hehehee!
Rise of the Quartron#036.speaker: Dado

Rise of the Quartron#037.src: I...huff... What was THAT for?! Are you offended that I don't like your flo- What? What am I doing with the quartz?
Rise of the Quartron#037.speaker: Dado

Rise of the Quartron#038.src: Uh, isn't it obvious? I'm working overtime and sending it up to Popo, duh. Where else would I be sending it?
Rise of the Quartron#038.speaker: Dado

Rise of the Quartron#039.src: What- Where's Popo sending it? Um...no clue. Whoever it is, they're super rich though. They pay me more than my house is worth every shipment!
Rise of the Quartron#039.speaker: Dado

Rise of the Quartron#040.src: Not sure why you need to- What? Where's Popo? Uh, he said he'd meet me at the cart track overpass, near the teal flags.
Rise of the Quartron#040.speaker: Dado

Rise of the Quartron#041.src: This was going to be our first meeting, so I don't know what he looks like, and likewise he's never seen me.
Rise of the Quartron#041.speaker: Dado

Rise of the Quartron#042.src: ...uh. Okay, I haave no clue why I told you all of that...um, have you got any more of those flowers though? It was actually really good...
Rise of the Quartron#042.speaker: Dado

Rise of the Quartron#043.src: Go up the minecart hill and find Popo.

Rise of the Quartron#044.src: Ah, you must- Wait, never mind. I was expecting a visit from someone else.
Rise of the Quartron#044.speaker: Popo

Rise of the Quartron#045.src: Wait, you're Dado? I guess humans have more brain capacity than orcs after all, hehah!
Rise of the Quartron#045.speaker: Popo

Rise of the Quartron#046.src: Okay, down to business. I'm gonna look busy to cover for you while you get to the base for briefing. You'll get the details there.
Rise of the Quartron#046.speaker: Popo

Rise of the Quartron#047.src: You stick out like a sore thumb, but thankfully humans like to get into lots of weird spots, so it won't look too out of place.
Rise of the Quartron#047.speaker: Popo

Rise of the Quartron#048.src: Use the small rail here, flick the lever. It'll look like you're just...doing what humans do, instead of drawing suspicion.
Rise of the Quartron#048.speaker: Popo

Rise of the Quartron#049.src: Ride the minecart to the bandit mansion.

Rise of the Quartron#050.src: Hop on the minecart, it's leaving! But act natural!
Rise of the Quartron#050.speaker: Popo

Rise of the Quartron#051.src: Interesting, a human's been swept up in our plans. Hadn't expected the work force to diversify so fast.
Rise of the Quartron#051.speaker: Harnort

Rise of the Quartron#052.src: Time for the rundown, oh I love explaining this! I think you'll find what I have to say quite interesting, yes yes!
Rise of the Quartron#052.speaker: Harnort

Rise of the Quartron#053.src: You see, quartz is a powerful magical material- moreso than many know! It can absorb and harness magical energy, but what more? I had to find out!
Rise of the Quartron#053.speaker: Harnort

Rise of the Quartron#054.src: The rubes in my research department got me kicked out for suggesting we further our research. What kind of scientist is scared to make advancements?!
Rise of the Quartron#054.speaker: Harnort

Rise of the Quartron#055.src: But without a board of directors breathing down my neck, my research has led me exactly where I'd hoped, and even more, yes yes!
Rise of the Quartron#055.speaker: Harnort

Rise of the Quartron#056.src: Oi. Got a guest taking the secret passage.
Rise of the Quartron#056.speaker: Guard

Rise of the Quartron#058.src: Harnort! I'M Dado! This sicko mugged me for info! They're gonna ruin us both!
Rise of the Quartron#058.speaker: Dado

Rise of the Quartron#059.src: Guards!! GUARDS!! Capture them! Stop them! Tie them up, do something!! Our research can't go to waste, not at this vital point!!
Rise of the Quartron#059.speaker: Harnort

Rise of the Quartron#060.src: HA! That's what you get for showing me that amazi- HORRIBLE flower! Outta here!
Rise of the Quartron#060.speaker: Dado

Rise of the Quartron#061.src: Break into the laboratory and stop Harnort.

Rise of the Quartron#062.src: ...so, it's come to this then. I knew the names of all those guards. I didn't hurt anyone to meet my goal.
Rise of the Quartron#062.speaker: Harnort

Rise of the Quartron#063.src: You...I won't let their sacrifices be in vain! {p} needs to see what quartz is truly capable of! I MUST show them.
Rise of the Quartron#063.speaker: Harnort

Rise of the Quartron#064.src: My Quartrons are the future! They need to see it! It will have been worth the scheming, and the thieving, and the burnt bridges!
Rise of the Quartron#064.speaker: Harnort

Rise of the Quartron#065.src: But you- you couldn't leave well enough alone. You stepped in, and callously threw away a hundred lives to stop the inevitable!
Rise of the Quartron#065.speaker: Harnort

Rise of the Quartron#066.src: One live for a hundred is a fair trade!!
Rise of the Quartron#066.speaker: Harnort

Rise of the Quartron#067.src: Take down the Quartron and return to nasea with the news.

Rise of the Quartron#068.src: Aaah! Not responding?! You- You... YOU! You've destroyed the future! MY future! GAVEL'S future!!!
Rise of the Quartron#068.speaker: Harnort

Rise of the Quartron#069.src: The futures of a hundred men or more!! You humans deserve to burn in hell for your careless destruction!
Rise of the Quartron#069.speaker: Harnort

Rise of the Quartron#070.src: The energy output by the detonations is overcharging the quartz in the walls... This entire lab is a deathtrap now! Do us all a favor- SIT STILL AND DIE ALREADY!!
Rise of the Quartron#070.speaker: Harnort

Rise of the Quartron#071.src: ...you've got some serious explaining to do. First you disappear to get that Tattle flower, or whatever it was.
Rise of the Quartron#071.speaker: Nasea

Rise of the Quartron#072.src: Then Dado ran through here screaming that he was drugged or nugged, and ran off to the east ridge.
Rise of the Quartron#072.speaker: Nasea

Rise of the Quartron#073.src: Then, he came back, asking me if I'd found any more of those flowers, and while he was blabbering the ENTIRE MOUNTAIN SHOOK.
Rise of the Quartron#073.speaker: Nasea

Rise of the Quartron#074.src: So, spill it. I wanted you to figure out where my quartz was going, and you made one of my workers an addict and caused a freaking landslide!!
Rise of the Quartron#074.speaker: Nasea

Rise of the Quartron#075.src: ...uh huh. Mhm. ... ...yeah, go on. Uh, okay, I can buy that... I'd never believe you if you hadn't given me the proof.
Rise of the Quartron#075.speaker: Nasea

Rise of the Quartron#076.src: A militarized quartz mech...yeesh. That guy sounds like a piece of work. Guess that wasn't really your fault after all.
Rise of the Quartron#076.speaker: Nasea

Rise of the Quartron#077.src: I'll round up the police to get all those guards and them. ...what's with that look? Almost looks like you don't think anyone'll be there. Anyways...
Rise of the Quartron#077.speaker: Nasea

Rise of the Quartron#078.src: Okay, so I'll out you a quick deal. I'll pay you now for figuring this out, and if you do justt one more thing for me then you'll get something extra.
Rise of the Quartron#078.speaker: Nasea

Rise of the Quartron#079.src: Take the elevator past the yellow flags and go into the private site, you have my permission. I'll meet you up there.
Rise of the Quartron#079.speaker: Nasea

Rise of the Quartron#080.src: Join Nasea at the end of the minecart track.

Rise of the Quartron#082.src: This is the newest mining annex, but we've hit a bit of a brick wall. Well...a gravel wall.
Rise of the Quartron#082.speaker: Nasea

Rise of the Quartron#083.src: So, if you can open up this area, you'll get access to the mine and whatever you find in it.
Rise of the Quartron#083.speaker: Nasea

Rise of the Quartron#084.src: I have to be off though, lots of work to get to. Hm. It looks like the core you showed me folded up into a ring. Really high-tech stuff, but I can't use it, so you can take it.
Rise of the Quartron#084.speaker: Nasea

Rise of the Quartron#085.src: Suppose that's all, then! Here's your payment. I'll see you around.
Rise of the Quartron#085.speaker: Nasea

Royal Trials#001.src: Back off! No'ne enters 'til the pirate queen is chosen. What's a landwalker like you doin' here?
Royal Trials#001.speaker: Skyraider Guard

Royal Trials#002.src: Participate? Are ye crazy? Ain't no way a landlubber is wearing the crown.
Royal Trials#002.speaker: Skyraider Guard

Royal Trials#003.src: Off with ya now! Before I call the gals to gut you. And dun' go wandering around chatting to any skyraiders!
Royal Trials#003.speaker: Skyraider Guard

Royal Trials#005.src: Yer wantin' to be pirate queen, ye? Don' worry, I can help ye.
Royal Trials#005.speaker: Hrona

Royal Trials#006.src: Y'see, the other pirates ain't fit for the role. They're dumb 'n weak. All they've got is looks.
Royal Trials#006.speaker: Hrona

Royal Trials#007.src: Yer got the lot! Looks and talent.
Royal Trials#007.speaker: Hrona

Royal Trials#008.src: Y'know, the guard, she's dumb too. A simple disguise will fool 'er. Issue is, ye dun' look like a skyraider at all!
Royal Trials#008.speaker: Hrona
