Royal Trials#009.src: Yer in luck, though. A skyraider will sell anything for a price - just look around the town and see if ye can persuade anyone to part with their outfit.
Royal Trials#009.speaker: Hrona

Royal Trials#010.src: Look around the skyraider town at [{~}, {~}, -{~}] and find a pirate outfit.

Royal Trials#011.src: Aye? A landwalker, wanderin' around our base? Whatcha' want?
Royal Trials#011.speaker: Egpla

Royal Trials#013.src: ... aye, I suppose I could be tempted to pass it on to ye... for a price.
Royal Trials#013.speaker: Egpla

Royal Trials#014.src: Here, these are what I'd trade it to ye for.
Royal Trials#014.speaker: Egpla

Royal Trials#015.src: If yer thinkin' emeralds... [{~} Emerald Blocks] seems like a fair price, heh.
Royal Trials#015.speaker: Egpla

Royal Trials#016.src: Of course, if you're running low on funds, how about ye grab me [{~} Dragonling Eggs] instead? Y'know, the ingredient. I'm 'oping to raise some 'o the lil critters!
Royal Trials#016.speaker: Egpla

Royal Trials#017.src: But if neither of them tickle ye fancy... I've always wanted [{~} Shiny Shell] - they're just so sparkly! Ye can find them in the cave south-east of here, beside the ladders.
Royal Trials#017.speaker: Egpla

Royal Trials#018.src: Ye can get me one o' those three, landwalker, and ye can have my outfit!
Royal Trials#018.speaker: Egpla

Royal Trials#019.src: Give an item to Egpla at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Royal Trials#020.src: So, landwalker, are ye ready to pay up? I can see emeralds in ye pocket, hand 'em over.
Royal Trials#020.speaker: Egpla

Royal Trials#021.src: Alrigh'! Those're exactly what I've been lookin' for. Give it here, lemme have a look...
Royal Trials#021.speaker: Egpla

Royal Trials#022.src: Aye, landwalker! Is that the sparkle of a shiny shell I spot in ye pocket?! Lemme have a look...
Royal Trials#022.speaker: Egpla

Royal Trials#023.src: Alright, landwalker. Ye can have me outfit. 'ere, lemme just get changed inside.
Royal Trials#023.speaker: Egpla

Royal Trials#024.src: Here ye go, landlubber. I hope ye get some kinda use out of it, whatever ye want it for.
Royal Trials#024.speaker: Egpla

Royal Trials#026.src: Another contestant, eh? That outfit looks a bit funny on ye, but I'll let yer in. Hurry up!
Royal Trials#026.speaker: Skyraider Guard

Royal Trials#028.src: Ugh! Ye can't be the queen, ye can barely fly an airship!
Royal Trials#028.speaker: Angry Contestant

Royal Trials#029.src: No! I'll be the queen! I'm much more qualified than any of you sky rats!
Royal Trials#029.speaker: Angry Contestant

Royal Trials#030.src: Listen to the Trials Overseer's speech.

Royal Trials#031.src: Gather round, ladies. The next Queen is about to be selected!
Royal Trials#031.speaker: Trials Overseer

Royal Trials#032.src: As ye know, our previous queen suffered a... nasty fate, murdered on her very own airship by a Wynn soldier.
Royal Trials#032.speaker: Trials Overseer

Royal Trials#033.src: But in the ashes of her honor, a new queen shall rise! Three trials. That's what ye all face now.
Royal Trials#033.speaker: Trials Overseer

Royal Trials#034.src: Only one, who passes all trials laid before her, will pass and gain the title of Skyraider Queen.
Royal Trials#034.speaker: Trials Overseer

Royal Trials#035.src: Now, I introduce ye all to the first trial, to test yer capability at a vital skill for queenship - combat!
Royal Trials#035.speaker: Trials Overseer

Royal Trials#037.src: Defeat the armory room of the combat challenge.

Royal Trials#038.src: Defeat the brig room of the combat challenge.

Royal Trials#039.src: Defeat the cockpit room of the combat challenge.

Royal Trials#040.src: Listen to the trials overseer's speech.

Royal Trials#041.src: Arr, that weeded out the weak. A queen must be strong to lead.
Royal Trials#041.speaker: Trials Overseer

Royal Trials#042.src: Now, to the second challenge - the task of flight! Ye can't be a queen if ye can't fly yer airship!
Royal Trials#042.speaker: Trials Overseer

Royal Trials#043.src: Make sure ye bring yer eyes, girls, one false move and death awaits.
Royal Trials#043.speaker: Trials Overseer

Royal Trials#044.src: This task should get rid of the rest of ye unworthy.
Royal Trials#044.speaker: Trials Overseer

Royal Trials#046.src: Listen to the trials overseer's speech.

Royal Trials#047.src: Well lookie here, an amateur made it through her flight.
Royal Trials#047.speaker: Trials Overseer

Royal Trials#048.src: Well let’s see how you hold up in the final task ladies.
Royal Trials#048.speaker: Trials Overseer

Royal Trials#049.src: Yer ain’ a pirate at all if ye can't steal, but this is different.
Royal Trials#049.speaker: Trials Overseer

Royal Trials#050.src: This is the real deal. Stealin’ from a highly secure mansion.
Royal Trials#050.speaker: Trials Overseer

Royal Trials#051.src: Yer job is to steal a priceless treasure from the richest family in the sky.
Royal Trials#051.speaker: Trials Overseer

Royal Trials#052.src: We'll be waiting with a getaway airship at the extraction point, everyone else'll left behind.
Royal Trials#052.speaker: Trials Overseer

Royal Trials#053.src: Remember, this be the real thing, and the consequences of failure will be severe. Good luck, ladies.
Royal Trials#053.speaker: Trials Overseer

Royal Trials#054.src: This here is the garden you we'll tunnel into, and yer'll 'ave to find a way into the Mansion, maybe yer can just ask nicely, heh.
Royal Trials#054.speaker: Trials Overseer

Royal Trials#055.src: Then yer'll have to sneak through these corridors to reach the treasure - and don't let the guards find yer, or they'll lock yer up and throw away the key.
Royal Trials#055.speaker: Trials Overseer

Royal Trials#056.src: This, o' course, is the mythical treasure that yer gonna want to grab and get outta here, stat. I'm sure there'll be some extra defenses, though.
Royal Trials#056.speaker: Trials Overseer

Royal Trials#057.src: And finally yer'll have to escape outta this window right 'ere - I'll be waitin' with an airship to carry all of ye out.
Royal Trials#057.speaker: Trials Overseer

Royal Trials#059.src: Aye', think ye ready to try grabbin' that treasure, eh? Just 'ead outta this hole and try to find yer way into the mansion.
Royal Trials#059.speaker: Skyraider

Royal Trials#060.src: Sneak past the guards and steal the treasure.

Royal Trials#061.src: Oi', you! Whatcha' think yer' doin' sneakin' around these parts? This be a restricted area! Yer' headed to the jail cell!
Royal Trials#061.speaker: Mansion Guard

Royal Trials#062.src: Get the treasure to the trials overseer outside of the mansion's window.

Royal Trials#063.src: Aye', men! Tha' treasure has been stolen! Prepare the defenses!
Royal Trials#063.speaker: Mansion Guard

Royal Trials#064.src: Aye, we caught the nasty thief! We'll be lockin' him up till' he rots!
Royal Trials#064.speaker: Mansion Guard

Royal Trials#065.src: Ah, I thought yer might be the first one back. Yer got a queenly look about ye...
Royal Trials#065.speaker: Trials Overseer

Royal Trials#066.src: Head to the airship behind me, lassie. We'll wait a second before the others.
Royal Trials#066.speaker: Trials Overseer

Royal Trials#067.src: Exit the Mansion onto the airship outside.

Royal Trials#068.src: Listen to the trials overseer's speech.

Royal Trials#069.src: Aha! I figured it'd be ye to win o'er the rest of that lot… Ye've earned the proper sovereignty of bein' our ruler, our queen of the Skyraiders.
Royal Trials#069.speaker: Trials Overseer

Royal Trials#070.src: Don't be worryin', we got this airship armoured somethin' heavy, and we’re miles away from their cannons… Nothin' to be afraid of, we're safe in this ship.
Royal Trials#070.speaker: Trials Overseer

Royal Trials#071.src: But, first things first, let’s take a look inside that fancy box ye got, see what mythical treasures lay guarded behind those grubby guardsmen, shall we?
Royal Trials#071.speaker: Trials Overseer

Royal Trials#073.src: I hafta wonder now if this weren't bein' guarded for a bit of a nefarious reason. This be... Quite the weapon. It'd be deadly if this got used.
Royal Trials#073.speaker: Trials Overseer

Royal Trials#074.src: Well, thanks to ye, us Skyraiders might have it now, but using this weapon against civilization would be beyond terrible. We might be pirates but we ain't heartless!
Royal Trials#074.speaker: Trials Overseer

Royal Trials#075.src: I think we'll just have to keep this locked up nice n' tight once we get back. We'll be sure to tie this little cataclysm-in-a-box down much safer th'n those idiot men did.
Royal Trials#075.speaker: Trials Overseer

Royal Trials#076.src: Aha! Just gettin' back now. Let's head down and start the ceremony, shall we?
Royal Trials#076.speaker: Trials Overseer

Royal Trials#077.src: I am pleased to introduce our {~}th Skyraider Queen. Fer the sake of our people, let her reign last more than two weeks.
Royal Trials#077.speaker: Trials Overseer

Royal Trials#078.src: I, on behalf on the rest of the Skyraider people, have the honor of decoratin' you with the highest decoration of the Skyraiders, The Queen's Headpiece.
Royal Trials#078.speaker: Trials Overseer

Royal Trials#079.src: Please use your sovereignty to lead us to the riches we deserve.
Royal Trials#079.speaker: Trials Overseer

Royal Trials#081.src: Yer Majesty. What an honour to have such a beautiful queen.
Royal Trials#081.speaker: Trials Overseer

Royal Trials#082.src: Now, we must crown ye, and give you yer reward.
Royal Trials#082.speaker: Trials Overseer

Royal Trials#083.src: Benefits of being a queen I 'spose.
Royal Trials#083.speaker: Trials Overseer

Shattered Minds#000.dst: 前往 {p} 的 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] 與 Likeru 交談。

Shattered Minds#001.src: Aha, perfect! You'll be perfect! Lucky a human decided to come here!
Shattered Minds#001.dst: 啊哈，太好了！你會非常適合！運氣真好，居然有個人類跑來這裡！
Shattered Minds#001.speaker: Likeru

Shattered Minds#002.src: I'll get to the point- I want you to go get something for me, and then bring it back here. Simple, right?
Shattered Minds#002.dst: 我直說了——我要你去幫我拿個東西，然後帶回來這裡。很簡單吧？
Shattered Minds#002.speaker: Likeru

Shattered Minds#003.src: When you do that, I'm going to fix it up and try something out on you. Something magically enlightening!
Shattered Minds#003.dst: 等你拿回來，我會把它處理一下，然後在你身上試點東西。某種能讓人靈光大開的魔法！
Shattered Minds#003.speaker: Likeru

Shattered Minds#004.src: Oh, don't give me that look, it should be perfectly safe! Unless you've been mired in darkness for the past however many years...
Shattered Minds#004.dst: 噢，別用那種眼神看我，那絕對安全！除非你過去這些年一直泡在黑暗裡……
Shattered Minds#004.speaker: Likeru

Shattered Minds#005.src: Anyway, what I need is a specific kind of mushroom that grows close by, the Bluecap Mushroom.
Shattered Minds#005.dst: 總之，我需要的是一種長在附近的特定蘑菇，藍帽菇。
Shattered Minds#005.speaker: Likeru

Shattered Minds#006.src: They grow underground- in a cave out the gate northwest of here. I'll even pay you if you bring it back, so what have you got to lose?
Shattered Minds#006.dst: 它們長在地底下——從這裡西北邊的門出去有個洞穴。你帶回來我還會付你錢，你有什麼好損失的？
Shattered Minds#006.speaker: Likeru

Shattered Minds#007.src: Bring Likeru the mushrooms from the cave at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Shattered Minds#007.dst: 從 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] 的洞穴帶蘑菇回來給 Likeru。

Shattered Minds#008.src: Figure out how to get out of the cave, and return to Likeru.
Shattered Minds#008.dst: 想辦法離開洞穴，然後回去找 Likeru。

Shattered Minds#009.src: Looks like someone rolled about the air fuzz too much, so indeed hello! A light hello to yourself, {u}, and a greetings to Professor Eih, which is me!
Shattered Minds#009.dst: 看來有人在空中的絨毛裡滾得太久啦，所以，你好哇！輕輕地向你問聲好，{u}，也向 Eih 教授，也就是我，致上問候！

Shattered Minds#010.src: I don't rhyme all the instances, I feel the need to say. But what do you say? Very little! But I bet you're wondering where you are.
Shattered Minds#010.dst: 我得說，我可不是每一句都押韻的。不過你說什麼呢？你什麼都沒說！但我敢打賭你正在想自己身在何處。
Shattered Minds#010.speaker: Professor Eih

Shattered Minds#011.src: I am no gambling man, but the chips are down and it is time to play {~}-Pickup with the puzzle pieces, and I'll eat my bowtie if you aren't ready.
Shattered Minds#011.dst: 我不是個賭徒，但籌碼都推出去了，該來玩一場 {~} 片拼圖大搜羅了，你要是還沒準備好，我就把我的領結吃下去。
Shattered Minds#011.speaker: Professor Eih

Shattered Minds#012.src: The betting pool says the way to go is the opposite of in front, so that leaves someplace we can't talk about in front of the kids as your path!
Shattered Minds#012.dst: 賭盤說該走的方向是「前面」的相反，所以剩下的那個——當著孩子的面說不出口的那個——就是你的路！
Shattered Minds#012.speaker: Professor Eih

Shattered Minds#013.src: I will be around! Or asquare, as it were. Technically amultiplesquares, replete with alines! And abevels! And other some such things like-
Shattered Minds#013.dst: 我會在附近！或者說在附方，就字面而言。嚴格說是在附複數方，外加附直線！還有附斜角！以及諸如此類的東西比如——
Shattered Minds#013.speaker: Professor Eih

Shattered Minds#014.src: The punks scramble like eggs, and your skillet is sizzling! Certainly the heat in the kitchen is too much- so where is the fire extinguisher?
Shattered Minds#014.dst: 小混混們像蛋一樣散開，而你的平底鍋正滋滋作響！廚房裡顯然太熱了——所以滅火器在哪裡？
Shattered Minds#014.speaker: Professor Eih

Shattered Minds#015.src: It won't rocket you! The hole in the shape of a door looms out of your transparent grasp- frogs can't skip leg day, so be froggy! Bounce and jump!
Shattered Minds#015.dst: 它不會把你射上天！門形狀的那個洞，從你透明的掌握中隱隱浮現——青蛙可不會蹺掉腿部訓練，所以像青蛙一點！彈起來，跳！
Shattered Minds#015.speaker: Professor Eih

Shattered Minds#016.src: Swoosh and sprint! Speed and non-slip shoes! With a CLICK upon me I give you all but one, as much as you need!
Shattered Minds#016.dst: 咻一聲，衝刺！速度加防滑鞋！在我身上「喀」一下，我就把除了一樣以外的全部給你，你要多少有多少！
Shattered Minds#016.speaker: Professor Eih

Shattered Minds#017.src: The colors! Shimmering as a prism- oh, no one likes those things. The writing is on the wall, but the window mugs it for pocket change! The inhumanity!
Shattered Minds#017.dst: 那些顏色！像稜鏡一樣閃爍——噢，沒人喜歡那種東西。字都寫在牆上了，可是窗戶把它搶去換零錢！真是毫無人性！
Shattered Minds#017.speaker: Professor Eih

Shattered Minds#018.src: Use your eyes as ears and hear what I shall write! The cockpit is missing ground control and the cornfields all look the same in endless rows!
Shattered Minds#018.dst: 用你的眼睛當耳朵，聽我寫下的話！駕駛艙聯絡不上地面管制，而玉米田一排排望過去全都長一個樣！
Shattered Minds#018.speaker: Professor Eih

Shattered Minds#019.src: So Eih, esquire professor PhD, will provide the coordinates in helpfully non-literal fashion, and one's joystick shall lead the holder to bliss!
Shattered Minds#019.dst: 所以本人 Eih，教授閣下、博士，將以極其不字面的方式提供座標，而持有者的操縱桿將引領其人抵達極樂！
Shattered Minds#019.speaker: Professor Eih

Shattered Minds#020.src: At one's boots, the colors paint themselves towards an orientation. Above one's head, the lights match and fling you the same!
Shattered Minds#020.dst: 在你的靴子旁，顏色自行塗抹出一個方向。在你的頭頂上，那些燈光彼此相符，把你朝同一邊拋出去！
Shattered Minds#020.speaker: Professor Eih

Shattered Minds#021.src: I'm all out of airplane food, but the goal is more than peanuts- it's progress, just opposite our position. Fly well!
Shattered Minds#021.dst: 我的飛機餐發完了，但目標可不只是幾顆花生——是進展，就在我們位置的正對面。飛得順利！
Shattered Minds#021.speaker: Professor Eih

Shattered Minds#022.src: WOW. Just, WOW! Your brain being frazzled doesn't excuse this failure! Time is money and we're swimming in a river called DEBT!
Shattered Minds#022.dst: 哇。就是，哇！你的腦子被烤糊了也不能當作這次失敗的藉口！時間就是金錢，而我們正泡在一條叫「負債」的河裡！
Shattered Minds#022.speaker: Professor Eih

Shattered Minds#023.src: I'm just going to stand here and you're gonna go into the teleporters I'm NOT in, and you're gonna like it!
Shattered Minds#023.dst: 我就站在這裡不動，你呢，就走進那些沒有我在裡面的傳送門，而且你會喜歡的！
Shattered Minds#023.speaker: Professor Eih

Shattered Minds#024.src: Explore the strange forest to find Likeru.
Shattered Minds#024.dst: 探索那片奇異的森林，找到 Likeru。

Shattered Minds#025.src: Hey, look to your left for a moment.

Shattered Minds#026.src: I hope you've got a note pad with you, if you want me to teach you the ways of a master you'll need to write a lot down!
Shattered Minds#026.dst: 希望你身上帶了筆記本，你要我教你大師之道的話，得寫下很多東西！
Shattered Minds#026.speaker: Steve

Shattered Minds#027.src: It doesn't matter that we're on a {~}-match losing streak, we'll never give up!
Shattered Minds#027.dst: 我們連輸 {~} 場又怎樣，我們永遠不會放棄！
Shattered Minds#027.speaker: Erd

Shattered Minds#028.src: C'mon Beakmeister, we've ventured together for years now! Why won't you listen to me?
Shattered Minds#028.dst: 拜託啊 Beakmeister，我們一起冒險這麼多年了！你為什麼就是不聽我的？
Shattered Minds#028.speaker: Flamingo Rider

Shattered Minds#029.src: I don't think she's even listening to me anymore. She's a free spirit!
Shattered Minds#029.dst: 我覺得她根本已經不聽我說話了。她是個自由的靈魂！
Shattered Minds#029.speaker: Flamingo Rider

Shattered Minds#030.src: Familiar to the nursing home, with no IV in sight! Phenomenal, and now my gambling metaphors will be apropos!
Shattered Minds#030.dst: 對療養院來說很熟悉，卻連一根點滴都看不到！了不起，這下我的賭博比喻就用得恰到好處了！
Shattered Minds#030.speaker: Professor Eih

Shattered Minds#031.src: A solid, {~} pure, statue-made-out-of-tons-of-things what looks like me! I call it, “Ill Of The Ooze, Young!” And it begets your path amongst the lilypads.
Shattered Minds#031.dst: 一尊結結實實、{~} 純度、用一噸東西堆出來、長得像我的雕像！我管它叫「黏液之病，年輕人！」而它引出了你在睡蓮之間的路。
Shattered Minds#031.speaker: Professor Eih

Shattered Minds#032.src: Likeru? No, no, she can’t find you here- her eyes deceive her. But I won't! Not any more than the film reel degrades, and the theater is ahead!
Shattered Minds#032.dst: Likeru？不不，她在這裡找不到你——她的眼睛在騙她。但我不會！絕不會比膠卷褪色得更多，而戲院就在前方！
Shattered Minds#032.speaker: Professor Eih

Shattered Minds#033.src: Now, don't tell the kids about this one either! The way forward is through my masterpiece- but I can't imagine a gullet glorious!
Shattered Minds#033.dst: 好了，這一個也別跟孩子們說！前進的路要穿過我的傑作——但我實在想像不出一根光榮的食道！
Shattered Minds#033.speaker: Professor Eih

Shattered Minds#034.src: Enter the giant frog and escape.
Shattered Minds#034.dst: 進入那隻巨大的青蛙，然後逃出來。

Shattered Minds#035.src: Don't come any closer... I don't want to have to fight...
Shattered Minds#035.dst: 別再靠近了……我不想動手……

Shattered Minds#036.src: I-I'm warning you. You'll stand no match against me...
Shattered Minds#036.dst: 我、我警告你。你根本不是我的對手……

Shattered Minds#038.src: There we are! Snapped out of it! Though perhaps writing in the mud was better- Soon it will dry.
Shattered Minds#038.dst: 這就對了！清醒過來了！不過也許寫在泥巴上還比較好——它很快就會乾。
Shattered Minds#038.speaker: Professor Eih

Shattered Minds#039.src: Without the static of the fungal caps, the radio station will be off-air- and the device unplugged!
Shattered Minds#039.dst: 沒了那些菌帽的雜訊，電台就會停播——而那台裝置就會被拔掉插頭！
Shattered Minds#039.speaker: Professor Eih

Shattered Minds#040.src: Scratch it in your eyelids- the lightbulb screwed between the arches, and the feather-duster's sunset shades will reveal my deepest compatriot. Quick now, wake!
Shattered Minds#040.dst: 把它刻進你的眼皮裡——旋在拱門之間的那顆燈泡，還有雞毛撢子的夕陽色，會顯露出我最深處的同伴。快，醒來！
Shattered Minds#040.speaker: Professor Eih

Shattered Minds#041.src: Ugh. Rats chewing the roots. They've their place, it simply isn't here. Neither is your place in the koi pond, stranger.
Shattered Minds#041.dst: 唉。老鼠在啃樹根。牠們有牠們的位置，只是不在這裡。就像你的位置也不在這座錦鯉池裡，陌生人。
Shattered Minds#041.speaker: Elder Berusia

Shattered Minds#042.src: I believe Likeru tossed you into the deep end without meaning, so to speak. I understand your being overwhelmed, but still...
Shattered Minds#042.dst: 我相信 Likeru 是無心地把你扔進了深水區，姑且這麼說。我理解你會不知所措，但話說回來……
Shattered Minds#042.speaker: Elder Berusia

Shattered Minds#043.src: Speaking of which, it might behoove you to let her know you've recovered. Though, should you need rest, you may take it here.
Shattered Minds#043.dst: 說到這個，讓她知道你恢復了或許對你有好處。不過，你要是需要休息，可以在這裡休息。
Shattered Minds#043.speaker: Elder Berusia

Shattered Minds#045.src: Ehm. Okay, that was...a bad idea. Should NOT have done that with a human. Uh, noted for the futu- oh, you're actually alright?!
Shattered Minds#045.dst: 呃。好吧，那真是……一個爛主意。絕對不該拿人類來做這個。呃，記下來以備將——噢，你其實沒事？！
Shattered Minds#045.speaker: Likeru

Shattered Minds#046.src: You came back and just leapt into the koi pond! I thought you'd drowned down there!
Shattered Minds#046.dst: 你回來之後直接跳進錦鯉池！我還以為你已經淹死在下面了！
Shattered Minds#046.speaker: Likeru

Shattered Minds#047.src: I guess the spores from the Bluecaps got to you before you could bring them back. I wonder what you saw?
Shattered Minds#047.dst: 我猜是藍帽菇的孢子在你把它們帶回來之前就先找上你了。真好奇你看到了什麼？
Shattered Minds#047.speaker: Likeru

Shattered Minds#048.src: You reacted like you were crazy when I tried to talk with you... You were supposed to get visions of the light! A deep connection!
Shattered Minds#048.dst: 我試著跟你說話的時候，你的反應像個瘋子……你本來應該看見光的異象！一種深刻的連結！
Shattered Minds#048.speaker: Likeru

Shattered Minds#049.src: Wait, maybe it's cause of that portal...the signals got mixed? I'll have to look into this more...but hey, I got the Bluecap, anyways, so...
Shattered Minds#049.dst: 等等，說不定是那道傳送門的關係……訊號混在一起了？我得再研究研究……不過欸，反正藍帽菇我拿到了，所以……
Shattered Minds#049.speaker: Likeru

Shattered Minds#050.src: Here, your payment- and a little extra I whipped up too. Um, really sorry about all that!
Shattered Minds#050.dst: 來，這是你的報酬——還有我順手做的一點額外的東西。嗯，那整件事真的很抱歉！
Shattered Minds#050.speaker: Likeru

Shrouded in Mist#000.src: Group up with the remaining members at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Shrouded in Mist#005.src: About what? What could you possibly be thinking about right-
Shrouded in Mist#005.speaker: Yusanu

Shrouded in Mist#006.src: I don't know, Yusanu! Maybe about what to do next? How we can- h-how we-
Shrouded in Mist#006.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#007.src: There's nothing we can do! We're stuck in unfamiliar territory, all lone, our family and friends all captured, or- or worse-
Shrouded in Mist#007.speaker: Yusanu

Shrouded in Mist#009.src: Urgh! I can't believe I let her convince me stealing this... this thing was worth it! If I hadn't, then... then our agreement wouldn't have fallen through, and none of this would have-
Shrouded in Mist#009.speaker: Yusanu

Shrouded in Mist#010.src: Don't you dare pin this on Rex. You heard what that Sovereign said, they- th-they knew what we were planning for ages!
Shrouded in Mist#010.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#011.src: ...then maybe it'd have been best if you left us out of it.
Shrouded in Mist#011.speaker: Yusanu

Shrouded in Mist#016.src: Woah woah woah woah woah! Alright, let's all take a step back, shall we?

Shrouded in Mist#017.src: Owls! Step down! Bit of a leap, jumping straight to violence- we reserve that for the obviously crown-aligned, eheheh.

Shrouded in Mist#018.src: Allow me to introduce myself! The name's Rurie, member of the Canopy, captain of the Owls division! Apologies for the roughhousing, seems everyone's a little enthusiastic today, eh?
Shrouded in Mist#018.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#020.src: Questions, questions! I'm afraid it's our turn first- I've called the owls off for a time, but don't think you're off the hook just yet, young lady!
Shrouded in Mist#020.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#021.src: ...captain, are you certain about this? For all we know, they could be spies-
Shrouded in Mist#021.speaker: Owl Fighter

Shrouded in Mist#022.src: Ah ah ah! Trust in the process, my friend. Spies or not, information is valuable.
Shrouded in Mist#022.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#023.src: Besides! We know how to... ah, deal with spies, as it were. Risk factor is minimal!
Shrouded in Mist#023.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#024.src: So... what, are you also resisting-
Shrouded in Mist#024.speaker: Yusanu

Shrouded in Mist#025.src: Hold it there, mister! Didn't you hear me? We'll be asking the questions here first.
Shrouded in Mist#025.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#026.src: Seems you're the only one who hasn't spoken yet! Well now, don't be shy. Tell me - where are you lot from?
Shrouded in Mist#026.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#027.src: Really? Quite far afield, aren't you? Finding your way from there to here is quite an endeavor.
Shrouded in Mist#027.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#028.src: Ahhh! Now the pieces are clicking together! I think I get it now.
Shrouded in Mist#028.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#029.src: Ohoho? Really now? How very, very curious. You're either a verrrry clever spy, or...
Shrouded in Mist#029.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#030.src: H... hey! Listen! I don't know who, or, or what you guys are, but--
Shrouded in Mist#030.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#031.src: How many times must I repeat myself? I said no que-
Shrouded in Mist#031.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#032.src: Shut UP! We just BARELY escaped {p} after we- after we tried to KILL the Queen! The rest of our friends are... captured, or d- dead!
Shrouded in Mist#032.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#033.src: So- so either leave us alone, or I'll- I'll make sure you never see your loved ones a- again!
Shrouded in Mist#033.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#036.src: Ohoho, she's sure got some temper, huh?
Shrouded in Mist#036.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#037.src: Rurie... her story could explain what-
Shrouded in Mist#037.speaker: Owl Fighter

Shrouded in Mist#038.src: Yes, my friend, I was just thinking the very same thing. Well well, new folk, if what you're saying is true, the Canopy might just be able to assist!
Shrouded in Mist#038.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#039.src: I may have information regarding your allies.
Shrouded in Mist#039.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#041.src: Ah- but! But but but, see- trust is a currency here in the {p}. I can't just spill all my secrets at once, can I?
Shrouded in Mist#041.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#042.src: And if you'd like to earn our trust... I'll need you to, ah, deal with some things for me.
Shrouded in Mist#042.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#044.src: Oh, nothing too difficult... I'll tell you on one condition! I'll be taking one of you with me as leverage! Eenie, meenie, money... you, little man!
Shrouded in Mist#044.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#046.src: You, indeed! Worry not, for I'll be sure to keep you safe, but... well, you understand the need, yes?
Shrouded in Mist#046.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#047.src: We can't! We can't lose... we can't lose anyone else. Please, there has to be something-
Shrouded in Mist#047.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#048.src: Sui... it's... fine. I don't think we have a choice. Just... do what they ask of you.
Shrouded in Mist#048.speaker: Yusanu

Shrouded in Mist#050.src: Goodness, so melodramatic! Come on, I'm a trustworthy fella! You've got nothing to worry about from me.
Shrouded in Mist#050.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#052.src: Ah-mazing! I'm glad you chose to be reasonable. In that case - I'll need the remaining two of you to go and sabotage three military structures.
Shrouded in Mist#052.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#053.src: Now, go and say your goodbyes, then come grab the list from me!
Shrouded in Mist#053.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#054.src: Talk to Rurie before heading out at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Shrouded in Mist#055.src: Hey. You'll be fine. I'll be fine.
Shrouded in Mist#055.speaker: Yusanu

Shrouded in Mist#056.src: I think we can trust them for now, at least. Not like we have an alternative...
Shrouded in Mist#056.speaker: Yusanu

Shrouded in Mist#058.src: We really... don't have a choice, do we? We, we need their support.
Shrouded in Mist#058.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#059.src: I just... hope Yusanu will be safe.
Shrouded in Mist#059.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#060.src: Ugh... Captain's being reckless as usual...
Shrouded in Mist#060.speaker: Owl Fighter

Shrouded in Mist#061.src: Have we finished with the heartfelt goodbyes? Excellent. Truly, I am glad you took me up on this generous offer.
Shrouded in Mist#061.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#062.src: Don't worry about your little friend over there! He'll be safe and sound amongst our Canopy.
Shrouded in Mist#062.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#063.src: ...and how can we trust you? To not... hurt him?
Shrouded in Mist#063.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#064.src: Ah, isn't that the issue at the heart of it all? You can't. But as I said, trust is valuable in these woods. That must go both ways!
Shrouded in Mist#064.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#065.src: Well, newbies! You've a list of the structures I need you to sabotage, so it really should be a simple task.
Shrouded in Mist#065.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#066.src: Just find a way to... disable them! However you manage it, I can't say I really care - so long as it gets done!
Shrouded in Mist#066.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#068.src: Why, because it's a golden opportunity! The work needs doing, and you need a way to prove yourselves...
Shrouded in Mist#068.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#069.src: So why not? It's less work for me to do, so I'm not complaining!
Shrouded in Mist#069.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#070.src: Newbies! That's what you are, isn't it? New to the woods, new to the world...
Shrouded in Mist#070.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#071.src: ...maybe new to Fruma, even? Ah ah, wipe that expression of shock off your face! I won't tell if you don't either.
Shrouded in Mist#071.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#073.src: Once you're done, find me back here! Just don't take too long, eh? Wouldn't want to get bored!
Shrouded in Mist#073.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#074.src: Ta ta, newbies! Good luck out there! And just a word of advice - stay on your guard. You never know what the mists may be hiding.
Shrouded in Mist#074.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#075.src: Select the structure to sabotage using the checklist.

Shrouded in Mist#076.src: Still a bit lost? Just use your taskbook to find the things I need broken!
Shrouded in Mist#076.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#077.src: Head to the watchtower at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] and sabotage it using a spell.

Shrouded in Mist#078.src: So is this... the place? "Military... Watchtower..." I guess so.
Shrouded in Mist#078.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#079.src: Those supports look rather unstable, don't they? I wonder...
Shrouded in Mist#079.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#080.src: C-can you deal with them, please?
Shrouded in Mist#080.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#081.src: Huh?! We're under attack - it must be the Canopy!
Shrouded in Mist#081.speaker: Watchtower Guard

Shrouded in Mist#083.src: Let's just get this over with.
Shrouded in Mist#083.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#085.src: Check the book, where should we go next?
Shrouded in Mist#085.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#087.src: Head to the water pump at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] and sabotage it.

Shrouded in Mist#089.src: I think we can work together for this one. Go, um, blast some weak spots on the structure, and I'll... see if I can reverse the water flow.
Shrouded in Mist#089.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#090.src: Let's just... get rid of this hunk of junk.
Shrouded in Mist#090.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#091.src: You, um, should try to blast some of the weak points with your magic.
Shrouded in Mist#091.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#092.src: Did you manage to apply some pressure on the pipes?
Shrouded in Mist#092.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#093.src: Good, then it's... time for my part, I guess. Um, come talk to me when you're ready.
Shrouded in Mist#093.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#095.src: Okay... okay. Breathe. I need to... focus.
Shrouded in Mist#095.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#096.src: After... after, um, everything that- that's happened, I've been... struggling with my cur-... ugh. You get what I mean.
Shrouded in Mist#096.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#097.src: It all feels so... so... hopeless! We've lost everyone, and now- now we've lost Yusanu too, and I... I couldn't do anything!
Shrouded in Mist#097.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#098.src: And the last thing we did before was... argue! And now, he's... he's safe, probably, but... I don't know. I wish we hadn't.
Shrouded in Mist#098.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#099.src: Every time I think about- about any of it, I get so... angry! And the swirling ocean around me starts raging more and more and more, and... and...
Shrouded in Mist#099.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#100.src: I'm scared, {u}. I'm scared for Mora... Syndra... Rex, Zeph, the whole Steel Feather- for all of them! And I... there's nothing I can do...
Shrouded in Mist#100.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#101.src: What if... what if they're all gone? And, and, and it's just us, forever...?
Shrouded in Mist#101.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#102.src: I... I know, {u}, I know! I'm... I'm trying, okay?!
Shrouded in Mist#102.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#105.src: I don't know if I, ha, have any left. Everything's... moving so fast...
Shrouded in Mist#105.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#106.src: I... I never wanted any of this. I just... I just wanted to live...
Shrouded in Mist#106.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#107.src: Sigh... okay. Sui, focus. You can do this.
Shrouded in Mist#107.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#109.src: That's... I don't... how did I...
Shrouded in Mist#109.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#110.src: It... the ocean, it... stopped. I pulled at it, and it... it stopped moving, and...
Shrouded in Mist#110.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#111.src: There's... there's no time to, to think about it. It worked, so... so that's good.
Shrouded in Mist#111.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#112.src: Just... check the book, what's our next stop?
Shrouded in Mist#112.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#113.src: I... I think that was the last one. Let's go tell Rurie that it's, um, done.
Shrouded in Mist#113.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#114.src: Head to the mining drill at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Shrouded in Mist#116.src: It looks... durable. Like, um, it'll be hard to just... break. We need to find another way...
Shrouded in Mist#116.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#117.src: There- there isn't any water nearby. So, so if any soldiers show up... please, can you deal with them?
Shrouded in Mist#117.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#118.src: Aha, saboteurs! You won't get away with damaging the crown's property, not on my watch!
Shrouded in Mist#118.speaker: Mistwoods Captain

Shrouded in Mist#119.src: Um... good job, {u}. I didn't think about breaking the controls...
Shrouded in Mist#119.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#120.src: We should check the book, and find our next stop.
Shrouded in Mist#120.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#121.src: Was that the last one? Let's head back to Rurie and... and tell him it's done.
Shrouded in Mist#121.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#122.src: Return to Rurie at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] and discuss the next step.

Shrouded in Mist#123.src: Well well! So the newbies return! Tell me, how did you find your trial?
Shrouded in Mist#123.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#124.src: We did what you asked, so... so tell us about our friends, already!
Shrouded in Mist#124.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#125.src: Ah ah ah! Not so fast! I'm afraid you're not done quite yet!
Shrouded in Mist#125.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#127.src: Deadly serious, I fear! That, dear friends, was but the first part of your task.
Shrouded in Mist#127.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#128.src: Oh, but on the contrary! I received word immediately once you had done the deed.
Shrouded in Mist#128.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#129.src: Ugh... we had an agreement! You can't just-
Shrouded in Mist#129.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#130.src: But I can. If you want our support, you'll do what we ask. If it is any consolation, this is the last I will ask of you before our deal is concluded.
Shrouded in Mist#130.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#132.src: I would ask of you to kindly... ehm, transport an {p} citizen here. Do make sure you aren't spotted by anyone else! That could cause... issues.
Shrouded in Mist#132.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#134.src: Ah! Allow me to rephrase. You need to kidnap them.
Shrouded in Mist#134.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#136.src: Yes, indeed! Kidnap them, bring them here, and we will deal with the rest.
Shrouded in Mist#136.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#137.src: You want us to just... just snatch a random citizen from their home? And, and what do you mean "deal with the rest?"
Shrouded in Mist#137.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#138.src: No questions, young lady! Not if you'd like to ensure the safety of your friend, that is.
Shrouded in Mist#138.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#140.src: You didn't even tell us who we're looking for!
Shrouded in Mist#140.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#141.src: Ahaha, apologies, my mistake! You'll be looking for the man named Nisen. Bring him here, but don't take too long!
Shrouded in Mist#141.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#142.src: Nisen. Fine. {u}, let's... talk about this outside the cave.
Shrouded in Mist#142.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#143.src: Leave the cave and discuss the plan with Sui at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Shrouded in Mist#145.src: This... this is just getting ridiculous.
Shrouded in Mist#145.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#146.src: We, we need to find a way to get Yusanu back, and... and get out of here.
Shrouded in Mist#146.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#147.src: I know, I know, I know! And if we start looking, they'll, they'll notice.
Shrouded in Mist#147.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#148.src: I'm... sick and tired of following that clown's orders. But you're right...
Shrouded in Mist#148.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#149.src: It's just... weird. This last task. I don't get it.
Shrouded in Mist#149.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#150.src: Even if Rurie's out of his mind... I don't see him just- just killing an innocent person. Especially if they're, um, a resistance group.
Shrouded in Mist#150.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#151.src: Ugh. I don't know. Maybe if we investigate this Nisen person, we'll... figure out Rurie's reasoning.
Shrouded in Mist#151.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#153.src: Head to {p} at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] and locate Nisen.

Shrouded in Mist#155.src: Phew. Getting up here really wasn't the easiest... the Red Fox back in Auburn really, ha, pales in comparison.
Shrouded in Mist#155.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#156.src: I've been trying to get information on Nisen, but... people don't seem to like me much.
Shrouded in Mist#156.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#157.src: Maybe you'll have some better luck?
Shrouded in Mist#157.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#172.src: ...I don't...see it. You haven't got one Er. I. I mean. Nothing. No. Definitely, uh...definitely not.
Shrouded in Mist#172.speaker: Jamie

Shrouded in Mist#173.src: I can't look, I'm really not supposed to be talking to you at all, and Wait, that counts as urgh!
Shrouded in Mist#173.speaker: Jamie

Shrouded in Mist#174.src: ...I'm. I. You. ...ugh, I'm no good at this.
Shrouded in Mist#174.speaker: Jamie

Shrouded in Mist#175.src: ...well. ...sorry. Nisen... I. I do know. I shouldn't be telling you, but I do know. Please don't hurt me.
Shrouded in Mist#175.speaker: Jamie

Shrouded in Mist#176.src: You need to take the zipline north-west. Not the one that goes upwards, though.
Shrouded in Mist#176.speaker: Jamie

Shrouded in Mist#180.src: Search Nisen's house for any [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] clues regarding him.

Shrouded in Mist#181.src: Um, let's hope he's not home...
Shrouded in Mist#181.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#182.src: That's odd... the latest entry's dated from weeks ago.
Shrouded in Mist#182.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#183.src: It's like they stopped writing them abruptly...
Shrouded in Mist#183.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#186.src: Eep! That must be Nisen! We need to think of an excuse...
Shrouded in Mist#186.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#187.src: Excuse me? What are you doing in my abode?
Shrouded in Mist#187.speaker: Nisen

Shrouded in Mist#188.src: If I am not mistaken, stumbling into other people's abodes is not a custom.
Shrouded in Mist#188.speaker: Nisen

Shrouded in Mist#189.src: Oh... I- I'm so sorry! I- I- we- we thought this was the... bakery.
Shrouded in Mist#189.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#191.src: Oh. Yes, wrong building. The bakery is down at ground level.
Shrouded in Mist#191.speaker: Nisen

Shrouded in Mist#192.src: Oh! Thank you for the directions. We are... so sorry for the misunderstanding.
Shrouded in Mist#192.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#193.src: Regroup with Sui at the main square at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Shrouded in Mist#195.src: That was close... I'm, um, surprised he believed us.
Shrouded in Mist#195.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#196.src: I- I panicked, okay! But it worked, didn't it?
Shrouded in Mist#196.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#197.src: He was... surprisingly chatty. That's a nice change compared to everyone else.
Shrouded in Mist#197.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#198.src: Though, um, he was a bit... odd. He didn't seem too certain about his answers...
Shrouded in Mist#198.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#199.src: I don't know. What are you thinking? Any theories?
Shrouded in Mist#199.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#200.src: I... was thinking the same thing. It'd explain the diary entries stopping abruptly...
Shrouded in Mist#200.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#201.src: Maybe... I guess he could be. I might just be jumping to conclusions.
Shrouded in Mist#201.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#202.src: Uh... let's workshop that one a little.
Shrouded in Mist#202.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#203.src: Look, I managed to snag a schedule off his bedside table.
Shrouded in Mist#203.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#204.src: Listen to this. "Deliver hunting tools from weaponsmith through southern exit at noon."
Shrouded in Mist#204.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#205.src: It's weird, right? Something's definitely off with him... but still, kidnapping him and handing him off to some... some random bird-man! I don't like it.
Shrouded in Mist#205.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#206.src: But... we don't have much of a choice. Let's camp outside the southern gate and wait...
Shrouded in Mist#206.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#209.src: Guess we'll just have to wait...
Shrouded in Mist#209.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#211.src: I... ha, I've been feeling really out of my depth, here. I've never had to do this much without... um, without their support.
Shrouded in Mist#211.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#212.src: But... you're here to help, so. Um. Thanks for- for sticking with me. I... I don't think I'd have made it this far without you.
Shrouded in Mist#212.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#216.src: Um... I think it worked, though. Can you help me?
Shrouded in Mist#216.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#218.src: That was... easier than I expected it to be.
Shrouded in Mist#218.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#219.src: I kind of just, um, landed on top of him? And... and here we are.
Shrouded in Mist#219.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#220.src: We should... probably get moving. I don't want anyone to- to see us!
Shrouded in Mist#220.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#221.src: Um! Control is... maybe not the right word. I... ha, I tried to freeze him. So... still working on it. I guess.
Shrouded in Mist#221.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#222.src: ......how are we going to move him?
Shrouded in Mist#222.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#223.src: Um! I... didn't think about that.
Shrouded in Mist#223.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#224.src: Well well, newbies! Looks like you could use a hand!
Shrouded in Mist#224.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#225.src: Aah! Wh- where did you come from?!
Shrouded in Mist#225.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#226.src: Why, from the trees, of course! I see you've managed to subdue the good mister Nisen over here, well done, well done.
Shrouded in Mist#226.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#227.src: ...we've done everything you've asked for. Now- now tell us what you know!!
Shrouded in Mist#227.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#228.src: Oh, dear, you thought you two were done? Ha! Ahahaha!
Shrouded in Mist#228.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#230.src: Kidding! Kidding, kidding- goodness, the looks on your faces! What's a little practical joke between friends, eh?
Shrouded in Mist#230.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#231.src: Fine! Fine, fine, I get it! Jeez, lady...
Shrouded in Mist#231.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#232.src: I'll cut it with the jokes... for now. Good news! You've passed the test!
Shrouded in Mist#232.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#234.src: Yes, yes, settle down, I will tell you. Give me a moment! Goodness. You're an impatient one, aren't you?
Shrouded in Mist#234.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#235.src: I'll be bringing you two to the Canopy! But, ah, one little precaution- I'll have to blindfold you till we arrive, Just a security measure!
Shrouded in Mist#235.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#236.src: Ugh... you know what, I don't even care anymore. Just... bring us to Yusanu.
Shrouded in Mist#236.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#238.src: Ugh! Fine fine fine! But hurry up.
Shrouded in Mist#238.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#239.src: Rurie, care to explain yourself? Why did you bring these outsiders here?
Shrouded in Mist#239.speaker: Fuhue

Shrouded in Mist#241.src: Ah, you know how it is, Fuhue! I was oh so bored on patrol this morning! You lot aren't exactly the life of the party..
Shrouded in Mist#241.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#242.src: You know Azael has clear rules on recruiting. Did you file the necessary paperwork? Because I didn't see anything on my desk regarding this.
Shrouded in Mist#242.speaker: Fuhue

Shrouded in Mist#243.src: The... ah, the paperwork was real? I always thought it was something you were making up for the fun of it.
Shrouded in Mist#243.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#244.src: No. We have the protocols in place for a reason, Captain Rurie. Will you find the time to review them yourself, or must I have Captain Cileon run you through them?
Shrouded in Mist#244.speaker: Fuhue

Shrouded in Mist#245.src: Yes, yes, I understand the importance- though, I believe Cileon shares my views on the protocols. Isn't that right, Cileon?
Shrouded in Mist#245.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#247.src: H- hey! Don't just act like, like we aren't right here!
Shrouded in Mist#247.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#248.src: Cileon! That is also against our protocols. We wouldn't want to leave a body for the crown to find, we have far simpler forms of disposal.
Shrouded in Mist#248.speaker: Fuhue

Shrouded in Mist#249.src: And of course, we need to torture any necessary information out of them first - I have heard this a dozen times over.
Shrouded in Mist#249.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#250.src: Ah! You were listening! Good, Captain Rurie. We'll knock some sense into you yet.
Shrouded in Mist#250.speaker: Fuhue

Shrouded in Mist#251.src: I did have some deerlings bring Nisen into our processing room earlier. Thank you for your service, Captain.
Shrouded in Mist#251.speaker: Fuhue

Shrouded in Mist#252.src: Ah, no problem! Hardly even broke a sweat!
Shrouded in Mist#252.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#253.src: Well, I'll be catching up with you later! I suppose if we're following protocols, I'll need to hand these kids off to Azael.
Shrouded in Mist#253.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#254.src: Hey hey, friends! I'm a bit thirsty, so I'll be leaving you now! Think you'll manage to find Azael yourselves?
Shrouded in Mist#254.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#255.src: Find the leader inside the Canopy at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Shrouded in Mist#256.src: Hm. Rurie told you to find Azael.
Shrouded in Mist#256.speaker: Cileon

Shrouded in Mist#265.src: The schedule's always so busy... and now I have even more to deal with.
Shrouded in Mist#265.speaker: Fuhue

Shrouded in Mist#266.src: But I suppose I can squeeze you in for questions.
Shrouded in Mist#266.speaker: Fuhue

Shrouded in Mist#267.src: I am Fuhue, Team Captain of the Deer clan.
Shrouded in Mist#267.speaker: Fuhue

Shrouded in Mist#268.src: I also function as the overall manager of the Canopy, not just the Deer operations.
Shrouded in Mist#268.speaker: Fuhue

Shrouded in Mist#269.src: Master Azael can be found in his hut... it's just to the south-west of here.
Shrouded in Mist#269.speaker: Fuhue

Shrouded in Mist#270.src: From what I've heard, your friend is over there as well.
Shrouded in Mist#270.speaker: Fuhue

Shrouded in Mist#271.src: I'm afraid so. Insufferable as always...
Shrouded in Mist#271.speaker: Fuhue

Shrouded in Mist#272.src: But he's incredibly talented at what he does. No one else could run the Owls like he does.
Shrouded in Mist#272.speaker: Fuhue

Shrouded in Mist#274.src: Or not! It's Master Azael's decision as to whether you stay or not. Just hope you manage to impress him.
Shrouded in Mist#274.speaker: Fuhue

Shrouded in Mist#275.src: I have heard about your adventures in the {p} thus far. Very impressive work.
Shrouded in Mist#275.speaker: Azael

Shrouded in Mist#276.src: Not to interrupt you, but we've been running around all day, and I'm tired. Where's Yusanu?
Shrouded in Mist#276.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#279.src: Oh, you're okay... I'm so glad.
Shrouded in Mist#279.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#280.src: Yes, reunited at last. But now that you are here, it is time for business.
Shrouded in Mist#280.speaker: Azael

Shrouded in Mist#281.src: I had Yusanu inform me of your adventures in the {p}.
Shrouded in Mist#281.speaker: Azael

Shrouded in Mist#282.src: And it would appear our causes are in alignment... to dismantle the crown. We here in the Canopy have taken a very active approach to this end.
Shrouded in Mist#282.speaker: Azael

Shrouded in Mist#283.src: We had established three teams, each with their own responsibility. Each team attacks the crown on different fronts.
Shrouded in Mist#283.speaker: Azael

Shrouded in Mist#284.src: The Owls are our eyes and ears. They are also our most efficient assassins. Captain Rurie, who you have already had the pleasure of meeting, is one of our most lethal members.
Shrouded in Mist#284.speaker: Azael

Shrouded in Mist#285.src: The Foxes are our assault team. They are skilled swordsmen utilizing techniques native to the {p}. They are trained to never lose a duel.
Shrouded in Mist#285.speaker: Azael

Shrouded in Mist#286.src: The Deers are our command team, the brains behind the operation. They are also responsible for... taking care of spies within {p}.
Shrouded in Mist#286.speaker: Azael

Shrouded in Mist#288.src: Spies. That man you brought in, Nisen... I fear that is no longer Nisen. Weeks ago, he had been replaced by one of the crown's elite spies. We know them as Changelings.
Shrouded in Mist#288.speaker: Azael

Shrouded in Mist#289.src: The {p} have been plagued for years by these masterful creatures of disguise. Whenever one is recognized, we capture them and hold them for questioning.
Shrouded in Mist#289.speaker: Azael

Shrouded in Mist#290.src: The people of our region have developed a form of identification, the medallions. If you do not possess one, many will refuse to speak with you.
Shrouded in Mist#290.speaker: Azael

Shrouded in Mist#291.src: Um... Azael, sir, I don't mean to come off as rude, but... Rurie told us there were news on our friends from the Roughworks.
Shrouded in Mist#291.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#292.src: In a sense, there are. However, we still are processing the information the Owls have returned with from the festival. I cannot offer anything just yet.
Shrouded in Mist#292.speaker: Azael

Shrouded in Mist#293.src: Rest assured, we will not withhold anything once we have gone through everything.
Shrouded in Mist#293.speaker: Azael

Shrouded in Mist#294.src: I give you my word that we will continue searching for any word of your friends.
Shrouded in Mist#294.speaker: Azael

Shrouded in Mist#295.src: It... it finally feels like we have a second to breath.
Shrouded in Mist#295.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#296.src: I'll stay with Yusanu and wait for them to sort through the information.
Shrouded in Mist#296.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#297.src: I'm going to focus on figuring out what this device is used for.
Shrouded in Mist#297.speaker: Yusanu

Shrouded in Mist#298.src: It must have be worth stealing it... somehow.
Shrouded in Mist#298.speaker: Sui

Solidarity of Steel#000.src: Regroup with your friends outside {p} at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Solidarity of Steel#001.src: ...that's everyone, then. Good. Good, you're all safe. I wasn't certain, after...
Solidarity of Steel#001.speaker: Syndra

Solidarity of Steel#002.src: Are you just going to ignore what happened back there?
Solidarity of Steel#002.speaker: Rex

Solidarity of Steel#004.src: Zhiraok's blessing... it gives him the power to revive himself. It takes some time, though.
Solidarity of Steel#004.speaker: Syndra

Solidarity of Steel#005.src: If we wanted any chance to get away, I had to- I had to kill him.
Solidarity of Steel#005.speaker: Syndra

Solidarity of Steel#006.src: Well, in any case, we're all here! We'll be meeting with my contact soon, after which we'll certainly be safe, but...
Solidarity of Steel#006.speaker: Syndra

Solidarity of Steel#008.src: We have some time to spare. You've had a few days to acclimate to the Roughworks - any thoughts?
Solidarity of Steel#008.speaker: Syndra

Solidarity of Steel#009.src: It is, isn't it? It's much busier, less open, and yet... it carries a certain nostalgia for me.
Solidarity of Steel#009.speaker: Syndra

Solidarity of Steel#010.src: Nostalgic? This place, really? What's so nostalgic about loud factories and urban sprawl?
Solidarity of Steel#010.speaker: Rex

Solidarity of Steel#012.src: Well, I'm with Rex on th- this- this one! I wouldn't want to s- st- stay here for long, it's s- so... smoggy.
Solidarity of Steel#012.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#013.src: Certainly, it is not as... clean, I suppose, as the {p}. The smell of the morning dew shall be sorely missed!
Solidarity of Steel#013.speaker: Mora

Solidarity of Steel#014.src: Alright, children, get it out of your system. Please refrain from speaking poorly of the Roughworks once we meet with my contact... I'd like to make a good first impression.
Solidarity of Steel#014.speaker: Syndra

Solidarity of Steel#015.src: Oh, you wouldn't think so if you actually had to live here.
Solidarity of Steel#015.speaker: Rex

Solidarity of Steel#017.src: What?! Most of them would agree with me!
Solidarity of Steel#017.speaker: Rex

Solidarity of Steel#018.src: I think I'm with Rex on this- this one! I can't im-imagine- imagine living here, it's s- so... smoggy.
Solidarity of Steel#018.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#019.src: Certainly, it is not as... clean, I suppose, as the {p}. The smell of the morning dew shall be sorely missed!
Solidarity of Steel#019.speaker: Mora

Solidarity of Steel#020.src: Alright, children, get it out of your system. Please refrain from speaking poorly of the Roughworks once we meet with my contact... no matter how much they may or may not agree.
Solidarity of Steel#020.speaker: Syndra

Solidarity of Steel#021.src: In any case, I was told to meet them in the city at noon - {p} is usually empty during the daytime.
Solidarity of Steel#021.speaker: Syndra

Solidarity of Steel#022.src: What? It's empty during the day? Th- that doesn't make a lot of sense.
Solidarity of Steel#022.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#023.src: I'm afraid the lives of the citizens of the Roughworks revolve entirely around their work. The work day starts at sunrise, and ends with sunset. So, let's just wait...
Solidarity of Steel#023.speaker: Syndra

Solidarity of Steel#025.src: Maybe they, um, just read time differently, here...? Or maybe we-
Solidarity of Steel#025.speaker: Sui

Solidarity of Steel#027.src: Hello, Quill. It's been a while since we've met face to face, hasn't it?
Solidarity of Steel#027.speaker: Syndra

Solidarity of Steel#028.src: Indeed, indeed... I hope your journey to cross to the Roughworks wasn't too difficult.
Solidarity of Steel#028.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#029.src: Could have been better, could have been worse. We expected difficulties going in.
Solidarity of Steel#029.speaker: Syndra

Solidarity of Steel#030.src: I see... You'll have to tell me more later. Now, which of you is the cursed one? I'd like a look at you.
Solidarity of Steel#030.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#031.src: Mmhm! So you're the one, eh? What I'd heard in correspondence had me thinking you'd be different than us. Seems like I was right!
Solidarity of Steel#031.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#032.src: There's a look in your eyes, something to your gait. In all my years I've seen quite a lot, and everything that shouts "promise" is there in you.
Solidarity of Steel#032.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#033.src: Ha! Yes, yes, I suppose that would be the correct response to that question. You'd do well to stick to that script.
Solidarity of Steel#033.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#034.src: But Syndra has already written much about you in our correspondence. No need to be shy.
Solidarity of Steel#034.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#035.src: Blessed, cursed... They're two sides of the same coin, in my eyes. I've seen my fair share of both in my time leading this group, heh heh...
Solidarity of Steel#035.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#036.src: I see no reason not to celebrate differences, and what better difference could there be?
Solidarity of Steel#036.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#037.src: ... Ah, we'll have more time to speak later. We'd best make our way down to the station, we can sort out arrangements there-
Solidarity of Steel#037.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#038.src: Hey, hey! We're leaving before we even get our introductions in? Why'd we even come here then, man?
Solidarity of Steel#038.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#039.src: Yes, Yuman, why did we come here? You're the one who dragged us all along.
Solidarity of Steel#039.speaker: Yulie

Solidarity of Steel#040.src: Well, hey, I just thought that this old man could use some help, that's all! Six people's a lot for one guy to greet, you know?
Solidarity of Steel#040.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#041.src: Yes, yes... Well, alright, since you all are here, we may as well handle introductions now.
Solidarity of Steel#041.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#042.src: I'm Yuman! I'm the greatest musician of our age, man! And I'm super muscular and cool, and-
Solidarity of Steel#042.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#043.src: Alright, Yuman, that's enough. I'm Yulie, oldest of three. I work as a detective in {p}.
Solidarity of Steel#043.speaker: Yulie

Solidarity of Steel#044.src: Booooring! Come on, bro, have some-
Solidarity of Steel#044.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#045.src: And I'm Yusanu! I'm a mechanic. Quill's told us a lot about you, it's a pleasure to finally meet you.
Solidarity of Steel#045.speaker: Yusanu

Solidarity of Steel#046.src: Uh... S- same, I guess. This is all s- st- still a bit new.
Solidarity of Steel#046.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#047.src: Eh, you'll get used to it. This place has a way of growing on you.
Solidarity of Steel#047.speaker: Rex

Solidarity of Steel#048.src: Ah, if I may - I don't suppose you'd have anything prepared for us to be able to blend in better? I'd imagine we stick out a fair bit right now.
Solidarity of Steel#048.speaker: Mora

Solidarity of Steel#049.src: Hm... I hadn't quite considered that. Boys, why don't you handle that while Syndra and I go ahead to sort out living arrangements?
Solidarity of Steel#049.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#051.src: Leaves, why don't you join them? It'll be a good opportunity to get to know each other.
Solidarity of Steel#051.speaker: Syndra

Solidarity of Steel#052.src: Um... I think I'd rather go with you. I'd like to rest a bit.
Solidarity of Steel#052.speaker: Sui

Solidarity of Steel#053.src: ... Then I'll tag along as well. Perhaps I could be of use at the station!
Solidarity of Steel#053.speaker: Mora

Solidarity of Steel#054.src: Very well. Follow me, we have an access point this way.
Solidarity of Steel#054.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#055.src: Well. I'm afraid I can't stay either... the station doesn't exactly run by itself. We'll have to catch up later!
Solidarity of Steel#055.speaker: Yusanu

Solidarity of Steel#056.src: Ugh, boring as usual... Oh well! Yulie and I can show you around just fine by ourselves.
Solidarity of Steel#056.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#057.src: We should start with getting you all some new clothes.
Solidarity of Steel#057.speaker: Yulie

Solidarity of Steel#058.src: Hey! Wh- what's wrong with our cur- current ones!
Solidarity of Steel#058.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#059.src: They make you look like poor forest people, man!
Solidarity of Steel#059.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#060.src: Yuman! Don't be rude to our guests.
Solidarity of Steel#060.speaker: Yulie

Solidarity of Steel#061.src: What, I'm just saying! Am I wrong?
Solidarity of Steel#061.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#062.src: Well! At l- lea- at least we don't smell bad!
Solidarity of Steel#062.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#063.src: Alright, boys, settle down, play nice. You're both pretty. So, Yulie, what's the plan?
Solidarity of Steel#063.speaker: Rex

Solidarity of Steel#064.src: I'll have to swing by some shops... Yuman, in the meantime, why don't you see if you can find any clothes around here?
Solidarity of Steel#064.speaker: Yulie

Solidarity of Steel#065.src: Great, I'll join you. I need to get re-acquainted with things around here.
Solidarity of Steel#065.speaker: Rex

Solidarity of Steel#066.src: Sure, that works. Any complaints, Yuman?
Solidarity of Steel#066.speaker: Yulie

Solidarity of Steel#067.src: If I had 'em, you'd hear it loud and clear. The plan's good, bro.
Solidarity of Steel#067.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#068.src: Okay, we'll meet back at the Steel Feather once we're done. See you then!
Solidarity of Steel#068.speaker: Yulie

Solidarity of Steel#069.src: ...Well! I've got a plan of my own in mind. Not exactly what Yulie had in mind, but... heh, what he doesn't know won't hurt him. Follow me, leaf people!

Solidarity of Steel#074.src: Man, haven't you noticed how empty {p} is?
Solidarity of Steel#074.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#077.src: A- and since they're out at their jobs, they're n- n- not home... you want us to just walk th- through someone's apartment, then?

Solidarity of Steel#078.src: Yep, yep, exaaaactly! You get it. I think you and I are gonna get along great.
Solidarity of Steel#078.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#079.src: Yeah... sure. L- let- let's get going! I think we can rea- reach the from this house. We'll find some clothes up there.

Solidarity of Steel#080.src: Ha! Really? You should... you should pay more attention, man. The moment you stop keeping an eye on things is the moment things go wrong, y'know? Jeez.

Solidarity of Steel#081.src: What I was gonna say is that it's the middle of the workday. People are out at their jobs! No time to stroll around the city, or anything.

Solidarity of Steel#082.src: A- and since they're out at their jobs, they're n- not home... you want us to just walk th- through someone's apartment, then?
Solidarity of Steel#082.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#083.src: Mhm, yep, you get it. They won't mind! Cause they won' know we were there, yeah?
Solidarity of Steel#083.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#084.src: I- I- I guess. Okay, let's get going! I think we can rea- reach the from this house. We'll find some clothes up there.
Solidarity of Steel#084.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#085.src: Climb up the apartment at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] and jump across the roofs.

Solidarity of Steel#088.src: I'll be right be- behind you! Let's get up to the rooftops. I think we can rea- reach them through this building.
Solidarity of Steel#088.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#089.src: ...what the hell are you doin' jumpin' around?
Solidarity of Steel#089.speaker: Timaca Mason

Solidarity of Steel#090.src: Buzz off, some've us got jobs.
Solidarity of Steel#090.speaker: Timaca Mason

Solidarity of Steel#091.src: Here we are! Best clothes in the entire province, man! Take your pick!
Solidarity of Steel#091.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#092.src: ... Wait a mi- min- minute. There are only dr- dresses here?
Solidarity of Steel#092.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#093.src: Oh, yeah. My bad, man! Bet you could pull it off though, eh?
Solidarity of Steel#093.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#094.src: I- y- you- wh- wh- what- h- huh? Ev- even- even if I could, Rex and Mora would- w- would never wear- wear these. A- and- and they're n- n- not-
Solidarity of Steel#094.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#095.src: Relax, I'm just messing with you, man! We'll find some more. But, hey, grab one if you want, yeah?
Solidarity of Steel#095.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#097.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#102.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#105.src: The one to the s- south- {u}, yes.
Solidarity of Steel#105.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#106.src: That's the one! I'll wait for you there, then we can head to the station. And hurry up, would ya?

Solidarity of Steel#110.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#111.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#113.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#119.src: Catch up with Zeph and Rex.
