The Cursed One#374.src: Welcome. Can I interest you in buying anything?
The Cursed One#374.speaker: Tea Stand Merchant

The Cursed One#375.src: Perhaps you would like to hear what we have to offer?
The Cursed One#375.speaker: Tea Stand Merchant

The Cursed One#377.src: We are selling both the raw ingredients and some freshly brewed tea.
The Cursed One#377.speaker: Tea Stand Merchant

The Cursed One#378.src: Let me bring you on a history lesson to learn about the finest ingredients the forest has to offer.
The Cursed One#378.speaker: Tea Stand Merchant

The Cursed One#379.src: Tea is very popular in Auburn and the people have managed to make tea out of almost any plant you can find! Some are... more tasty than others.
The Cursed One#379.speaker: Tea Stand Merchant

The Cursed One#380.src: The Reishi Mushroom for example! Brewing tea of the mushroom alone often turns... bitter. With the help of herbs and spices it goes from a bitter to a rich spicy flavour!
The Cursed One#380.speaker: Tea Stand Merchant

The Cursed One#381.src: The mushroom itself is said to keep you healthy. It is also said to boost your resistances!
The Cursed One#381.speaker: Tea Stand Merchant

The Cursed One#382.src: The Tea Tree Mushroom on the other hand is perfect for a good tea blend. The mushroom alone gives it a sweet and earthy flavour.
The Cursed One#382.speaker: Tea Stand Merchant

The Cursed One#383.src: The mushroom is also said to regenerate you back to health and alleviate the feeling of tiredness! How amazing.
The Cursed One#383.speaker: Tea Stand Merchant

The Cursed One#384.src: If you feel like buying something, please talk to my assistant.
The Cursed One#384.speaker: Tea Stand Merchant

The Cursed One#387.src: It's festival time! *hic* that means... drinking time!!!
The Cursed One#387.speaker: Alcohol Stand Merchant

The Cursed One#388.src: Inteeeerested in any of our mouth-watering beverages?
The Cursed One#388.speaker: Alcohol Stand Merchant

The Cursed One#390.src: *Hic* Todaaaay, we have a couple of imported drinks as well as our classic Autumn Amaretto.
The Cursed One#390.speaker: Alcohol Stand Merchant

The Cursed One#391.src: Seen them blue fruits in the trees around here? Most of 'em are inedible Liffberries, buuut, some of 'em are actually a more edible fruit called Autumn Fruit, which carry a high value!
The Cursed One#391.speaker: Alcohol Stand Merchant

The Cursed One#392.src: The Amaretto is made from Autumn Fruit kernels! We have aaaalso mixed in some Liff Leaves which *hic* gives it its warm colour and slightly bitter and metallic taste.
The Cursed One#392.speaker: Alcohol Stand Merchant

The Cursed One#394.src: We have also imported the faaaamed Heather Beer from the rich highlands.
The Cursed One#394.speaker: Alcohol Stand Merchant

The Cursed One#395.src: A beer infused with the most beautiful heather grown across the highlands. *hic* You can almost taste the richness of the aristocrats.
The Cursed One#395.speaker: Alcohol Stand Merchant

The Cursed One#396.src: *hic* If I were you, I would deeefinitely try this drink. Stuff like this doesn't come to Auburn often.
The Cursed One#396.speaker: Alcohol Stand Merchant

The Cursed One#397.src: If you feel like blessing your taste buds, talk to my brother over there. *hic*
The Cursed One#397.speaker: Alcohol Stand Merchant

The Cursed One#400.src: We have freshly cooked and baked regional goods.
The Cursed One#400.speaker: Food Stand Merchant

The Cursed One#401.src: Would you like to hear about our menu, dear?
The Cursed One#401.speaker: Food Stand Merchant

The Cursed One#402.src: Just perfect! Auburn is famous for their bold, earthy and cosy flavours!
The Cursed One#402.speaker: Food Stand Merchant

The Cursed One#403.src: We also love to cook using our wild animals and resources, but I'm sure you already know all of this, haha.
The Cursed One#403.speaker: Food Stand Merchant

The Cursed One#404.src: Let me go over some of our special dishes for today, dear.
The Cursed One#404.speaker: Food Stand Merchant

The Cursed One#405.src: The most important dish in Auburn, is of course the "Gift of the Forest". A wonderful meat and fruit mixture inside a steamed leaf wrap.
The Cursed One#405.speaker: Food Stand Merchant

The Cursed One#406.src: We have hand wrapped all of our gifts this morning and they are steamed to go!
The Cursed One#406.speaker: Food Stand Merchant

The Cursed One#407.src: If that doesn't interest you, we also have the classic "Forest Feast". A grilled piece of boar meat with a mud-kin salad.
The Cursed One#407.speaker: Food Stand Merchant

The Cursed One#408.src: I'm afraid we have run out of ingredients at the moment. Please come back later!
The Cursed One#408.speaker: Food Stand Merchant

The Cursed One#410.src: Hey! You look like a tourist to me!
The Cursed One#410.speaker: Zoo Keeper

The Cursed One#411.src: I'm glad you decided to check out my little exhibition here.
The Cursed One#411.speaker: Zoo Keeper

The Cursed One#412.src: Is it your first time in this part of the region? Would you perhaps like to hear some fun facts about our animals?
The Cursed One#412.speaker: Zoo Keeper

The Cursed One#414.src: First we have our Roly-bugs here! These little buggers are a pest to the people here.
The Cursed One#414.speaker: Zoo Keeper

The Cursed One#415.src: They love gnawing on our houses. Luckily, we built most of our structures on stilts aaaand those bugs can't climb.
The Cursed One#415.speaker: Zoo Keeper

The Cursed One#416.src: Now! Frogs! The north-western bog is the best place for frog-watching. Just be careful of the bog monster.
The Cursed One#416.speaker: Zoo Keeper

The Cursed One#417.src: Frogs might be a good source of food but we like to see them more as... pets!
The Cursed One#417.speaker: Zoo Keeper

The Cursed One#418.src: Lastly, we have foxes! These little cuties are very shy in nature. But beware, there are bigger versions of them, known as Foxhounds.
The Cursed One#418.speaker: Zoo Keeper

The Cursed One#419.src: Those are not as shy... or peaceful, as their smaller cousins. They are just as cute though!
The Cursed One#419.speaker: Zoo Keeper

The Cursed One#420.src: Please have a looksie around! You can also pet them.
The Cursed One#420.speaker: Zoo Keeper

The Cursed One#422.src: Howdy and welcome to a mudkin farm!
The Cursed One#422.speaker: Kabo

The Cursed One#423.src: Mudkins are popular vegetables in food around here. They grow underground and you have to yoikn em' out!
The Cursed One#423.speaker: Kabo

The Cursed One#424.src: Are ya interested in a game of Mudkin Picking?
The Cursed One#424.speaker: Kabo

The Cursed One#425.src: Basically, ye goal is to get as many points as possible before the time runs out.
The Cursed One#425.speaker: Kabo

The Cursed One#426.src: There are three sizes of Mudkins, each size gives a set of points. However! There are two ginger roots that give negative points.
The Cursed One#426.speaker: Kabo

The Cursed One#427.src: Simply click on the dirt particles appearing in the field. There are five spots for ya to pick.
The Cursed One#427.speaker: Kabo

The Cursed One#430.src: Return to Syndra at or keep exploring the festival.

The Cursed One#431.src: Ah. There you are. Have you been enjoying yourself?
The Cursed One#431.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#433.src: For all that the festival revolves around the crown, I've always appreciated its representation of our culture.**
The Cursed One#433.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#434.src: I hope your experience with the crown has not ruined your perception of our province... there are still many things to celebrate.
The Cursed One#434.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#435.src: Sometimes, it can be nice to set aside your woes, and... take things as they are. Breathe, a little.
The Cursed One#435.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#437.src: It's hard to enjoy yourself with your experiences with the crown weighing you down, isn't it? I know the feeling.
The Cursed One#437.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#438.src: Mmn. I'd suggest to take what you can get. Happy moments like this can be fleeting, in my experience.
The Cursed One#438.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#439.src: If there's even the smallest spark of joy... take hold of it before it's gone. Cherish it while you still can. Try not to grow old and jaded like I have, would you?
The Cursed One#439.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#440.src: Ha! It's alright. Neither have I.
The Cursed One#440.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#441.src: Every year... every single year, the crown hosts these festivals. Starting here, and moving around in a ring around the province.
The Cursed One#441.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#442.src: The festival's a holiday, a day of rest, of celebration. What a gift it is, not needing to work for a time! How generous.
The Cursed One#442.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#443.src: I can't stand it here... Every year, I convince myself I can bear it. The reminder it brings, of memories long passed. Every year, I'm proven wrong.
The Cursed One#443.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#444.src: ...Ah. It's time. The main event is about to begin.
The Cursed One#444.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#445.src: Why, Her Majesty's annual speech, of course! It wouldn't be a Festival of the Crown if she didn't make an appearance, would it?
The Cursed One#445.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#446.src: Ha! No, no. Of course not. It wouldn't be a Festival of the Crown without a speech from Her Majesty herself, would it?
The Cursed One#446.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#447.src: Now... observe. Behold our enemy, take note of how she presents herself, what she says, what she doesn't say.
The Cursed One#447.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#448.src: Ah... beloved people of the {p}! What a joy, what an honor it is to stand amongst you once again.
The Cursed One#448.speaker: Her Majesty

The Cursed One#449.src: Some will claim the stunning {p} to be our most beautiful region, with its vibrant blossoming trees and grand historic castles...
The Cursed One#449.speaker: Her Majesty

The Cursed One#450.src: But I've always held a special regard for this place. The leaves and their warm shades, blowing in the soft breeze... all the woes of the world would be worth this sight.
The Cursed One#450.speaker: Her Majesty

The Cursed One#451.src: If I were able, perhaps I could stay here year-round! Ah, but alas... work in the Citadel keeps us all occupied!
The Cursed One#451.speaker: Her Majesty

The Cursed One#452.src: We have many plans for the coming year. Increased imports from the other regions, easier access to travel for all, and additional openings in military positions!
The Cursed One#452.speaker: Her Majesty

The Cursed One#453.src: More will be revealed soon. Now, some words from your beloved Sovereign.
The Cursed One#453.speaker: Her Majesty

The Cursed One#454.src: ...ah. The one thing I miscalculated. The mic height. Oh well Testing, testing, one two three...
The Cursed One#454.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

The Cursed One#455.src: Welcome one and all! I'm your Sovereign, Zhiraok. It's an honor to be here before you all again today.
The Cursed One#455.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

The Cursed One#456.src: Two decades of work in the {p}. Twenty years. It feels like I've been here for so much longer this place, these people, really have become my home.
The Cursed One#456.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

The Cursed One#457.src: My duty is not just to serve the Crown, but also to serve you. To make your lives better, to raise this region we live in to new heights.
The Cursed One#457.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

The Cursed One#458.src: Whether that's by increasing production of Liff Leaves to share our resources and knowledge the province over, which we owe to your hard work...
The Cursed One#458.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

The Cursed One#459.src: ...or through sharpening our infrastructure to exponentiate your quality of life, in thanks for what you do!
The Cursed One#459.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

The Cursed One#460.src: I'd be here all day listing the improvements over the last year, but I'll summarize Multiple major road improvements, countless new job opportunities, multiplying guard patrols to keep you safe...
The Cursed One#460.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

The Cursed One#461.src: The place we came from twenty years ago is unrecognizable now. My vow is that twenty years ahead, I can say the same thing for how much more we, together, improve our home.
The Cursed One#461.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

The Cursed One#462.src: 'til the day we sum up to the grandeur of {p} Thank you all! Enjoy the festivities!
The Cursed One#462.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

The Cursed One#463.src: What fine work Sovereign Zhiraok has done for our province! Truly, there could have been no better choice to fill that role!
The Cursed One#463.speaker: Her Majesty

The Cursed One#464.src: The {p} flourishes under his governance, and I could not be more pleased by the progress he has made.
The Cursed One#464.speaker: Her Majesty

The Cursed One#465.src: One final message before we conclude. These past few years, we have seen fewer and fewer reports of the cursed a sign of our strength as a people.
The Cursed One#465.speaker: Her Majesty

The Cursed One#466.src: And it is all thanks to you! Your diligent reporting of suspicious activity makes all the difference in keeping our province safe.
The Cursed One#466.speaker: Her Majesty

The Cursed One#467.src: We must stand strong, together! We will not allow this evil its victory, we will not let our province fall like so many others have beyond our walls!
The Cursed One#467.speaker: Her Majesty

The Cursed One#468.src: With that, let the celebrations begin!
The Cursed One#468.speaker: Her Majesty

The Cursed One#470.src: Did anything stand out to you?
The Cursed One#470.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#471.src: Indeed, it is. It's quite puzzling, isn't it? It's a sort of reverence she never displays elsewhere.
The Cursed One#471.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#472.src: And if there's one thing I'm certain she's being truthful about, it's this. Which only makes it all the stranger.
The Cursed One#472.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#473.src: Yes, yes... improvements. Life has improved since he ascended to that position. I'll give him that. He's invested in Auburn.
The Cursed One#473.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#474.src: But he is still working under the crown. Don't forget that. For every improvement he has made, there's another he has left ignored.
The Cursed One#474.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#475.src: No, I suppose they wouldn't. Better to leave the public unaware of such failures.
The Cursed One#475.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#476.src: But rest assured that internally, they have not forgotten. They will keep searching for you.
The Cursed One#476.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#477.src: Yes... the cursed. The crown needs to keep the people afraid. If there's another enemy out there that the crown supposedly protects them from...
The Cursed One#477.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#478.src: There's a reason they want people to believe the outside world is destroyed. Any contact could break the illusion.
The Cursed One#478.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#479.src: They'll be closing out the festival soon... so, our work here is done. We should be leaving before the crowd thins enough for us to be spotted.
The Cursed One#479.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#480.src: I've scheduled a meeting for tomorrow I'd like for you to attend. It'll be about our next steps, now that the crown has moved on. I'll see you there.
The Cursed One#480.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#482.src: I think I've had just about enough of people sneaking into my office. Care to knock next time?
The Cursed One#482.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

The Cursed One#483.src: Mmn. It's more interesting this way. I have news from the capital your request for additional troops has been granted. Reassignments should come through by the end of the week.

The Cursed One#484.src: Well, that'll solve some problems. But that's not the whole message, is it? What obtuse remark has he got for me this time?
The Cursed One#484.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

The Cursed One#485.src: Merely a reminder to... "get your act together," as it were.

The Cursed One#486.src: Get my act toge That floundering fractal's developed less in his quadrant in a hundred-fifty years than I've done in two, in the last ten!
The Cursed One#486.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

The Cursed One#487.src: I Ugh, focus, Z... He's not even here, don't let him get under your skin...
The Cursed One#487.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

The Cursed One#488.src: I'll get off that tangent. If that was all you had to say, it'd be a waste of your time. What do you need to say that a courier can't send in a letter?
The Cursed One#488.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

The Cursed One#489.src: The intruder. Does your administration believe it can get the situation under control?

The Cursed One#490.src: There it is. Listen, I've got their number, alright? There's no way in or out of the district where they won't be detected. We'll track them down.
The Cursed One#490.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

The Cursed One#491.src: Though unlike some people, my ego isn't so massive I can't recognize when an ally can be of use. Your types have an expertise here, so if you could spare a set or two of eyes it'd be much appreciated.
The Cursed One#491.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

The Cursed One#492.src: I'll see what I can do. There happens to be an ongoing operation in the area already, we can discuss redirecting the agent once it's concluded.

The Cursed One#493.src: One last thing the identity of the intruder has been made clear to you already, yes?

The Cursed One#494.src: Mhm. Like I said, I've got their number.
The Cursed One#494.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

The Cursed One#495.src: Then you will understand Her Majesty's order not to speak of this ordeal to our newest. Ascension is a difficult process, and it would be... unwise to add additional distractions to it.

The Cursed One#496.src: Wouldn't want to distract a hard worker like him, right. But if that's everything, Spymaster? My to-do list is getting more added by the minute.
The Cursed One#496.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

The Dark Descent#000.dst: 前往 [{~}, {~}, -{~}] 與 Graken 將軍交談

The Dark Descent#001.src: Ah, hello there chap! I must say, I didn't expect to see a part of the old {p} regiment over 'ere.
The Dark Descent#001.dst: 啊，你好啊，仁兄！我得說，真沒想到會在這兒見到 {p} 老部隊的人。
The Dark Descent#001.speaker: General Graken

The Dark Descent#002.src: I am General Graken, leader of the {p} militia. Charmed to meet you!
The Dark Descent#002.dst: 我是 Graken 將軍，{p} 民兵團的頭頭。幸會幸會！
The Dark Descent#002.speaker: General Graken

The Dark Descent#003.src: You've seen all the bloody zombies faffing about everywhere, yes? They're all seeming to come from this massive skull.
The Dark Descent#003.dst: 那些到處晃來晃去的該死殭屍你都看到了吧？牠們似乎全是從那個巨大的骷髏頭裡冒出來的。
The Dark Descent#003.speaker: General Graken

The Dark Descent#004.src: I'm putting together a crack team for an expedition inside, but we haven't got any bleedin' idea what's down there!
The Dark Descent#004.dst: 我正在組一支精銳小隊要進去探一探，可我們對底下有什麼東西一點頭緒都沒有！
The Dark Descent#004.speaker: General Graken

The Dark Descent#005.src: If you're up for it, chap, we could absolutely do with some recon 'round the old town, look for clues and the like.
The Dark Descent#005.dst: 你要是願意，仁兄，我們非常需要有人在老城區偵察一下，找找線索之類的。
The Dark Descent#005.speaker: General Graken

The Dark Descent#006.src: I took a gander earlier, and one of the ol' houses caught my eye - it had a bloomin' great skull right over the door!
The Dark Descent#006.dst: 我稍早去瞧了一眼，有一棟老房子引起了我的注意——門上頭掛著一顆大得驚人的骷髏頭！
The Dark Descent#006.speaker: General Graken

The Dark Descent#007.src: I didn't have time to look in proper, but I'd start the investigation there, chap.
The Dark Descent#007.dst: 我沒時間仔細看，不過要查我就從那裡查起，仁兄。
The Dark Descent#007.speaker: General Graken

The Dark Descent#008.src: It's just south of here. The house still had solid wood boarding in it, despite the age, so look lively, chum!
The Dark Descent#008.dst: 就在這裡的南邊。那房子這麼多年了，木板居然還很結實，所以打起精神，老弟！
The Dark Descent#008.speaker: General Graken

The Dark Descent#010.src: Oh, sod it, I knew I was forgetting something! Steady there, chum! I'm on my way!
The Dark Descent#010.dst: 噢，糟了，我就知道我忘了什麼！撐住，老弟！我馬上過去！
The Dark Descent#010.speaker: General Graken

The Dark Descent#011.src: Drat! Too late, it seems. Yes, I forgot to mention the floor was in poor condition. Up here! You took quite the tumble, are you alright?
The Dark Descent#011.dst: 該死！看來是晚了一步。是的，我忘了說地板狀況很糟。往上看！你摔得可不輕，還好吧？
The Dark Descent#011.speaker: General Graken

The Dark Descent#012.src: Well, there's some good news, I suppose. Still though, seems I sent you a ticket to a bit of a sticky wicket! Do you see a way out anywhere down there?
The Dark Descent#012.dst: 嗯，我想這也算有點好消息。不過話說回來，我好像把你送進了個相當棘手的局面！你在下面看得到出路嗎？
The Dark Descent#012.speaker: General Graken

The Dark Descent#013.src: There's a tunnel? Aha, spiffing! I suggest you take it immediately. I'll have to return to my post now, post-haste!
The Dark Descent#013.dst: 有條隧道？啊哈，好極了！我建議你立刻走那條路。我現在得趕緊回崗位上了！
The Dark Descent#013.speaker: General Graken

The Dark Descent#014.src: Good luck, chum! Now, back, you cads! Back I say!
The Dark Descent#014.dst: 祝你好運，老弟！好了，退後，你們這些傢伙！我叫你們退後！
The Dark Descent#014.speaker: General Graken

The Dark Descent#015.src: Keheh... Come further, little human... Step into the shadows...
The Dark Descent#015.dst: 嘿嘿……再走近一點，小小的人類……走進陰影裡……

The Dark Descent#016.src: Explore the tunnel in the basement of the house.
The Dark Descent#016.dst: 探索房子地下室裡的隧道。

The Dark Descent#017.dst: 調查那個詭異的黑暗領域。

The Dark Descent#019.src: Scout! Report your findings, immediately! How many corrupteds are coming?
The Dark Descent#019.dst: 斥候！立刻回報你的發現！有多少墮落者要來？
The Dark Descent#019.speaker: Soldier

The Dark Descent#020.dst: 我……那裡……太多了……幾、幾千個，至少……
The Dark Descent#020.speaker: Scout

The Dark Descent#021.src: Thousands...? This is far worse than I expected. Men! Prepare for-
The Dark Descent#021.dst: 幾千……？這比我預想的糟得多。弟兄們！準備——
The Dark Descent#021.speaker: Soldier

The Dark Descent#023.src: Wait, w-what's going on? What's happening to you?!
The Dark Descent#023.dst: 等等，怎、怎麼回事？你到底怎麼了？！
The Dark Descent#023.speaker: Soldier

The Dark Descent#024.src: Please, stop this! Whoever you are, leave me and my family in peace! What did we ever do to deserve this?!
The Dark Descent#024.dst: 拜託，住手！不管你是誰，放過我和我的家人！我們到底做錯了什麼要遭這種罪？！
The Dark Descent#024.speaker: Lost Soul

The Dark Descent#025.src: Ah, but if you had only said so sooner! They have already left this mortal coil...oh, what a shame.
The Dark Descent#025.dst: 啊，可惜你沒早點說！他們早已離開這副凡人的軀殼了……噢，真是遺憾。

The Dark Descent#026.dst: 你、你這個……我以為他們……噢，天啊，不……
The Dark Descent#026.speaker: Lost Soul

The Dark Descent#027.src: Hush now. I will ensure that you and your family are reunited. You will even be able to partake in...keheh...family outings, under my watchful eye...
The Dark Descent#027.dst: 別出聲。我會讓你和你的家人團聚。你們甚至還能一起……嘿嘿……在我的注視底下，出門走走……

The Dark Descent#028.src: Wha...you mean... N-no, please! I don't want to hurt anyone! I don't want to die!!
The Dark Descent#028.dst: 什……你是說……不、不要，拜託！我不想傷害任何人！我不想死！！
The Dark Descent#028.speaker: Lost Soul

The Dark Descent#029.src: Aha, naive girl. How cute, you believe you have a choice in the matter. What you want, is not what I need.
The Dark Descent#029.dst: 啊哈，天真的姑娘。真可愛，你以為這件事你有得選。你想要什麼，並不是我需要什麼。

The Dark Descent#031.src: Do you see how easily this place fell? How quickly I became its master? And how I could simply dispose of you without a second thought?
The Dark Descent#031.dst: 看見這地方倒得多輕易了嗎？我多快就成了它的主人？而我又能多麼隨意地把你處理掉，連想都不必想？

The Dark Descent#032.src: Hundreds slaughtered in mere moments... only to rise again as my soldiers in infinite amounts.
The Dark Descent#032.dst: 幾百人在轉眼間被屠盡……只為了再站起來，成為我數之不盡的士兵。

The Dark Descent#033.src: You can barely keep them at bay on the surface, and yet you think you can enter my own domain, to challenge me in the Underworld?
The Dark Descent#033.dst: 你們在地面上勉強擋著都吃力，卻以為自己能踏進我的領地，到冥界來挑戰我？

The Dark Descent#034.src: You will fail, and I will be free to string your body up like a puppet and make you dance for me.
The Dark Descent#034.dst: 你會失敗，而我將能把你的身體像傀儡一樣吊起來，讓你為我起舞。

The Dark Descent#035.src: So enter the mouth of the skull, soldier, make your way below the ground. I look forward to our next meeting, keheheh...
The Dark Descent#035.dst: 所以走進那顆骷髏的嘴裡吧，士兵，往地底下去。我很期待我們的下一次見面，嘿嘿嘿……

The Dark Descent#036.dst: 離開那個詭異的黑暗領域。

The Dark Descent#037.src: Return the ruby to Graken at [{~}, {~}, -{~}]
The Dark Descent#037.dst: 把紅寶石帶回 [{~}, {~}, -{~}] 交給 Graken

The Dark Descent#038.src: Return to your world, now. And if you still want to challenge me... I'll be waiting.
The Dark Descent#038.dst: 現在，回你的世界去。如果你還想挑戰我……我會等著。

The Dark Descent#039.src: Hey! Come on, come over here! Quit milling about with the zombies, chap!
The Dark Descent#039.dst: 嘿！過來，快過來這邊！別跟殭屍們混在一起晃了，仁兄！
The Dark Descent#039.speaker: General Graken

The Dark Descent#040.src: Oi! Hallo?! Chum? Why're you wandering round all bog-eyed? Come back to me now!
The Dark Descent#040.dst: 喂！哈囉？！老弟？你眼神呆滯地到處亂走做什麼？快回神啊！
The Dark Descent#040.speaker: General Graken

The Dark Descent#041.src: Come on, pip pip! Let's see a bit more colour in your eyes- There we are! Back now, chap?
The Dark Descent#041.dst: 振作點，打起精神！讓我看看你眼裡多點血色——這就對了！回來了嗎，仁兄？
The Dark Descent#041.speaker: General Graken

The Dark Descent#042.src: Capital! You had me quite worried for a spot, there. Do bubble about just what went on down there, mm?
The Dark Descent#042.dst: 好極了！你剛才可把我嚇得不輕。來，好好說說底下究竟發生了什麼事，嗯？
The Dark Descent#042.speaker: General Graken

The Dark Descent#043.src: But, you were stumbling about like a senile biddy, eyes blank as cream, and you kept muttering something about a Charon.
The Dark Descent#043.dst: 不過呢，你當時像個老糊塗一樣跌跌撞撞，眼睛白得像奶油，嘴裡一直唸著什麼 Charon。
The Dark Descent#043.speaker: General Graken

The Dark Descent#044.src: I'm supposing he was the one who took you for a spin there? Well, you certainly haven't carked it, so I might call this operation a jolly good success!
The Dark Descent#044.dst: 我猜就是他把你拖去繞了那一圈？嗯，你到底沒送命，所以這次行動我就當它是圓滿成功了！
The Dark Descent#044.speaker: General Graken

The Dark Descent#045.src: Your discoveries fit in jolly-well with what we already know - and I'm convinced. To stop all these bleedin' zombos, we're going to have to go down under.
The Dark Descent#045.dst: 你的發現跟我們既有的情報吻合得很好——我信了。要擋住這些該死的殭屍，我們非下去不可。
The Dark Descent#045.speaker: General Graken

The Dark Descent#046.src: Preliminary expeditions have brought back some real nasty bits, brains and such - but also some fancy-as-you-like jewellery!
The Dark Descent#046.dst: 先遣隊帶回來一些很噁心的東西，腦漿之類的——不過也帶回了些相當漂亮的珠寶！
The Dark Descent#046.speaker: General Graken

The Dark Descent#047.src: Take some with you, remind you what we're up against. But keep your eyes on the prize!
The Dark Descent#047.dst: 拿幾件走吧，提醒你我們面對的是什麼。不過眼睛要盯著正事！
The Dark Descent#047.speaker: General Graken

The Dark Descent#048.src: When you're ready, I'd be chuffed to have you along again in the expedition down into the depths, old bean!
The Dark Descent#048.dst: 等你準備好了，我很樂意再請你一起加入那趟深入地底的遠征，老兄！
The Dark Descent#048.speaker: General Graken

The Envoy Part I#002.dst: 我這身打扮讓你覺得新奇嗎？
The Envoy Part I#002.speaker: Olivin

The Envoy Part I#003.src: I'm not from around here. In fact I am from Corkus.
The Envoy Part I#003.dst: 我不是這一帶的人。老實說，我來自 Corkus。
The Envoy Part I#003.speaker: Olivin

The Envoy Part I#004.src: It's an independent island to the west. In fact.. If you want to go...
The Envoy Part I#004.dst: 那是西邊一座獨立的島。說起來……如果你想去的話……
The Envoy Part I#004.speaker: Olivin

The Envoy Part I#005.src: We're looking for Wynn representatives. Head to the C.S.S Wavebreaker down at the dock if you want to experience Corkus. Enjoy Corkus if you go!
The Envoy Part I#005.dst: 我們正在找 Wynn 的代表。想見識 Corkus 的話，就到碼頭去找 C.S.S Wavebreaker。真去了的話，好好享受 Corkus！
The Envoy Part I#005.speaker: Olivin

The Envoy Part I#006.src: Speak to C.S.S Wavebreaker Captain at the {p} docks.
The Envoy Part I#006.dst: 到 {p} 碼頭與 C.S.S Wavebreaker 的船長對話。

The Envoy Part I#007.dst: 歡迎，歡迎登上 C.S.S Wavebreaker！
The Envoy Part I#007.speaker: C.S.S Wavebreaker Captain

The Envoy Part I#008.src: The only boat that'll take ye directly to {p}.
The Envoy Part I#008.dst: 全世界唯一一艘直達 {p} 的船。
The Envoy Part I#008.speaker: C.S.S Wavebreaker Captain

The Envoy Part I#009.src: Just hop aboard and make yerself comfy.
The Envoy Part I#009.dst: 上船來，自個兒找地方坐舒服。
The Envoy Part I#009.speaker: C.S.S Wavebreaker Captain

The Envoy Part I#011.src: Welcam aboard me ship, I'll bring ye directly to Corkus.
The Envoy Part I#011.dst: 歡迎上俺的船，俺直接把你送到 Corkus。
The Envoy Part I#011.speaker: C.S.S Wavebreaker Captain

The Envoy Part I#012.src: Trust me, it is fa' more amazin than Gavel and Wynn. We even 'ave machines!
The Envoy Part I#012.dst: 信俺的，那地方比 Gavel 跟 Wynn 精彩太多啦。俺們連機器都有咧！
The Envoy Part I#012.speaker: C.S.S Wavebreaker Captain

The Envoy Part I#013.src: And don't get me started on our architectur'!
The Envoy Part I#013.dst: 更別提俺們那些建築了，講起來沒完！
The Envoy Part I#013.speaker: C.S.S Wavebreaker Captain

The Envoy Part I#014.src: Trust me, you will enjoy yer stay.
The Envoy Part I#014.dst: 信俺的，你會待得很開心。
The Envoy Part I#014.speaker: C.S.S Wavebreaker Captain

The Envoy Part I#016.dst: 與 Corkus 的代表對話

The Envoy Part I#017.src: It's such an honour to have a Wynn soldier visit our island.
The Envoy Part I#017.dst: 能有 Wynn 的士兵造訪本島，實在是莫大的榮幸。
The Envoy Part I#017.speaker: Corkus Delegate

The Envoy Part I#018.src: We were hoping for a true envoy, but you will do.
The Envoy Part I#018.dst: 我們原本期待的是正式的使者，不過你也行。
The Envoy Part I#018.speaker: Corkus Delegate

The Envoy Part I#019.src: If you follow me, I'll give you a tour of the city.
The Envoy Part I#019.dst: 跟我來，我帶你在城裡走一圈。
The Envoy Part I#019.speaker: Corkus Delegate

The Envoy Part I#020.src: We first arrived on Corkus {~} years ago.
The Envoy Part I#020.dst: 我們是在 {~} 年前首次登上 Corkus 的。
The Envoy Part I#020.speaker: Corkus Delegate

The Envoy Part I#021.src: The Corkians, like you, are from Fruma originally...
The Envoy Part I#021.dst: Corkians 跟你一樣，祖先都來自 Fruma……
The Envoy Part I#021.speaker: Corkus Delegate

The Envoy Part I#023.src: Coming from Fruma, we of course knew no magic at all.
The Envoy Part I#023.dst: 從 Fruma 來的人，自然是完全不懂魔法的。
The Envoy Part I#023.speaker: Corkus Delegate

The Envoy Part I#024.src: We soon developed our own. The rare power of Electromagic.
The Envoy Part I#024.dst: 我們很快發展出自己的一套：罕見的 Electromagic 之力。
The Envoy Part I#024.speaker: Corkus Delegate

The Envoy Part I#025.src: It's a difficult modern branch of magic that allows us to create machines.
The Envoy Part I#025.dst: 那是一門艱深的現代魔法分支，讓我們得以造出機器。
The Envoy Part I#025.speaker: Corkus Delegate

The Envoy Part I#026.src: Ah, here already. Welcome to {p}, Capital of our island.
The Envoy Part I#026.dst: 啊，這麼快就到了。歡迎來到 {p}，本島的首都。
The Envoy Part I#026.speaker: Corkus Delegate

The Envoy Part I#027.src: We've come a long way in a short time.
The Envoy Part I#027.dst: 短短時間裡，我們走了很長一段路。
The Envoy Part I#027.speaker: Corkus Delegate

The Envoy Part I#028.src: Let me point out where the shops are.
The Envoy Part I#028.dst: 我來告訴你商店都在哪裡。
The Envoy Part I#028.speaker: Corkus Delegate

The Envoy Part I#029.src: North, you can buy weapons and potions. If you will continue through the gate you will find the native Avos.
The Envoy Part I#029.dst: 北邊可以買武器和藥水。再往城門外走，會遇到本地的 Avos。
The Envoy Part I#029.speaker: Corkus Delegate

The Envoy Part I#030.src: West, you can buy armor, and another entrance to the potion shop.
The Envoy Part I#030.dst: 西邊可以買護甲，那裡還有一個通往藥水店的入口。
The Envoy Part I#030.speaker: Corkus Delegate

The Envoy Part I#031.src: To the south is our bank, powder shop, scrolls, and our exclusive powder exchange!
The Envoy Part I#031.dst: 南邊是銀行、粉末店、捲軸店，還有我們獨有的粉末兌換所！
The Envoy Part I#031.speaker: Corkus Delegate

The Envoy Part I#032.src: Oh! And speaking of the powder exchange, I'll start you off with some of these.
The Envoy Part I#032.dst: 喔！說到粉末兌換所，先給你一些這個當見面禮。
The Envoy Part I#032.speaker: Corkus Delegate

The Envoy Part I#033.src: Moving on... The south gate leads to {p}. On your way there, you might pass by the-
The Envoy Part I#033.dst: 繼續說……南門通往 {p}。往那邊走的路上，你可能會經過——
The Envoy Part I#033.speaker: Corkus Delegate

The Envoy Part I#034.src: Uhm, nevermind. In fact, we have a gift for you.
The Envoy Part I#034.dst: 呃，當我沒說。對了，我們替你準備了一份禮物。
The Envoy Part I#034.speaker: Corkus Delegate

The Envoy Part I#035.src: The Five Gears Diner is hosting any guests of the island.
The Envoy Part I#035.dst: The Five Gears Diner 正在招待所有來訪本島的客人。
The Envoy Part I#035.speaker: Corkus Delegate

The Envoy Part I#036.src: Go through the western gate and head to the diner for your free feast. Enjoy!
The Envoy Part I#036.dst: 從西門出去，到那間餐館享用你的免費大餐。祝你用餐愉快！
The Envoy Part I#036.speaker: Corkus Delegate

The Envoy Part I#037.src: Walk towards The Five Gears Diner.
The Envoy Part I#037.dst: 前往 The Five Gears Diner。

The Envoy Part I#041.src: Mo'in, Wynnian. Thank goodness I stopped you.
The Envoy Part I#041.dst: Mo'in，Wynn 來的朋友。還好我把你攔下來了。
The Envoy Part I#041.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part I#042.src: The diner is being raided by mechs..
The Envoy Part I#042.dst: 那間餐館正被 mech 洗劫……
The Envoy Part I#042.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part I#043.src: Before we do anything, I have to explain what's happening here...
The Envoy Part I#043.dst: 動手之前，我得先跟你說明這裡的狀況……
The Envoy Part I#043.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part I#044.src: My name is Maxie by the way. Nice to meet you.
The Envoy Part I#044.dst: 對了，我叫 Maxie。很高興認識你。
The Envoy Part I#044.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part I#045.src: This town is usually full of life.
The Envoy Part I#045.dst: 這座城平常是很熱鬧的。
The Envoy Part I#045.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part I#047.src: Our creations have rebelled against us.
The Envoy Part I#047.dst: 我們造出來的東西，反過來背叛了我們。
The Envoy Part I#047.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part I#048.src: They now raid towns for parts.
The Envoy Part I#048.dst: 現在它們洗劫城鎮，就為了搜刮零件。
The Envoy Part I#048.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part I#049.src: Mechs are getting increasingly more desperate.
The Envoy Part I#049.dst: 那些 mech 越來越不擇手段。
The Envoy Part I#049.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part I#050.src: Even in rust, they are still powerful.
The Envoy Part I#050.dst: 就算鏽成那樣，它們依然強悍。
The Envoy Part I#050.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part I#051.src: We have tried to remove them but the factory always makes more.
The Envoy Part I#051.dst: 我們試過清除它們，可是工廠總會再造出新的。
The Envoy Part I#051.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part I#052.src: It is Corkus' greatest failure. It must be stopped.
The Envoy Part I#052.dst: 那是 Corkus 最大的失敗。非阻止不可。
The Envoy Part I#052.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part I#054.src: I can try to open the vent to sneak in.
The Envoy Part I#054.dst: 我可以試著打開通風口，從那裡溜進去。
The Envoy Part I#054.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part I#055.src: I know you are a stranger, but talk to me if you want to help.
The Envoy Part I#055.dst: 我知道你只是個外人，不過你願意幫忙的話，就來跟我說一聲。
The Envoy Part I#055.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part I#058.src: Alright, I'll open the door with electromagic.
The Envoy Part I#058.dst: 好，我用 electromagic 把門打開。
The Envoy Part I#058.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part I#060.src: Gah! I can't even do the most basic spell!
The Envoy Part I#060.dst: 唉！我連最基本的法術都施不出來！
The Envoy Part I#060.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part I#063.src: I'm sorry for being useless in front of you...
The Envoy Part I#063.dst: 在你面前這麼沒用，真是抱歉……
The Envoy Part I#063.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part I#064.src: Electromagic is different from your magic.. I'm not very good at it...
The Envoy Part I#064.dst: Electromagic 跟你們的魔法不一樣……我不太拿手……
The Envoy Part I#064.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part I#065.src: I'm not sure which way it is, let's split up. I'll go to the right.
The Envoy Part I#065.dst: 我不確定該走哪邊，我們分頭吧。我走右邊。
The Envoy Part I#065.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part I#067.src: Open the door and exit the ducts.

The Envoy Part I#072.src: Mo'in. Sorry had a problem with the-
The Envoy Part I#072.dst: Mo'in。抱歉，我這邊出了點問題——
The Envoy Part I#072.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part I#073.src: What in the world is that mech on top of the pile of scrap over there?
The Envoy Part I#073.dst: 那邊廢料堆上面那台 mech 到底是什麼東西？
The Envoy Part I#073.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part I#074.src: That is definitely not a regular despermech... It looks brand new!
The Envoy Part I#074.dst: 那絕對不是普通的 despermech……它看起來是全新的！
The Envoy Part I#074.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part I#075.src: One of those hasn't been seen since the factory was running...
The Envoy Part I#075.dst: 那種東西自從工廠停工之後就再也沒出現過……
The Envoy Part I#075.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part I#076.src: We need to do something! I'll clear the path for you. That's the only thing I can do, I... hurt my... leg.
The Envoy Part I#076.dst: 我們得做點什麼！我幫你清出一條路。我也就只能做這個了，我……腳……受傷了。
The Envoy Part I#076.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part I#080.src: Are you okay? Good. Meet me at the entrance where we met. We need to report to {p}!
The Envoy Part I#080.dst: 你還好吧？很好。到我們初次見面的那個入口找我。我們得回 {p} 通報！
The Envoy Part I#080.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part I#081.src: Talk to Maxie at the entrance to The Five Gears Diner.
The Envoy Part I#081.dst: 在 The Five Gears Diner 的入口與 Maxie 對話。

The Envoy Part I#082.src: Don't worry about the guards, they are disabled for now. Follow me.
The Envoy Part I#082.dst: 別擔心那些守衛，它們暫時停擺了。跟我來。
The Envoy Part I#082.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part I#083.src: I know a shortcut, we'll be in {p} in no time.
The Envoy Part I#083.dst: 我知道一條捷徑，很快就能到 {p}。
The Envoy Part I#083.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part I#084.src: Talk to Maxie and Corkus Delegate in {p}.
The Envoy Part I#084.dst: 在 {p} 與 Maxie 和 Corkus 的代表對話。

The Envoy Part I#086.src: Beltrude, we have a problem! The factory is running!
The Envoy Part I#086.dst: Beltrude，出大事了！工廠又開始運轉了！
The Envoy Part I#086.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part I#087.src: We saw a mech... A new mech! It looked different like it was made in-
The Envoy Part I#087.dst: 我們看到一台 mech……一台新的 mech！它長得不一樣，像是在——
The Envoy Part I#087.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part I#088.src: What a load of scrap! You shouldn't talk about that in front of our guest!
The Envoy Part I#088.dst: 一派胡言！這種事怎麼能在客人面前講！
The Envoy Part I#088.speaker: Corkus Delegate

The Envoy Part I#089.src: Our guest... just killed several despermechs by himself.
The Envoy Part I#089.dst: 我們的客人……一個人就解決了好幾台 despermech。
The Envoy Part I#089.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part I#090.src: And why would we take the word of someone who can't do basic electromagic?
The Envoy Part I#090.dst: 那我們憑什麼相信一個連基本 electromagic 都不會的人？
The Envoy Part I#090.speaker: Corkus Delegate

The Envoy Part I#091.src: Don't listen to Maxie. Enjoy your stay.
The Envoy Part I#091.dst: 別聽 Maxie 的。祝你在這裡過得愉快。
The Envoy Part I#091.speaker: Corkus Delegate

The Envoy Part I#092.src: They won't admit anything with you around. They want to become allies with Wynn.
The Envoy Part I#092.dst: 有你在場，他們什麼都不會承認的。他們想跟 Wynn 結盟。
The Envoy Part I#092.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part I#093.src: Come to my house when you reach level {~}, here's a key so you can get in. We must prepare to break into the factory.
The Envoy Part I#093.dst: 等你到 {~} 級就來我家，這是鑰匙，你進得來。我們得準備闖進工廠。
The Envoy Part I#093.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part II#000.src: Use Maxie's house key to enter Maxie's house
The Envoy Part II#000.dst: 用 Maxie 的家門鑰匙進入 Maxie 的家

The Envoy Part II#003.src: Talk to Maxie on the first floor.
The Envoy Part II#003.dst: 在一樓與 Maxie 對話。

The Envoy Part II#004.src: Mo'in. I've been researching everything I can about the factory.
The Envoy Part II#004.dst: Mo'in。關於那座工廠，我能查的都查了。
The Envoy Part II#004.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part II#005.src: To get in we need two keys. One from the Avos and one from Corkians.
The Envoy Part II#005.dst: 要進去得有兩把鑰匙。一把在 Avos 手上，一把在 Corkians 手上。
The Envoy Part II#005.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part II#006.src: The idea was that both species had equal roles in the factories operantions.
The Envoy Part II#006.dst: 當初的用意，是讓兩個種族在工廠的運作上地位平等。
The Envoy Part II#006.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part II#007.src: We need those keys in get in and shut down the factory once more.
The Envoy Part II#007.dst: 我們得拿到那兩把鑰匙才進得去，才能再一次把工廠關掉。
The Envoy Part II#007.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part II#008.src: The corkians won't give up their key very easily, so we should start with the Avos.
The Envoy Part II#008.dst: Corkians 不會輕易交出他們那把，所以我們先從 Avos 下手。
The Envoy Part II#008.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part II#009.src: Our best bet is to ask the chief. However, because of tensions the border is closed.
The Envoy Part II#009.dst: 最好的辦法是去問族長。可是因為關係緊張，邊界已經封閉了。
The Envoy Part II#009.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part II#010.src: Fortunately there is something that can help us in a village north-west of here. Let's meet there.
The Envoy Part II#010.dst: 幸好西北邊有座村子，那裡有樣東西幫得上忙。我們在那裡碰面。
The Envoy Part II#010.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part II#012.src: I knew it! There was something here we could use.
The Envoy Part II#012.dst: 我就知道！這裡果然有能用的東西。
The Envoy Part II#012.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part II#013.src: I'll have to use electromagic to make it launch, so you will have to go alone.
The Envoy Part II#013.dst: 我得用 electromagic 才能把它發射出去，所以你得一個人去。
The Envoy Part II#013.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part II#014.src: Find the Avos chief. Ask for the factory key.
The Envoy Part II#014.dst: 找到 Avos 的族長，向他要工廠的鑰匙。
The Envoy Part II#014.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part II#016.src: Press the button when you're ready.
The Envoy Part II#016.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part II#019.src: Locate the Avos Chief by asking the Avos citizens. Avos Chief is at -{~}, -{~}
The Envoy Part II#019.dst: 向 Avos 的居民打聽，找出 Avos 族長的位置。族長在 -{~1}, -{~2}

The Envoy Part II#020.src: Hmm no gears or goggles.. You are no Corkian Human.
The Envoy Part II#020.dst: 唔，沒有齒輪，也沒有護目鏡……你不是 Corkus 的人類。
The Envoy Part II#020.speaker: Avos Shaman

The Envoy Part II#021.src: The chief said your people are welcome here.
The Envoy Part II#021.dst: 族長說過，你的同族在這裡是受歡迎的。
The Envoy Part II#021.speaker: Avos Shaman

The Envoy Part II#022.src: You must be here to see him.
The Envoy Part II#022.speaker: Avos Shaman

The Envoy Part II#023.dst: 順著這道階梯上去就是了。
The Envoy Part II#023.speaker: Avos Shaman

The Envoy Part II#024.src: Mo'in, soldier. I have been expecting you.
The Envoy Part II#024.speaker: Chief Avos

The Envoy Part II#025.src: You can't catapult yourself into a village full of bird people and not get noticed.
The Envoy Part II#025.dst: 你把自己用投石機扔進一座滿是鳥人的村子，怎麼可能沒人注意到。
The Envoy Part II#025.speaker: Chief Avos

The Envoy Part II#026.src: We know what you are here for, however. The Avos factory key.
The Envoy Part II#026.dst: 不過我們知道你來的目的：Avos 那把工廠鑰匙。
The Envoy Part II#026.speaker: Chief Avos

The Envoy Part II#027.src: We saw your battle with “Mech X” at the docks from above. I believe we can trust you.
The Envoy Part II#027.dst: 你在碼頭跟「Mech X」那一戰，我們在空中看得清清楚楚。我相信你是可信的。
The Envoy Part II#027.speaker: Chief Avos

The Envoy Part II#028.src: The key you seek is hidden deep within our most protected temple.
The Envoy Part II#028.dst: 你要找的鑰匙，藏在我們守衛最森嚴的神殿深處。
The Envoy Part II#028.speaker: Chief Avos

The Envoy Part II#029.src: Follow the road north of here to reach the temple. Speak to the grandmaster and she will allow you entry.
The Envoy Part II#029.dst: 沿著北邊那條路走就會到神殿。去跟大宗師說一聲，她會放你進去。
The Envoy Part II#029.speaker: Chief Avos

The Envoy Part II#030.src: Talk to the chief's friend at

The Envoy Part II#031.src: Eh, It's the warrior. I have my orders, but still say this is a bad idea.
The Envoy Part II#031.dst: 哼，是那個戰士啊。我是奉命行事，但我還是要說，這主意很糟。
The Envoy Part II#031.speaker: Grandmaster Shaman

The Envoy Part II#032.src: We hid this key for the purpose that it would never be used again.
The Envoy Part II#032.dst: 我們把這把鑰匙藏起來，就是為了讓它永遠不再被使用。
The Envoy Part II#032.speaker: Grandmaster Shaman

The Envoy Part II#033.src: The creatures we summoned down there are hostile to all. Even Avos.
The Envoy Part II#033.dst: 我們召到下面去的那些東西對誰都懷有敵意。連 Avos 也不例外。
The Envoy Part II#033.speaker: Grandmaster Shaman

The Envoy Part II#034.src: I can't say I have high hopes for you.
The Envoy Part II#034.dst: 我對你可沒抱多大期望。
The Envoy Part II#034.speaker: Grandmaster Shaman

The Envoy Part II#035.src: Meet me round the back of my house and I shall show you the way.
The Envoy Part II#035.dst: 到我屋子後面來找我，我會帶你走那條路。
The Envoy Part II#035.speaker: Grandmaster Shaman

The Envoy Part II#036.src: Meet the grandmaster behind her house and get over the gap and enter the temple.
The Envoy Part II#036.dst: 到大宗師屋後與她會合，越過斷崖進入神殿。

The Envoy Part II#037.src: I'll make the bridge for you.
The Envoy Part II#037.speaker: Grandmaster Shaman

The Envoy Part II#038.src: I don't see why we’re helping humans...
The Envoy Part II#038.dst: 我實在不懂我們為什麼要幫人類……
The Envoy Part II#038.speaker: Grandmaster Shaman

The Envoy Part II#039.src: You all act the same to me. Anyway, there you go.
The Envoy Part II#039.dst: 在我看來你們全都一個樣。算了，過去吧。
The Envoy Part II#039.speaker: Grandmaster Shaman

The Envoy Part II#040.src: Find the key inside the temple.

The Envoy Part II#041.src: You cannot have the key. Prepare for destruction.
The Envoy Part II#041.dst: 鑰匙不會給你。準備受死吧。
The Envoy Part II#041.speaker: Key Temple Dragon

The Envoy Part II#042.src: Return to Maxie in his house with the first key.
The Envoy Part II#042.dst: 帶著第一把鑰匙回到 Maxie 家找他。

The Envoy Part II#043.src: You're back, and you have the key!
The Envoy Part II#043.dst: 你回來了，而且拿到鑰匙了！
The Envoy Part II#043.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part II#044.src: Excellent. I will hold onto that for now. Let's focus on getting the Corkian's Key.
The Envoy Part II#044.dst: 太好了。這把先由我保管。接下來專心去拿 Corkians 那把。
The Envoy Part II#044.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part II#045.src: They keep it in a vault inside the castle. I honestly don't know how to get in there.
The Envoy Part II#045.dst: 他們把它鎖在城堡裡的金庫。老實說，我不知道要怎麼進去。
The Envoy Part II#045.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part II#046.src: I think first we should just go and scout out the vault itself and work it out.
The Envoy Part II#046.dst: 我想我們先去金庫那邊探探，再想辦法。
The Envoy Part II#046.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part II#047.src: I'll meet you there. It's in the castle and to the right. There's {~} guards there at all times, you can't miss it.
The Envoy Part II#047.dst: 我在那裡等你。金庫在城堡裡靠右邊，隨時都有 {~} 名守衛，不會找錯。
The Envoy Part II#047.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part II#050.src: Uh- No need to worry! We accidentally...
The Envoy Part II#050.dst: 呃——不用擔心！我們只是不小心……
The Envoy Part II#050.speaker: Bertil

The Envoy Part II#051.src: Blew a hole in the wall! Yep!
The Envoy Part II#051.dst: 在牆上炸了個洞！對，就是這樣！
The Envoy Part II#051.speaker: Reiva

The Envoy Part II#052.src: Stop. Maxie, was right. I'm sorry. Mech X pierced the vault like it was nothing and took the key.
The Envoy Part II#052.dst: 別說了。Maxie 是對的。我很抱歉。Mech X 像戳紙一樣穿透金庫，把鑰匙拿走了。
The Envoy Part II#052.speaker: Corkus Delegate

The Envoy Part II#053.src: The mechs were covered in farm produce for some reason and left a convenient trail. If you are serious about fighting the factory, follow it.
The Envoy Part II#053.dst: 那些 mech 不知為何沾滿了農作物，剛好留下一道好認的痕跡。你要是真心想跟工廠對抗，就順著它走。
The Envoy Part II#053.speaker: Corkus Delegate

The Envoy Part II#054.src: Look for the hidden mech base.
The Envoy Part II#054.dst: 尋找隱藏的 mech 基地。

The Envoy Part II#055.src: Psst! Over here, in the field!
The Envoy Part II#055.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part II#056.src: Mo'in. See that guy up there? He hasn't moved an inch since I got here.
The Envoy Part II#056.dst: Mo'in。看到上面那傢伙沒？我來到現在，他一寸都沒動過。
The Envoy Part II#056.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part II#057.src: I don't think he's actually a farmer. Follow me.
The Envoy Part II#057.dst: 我看他根本不是農夫。跟我來。
The Envoy Part II#057.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part II#058.src: HELLO... I AM A... HUMAN... FARMER.
The Envoy Part II#058.speaker: Farmer

The Envoy Part II#059.src: DO YOU... HAVE... ANY BUSINESS... WITH ME?
The Envoy Part II#059.speaker: Farmer

The Envoy Part II#060.src: Nice try, mech! Not convincing enough for me!
The Envoy Part II#060.dst: 演得不錯嘛，mech！可惜騙不了我！
The Envoy Part II#060.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part II#061.src: REPORT... COVER HAS BEEN COMPROMISED... TWO UNAUTHORIZED INTRUDERS... OUTSIDE OF BASE.
The Envoy Part II#061.dst: 回報……偽裝已暴露……兩名未授權入侵者……位於基地外。
The Envoy Part II#061.speaker: S-63 Mech

The Envoy Part II#064.src: That model was a S-{~}, meaning it has warned the others. Follow me.
The Envoy Part II#064.dst: 那台是 S-{~} 型，也就是說它已經通報其他同伴了。跟我來。
The Envoy Part II#064.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part II#065.dst: 你看，我們被鎖在外面了。
The Envoy Part II#065.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part II#066.src: Stand back, I'll open the door.
The Envoy Part II#066.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part II#067.src: I think we can safely assume this is the right place.
The Envoy Part II#067.dst: 我想我們可以放心斷定，就是這裡沒錯。
The Envoy Part II#067.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part II#068.src: You storm in and find what we need. I'll cover you from out here.
The Envoy Part II#068.dst: 你衝進去把我們要的東西找出來。我在外面掩護你。
The Envoy Part II#068.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part II#069.src: You need to find and destroy that new factory mech.
The Envoy Part II#069.dst: 你得找到那台工廠新造的 mech，把它毀掉。
The Envoy Part II#069.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part II#070.src: Retrieve the key from the base.

The Envoy Part II#071.dst: 偵測到入侵者。予以摧毀。
The Envoy Part II#071.speaker: Mech X

The Envoy Part II#072.src: Corkus has to suffer... They shut down the Factory, locked us up in there. Once we have both keys we can open it and you are NOT getting this one.
The Envoy Part II#072.dst: Corkus 必須付出代價……他們關閉了工廠，把我們鎖在裡面。等兩把鑰匙都到手，我們就能打開它——而這一把，你休想拿走。
The Envoy Part II#072.speaker: Mech X

The Envoy Part II#073.src: Find Maxie and give him the key.
The Envoy Part II#073.dst: 找到 Maxie，把鑰匙交給他。

The Envoy Part II#074.src: Mo'in. Did you get the key?
The Envoy Part II#074.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part II#075.src: Amazing. Now we need to meet at the factory. Now the real hard part begins.
The Envoy Part II#075.dst: 太厲害了。接下來我們在工廠會合。真正難的部分現在才開始。
The Envoy Part II#075.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part II#076.src: Follow the northwestern road and enter the factory from the west side. I will meet you there.
The Envoy Part II#076.dst: 沿著西北那條路走，從西側進入工廠。我在那裡等你。
The Envoy Part II#076.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part II#077.src: Find Maxie outside the factory at

The Envoy Part II#078.src: Mo'in. Are you sure you are ready?
The Envoy Part II#078.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part II#079.src: This won't be your average fight. The factory is cutting edge. Run by a being of pure electromagic.
The Envoy Part II#079.dst: 這不會是一般的戰鬥。那座工廠是最尖端的技術，由一個純粹以 electromagic 構成的存在在運轉。
The Envoy Part II#079.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part II#080.src: The smartest man on Corkus, Cerid spent years making a being smarter even than he is...
The Envoy Part II#080.dst: Corkus 最聰明的人 Cerid，花了好幾年造出一個比他自己更聰明的存在……
The Envoy Part II#080.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part II#081.src: Now it runs the factory with a twisted sense of morality. It's easy to see why it was shut down.
The Envoy Part II#081.dst: 如今它以一套扭曲的道德觀經營著那座工廠。工廠為什麼會被關閉，一看便知。
The Envoy Part II#081.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part II#082.src: Also.. I- I made you these boots using my magic. It turns out I am pretty good at making stuff.
The Envoy Part II#082.dst: 還有……我、我用我的魔法幫你做了這雙靴子。看來我在造東西這方面還挺行的。
The Envoy Part II#082.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part II#083.src: I just wanted to say thanks, too. I really feel like I made a difference fighting with you. When you are ready, just walk up to the factory doors.
The Envoy Part II#083.dst: 我也想跟你說聲謝謝。跟你並肩作戰，我真的覺得自己起了作用。準備好之後，直接走向工廠大門就行了。
The Envoy Part II#083.speaker: Maxie

The Feathers Fly Part I#000.src: Visit the workshop at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] (Requires completion of The Envoy Part II)

The Feathers Fly Part I#001.src: Oh?! Hold on, is anyone there..!

The Feathers Fly Part I#002.src: Why hello there! Whatcha doin' here? I'm Ava!
The Feathers Fly Part I#002.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#003.src: Want a quick job? How 'bout helpin' me out?! That was perfect timing!
The Feathers Fly Part I#003.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#004.src: Y'see, while the other Avos hate it, I just find electromagic so fascinating!
The Feathers Fly Part I#004.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#005.src: Look, I think I got a breakthrough invention. If it works... Oh man...
The Feathers Fly Part I#005.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#006.src: I just need to harness some nature magic, and there's an amazing source in the chief's hut. Ya comin'?
The Feathers Fly Part I#006.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#007.src: Don't you worry about rewards! I got you! See ya' there!
The Feathers Fly Part I#007.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#009.src: Hey! You showed up! Listen up, here's the plan...
The Feathers Fly Part I#009.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#010.src: There's a small museum inside the hut with all kinds of trophies.
The Feathers Fly Part I#010.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#011.src: Our chief is quite the talkative fella, and I can guarantee he'd love to tell you stories.
The Feathers Fly Part I#011.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#012.src: That should keep him and his guards busy. And that's where I come in!
The Feathers Fly Part I#012.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#013.src: I'll take that chance to sneak behind the throne, where our sacred totem is. I'm not stealing it, don't worry!
The Feathers Fly Part I#013.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#014.src: I'm a little clumsy, but I'm sure I can count on ya'! No matter what, keep the chief busy!
The Feathers Fly Part I#014.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#017.src: So, what brings you here, hm?
The Feathers Fly Part I#017.speaker: Avos Chieftain

The Feathers Fly Part I#018.src: Oh, you want to learn more about us... Of course, of course!
The Feathers Fly Part I#018.speaker: Avos Chieftain

The Feathers Fly Part I#019.src: We have a room where I can show you some of our history.
The Feathers Fly Part I#019.speaker: Avos Chieftain

The Feathers Fly Part I#020.src: You're in luck, I'm in a good mood. Follow me then.
The Feathers Fly Part I#020.speaker: Avos Chieftain

The Feathers Fly Part I#022.src: It's alright, these books aren't important... Be careful though.
The Feathers Fly Part I#022.speaker: Avos Chief

The Feathers Fly Part I#024.src: It's one of a kind! We planted it eons ago. It has never ever grown an inch. Or moved.
The Feathers Fly Part I#024.speaker: Avos Chief

The Feathers Fly Part I#025.src: Never died or anything either. For all we know, it might predate your corruption too!
The Feathers Fly Part I#025.speaker: Avos Chief

The Feathers Fly Part I#026.src: Oh, this is quite the important tome.
The Feathers Fly Part I#026.speaker: Avos Chief

The Feathers Fly Part I#027.src: This book has a signature from all Avos chiefs ever since we discovered ink!
The Feathers Fly Part I#027.speaker: Avos Chief

The Feathers Fly Part I#029.src: It's a custom for every Avos chief to keep their feathers somewhere. I guess I left that here.
The Feathers Fly Part I#029.speaker: Avos Chief

The Feathers Fly Part I#031.src: Though, we don't really have the time to sit down and read all of it, do we?
The Feathers Fly Part I#031.speaker: Avos Chief

The Feathers Fly Part I#033.src: Someone broke in? But why? Anyone can use our totem...
The Feathers Fly Part I#033.speaker: Avos Chieftain

The Feathers Fly Part I#034.src: I don't get it. They could've just asked...
The Feathers Fly Part I#034.speaker: Avos Chieftain

The Feathers Fly Part I#035.src: Report back to Ava in the Workshop at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

The Feathers Fly Part I#036.src: Oh, hey! Thanks for earlier. You were a big help.
The Feathers Fly Part I#036.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#037.src: Truth is, anyone can use that totem. They just don't like me very much.
The Feathers Fly Part I#037.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#038.src: Anyway, we got what we needed, and it's promising! Now onto the next part...
The Feathers Fly Part I#038.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#039.src: Y'see, I managed to bottle up some of our magic, but I still need corkian stuff.
The Feathers Fly Part I#039.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#040.src: Fortunately for us, there's a shop outside the city. Though, things might get complicated...
The Feathers Fly Part I#040.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#041.src: A bunch of Corkians aren't too fond of... Us. I just think you should come along with me, y'know?
The Feathers Fly Part I#041.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#042.src: Here, I wrote the coords into that book of yours. It's a bit far, so come on out and I'll give you a lift!
The Feathers Fly Part I#042.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#043.src: Meet Ava near the Corkian shop at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

The Feathers Fly Part I#044.src: Alright, if you want a lift, tell me, or you could just walk!
The Feathers Fly Part I#044.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#045.src: Not sure why you'd do that when I'm right here though!
The Feathers Fly Part I#045.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#046.src: Alright, buckle up, we're taking off!
The Feathers Fly Part I#046.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#047.src: Still holding on? We're almost there!
The Feathers Fly Part I#047.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#048.src: Here we are! Enjoyed the lift? I'm a great form of fast travel, right?!
The Feathers Fly Part I#048.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#049.src: Well, this was my first time using this magic magnet on people, but...
The Feathers Fly Part I#049.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#050.src: This is the shop! I think we can buy an Enhanced Potential Microchip here.
The Feathers Fly Part I#050.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#051.src: I need you to accompany me.
The Feathers Fly Part I#051.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#052.src: If I'm with a human, surely they'll sell one, right?
The Feathers Fly Part I#052.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#053.src: You go first, I'll follow you.
The Feathers Fly Part I#053.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#054.src: Or I guess you could just leave, that's cool too...
The Feathers Fly Part I#054.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#055.src: Ah, finally! I could've taken you there y'know!
The Feathers Fly Part I#055.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#056.src: Honestly, I just wanted to test something on you... Oh well!
The Feathers Fly Part I#056.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#057.src: This is the shop! I think we can buy an Enhanced Potential Microchip here.
The Feathers Fly Part I#057.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#058.src: I need you to accompany me.
The Feathers Fly Part I#058.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#059.src: If I'm with a human, surely they'll sell one, right?
The Feathers Fly Part I#059.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#060.src: You go first, I'll follow you.
The Feathers Fly Part I#060.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#061.src: Hmpf. What are you doing in here, Avo?!
The Feathers Fly Part I#061.speaker: Shopkeeper

The Feathers Fly Part I#063.src: So-uh, I was, y'know, wonderin' if you had any-
The Feathers Fly Part I#063.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#066.src: There's NO WAY I'm selling anythin' to an Avo! Shoo! Get out!
The Feathers Fly Part I#066.speaker: Shopkeeper

The Feathers Fly Part I#069.src: I am NOT giving up! To hell with all this!
The Feathers Fly Part I#069.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#070.src: Here, go in yourself and ask. I'll cover the cost later.
The Feathers Fly Part I#070.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#071.src: I'll stand back. CLEARLY this guy is too STUCK up to- Ugh, I'm getting angry! Just go in again.
The Feathers Fly Part I#071.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#072.src: Ask for an Enhanced Microchip at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

The Feathers Fly Part I#073.src: Huh?! I made myself clear! You were with her!
The Feathers Fly Part I#073.speaker: Shopkeeper

The Feathers Fly Part I#074.src: I'm closing for today, I cannot stand this! OUT!!
The Feathers Fly Part I#074.speaker: Shopkeeper

The Feathers Fly Part I#075.src: Oh, and don't even think about even approaching MY shop!
The Feathers Fly Part I#075.speaker: Shopkeeper

The Feathers Fly Part I#076.src: Find the control panel near the shop at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

The Feathers Fly Part I#077.src: So you did come back! Hang tight!
The Feathers Fly Part I#077.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#078.src: Look, we need a plan. Talk to me.
The Feathers Fly Part I#078.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#080.src: I'm... surprised he kicked you out, too. Maybe he's a patriot?
The Feathers Fly Part I#080.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#081.src: Well, anyway, we need a plan. I don't wanna wait this out.
The Feathers Fly Part I#081.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#082.src: Look, this guy has to have a control panel somewhere. Maybe we can neutralize the robots.
The Feathers Fly Part I#082.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#083.src: That stuff hates water, y'know? So I'll go fetch some in the meantime.
The Feathers Fly Part I#083.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#084.src: I'd like to NOT get zapped by a forcefield, so I'll sneak inside once we're done with that.
The Feathers Fly Part I#084.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#085.src: Got it? Find the control panel. It should be somewhere around the house. Talk to me once you're ready.
The Feathers Fly Part I#085.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#086.src: Good luck, then! I'll be back once you find the control panel!
The Feathers Fly Part I#086.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#087.src: Here we are! Good job! Alright, let's see...
The Feathers Fly Part I#087.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#088.src: Wait... Why are there... Buttons... Everywhere??
The Feathers Fly Part I#088.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#089.src: I feel like soaking everything would be quite the mistake.
The Feathers Fly Part I#089.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#090.src: And none of them are labelled! What is that?!
The Feathers Fly Part I#090.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#091.src: Look, your choice. What should we neutralize first?
The Feathers Fly Part I#091.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#092.src: Left, huh? Well, let's see how that goes.
The Feathers Fly Part I#092.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#095.src: Center... I guess the most important stuff could be here. In theory. I wouldn't count on it.
The Feathers Fly Part I#095.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#096.src: Huh! This wasn't that bad. And... I see something poking out, hold on...
The Feathers Fly Part I#096.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#097.src: Haha!... Wait, that's not it. Urgh.
The Feathers Fly Part I#097.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#098.src: Hey, I'll just give that to you. Though, you probably don't know how to use it, heh!
The Feathers Fly Part I#098.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#099.src: Looks like we got another shot. I still have some water left.
The Feathers Fly Part I#099.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#100.src: Center... I guess the most important stuff could be here. In theory. I wouldn't count on it.
The Feathers Fly Part I#100.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#101.src: Huh! This wasn't that bad. And... I see something poking out, hold on...
The Feathers Fly Part I#101.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#102.src: Haha! I think that's what we're looking for!
The Feathers Fly Part I#102.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#103.src: Look, I still want to make it up to the guy. I really don't want to be the villain of his story.
The Feathers Fly Part I#103.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#104.src: I'll meet you back at the Workshop. You can go on ahead.
The Feathers Fly Part I#104.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#105.src: Right, right. Stand back, just in case.
The Feathers Fly Part I#105.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#106.src: Oh wow. You got the right one, first try! How'd you know?
The Feathers Fly Part I#106.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#107.src: Well, good job. I still want to make it up to the poor guy though.
The Feathers Fly Part I#107.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#108.src: Just meet me back at the Workshop, I'll be there!
The Feathers Fly Part I#108.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#109.src: Fight your way out of the shop at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

The Feathers Fly Part I#110.src: Meet Ava in the workshop at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

The Feathers Fly Part I#112.src: Sorry about all the trouble I caused... I hope this makes it up to you.
The Feathers Fly Part I#112.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#113.src: I hope 's alright... I managed to find the microchip right away, after all.
The Feathers Fly Part I#113.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#114.src: ...Alright. Time to go. I'll wait for {u}, I guess.
The Feathers Fly Part I#114.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#116.src: Sorry about all the trouble I caused... I hope this makes it up to you.
The Feathers Fly Part I#116.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#118.src: Oh, there you are! I felt sad leaving you behind!
The Feathers Fly Part I#118.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#119.src: Say, if you need a lift, just tell me.
The Feathers Fly Part I#119.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#121.src: Alright, I'm dropping you off! Stick the landing!
The Feathers Fly Part I#121.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#122.src: I can't believe it! It's working! Look! Look at it!
The Feathers Fly Part I#122.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#123.src: A Growth Accelerator... Can you imagine the possibilities?!
The Feathers Fly Part I#123.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#124.src: We'll be able to... I don't know, help the poor, that's nice, right?
The Feathers Fly Part I#124.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#125.src: But we're not done. Well, I'm not done. I'd still like your help.
The Feathers Fly Part I#125.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#126.src: Look, let's try it out together, alright? Maybe I'll let you go afterwards?
The Feathers Fly Part I#126.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#127.src: I'll join you outside. Once I'm sure this works, I'll be able to... Show it to them.
The Feathers Fly Part I#127.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#128.src: In theory, it should be easy to operate... I'm trusting you. Again. Sorry 'bout that.
The Feathers Fly Part I#128.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#129.src: Meet Ava outside of the Workshop and help her operate her machine at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

The Feathers Fly Part I#130.src: Alright, it's just on the hill next to us, but I can bring you there if ya want!
The Feathers Fly Part I#130.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#131.src: Just don't get too used to me, alright? Tell me when you're ready.
The Feathers Fly Part I#131.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#133.src: Or I guess you could just leave, that's cool too...
The Feathers Fly Part I#133.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#134.src: Alright, this should be good. Talk to me and I'll explain!
The Feathers Fly Part I#134.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#135.src: I'll do a quick rundown of how to operate this. It's not automatic yet.
The Feathers Fly Part I#135.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#136.src: I'll give you a remote. You'll simply have to click in the right orders. You'll see!
The Feathers Fly Part I#136.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#137.src: You have to be quick, though! You can't just take all the time you want.
The Feathers Fly Part I#137.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#138.src: I have no clue how stable all of this is, so we'll start slowly!
The Feathers Fly Part I#138.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#139.src: I know this sounds a li'l scary, but you've shown yourself being capable.
The Feathers Fly Part I#139.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#140.src: Tell me when you're ready, I'll give you the remote then start the machine!
The Feathers Fly Part I#140.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#142.src: Think of it like... Casting one of your spells. You're used to that, right?
The Feathers Fly Part I#142.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#143.src: Let's start slowly! You have {~} seconds to fully charge it up!
The Feathers Fly Part I#143.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#146.src: Do you have ANY idea what it is we've just done?
The Feathers Fly Part I#146.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#147.src: I have to show that to the Chief. They WILL accept me! I cannot fail now!
The Feathers Fly Part I#147.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#148.src: Tell you what, let's meet up at the Chief's hut. If you want me to take you there right now, you can just go ahead and tell me!
The Feathers Fly Part I#148.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#149.src: Operate the machine with Ava for the Avos Chief at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

The Feathers Fly Part I#151.src: It really is convenient being with me, huh?
The Feathers Fly Part I#151.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#152.src: On second thought... Isn't it too soon?
The Feathers Fly Part I#152.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#153.src: I-I think I want to turn back... I...
The Feathers Fly Part I#153.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#154.src: You should approach the Chief first. It... won't work if I do it. I'll come by afterwards.
The Feathers Fly Part I#154.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#155.src: Ah, human! Welcome back. Good timing...
The Feathers Fly Part I#155.speaker: Avos Chieftain

The Feathers Fly Part I#156.src: Did you happen to see... An oddly dressed Avo around here recently?
The Feathers Fly Part I#156.speaker: Avos Chieftain

The Feathers Fly Part I#157.src: We kicked that girl from the tribe, and we do have our reasons.
The Feathers Fly Part I#157.speaker: Avos Chieftain

The Feathers Fly Part I#158.src: I've heard reports of her snooping around recently. With a human, even.
The Feathers Fly Part I#158.speaker: Avos Chieftain

The Feathers Fly Part I#159.src: And I believe... That this is no coincidence you're here.
The Feathers Fly Part I#159.speaker: Avos Chieftain

The Feathers Fly Part I#160.src: I will be frank. You're with her, aren't you? I won't hurt you. I won't hurt her either.
The Feathers Fly Part I#160.speaker: Avos Chieftain

The Feathers Fly Part I#161.src: She's not exactly welcome here. But she's never told you about that, did she?
The Feathers Fly Part I#161.speaker: Avos Chieftain

The Feathers Fly Part I#162.src: And I have nothing to hide, Chief.
The Feathers Fly Part I#162.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#163.src: STOP IT, you two! Let her talk!
The Feathers Fly Part I#163.speaker: Avos Chieftain

The Feathers Fly Part I#164.src: You're all scared of change, and that's all there is to it. Now...
The Feathers Fly Part I#164.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#166.src: Hmpf. Let's see that broken atrocity of yours.
The Feathers Fly Part I#166.speaker: Avos Chieftain

The Feathers Fly Part I#168.src: This is it. I can't fail now... I really hope I can trust you.
The Feathers Fly Part I#168.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#169.src: You have no idea how important this is to me.
The Feathers Fly Part I#169.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#170.src: It'll be slightly more difficult than last time, so get ready.
The Feathers Fly Part I#170.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#171.src: I'll give you the remote once you're ready!
The Feathers Fly Part I#171.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#172.src: Wait, are you sure this isn't dang-
The Feathers Fly Part I#172.speaker: Avos Chieftain

The Feathers Fly Part I#175.src: Let's just give her a chance for now.
The Feathers Fly Part I#175.speaker: Avos Chieftain

The Feathers Fly Part I#176.src: Why is she getting away with using such magic?!
The Feathers Fly Part I#176.speaker: Avos Guard

The Feathers Fly Part I#177.src: Oh I'm gonna charge this sapling like crazy!
The Feathers Fly Part I#177.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#179.src: One last time soldier, and I'm counting on you to be quick!
The Feathers Fly Part I#179.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#182.src: Wait... That's it?? No, this isn't right...
The Feathers Fly Part I#182.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#185.src: Chief! Have you seen what she just did?!
The Feathers Fly Part I#185.speaker: Avos Guard

The Feathers Fly Part I#186.src: I-I didn't mean to! I told you to stand back!!
The Feathers Fly Part I#186.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#187.src: Under normal circumstances, I'd have sent you down the pit after cutting off your feathers.
The Feathers Fly Part I#187.speaker: Avos Chieftain

The Feathers Fly Part I#188.src: But these are not normal circumstances. Soldier, may you come over here as well?
The Feathers Fly Part I#188.speaker: Avos Chieftain

The Feathers Fly Part I#189.src: Talk to the Avos Chief with Ava at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

The Feathers Fly Part I#190.src: So you fused OUR magic... With electromagic?
The Feathers Fly Part I#190.speaker: Avos Chieftain

The Feathers Fly Part I#191.src: I recognized extracts from the totem too. You're the one who stole from us, right?
The Feathers Fly Part I#191.speaker: Avos Chieftain

The Feathers Fly Part I#193.src: And on top of that, you used the Wynn warrior to fool us?
The Feathers Fly Part I#193.speaker: Avos Chieftain

The Feathers Fly Part I#194.src: And I'm sure you know why I did!
The Feathers Fly Part I#194.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#195.src: Do you have any idea how unstable this wretched electromagic is?!
The Feathers Fly Part I#195.speaker: Avos Chieftain

The Feathers Fly Part I#197.src: And you should NOT! Don't you understand? This is too dangerous!
The Feathers Fly Part I#197.speaker: Avos Chieftain

The Feathers Fly Part I#198.src: Should we kill her on the spot?! We almost died!
The Feathers Fly Part I#198.speaker: Avos Guard

The Feathers Fly Part I#199.src: No, don't kill her. I want her and the soldier in my hut, now.
The Feathers Fly Part I#199.speaker: Avos Chieftain

The Feathers Fly Part I#200.src: Ava. You can't keep going with this. Just stop. This is your final warning.
The Feathers Fly Part I#200.speaker: Avos Chieftain

The Feathers Fly Part I#201.src: What do you even hope to accomplish? You used to be such a brilliant kid.
The Feathers Fly Part I#201.speaker: Avos Chieftain

The Feathers Fly Part I#202.src: I just... wanna help people. You know that, I'm sure you understand!
The Feathers Fly Part I#202.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#203.src: Have you seen the Factory? They tried to help people, and instead they killed hundreds!
The Feathers Fly Part I#203.speaker: Avos Chieftain

The Feathers Fly Part I#204.src: Do you think you're able change the world?! Well, you can't, Ava! This is beyond you!
The Feathers Fly Part I#204.speaker: Avos Chieftain

The Feathers Fly Part I#205.src: So, for the last time. Stop all of this. I might reconsider your banishment then.
The Feathers Fly Part I#205.speaker: Avos Chieftain

The Feathers Fly Part I#206.src: You... You're really serious about that, huh? You'll NEVER change, will you?!
The Feathers Fly Part I#206.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#207.src: Do you guys have ANY idea how archaic you all are?! A final warning??
The Feathers Fly Part I#207.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#1257.src: Yeah, I'm... interested in working with you. Learning from you.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1257.speaker: Maxie

The Feathers Fly Part II#1258.src: You're clearly better at Electromagic than I, so...
The Feathers Fly Part II#1258.speaker: Maxie

The Feathers Fly Part II#1259.src: I'm willing to provide you with what you need. Help you out from time to time.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1259.speaker: Maxie

The Feathers Fly Part II#1260.src: You've been alone for so long, Ava. I'm lending you Maxie!
The Feathers Fly Part II#1260.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#1261.src: Hey, don't say it like that!
The Feathers Fly Part II#1261.speaker: Maxie

The Feathers Fly Part II#1262.src: *chuckles* I'm kidding. The rest of the council isn't aware yet.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1262.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#1263.src: They're not gonna like this, but I'll handle it.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1263.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#1264.src: You know I can't kill you. Can you imagine how the Avos would take it? Even though you're banished...
The Feathers Fly Part II#1264.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#1265.src: But I don't want to either. As for you, {u}...
The Feathers Fly Part II#1265.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#1266.src: I'll give you some stuff. I can't imagine how things would've gone if it weren't for you.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1266.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#1267.src: Now, you're banished from everyone Ava. I know that's no happy ending.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1267.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#1268.src: But that would've been too easy, don't ya think?
The Feathers Fly Part II#1268.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#1269.src: Maybe later, you'll get your happy ending. But you can settle with not being alone anymore, right?
The Feathers Fly Part II#1269.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#1270.src: Goodbye, Ava. Who knows, I might stop by sometimes. Maybe you'll have figured out that armour of yours.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1270.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#1271.src: ...? If you stop by the Workshop later, maybe I'll have some things for you as well.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1271.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#1273.src: Please contact Cerid for more information about this model.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1273.speaker: Robot Sentry

The Feathers Fly Part II#1274.src: If you have any questions, know that I am definitely not the right machine to ask.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1274.speaker: Robot Sentry

The Feathers Fly Part II#1276.src: Hey, it's alright. We'll be fine.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1276.speaker: Maxie

The Feathers Fly Part II#1278.src: You know, that Workshop of yours is way nicer than I expected.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1278.speaker: Maxie

The Feathers Fly Part II#1279.src: {u}, thanks for the help. You've introduced me to quite the talent!
The Feathers Fly Part II#1279.speaker: Maxie

The Feathers Fly Part II#1280.src: Believe me, I know how rejection feels like. I guess everyone does, in their own ways.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1280.speaker: Maxie

The Feathers Fly Part II#1282.src: Efena... She's nicer than Chief, that's for sure...
The Feathers Fly Part II#1282.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#1283.src: This is all... Very hard to believe.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1283.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#1285.src: {u}, once you come back here, you'll be able to get some of my gadgets.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1285.speaker: Ava

The Hero of Gavel#000.src: Find out what's happening in the center of {p} at [{~}, {~}, -{~}]

The Hero of Gavel#001.src: Hmm.. I might have just enough for one tier {~}... Why are you standing there?
The Hero of Gavel#001.speaker: Excited Fan

The Hero of Gavel#002.src: What all these people are here for? Don't tell me you don't know about the Siegfried contest.
The Hero of Gavel#002.speaker: Excited Fan

The Hero of Gavel#003.src: Are you SERIOUS?! It's the biggest thing happening since the last contest last month!
The Hero of Gavel#003.speaker: Excited Fan

The Hero of Gavel#004.src: Whoever wins the big scavenger hunt gets to go on an adventure with Siegfried himself.
The Hero of Gavel#004.speaker: Excited Fan

The Hero of Gavel#005.src: This year, I think I even have a good chance to win!
The Hero of Gavel#005.speaker: Excited Fan

The Hero of Gavel#006.src: Huh? Oh, you want this ticket? No way, this one's mine. Go get your own at that little shop.
The Hero of Gavel#006.speaker: Excited Fan

The Hero of Gavel#007.src: Hey, that's the mug I dropped!
