The Hero of Gavel#007.speaker: Siegfried Fan 1

The Hero of Gavel#011.src: How can I win an adventure now?
The Hero of Gavel#011.speaker: Siegfried Fan 2

The Hero of Gavel#012.src: Get a Siegfried Scavenger Hunt ticket in the center of {p} at [{~}, {~}, -{~}]

The Hero of Gavel#013.src: Tickets for sale! You! Would you like to join the great Siegfried Scavenger Hunt?
The Hero of Gavel#013.speaker: Scavenger Hunt Collector

The Hero of Gavel#014.src: Entry is completely free, and if you win, you'll get to adventure with Siegfried himself!
The Hero of Gavel#014.speaker: Scavenger Hunt Collector

The Hero of Gavel#015.src: You're interested? Great! Here, it's all quite simple.
The Hero of Gavel#015.speaker: Scavenger Hunt Collector

The Hero of Gavel#016.src: The ticket shows what items you need to find. It's split into three tiers.
The Hero of Gavel#016.speaker: Scavenger Hunt Collector

The Hero of Gavel#017.src: The first two, they're for the common folk. But if you REALLY want to win, you need a tier {~} item.
The Hero of Gavel#017.speaker: Scavenger Hunt Collector

The Hero of Gavel#018.src: Heh, you can even bring all three and you're practically guaranteed to win!
The Hero of Gavel#018.speaker: Scavenger Hunt Collector

The Hero of Gavel#019.src: Here, take the ticket. Come back with your items and you'll be entered into the draw.
The Hero of Gavel#019.speaker: Scavenger Hunt Collector

The Hero of Gavel#020.src: Bring all three limited Siegfried Collection items to the merchant in {p} Center at [{~}, {~}, -{~}]

The Hero of Gavel#021.src: You’re back! Let me see your items.
The Hero of Gavel#021.speaker: Scavenger Hunt Collector

The Hero of Gavel#022.src: This… Wow, all of them? Let me take a look at these…
The Hero of Gavel#022.speaker: Scavenger Hunt Collector

The Hero of Gavel#023.src: They’re all authentic! You must be ri-I mean, you must be a huge fan of Siegfried!
The Hero of Gavel#023.speaker: Scavenger Hunt Collector

The Hero of Gavel#025.src: Okay, I’ve entered you into the draw. The event’s taking place at the Golden Eagle Theatre.
The Hero of Gavel#025.speaker: Scavenger Hunt Collector

The Hero of Gavel#026.src: Just turn toward the bank and follow the signs, the winner will be selected when everyone gets there.
The Hero of Gavel#026.speaker: Scavenger Hunt Collector

The Hero of Gavel#027.src: Go to the Golden Eagle Theatre behind the Bank in {p} at [{~}, {~}, -{~}] for the winners to be announced.

The Hero of Gavel#028.src: Welcome, welcome everyone! We’re only waiting on a few more people before we begin.
The Hero of Gavel#028.speaker: Announcer

The Hero of Gavel#029.src: Ah, there we go! I believe we’re all set now.
The Hero of Gavel#029.speaker: Announcer

The Hero of Gavel#030.src: Welcome everyone, to the monthly SIEGFRIED FESTIVAL SCAVENGER HUNT!
The Hero of Gavel#030.speaker: Announcer

The Hero of Gavel#031.src: Today, we are once again celebrating the heroic deeds of Siegfried!
The Hero of Gavel#031.speaker: Announcer

The Hero of Gavel#032.src: All of you, my fellow gavellians, have adventured far and wide to gather rare items across the province.
The Hero of Gavel#032.speaker: Announcer

The Hero of Gavel#033.src: And yet, I cannot announce the winner…
The Hero of Gavel#033.speaker: Announcer

The Hero of Gavel#043.src: Thank you all for participating in this fantastic scavenger hunt around Gavel! Siegfried: The winner of this hunt will have the privilege of going on a once-in-a-lifetime, fully authentic, adventure with me!
The Hero of Gavel#043.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#044.src: Now, without further ado: I shall announce the winner!
The Hero of Gavel#044.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#047.src: I better win, I bought his mug!
The Hero of Gavel#047.speaker: Siegfried Fan

The Hero of Gavel#051.src: {u}, please head to the backstage area to my right for your adventure. Thank you everyone!!
The Hero of Gavel#051.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#052.src: Meet Siegfried backstage in the Golden Eagle Theatre to go on your adventure!

The Hero of Gavel#053.src: Welcome ! Congratulations on winning the scavenger hunt!
The Hero of Gavel#053.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#054.src: Today, you’ll be going with me on one of my glorious adventures.
The Hero of Gavel#054.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#055.src: And to get there, we’ll ride in the great Siegfried Airship!
The Hero of Gavel#055.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#056.src: It’s up at the airship docks – I’ll teleport us there!
The Hero of Gavel#056.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#057.src: (translated: Gavellian) MAGICAL MAGICKY MAGIC MAGICSPELL. Teleport!
The Hero of Gavel#057.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#059.src: Travel with Siegfried on his airship at the {p} airship docks at [{~}, {~},-{~}]

The Hero of Gavel#060.src: Here, follow me onto the airship!
The Hero of Gavel#060.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#062.src: Impressed by my piloting skills? Dodging these islands isn’t a challenge at all for the mighty Siegfried!
The Hero of Gavel#062.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#063.src: I rode an airship much like this one when I saved {p} from the dragon.
The Hero of Gavel#063.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#064.src: Right now we’re heading to a cave on the far east of the region.
The Hero of Gavel#064.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#065.src: We’ll have to navigate its treacherous corridors and defeat terrible beasts to get to the treasure at the end.
The Hero of Gavel#065.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#066.src: Why don’t you go get my map from the upper level of the airship, and we’ll get ready for our adventure.
The Hero of Gavel#066.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#067.src: How much lon- Oh, you brought the map!
The Hero of Gavel#067.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#068.src: We’ll need to use this map to navigate the dangerous cave we’re going to.
The Hero of Gavel#068.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#069.src: How did I get this? Well-er- I always prepare before my adventures!
The Hero of Gavel#069.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#070.src: Anyway, we’re about to land now – be careful not to fall off!
The Hero of Gavel#070.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#071.src: Enter the perilous cave on the eastern edge of the {p} with Siegfried at [{~}, {~}, -{~}]

The Hero of Gavel#072.src: Here we are, the great Cave of Treasure-Hoarding Evil Creatures!
The Hero of Gavel#072.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#073.src: Speak to me when you’re fully prepared for this dangerous adventure.
The Hero of Gavel#073.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#074.src: This cave is exceedingly dangerous, so make sure to follow my instructions.
The Hero of Gavel#074.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#075.src: I’ve got decades of experience bravely adventuring in these caves, so I know what I’m doing.
The Hero of Gavel#075.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#077.src: Follow Siegfried through the cave on the eastern edge of the {p} at [{~}, {~}, -{~}]

The Hero of Gavel#078.src: You sure took your time getting here! No matter.
The Hero of Gavel#078.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#079.src: I adventure in caves such as these often to get rid of the evil beasts dwelling within.
The Hero of Gavel#079.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#080.src: If it wasn’t for me defeating them before they could even--
The Hero of Gavel#080.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#081.src: Woah, stop! This might look like a harmless decoration, but it’s a trap!
The Hero of Gavel#081.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#082.src: Stay behind me, I’ll open it with my magic spell. (translated: Gavellian) OPEN!
The Hero of Gavel#082.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#083.src: Aha! I’ll protect you from the guardian, you deal with the rat!
The Hero of Gavel#083.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#085.src: Ow- I mean, hah! That was easier than swatting a fly for the mighty Siegfried!
The Hero of Gavel#085.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#086.src: Seems like we’re done here! That must have been a very difficult fight for you.
The Hero of Gavel#086.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#087.src: The caves I adventure in are filled with terrifying beasts similar to those.
The Hero of Gavel#087.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#088.src: WAIT! Don’t move, that boulder is about to fall!
The Hero of Gavel#088.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#089.src: Wow, that was close! Of course, I saw that coming and had no risk at all.
The Hero of Gavel#089.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#090.src: You might say that we can’t go further, as it’s blocking our way. But I can fix that!
The Hero of Gavel#090.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#091.src: And no more boulder! Only one as powerful as I can do that.
The Hero of Gavel#091.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#092.src: All we must do now is cross a perilous bridge over the Endless Chasm.
The Hero of Gavel#092.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#093.src: Aa, why did- Woah, careful! It looks like the bridge fell.
The Hero of Gavel#093.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#094.src: But this is not such an obstacle as you might think, for I can, uh, jump over this chasm!
The Hero of Gavel#094.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#099.src: Jump after Siegfried into the pit at the end of the cave.

The Hero of Gavel#100.src: Find a way to wake Siegfried.

The Hero of Gavel#102.src: Aaaaggggh my LEGS MY LEGS AAAGGH SO COLD!
The Hero of Gavel#102.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#104.src: Why couldn’t I THINK when I signed that STUPID CONTRACT that I’d end up here!?
The Hero of Gavel#104.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#106.src: They aren’t gonna come rescue us, you know. We’re on our own.
The Hero of Gavel#106.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#107.src: Why are you so calm? DON’T YOU SEE?!
The Hero of Gavel#107.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#108.src: WE’RE ON OUR OWN! This is REAL now! No coming back after ‘dying’, no more obvious traps, no more Siegfried. If I die here, I DIE! No coming back!
The Hero of Gavel#108.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#109.src: I.. I can’t do this. We’ll just starve here, in this cave… where nobody will ever find our bodies.
The Hero of Gavel#109.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#110.src: Stop looking at me! You figure out how to get us out of here, I’m just a worthless actor! Tell me if you find anything, I- I need a moment alone.
The Hero of Gavel#110.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#111.src: You found something? Ok. I’ll… follow you then.
The Hero of Gavel#111.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#112.src: WHAT WAS THAT SOUND?! A- are you sure we should go into there?
The Hero of Gavel#112.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#113.src: MY ARM! IT HIT MY ARM!
The Hero of Gavel#113.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#114.src: … I think I can manage.. OW!
The Hero of Gavel#114.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#115.src: Venture deeper into the cave with Siegfried.

The Hero of Gavel#116.src: You.. You got us out of there!
The Hero of Gavel#116.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#117.src: I didn’t think we’d ever find a way out of there…
The Hero of Gavel#117.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#118.src: … Well, I guess we should keep going. M- Maybe there’s a way out?
The Hero of Gavel#118.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#119.src: L- Look! There’s plants and light up ahead! A WAY OUT!
The Hero of Gavel#119.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#122.src: Rescue Siegfried from the trap OR leave him there.

The Hero of Gavel#123.src: W- What just happened?! I’m trapped in here!
The Hero of Gavel#123.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#124.src: … It’s… some sort of trap. I can feel the ground heating up!!
The Hero of Gavel#124.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#125.src: T-That was terrifying… Y-you saved my life. Thank you … I wasn’t prepared for real danger like this.
The Hero of Gavel#125.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#126.src: Rest before continuing through the cave.

The Hero of Gavel#127.src: …What? Houses, and a well? All the way down here?
The Hero of Gavel#127.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#128.src: It’s… empty. And the houses sure don’t look like anyone’s lived here for.. centuries.
The Hero of Gavel#128.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#129.src: OW! MY LEGS! And my arms, too! E- Everything hurts so much.. I need to sit down. I think I turned my arm the wrong way.
The Hero of Gavel#129.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#130.src: I’ll just.. rest here a bit. W- would you mind taking a look around for something we can eat? I can.. hardly move.
The Hero of Gavel#130.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#131.src: … Was this a sandwich at some point?
The Hero of Gavel#131.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#132.src: It barely has any resemblance to one.
The Hero of Gavel#132.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#133.src: Well… I doubt there’s anything better around here. I- I’ll take it.
The Hero of Gavel#133.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#134.src: OW!! I think I broke my teeth! This is like eating stone!
The Hero of Gavel#134.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#135.src: … I th-ow-ink I’m ready to- ow- move on. Let’s get go-oow-ing.
The Hero of Gavel#135.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#136.src: ... Is this the food you found?
The Hero of Gavel#136.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#137.src: I guess it's... the best that could be found here. You say you cooked it yourself?
The Hero of Gavel#137.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#138.src: I'll give it a try, then. Doubt there's anything better around here.
The Hero of Gavel#138.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#140.src: Thank you, {u}! I feel much better. I can head deeper as soon as you're ready.
The Hero of Gavel#140.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#142.src: I guess... I'll eat it, if it's the only food around.
The Hero of Gavel#142.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#143.src: Let's see... How do i even eat these?
The Hero of Gavel#143.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#146.src: You know… my name is actually Gurix.
The Hero of Gavel#146.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#147.src: Sound extremely Corkian, I know. They made me use Siegfried because it sounds less foreign, I suppose.
The Hero of Gavel#147.speaker: Gurix

The Hero of Gavel#149.src: OW! {u}, I think this web is poisoned! Quick, get me out with one of your spells!
The Hero of Gavel#149.speaker: Gurix

The Hero of Gavel#150.src: Thank you . I’ll.. I’ll follow you from now on. Clearly you’re more prepared than I am.
The Hero of Gavel#150.speaker: Gurix

The Hero of Gavel#151.src: Find your way through the spider burrows.

The Hero of Gavel#152.src: {u}? I think that giant web there is being held up by the platforms on the walls.
The Hero of Gavel#152.speaker: Gurix

The Hero of Gavel#153.src: I think… Maybe you can cut them down? I’ll stay here, I think it’s the safest place. I’ll call for you if a spider webs me again.
The Hero of Gavel#153.speaker: Gurix

The Hero of Gavel#154.src: You did it! The web fell!
The Hero of Gavel#154.speaker: Gurix

The Hero of Gavel#155.src: Let’s head onwards, I don’t want to deal with any more spiders.
The Hero of Gavel#155.speaker: Gurix

The Hero of Gavel#157.src: Hey, wait up! Thanks for saving me there.
The Hero of Gavel#157.speaker: Gurix

The Hero of Gavel#158.src: Woah... This is enormous! Who knows what this used to be?
The Hero of Gavel#158.speaker: Gurix

The Hero of Gavel#159.src: The path seems to be across those yellow shards, maybe we can reach them?
The Hero of Gavel#159.speaker: Gurix

The Hero of Gavel#160.src: Find a way to escape through the skylight at the end of the cave.

The Hero of Gavel#161.src: Another town? Or another part of the same one? I’m not sure..
The Hero of Gavel#161.speaker: Gurix

The Hero of Gavel#162.src: This one even seems to have a forge and a tailor.. It was a full, proper village!
The Hero of Gavel#162.speaker: Gurix

The Hero of Gavel#164.src: {u}, look! I can see the sky from here! M- maybe there’s a way to get up!
The Hero of Gavel#164.speaker: Gurix

The Hero of Gavel#165.src: I think.. what if we can this geyser somehow? It looks dormant, but I feel like we can activate it again.
The Hero of Gavel#165.speaker: Gurix

The Hero of Gavel#166.src: You take a look around, I’ll be resting a little. I don’t think I’ve ever walked this much in my life…
The Hero of Gavel#166.speaker: Gurix

The Hero of Gavel#168.src: W-Wait.. that’ll be quite a long fall after we get launched up. Can you try making some safety equipment, like a parachute or some really soft boots?
The Hero of Gavel#168.speaker: Gurix

The Hero of Gavel#169.src: You’ve already made something? Let me see.
The Hero of Gavel#169.speaker: Gurix

The Hero of Gavel#170.src: This looks… usable? It’s something, at least.
The Hero of Gavel#170.speaker: Gurix

The Hero of Gavel#171.src: Probably the best we’ll get down here. Are you sure you don’t need anything for yourself? No? Okay.
The Hero of Gavel#171.speaker: Gurix

The Hero of Gavel#172.src: I can’t wait to see the look on their faces when we get back. We’ve just saved the legacy of Siegfried!
The Hero of Gavel#172.speaker: Gurix

The Hero of Gavel#176.src: W-we made it? …, WE DID IT! WE’RE BACK! HAHAAA! I’M ALIVE!
The Hero of Gavel#176.speaker: Gurix

The Hero of Gavel#177.src: Hello there! It is I, Siegfried, and I just stopped the threat that was this cave!
The Hero of Gavel#177.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#178.src: Hah, that’s a great costume you have there! Looks just like me!
The Hero of Gavel#178.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#180.src: Hah, don’t mind the jokester over there. He does have an impressive costume though!
The Hero of Gavel#180.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#181.src: W-what's going on here? You can't replace me!
The Hero of Gavel#181.speaker: Gurix

The Hero of Gavel#183.src: Look over there! Those must be fireworks to celebrate my victory!
The Hero of Gavel#183.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#185.src: Well, anyways! You had a really bad fall in that cave there. I carried you out myself, you must’ve had some wild hallucinations.
The Hero of Gavel#185.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#186.src: Even though it was your own mistake, I’ll return you the emeralds you spent on the scavenger hunt.. and some more as compensation. That'll be.. [{~} Liquified Emeralds]!
The Hero of Gavel#186.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#187.src: I must return to {p} for the celebration now. Perhaps we will meet again at the next scavenger hunt!
The Hero of Gavel#187.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#188.src: Hello there, human! It is I, Siegfried! You must have just missed how I expertly ended the threat of this monster-ridden cave!
The Hero of Gavel#188.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#191.src: {u}, I'm glad to see you managed to get out alive. That must have been quite a fall into the chasm.
The Hero of Gavel#191.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#192.src: Of course, I got out easily using my spells and great knowledge of caves! Well, I must be off now. Maybe we may meet again if you win the next scavenger hunt!
The Hero of Gavel#192.speaker: Siegfried

The Hero of Gavel#193.src: As compensation for your unfortunate accident, Siegfried will return you the emeralds spent on purchasing scavenger hunt items.

The Hero of Gavel#194.src: That should amount to... {~} Liquid Emeralds. We apologize for the difficulties you encountered during your adventure with Siegfried!

The Hidden City#001.src: A Human! Agh! Don't worry about getting me medical attention, I've got this under control...
The Hidden City#001.speaker: Narder

The Hidden City#002.src: It's a broken leg. I'm already getting it treated, but I have a job to do elsewise- and a time sensitive one, too.
The Hidden City#002.speaker: Narder

The Hidden City#003.src: I won't be able to do it like this, but it doesn't matter if I'm the one who carries it out. It just needs to be done.
The Hidden City#003.speaker: Narder

The Hidden City#004.src: I don't work for villagers, I was hired to come here by other humans... there's something you must keep secret.
The Hidden City#004.speaker: Narder

The Hidden City#005.src: Swear it! If you're going to take the job, and my payment for it, you must be silent about it!
The Hidden City#005.speaker: Narder

The Hidden City#008.src: There is a hidden town in the canyon here. Up in the mountains- it was built and run by humans.
The Hidden City#008.speaker: Narder

The Hidden City#009.src: Now, the villagers have very strict rules about humans living in their lands, and it's VERY illegal.
The Hidden City#009.speaker: Narder

The Hidden City#010.src: I was contacted by the Mayor because he is aware that the town may have become... compromised.
The Hidden City#010.speaker: Narder

The Hidden City#011.src: The job is to figure out who and why, of course. To let this slip could collapse the treatise between our races.
The Hidden City#011.speaker: Narder

The Hidden City#012.src: I've never been to the city in the mountains, but I was given instructions. Here, I'll write down the location in your book.
The Hidden City#012.speaker: Narder

The Hidden City#013.src: Be aware though, they won't let you in unless the area is safe. They can't risk villagers wandering in.
The Hidden City#013.speaker: Narder

The Hidden City#015.src: Head to [{~}, {~}, -{~}] to find the human town.

The Hidden City#016.src: Hm? Oh, a fellow adventurer, I see! I'm sorry, but this discovery is mine to make. There's something strange about that door...
The Hidden City#016.speaker: Curious Villager

The Hidden City#017.src: Deadly gasses? Nonsense! As you can see the two of us are breathing just fine.
The Hidden City#017.speaker: Curious Villager

The Hidden City#018.src: You want me to leave? Why, so that you can have all of the glory for yourself? Ha, not a chance!
The Hidden City#018.speaker: Curious Villager

The Hidden City#019.src: The only way I'm leaving is if I can get that door open or if the whole cave starts crashing down on us.
The Hidden City#019.speaker: Curious Villager

The Hidden City#021.src: Gweh! I just had to go running my mouth about the cave collapsing! I'm out- if you have any sense you'll leave too!
The Hidden City#021.speaker: Curious Villager

The Hidden City#022.src: Go up to the door and inspect the noise.

The Hidden City#024.src: Thank you for getting rid of that curious villager! We thought he'd never leave.
The Hidden City#024.speaker: Eltom Guard

The Hidden City#025.src: I've never seen you before. Who gave you access to the town?
The Hidden City#025.speaker: Eltom Guard

The Hidden City#026.src: You're here in place of the detective the mayor hired?
The Hidden City#026.speaker: Eltom Guard

The Hidden City#027.src: Normally, I wouldn't believe that, but come in. We're desperate.
The Hidden City#027.speaker: Eltom Guard

The Hidden City#028.src: If you ever need to leave and get back, I can simply open the way.
The Hidden City#028.speaker: Eltom Guard

The Hidden City#029.src: You probably should be going now. Our mayor can get impatient.
The Hidden City#029.speaker: Eltom Guard

The Hidden City#030.src: Talk to Mayor Eoric in the town hall.

The Hidden City#031.src: What are you doing here? I'm writing an important letter, this better be worth my time.
The Hidden City#031.speaker: Eoric

The Hidden City#032.src: What? Narder sent you? Why'd he send a {p} soldier?
The Hidden City#032.speaker: Eoric

The Hidden City#033.src: I didn't think the army were authorized to know about {p}, especially Fruma recruits.
The Hidden City#033.speaker: Eoric

The Hidden City#034.src: Anyway, {p}'s secrecy is in great danger. We have found evidence of the traitor.
The Hidden City#034.speaker: Eoric

The Hidden City#035.src: We have locked down all of the exits. No one leaves or enters without my permission.
The Hidden City#035.speaker: Eoric

The Hidden City#036.src: We need a detective to sniff out the traitor and expose him.
The Hidden City#036.speaker: Eoric

The Hidden City#037.src: Start by asking the citizens around here about anything suspicious they've seen.
The Hidden City#037.speaker: Eoric

The Hidden City#038.src: When you find the culprit, remember to leave him alive! The guards will take care of him.
The Hidden City#038.speaker: Eoric

The Hidden City#040.src: Sorry, detective, but I haven't seen anything suspicious. In fact, I haven't even left my house for the last week.
The Hidden City#040.speaker: Reder

The Hidden City#041.src: The only suspicious thing I've seen is a hooded man walking around. There's not many people in {p} so it's weird.
The Hidden City#041.speaker: Nichye

The Hidden City#042.src: If you want to find out anything, the best person to ask is Lumilda. She's in her bakery, next to the Scroll Shop.
The Hidden City#042.speaker: Sybeth

The Hidden City#043.src: Ah, detective! What brings you to the sweet Lumilda's Bakery?
The Hidden City#043.speaker: Lumilda

The Hidden City#044.src: Hm, yes, there is a weird person coming through.
The Hidden City#044.speaker: Lumilda

The Hidden City#045.src: It's a hooded man. Never seen the face. A trouble maker, if you ask me!
The Hidden City#045.speaker: Lumilda

The Hidden City#046.src: He's been here a few times, usually writing things on a piece of paper. That man's a real mystery. No one even knows where he lives.
The Hidden City#046.speaker: Lumilda

The Hidden City#047.src: One time my grandson couldn't resist and followed the man. Last thing he saw was the man leaving through the Eastern Exit.
The Hidden City#047.speaker: Lumilda

The Hidden City#048.src: Ain't that a place to start, sweetheart?
The Hidden City#048.speaker: Lumilda

The Hidden City#049.src: Inspect anything beyond the Eastern Exit.

The Hidden City#051.src: Ah. You must be the detective then. None of those half witted Eltomites would figure it out.

The Hidden City#052.src: I guess the Grook is out of the pen then.

The Hidden City#053.src: This town shouldn’t even be here. Humans aren't allowed to settle in Gavel.

The Hidden City#054.src: These Humans couldn’t be bothered to fight their own war, so they hid an entire city here.

The Hidden City#055.src: Traitor? I’m no traitor. I'm just looking to carry out the law where it needs to be carried out. Nothing personal, yes?

The Hidden City#056.src: Maybe they'll actually use "Ardulf" instead of saying "freak" once they've seen the good I can do for them!
The Hidden City#056.speaker: Ardulf

The Hidden City#057.src: Read the note on the table.

The Hidden City#063.src: Requested to use a ship... I refused...
The Hidden City#063.speaker: Hilan

The Hidden City#064.src: He beat me up... And left...
The Hidden City#064.speaker: Hilan

The Hidden City#066.src: Head up to the Airbase's Tower to confront the hooded man.

The Hidden City#068.src: What are you doing here? Why are you protecting this illegal town?
The Hidden City#068.speaker: Ardulf

The Hidden City#069.src: The Villagers will not be happy about {p}. This could seriously harm the Gavel-Wynn relationship.
The Hidden City#069.speaker: Ardulf

The Hidden City#070.src: You can't stop me. You wouldn't murder one of your own, would you?
The Hidden City#070.speaker: Ardulf

The Hidden City#071.src: I will tell the mayor of {p} all about this place, and claim my reward for doing so. I will be rich and if you want to stop me you will have to do it yourself!
The Hidden City#071.speaker: Ardulf

The Hidden City#072.src: Escape your cell and find a way to sabotage the ship.

The Hidden City#074.src: Talk to {p}'s Mayor at the top of {p}.

The House of Twain (Quest)#000.src: Talk to Twendle at The {p} at [{~}, {~}, -{~}]
The House of Twain (Quest)#000.dst: 前往 {p} 與 Twendle 對話，座標 [{~1}, {~2}, -{~3}]

The House of Twain (Quest)#001.src: Oh, hey you there! Are you heading down this road? You know it's a dead end, right?
The House of Twain (Quest)#001.dst: 喔，那邊那位！你要往這條路走嗎？你知道那是死路吧？
The House of Twain (Quest)#001.speaker: Twendle

The House of Twain (Quest)#002.src: It leads to an old mansion, that has fallen into decay.
The House of Twain (Quest)#002.dst: 那條路通往一棟老宅，早就荒廢了。
The House of Twain (Quest)#002.speaker: Twendle

The House of Twain (Quest)#003.src: That mansion is the house of my ancestor; Dwendle Twain. It was a house of incredible heritage and magical powers, Dwendle himself was adopted into it.
The House of Twain (Quest)#003.dst: 那棟宅子是我祖先的家，Dwendle Twain 的家。那是一戶有著驚人傳承與魔法力量的家族，Dwendle 本人是被收養進去的。
The House of Twain (Quest)#003.speaker: Twendle

The House of Twain (Quest)#004.src: Marius Twain was the leader of the mansion; they fought against evil spirits, I think. The history of the house is not well-known, outside of a novel.
The House of Twain (Quest)#004.dst: Marius Twain 是那棟宅子的主人；我想他們是在跟惡靈作戰吧。這戶人家的歷史除了一本小說之外，幾乎沒人知道。
The House of Twain (Quest)#004.speaker: Twendle

The House of Twain (Quest)#005.src: I want to know the history of the mansion and uncover its secrets, but every time I get close, dark beings prevent me from entering.
The House of Twain (Quest)#005.dst: 我想弄清楚那棟宅子的歷史、揭開它的祕密，可是每次我一靠近，就有黑暗的東西擋住我。
The House of Twain (Quest)#005.speaker: Twendle

The House of Twain (Quest)#006.src: I am no soldier, and I don't think I will ever uncover the truth without your help. I can greatly reward you for your help.
The House of Twain (Quest)#006.dst: 我不是什麼戰士，沒有你的幫忙，我恐怕永遠查不出真相。你願意幫我的話，我可以給你很優厚的報酬。
The House of Twain (Quest)#006.speaker: Twendle

The House of Twain (Quest)#007.src: My ancestor left our family a large amount of emeralds. Beware though, traveller, the mansion's secrets are incredibly difficult to uncover and the monsters are powerful.
The House of Twain (Quest)#007.dst: 我的祖先留給家族一大筆綠寶石。不過旅人，你要小心——那棟宅子的祕密極難揭開，裡頭的怪物也很強。
The House of Twain (Quest)#007.speaker: Twendle

The House of Twain (Quest)#008.src: Unravel the secrets of the mansion and help me uncover the secrets of my heritage. Bring me [{~} Twain Journal].
The House of Twain (Quest)#008.dst: 解開那棟宅子的謎團，幫我查清我家族的來歷。把 [{~} Twain 日誌] 帶回來給我。
The House of Twain (Quest)#008.speaker: Twendle

The House of Twain (Quest)#009.src: This book has been hidden within the depths of the mansion and is protected by far more than puzzles or walls.
The House of Twain (Quest)#009.dst: 那本書藏在宅子的最深處，而且守著它的遠不只是機關和高牆。
The House of Twain (Quest)#009.speaker: Twendle

The House of Twain (Quest)#010.src: I believe the spirits that now haunt the mansion will do anything to protect the book. I'm sure they think it's their own, and the secrets it hides.
The House of Twain (Quest)#010.dst: 我相信如今在宅子裡遊蕩的那些靈魂，會不計代價護著那本書。牠們大概認定那本書、還有書裡的祕密，都是牠們的。
The House of Twain (Quest)#010.speaker: Twendle

The House of Twain (Quest)#011.dst: 把 [{~} Twain 日誌] 帶給 Twendle

The House of Twain (Quest)#012.src: If you already have a Ghostly Cap, you can wear that one and do not have to do any previous steps in order for the quest to work.
The House of Twain (Quest)#012.dst: 如果你已經有 Ghostly Cap，直接戴上就行，前面那些步驟都可以跳過，任務照樣會進行。
The House of Twain (Quest)#012.speaker: Note

The House of Twain (Quest)#013.src: I guess I put my faith in the right person. My history lies within these pages, and I don't intend to keep them secret. I shall make them public.
The House of Twain (Quest)#013.dst: 看來我沒有看錯人。我的家族史就在這幾頁裡，我不打算把它藏起來——我要讓所有人都讀得到。
The House of Twain (Quest)#013.speaker: Twendle

The House of Twain (Quest)#014.src: Thank you traveller. As promised, here is your reward.
The House of Twain (Quest)#014.dst: 謝謝你，旅人。說好的報酬，拿去吧。
The House of Twain (Quest)#014.speaker: Twendle

The Lost#001.src: Ho, traveler! I need the help of a true explorer, I can see it in your eyes, you are an adventurer like me!
The Lost#001.dst: 嗬，旅人！我需要一位真正的探險家幫忙，我從你眼裡看得出來，你跟我一樣是冒險者！
The Lost#001.speaker: Dejol

The Lost#002.src: While you are here, adventurer, I could use your help with something. I have gotten myself into a small predicament in my travels.
The Lost#002.dst: 既然你來了，冒險者，有件事我需要你幫忙。我在旅途中把自己弄進了一點小麻煩。
The Lost#002.speaker: Dejol

The Lost#003.src: You see, me and three others were on a grand expedition to explore the entire canyon! Unfortunately, we ran into a slight problem...
The Lost#003.dst: 是這樣的，我和另外三個人本來要進行一場壯闊的遠征，探索整座峽谷！可惜我們遇到了一個小問題……
The Lost#003.speaker: Dejol

The Lost#004.src: The {p} is clearly called that for a reason, within hours, we had lost each other!
The Lost#004.dst: {p} 會叫這個名字顯然是有原因的，不到幾個小時，我們就走散了！
The Lost#004.speaker: Dejol

The Lost#005.src: Luckily, we were prepared for it. We each carried a flag so if we ever got lost, we can raise it to be found.
The Lost#005.dst: 幸好我們有準備。每個人身上都帶了一面旗，萬一走丟了就把它升起來，好讓人找到。
The Lost#005.speaker: Dejol

The Lost#006.src: They were all meant to come to my blue flag, but they must all be trapped in some predicament! The canyon can be a dangerous place.
The Lost#006.dst: 他們本來都該往我的藍旗這邊來，但他們一定全都被困在什麼麻煩裡了！峽谷可是個危險的地方。
The Lost#006.speaker: Dejol

The Lost#007.src: I can see all three red flags from here, but it would be terrible if I went looking and they came back to this flag to find me gone!
The Lost#007.dst: 從這裡三面紅旗我都看得到，可是萬一我去找人、他們卻回到這面旗這邊發現我不在，那就慘了！
The Lost#007.speaker: Dejol

The Lost#008.src: Do you think you could go and check if they're all alright? I'm sure I can find some reward for you if you help!
The Lost#008.dst: 你能不能去看看他們三個還好嗎？你要是願意幫忙，我一定找得出什麼東西謝你！
The Lost#008.speaker: Dejol

The Lost#009.src: Find the three lost crew members at the red flags around [{~}, {~}, -{~}]
The Lost#009.dst: 在 [{~}, {~}, -{~}] 一帶的紅旗處找到三名走失的隊員

The Lost#010.dst: ……啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊！！！！！！！救命啊啊啊啊啊！！！！！！有鳥啊啊啊啊啊啊！！！！！！
The Lost#010.speaker: Fetu

The Lost#011.src: HUMAN! YOU, DOWN THERE! HELP ME! I was just trying to find my way back to my friends...
The Lost#011.dst: 人類！你，下面那個！救我！我只是想找路回去找我朋友……
The Lost#011.speaker: Fetu

The Lost#012.src: When this GIANT BIRD KIDNAPPED ME and threw me in her nest! I think she thinks I'm one of her chicks!
The Lost#012.dst: 結果這隻超大的鳥把我抓走，扔進牠的巢！我想牠把我當成牠的雛鳥了！
The Lost#012.speaker: Fetu

The Lost#013.src: The Canyon's movements must've dislodged her eggs from her nest-
The Lost#013.dst: 峽谷的移動一定把牠的蛋從巢裡震出去了——
The Lost#013.speaker: Fetu

The Lost#014.src: O-OH GROOK, SHE'S PECKING ME! FIND HER EGGS NEARBY AND THROW THEM UP HERE... QUICKLY!!
The Lost#014.dst: 噢——噢天啊，牠在啄我！去附近找牠的蛋然後扔上來……快點！！
The Lost#014.speaker: Fetu

The Lost#015.src: YOU HAVE THE EGGS?? GOOD! THROW THEM UP HERE, PLEASE!!!
The Lost#015.dst: 你拿到蛋了？？太好了！拜託，扔上來這裡！！！
The Lost#015.speaker: Fetu

The Lost#016.src: W-WOAH, STAY BACK, BIRD! I have a... uhh... I DON'T HAVE A WEAPON, HUMAN! PLEASE HURRY UP!
The Lost#016.dst: 哇——哇啊，退後，鳥！我有……呃……我沒有武器啊，人類！拜託你快一點！
The Lost#016.speaker: Fetu

The Lost#017.src: YES YES YES!!! THANK YOU, HUMAN! Oh, thank grook, this bird's leaving me alone now... It worked!
The Lost#017.dst: 好耶好耶好耶！！！謝謝你，人類！噢，謝天謝地，這隻鳥終於不理我了……成功了！
The Lost#017.speaker: Fetu

The Lost#018.src: I'll head back to Dejol, now... And I'm never going to go near another bird again!
The Lost#018.dst: 我現在要回去找 Dejol 了……而且我這輩子再也不要靠近任何一隻鳥！
The Lost#018.speaker: Fetu

The Lost#019.src: A-ah, hello. I'm g-guessing Dejol sent you?
The Lost#019.dst: 啊——啊，你好。我、我猜是 Dejol 叫你來的吧？
The Lost#019.speaker: Yuge

The Lost#020.src: W-Well, I was just walking through the c-canyon, when... the ground suddenly rose up underneath me and launched me all the way up here!
The Lost#020.dst: 那、那個，我本來只是走在峽谷裡，結果……地面突然從我腳下升起來，把我一路彈到這上面！
The Lost#020.speaker: Yuge

The Lost#021.src: N-Now, I'm... embarrassed to admit it, but I'm REALLY afraid of heights, s-so I don't know what to do... Do you have any ideas?
The Lost#021.dst: 現、現在，我……說出來很丟臉，但我真的非常怕高，所、所以我不知道該怎麼辦……你有什麼辦法嗎？
The Lost#021.speaker: Yuge

The Lost#023.src: Y-YOU JERK!! I COULD HAVE DIED!! WHAT THE HELL IS WRONG WITH YOU???
The Lost#023.dst: 你、你這個混蛋！！我可能會死的！！你到底是哪根筋不對啊？？？
The Lost#023.speaker: Yuge

The Lost#024.src: P-Please NEVER do that again! That was the worst thing I have ever done in my entire life!!
The Lost#024.dst: 拜、拜託你再也不要這樣做！那是我這輩子經歷過最糟糕的事！！
The Lost#024.speaker: Yuge

The Lost#025.src: ...Ugh! I-I'm going to head back to Dejol now. I hope I NEVER have to see you again!
The Lost#025.dst: ……唉！我、我現在要回去找 Dejol 了。希望我這輩子再也不要見到你！
The Lost#025.speaker: Yuge

The Lost#026.src: Hey there! I'm in a bit of a pickle right now, you see. This house I took refuge in, well... The original owner must have left for a reason!
The Lost#026.dst: 嘿，你好！我現在有點麻煩，你看。我躲進來的這棟房子，嗯……原本的屋主會離開一定是有原因的！
The Lost#026.speaker: Gordon

The Lost#027.src: It's so sad... So many people are constantly displaced by the canyon's movements destroying their homes every year. I remember hearing a story once, it was about-
The Lost#027.dst: 這很讓人難過……每年都有那麼多人因為峽谷移動摧毀家園而被迫搬遷。我記得聽過一個故事，是關於——
The Lost#027.speaker: Gordon

The Lost#028.src: Wait... Hey, do you hear that?
The Lost#028.speaker: Gordon

The Lost#029.src: Hey! You alright down there?! Oh, lord, how are we going to get out of this? I'm up here, come find me.
The Lost#029.dst: 嘿！你在下面還好嗎？！噢天啊，我們要怎麼出去？我在上面，過來找我。
The Lost#029.speaker: Gordon

The Lost#030.src: Oh... Well, this isn't good! The house just went and collapsed on us!
The Lost#030.dst: 噢……這下不妙！房子就這樣塌在我們頭上了！
The Lost#030.speaker: Gordon

The Lost#031.src: See what I was talking about, human? The canyon isn't really a good place to be. Now we're stuck in this pit!
The Lost#031.dst: 懂我剛才在說什麼了吧，人類？峽谷真的不是什麼好地方。現在我們卡在這個坑裡了！
The Lost#031.speaker: Gordon

The Lost#032.src: Although... there is a crafting table over there... Hey, maybe you could collect some supplies and make something to get us out of here?
The Lost#032.dst: 不過……那邊有一張工作台……嘿，也許你可以蒐集一些材料，做點什麼把我們弄出去？
The Lost#032.speaker: Gordon

The Lost#033.src: Heh, that's certainly one way to get out here! You made an entire catapult, huh?
The Lost#033.dst: 嘿嘿，這確實是出去的方法之一！你造了一整座投石機，是吧？
The Lost#033.speaker: Gordon

The Lost#034.src: So we're just going to launch ourselves out of this pit? You got it!
The Lost#034.dst: 所以我們是要把自己從這個坑裡射出去？就這麼辦！
The Lost#034.speaker: Gordon

The Lost#035.src: Alrighty, I'll be right behind you!
The Lost#035.speaker: Gordon

The Lost#036.src: Me first? Okay, I'll do just that!
The Lost#036.speaker: Gordon

The Lost#038.src: Hey, I made it!! You should come up as well, now.
The Lost#038.dst: 嘿，我成功了！！你現在也上來吧。
The Lost#038.speaker: Gordon

The Lost#039.src: Woah... That's certainly a lot of fun! Anyways, come talk to me.
The Lost#039.dst: 哇……這真的滿好玩的！總之，過來跟我說話。
The Lost#039.speaker: Gordon

The Lost#040.src: Thanks for the help, friend! I couldn't have done it without you!
The Lost#040.dst: 謝謝你幫忙，朋友！沒有你我做不到！
The Lost#040.speaker: Gordon

The Lost#041.src: I'm gonna go find my friend Dejol now- wait, you know who he is??
The Lost#041.dst: 我現在要去找我朋友 Dejol 了——等等，你認識他？？
The Lost#041.speaker: Gordon

The Lost#042.src: Oh... Wow, guess it's a small world, huh? That's funny! I'll see you down there later, then!
The Lost#042.dst: 噢……哇，看來世界真小，是吧？真有意思！那我們等一下下面見！
The Lost#042.speaker: Gordon

The Lost#043.src: Return to Dejol at [{~}, {~}, -{~}] to tell him of your success
The Lost#043.dst: 回到 [{~}, {~}, -{~}] 找 Dejol，把好消息告訴他

The Lost#044.src: Ho, adventurer! Looks like you had some adventures helping out my crew!
The Lost#044.dst: 嗬，冒險者！看來你幫我的隊員時經歷了不少冒險！
The Lost#044.speaker: Dejol

The Lost#045.src: Thank goodness they all found their way back unharmed. Mostly. Yuge's pride seems to have taken a hit.
The Lost#045.dst: 謝天謝地他們都毫髮無傷地回來了。大致上啦。Yuge 的自尊心好像受了點傷。
The Lost#045.speaker: Dejol

The Lost#046.src: Anyway, we ought to get back to our exploration - and we'll stick together closer this time!
The Lost#046.dst: 總之，我們該回去繼續探索了——這次我們會靠得更緊一點！
The Lost#046.speaker: Dejol

The Lost#047.src: You were a huge help, though, so please take this as a reward!
The Lost#047.dst: 不過你幫了大忙，所以請收下這個當作謝禮！
The Lost#047.speaker: Dejol

The Maiden Tower#001.src: Ah! What are you doing in my swamp?! Don't you know that Ogres live alone for a reason?
The Maiden Tower#001.dst: 啊！你跑來我的沼澤幹嘛？！你不知道食人妖獨居是有原因的嗎？
The Maiden Tower#001.speaker: Sherk

The Maiden Tower#002.src: Eh? You're from across the sea, a land called Win? You certainly don't look like a winner to me, ya small fry.
The Maiden Tower#002.dst: 欸？你從海的另一頭來，一個叫 Win 的地方？我看你可一點都不像個贏家啊，小不點。
The Maiden Tower#002.speaker: Sherk

The Maiden Tower#003.src: Fine then. Consider yourself lucky I'm in a... mood. I'll talk with you instead of crackin' yer bones for my bread.
The Maiden Tower#003.dst: 算了。算你走運，我今天……心情還行。我跟你講講話，不把你的骨頭敲碎配麵包吃。
The Maiden Tower#003.speaker: Sherk

The Maiden Tower#004.src: Ogres are tough. We're independent and solitary folks. You don't bother us or interfere with our life, we leave you alone.
The Maiden Tower#004.dst: 食人妖很硬。我們獨立、我們獨處。你不來煩我們、不插手我們的日子，我們也不理你。
The Maiden Tower#004.speaker: Sherk

The Maiden Tower#005.src: That is, until it's time to find ourselves a partner. Then we'll turn over hell and highwater ta be together.
The Maiden Tower#005.dst: 不過呢，等到該找伴的時候就不一樣了。那時候我們會翻天覆地，只為了跟對方在一起。
The Maiden Tower#005.speaker: Sherk

The Maiden Tower#006.src: And... well, when it's two ogres getting together, it's simple. But... I passed by a tall tower, and heard a Maiden's voice from inside.
The Maiden Tower#006.dst: 而且……嗯，兩隻食人妖湊一起是很簡單的事。可是……我路過一座高塔，聽見裡面傳來一位淑女的聲音。
The Maiden Tower#006.speaker: Sherk

The Maiden Tower#007.src: Ogres don't live in fairytale towers, or have a voice that could make flowers grow with its lovely lilt!
The Maiden Tower#007.dst: 食人妖不住童話裡的高塔，也沒有那種悅耳到能讓花開的嗓子！
The Maiden Tower#007.speaker: Sherk

The Maiden Tower#008.src: I've been tryin' ta figure out how to approach this... I'm gettin' on in years, I need to find someone, and she's the girl.
The Maiden Tower#008.dst: 我一直在想這事該怎麼開口……我年紀也不小了，得找個人了，而她就是那個人。
The Maiden Tower#008.speaker: Sherk

The Maiden Tower#009.src: If you can help me out, I'll be real grateful. I'm sure I've got something that you'd like in exchange.
The Maiden Tower#009.dst: 你要是能幫我一把，我會非常感激。我這兒肯定有你會喜歡的東西可以拿來換。
The Maiden Tower#009.speaker: Sherk

The Maiden Tower#010.src: Follow the rocky-looking path to find the tower. I'll meet with you there- prepare to be a wingman for an ogre.
The Maiden Tower#010.dst: 順著那條像石頭鋪的路走就能找到那座塔。我在那邊跟你會合——準備好給食人妖當僚機吧。
The Maiden Tower#010.speaker: Sherk

The Maiden Tower#011.src: Follow the stones in the path to the tower at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
The Maiden Tower#011.dst: 順著路上的石頭走到 [-{~1}, {~2}, -{~3}] 的高塔

The Maiden Tower#012.src: This is the place. She's up at the top... Remember, I won't stop 'til I meet her. Coming here means you're in for the long haul.
The Maiden Tower#012.dst: 就是這裡。她在最上面……記住，見不到她我是不會罷休的。你既然來了，就得陪我耗到底。
The Maiden Tower#012.speaker: Sherk

The Maiden Tower#013.src: I hear a voice outside! Oh, who might it be, I wonder~
The Maiden Tower#013.dst: 外面有人在說話！哎呀，會是誰呢～
The Maiden Tower#013.speaker: Maiden

The Maiden Tower#014.src: Here goes... Hello, fair lady of the tower! I am Sherk! I heard your voice on the road- and I must meet you myself! ...that's formal enough, right?
The Maiden Tower#014.dst: 上了……哈囉，塔上的美麗女士！我是 Sherk！我在路上聽見了你的聲音——我非見你一面不可！……這樣夠正式了吧？
The Maiden Tower#014.speaker: Sherk

The Maiden Tower#015.src: Ohoho! An admirer? Such a lovely, rugged accent! However ...if you wish to meet me, I'd like to see your devotion, yes?
The Maiden Tower#015.dst: 喔呵呵！有仰慕者？多麼可愛又粗獷的口音！不過……你若想見我，我想先看看你的誠意，好嗎？
The Maiden Tower#015.speaker: Maiden

The Maiden Tower#016.src: Woman, you have no idea what you're sayin' when you ask for devotion.
The Maiden Tower#016.dst: 女人，你說「誠意」的時候，根本不知道自己在說什麼。
The Maiden Tower#016.speaker: Sherk

The Maiden Tower#017.src: There is a lovely urn my father had before. He took it with him to his grave, and I do miss my dear father so.
The Maiden Tower#017.dst: 我父親生前有一只很美的骨灰罈。他把它一起帶進了墳墓，而我實在很想念我親愛的父親。
The Maiden Tower#017.speaker: Maiden

The Maiden Tower#018.src: Retrieve the urn for me, so I can have a memento of him. Brave the crypts of {p}, behind the bank... And prove your devotion, dear suitor~
The Maiden Tower#018.dst: 把那只罈子取回來給我，讓我留個念想。到 {p} 銀行後面的地窖去闖一闖……證明你的誠意吧，親愛的追求者～
The Maiden Tower#018.speaker: Maiden

The Maiden Tower#019.src: ...I'll return! You'll get your urn, no doubt! ... ...and a lovely fine boot up my backside. I don't fancy a massacre for a piece of pottery, Win person.
The Maiden Tower#019.dst: ……我會回來的！那罈子你一定拿得到！……然後我屁股上大概會挨一腳。我可不想為了一件陶器搞出一場屠殺，Win 人。
The Maiden Tower#019.speaker: Sherk

The Maiden Tower#020.src: I go into {p}, I'll get attacked. I get attacked, I attack back. They'll come after us... wouldn't want to present her with that. You get that urn for me, alright?
The Maiden Tower#020.dst: 我一進 {p}，就會被攻擊。被攻擊，我就會還手。他們就會追著我們跑……我可不想帶著那種東西去見她。那罈子你幫我拿，好嗎？
The Maiden Tower#020.speaker: Sherk

The Maiden Tower#021.src: Find the urn in the {p} Catacombs, behind the {p} bank at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
The Maiden Tower#021.dst: 前往 [-{~1}, {~2}, -{~3}]，在 {p} 銀行後方的 {p} 墓窟中找到那只罈子

The Maiden Tower#022.src: And this is why I asked your help. As nice as blood spreads on toast, I have to reserve my sensibilities for the miss.
The Maiden Tower#022.dst: 這就是我找你幫忙的原因。血抹在吐司上是挺好看的，可我得把那點斯文留給那位小姐。
The Maiden Tower#022.speaker: Sherk

The Maiden Tower#023.src: I've got you some compensation already, so don't worry about getting snubbed for credit. Thank you kindly for the help.
The Maiden Tower#023.dst: 你的報酬我已經備好了，不用擔心功勞被我搶走。真的很謝謝你幫忙。
The Maiden Tower#023.speaker: Sherk

The Maiden Tower#024.src: Just one last thing. I doubt she'll be expecting an ogre of all people to climb up her tower. I don't want her to get frightened away.
The Maiden Tower#024.dst: 還有最後一件事。她大概怎麼也想不到，爬上她那座塔的會是隻食人妖。我不想把她嚇跑。
The Maiden Tower#024.speaker: Sherk

The Maiden Tower#025.src: So, Win person. Care to temper her expectations before I arrive? Head up before me.
The Maiden Tower#025.dst: 所以呢，Win 人。能不能麻煩你在我上去之前，先幫她打個預防針？你先上。
The Maiden Tower#025.speaker: Sherk

The Maiden Tower#026.src: Enter the tower and make Sherk confess his love to the maiden.
The Maiden Tower#026.dst: 進入高塔，讓 Sherk 向那位淑女告白。

The Maiden Tower#027.src: Ohoho... you're one of those Humans I've read about, aren't you? Did you truly intend to be my suitor, dear?~
The Maiden Tower#027.dst: 喔呵呵……你就是我書上讀過的那種人類吧？親愛的，你真的是來當我的追求者的嗎？～
The Maiden Tower#027.speaker: Maiden

The Maiden Tower#028.src: Not exactly, milady! I'm the one seeking your affections- Coming up the ladder. I know I may not be a fairytale husband, but-
The Maiden Tower#028.dst: 不是我，女士！想追求你的人是我——我正爬梯子上來。我知道我大概不是童話裡那種夫婿，不過——
The Maiden Tower#028.speaker: Sherk

The Maiden Tower#029.src: Oh...my...goodness! A big, strong, strapping ogre!! Not a fairytale, my foot! And so polite too... Oh you'll make a perfect husband, heehee~
The Maiden Tower#029.dst: 喔……我的……天啊！一隻高大、強壯、體格結實的食人妖！！什麼不是童話，才怪呢！而且還這麼有禮貌……喔，你會是個完美的丈夫，嘻嘻～
The Maiden Tower#029.speaker: Maiden

The Maiden Tower#031.src: Aren't your type supposed to be less... Ehm... Clefted? Grizzled? Pale?
The Maiden Tower#031.dst: 你們這種人不是應該比較……呃……沒那麼裂？沒那麼粗？沒那麼白？
The Maiden Tower#031.speaker: Sherk

The Maiden Tower#032.src: Oh, come here, Sherky-pie, give me a big kiss! And no need to worry, there's plenty more in store for my big hubby after that~
The Maiden Tower#032.dst: 喔，過來嘛，Sherk 寶貝，親我一個！別擔心，親完之後，我這裡還有多的是等著我的大老公呢～
The Maiden Tower#032.speaker: Maiden

The Maiden Tower#033.src: Cor, lady! Even for an ogre you're layin' it on a bit thick! Aah, you see, ogres, and people like you, they have layers, right? And your first one is... Eh... ...rotten.
The Maiden Tower#033.dst: 我的天，女士！就算對食人妖來說，你也太過火了！啊，你看，食人妖跟你們這種人一樣，都是一層一層的，對吧？而你的第一層是……呃……爛掉的。
The Maiden Tower#033.speaker: Sherk

The Maiden Tower#034.src: Now I'm sure you'll find a nice lad somewhere who'll take you for who you are, but until you find someone who has no standards, shove your creepy lips where I can't see 'em!!
The Maiden Tower#034.dst: 我相信你總有一天會在哪裡找到一個願意接受真實的你的好小子，不過在你找到那個沒有標準的人之前，把你那噁心的嘴唇拿到我看不見的地方去！！
The Maiden Tower#034.speaker: Sherk

The Maiden Tower#035.src: ...I...I g-guess he was rotten to the core, despite his...l-luscious exterior ...but you'll make me feel better, right, you s-studly human? Right?! RIGHT?!!
The Maiden Tower#035.dst: ……我……我想他大概真的是爛到骨子裡了，儘管他……那、那麼有魅力……不過你會讓我好過一點的，對吧，你這個強、強壯的人類？對吧？！對吧？！！
The Maiden Tower#035.speaker: Maiden

The Mercenary#000.src: Talk to the Scout in {p} at [{~}, {~}, -{~}] or find one in another town.

The Mercenary#002.src: Admiral Amerigo of the Almuji Army requests the aid of able-bodied and unmoored soldiers from around the Province of Wynn.
The Mercenary#002.speaker: Military Scout

The Mercenary#003.src: To put it bluntly... they've run into a predicament over there. {p}'s standing army has been taken captive, and the desert barracks overtaken.
The Mercenary#003.speaker: Military Scout

The Mercenary#004.src: The Admiral has sent scouts round to gather any free-moving soldiers to help him... remedy the situation.
The Mercenary#004.speaker: Military Scout

The Mercenary#005.src: ... If you ask me, I reckon he'd like this taken care of quietly and discreetly. I don't blame the man, really, given the circumstances.
The Mercenary#005.speaker: Military Scout

The Mercenary#006.src: Anyhow, if you can, travel on over that way. {p} is the desert city to the east of {p}, if you've never seen it.
The Mercenary#006.speaker: Military Scout

The Mercenary#007.src: With that, I'm off! There are many more soldiers to find. Good luck, if you choose to heed the summons!
The Mercenary#007.speaker: Military Scout

The Mercenary#009.src: Admiral Amerigo of the Almuji Army requests the aid of able-bodied and unmoored soldiers from around the Province of Wynn.
The Mercenary#009.speaker: Military Scout

The Mercenary#010.src: To put it bluntly... they've run into a predicament over there. {p}'s standing army has been taken captive, and the desert barracks overtaken.
The Mercenary#010.speaker: Military Scout

The Mercenary#011.src: The Admiral has sent scouts round to gather any free-moving soldiers to help him... remedy the situation.
The Mercenary#011.speaker: Military Scout

The Mercenary#012.src: ... If you ask me, I reckon he'd like this taken care of quietly and discreetly. I don't blame the man, really, given the circumstances.
The Mercenary#012.speaker: Military Scout

The Mercenary#013.src: Anyhow, if you can, travel on over that way. {p} is the desert city to the east of {p}, if you've never seen it.
The Mercenary#013.speaker: Military Scout

The Mercenary#014.src: With that, I'm off! There are many more soldiers to find. Good luck, if you choose to heed the summons!
The Mercenary#014.speaker: Military Scout

The Mercenary#016.src: Admiral Amerigo of the Almuji Army requests the aid of able-bodied and unmoored soldiers from around the Province of Wynn.
The Mercenary#016.speaker: Military Scout

The Mercenary#017.src: To put it bluntly... they've run into a predicament over there. {p}'s standing army has been taken captive, and the desert barracks overtaken.
The Mercenary#017.speaker: Military Scout

The Mercenary#018.src: The Admiral has sent scouts round to gather any free-moving soldiers to help him... remedy the situation.
The Mercenary#018.speaker: Military Scout

The Mercenary#019.src: ... If you ask me, I reckon he'd like this taken care of quietly and discreetly. I don't blame the man, really, given the circumstances.
The Mercenary#019.speaker: Military Scout

The Mercenary#020.src: Anyhow, if you can, head on over to the Admiral's office. It's just by the bank, you can't miss it.
The Mercenary#020.speaker: Military Scout

The Mercenary#021.src: With that, I'm off! There are many more soldiers to find. Good luck, if you choose to heed the summons!
The Mercenary#021.speaker: Military Scout

The Mercenary#023.src: Ugh, for crying out loud- I'm busy, can't you see that? I don't have time to...
The Mercenary#023.speaker: Admiral Amerigo

The Mercenary#024.src: Ah. You're a soldier. Good, that's one more to add to the list. You met the scout, I'm sure.
The Mercenary#024.speaker: Admiral Amerigo

The Mercenary#025.src: Not as many of you lot as I would have hoped for, but it'll have to do. Come down here, the others are in the briefing room already.
The Mercenary#025.speaker: Admiral Amerigo

The Mercenary#026.src: Hmph. I suppose this is as many soldiers as we'll be able to get. Very well!
The Mercenary#026.speaker: Admiral Amerigo

The Mercenary#027.src: To begin with - the situation. Commander Takan of {p} has abandoned his post, and has taken the lead of a group of local bandits.
The Mercenary#027.speaker: Admiral Amerigo

The Mercenary#028.src: Under his command, they were able to strike our forces in the dead of night, and have taken over the barracks to the northeast.
The Mercenary#028.speaker: Admiral Amerigo

The Mercenary#029.src: Our entire military force, captured or killed! What a disgrace. We've sent messengers to {p}, and they have promised their support...
The Mercenary#029.speaker: Admiral Amerigo

The Mercenary#030.src: But I would like this dealt with quickly and quietly. That's where you five come in.
The Mercenary#030.speaker: Admiral Amerigo

The Mercenary#031.src: You will attack and infiltrate the barracks, and assassinate our treasonous commander. I will leave the strategizing to you, as there is much I still must handle here.
The Mercenary#031.speaker: Admiral Amerigo

The Mercenary#032.src: A question, if I may. Do we know the commander's reasoning for this attack? It seems out of character.
The Mercenary#032.speaker: Lanu

The Mercenary#033.src: ...No. There is nothing that I can recall that would motivate such an attack. Will that be all?
The Mercenary#033.speaker: Admiral Amerigo

The Mercenary#035.src: Then I must be off! Good luck, soldiers. I hope for a swift end to this disaster.
The Mercenary#035.speaker: Admiral Amerigo

The Mercenary#036.src: ...Well, darn. Bandits sound like trouble. Do we know what sort?
The Mercenary#036.speaker: Mel

The Mercenary#037.src: Does it matter? We'll probably be fighting them no matter what kind they are.
The Mercenary#037.speaker: Linton

The Mercenary#038.src: It might, actually... Some bandit groups are stronger than others. If we know which group we're dealing with ahead of time, it might-
The Mercenary#038.speaker: Lanu

The Mercenary#039.src: We've been standing around here for too long. Come on, let's make our way closer to the barracks. We can come up with a plan there.
The Mercenary#039.speaker: Aledar

The Mercenary#044.src: Well, darn. The place is swarming with bandits...
The Mercenary#044.speaker: Mel

The Mercenary#045.src: I don't see how that's a problem! We can just launch explosives into the crowd, and boom, problem solved.
The Mercenary#045.speaker: Linton

The Mercenary#047.src: We can't do that. You'd almost certainly damage the structure in the process!
The Mercenary#047.speaker: Lanu

The Mercenary#048.src: Ah, true. Can't forget about the historical value. Good catch.
The Mercenary#048.speaker: Linton

The Mercenary#049.src: ...Right. Well, anyway, I don't think we can get through those bandits with brute force. We'll have to try to find a way around them...
The Mercenary#049.speaker: Aledar

The Mercenary#050.src: Well, if I may interject- I reckon I won't be of much use in proper combat! Injured leg, 'n all. Makes moving a little hard!
The Mercenary#050.speaker: Mel

The Mercenary#051.src: So, if we think goin' right in won't work, I could try to create a distraction? I've got the magic for it, and I'd be of much more use out here.
The Mercenary#051.speaker: Mel

The Mercenary#052.src: It could work... if I join you, we'd be able to draw attention towards us while the others sneak in from a different angle.
The Mercenary#052.speaker: Lanu

The Mercenary#053.src: Good idea. But, how do we get in? I don't think there is another entrance, other than that one in front.
The Mercenary#053.speaker: Aledar

The Mercenary#055.src: This had better not be going where I think it is, Linton.
The Mercenary#055.speaker: Aledar

The Mercenary#056.src: Okay, maybe it is. But, listen! We don't have any entrances, right? What if we made our own... by blowing a hole through a wall?
The Mercenary#056.speaker: Linton

The Mercenary#057.src: ...Alright, fine. That sounds like it could work.
The Mercenary#057.speaker: Aledar

The Mercenary#059.src: Exactly! You need to have more faith in the experts, Aledar.
The Mercenary#059.speaker: Linton

The Mercenary#060.src: We all need to make sacrifices, Lanu.
The Mercenary#060.speaker: Mel

The Mercenary#061.src: Hm. No, I don't think I do. Either way, that sounds like a plan. {u}, Linton, and I will break into the barracks then.
The Mercenary#061.speaker: Aledar

The Mercenary#063.src: And Lanu and I can distract 'em while you do so. Sounds like a plan! Let's get goin'.
The Mercenary#063.speaker: Mel

The Mercenary#065.src: Well, well. This looks like a good place to break our way in, wouldn't you say, Aledar?
The Mercenary#065.speaker: Linton

The Mercenary#066.src: Yes, Linton, it looks fine. {u}, we'll be looking for Takan. I think the two of us could take him out.
The Mercenary#066.speaker: Aledar

The Mercenary#067.src: And I'll be looking for the captured soldiers! I stole a map of the barracks from Amerigo's desk, so I'll be able to find them easily enough!
The Mercenary#067.speaker: Linton

The Mercenary#068.src: You-... nevermind, I don't care. Just do your job, please?
The Mercenary#068.speaker: Aledar

The Mercenary#070.src: See you two on the other side!
The Mercenary#070.speaker: Linton

The Mercenary#073.src: Damn it... damn it, damn it, damn it ALL! Couldn't give me a MOMENT of peace, could he, that rat Amerigo...
The Mercenary#073.speaker: Takan

The Mercenary#074.src: ...do I really need to do everything myself?! It's almost as though-
The Mercenary#074.speaker: Takan

The Mercenary#075.src: Oh, I see. I see what's going on. More of Amerigo's dogs, here to take care of his business, huh?! Get out here where I can see you.
The Mercenary#075.speaker: Takan

The Mercenary#076.src: You look new... haven't been around long enough to really see the face of War up close and personal yet, have you?
The Mercenary#076.speaker: Takan

The Mercenary#077.src: You think this is right? You think it's right that those DAMNED admirals get all the wealth and fame, when WE'RE the ones out fighting in the trenches?!
The Mercenary#077.speaker: Takan

The Mercenary#078.src: I've seen soldiers fall and fall and fall, then rise back up again. I've lived through the chaos and death of battle more times than I could count.
The Mercenary#078.speaker: Takan

The Mercenary#079.src: And these IDIOTS think they deserve their power? Their authority?!
The Mercenary#079.speaker: Takan

The Mercenary#080.src: ...You've killed dozens, and you're keeping dozens more captured.
The Mercenary#080.speaker: Aledar

The Mercenary#081.src: And I'd do all that and more, just to prove my point! They think they hold power?! I'll show them power...
The Mercenary#081.speaker: Takan

The Mercenary#082.src: I suppose I'll start with you. What are two more compared to dozens?
The Mercenary#082.speaker: Takan

The Mercenary#083.src: Step aside, Shadow Spears. I'd like to deal with these dogs myself.
The Mercenary#083.speaker: Takan

The Mercenary#084.src: ...We won't make it easy for you.
The Mercenary#084.speaker: Aledar

The Mercenary#089.src: This tower can only go up... Come on, we need to chase after him! We can't let him get away!
The Mercenary#089.speaker: Aledar

The Mercenary#090.src: Continue up the stairs in the barracks.

The Mercenary#093.src: Look, it's obvious we've lost here. Even if that idiot escapes, you military folk will find him.
The Mercenary#093.speaker: Shadow Spears Leader

The Mercenary#094.src: So, I surrender! Don't see the point in fightin' a pointless battle. Not like we're gonna be paid after this mess, anyhow.
The Mercenary#094.speaker: Shadow Spears Leader

The Mercenary#095.src: Here, take the key to the tower. A sign of good faith. Do what you will with him, I really don't care.
The Mercenary#095.speaker: Shadow Spears Leader

The Mercenary#096.src: I always preferred his brother anyway. Much quieter.
The Mercenary#096.speaker: Shadow Spears Leader

The Mercenary#097.src: Ugh, more bandits... I'll hold them off here.
The Mercenary#097.speaker: Aledar

The Mercenary#098.src: Keep going after Takan! I'll be fine!
The Mercenary#098.speaker: Aledar

The Mercenary#099.src: Head up the tower and take out Takan.

The Mercenary#100.src: Urgh... Why did I even come up here?! There's nowhere for me to-
The Mercenary#100.speaker: Takan

The Mercenary#101.src: ...Oh. L-listen. We can talk this out-
The Mercenary#101.speaker: Takan

The Mercenary#104.src: ...and so then, I had to free them somehow! So I shouted at them to brace for it, and-
The Mercenary#104.speaker: Linton

The Mercenary#105.src: {u}! There you are! I'm glad you made it out safely. It looks like the bandits are dispersing.
The Mercenary#105.speaker: Aledar

The Mercenary#106.src: And so is my train of thought for my story. So! Did you get him?
The Mercenary#106.speaker: Linton

The Mercenary#107.src: That's good to hear. At least something good came of this whole situation...
The Mercenary#107.speaker: Lanu

The Mercenary#108.src: I'm glad we managed to take him out after all. The things he was saying... he seemed like a dangerous man.
The Mercenary#108.speaker: Aledar

The Mercenary#109.src: Oh, not this again. You're still on that?
The Mercenary#109.speaker: Mel

The Mercenary#110.src: I caught a few of the things he was shoutin' from outside. It didn't sound very pleasant.
The Mercenary#110.speaker: Mel

The Mercenary#111.src: Some of us care about history, Mel.
The Mercenary#111.speaker: Lanu

The Mercenary#112.src: Well, I didn't hear a thing. Probably on account of the ringing in my ears. It seems to me we're done here, though, right?
The Mercenary#112.speaker: Linton

The Mercenary#113.src: It looks like it, yes. I think I'll stay behind to help the soldiers clear out the remaining bandits.
The Mercenary#113.speaker: Lanu

The Mercenary#114.src: I figure I'll stick around too. Don't got anythin' better to do right now, anyway!
The Mercenary#114.speaker: Mel

The Mercenary#115.src: Well, I'm out of here. I've got places to be! Things to do! Explosives to return! Goodbye!
The Mercenary#115.speaker: Linton

The Mercenary#116.src: {u}, I guess that leaves the two of us to return to {p} with the news! Let's get going.
The Mercenary#116.speaker: Aledar

The Mercenary#117.src: Bring Takan's badge to Amerigo at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].

The Mercenary#118.src: Soldiers! Report! Don't tell me you're the only two survivors, damn it all...
The Mercenary#118.speaker: Admiral Amerigo

The Mercenary#119.src: No, sir, the mission was a success. Takan is dead.
The Mercenary#119.speaker: Aledar

The Mercenary#120.src: You're certain of this? You have his badge, surely...?
The Mercenary#120.speaker: Admiral Amerigo

The Mercenary#121.src: I see... satisfactory work, soldiers. You two, and the others, have {p}'s gratitude.
The Mercenary#121.speaker: Admiral Amerigo

The Mercenary#122.src: Admiral, sir. Some of what Takan is saying, it was-
The Mercenary#122.speaker: Aledar

The Mercenary#123.src: I wouldn't put too much stock in those traitor's words. People like him, who spit vitriol with no merit, riling up the masses against the order we hold.
The Mercenary#123.speaker: Admiral Amerigo

The Mercenary#124.src: He is an angry man holding a grudge for an imagined wrongdoing. There is nothing more to it than that. I would suggest putting it out of your mind.
The Mercenary#124.speaker: Admiral Amerigo

The Mercenary#125.src: You will all be well-compensated for your work today. Now, run along. I have to collect my honorary badge for taking out Ex-Commander Takan.
The Mercenary#125.speaker: Admiral Amerigo

The Mercenary#127.src: I'm starting to see why Takan hated him so much.
The Mercenary#127.speaker: Aledar

The Mercenary#128.src: I'll... probably try to speak to Admiral Aegis about that the next time I'm in {p}.
The Mercenary#128.speaker: Aledar

The Mercenary#129.src: Anyway! What an adventure, right? I can't wait to tell Tasim about it.
The Mercenary#129.speaker: Aledar

The Mercenary#130.src: ...Speaking of. Have you heard from him recently? I can't seem to get ahold of him at all.
The Mercenary#130.speaker: Aledar

The Mercenary#131.src: It's weird. Last I heard, he was at {p}, but he's not there anymore.
The Mercenary#131.speaker: Aledar

The Mercenary#132.src: He- what? Really? And he didn't even tell me...
The Mercenary#132.speaker: Aledar

The Mercenary#133.src: ...I guess it must have slipped his mind. That's alright. We're all busy around here, right?
The Mercenary#133.speaker: Aledar

The Mercenary#134.src: A general location is useful, though. I'll see if I can get any letters to him. Thanks for telling me.
The Mercenary#134.speaker: Aledar

The Mercenary#135.src: Yeah, that makes two of us...
The Mercenary#135.speaker: Aledar

The Mercenary#136.src: Well, it's probably fine. I'm sure he'll pop up eventually! We just need to wait.
The Mercenary#136.speaker: Aledar

The Mercenary#137.src: I wonder where he's gone off to? Some kind of assignment in {p}, maybe? Or could he have gone off to Gavel...?
The Mercenary#137.speaker: Aledar

The Mercenary#138.src: Well, whatever. It was good to see you again! Even if... well. Even if it was strange.
The Mercenary#138.speaker: Aledar

The Mercenary#140.src: Well, I guess I'm going to head off. I'll see you around, {u}!
The Mercenary#140.speaker: Aledar

The Missing Piece#000.src: Pick up your post in the Post Office at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

The Missing Piece#002.src: Don't you see I'm busy!? Take a ticket and wait in line as you're supposed to! i don't care if no one else is here, follow protocol!
The Missing Piece#002.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#003.src: Take a ticket from the Ticket Machine at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

The Missing Piece#004.src: You have to take a ticket, just like everyone else!
The Missing Piece#004.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#005.src: Return to the Post Office at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

The Missing Piece#008.src: I'll be with you in one second! Gosh, so impatient these days...
The Missing Piece#008.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#009.src: Tired of waiting already? Well, someone decided to leave this place a mess for when I returned!
The Missing Piece#009.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#010.src: I come back to the office yesterday from a well-deserved, brief, eighteen week, vacation. And this is how I'm thanked?!
The Missing Piece#010.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#011.src: Do you see the mess my substitute left this place in? And now I have to clean it up, or the Royal Inspector will have my head!
The Missing Piece#011.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#012.src: I'll have you know I graduated with honours from the Royal University of Aelumia.
The Missing Piece#012.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#013.src: Frankly, it's demeaning they stuck me out here with the... ugh... peasants! Oh, and don't even get me started on the smell!
The Missing Piece#013.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#014.src: But anyway, that is all besides the point. What did you want again?
The Missing Piece#014.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#015.src: It's you! You're the one I left in charge over my vacation, you scoundrel!
The Missing Piece#015.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#016.src: I knew it! A university graduate like me couldn't possibly be wrong!
The Missing Piece#016.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#017.src: Don't try to weasel your way out of it! A university graduate like me couldn't possibly be wrong!
The Missing Piece#017.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#020.src: It's not just me who's going to be in trouble when the inspection comes, surely you realize that?
The Missing Piece#020.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#022.src: If you fix this mess you made... Then no one ever has to hear a word of what happened.
The Missing Piece#022.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#023.src: You don't get in trouble, the Royal Inspector is happy, I'm happy. Everyone is happy!
The Missing Piece#023.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#026.src: Then I'll have you sorting post like your life depends on it, scoundrel!
The Missing Piece#026.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#030.src: Sorting is so easy even someone like you should be able to do it.
The Missing Piece#030.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#031.src: All you do is take the packages from the conveyor over there.
The Missing Piece#031.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#032.src: And put them where they're supposed to go over there.
The Missing Piece#032.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#033.src: {p} packages to the {p}, Auburn packages to the {p}, and so on.
The Missing Piece#033.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#035.src: Fantastic! Just don't make a mess of it, okay?
The Missing Piece#035.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#039.src: Well, that was just the warmup! There's more to come, so don't go slacking off now!
The Missing Piece#039.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#040.src: Hmm... You did fine this time, but watch out, because these last packages come fast!
The Missing Piece#040.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#041.src: Don't think you're somebody just because you can sort some packages!
The Missing Piece#041.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#042.src: What are you doing over there!?
The Missing Piece#042.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#043.src: Agh! Try again, but you better do it right this time!
The Missing Piece#043.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#044.src: Agh! Try again, but you better do it right this time!
The Missing Piece#044.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#045.src: Don't bother me while I'm working! I didn't go to university just to slack off with people like you!
The Missing Piece#045.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#047.src: Ah, perfect! You sorted the packages!
The Missing Piece#047.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#048.src: But wait, what's this then? Why are there so many packages to the {p}?
The Missing Piece#048.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#049.src: Did you mess up the sorting, you fool!?
The Missing Piece#049.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#050.src: What's up with these packages! They're filled with letters?
The Missing Piece#050.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#051.src: Hmph... all of them to the woman on the hill... Whatever that means!
The Missing Piece#051.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#052.src: Hey you, scoundrel. This is part of your duty too, you know!
The Missing Piece#052.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#053.src: Go deliver these letters! Or... or I'll tell the Royal Inspector about what you did! That's right, don't mess with me!
The Missing Piece#053.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#054.src: How should I know! That's your job to figure out. See, it says here 'to the woman on the hill', that should be enough shouldn't it?
The Missing Piece#054.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#055.src: Oh, but you are! I have very many friends, in very high places! Met them in university, makes sure to remember that!
The Missing Piece#055.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#056.src: Great! Now with that settled I can finally go back to my very important work.
The Missing Piece#056.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#057.src: Oh, yes. Very important. University graduate, did I mention that?
The Missing Piece#057.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#058.src: Now now, off you go. And don't come back crying if you can't find this mysterious woman!
The Missing Piece#058.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#059.src: But if you lose the letter I can always give you another, they seem to be practically infinite anyhow!
The Missing Piece#059.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#060.src: Find out about the woman on the hill around [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

The Missing Piece#061.src: Are you trying to slack off? You still have the letter on you, go deliver it!
The Missing Piece#061.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#063.src: Hmm, you lost the letter? Already!?
The Missing Piece#063.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#064.src: Don't think you're getting out of this! I have spares!
The Missing Piece#064.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#065.src: Now go on and sort this out for me, won't you? I have enough to worry about as is without you bungling about!
The Missing Piece#065.speaker: Postmaster

The Missing Piece#067.src: Looking for someone, huh? 'round these parts it's usually the tin cans who do that.
The Missing Piece#067.speaker: Vagabond

The Missing Piece#068.src: A visit from one of those and you get an all-expenses-paid vacation on the Crown, if you catch my drift.
The Missing Piece#068.speaker: Vagabond

The Missing Piece#069.src: Safe to say, if it were Lars you were looking for I'd be happy to rat him out, but you haven't told me who it is yet.
The Missing Piece#069.speaker: Vagabond

The Missing Piece#070.src: PLenty of hills 'round these parts, women too. But they're in the factories, slaving away, not on any hills 'sfar as I'm aware.
The Missing Piece#070.speaker: Vagabond

The Missing Piece#071.src: Sorry bud, don't think I can help you with this one. Try asking Lars, he's usually hogging the fire in the alley here behind me. Hate that guy...
The Missing Piece#071.speaker: Vagabond

The Missing Piece#073.src: Already told you everythin', didn't I? Go harass Lars instead, I have nothing more to say.
The Missing Piece#073.speaker: Vagabond

The Missing Piece#075.src: I'm looking for someone called 'the woman on the hill'. I have a letter I need to deliver to her.
The Missing Piece#075.speaker: Vagrant

The Missing Piece#076.src: A letter? Don't know nuthin' about no woman on the hill, but maybe Bush over there would know.
The Missing Piece#076.speaker: Vagrant

The Missing Piece#077.src: He usually knows things... He's a knower.
The Missing Piece#077.speaker: Vagrant

The Missing Piece#078.src: Don't talk to him for too long though, or he'll start putting strange ideas in your head...
The Missing Piece#078.speaker: Vagrant

The Missing Piece#080.src: Ask Bush. I told you I don't know nuthin'.
The Missing Piece#080.speaker: Vagrant

The Missing Piece#081.src: I'm Bush, nice to meet you. Is there something you wish to know?
The Missing Piece#081.speaker: Bush

The Missing Piece#082.src: Oh, yes, her... This bush knows her all too well!
The Missing Piece#082.speaker: Bush

The Missing Piece#083.src: Without her this bush would wilt! Yes, a bush requires water to grow. I know, I know!
The Missing Piece#083.speaker: Bush

The Missing Piece#084.src: But first, I must know why you must know! Do you know?
The Missing Piece#084.speaker: Bush

The Missing Piece#085.src: A letter! If only this Bush could know its contents... Alas, it would be rude to know...
The Missing Piece#085.speaker: Bush

The Missing Piece#086.src: The mail-deliverer, truly a noble profession. I will share with you her location, but in exchange you must tell her: her friend is back in town.
The Missing Piece#086.speaker: Bush

The Missing Piece#087.src: Here, let me write it down for you!
The Missing Piece#087.speaker: Bush

The Missing Piece#088.src: Now you know! Now you know!
The Missing Piece#088.speaker: Bush

The Missing Piece#089.src: To know why I must know? Not even I know... All I know is that I must know!
The Missing Piece#089.speaker: Bush

The Missing Piece#090.src: Again, tell me why you must know.
The Missing Piece#090.speaker: Bush

The Missing Piece#091.src: Nothing? That such people existed, I did not know! Now I know, now I know!
The Missing Piece#091.speaker: Bush

The Missing Piece#093.src: Now you know! Now you know!
The Missing Piece#093.speaker: Bush

The Missing Piece#095.src: Post? You must be at the wrong house, dear.
The Missing Piece#095.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#096.src: No one is sending me any of that...
The Missing Piece#096.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#097.src: Well, if it says so on the letter...
The Missing Piece#097.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#098.src: Come in and we'll talk about it.
The Missing Piece#098.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#100.src: I don't usually get a lot of visitors up on the hill.
The Missing Piece#100.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#105.src: Place the letters on the table at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

The Missing Piece#108.src: I think I'll need a closer look at this.
The Missing Piece#108.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#109.src: Please, have a seat. I'll make you something to drink.
The Missing Piece#109.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#111.src: You don't look like you're from around these parts, do you?
The Missing Piece#111.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#112.src: Hmm? Well, I shouldn't pry into my guest's secrets. Better to let the unexplained rest, ha. Wouldn't you agree?
The Missing Piece#112.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#113.src: Here in the Roughworks, we don't have any secrets. At least that's what Her Majesty wants to believe, ha.
The Missing Piece#113.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#114.src: That's why I chose to live here. In the neighborhoods, the walls are thinner than paper. Nothing goes unheard.
The Missing Piece#114.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#115.src: Up here on the hill, it's much more peaceful. As long as the Water Authority doesn't come knocking, ha.
The Missing Piece#115.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#116.src: Well, if you're already here, why don't we have a little chat? Not a lot of people to talk to up here!
The Missing Piece#116.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#117.src: Pick up the Watering Can outside at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

The Missing Piece#118.src: The watering can is just outside in the garden. There are three plants inside and three plants outside.
The Missing Piece#118.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#119.src: Water Elise's plants while she reads the letters.

The Missing Piece#121.src: Oh, what a mess... trying to make sense of this is making my head hurt.
The Missing Piece#121.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#122.src: So many letters, over so many years... who would possibly be so insistent on reaching me?
The Missing Piece#122.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#123.src: Hm? Oh, you finished watering the plants already? That was quick!
The Missing Piece#123.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#124.src: Well, I certainly won't make any progress like this, and it seems we both are in need of a break.
The Missing Piece#124.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#125.src: Oh, it's such a lovely day today... Why don't we go outside and enjoy the garden for a bit?
The Missing Piece#125.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#126.src: Follow Elise outside and take a seat at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

The Missing Piece#128.src: It really is beautiful today, isn't it?
The Missing Piece#128.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#129.src: Ah... freshly watered flowers. Nothing beats that smell.
The Missing Piece#129.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#130.src: Hm. Do you see that tree over there?
The Missing Piece#130.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#131.src: It's the only one of its kind in the whole of the Roughworks. Isn't it beautiful?
The Missing Piece#131.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#132.src: It was a gift, but from who... It's another thing I've forgotten.
The Missing Piece#132.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#133.src: It's frustrating, so frustrating... All these precious memories...
The Missing Piece#133.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#135.src: It isn't much now, that is for certain.

The Missing Piece#136.src: Well. It's beautiful already, don't you think?
The Missing Piece#136.speaker: Elise

The Missing Piece#138.src: Ha! Of course it will, it's a tree!
The Missing Piece#138.speaker: Elise
