The Price of Ingenuity#181.src: It's like... there's an ocean of swirling energy, all around me. If I can get a bit, in, like... a bucket, I can use it. But... I don't know how to get it without, um, falling into it and getting overwhelmed.
The Price of Ingenuity#181.speaker: Sui

The Price of Ingenuity#183.src: Uh... n- not- not really, but-
The Price of Ingenuity#183.speaker: Zeph

The Price of Ingenuity#188.src: I... I'm fine. No, even... more than that...
The Price of Ingenuity#188.speaker: Sui

The Price of Ingenuity#189.src: It's like... I finally felt this power's ebb and flow, not just... it pouring out, I...
The Price of Ingenuity#189.speaker: Sui

The Price of Ingenuity#190.src: ...ah! Is everyone fine? You... you all seem fine. Okay...
The Price of Ingenuity#190.speaker: Sui

The Price of Ingenuity#191.src: I think... I think that's all from me.
The Price of Ingenuity#191.speaker: Sui

The Price of Ingenuity#192.src: Very well! This is as good an opportunity as any to show off my progress!
The Price of Ingenuity#192.speaker: Mora

The Price of Ingenuity#193.src: Although I am proficient in combat with my hammer, that is... standard. So, allow me to show my magic instead, as that is what I have been training!
The Price of Ingenuity#193.speaker: Mora

The Price of Ingenuity#194.src: ...oh, dear. I did not expect it to have become so powerful! It seems I must still master control over it...
The Price of Ingenuity#194.speaker: Mora

The Price of Ingenuity#195.src: I apologize for the damage I have caused. If you would ask for compensation, I would gladly provide it.
The Price of Ingenuity#195.speaker: Mora

The Price of Ingenuity#196.src: Eh, don't worry about it. It's just a training room. Besides, all this junk in here doesn't even work anymore.
The Price of Ingenuity#196.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#198.src: Yo, that was badass, man! Your curse is awesome.
The Price of Ingenuity#198.speaker: Yuman

The Price of Ingenuity#199.src: Is it! I suppose it is, haha! I am glad to have had the oppurtunity to learn to use it.
The Price of Ingenuity#199.speaker: Mora

The Price of Ingenuity#200.src: That is all, then. Who will go next?
The Price of Ingenuity#200.speaker: Mora

The Price of Ingenuity#201.src: Lemme show you just what I can really do, man.
The Price of Ingenuity#201.speaker: Yuman

The Price of Ingenuity#202.src: Watch and learn, princess. Not every day you get to see me shred.
The Price of Ingenuity#202.speaker: Yuman

The Price of Ingenuity#204.src: Yuman But wait! That's not all!
The Price of Ingenuity#204.speaker: Yuman

The Price of Ingenuity#205.src: My Sonic Boomer can help out with defense too! I'm no one trick pony - I can cover every genre of combat!
The Price of Ingenuity#205.speaker: Yuman

The Price of Ingenuity#206.src: And bam! That's it from me and Sonic Boomer for today.
The Price of Ingenuity#206.speaker: Yuman

The Price of Ingenuity#209.src: I'll say, I'm not as... direct... as Yuman. But I can hold my own in a fight.
The Price of Ingenuity#209.speaker: Yulie

The Price of Ingenuity#211.src: I mean... yeah? Yusanu made this thing for me, and he calls it the Electric Blaster.
The Price of Ingenuity#211.speaker: Yulie

The Price of Ingenuity#212.src: It's also able to fire a much larger blast with way more power, but that does make it less... precise.
The Price of Ingenuity#212.speaker: Yulie

The Price of Ingenuity#213.src: That's all from me. Next one!
The Price of Ingenuity#213.speaker: Yulie

The Price of Ingenuity#214.src: Alrighty! Let's see... where to start...
The Price of Ingenuity#214.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#215.src: Oh, you have gotta be... again?! Really?! Ugh!
The Price of Ingenuity#215.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#216.src: Yulie, Yuman, can you check the tunnels for any intruders?
The Price of Ingenuity#216.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#217.src: If you need us to. Keep us updated, would you?
The Price of Ingenuity#217.speaker: Yulie

The Price of Ingenuity#218.src: Sure. Get the others to help you, I gotta run and check on things!
The Price of Ingenuity#218.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#219.src: Of course we can help, just tell us what to do!
The Price of Ingenuity#219.speaker: Mora

The Price of Ingenuity#220.src: {u} and I actually have some important tasks Syndra needed done!! Will you be okay without us?
The Price of Ingenuity#220.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#221.src: We will. It shouldn't be too hard for us, anyway- just routine check ups.
The Price of Ingenuity#221.speaker: Yulie

The Price of Ingenuity#222.src: Yep, yep! Alright guys, follow papa!
The Price of Ingenuity#222.speaker: Yuman

The Price of Ingenuity#223.src: Wh- what? Ugh... put some c- cl- clothes on, a- at- at least.
The Price of Ingenuity#223.speaker: Zeph

The Price of Ingenuity#227.src: I needed a way to get everyone else out of here so we could talk!
The Price of Ingenuity#227.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#228.src: Yeah, obviously! It was the best excuse I could come up with in the moment.
The Price of Ingenuity#228.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#229.src: So, look. Yusanu's been really hard to get a read of! He's barely ever around- I'm honestly surprised he even showed up today!
The Price of Ingenuity#229.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#230.src: But anyway, when you and Zeph headed out with Yuman during the last alarm, I wanted to check in with Yusanu and see what he was up to.
The Price of Ingenuity#230.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#231.src: But guess what? He was gone! Walked into his workshop and never walked out. Isn't that weird?
The Price of Ingenuity#231.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#232.src: I don't know what it means, and I don't know if he's a risk to us or not. But what I do know is that he's suspicious!
The Price of Ingenuity#232.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#233.src: Because they'd all probably tell me not to do anything impulsive right now. Which isn't even true, I've thought this plan out extensively!
The Price of Ingenuity#233.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#234.src: Come on, meet me outside his workshop! I just want to look. If it's nothing, then it's nothing! But I don't think it's nothing.
The Price of Ingenuity#234.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#236.src: I'll meet up with you at the workshop.
The Price of Ingenuity#236.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#239.src: See? I told you! He's just... gone.
The Price of Ingenuity#239.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#240.src: Not even a trace... Seems like I wasn't distrustful for nothing. But how?
The Price of Ingenuity#240.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#241.src: He has to have gone somewhere! He couldn't have just... vanished.
The Price of Ingenuity#241.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#242.src: There has to be something else going on here! Do you see why I suspect him now?
The Price of Ingenuity#242.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#243.src: Let's snoop around a bit and make sure he's not posing a threat to us.
The Price of Ingenuity#243.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#244.src: I'm glad you feel that way. Makes me feel less... horrible... about it.
The Price of Ingenuity#244.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#245.src: I guess we can be horrible people together, then.
The Price of Ingenuity#245.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#246.src: I get it, trust me. They've taken us in and given us a place to stay, and now...
The Price of Ingenuity#246.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#247.src: If we're wrong, if I'm wrong, then we both might get thrown out.
The Price of Ingenuity#247.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#248.src: The blame will land squarely on us both. I really hope that even if we are kicked out, the rest can still stay here...
The Price of Ingenuity#248.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#249.src: ...no time to dwell on that. He must have left the workshop through an exit somewhere. Let's look around and see what we can find.
The Price of Ingenuity#249.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#250.src: Try and find Yusanu in his workshop at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

The Price of Ingenuity#251.src: Aha! And you thought I was just being paranoid.
The Price of Ingenuity#251.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#252.src: But you were thinking it, I could tell!
The Price of Ingenuity#252.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#253.src: Okay, fine, maybe a little. But I was right to be!
The Price of Ingenuity#253.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#254.src: That's confirmation. Though, not like we needed it...
The Price of Ingenuity#254.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#257.src: Yusanu's really puulling out all the stops to make sure nobody follows him!
The Price of Ingenuity#257.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#258.src: Too bad we're persistent, though. There's got to be some way to open it, we just need to find it!
The Price of Ingenuity#258.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#259.src: Whatever you did seems to have worked, the door's open!
The Price of Ingenuity#259.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#261.src: Dead end? No, I see something on the other side...
The Price of Ingenuity#261.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#262.src: How do we get across? I guess you could try to use your magic... but I don't want you to put yourself at risk just cause I dragged you along for this.
The Price of Ingenuity#262.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#265.src: Oh! Yusanu has to have taken this way, there aren't any other options. So, there's a trick to it...
The Price of Ingenuity#265.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#266.src: Look, over there! Do you see the button on the other side? I bet he uses it to close off this path whenever he takes it.
The Price of Ingenuity#266.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#267.src: It's a good thing you have the best sharpshooter in all of Fruma on your side! A shot like that is nothing to me.
The Price of Ingenuity#267.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#268.src: Just a moment... need to line it up... just right...
The Price of Ingenuity#268.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#269.src: Got it! Oh, that's more precarious than I expected. Be careful!
The Price of Ingenuity#269.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#271.src: ...okay, why are we right outside the Sovereign's mansion?!
The Price of Ingenuity#271.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#272.src: This place is so heavily guarded, and he just has a secret tunnel directly to the front door?!
The Price of Ingenuity#272.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#274.src: We can't just leave it here, obviously, but we're definitely not getting through the front door...
The Price of Ingenuity#274.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#275.src: Loko, up there. The arch connects to the main structure, and probably has a way inside.
The Price of Ingenuity#275.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#276.src: Maybe we can get up by climbing this building over here!
The Price of Ingenuity#276.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#277.src: Travel up the nearby building at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] and enter Soosu's mansion.

The Price of Ingenuity#278.src: Sneak through Soosu's mansion looking for Yusanu at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

The Price of Ingenuity#279.src: ... Hey, stay on your guard. We don't want to get caught in here.
The Price of Ingenuity#279.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#280.src: Though... it's kind of quiet in here. Weird.
The Price of Ingenuity#280.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#281.src: Okay. Okay okay. That's a lot of buttons.
The Price of Ingenuity#281.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#282.src: So these two say up and down... over here it looks like a list...? Office, Workshop, Quarters, Workshop {~}, Roof Workshop... And why is there a lever? It's not even labeled.
The Price of Ingenuity#282.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#283.src: Ugh, I can never figure out Roughworks machines. Always overly complicated...
The Price of Ingenuity#283.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#284.src: Well, what about you? Any thoughts?
The Price of Ingenuity#284.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#285.src: Okay. Sure! As good a suggestion as any.
The Price of Ingenuity#285.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#286.src: ...so, which one of these is up?
The Price of Ingenuity#286.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#287.src: Okay. Thanks for the input. I'm... not going to do that! That sounds like an awful idea- has Zeph been rubbing off on you?
The Price of Ingenuity#287.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#288.src: And I thought one of him was bad enough...
The Price of Ingenuity#288.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#289.src: Oh, whatever! Let's just try something.
The Price of Ingenuity#289.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#293.src: That was... I don't want to talk about it.
The Price of Ingenuity#293.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#294.src: Wait! {u}, quietly, come look at this.
The Price of Ingenuity#294.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#295.src: Shoot, they're coming this way! Follow me!
The Price of Ingenuity#295.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#299.src: N-O-O-O!!! Mother w-o-o-o-ould know what to do!
The Price of Ingenuity#299.speaker: Glitter

The Price of Ingenuity#301.src: Those "guards" don't seem very normal, do they? Isn't this supposed to be the Sovereign's mansion?
The Price of Ingenuity#301.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#302.src: They didn't even see us... oh, whatever. Let's keep moving.
The Price of Ingenuity#302.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#304.src: Why did you call me here again so soon? I was just here yesterday.
The Price of Ingenuity#304.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#305.src: Oh, don't play dumb! Dead soldiers! Killed on the job! Sound familiar??
The Price of Ingenuity#305.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

The Price of Ingenuity#307.src: Well, it better! Again - dead soldiers!! We had an agreement, Yus, and you've clearly gone and broken it!
The Price of Ingenuity#307.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

The Price of Ingenuity#308.src: I- I know. And I'm sorry that it happened. But- it happened while I was here, working! What do you expect me to have done about it?!
The Price of Ingenuity#308.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#309.src: Hmph! You're smart, aren't you? Smart enough to be able to grasp the fundamentals of conductivity and electrical currents! You could have found a way.
The Price of Ingenuity#309.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

The Price of Ingenuity#310.src: It's such a shame... you were one of my favorites, Yus. And now you've really let me down.
The Price of Ingenuity#310.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

The Price of Ingenuity#311.src: ...I know. I- I'll find a way to fix it. Tell me what to do, and- and I can. Whatever I need to- so I can keep them safe- I'll, I'll do it.
The Price of Ingenuity#311.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#312.src: Oh, Yus, you're so silly. There's nothing you can do to fix this now. The damage is done, and nobody around here will shut! Up! About it!!!
The Price of Ingenuity#312.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

The Price of Ingenuity#313.src: I let you live in that abandoned trainyard because I thought you'd be quiet. But this isn't quiet! I can't focus now that everyone is-
The Price of Ingenuity#313.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

The Price of Ingenuity#315.src: A GHO–O–O–OST! SPARKLES HEARD A GHO–O–O–O–OST! WHAT DO WE–E–E–E DO???
The Price of Ingenuity#315.speaker: Glitter

The Price of Ingenuity#316.src: Ugh! Not now!! Can't you see mommy's busy?!
The Price of Ingenuity#316.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

The Price of Ingenuity#318.src: ...They'll be fine. I'll just bring them back later!
The Price of Ingenuity#318.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

The Price of Ingenuity#319.src: You know, they've been getting better and better at replicating human behavior! My latest constructs were at an estimated {~} accuracy-
The Price of Ingenuity#319.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

The Price of Ingenuity#321.src: Right! Here's what you can do for me, Yus. This isn't going to go away. I need someone to pin this on, so they'll all shut up and move on from it!
The Price of Ingenuity#321.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

The Price of Ingenuity#322.src: Especially that loudmouth from the north! Would it kill him to leave me alone and stop meddling in my business??
The Price of Ingenuity#322.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

The Price of Ingenuity#324.src: Don't answer that. Look, this is the only way. You need to hand over whoever is responsible for this whole thing. That's the only way we can keep our peace and keep being friends.
The Price of Ingenuity#324.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

The Price of Ingenuity#325.src: Wh- you can't be serious! I can't do that, Soosu! You- you really expect me to give up one of my friends or family?!
The Price of Ingenuity#325.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#326.src: No, Yus, what I expected from you was to keep your "friends and family" quiet! But we're past that point now. Something needs to happen.
The Price of Ingenuity#326.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

The Price of Ingenuity#327.src: I-... I understand. I need to think. I'll... I'll let you know soon.
The Price of Ingenuity#327.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#328.src: What is he doing?! Sneaking around, meeting with the Sovereign?!
The Price of Ingenuity#328.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#329.src: We need to cut him off. I'm not letting him get away with this. Follow me, quickly!
The Price of Ingenuity#329.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#330.src: Come on! Let's see if we can cut him off before he enters the tunnel!
The Price of Ingenuity#330.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#332.src: Okay. This is as good a place as any to hide out and wait...
The Price of Ingenuity#332.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#333.src: I can't believe this! I can't believe him! How long has he been doing this?
The Price of Ingenuity#333.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#334.src: I... uh, I'll see you guys later, I... guess.
The Price of Ingenuity#334.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#338.src: Not a word, Yusanu. You are in no position to be asking questions!
The Price of Ingenuity#338.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#339.src: Secretly meeting with the Sovereign? Really? Are you insane?!
The Price of Ingenuity#339.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#340.src: You- you... followed me... oh, no... no no no, no... you weren't seen, were you? You're going to ruin ev-
The Price of Ingenuity#340.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#341.src: We're going to ruin everything?! And not you, the guy always sneaking off to meet the Sovereign?!
The Price of Ingenuity#341.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#342.src: You don't understand! The only reason we're safe down there is BECAUSE I struck a deal with her!!
The Price of Ingenuity#342.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#344.src: I work as her assistant in her workshop, help her with whatever projects she's working on, and in exchange she allows us to live in the station!
The Price of Ingenuity#344.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#345.src: As long as we don't cause any trouble with soldiers, at least- which, might I remind you, you people caused? So don't- don't act like...
The Price of Ingenuity#345.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#346.src: Oh my god, you idiot. How long were you planning to keep this a secret? Were you ever going to tell anyone?
The Price of Ingenuity#346.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#348.src: You were just gonna let it sit until, inevitably, someone was going to piss off the soldiers? Because, trust me, that would have happened eventually. With or without us.
The Price of Ingenuity#348.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#350.src: Ack! You- you heard that part too?
The Price of Ingenuity#350.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#352.src: Ughhh.... I don't know! I don't know. I don't want to, obviously! You're all good people, and it'd break every single one of our guidelines to throw someone out like that!
The Price of Ingenuity#352.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#353.src: But... I don't think I have a choice. The Steel Feather's safety is on the line, and I could fix it by just- just- handing someone over, but- I- I can't. I can't do that.
The Price of Ingenuity#353.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#355.src: Okay. You were doing what you thought was right. I can understand that. But this - keeping secrets, following their rules - it was never going to end well!
The Price of Ingenuity#355.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#356.src: We can get past this choice by doing what we were already doing - trying to take down the crown! If we succeed, there won't be any more risk for you all.
The Price of Ingenuity#356.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#358.src: This is your chance to make it right, Yusanu! You have information. Tell us what you and the Sovereign were working on. Is it important?
The Price of Ingenuity#358.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#359.src: ...I don't know much about... what it is. I know it's not a weapon, at least- Soosu was clear on that. It's... an important assignment from the Queen.
The Price of Ingenuity#359.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#360.src: It's- it's strange. Very, very strange. It uses science that sounds... impossible. I think we're building over an existing device, something the Queen already had.
The Price of Ingenuity#360.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#361.src: Soosu... she's stressed about the project. She needs to get it done, but it- it seems like an impossible task. There's something on the line for her.
The Price of Ingenuity#361.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#362.src: ...mysterious device, important to the crown... got it. {u}, Yusanu- we need to steal it. If it's important to the crown... whatever it does, it's better if they don't have it.
The Price of Ingenuity#362.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#363.src: Wh- what?! You can't be serious! We can't just-
The Price of Ingenuity#363.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#364.src: We can, and we should! The Sovereigns aren't your friends, Yusanu, they're complicit in and responsible for everything wrong with Fruma!!
The Price of Ingenuity#364.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#365.src: If we can hurt them, then we can hurt the crown. And if we can hurt the crown... we might actually stand a chance.
The Price of Ingenuity#365.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#366.src: ...okay. Okay, fine! You're right. You're... right.
The Price of Ingenuity#366.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#367.src: I can get you to it. Uh... how did you get in, anyway?
The Price of Ingenuity#367.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#368.src: We'll show you. Come on, back in we go.
The Price of Ingenuity#368.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#372.src: Right, we'll need to be fast. Soosu tends to spend most of her time in the workshops...
The Price of Ingenuity#372.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#374.src: I... would probably be fine. But if she sees you two, then...
The Price of Ingenuity#374.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#375.src: So don't get caught, got it. I'm guessing we wouldn't stand a chance fighting her?
The Price of Ingenuity#375.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#376.src: No!! No, no, absolutely not. Her blessing... I haven't seen her use it in combat, but knowing what it can do...
The Price of Ingenuity#376.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#377.src: Being able to mold matter... it means more than just putting together machines. So...
The Price of Ingenuity#377.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#378.src: It won't come to that. Come one, let's get going.
The Price of Ingenuity#378.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#379.src: Alright, before we descend - Soosu has a bunch of golems walking around her workshop.
The Price of Ingenuity#379.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#380.src: They're more... uh, advanced than Sparkles and Glitter. If they see us, they'll sound the alarms. So don't get caught!
The Price of Ingenuity#380.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#381.src: How did you two even manage to find me?
The Price of Ingenuity#381.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#382.src: Really? I'm... surprised the system held together long enough for that.
The Price of Ingenuity#382.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#383.src: Look, it's not our fault this... thing doesn't come with an instruction manual!
The Price of Ingenuity#383.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#384.src: Ha! Okay, it's a little hard to figure out. You have to pick the destination, then hit up or down, and then pull the lever to turn it on! Simple.
The Price of Ingenuity#384.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#385.src: That... sounds right, but the way you say that is concerning. What actually happened?
The Price of Ingenuity#385.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#386.src: Ugh, it doesn't matter what happened. What matters is this stupid box is overly complicated and annoying!
The Price of Ingenuity#386.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#387.src: Okay, okay! It is... a little hard to figure out. You have to pick the destination, then hit up or down, and then pull the lever to turn it on! Simple.
The Price of Ingenuity#387.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#388.src: ...I chose the music, by the way.
The Price of Ingenuity#388.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#390.src: Oh... I forgot how much of a mess it was down here.
The Price of Ingenuity#390.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#391.src: Sneak through the mansion avoiding the guards.

The Price of Ingenuity#392.src: Alright! That's our goal, over there.
The Price of Ingenuity#392.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#393.src: It's the most important sector of Soosu's workshop.
The Price of Ingenuity#393.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#394.src: Look around Soosu's workshop for the device.

The Price of Ingenuity#395.src: And you're sure she won't be coming down here?
The Price of Ingenuity#395.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#396.src: Uh... mostly. {~} sure. We should be fine today, if we move quickly.
The Price of Ingenuity#396.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#398.src: The festival's coming up, so she has a lot to handle. She'll be busy cleaning up the other workshops, building whatever contraptions she needs for this year's festival... that sort of stuff.
The Price of Ingenuity#398.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#399.src: She only comes down here for the big projects. Well, or when she needs to let out some steam. But she doesn't have anything going on today, so... we're safe.
The Price of Ingenuity#399.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#400.src: ...if you say so, Yusanu. Still, I'd rather be out of here quickly.
The Price of Ingenuity#400.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#401.src: Yeah... same. Let's take the device and go.
The Price of Ingenuity#401.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#402.src: This is Soosu's favorite room in the workshop. Her golem creation room.
The Price of Ingenuity#402.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#403.src: She... told me once that she likes working with plants. It's why a lot of her golems are built off of flower pots and soil.
The Price of Ingenuity#403.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#404.src: Hm. Well, good thing she's using her blessing on this, and not... I don't know. Reshaping the whole world?
The Price of Ingenuity#404.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#405.src: A-another golem? Should we turn back?
The Price of Ingenuity#405.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#406.src: Oh, hey, it's Flowers! That's Soosu's favourite golem! Wonder why he's sleeping here and not on his Flowersbed, though. ... I wasn't the one that named that.
The Price of Ingenuity#406.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#407.src: *** Finally!!! He said yes!!! Uncle T finally let me visit his workshop, I'm so excited!!!!
The Price of Ingenuity#407.speaker: 125 NA

The Price of Ingenuity#408.src: *** He's real!! Flowers is REAL NOW!!!! I showed Ma my drawing, and she helped me sew him together!! Now I can match with Fiona! She has Daruma, and I have... Flowers!
The Price of Ingenuity#408.speaker: 125 NA

The Price of Ingenuity#409.src: *** Hmph. Hmph!!!!!!!! Fiona's old enough now, she's gotta work too... she's always so tired now, she won't play with me anymore!!!! This sucks. This sucks!!!!
The Price of Ingenuity#409.speaker: 126 NA

The Price of Ingenuity#410.src: *** Uncle T agreed to help me make the super ultra cow milker o-matic!!
The Price of Ingenuity#410.speaker: 126 NA

The Price of Ingenuity#412.src: *** Grrrrrr............ I haven't written in AGES......... and it's because I gotta WORK!!!! In the FIELDS!!!!
The Price of Ingenuity#412.speaker: 127 NA

The Price of Ingenuity#413.src: *** I've been READING!! Reading so so many books... about FARMING!
The Price of Ingenuity#413.speaker: 128 NA

The Price of Ingenuity#414.src: *** It's that time of year again!! The FESTIVAL OF THE CROWN!!! Just a week away!!!
The Price of Ingenuity#414.speaker: 128 NA

The Price of Ingenuity#415.src: *** Weird thing happened today. Uncle T came home with a strange man from the military, big ol fancy uniform and all!
The Price of Ingenuity#415.speaker: 128 NA

The Price of Ingenuity#416.src: *** It turns out, the Crown really liked my super duper farmer!! Cause it makes it easier to harvest crops and stuff, they want us to make more of them, so everyone can do their work faster!!!
The Price of Ingenuity#416.speaker: 128 NA

The Price of Ingenuity#417.src: *** Ugh...... ughhhhhhhh......... UGHHHHHHH...... I'm so TIRED!!!
The Price of Ingenuity#417.speaker: 128 NA

The Price of Ingenuity#418.src: *** Uncle T got really hurt today. Really, really, really hurt.
The Price of Ingenuity#418.speaker: 129 NA

The Price of Ingenuity#419.src: *** Ma says Uncle T's gonna be okay. He will.
The Price of Ingenuity#419.speaker: 129 NA

The Price of Ingenuity#422.src: *** The Citadel was AWESOME!!! I've always dreamed of going up there, someday... and now I HAVE!!
The Price of Ingenuity#422.speaker: 129 NA

The Price of Ingenuity#423.src: *** Work on project E-lec-tricity is ongoing (yes, the name changed... the Sovereign didn't like what I called it before...... bleh.), and it's going really well!!
The Price of Ingenuity#423.speaker: 129 NA

The Price of Ingenuity#424.src: *** OKAY!!! DO NOT PANIC!!!! BUT THINGS! ARE! HAPPENING!!!!
The Price of Ingenuity#424.speaker: 130 NA

The Price of Ingenuity#426.src: *** Looking back at these entries, I... I feel hollow.
The Price of Ingenuity#426.speaker: 3 IA

The Price of Ingenuity#427.src: *** Mother passed away from her illness, a few days ago. They knew it was coming for a while, apparently, but... it was still a shock.
The Price of Ingenuity#427.speaker: 4 IA

The Price of Ingenuity#428.src: *** What's the point in writing these, anymore? I don't know what to say. I could talk about my projects, about all the progress I've been making, but it all feels so hollow.
The Price of Ingenuity#428.speaker: 10 IA

The Price of Ingenuity#429.src: *** How many years has it been? I can check the dates, but... I don't want to.
The Price of Ingenuity#429.speaker: 40 IA

The Price of Ingenuity#430.src: *** Never forget, never stop creating, never give in!
The Price of Ingenuity#430.speaker: 45 IA

The Price of Ingenuity#431.src: And there it is... looking at it like this, it really is impressive.
The Price of Ingenuity#431.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#432.src: Again, you really don't know what this is for? And more importantly, which of us will carry it out?
The Price of Ingenuity#432.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#433.src: I'd say until we're in the clear, {u} should carry it. And no... I really, absolutely do not. Every time I've asked Soosu to elaborate, she's just blown me off.
The Price of Ingenuity#433.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#434.src: Well. Whatever this is, it can't be any good if the Crown wants it. {u}, are you ready?
The Price of Ingenuity#434.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#435.src: Wait. Do you also hear that sound? Are those footsteps?
The Price of Ingenuity#435.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#436.src: Can't be anything else - and there's two pairs of them. So Soosu is here, but with whom...?
The Price of Ingenuity#436.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#437.src: ...are you sure this is the best idea? Dividing your attention between the discussion, and your...projects... It hasn't worked out in the past.
The Price of Ingenuity#437.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

The Price of Ingenuity#438.src: Well, you know, Zhiraok, not eeeveryone seems to have the time to drop everything and leave their region. Sometimes, we have a job to do.
The Price of Ingenuity#438.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

The Price of Ingenuity#439.src: Ah, there you are, Flowers! Wakey wakey, sleepyhead - you've got some guarding to get back to!
The Price of Ingenuity#439.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

The Price of Ingenuity#441.src: Awareness, Soosu! A bit of warning before you stop like that?
The Price of Ingenuity#441.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

The Price of Ingenuity#442.src: Hm? Ah, sorry, sorry, but an unexpected run-in with a close friend is just sooo nice! Surely there's space somewhere in your mind to know that, hmm?
The Price of Ingenuity#442.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

The Price of Ingenuity#443.src: Soosu... This is a solved problem! How many times have I told you that? ...Alright, look, that's a tangent. What I really need to tell you-
The Price of Ingenuity#443.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

The Price of Ingenuity#444.src: Escape the workshop without being spotted.

The Price of Ingenuity#445.src: Soosu's here? And with Zhiraok, of all people?! We have to get out, now!
The Price of Ingenuity#445.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#446.src: Yeah, but I bet Soosu's got Flowers on high alert! Don't use your magic, and whatever you do, don't get spotted!
The Price of Ingenuity#446.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#447.src: Wait- What's that, Flowers? Intruders?! Right by the device room?!
The Price of Ingenuity#447.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

The Price of Ingenuity#448.src: ...!! The Cursed!! You're not laying one digit on her, you hear me?!
The Price of Ingenuity#448.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

The Price of Ingenuity#449.src: Wh-what the helix Infiltrators! You aren't getting away this time!
The Price of Ingenuity#449.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

The Price of Ingenuity#450.src: Yusanu?! Who is that with you? Wait, are you trying to steal the device?!
The Price of Ingenuity#450.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

The Price of Ingenuity#451.src: Hello, we're meant to run! Are you even taking this seriously?!
The Price of Ingenuity#451.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#452.src: ...you're smart enough that I shouldn't need to reiterate this! I know you are! Please, take the problem seriously!
The Price of Ingenuity#452.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

The Price of Ingenuity#453.src: A set of criminals is in your quadrant, the Cursed behind the Torann massacre is with them, they're infil-
The Price of Ingenuity#453.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

The Price of Ingenuity#454.src: Oh my god, Z, I get it!!! All you do is yap yap yap yap YAP!!! Give me some room to think!!!
The Price of Ingenuity#454.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

The Price of Ingenuity#455.src: Bla bla criminals, bla bla cursed one!!!! Yes, I know how important it is! Flowers, hold this steady for me, won't you?
The Price of Ingenuity#455.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

The Price of Ingenuity#456.src: As long as your focus is on the solutions, not your... But, Soosu, I haven't heard anything from you. There was key information I had to learn offhand!
The Price of Ingenuity#456.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

The Price of Ingenuity#457.src: One of your commanders summarized the topic for me. I should've heard it from you! So...what's your angle? It feels like you're ignoring the issue.
The Price of Ingenuity#457.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

The Price of Ingenuity#458.src: ...Soosu? Soosu, are you listening? I asked you a question!
The Price of Ingenuity#458.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

The Price of Ingenuity#459.src: Hm? Yeah, yeah, sure. Hey, could you fetch me some bolts?
The Price of Ingenuity#459.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

The Price of Ingenuity#460.src: ...fine, sure- But please, we have to round this out, Soosu. You have to get involved.
The Price of Ingenuity#460.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

The Price of Ingenuity#462.src: Oh, right, about Flowers. Could you go check if his body picked up any parts while walking that I could use?
The Price of Ingenuity#462.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

The Price of Ingenuity#464.src: I knew letting you work in here was irrational. There's such a greater sum of problems than your toys! You're acting like a child, but you aren't one!
The Price of Ingenuity#464.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

The Price of Ingenuity#465.src: I know you can do such good work if you just apply yourself! Why are you just ignoring a high-ranking defector and a Cursed exponentiating each others' threat?!
The Price of Ingenuity#465.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

The Price of Ingenuity#467.src: Do you think you're better than me, Zhiraok?
The Price of Ingenuity#467.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

The Price of Ingenuity#468.src: Oh, look at Soosu, always so inattentive and clueless, always ignoring the needs of her district, always cooped up in her laboratory.
The Price of Ingenuity#468.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

The Price of Ingenuity#469.src: Who even cares about the work she does? The projects she's assigned?! Who even cares that she knows, she knows, she KNOWS!!!!
The Price of Ingenuity#469.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

The Price of Ingenuity#470.src: ...Hm! Maybe you are better, Z. If you weren't, maybe we wouldn't be here right now!!
The Price of Ingenuity#470.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

The Price of Ingenuity#471.src: I... ... ...I'm sorry Soosu. That...that wasn't my angle, I didn't mean t-
The Price of Ingenuity#471.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

The Price of Ingenuity#472.src: But you did! Hand me cog C-{~}, would you?
The Price of Ingenuity#472.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

The Price of Ingenuity#473.src: ...alright. I just want to reach the end of this sequence as fast as possible.
The Price of Ingenuity#473.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

The Price of Ingenuity#474.src: That makes two of us. I'm working on it. You can stop bugging me about it!!
The Price of Ingenuity#474.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

The Price of Ingenuity#475.src: ...maybe I should've been paying more attention. I didn't realize her project was putting so much weight on your soldiers. And I promised to help, too...
The Price of Ingenuity#475.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

The Price of Ingenuity#477.src: Return to the Steel Feather through Yusanu's tunnel at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

The Price of Ingenuity#478.src: ...what was that?! What were they DOING there?!
The Price of Ingenuity#478.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#479.src: I- I- I don't know! A surprise visit? I didn't... I didn't think...
The Price of Ingenuity#479.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#480.src: So, "letting off some steam", huh?! Oh, sure, bring Sovereign Zhiraok along with you!! Why not!!!
The Price of Ingenuity#480.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#481.src: We almost got caught! We- oh god, we... we almost got caught...
The Price of Ingenuity#481.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#482.src: ...what are we doing? Why did- why did we do that? That was so...
The Price of Ingenuity#482.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#483.src: You're asking ME?! Yeah, Rex, why did we do that?!
The Price of Ingenuity#483.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#484.src: Stop. Just... stop, for a second. I need to... think.
The Price of Ingenuity#484.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#485.src: ...damn it. Damn it, damn it, damn it! Stupid, impulsive... ugh!!
The Price of Ingenuity#485.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#487.src: No, I... I'm not. I'm sorry, I- I should know better by now...
The Price of Ingenuity#487.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#488.src: It... doesn't matter. It's too late to take it back. We can... we can use it as a trump card. Yusanu, please tell me you can figure out what it is.
The Price of Ingenuity#488.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#489.src: I... I don't know. I never got to work too closely with it, so... I have no idea what it is. If I work with it, maybe I can get somewhere. But...
The Price of Ingenuity#489.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#490.src: Good enough, I guess. Come on, let's get back to. I need to... find Mora. And you need to tell everyone what you've been up to.
The Price of Ingenuity#490.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#491.src: ...so just hiding what we did today isn't an option?
The Price of Ingenuity#491.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#492.src: And let it come back to bite us later down the line? No thanks. Let's go.
The Price of Ingenuity#492.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#493.src: Really, Rex, are you... alright? I don't think I've ever seen-
The Price of Ingenuity#493.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#494.src: Don't. Don't push it. Not right now.
The Price of Ingenuity#494.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#495.src: Hey! You three, where the heck have you been all day?!
The Price of Ingenuity#495.speaker: Yuman

The Price of Ingenuity#497.src: Yes, it's rather curious! I happened to speak to Syndra, and apparently there were no such "important tasks" assigned to you! She seemed rather clueless about the whole matter!
The Price of Ingenuity#497.speaker: Mora

The Price of Ingenuity#499.src: You know what happened, Mora. I- I messed up. Again.
The Price of Ingenuity#499.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#500.src: Huh? What do you mean, agai-
The Price of Ingenuity#500.speaker: Yuman

The Price of Ingenuity#501.src: Ah, Yuman, would you mind taking Yusanu along with you to go tell the others we'll be a little late to the meeting? I believe there will be some additional news today.
The Price of Ingenuity#501.speaker: Mora

The Price of Ingenuity#502.src: Uh... sure, I guess. Yus, can you tell me what's up while we walk?
The Price of Ingenuity#502.speaker: Yuman

The Price of Ingenuity#505.src: It's... bad. We stole something important from the Sovereign's workshop. It's... a long story. Yusanu should tell his part of it. But...
The Price of Ingenuity#505.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#506.src: I see. I apologize, Rex, I should have been more attentive.
The Price of Ingenuity#506.speaker: Mora

The Price of Ingenuity#507.src: No! No, it's not your fault, I should have- I should have known I was being impulsive, I... I wasn't thinking straight.
The Price of Ingenuity#507.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#508.src: Ah. Of course, you don't know. I should have informed you the last time this happened...
The Price of Ingenuity#508.speaker: Mora

The Price of Ingenuity#509.src: Rex has these... ah, "moods," sometimes, wherein she gets... overly excitable and impulsive. Many a time have they led her into trouble.
The Price of Ingenuity#509.speaker: Mora

The Price of Ingenuity#510.src: Ugh, I should know better by now! Especially here, especially now, when...
The Price of Ingenuity#510.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#511.src: Well, what is done is done, and nevertheless, we must press on. Let's join the others for the meeting. Syndra has something important to tell us.
The Price of Ingenuity#511.speaker: Mora

The Price of Ingenuity#512.src: Attend the meeting in the Steel Feather at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

The Price of Ingenuity#513.src: There you are! Mora, Rex, what's going-
The Price of Ingenuity#513.speaker: Syndra

The Price of Ingenuity#514.src: Syndra, I believe that can wait. We've, ah, held up dinner long enough, I believe. If everyone is here, we should begin. First- Yusanu, what was it you had to tell us?
The Price of Ingenuity#514.speaker: Quill

The Price of Ingenuity#515.src: ...sigh. Before I begin, I need to make it clear- I was doing what I thought was best for the Steel Feather.
The Price of Ingenuity#515.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#516.src: Yeah, man, good start... really instills confidence.
The Price of Ingenuity#516.speaker: Yuman

The Price of Ingenuity#517.src: Yuman, please... let me get through this. Don't interrupt.
The Price of Ingenuity#517.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#518.src: So. So, so,so... The... the reason the crown has left us alone down here is because I have been working with Sovereign Soosu.
The Price of Ingenuity#518.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#521.src: The reason we've been able to stay under the radar for so long is because of this, Yulie.
The Price of Ingenuity#521.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#522.src: The reason we can live here, leave our home, make use of the city's electricity... it's because of my collaboration.
The Price of Ingenuity#522.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#523.src: She said she saw potential in me. Told me that if I helped her in her workshops, then... then you all would be safe down here.
The Price of Ingenuity#523.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#524.src: I didn't tell anybody because I knew you wouldn't get it. You'd think it was stupid, and risky, and a bad idea. Working with... with someone responsible for our problems.
The Price of Ingenuity#524.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#525.src: And I knew it was risky. I did. But I thought that if I were to mess up, only I would be punished. You all would be safe.
The Price of Ingenuity#525.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#526.src: ...now. I understand emotions are running high right now. I would ask everyone to take a step back, think through it logically, and remain c-
The Price of Ingenuity#526.speaker: Quill

The Price of Ingenuity#527.src: Are you insane, Yusanu?! Of all the secrets you could have been keeping-
The Price of Ingenuity#527.speaker: Yulie

The Price of Ingenuity#529.src: No, I don't think I will! Is that what the alarms were about? How long has this been going on? What was running through your head when you decided-
The Price of Ingenuity#529.speaker: Yulie

The Price of Ingenuity#530.src: As if you haven't been doing the same thing this whole time! Trying to put all the weight on your own shoulders, not getting help from anyone else!!
The Price of Ingenuity#530.speaker: Yuman

The Price of Ingenuity#531.src: So- so, y'know, I'm a little mad. He should have talked to us about it! But... he's telling us now. He's asking for help now.
The Price of Ingenuity#531.speaker: Yuman

The Price of Ingenuity#535.src: After yesterday's run-in with the soldiers... Soosu is demanding I hand over whoever's responsible. I... I can't do that.
The Price of Ingenuity#535.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#536.src: Rex and {u} caught me talking to her today. That's why... that's why I'm telling you.
The Price of Ingenuity#536.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#537.src: ...yeah. I convinced him to stop working with her, and to tell you all about it.
The Price of Ingenuity#537.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#538.src: We also... stole an important gadget she and Yusanu were working on. Something the Queen was very invested in.
The Price of Ingenuity#538.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#539.src: I don't know what it is or what it does. I don't know what it's for. All I know is that the Queen needs it finished. It's all she's had Soosu working on for... months.
The Price of Ingenuity#539.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#540.src: I'll try to figure out what it is in my spare time. Maybe it'll help us! I... hope it will.
The Price of Ingenuity#540.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#541.src: Yulie, Yuman... I owe you a better apology. I can talk to you in private later, but... right now, we should continue with the meeting.
The Price of Ingenuity#541.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#543.src: ...that was certainly a lot. Fortunately, angering the Sovereign may not ultimately matter. If all goes according to plan... the crown will fall at the end of the festival.
The Price of Ingenuity#543.speaker: Syndra

The Price of Ingenuity#544.src: My goal, as always, has been to find a way to destroy the crown's influence and to free our province. I believe this upcoming festival is an opportunity to do just that.
The Price of Ingenuity#544.speaker: Syndra

The Price of Ingenuity#545.src: During the Crown Festival, Her Majesty will die.
The Price of Ingenuity#545.speaker: Syndra

The Price of Ingenuity#546.src: Settle down, everyone, settle down! Please, allow Syndra to continue.
The Price of Ingenuity#546.speaker: Quill

The Price of Ingenuity#547.src: It will not be easy. But if we strike when her guard is down, and catch her by surprise, I believe it is possible.
The Price of Ingenuity#547.speaker: Syndra

The Price of Ingenuity#548.src: I'll be splitting you all into several groups, and will assign tasks that must be completed before the festival.
The Price of Ingenuity#548.speaker: Syndra

The Price of Ingenuity#549.src: The decision Quill and I have come to is that I alone will be going for the kill. That way, if anything goes wrong... no one else faces the consequences.
The Price of Ingenuity#549.speaker: Syndra

The Price of Ingenuity#550.src: I'll go over the details tomorrow. I think... we've had enough excitement today. Please, hold your complaints until then, as well.
The Price of Ingenuity#550.speaker: Syndra

The Price of Ingenuity#551.src: Ahem. Yes, indeed. I suppose we should be getting to dinner, as well.
The Price of Ingenuity#551.speaker: Quill

The Price of Ingenuity#552.src: Yuman... this may be unfair of me to ask, but would you be willing to play us a song tonight? We will not have many days left together.
The Price of Ingenuity#552.speaker: Quill

The Price of Ingenuity#553.src: Yeah... yeah, man, of course. I can do that.
The Price of Ingenuity#553.speaker: Yuman

The Price of Ingenuity#554.src: Then let us enjoy the remainder of our company!
The Price of Ingenuity#554.speaker: Quill

The Price of Ingenuity#556.src: Hey, everyone! Man, uh... small crowd today, huh?
The Price of Ingenuity#556.speaker: Yuman

The Price of Ingenuity#557.src: Oh, man, is that Jiro I see? Hey, man! I didn't, uh... expect to see ya.
The Price of Ingenuity#557.speaker: Yuman

The Price of Ingenuity#559.src: Uh, just, you didn't seem super happy with me after... after yesterday. With the- soldier thing.
The Price of Ingenuity#559.speaker: Yuman

The Price of Ingenuity#560.src: ... Oh! Yeah. No worries. Water under the bridge.
The Price of Ingenuity#560.speaker: Jiro

The Price of Ingenuity#561.src: If... if you say so! Don't think you've heard this one before, so tell me how you like it!
The Price of Ingenuity#561.speaker: Yuman

The Price of Ingenuity#562.src: But first... Yus. Yusanu. Look, I... I'm not one to hold grudges. So I don't need any more apologies from you! I get it.
The Price of Ingenuity#562.speaker: Yuman

The Price of Ingenuity#563.src: I just... want you to trust us more, 'kay? You and Yulie both, haha! 'Cause... I want to help!
The Price of Ingenuity#563.speaker: Yuman

The Price of Ingenuity#564.src: I had a think, and yeah. It sucks you didn't tell us. But your deal with Soosu- it saved us! Gave us a home, gave us a future!
The Price of Ingenuity#564.speaker: Yuman

The Price of Ingenuity#565.src: So... this song's dedicated to you. Hope you like it.
The Price of Ingenuity#565.speaker: Yuman

The Price of Ingenuity#566.src: No... no no no no no, where is it, where IS IT?! I can't... I need to find it, I-
The Price of Ingenuity#566.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

The Price of Ingenuity#568.src: EEP! Y- your Majesty, I- I- I wasn't expecting you until... tomorrow. Wh- what're you doing here?
The Price of Ingenuity#568.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

The Price of Ingenuity#569.src: My schedule freed up, so I decided to check in early. Is something wrong, Sovereign?
The Price of Ingenuity#569.speaker: Her Majesty

The Price of Ingenuity#571.src: Don't bother. How incompetent must you be, to have lost it from your own workshop?!
The Price of Ingenuity#571.speaker: Her Majesty

The Price of Ingenuity#572.src: I- I- I don't understand how, my golems haven't been disturbed! They didn't detect anything!
The Price of Ingenuity#572.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

The Price of Ingenuity#573.src: Perhaps if you focused more on efficiency instead of playing around with your toys, this could have been prevented.
The Price of Ingenuity#573.speaker: Her Majesty

The Price of Ingenuity#574.src: I'll- I'll fix this, I promise! I promise I promise I promise, I can fix it! I can... I can restart! I still have all the research notes, and I-
The Price of Ingenuity#574.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

The Price of Ingenuity#575.src: Enough. I have been lenient with your performance maintaining your district, because I had faith there would be results.
The Price of Ingenuity#575.speaker: Her Majesty

The Price of Ingenuity#576.src: Restarting the Resonance Weaver project... it cannot be done. That artifact I entrusted you with... that magic is a lost art. It cannot be replicated.
The Price of Ingenuity#576.speaker: Her Majesty

The Price of Ingenuity#577.src: N- no, I have the notes, I- I know how it works, I can do it, just- just give me a chance! I can fix this!
The Price of Ingenuity#577.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

The Price of Ingenuity#578.src: I must prepare for the festival. I will expect your presence there, as usual. Please... clean yourself up before that.
The Price of Ingenuity#578.speaker: Her Majesty

The Price of Ingenuity#581.src: Consider our agreement null. You have failed me. You will continue your service as Sovereign indefinitely... with your blessing intact.
The Price of Ingenuity#581.speaker: Her Majesty

The Price of Ingenuity#582.src: ...what? No- no, no no no, you- you can't, you can't, you can't!!!!
The Price of Ingenuity#582.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

The Qira Hive (Quest)#000.src: I see another lost soul has found their way to The {p}!
The Qira Hive (Quest)#000.dst: 看來又有一個迷途的靈魂，找上了 {p}！
The Qira Hive (Quest)#000.speaker: Yansur

The Qira Hive (Quest)#001.src: I can't say I am overwhelmed by your appearance. Here, the birth of many powerful and magical monsters take place.
The Qira Hive (Quest)#001.dst: 你的樣子並沒有讓我多驚豔。在這裡，誕生的是無數強大而充滿魔力的怪物。
The Qira Hive (Quest)#001.speaker: Yansur

The Qira Hive (Quest)#002.src: Gavel's governments can not stop Mistress Qira. I doubt you can either.
The Qira Hive (Quest)#002.dst: Gavel 的各國政府擋不住 Qira 大人。我看你也一樣。
The Qira Hive (Quest)#002.speaker: Yansur

The Qira Hive (Quest)#003.src: If you want to meet her, you will have to defeat each division of her army.
The Qira Hive (Quest)#003.dst: 你想見她，就得把她軍隊的每一支部隊都打敗。
The Qira Hive (Quest)#003.speaker: Yansur

The Qira Hive (Quest)#004.src: Although powerful, she is not without honour. After every floor you complete, you will receive a token for a reward from the shop. Good luck, adventurer-
The Qira Hive (Quest)#004.dst: 她雖強大，卻不失氣度。每通過一層，你都會拿到一枚代幣，可以到店裡換取獎勵。祝你好運，冒險——
The Qira Hive (Quest)#004.speaker: Yansur

The Qira Hive (Quest)#005.src: Wh- Oh, Mistress, am I? My apologies...
The Qira Hive (Quest)#005.dst: 什——喔，大人，是嗎？我失禮了……
The Qira Hive (Quest)#005.speaker: Yansur

The Qira Hive (Quest)#006.src: Begin, the Thunder Division! Strike quickly and move on, for those within will warp your very mind should you stray for too long!
The Qira Hive (Quest)#006.dst: 開始吧，雷之部隊！速戰速決，別逗留——待得太久，裡面的東西會扭曲你的心智！
The Qira Hive (Quest)#006.speaker: Qira

The Qira Hive (Quest)#007.src: Heeheehahaaah! I see you! You humans have such easily influenced minds, but I'll settle for beating you within an inch of your life! Come through, come through!!!
The Qira Hive (Quest)#007.dst: 嘻嘻哈哈哈！我看見你啦！你們人類的腦袋真是好擺弄，不過我就先把你打個半死吧！過來，快過來！！！

The Qira Hive (Quest)#008.src: Feh, you're no fun, you little cheater! I was supposed to beat you, not the other way around!
The Qira Hive (Quest)#008.dst: 切，你真沒意思，小騙子！該被打趴的是你，不是我啊！
The Qira Hive (Quest)#008.speaker: Psychomancer

The Qira Hive (Quest)#009.src: I hate you so much. Just get out and talk to that idiot servant already!!
The Qira Hive (Quest)#009.dst: 我恨死你了。快滾出去跟那個蠢僕人講話啦！！
The Qira Hive (Quest)#009.speaker: Psychomancer

The Qira Hive (Quest)#010.src: You have completed the Thunder floor? How surprising. They were some of Mistress Qira's earliest successes.
The Qira Hive (Quest)#010.dst: 你通過雷之層了？真令人意外。那些可是 Qira 大人最早的成功之作。
The Qira Hive (Quest)#010.speaker: Yansur

The Qira Hive (Quest)#011.src: I agree, Mistress. As promised, here is a Thunder Voucher.
The Qira Hive (Quest)#011.dst: 遵命，大人。如約定，這是 Thunder Voucher。
The Qira Hive (Quest)#011.speaker: Yansur

The Qira Hive (Quest)#012.src: Take it to the shop to claim your prize. It is located at the base of the Hive. The servant there will have important information for you regarding your prizes.
The Qira Hive (Quest)#012.dst: 拿去店裡兌換你的獎品。店就在 Hive 的底層。那裡的僕人會告訴你關於獎品的重要事項。
The Qira Hive (Quest)#012.speaker: Yansur

The Qira Hive (Quest)#013.src: I doubt you are still worth Mistress's time, however. She has much to tend to here, as you might guess.
The Qira Hive (Quest)#013.dst: 不過我可不覺得你還值得大人費神。你也想得到，她這裡有太多事要照料。
The Qira Hive (Quest)#013.speaker: Yansur

The Qira Hive (Quest)#014.src: She made a deal with Gavel's people long ago, after they foolishly attempted to lay siege to our Hive.
The Qira Hive (Quest)#014.dst: 很久以前，Gavel 的人愚蠢地想圍攻我們的 Hive，之後她便與他們立了約。
The Qira Hive (Quest)#014.speaker: Yansur

The Qira Hive (Quest)#015.src: She could continue her unethical and possibly evil work...and in return, she would allow the people of Gavel to remain undisturbed by her.
The Qira Hive (Quest)#015.dst: 她可以繼續她那些違背倫理、甚至可說是邪惡的工作……而作為交換，她不會去打擾 Gavel 的人民。
The Qira Hive (Quest)#015.speaker: Yansur

The Qira Hive (Quest)#016.src: Next you must tackle the Air division, featuring some of her tougher creations.
The Qira Hive (Quest)#016.dst: 接下來你得面對風之部隊，那裡有她更難纏的一些造物。
The Qira Hive (Quest)#016.speaker: Yansur

The Qira Hive (Quest)#017.src: Begin, the Air Division! Fight freely with the wind, for the coming storm shall claim you for my own if you cannot spread your wings here!
The Qira Hive (Quest)#017.dst: 開始吧，風之部隊！隨風而戰，自由揮灑——在這裡展不開翅膀，將至的風暴就會把你收歸我有！
The Qira Hive (Quest)#017.speaker: Qira

The Qira Hive (Quest)#018.src: Well, nice work getting this far! Don't tell anyone, but I'm gonna pull my punches here, okay? I'm rooting for you, so let's have fun with this! Come on through!
The Qira Hive (Quest)#018.dst: 哇，能走到這裡真不錯！別跟別人說喔，我等下會手下留情，好嗎？我可是站你這邊的，我們玩得開心點！過來吧！

The Qira Hive (Quest)#019.src: Heehee, maybe I didn't need to hold back after all? You did really well, really well!
The Qira Hive (Quest)#019.dst: 嘻嘻，說不定我根本不必留手呢？你表現得真的很好，非常好！
The Qira Hive (Quest)#019.speaker: Gale

The Qira Hive (Quest)#020.src: A lot of people say I'm the roughest we have to offer, so you've got this! I'm sorry you have to go talk to Yansur of all people now, though.
The Qira Hive (Quest)#020.dst: 很多人說我是我們這裡最難纏的，所以你沒問題的！不過接下來要去跟 Yansur 那種人講話，真是辛苦你了。
The Qira Hive (Quest)#020.speaker: Gale

The Qira Hive (Quest)#021.src: Hrm, perhaps we have underestimated you. The creations of Air have defeated thousands, particularly-
The Qira Hive (Quest)#021.dst: 唔，或許我們是低估你了。風之造物擊敗過成千上萬的人，尤其是——
The Qira Hive (Quest)#021.speaker: Yansur

The Qira Hive (Quest)#022.src: ...yes. Here is the promised Air Voucher.
The Qira Hive (Quest)#022.speaker: Yansur

The Qira Hive (Quest)#023.src: The shop has your reward prepared. If you have not talked to the servant at the shop, do so next you go there.
The Qira Hive (Quest)#023.dst: 店裡已經備好你的獎勵。你要是還沒跟店裡的僕人談過，下次去的時候記得談。
The Qira Hive (Quest)#023.speaker: Yansur

The Qira Hive (Quest)#024.src: You still have a long way to go. It is not easy to gain an audience with Mistress Qira.
The Qira Hive (Quest)#024.dst: 你還有很長的路要走。想見 Qira 大人一面可不容易。
The Qira Hive (Quest)#024.speaker: Yansur

The Qira Hive (Quest)#025.src: Your next objective is to clear the Earth division. Some of the most powerful, raw creatures ever hatched.
The Qira Hive (Quest)#025.dst: 你的下一個目標是清空地之部隊。那裡是有史以來最強悍、最原始的孵化物。
The Qira Hive (Quest)#025.speaker: Yansur

The Qira Hive (Quest)#026.src: Begin, the Earth Division! You must withstand both sheer force and deadly toxins! Be quick on your feet, or you will return to the dust of the earth!
The Qira Hive (Quest)#026.dst: 開始吧，地之部隊！你得同時扛住蠻力與劇毒！腳步放快些，否則你就要歸於塵土！
The Qira Hive (Quest)#026.speaker: Qira

The Qira Hive (Quest)#027.src: Creatures of the earth were not enough for you... Mistress's most rawly powerful... Destroyed.
The Qira Hive (Quest)#027.dst: 地之造物竟也擋不住你……大人最原始強悍的那些……全被摧毀了。
The Qira Hive (Quest)#027.speaker: Yansur

The Qira Hive (Quest)#028.src: Well, here is your Earth Voucher.
The Qira Hive (Quest)#028.dst: 好吧，這是你的 Earth Voucher。
The Qira Hive (Quest)#028.speaker: Yansur

The Qira Hive (Quest)#029.src: The shop has your reward prepared. If you have not talked to the servant at the shop, do so next you go there.
The Qira Hive (Quest)#029.dst: 店裡已經備好你的獎勵。你要是還沒跟店裡的僕人談過，下次去的時候記得談。
The Qira Hive (Quest)#029.speaker: Yansur

The Qira Hive (Quest)#030.src: It is impressive to see how far you have come. Many have failed at this point.
The Qira Hive (Quest)#030.dst: 你能走到這一步，確實令人刮目相看。許多人都倒在這裡了。
The Qira Hive (Quest)#030.speaker: Yansur

The Qira Hive (Quest)#031.src: It is of no consequence, however, for the Water division is your next challenge. I am sure you will not succeed.
The Qira Hive (Quest)#031.dst: 不過那也無妨，你下一關是水之部隊。我確信你不會成功。
The Qira Hive (Quest)#031.speaker: Yansur

The Qira Hive (Quest)#032.src: Begin, the Water Division! If you will not withstand the crashing waves, the creatures that lurk within shall ensure you never emerge from the abyss!
The Qira Hive (Quest)#032.dst: 開始吧，水之部隊！你若擋不住拍擊的浪濤，潛伏其中的生物會確保你永遠浮不出深淵！
The Qira Hive (Quest)#032.speaker: Qira

The Qira Hive (Quest)#033.src: You have been judged worthy enough to face me in combat. However, I know your strength, and I do not believe it enough to defeat me. Come forth now. Make your attempt to prove me wrong.
The Qira Hive (Quest)#033.dst: 經判定，你有資格與我一戰。然而我清楚你的實力，我不認為那足以擊敗我。上前來吧。試著證明我看走了眼。

The Qira Hive (Quest)#034.src: Seems my judgment was incorrect. In this case, however, it is refreshing to see.
The Qira Hive (Quest)#034.dst: 看來我的判斷有誤。不過在此事上，錯得令人愉快。
The Qira Hive (Quest)#034.speaker: Oceanic Judge

The Qira Hive (Quest)#035.src: Continue forwards, honourable human. Perhaps your intellect and respect will rub off on that insufferable Yansur.
The Qira Hive (Quest)#035.dst: 繼續前行吧，可敬的人類。或許你的才智與敬意，能感染那個令人難以忍受的 Yansur。
The Qira Hive (Quest)#035.speaker: Oceanic Judge

The Qira Hive (Quest)#036.src: Impossible. Not even the most tactically advanced monsters could defeat you.
The Qira Hive (Quest)#036.dst: 不可能。連戰術最精妙的怪物都拿不下你。
The Qira Hive (Quest)#036.speaker: Yansur

The Qira Hive (Quest)#038.src: The shop has your reward prepared. If you have not talked to the servant at the shop, do so next you go there.
The Qira Hive (Quest)#038.dst: 店裡已經備好你的獎勵。你要是還沒跟店裡的僕人談過，下次去的時候記得談。
The Qira Hive (Quest)#038.speaker: Yansur

The Qira Hive (Quest)#039.src: We are intrigued by your determination... But we are not worried. We do not expect you to make it past the next floor.
The Qira Hive (Quest)#039.dst: 你的決心引起了我們的興趣……但我們並不擔心。我們不認為你過得了下一層。
The Qira Hive (Quest)#039.speaker: Yansur

The Qira Hive (Quest)#040.src: Now you must face some of the toughest creatures of Mistress Qira's imagination!
The Qira Hive (Quest)#040.dst: 接下來你要面對的，是 Qira 大人想像力所及最難纏的一些生物！
The Qira Hive (Quest)#040.speaker: Yansur

The Qira Hive (Quest)#041.src: You must now face the division of Fire, and it will be sure to burn you.
The Qira Hive (Quest)#041.dst: 現在你得面對火之部隊，它必定會把你燒個透。
The Qira Hive (Quest)#041.speaker: Yansur

The Qira Hive (Quest)#042.src: Begin, the Fire Division! Summon your courage, and brave the heat of the volcanoes and blow away in the breeze!
The Qira Hive (Quest)#042.dst: 開始吧，火之部隊！鼓起你的勇氣，闖過火山的熾熱——否則就隨風化為飛灰！
The Qira Hive (Quest)#042.speaker: Qira

The Qira Hive (Quest)#043.src: Impressive, making it this far. I am your final test. Let us fight fairly, then. An honourable end to your challenge is only fitting, whether that be triumph or defeat. Come forward and face me.
The Qira Hive (Quest)#043.dst: 能走到這裡，令人佩服。我是你最後的試煉。那麼，我們就堂堂正正地打一場。無論是勝是敗，你的挑戰都該有個體面的收尾。上前來面對我吧。

The Qira Hive (Quest)#044.src: Defeat feels strange, after so long. You fought valiantly, and with great zeal, however. It would be a lie to say I am disappointed. Impart these traits onto Mistress's servant, if you would, and claim your final prize.
The Qira Hive (Quest)#044.dst: 隔了這麼久，敗北的滋味有些陌生。不過你打得英勇，也充滿熱忱。要說我失望，那是騙人的。若你願意，把這些品格也帶給大人的僕人，然後去領你最後的獎品吧。
The Qira Hive (Quest)#044.speaker: Solar Vanguard

The Qira Hive (Quest)#045.src: All that is left is to talk to Mistress's servant, and claim your final prize. Surely he will not be as great an obstacle as I was.
The Qira Hive (Quest)#045.dst: 剩下的只有去跟大人的僕人談話、領取你最後的獎品。他想必不會像我這樣難以逾越。
The Qira Hive (Quest)#045.speaker: Solar Vanguard

The Qira Hive (Quest)#046.src: This is unprecedented. You have defeated some of the most recent and powerful creations.
The Qira Hive (Quest)#046.dst: 這是前所未有的事。你擊敗了最新、也最強大的一批造物。
The Qira Hive (Quest)#046.speaker: Yansur

The Qira Hive (Quest)#047.src: Here you are then, the Fire Voucher!
The Qira Hive (Quest)#047.speaker: Yansur

The Qira Hive (Quest)#048.src: The shop has your reward prepared. If you have not talked to the servant at the shop, do so next you go there.
The Qira Hive (Quest)#048.dst: 店裡已經備好你的獎勵。你要是還沒跟店裡的僕人談過，下次去的時候記得談。
The Qira Hive (Quest)#048.speaker: Yansur

The Qira Hive (Quest)#049.src: This is unorthodox, as no one has made it this far. But I suppose this means that you have earned an audience with-
The Qira Hive (Quest)#049.dst: 這不合常規，畢竟從沒有人走到這一步。但我想，這也代表你已經有資格晉見——
The Qira Hive (Quest)#049.speaker: Yansur

The Qira Hive (Quest)#050.src: Hah! Incredible! Mistress wishes to battle you herself! You astound me.
The Qira Hive (Quest)#050.dst: 哈！難以置信！大人要親自與你一戰！你真讓我吃驚。
The Qira Hive (Quest)#050.speaker: Yansur

The Qira Hive (Quest)#051.src: Be warned, however. This will be your toughest battle yet. Mistress Qira is the most feared being in Gavel.
The Qira Hive (Quest)#051.dst: 不過先警告你。這將是你至今最艱難的一戰。Qira 大人是 Gavel 最令人畏懼的存在。
The Qira Hive (Quest)#051.speaker: Yansur

The Qira Hive (Quest)#052.src: You will die...but consider it the greatest honour to die by her hand.
The Qira Hive (Quest)#052.dst: 你會死的……但死在她手上，就當是至高的榮耀吧。
The Qira Hive (Quest)#052.speaker: Yansur

The Qira Hive (Quest)#053.src: How cowardly! After defeating so many in the Hive, and receiving such praise, you've the gall to upstand Mistress's request?
The Qira Hive (Quest)#053.dst: 好個懦夫！在 Hive 裡擊敗了那麼多對手、受了那樣的讚譽，你竟有臉放大人的鴿子？
The Qira Hive (Quest)#053.speaker: Yansur

The Qira Hive (Quest)#054.src: I had begun to think highly of you, but after such a disgusting display-
The Qira Hive (Quest)#054.dst: 我本來已經開始高看你，可是在這種令人作嘔的表現之後——
The Qira Hive (Quest)#054.speaker: Yansur

The Qira Hive (Quest)#055.src: Wha...that- No, that can't possibly be correct, you are-
The Qira Hive (Quest)#055.dst: 什……那——不，那不可能是真的，你——
The Qira Hive (Quest)#055.speaker: Yansur

The Qira Hive (Quest)#056.src: ...Masterful...Have we been cooped up in this Hive so long that our army is outdated?
The Qira Hive (Quest)#056.dst: ……真是高明……我們窩在這座 Hive 裡太久，久到軍隊都過時了嗎？
The Qira Hive (Quest)#056.speaker: Yansur

The Qira Hive (Quest)#057.src: To be defeated by a human of Wynn... I am not sure whether to be disappointed or amazed. Our ultimate challenge has been bested.
The Qira Hive (Quest)#057.dst: 竟敗在一個 Wynn 的人類手上……我不知道該失望還是該驚嘆。我們最終的試煉被攻破了。
The Qira Hive (Quest)#057.speaker: Yansur

The Qira Hive (Quest)#058.src: Here is your voucher, then. The back room in the shop will have your rewards. If you still have not talked to the servant at the shop...well. You should know by now.
The Qira Hive (Quest)#058.dst: 那麼，這是你的兌換券。店裡的後間備有你的獎勵。你要是到現在還沒跟店裡的僕人談過……好吧，這時候你也該知道了。
The Qira Hive (Quest)#058.speaker: Yansur

The Qira Hive (Quest)#059.src: Mistress...if I may tell the tale? She was once called upon to help stop the decay of the forest.
The Qira Hive (Quest)#059.dst: 大人……容我說個故事？她曾經被請去協助阻止森林的衰敗。
The Qira Hive (Quest)#059.speaker: Yansur

The Qira Hive (Quest)#060.src: With her boundless knowledge and magic, she surely could have cured it. But she declined.
The Qira Hive (Quest)#060.dst: 以她無邊的學識與魔法，她一定治得好。但她拒絕了。
The Qira Hive (Quest)#060.speaker: Yansur

The Qira Hive (Quest)#061.src: She instead chose to create, obsessed with preparing for some sort of war.
The Qira Hive (Quest)#061.dst: 她選擇了創造，執著於為某一場戰爭做準備。
The Qira Hive (Quest)#061.speaker: Yansur

The Qira Hive (Quest)#062.src: Mistress never elaborated, but it seems like she knows something we don't.
The Qira Hive (Quest)#062.dst: 大人從未細說，但看來她知道某些我們不知道的事。
The Qira Hive (Quest)#062.speaker: Yansur

The Realm of Light (Quest)#002.src: ... Achara... I do not believe I can ever atone for what I have done to you. An apology simply isn't enough.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#002.dst: ……achara……我不認為我這輩子能補償我對你做的事。一句道歉根本不夠。
The Realm of Light (Quest)#002.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#003.src: As infuriating as what you did was, you were following orders... I had every right to be angry, but to try and take your life was ten steps too far.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#003.dst: 儘管你做的事有多令人抓狂，你是在奉命行事……我有一萬個生氣的理由，但要取你性命，那已經越線越了十步。
The Realm of Light (Quest)#003.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#004.src: Even though it is not enough, I will say I am sorry for the pain I caused you. The Guardian was right, in the end.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#004.dst: 就算不夠，我還是要說，我為我造成的痛苦向你道歉。到頭來，守護者是對的。
The Realm of Light (Quest)#004.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#005.src: Without you carrying out Orphion's will, we would not be here. You truly are necessary in this, and I believe I have finally made peace with that.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#005.dst: 若不是你執行了 Orphion 的意志，我們不會走到這裡。你在這件事上確實是不可或缺的，而我想我終於能與這件事和解了。
The Realm of Light (Quest)#005.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#006.src: It has been a long time since I had a partner willing to help me in this way. I was unused to it, I suppose... Still.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#006.dst: 我已經很久沒有一個願意這樣幫我的同伴了。我大概是不習慣吧……不過還是。
The Realm of Light (Quest)#006.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#007.src: If you'll be willing to aid me, it would be a great relief. It has been a thousand years since I entered the Realm of Light...
The Realm of Light (Quest)#007.dst: 你若願意助我一臂之力，那會是莫大的寬慰。距離我上一次進入光之領域，已經一千年了……
The Realm of Light (Quest)#007.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#008.src: I can only hope things have not changed much. I remember how it was, right down to the last petal...
The Realm of Light (Quest)#008.dst: 我只能希望那裡沒有變太多。我記得它當時的模樣，連最後一片花瓣都記得……
The Realm of Light (Quest)#008.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#009.src: Walk towards the portal with Lari.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#009.dst: 與 Lari 一起走向傳送門。

The Realm of Light (Quest)#010.src: Wait a moment, {u}. I have one more thing I would like to say before we enter.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#010.dst: 等一下，{u}。進去之前，我還有一件事想說。
The Realm of Light (Quest)#010.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#011.src: I... I need to thank you. For helping, as you have. For staying by me as you have. There was one other before you like that...
The Realm of Light (Quest)#011.dst: 我……我得謝謝你。謝謝你像這樣幫我。謝謝你像這樣留在我身邊。在你之前，還有過一個人是這樣的……
The Realm of Light (Quest)#011.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#012.src: I promise that you will not meet the same fate as him. I will fight with you to the bitter end, achara.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#012.dst: 我保證你不會落得跟他一樣的下場。我會與你並肩戰到最後一刻，achara。
The Realm of Light (Quest)#012.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#013.src: It's time, then. To visit Orphion.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#013.dst: 那麼，時候到了。去見 Orphion 吧。
The Realm of Light (Quest)#013.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#014.src: Jump into the portal after Lari.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#014.dst: 跟著 Lari 跳進傳送門。

The Realm of Light (Quest)#015.src: Talk to Lari at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] in the Realm of Light.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#015.dst: 在光之領域到 [-{~1}, {~2}, -{~3}] 跟 Lari 談話。

The Realm of Light (Quest)#016.src: Welcome to the Realm of Light then, {u}. Once you've re-oriented yourself, come over here.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#016.dst: 那麼，歡迎來到光之領域，{u}。等你站穩了就過來這裡。
The Realm of Light (Quest)#016.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#017.src: It's so much smaller than it used to be! There used to be many more landmasses, all connected to each other...
The Realm of Light (Quest)#017.dst: 它比以前小太多了！以前有更多塊陸地，彼此都連在一起……
The Realm of Light (Quest)#017.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#018.src: I feel... I feel everything in here. With Orphion's light, I can tap into the very core of the realm.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#018.dst: 我感覺得到……我感覺得到這裡的一切。憑著 Orphion 的光，我能觸及這個領域最核心的地方。
The Realm of Light (Quest)#018.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#019.src: And I can feel disturbances. There are dark creatures here, where there should be none!
The Realm of Light (Quest)#019.dst: 而我感覺得到擾動。這裡有黑暗的生物，而這裡本不該有！
The Realm of Light (Quest)#019.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#020.src: I mean, even look at this creature. The light emanating from it is-
The Realm of Light (Quest)#020.dst: 我是說，你看看這隻生物。從牠身上散發出來的光——
The Realm of Light (Quest)#020.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#021.src: Wait. Wh... Why is it attacking you!?
The Realm of Light (Quest)#021.dst: 等等。為……為什麼牠在攻擊你？！
The Realm of Light (Quest)#021.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#022.src: Its mind was addled by darkness. Poor thing was terrified... Nothing for it though.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#022.dst: 牠的心智被黑暗攪亂了。可憐的東西，牠只是嚇壞了……不過也沒別的辦法。
The Realm of Light (Quest)#022.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#023.src: I suppose your more ruthless nature is a good thing, in this case. We each will need to fight, if this is as widespread as it feels.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#023.dst: 這種時候，你那份比較狠得下心的性子，我想反倒是好事。若這事真如我感覺到的那樣蔓延，我們兩個都得動手。
The Realm of Light (Quest)#023.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#024.src: I'll have to prepare myself for that... Being willing to take action will not make it any easier on my conscience.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#024.dst: 我得先讓自己有心理準備……願意動手，並不會讓我良心上好過一點。
The Realm of Light (Quest)#024.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#025.src: But I will set that aside, until the day this all becomes a memory. We'll both need to seek the Nexus of Light, Orphion's home. Follow me!
The Realm of Light (Quest)#025.dst: 但我會把那些先擱在一旁，直到這一切成為回憶的那一天。我們兩個都得去找光之樞紐，Orphion 的居所。跟我來！
The Realm of Light (Quest)#025.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#026.src: Follow Lari to Orphion's Nexus of Light at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
The Realm of Light (Quest)#026.dst: 跟著 Lari 前往 [-{~1}, {~2}, -{~3}] 的 Orphion 光之樞紐。

The Realm of Light (Quest)#027.src: I should have expected this. With the connections severed, of course the bridge to the Nexus would be gone.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#027.dst: 我早該料到的。連結既然斷了，通往樞紐的橋當然也就沒了。
The Realm of Light (Quest)#027.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#028.src: This must be because of that horrid parasite... The Guardian of the Forest informed me of the situation afterwards.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#028.dst: 這一定是那個可憎的寄生體害的……森林守護者事後把情況告訴了我。
The Realm of Light (Quest)#028.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#029.src: The gap may be too far for me to carry you over... Is there a way I can bypass this, I wonder?
The Realm of Light (Quest)#029.dst: 這道缺口大概太遠，我沒辦法把你帶過去……不知道有沒有辦法繞過它？
The Realm of Light (Quest)#029.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#030.src: Perhaps I can try to bridge the gap myself. Let's see if this will work.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#030.dst: 或許我可以試著自己把缺口接起來。看看行不行得通。
The Realm of Light (Quest)#030.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#032.src: ...hm. That ought to have worked! Is the Nexus too far to reach?
The Realm of Light (Quest)#032.dst: ……嗯。這本來應該有效的！難道樞紐遠到搆不著？
The Realm of Light (Quest)#032.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#033.src: There has to be some way over... Maybe the direct method is- Hm? Another creature?
The Realm of Light (Quest)#033.dst: 一定有辦法過去……也許直接一點的方法是——嗯？又一隻生物？
The Realm of Light (Quest)#033.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#034.src: This one doesn't seem hostile, {u}... I'll try and talk with it.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#034.dst: 這一隻看起來沒有敵意，{u}……我試著跟牠溝通看看。
The Realm of Light (Quest)#034.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#035.src: Its mind is whole, but it's wary of your presence. You should stay back, just in case.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#035.dst: 牠的心智是完整的，但牠對你的存在很戒備。你先退開一點，以防萬一。
The Realm of Light (Quest)#035.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#036.src: So tell me, achara. What is it you sought me for?
The Realm of Light (Quest)#036.dst: 那麼告訴我，achara。你來找我，是為了什麼？
The Realm of Light (Quest)#036.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#037.src: Ahh, I see. You wish to see your master once more as well...
The Realm of Light (Quest)#037.dst: 啊，我明白了。你也希望能再見你的主人一面……
The Realm of Light (Quest)#037.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#038.src: The monoliths? Are they what's severed the connections?
The Realm of Light (Quest)#038.dst: 那些巨石碑？切斷連結的就是它們嗎？
The Realm of Light (Quest)#038.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#039.src: Ahh, I understand. I assure you, we will fix this!
The Realm of Light (Quest)#039.dst: 啊，我懂了。我向你保證，我們會把它修好！
The Realm of Light (Quest)#039.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#040.src: It said that the connections to the rest of the realm were severed intentionally by Orphion, in order to protect them.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#040.dst: 牠說，通往領域其他部分的連結，是 Orphion 刻意切斷的，為的是保護它們。
The Realm of Light (Quest)#040.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#041.src: Two monoliths on this landmass controlled the connections, and they are being drained of their light- As such, they closed the bridges.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#041.dst: 這塊陸地上有兩座巨石碑控制著那些連結，而它們的光正被抽走——所以它們把橋關上了。
The Realm of Light (Quest)#041.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#042.src: The light is still there- But it must be drawn back out. We have our task ahead of us now, achara. We need to go to the first monolith. Follow me!
The Realm of Light (Quest)#042.dst: 光還在裡面——只是必須把它引回來。我們眼前的任務有了，achara。我們得去第一座巨石碑。跟我來！
The Realm of Light (Quest)#042.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#043.src: Search for the monolith Lari was talking about at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
The Realm of Light (Quest)#043.dst: 到 [-{~1}, {~2}, -{~3}] 尋找 Lari 說的那座巨石碑。

The Realm of Light (Quest)#044.src: I never knew the monoliths kept the realm together as they did. You can see that it is inactive, yes?
The Realm of Light (Quest)#044.dst: 我從來不知道巨石碑是這樣把整個領域維繫在一起的。你也看得出來它是停擺的，對吧？
The Realm of Light (Quest)#044.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#045.src: There should be bright bands of color going along it, and light pouring from it. This is where we play our roles, {u}!
The Realm of Light (Quest)#045.dst: 它上面本該有一道道明亮的色帶，還有光傾瀉出來。就是這裡，該我們上場了，{u}！
The Realm of Light (Quest)#045.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#046.src: It may be getting drained, but there is certainly still light within it, and if that parasite is battling Orphion we should be able to recharge it.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#046.dst: 它的光是正在被抽走沒錯，但裡面肯定還有光。而如果那個寄生體正在跟 Orphion 纏鬥，我們應該有辦法把它重新充滿。
The Realm of Light (Quest)#046.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#047.src: I'll tap into the monolith... You'll need to enter it, and find its core. I'll send a part of Orphion's light with you to activate it once you do.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#047.dst: 我來與巨石碑相連……你得進到它裡面去，找到它的核心。你找到之後，我會把一部分 Orphion 的光隨你送進去，用來啟動它。
