The Realm of Light (Quest)#047.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#049.src: The damage here is minor- Nothing that can't be fixed, thankfully.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#049.dst: 這裡的損傷不算嚴重——謝天謝地，沒有修不好的。
The Realm of Light (Quest)#049.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#050.src: Its aura is lowered- Now your soul must enter. I will keep you safe, {u}.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#050.dst: 它的氣息降下來了——現在該你的靈魂進去了。我會護你周全，{u}。
The Realm of Light (Quest)#050.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#051.src: Allow my magic to open your senses... Good luck, achara.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#051.dst: 讓我的魔法為你打開感官……祝你順利，achara。
The Realm of Light (Quest)#051.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#053.src: Find a way to fill the monolith with light.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#053.dst: 想辦法讓巨石碑重新充滿光。

The Realm of Light (Quest)#054.src: Follow Lari to the next monolith at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
The Realm of Light (Quest)#054.dst: 跟著 Lari 前往 [-{~1}, {~2}, -{~3}] 的下一座巨石碑。

The Realm of Light (Quest)#055.src: Welcome back, {u}. I had few troubles dealing with the creatures trying to get close. Did you have issues inside?
The Realm of Light (Quest)#055.dst: 歡迎回來，{u}。想靠近的那些生物我應付得還算輕鬆。你在裡面有遇到麻煩嗎？
The Realm of Light (Quest)#055.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#056.src: The light is starting to pulse out from the monolith again, so I would say you've succeeded. I suppose we do make a decent team?
The Realm of Light (Quest)#056.dst: 光已經開始重新從巨石碑脈動出來了，所以我想你是成功了。看來我們算是不錯的搭檔？
The Realm of Light (Quest)#056.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#057.src: Look! The colours are returning to the monolith! It's definitely reactivated. I'll run ahead and get to the other monolith.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#057.dst: 你看！顏色回到巨石碑上了！它確實重新啟動了。我先跑一步，去另一座巨石碑那邊。
The Realm of Light (Quest)#057.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#058.src: Follow the path! The way there is up the big cliff where we first entered the Realm.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#058.dst: 順著路走！要上去的地方，就是我們最初進入這個領域的那道大崖壁。
The Realm of Light (Quest)#058.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#059.src: I'm unsure if you can feel the light returning from the monolith, but I can. I almost feel reborn, with all this energy!
The Realm of Light (Quest)#059.dst: 我不確定你感不感覺得到光正從巨石碑回流，但我感覺得到。這股能量幾乎讓我覺得自己重生了！
The Realm of Light (Quest)#059.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#060.src: The rift ahead ought to take us to the second monolith, but it doesn't seem to be working, and I'm unsure why.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#060.dst: 前面那道裂隙本該把我們送到第二座巨石碑，可它好像沒有作用，我也不曉得為什麼。
The Realm of Light (Quest)#060.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#061.src: See? It's inert, which is... Odd. These aren't connected to the energy of the monolith.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#061.dst: 看到沒？它是死的，這……很奇怪。這些東西並沒有連著巨石碑的能量。
The Realm of Light (Quest)#061.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#062.src: It shouldn't be inactive as it is. There's some dark influence around here, but I can't seem to place it.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#062.dst: 它不該像這樣停擺。這附近有某種黑暗的影響，可我就是抓不出它在哪。
The Realm of Light (Quest)#062.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#063.src: My only guess is that it's interfering with the rift's energy. I've already scoured the hill though- No dark patches to be seen.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#063.dst: 我唯一的猜測是，那東西干擾了裂隙的能量。可是這座山丘我已經搜遍了——一塊黑暗的痕跡都沒有。
The Realm of Light (Quest)#063.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#064.src: Do you think you could take a second look-
The Realm of Light (Quest)#064.dst: 你能不能再幫我看第二遍——
The Realm of Light (Quest)#064.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#065.src: ...maybe you won't need to, after all. That was...
The Realm of Light (Quest)#065.dst: ……說不定你不用看了。剛才那是……
The Realm of Light (Quest)#065.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#068.src: We've found the disturbance... Even beyond this, I'll need to charge the rift with energy to activate it.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#068.dst: 我們找到擾動的來源了……就算解決了這個，我還得把能量灌進裂隙才能啟動它。
The Realm of Light (Quest)#068.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#069.src: Go in peace, tortured ones! Be at one with the light!
The Realm of Light (Quest)#069.dst: 安息吧，受折磨的生靈！與光同歸為一！
The Realm of Light (Quest)#069.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#070.src: Get the rest of them, {u}! I'll charge the rift!
The Realm of Light (Quest)#070.dst: 剩下的交給你了，{u}！我來給裂隙充能！
The Realm of Light (Quest)#070.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#071.src: Defeat the darkened creatures and progress to the monolith.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#071.dst: 擊敗被黑暗侵蝕的生物，前進到巨石碑。

The Realm of Light (Quest)#072.src: Thank you, achara. The rift is charged again- Just walk into it!
The Realm of Light (Quest)#072.dst: 謝謝你，achara。裂隙重新充能好了——直接走進去就行！
The Realm of Light (Quest)#072.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#074.src: The process here should be roughly the same. I bring down the barrier, you enter and charge it with the light I provide.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#074.dst: 這裡的程序應該大同小異。我把屏障降下來，你進去，用我提供的光把它充滿。
The Realm of Light (Quest)#074.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#075.src: I'll need to focus the energies of the monoliths to reconnect the Nexus of Light to the mainland here, so you'll be alone.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#075.dst: 我得集中兩座巨石碑的能量，才能把光之樞紐重新接回這邊的主陸，所以這次你得自己來。
The Realm of Light (Quest)#075.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#076.src: I'll leave a barrier around you. Few creatures live on these cliffs, but best to be certain, of course.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#076.dst: 我會在你周圍留一道屏障。這些崖壁上沒什麼生物，不過當然還是保險一點好。
The Realm of Light (Quest)#076.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#077.src: Once you're done, meet me at the cliff near the Nexus. If we're to free Orphion from the parasite, having you along would be a great help.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#077.dst: 你弄好之後，到樞紐附近的崖邊來找我。如果我們要把 Orphion 從那個寄生體手裡救出來，有你同行會是很大的幫助。
The Realm of Light (Quest)#077.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#078.src: Good luck, achara. I will see you soon.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#078.dst: 祝你順利，achara。我們很快就會再見。
The Realm of Light (Quest)#078.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#081.src: There. The connection to the Nexus is established, and so we'll cross.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#081.dst: 好了。通往樞紐的連結建立起來了，我們過橋吧。
The Realm of Light (Quest)#081.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#082.src: Wait! Something... Something's not quite right...
The Realm of Light (Quest)#082.dst: 等等！有什麼……有什麼不太對勁……
The Realm of Light (Quest)#082.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#083.dst: 有東西正從那道門裡出來！
The Realm of Light (Quest)#083.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#084.src: Interfere?! You're one of the dark!
The Realm of Light (Quest)#084.dst: 干涉？！你根本就是黑暗的一員！
The Realm of Light (Quest)#084.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#085.src: You're the one trespassing in realms not your own!
The Realm of Light (Quest)#085.dst: 擅闖不屬於你的領域的人是你！
The Realm of Light (Quest)#085.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#086.src: {u}. I think. I found someone. Who deserves to be killed. Help me out?
The Realm of Light (Quest)#086.dst: {u}。我想。我找到一個。該死的東西了。幫我一把？
The Realm of Light (Quest)#086.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#087.src: Continue up the road towards Orphion's Nexus of Light.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#087.dst: 沿著路繼續往 Orphion 的光之樞紐前進。

The Realm of Light (Quest)#088.src: {u}!! Stay back! I'm keeping up but he'll destroy you if you get close!!
The Realm of Light (Quest)#088.dst: {u}！！退後！我還撐得住，但你一靠近他就會把你毀了！！
The Realm of Light (Quest)#088.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#089.src: AGH, ENOUGH OF THIS! You aren't allowed here, foul thing!
The Realm of Light (Quest)#089.dst: 啊，夠了！這裡不准你來，骯髒的東西！
The Realm of Light (Quest)#089.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#091.src: No! You won't run- I'll kill you before that!
The Realm of Light (Quest)#091.dst: 不行！你別想逃——我會在那之前殺了你！
The Realm of Light (Quest)#091.speaker: Lari

The Scarred Springs#000.src: Talk to Maripe at Pishlas at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

The Scarred Springs#001.src: Oh! Well, hello there, tourist! I have to assume you're a tourist, anyways. That doesn't look like local dress, anyways. I suppose you've heard about the hot springs!
The Scarred Springs#001.speaker: Maripe

The Scarred Springs#002.src: Well, ah...unfortunately, Pishlas is closed for renovations. You see, it's been closed for a long time... My family has run it for generations, but trouble started.
The Scarred Springs#002.speaker: Maripe

The Scarred Springs#003.src: With my mother having been stricken ill for so long, my father and all our family, we've had to abandon this place to care for her. It's fallen into disrepair.
The Scarred Springs#003.speaker: Maripe

The Scarred Springs#004.src: She's well enough now that she doesn't need someone looking after her every hour, so I'm taking it on myself to return this place to its former glory!
The Scarred Springs#004.speaker: Maripe

The Scarred Springs#005.src: It's been hard work...and it should be opening soon- but I'm not quite done. Again, I'm so sorry you came all this way for nothing.
The Scarred Springs#005.speaker: Maripe

The Scarred Springs#006.src: I- excuse me? You want to...
The Scarred Springs#006.speaker: Maripe

The Scarred Springs#007.src: That'd... That'd be absolutely fantastic!! I've been working alone on this for months now!! I'm NEARLY done, but-
The Scarred Springs#007.speaker: Maripe

The Scarred Springs#008.src: Come on, come on! I'll show you around! Let's go, let's go!!
The Scarred Springs#008.speaker: Maripe

The Scarred Springs#009.src: Hopefully you'll be able to visit before you have to go home then!
The Scarred Springs#009.speaker: Maripe

The Scarred Springs#010.src: Okay, okay, what's next on the list... C'mon, think like Sovereign Zhiraok!
The Scarred Springs#010.speaker: Maripe

The Scarred Springs#011.src: Let Maripe show you around at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

The Scarred Springs#012.src: Okay, so! These are the main pools- Frankly, I have no idea how all these frogs got here, given the bog is clear across the whole forest...
The Scarred Springs#012.speaker: Maripe

The Scarred Springs#013.src: But they've got to go. Sure, they're cute, but no one's going to want to take a soak with them... Or with all these fallen leaves in the pools.
The Scarred Springs#013.speaker: Maripe

The Scarred Springs#014.src: The side pool over here is just as important to clean out. Need to have clear pools for the guests! And maybe even for the Sovereign!
The Scarred Springs#014.speaker: Maripe

The Scarred Springs#015.src: I've already put a lot of time into fixing up these huts. I do carpentry work. These used to be in so much worse shape... I'm a little glad my grandparents didn't end up seeing it like this.
The Scarred Springs#015.speaker: Maripe

The Scarred Springs#016.src: I have such fond memories of playing around here when I was younger... What would they think, seeing it fall apart? That thought has been giving me motivation this whole time.
The Scarred Springs#016.speaker: Maripe

The Scarred Springs#017.src: It'd be a disgrace to let Pishlas fall completely apart. Even Sovereign Zhiraok agreed! Did you know he dropped by, when I was first starting- Oh, wait! There's one other place!
The Scarred Springs#017.speaker: Maripe

The Scarred Springs#018.src: The teahouse! Refreshments, hot drinks, a place to sit out of the water... This is one of the big remaining projects. I'll take care of this- but, back about the Sovereign?
The Scarred Springs#018.speaker: Maripe

The Scarred Springs#019.src: He visited one day, while I was starting on fixing the place, and he told me this would be a fantastic community service! Since it's been so long since Pishlas has been usable, I mean.
The Scarred Springs#019.speaker: Maripe

The Scarred Springs#020.src: This used to be a big community center. Losing it was a blow to all Auburn residents... He's promised some great things if I can clean this all up! So let's get to it!
The Scarred Springs#020.speaker: Maripe

The Scarred Springs#021.src: You go gather up the frogs! There's a pond to the you can drop them off at. Then...the leaves! Pick them out of the pools. Then...then come back and we'll see where we're at!
The Scarred Springs#021.speaker: Maripe

The Scarred Springs#023.src: How's it coming? Still working on this. Will be for a bit, but I'm energized! Maybe I can get this done today, even! Uh...right, right! Frogs!
The Scarred Springs#023.speaker: Maripe

The Scarred Springs#024.src: Okay, there were five, and you're holding... Alright, so there's left to get!
The Scarred Springs#024.speaker: Maripe

The Scarred Springs#025.src: Release the frogs at the pond in the back at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

The Scarred Springs#026.src: Woah! That...that's sure a way to carry the frogs, haha! Y- Pfffkhhhaaahahahaa!! You look- Wahaha, that's fantastic!! Oh, Ohhkay, okay, right!
The Scarred Springs#026.speaker: Maripe

The Scarred Springs#027.src: There's a pond to the of Pishlas here you can drop them off at! Now, g-get out of here, eheheh! I gotta concentrate, and there's frogs on y- heehehahahahaaah!!
The Scarred Springs#027.speaker: Maripe

The Scarred Springs#028.src: Pick up all the leaf piles around [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

The Scarred Springs#029.src: Okay, frogs are dealt with, now the leaves! There were ten big patches out there I saw. Get in there and scoop them up- Uh, lemme see. ...
The Scarred Springs#029.speaker: Maripe

The Scarred Springs#030.src: Okay, you got left! Hopefully once you do, I'll be all done over here, and we'll go from there!
The Scarred Springs#030.speaker: Maripe

The Scarred Springs#032.src: Okay, there! And STAY in, you darn board... So, how's the work going?
The Scarred Springs#032.speaker: Maripe

The Scarred Springs#033.src: Frogs dealt with, check...and leaves out of the water, check! Which, ah...well, that means now I need you to get some leaves...to put IN the water, eheh!
The Scarred Springs#033.speaker: Maripe

The Scarred Springs#034.src: What I mean by that, is that I need fresh tea for the teahouse! I've already got some food stowed away for refreshments, but I'll need some drinks to go along with that.
The Scarred Springs#034.speaker: Maripe

The Scarred Springs#035.src: I might be done in this building, but there's still plenty of things for me to take care of, so I've got to stay behind and really...really focus in on this!
The Scarred Springs#035.speaker: Maripe

The Scarred Springs#036.src: It's just that...a lot of this isn't heavy work, but there's just so many tasks on the list that I don't know where to start, so I just can't get it going. You taking care of the other things is helping with that!
The Scarred Springs#036.speaker: Maripe

The Scarred Springs#037.src: So, uh, anyway! There's a teahouse off to the northwest, up on a ridge. I know the owner- her name's Marseled, and she makes the best tea in the whole forest!
The Scarred Springs#037.speaker: Maripe

The Scarred Springs#038.src: So, your job is to head there for a big bulk order, and then bring it back! I'll ask her about paying it off later, since we trade favors a lot. Tell her I sent you!
The Scarred Springs#038.speaker: Maripe

The Scarred Springs#040.src: Okay, dust busted, cobwebs cleared, lanterns in the middle of being lit- Oh, hey! Did you get the tea?
The Scarred Springs#040.speaker: Maripe

The Scarred Springs#041.src: Marseled's teahouse is off to the northwest, up on the ridge. If you need the exact spot, look in your !
The Scarred Springs#041.speaker: Maripe

The Scarred Springs#042.src: Welcome, traveler, to my humble teahouse. My name is Marseled. It is always a pleasure to see a new customer.
The Scarred Springs#042.speaker: Marseled

The Scarred Springs#043.src: So, what can I do for you?
The Scarred Springs#043.speaker: Marseled

The Scarred Springs#044.src: Oh, is that so? Why, that's wonderful! He's spoken with me a few times about working on old Pishlas there. If he wants fresh stock for drinks, he must be confident that it's nearly finished!
The Scarred Springs#044.speaker: Marseled

The Scarred Springs#045.src: Admittedly, though, I'm facing some...difficulties. I've not got quite enough to fill up an order like he'll need. You see, ah...there's...
The Scarred Springs#045.speaker: Marseled

The Scarred Springs#046.src: It's COCKROACHES! Filthy, ugly, disgusting COCKROACHES!! They keep getting all over the mushrooms and on the tea leaves and I CAN'T touch them, I can't I can't I CAN'T!!
The Scarred Springs#046.speaker: Marseled

The Scarred Springs#047.src: They aren't even harming the plants or anything, but I go out to harvest them and they race up to me and crawl all over my feet and up my leggings and aahghguhgughuguhhhh!!!
The Scarred Springs#047.speaker: Marseled

The Scarred Springs#048.src: I hate them I hate them I hate them, I hate them so much! I- Er. Um. S-sorry. I...shouldn't act so ill-mannered in front of my customers.
The Scarred Springs#048.speaker: Marseled

The Scarred Springs#049.src: The musrooms are right out front and the leaves are down the side of the hill. and should be enough to get me started again.
The Scarred Springs#049.speaker: Marseled

The Scarred Springs#050.src: I do hate to ask, but...if you could go out and harvest some of the ingredients for me? And deal with the pests? I've tried, but every time I just...panic.
The Scarred Springs#050.speaker: Marseled

The Scarred Springs#051.src: If you could take care of that problem for me, I'll be able to fill out the order for Maripe... And, hopefully, I won't wake the whole of {p} shrieking over a roach in my pants.
The Scarred Springs#051.speaker: Marseled

The Scarred Springs#052.src: The mushrooms are just out front, and the leaves are down the side of the hill. and should be enough to fill the order.
The Scarred Springs#052.speaker: Marseled

The Scarred Springs#053.src: Collect {~} mushrooms and {~} leaf batches from the tea farm at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

The Scarred Springs#054.src: Oh, hey! Did you get the tea yet? I'm trying to get everything in ship-shape here, but I'm running in circles a little...
The Scarred Springs#054.speaker: Maripe

The Scarred Springs#055.src: Oh, ew. She's got roaches in the farm? Yeah, that's rough. Anyways, go get 'em! I'll be, uh... Well, hopefully I'll have this done by the time you deal with that!
The Scarred Springs#055.speaker: Maripe

The Scarred Springs#056.src: Bring the tea you collected back to Marseled at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

The Scarred Springs#057.src: So, what can I do for you?
The Scarred Springs#057.speaker: Marseled

The Scarred Springs#059.src: YES!! Take THAT, you dirty things! No more cockroooaches, no more cockroooaches, yeah, yeah- Er!
The Scarred Springs#059.speaker: Marseled

The Scarred Springs#060.src: ...if you could. Um. Not tell anyone I was...doing that happy dance. Please. I don't think I've done that since I was a child.
The Scarred Springs#060.speaker: Marseled

The Scarred Springs#061.src: A-anyway, I'll pack up that order and bring it down to Pishlas on my own time. I know where it is. Perhaps I can be there for the opening celebrations, too!
The Scarred Springs#061.speaker: Marseled

The Scarred Springs#062.src: I'll be sure to let my customers know. An entire generation has missed out on those hot springs, if my parents speak truly, so this will be an event to cherish, I think!
The Scarred Springs#062.speaker: Marseled

The Scarred Springs#063.src: Okay, that's that now, so now- Oh, you're back! Did you get the order all filled out?
The Scarred Springs#063.speaker: Maripe

The Scarred Springs#064.src: ...oops. You got confused, didn't you. Nah, those ingredients need to go to Marseled, and THEN come here. Good hustle, though! Get those to Marseled for processing!
The Scarred Springs#064.speaker: Maripe

The Scarred Springs#065.src: Bring the tea back to Maripe at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

The Scarred Springs#066.src: Oh my gosh, oh my gosh...L-Look! We have visitors!! Um, I know I'm not setting a great example, but...be quiet, okay? Don't disturb them!
The Scarred Springs#066.speaker: Maripe

The Scarred Springs#067.src: See? The foxes...! I haven't seen them around here since I was a kid! I- well, if you're a tourist you wouldn't know, I suppose, but this is exciting!
The Scarred Springs#067.speaker: Maripe

The Scarred Springs#068.src: There's a really common tale about foxes here- That they're the reincarnation of our ancestors, that their spirits inhabit them. I know it's...well, it's supposed to be just a tall tale, but...
The Scarred Springs#068.speaker: Maripe

The Scarred Springs#069.src: I really can't help but feel like seeing them here is a good omen! It's like my grandparents are back again- Er, wait! The tea! I completely forgot, did you get the order placed?
The Scarred Springs#069.speaker: Maripe

The Scarred Springs#070.src: Oh, Marseled said she'd bring it by herself? Alright, fantastic! And she said she'd invite folks to the opening too... Funny she did, since that's what I was just about to ask you to do!
The Scarred Springs#070.speaker: Maripe

The Scarred Springs#071.src: Pishlas is almost back to the way I remember it being when I was younger. I've still got a bit of decorating to do, so I want you to spread the word!
The Scarred Springs#071.speaker: Maripe

The Scarred Springs#072.src: I've got some notes here on where you could find folks I know in {p}. You tell them, put some notices up...
The Scarred Springs#072.speaker: Maripe

The Scarred Springs#073.src: ...and then after the big celebration re-opening, they'll tell their families, and then word will spread from there! Is it odd to say I'm looking forward to the work of maintaining the place?
The Scarred Springs#073.speaker: Maripe

The Scarred Springs#074.src: Anyways, head off and start getting the word out! If you don't know where to look, just ! If you lose my notes you can come back and I'll copy them down again for you.
The Scarred Springs#074.speaker: Maripe

The Scarred Springs#075.src: Invite citizens of {p} at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] to join the opening celebrations.

The Scarred Springs#076.src: Whew, okay... Whew. Gotta remember, I'm not the Sovereign. Can't be everywhere at once. Need to slow down...it's nearly done, no need to stress out- Oh, hey!
The Scarred Springs#076.speaker: Maripe

The Scarred Springs#077.src: Have you spread the word yet? to see where the people usually are, and get the news out! You're invited to the grand re-opening too, of course.
The Scarred Springs#077.speaker: Maripe

The Scarred Springs#078.src: Whew, okay... Whew. Gotta remember, I'm not the Sovereign. Can't be everywhere at once. Need to slow down...it's nearly done, no need to stress out- Oh, hey!
The Scarred Springs#078.speaker: Maripe

The Scarred Springs#079.src: Oh, you lost my notes. Don't worry, it happens. Do you think you can find the spots on your own, or do you want me to write a new copy down for you?
The Scarred Springs#079.speaker: Maripe

The Scarred Springs#080.src: Okay, one sec...and...here! Remember to for where to go!
The Scarred Springs#080.speaker: Maripe

The Scarred Springs#081.src: All the spots I listed are {u}, but if you're having trouble, I'll write you up a new set if you ask!
The Scarred Springs#081.speaker: Maripe

The Scarred Springs#082.src: Oh, hello there. I certainly haven't seen you around here before.
The Scarred Springs#082.speaker: Cousullo

The Scarred Springs#083.src: Is there something you wanted to speak with me about?
The Scarred Springs#083.speaker: Cousullo

The Scarred Springs#085.src: Oh, OH! Pishlas? The hot springs? Sorry, it's been so long that I nearly forgot the name.
The Scarred Springs#085.speaker: Cousullo

The Scarred Springs#086.src: I have such vague memories of going there as a child, but I couldn't imagine them after seeing how the place was abandoned.
The Scarred Springs#086.speaker: Cousullo

The Scarred Springs#087.src: Maripe did tell me some time ago he would be working on renovating it. I'm to suppose his work has paid off, then! I'd intended to visit him again soon, but this provides a nice excuse, as well.
The Scarred Springs#087.speaker: Cousullo

The Scarred Springs#088.src: ...I might have to spread the word to his family for him. Even if Maripe's father is too busy looking after his wife, I'm sure he'll be delighted to hear about this.
The Scarred Springs#088.speaker: Cousullo

The Scarred Springs#089.src: Well, I hope to see you there, stranger!
The Scarred Springs#089.speaker: Cousullo

The Scarred Springs#090.src: Well, this is a sight, for sure! What can we do for you, fella?
The Scarred Springs#090.speaker: Mont

The Scarred Springs#092.src: It's been ages, right...? That place, it's been in a state of disrepair for as long as I can recall...
The Scarred Springs#092.speaker: Nerod

The Scarred Springs#093.src: They're finally going to be open again? And fully renovated? Sounds-
The Scarred Springs#093.speaker: Mont

The Scarred Springs#094.src: Sounds tempting. It's been ages since I've been able to bathe in hot water or relax properly...
The Scarred Springs#094.speaker: Feri

The Scarred Springs#095.src: We'll surely all be there! These old bones could use a nice, long soak, I think!
The Scarred Springs#095.speaker: Mont

The Scarred Springs#096.src: The tourist returns! Anything else you wanted to talk about?
The Scarred Springs#096.speaker: Mont

The Scarred Springs#097.src: Head back to Pishlas to participate in the celebrations at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

The Scarred Springs#098.src: Okay. Phew. Wow. Okay. Alright, alright, it's...
The Scarred Springs#098.speaker: Maripe

The Scarred Springs#099.src: It's...it's done. It's all... It's all done, wow, I... There's. There's people... And they're here, and they're enjoying it, and, and...
The Scarred Springs#099.speaker: Maripe

The Scarred Springs#100.src: And I don't have to think about this anymore, and my parents can relax about having let the place go, and...
The Scarred Springs#100.speaker: Maripe

The Scarred Springs#101.src: And, and, and, the, the Sovereign, he'll, Ill get to tell him I'm done, and I'll get that, and... Ohhh my stars I'm done but I'm even more anxious now that it's done than I was before, aaah-
The Scarred Springs#101.speaker: Maripe

The Scarred Springs#102.src: Okay, come on, keep your head on straight, Maripe! Now's the time to relax a bit... Deep breaths now- Oh, hey!
The Scarred Springs#102.speaker: Maripe

The Scarred Springs#103.src: Uh, I...I need a minute, eheh. How about...you, uh, talk to everyone else, first, and just...yeah?
The Scarred Springs#103.speaker: Maripe

The Scarred Springs#104.src: I'd say I barely recognize the place after all the renovations...but honestly, it feels like I'm right at home, like I'm that little fox kit I used to be.
The Scarred Springs#104.speaker: Cousullo

The Scarred Springs#105.src: Maripe tried to talk you up like you did all the work! I practically had to pry a confession out of him that you just came in at the end to help with the finishing touches.
The Scarred Springs#105.speaker: Cousullo

The Scarred Springs#106.src: He's always been a humble sort, but I think that just shows his gratitude. And believe me, I'm grateful to you as well! I think you gave him the kick he needed.
The Scarred Springs#106.speaker: Cousullo

The Scarred Springs#107.src: Ohhhohoho that's the spot. Man...I never knew what I was missing. Sort of an old style name, Pishlas, but...
The Scarred Springs#107.speaker: Denis

The Scarred Springs#108.src: Phew, I'm definitely going to be coming back here again. A long day of Liff hunting, then a long night's soak... Oh, that sounds like a satisfying routine...
The Scarred Springs#108.speaker: Denis

The Scarred Springs#109.src: Maripe, hm. That boy has done good. Certainly couldn't have done better myself, at my age. He's got an eye for carpentry, for decoration, for the respect of his ancestors...
The Scarred Springs#109.speaker: Feri

The Scarred Springs#110.src: And heck, he's even got free towels provided! I'll be a regular from now on, that's for sure! Hope he's prepared for daily business!
The Scarred Springs#110.speaker: Feri

The Scarred Springs#111.src: Wow... I'll have to tell Timot what he's missing out on. This is fantastic. Perfect view, perfect water, perfect service...
The Scarred Springs#111.speaker: Nerod

The Scarred Springs#112.src: Family concerns are dfinitely more important than a warm bath, but... I'll have to share some leaves with him, buy his ticket for next time. He deserves a free soak.
The Scarred Springs#112.speaker: Nerod

The Scarred Springs#113.src: Ahhh, that hits the spot... Youngster, do yourself a favor- never get as old as I am. {~} years, I've got...and this... Goodbye, aches, my dear old enemies...
The Scarred Springs#113.speaker: Mont

The Scarred Springs#114.src: It's heavenly to feel them wash away in the water, but boy would I love to not creak when I sit down to begin with. Good on you for helping out, by the way- especially for a tourist!
The Scarred Springs#114.speaker: Mont

The Scarred Springs#115.src: After the community notice board got vandalized so badly a couple years ago, I thought not to trust it again. I'm quite glad I broke with that and gave it a look now.
The Scarred Springs#115.speaker: Fiscu

The Scarred Springs#116.src: Have you seen the owner of the springs, by the way? He's had a few foxes around him all day- normally, they're not the ones doing the chasing like that!
The Scarred Springs#116.speaker: Fiscu

The Scarred Springs#117.src: Oh, it's lovely to be back. Having visited this place as a teenager, it had always saddened me that it closed. My heart really does go out to Maripe's mother.
The Scarred Springs#117.speaker: Estur

The Scarred Springs#118.src: Honestly, if the Sovereign can manage all his business, his father should've been able to keep up. But either way, Maripe has outdone himself- and the Auburn Amaretto is such a fine vintage!
The Scarred Springs#118.speaker: Estur

The Scarred Springs#119.src: I've enough years on me to remember how Maripe's grandparents used to run this place. Maripe has outdone himself- this is, at barest minimum, up to their standard. No one can say otherwise.
The Scarred Springs#119.speaker: Marseled

The Scarred Springs#120.src: It always was something of a...blemish, on his family's name, this place. I understand his mother fell ill, and that's certainly no one's fault, but abandoning a family business for any reason...
The Scarred Springs#120.speaker: Marseled

The Scarred Springs#121.src: People judged them all, whether they realized it or not. Hopefully now with Pishlas open, that will end. It feels as if a cloud has lifted, really. Hmhm, or maybe that's just the tea.
The Scarred Springs#121.speaker: Marseled

The Scarred Springs#122.src: Either way, this is marvelous work. And I can take my harvest without having to worry about disgusting cockroaches crawling all over me! So thank you for that, as well.
The Scarred Springs#122.speaker: Marseled

The Scarred Springs#124.src: I think I said earlier- with so many different little things piling up, I just couldn't think straight. i've been stuck at 'almost done' for a while now.
The Scarred Springs#124.speaker: Maripe

The Scarred Springs#125.src: You showing up, offering to take care of all the little things cluttering up my brainspace...that made this...possible! I don't think I could've done it without you!
The Scarred Springs#125.speaker: Maripe

The Scarred Springs#126.src: It really is jsut like I remembered it being. Everyone getting together and relaxing, talking about whatever strikes their fancy, just letting their woes disappear...
The Scarred Springs#126.speaker: Maripe

The Scarred Springs#127.src: It even feels like I've got my grandparents right here with me. ...though, maybe that's just these two. These foxes have been following me all day...I hope they'll stick around.
The Scarred Springs#127.speaker: Maripe

The Scarred Springs#128.src: It's this feeling of... a weight off my chest, but the knowledge there's a new task ahead of me- keeping up with this place. With Pishlas. It's...refreshing, I think.
The Scarred Springs#128.speaker: Maripe

The Scarred Springs#129.src: Do... I know you're just a tourist, but...do you think... Do you think my grandparents would be proud of me? For all this?
The Scarred Springs#129.speaker: Maripe

The Scarred Springs#131.src: ...oh gosh, I promised myself I wouldn't cry...a-and here I am doing it anyways. Haha... Stars, I'm tired after all this. So, so tired...but. But the good king of tired, you know?
The Scarred Springs#131.speaker: Maripe

The Scarred Springs#132.src: You might need to go home soon, since you're just visiting...but come back any time. It'll be free, for you- and these should go pretty far in the {p}, I think. I just- Thank you...so much.
The Scarred Springs#132.speaker: Maripe

The Scarred Springs#133.src: ...you know...you might have a point. I've been so weighed down by what everyone might think, that I could barely focus on the work. I should try and let that go, shouldn't I?
The Scarred Springs#133.speaker: Maripe

The Scarred Springs#134.src: You know, for a tourist, you sure are generous with the help. So, I should be generous too! How's free access for life...and a personal gift from me sound? Again...thank you, so much!
The Scarred Springs#134.speaker: Maripe

The Scarred Springs#135.src: ...heh. I guess that would make sense. But...I'd like to think they would be. I really would.
The Scarred Springs#135.speaker: Maripe

The Scarred Springs#136.src: So... For one thing. You get free access! For another...here's a personal gift from me! After all, you didn't HAVE to help...but you did! You'll get a lot more use out of these than I will. SO...thank you, so much!
The Scarred Springs#136.speaker: Maripe

The Sewers of Ragni#001.src: Soldier! Good timing. We've been requesting help for ages.
The Sewers of Ragni#001.dst: 士兵！來得正好。我們求援求了好久了。
The Sewers of Ragni#001.speaker: Jenprest

The Sewers of Ragni#002.src: With the corrupted hordes terrorising the Wynn Plains, more and more people are moving to {p}.
The Sewers of Ragni#002.dst: 腐化大軍在 Wynn 平原橫行，越來越多人搬進 {p}。
The Sewers of Ragni#002.speaker: Jenprest

The Sewers of Ragni#003.src: Issue is, a major sewage pipe's been blocked up. No wonder nobody wanted the job.
The Sewers of Ragni#003.dst: 問題是，一條主排污管被堵住了。難怪沒人想接這差事。
The Sewers of Ragni#003.speaker: Jenprest

The Sewers of Ragni#004.src: I'm going to need you to get your hands dirty. I'll need some assistance with the blockage.
The Sewers of Ragni#004.dst: 我需要你弄髒一下手。清那個阻塞得有人幫我。
The Sewers of Ragni#004.speaker: Jenprest

The Sewers of Ragni#005.src: Here's the brief. We get in, deploy some small explosives to dislodge the blockage, and get out.
The Sewers of Ragni#005.dst: 任務簡報是這樣：我們進去，放幾顆小型炸藥把堵塞物炸開，然後出來。
The Sewers of Ragni#005.speaker: Jenprest

The Sewers of Ragni#006.src: We're using the side pipe. The larger one down the hill, well... you don't want to stray too far into that one.
The Sewers of Ragni#006.dst: 我們走側管。山坡下那條比較大的，嗯……你不會想走太深進去的。
The Sewers of Ragni#006.speaker: Jenprest

The Sewers of Ragni#007.src: Keep your wits about you in there. All sorts of things could be lurking. Ready? Let's go!
The Sewers of Ragni#007.dst: 在裡面提高警覺。什麼東西都可能潛伏在那裡。準備好了嗎？走吧！
The Sewers of Ragni#007.speaker: Jenprest

The Sewers of Ragni#008.src: Enter the sewer at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] and find the blockage.

The Sewers of Ragni#009.src: Explore the sewer and find the blockage.
The Sewers of Ragni#009.dst: 探索下水道，找到堵塞處。

The Sewers of Ragni#010.src: Good, you caught up. Watch your step around this place, soldier.
The Sewers of Ragni#010.dst: 很好，你跟上了。在這裡走路小心點，士兵。
The Sewers of Ragni#010.speaker: Jenprest

The Sewers of Ragni#011.src: Our scouts have confirmed that this area is clear, but a wrong turn could lead you into the old prison complex.
The Sewers of Ragni#011.dst: 我們的偵察兵確認過這一區是安全的，不過走錯一個彎就會走進那座舊監獄。
The Sewers of Ragni#011.speaker: Jenprest

The Sewers of Ragni#012.src: I... we really don't want to end up there.
The Sewers of Ragni#012.dst: 我……我們真的不會想跑到那裡去。
The Sewers of Ragni#012.speaker: Jenprest

The Sewers of Ragni#013.src: Anyway, I've found the blockage. It's right up ahead.
The Sewers of Ragni#013.dst: 總之，我找到堵塞處了。就在前面。
The Sewers of Ragni#013.speaker: Jenprest

The Sewers of Ragni#014.src: Here's a small explosive. I placed this one at the blockage already, if that alone doesn't work, use this.
The Sewers of Ragni#014.dst: 這是一顆小型炸藥。堵塞處那邊我已經放了一顆，如果那顆不夠，就用這顆。
The Sewers of Ragni#014.speaker: Jenprest

The Sewers of Ragni#015.src: Find a way to fix the blockage.

The Sewers of Ragni#016.src: Find a way out of the spooky sewer.
The Sewers of Ragni#016.dst: 想辦法離開這條陰森的下水道。

The Sewers of Ragni#017.src: Ah, you're alive. Looks like we underestimated the amount of sewage.
The Sewers of Ragni#017.dst: 啊，你還活著。看來我們低估了污水的量。
The Sewers of Ragni#017.speaker: Jenprest

The Sewers of Ragni#018.src: I lost you for a bit back there. It's lucky we found each other, to be honest.
The Sewers of Ragni#018.dst: 剛才有一陣子跟你走散了。老實說，能再會合算是運氣好。
The Sewers of Ragni#018.speaker: Jenprest

The Sewers of Ragni#019.src: ... ah. This sewer has some history, you know. Back during the {p} Raids, they used to hide civilians here, in the old prison.
The Sewers of Ragni#019.dst: ……啊。這條下水道是有點歷史的。當年 {p} 大掠襲的時候，他們會把平民藏在這裡，藏在那座舊監獄裡。
The Sewers of Ragni#019.speaker: Jenprest

The Sewers of Ragni#020.src: Sometimes... sometimes it wasn't enough. Some say there are still... things roaming there. Left over from the slaughters.
The Sewers of Ragni#020.dst: 有時候……有時候還是不夠。有人說那裡到現在還有……東西在遊蕩。那些屠殺留下來的。
The Sewers of Ragni#020.speaker: Jenprest

The Sewers of Ragni#021.src: Let's get out of here. Do you still have the explosive I gave you?
The Sewers of Ragni#021.dst: 我們出去吧。我給你的那顆炸藥還在嗎？
The Sewers of Ragni#021.speaker: Jenprest

The Sewers of Ragni#022.src: Good, let's use it on this wall, it looks like we can break right through...
The Sewers of Ragni#022.dst: 很好，就炸這面牆，看起來我們可以直接打通……
The Sewers of Ragni#022.speaker: Jenprest

The Sewers of Ragni#023.dst: 到 [-{~1}, {~2}, -{~3}] 跟 Jenprest 談話

The Sewers of Ragni#024.src: Phew! Looks like that first explosion cleared the pipe, and the {p} citizens are going to be happy.
The Sewers of Ragni#024.dst: 呼！看來第一顆炸藥就把管路清通了，{p} 的居民要開心了。
The Sewers of Ragni#024.speaker: Jenprest

The Sewers of Ragni#025.src: And count yourself lucky we didn't run into anything too nasty in there. Some of the stories...
The Sewers of Ragni#025.dst: 而且算我們走運，在裡面沒撞上什麼太難纏的東西。那些傳聞啊……
The Sewers of Ragni#025.speaker: Jenprest

The Sewers of Ragni#026.src: ... I don't exactly know what's in there, soldier.
The Sewers of Ragni#026.dst: ……我也說不準裡面到底有什麼，士兵。
The Sewers of Ragni#026.speaker: Jenprest

The Sewers of Ragni#027.src: I can't stop you from exploring the dungeon, but I recommend you gear up first.
The Sewers of Ragni#027.dst: 我沒辦法阻止你去闖那座地城，但我建議你先把裝備弄好。
The Sewers of Ragni#027.speaker: Jenprest

The Sewers of Ragni#028.src: Legend has it that Bob, the legendary warrior, was born in them during a raid on {p}.
The Sewers of Ragni#028.dst: 傳說中，那位傳奇戰士 Bob 就是在 {p} 遭到掠襲時，在裡面出生的。
The Sewers of Ragni#028.speaker: Jenprest

The Sewers of Ragni#029.src: His mother died in childbirth, but some people said she lay down there for years. Rotting. Waiting.
The Sewers of Ragni#029.dst: 他母親難產過世了，不過有人說她在下面躺了好多年。腐爛著。等著。
The Sewers of Ragni#029.speaker: Jenprest

The Sewers of Ragni#030.src: But that's just a story! Thanks for your help, soldier, and good luck.
The Sewers of Ragni#030.dst: 不過那只是個故事罷了！謝謝你的幫忙，士兵，祝你好運。
The Sewers of Ragni#030.speaker: Jenprest

The Shadow of the Beast#000.src: Talk to Dereg in his house at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

The Shadow of the Beast#001.src: Oh, you look tough. You must be one of those humans I keep hearing about, right? People talk about your kind all the time.
The Shadow of the Beast#001.speaker: Dereg

The Shadow of the Beast#002.src: You know, that you're all scrappers. Tough as nails, and willing to kill all sorts of beasts, you know?
The Shadow of the Beast#002.speaker: Dereg

The Shadow of the Beast#003.src: I think you know what I'm getting at. I saw some massive thing lumbering around the swamp one night! Tall as the trees, it was.
The Shadow of the Beast#003.speaker: Dereg

The Shadow of the Beast#004.src: I couldn't make out the details, but if its size was any indication, it could just step over the {p} walls and wreck the whole town!
The Shadow of the Beast#004.speaker: Dereg

The Shadow of the Beast#005.src: Of course, there's so many scam artists around here trying to sell anti-monster underwear or whatever that no one believes me.
The Shadow of the Beast#005.speaker: Dereg

The Shadow of the Beast#006.src: So, that means it's up to you! Ehm, supposing that you're willing to help out, at least... The one thing I know for sure is that it was eating something.
The Shadow of the Beast#006.speaker: Dereg

The Shadow of the Beast#007.src: See that blood on the ground? That stuff is fresh. Follow it, see where it leads, and hunt that beast before it does something terrible!
The Shadow of the Beast#007.speaker: Dereg

The Shadow of the Beast#008.src: That blood trail ought to lead you to wherever the beast went. Hunt that thing down for us all!
The Shadow of the Beast#008.speaker: Dereg

The Shadow of the Beast#009.src: Follow the trail of blood left by the beast.

The Shadow of the Beast#010.src: Oh, this is such a mess! And my axe is busted, too...how am I going to get this fixed?!
The Shadow of the Beast#010.speaker: Tolem

The Shadow of the Beast#011.src: I can't pay for- AAAH! H-Human! What do you want?! Not a good time!
The Shadow of the Beast#011.speaker: Tolem

The Shadow of the Beast#012.src: Something destroyed my cow pen and wrecked up my entire farm!
The Shadow of the Beast#012.speaker: Tolem

The Shadow of the Beast#013.src: And they were solid, good-quality Willow, too...uff...
The Shadow of the Beast#013.speaker: Tolem

The Shadow of the Beast#014.src: Wait, what? You're hunting the thing? Well, that's fine and dandy, but do you think you could help here first?
The Shadow of the Beast#014.speaker: Tolem

The Shadow of the Beast#015.src: I have an idea of where it went, so...you scratch my back, I scratch yours?
The Shadow of the Beast#015.speaker: Tolem

The Shadow of the Beast#016.src: Okay, this can work, this can work! I have to figure out how to fix this, and some of my cows ran off in a panic.
The Shadow of the Beast#016.speaker: Tolem

The Shadow of the Beast#017.src: So, you can take care of them while I re-plan my fencing. Simple enough, right?
The Shadow of the Beast#017.speaker: Tolem

The Shadow of the Beast#018.src: Three of my cows ran off. Look around the farm for them. They were eating, so look for fallen wheat on the ground!
The Shadow of the Beast#018.speaker: Tolem

The Shadow of the Beast#019.src: Go on, hop to it! I'm waiting for you right here!
The Shadow of the Beast#019.speaker: Tolem

The Shadow of the Beast#020.src: Deal with the three escaped cows near the house and in the cave under the farm.

The Shadow of the Beast#021.src: Oh, back aleady? I haven't even finished my stuff, where are the cows?
The Shadow of the Beast#021.speaker: Tolem

The Shadow of the Beast#023.src: ...eheh. You. You're. This is a joke, right? We're having a chuckle?!
The Shadow of the Beast#023.speaker: Tolem

The Shadow of the Beast#024.src: WE'RE JOKING, RIGHT?! FOR THE LOVE OF ALL THAT'S HOLY TELL ME THIS IS A JOKE!
The Shadow of the Beast#024.speaker: Tolem

The Shadow of the Beast#025.src: WHAT IS THIS?! ARE YOU BRAINDEAD?!
The Shadow of the Beast#025.speaker: Tolem

The Shadow of the Beast#026.src: NO, WAIT, YOU'RE HUMAN, THAT'S THE PROBLEM! IDIOT THUGS, ALL OF YOU!
The Shadow of the Beast#026.speaker: Tolem

The Shadow of the Beast#027.src: DID I NEED TO SPECIFY THAT I WANTED THEM BACK ALIVE? WAS THAT NOT OBVIOUS TO YOU?!
The Shadow of the Beast#027.speaker: Tolem

The Shadow of the Beast#028.src: Hff...haah...hrrgh...I...I can't bellevue...bellevue? Believe! I can't believe this!
The Shadow of the Beast#028.speaker: Tolem

The Shadow of the Beast#029.src: Uff, settle down, Tolem, settle down...you can still salvage this...
The Shadow of the Beast#029.speaker: Tolem

The Shadow of the Beast#030.src: Alright, two things. Your new name is Idiot, and I'm changing our deal. You owe me [{~} Willow Planks].
The Shadow of the Beast#030.speaker: Tolem

The Shadow of the Beast#031.src: You're going to help me get at least one thing around here working. You get the wood, I'll keep looking over the fencing.
The Shadow of the Beast#031.speaker: Tolem

The Shadow of the Beast#033.src: Oh lovely. Idiot's back! Joy of joys. Willow planks, please.
The Shadow of the Beast#033.speaker: Tolem

The Shadow of the Beast#034.src: Good. Even if you've got murder on the mind constantly, you have decent woodcutting arms.
The Shadow of the Beast#034.speaker: Tolem

The Shadow of the Beast#035.src: I'll sell the remainder of these planks to try and recoup the money for my cows you mulched.
The Shadow of the Beast#035.speaker: Tolem

The Shadow of the Beast#036.src: So go on, get out of here now. Make yourself useful and follow the giant footprints in the ground. Hunt something that NEEDS hunting, instead of cattle!
The Shadow of the Beast#036.speaker: Tolem

The Shadow of the Beast#037.src: Go on, get out of here. Make yourself useful and follow the giant footprints in the ground. Hunt something that NEEDS hunting, instead of cattle!
The Shadow of the Beast#037.speaker: Tolem

The Shadow of the Beast#038.src: Follow the footprints from Tolem's house at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

The Shadow of the Beast#039.src: Oh, I'll never be able to fix this with my back in this state...
The Shadow of the Beast#039.speaker: Kroac

The Shadow of the Beast#041.src: Oh, look at this...all my years of carpentry and my bad back does my poor house in.
The Shadow of the Beast#041.speaker: Kroac

The Shadow of the Beast#042.src: What on earth could have done this?! It must be the biggest beast in the swamp!
The Shadow of the Beast#042.speaker: Kroac

The Shadow of the Beast#043.src: I was just sitting inside having some dinner, I hear some rumbling, and suddenly my house is falling apart!
The Shadow of the Beast#043.speaker: Kroac

The Shadow of the Beast#044.src: You human folk are good with physical labor, I hear? Do you think you could help me out here?
The Shadow of the Beast#044.speaker: Kroac

The Shadow of the Beast#045.src: There's a mine just over there. Think you can get [{~} Cobblestone] out of it?
The Shadow of the Beast#045.speaker: Kroac

The Shadow of the Beast#046.src: I'll go find someone who's selling any spare wood for the roof...
The Shadow of the Beast#046.speaker: Kroac

The Shadow of the Beast#047.src: Think you could help fix my house? You'll need [{~} Cobblestone] to do it.
The Shadow of the Beast#047.speaker: Kroac

The Shadow of the Beast#048.src: Enter Kroac's mine and gather [{~} Cobblestone].

The Shadow of the Beast#049.src: Did you get enough cobblestone? I found a guy down the street selling this top-quality Willow...
The Shadow of the Beast#049.speaker: Kroac

The Shadow of the Beast#050.src: Good, perfect. That should be enough. Though, I do have one other thing to ask you, soldier.
The Shadow of the Beast#050.speaker: Kroac

The Shadow of the Beast#051.src: My back's already screaming at me just from lugging the wood over here, there's no way I can climb up there and fix the roof like this.
The Shadow of the Beast#051.speaker: Kroac

The Shadow of the Beast#052.src: I can compensate you for the trouble, but d'you think you could do some patchwork for me with that cobble?
The Shadow of the Beast#052.speaker: Kroac

The Shadow of the Beast#053.src: Oh, you're a saint. Can't imagine why the guy was grumbling about humans... Just climb right on up the ladder!
The Shadow of the Beast#053.speaker: Kroac

The Shadow of the Beast#054.src: Repair Kroac's house using the cobblestone from the mine.

The Shadow of the Beast#055.src: I'm sorry, but your patchjob fell apart. You'll need something like {~} cobblestone to help fix this.
The Shadow of the Beast#055.speaker: Kroac

The Shadow of the Beast#056.src: That'll do just fine, kind soldier! You're a lifesaver, really, you are.
The Shadow of the Beast#056.speaker: Kroac

The Shadow of the Beast#057.src: Wait, you're going after the thing that did this? Really?! Fantastic! That's a load off my mind.
The Shadow of the Beast#057.speaker: Kroac

The Shadow of the Beast#058.src: Look's like there's tracks off to the east...big tracks. Good luck following it, stay safe!
The Shadow of the Beast#058.speaker: Kroac

The Shadow of the Beast#059.src: If you are done fixing my house, it looks like there're tacks off to the east...big tracks. Good luck following it, stay safe!
The Shadow of the Beast#059.speaker: Kroac

The Shadow of the Beast#060.src: Keep following the tracks of the beast.

The Shadow of the Beast#061.src: EVERYONE, MOVE! THE BEAST IS ON A RAMPAGE!
The Shadow of the Beast#061.speaker: Rileen

The Shadow of the Beast#062.src: Aah, no! There were people in that house!
The Shadow of the Beast#062.speaker: Rileen

The Shadow of the Beast#063.src: Wah! H-Human! Get away, there's nothing you can help with here!
The Shadow of the Beast#063.speaker: Rileen

The Shadow of the Beast#064.src: All your type does is break and hurt! You have more in common with the giant there than any of us!
The Shadow of the Beast#064.speaker: Rileen

The Shadow of the Beast#065.src: Aah, there's so many people hurt already, don't make it worse please!
The Shadow of the Beast#065.speaker: Rileen

The Shadow of the Beast#066.src: We don't even have any medicine...
The Shadow of the Beast#066.speaker: Rileen

The Shadow of the Beast#067.src: Ugh, think Rileen! You have the herbs, what else goes into the poultices...
The Shadow of the Beast#067.speaker: Rileen

The Shadow of the Beast#068.src: Oh, right! Fish oil...but I don't have a rod, gah!
The Shadow of the Beast#068.speaker: Rileen

The Shadow of the Beast#069.src: There's no way I can get [{~} Salmon Oil], even if that pond out back is teeming with fish...
The Shadow of the Beast#069.speaker: Rileen

The Shadow of the Beast#071.src: No, there's no time to make a fishing spear- AAH! You're still here? What do you WANT?!
The Shadow of the Beast#071.speaker: Rileen

The Shadow of the Beast#072.src: W-wait, what's...is this... This is salmon oil! Ten bottles of it! You...you heard me talking?
The Shadow of the Beast#072.speaker: Rileen

The Shadow of the Beast#073.src: And you went out of your way to... What kind of a human are you? I've only ever heard horror stories about your kind.
The Shadow of the Beast#073.speaker: Rileen

The Shadow of the Beast#075.src: ...maybe you're not so bad. I don't have anything that I can give you in return, but thank you, still.
The Shadow of the Beast#075.speaker: Rileen

The Shadow of the Beast#076.src: Wait, you were chasing the giant? That's why you were here? That...that's amazing news!
The Shadow of the Beast#076.speaker: Rileen

The Shadow of the Beast#077.src: I think it went into the cave east of here. Go for it! Stop that thing before it causes any more damage!
The Shadow of the Beast#077.speaker: Rileen

The Shadow of the Beast#078.src: Find the cave of the beast by following the footprints behind Rileen's house.

The Shadow of the Beast#079.src: Kill the beast and return to Dereg with proof of its death at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

The Shadow of the Beast#080.src: You're back! Any luck hunting the thing down?
The Shadow of the Beast#080.speaker: Dereg

The Shadow of the Beast#081.src: What? You actually found the beast?! Heck of a hunting job, human!
The Shadow of the Beast#081.speaker: Dereg

The Shadow of the Beast#082.src: You wouldn't be back here if you didn't manage to kill it...which means our problems are solved, right?
The Shadow of the Beast#082.speaker: Dereg

The Shadow of the Beast#083.src: Heheh! That bone powder looks giant enough to me! Great job, bucko!
The Shadow of the Beast#083.speaker: Dereg

The Shadow of the Beast#084.src: Y'know, come to think of it, I remember something that might be interesting to your sort.
The Shadow of the Beast#084.speaker: Dereg

The Shadow of the Beast#085.src: The weapon merchant in {p} researches cryptids as a hobby, and that beast seemed one-of-a-kind to me.
The Shadow of the Beast#085.speaker: Dereg

The Shadow of the Beast#086.src: You should show him that bone powder! He might have some good gear for you.
The Shadow of the Beast#086.speaker: Dereg

The Strong Survive#001.src: I am disappointed in you Perin.
The Strong Survive#001.speaker: Military Recruiter

The Strong Survive#002.src: When I meet new recruits, I expect them to look at least somewhat in shape!
The Strong Survive#002.speaker: Military Recruiter

The Strong Survive#003.src: Yet here we are... Have you even done any training since we sent you the letter?
The Strong Survive#003.speaker: Military Recruiter

The Strong Survive#004.src: I have been training! I swear!
The Strong Survive#004.speaker: Perin

The Strong Survive#005.src: Oh really, has a mentor been preparing you? Surely your family could afford one.
The Strong Survive#005.speaker: Military Recruiter

The Strong Survive#006.src: Mentor? Y-yeah, of course I have one!
The Strong Survive#006.speaker: Perin

The Strong Survive#007.src: They're right there! We were just about to start my training for the day actually.
The Strong Survive#007.speaker: Perin

The Strong Survive#009.src: So you're Perin's mentor huh? There's no other way to say this, but you must be terrible at your job...
The Strong Survive#009.speaker: Military Recruiter

The Strong Survive#010.src: You certainly look fit to be a soldier though. Perhaps training isn't your strong suit.
The Strong Survive#010.speaker: Military Recruiter

The Strong Survive#011.src: So how about I take you to join the Fruman military instead of Perin?
The Strong Survive#011.speaker: Military Recruiter

The Strong Survive#012.src: That sounds great! Meet us near the south {p} entrance, then we will take you to {p}.
The Strong Survive#012.speaker: Military Recruiter

The Strong Survive#013.src: Oh, and don't keep us waiting. Or it might end up on your record.
The Strong Survive#013.speaker: Military Recruiter

The Strong Survive#014.src: I hope you enjoy MY spot at Tericen!
The Strong Survive#014.speaker: Perin

The Strong Survive#016.src: Meet the recruiter near the south entrance to {p} at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

The Strong Survive#017.src: There you are! Didn't I tell you not to keep us waiting?
The Strong Survive#017.speaker: Military Recruiter

The Strong Survive#018.src: Get into the carriage, we'll take you to {p}.
The Strong Survive#018.speaker: Military Recruiter

The Strong Survive#019.src: You don't want to miss the opening speech from the famed Sovereign Majin!
The Strong Survive#019.speaker: Military Recruiter

The Strong Survive#020.src: Watch out for the horses, they can be a bit nippy.
The Strong Survive#020.speaker: Carriage Driver

The Strong Survive#022.src: Head into the carriage and then we'll go to {p}.
The Strong Survive#022.speaker: Military Recruiter

The Strong Survive#023.src: The carriage is ready to go, we're just waiting on you.
The Strong Survive#023.speaker: Carriage Driver

The Strong Survive#024.src: Don't keep us waiting, get into the carriage.
The Strong Survive#024.speaker: Military Guard

The Strong Survive#025.src: You shouldn't worry about Perin anymore. Trust me, I am doing him a favour by taking you instead.
The Strong Survive#025.speaker: Military Recruiter

The Strong Survive#026.src: Although, he will surely be shamed by his community for not becoming a soldier, but frankly, he deserves it.
The Strong Survive#026.speaker: Military Recruiter

The Strong Survive#027.src: You must be very excited to become a recruit, I can see it on your face!
The Strong Survive#027.speaker: Military Recruiter

The Strong Survive#028.src: But let me warn you, the process is not all sunshine and rainbows.
The Strong Survive#028.speaker: Military Recruiter

The Strong Survive#029.src: The training is grueling and competitive, every single facet of your physical ability will be tested!
The Strong Survive#029.speaker: Military Recruiter

The Strong Survive#030.src: Think you're up for it? Well, I think you could manage. You'd certainly do better than Perin!
The Strong Survive#030.speaker: Military Recruiter

The Strong Survive#031.src: {p} is run by the esteemed Commander Ferreo. When you meet him, it's very important that you show him his due respect.
The Strong Survive#031.speaker: Military Recruiter

The Strong Survive#032.src: The Commander's been serving since as long as I can remember. He's probably the most accomplished man in the {p}, aside from Sovereign Majin of course!
The Strong Survive#032.speaker: Military Recruiter

The Strong Survive#033.src: Ah, I hope you're ready, we should be arriving soon.
The Strong Survive#033.speaker: Military Recruiter

The Strong Survive#035.src: We're here, just head on in and I'll meet you up ahead inside!
The Strong Survive#035.speaker: Military Recruiter

The Strong Survive#036.src: I don't mind, but did we really need to take the carriage?
The Strong Survive#036.speaker: Carriage Driver

The Strong Survive#037.src: Thank the Queen, I won't have to follow this idiot around anymore, now that the recruiting process is done.
The Strong Survive#037.speaker: Military Guard

The Strong Survive#039.src: Return to the Tericen entrance at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

The Strong Survive#040.src: Talk to the Uniform Tailor, then go see Commander Ferreo.

The Strong Survive#042.src: This is where you will be staying until you become a soldier.
The Strong Survive#042.speaker: Secretary

The Strong Survive#043.src: Please see the tailor across from me to get your uniform, then see Commander Ferreo in the next room.
The Strong Survive#043.speaker: Secretary

The Strong Survive#044.src: I can't let you enter until you get your uniform, speak with the tailor.
The Strong Survive#044.speaker: Military Guard

The Strong Survive#045.src: Are you also here as a recruit?
The Strong Survive#045.speaker: Arnol

The Strong Survive#046.src: I'm Arnol, it seems like we've made it just in time!
The Strong Survive#046.speaker: Arnol

The Strong Survive#047.src: I'll let you get your uniform. We should talk after the speech.
The Strong Survive#047.speaker: Arnol

The Strong Survive#048.src: Welcome to {p}! Congratulations on getting accepted to become a soldier!
The Strong Survive#048.speaker: Uniform Tailor

The Strong Survive#049.src: You must be from the {p}. The rest of the recruits have already gotten their uniforms.
The Strong Survive#049.speaker: Uniform Tailor

The Strong Survive#050.src: Your uniform colour will be yellow.
The Strong Survive#050.speaker: Uniform Tailor

The Strong Survive#051.src: What is your name? I need to write it on your uniform.
The Strong Survive#051.speaker: Uniform Tailor

The Strong Survive#052.src: ** The Shield room has five turrets the first day and seven on the second day. The turrets also use more complicated patterns.
The Strong Survive#052.speaker: Resilience

The Strong Survive#053.src: ** The Parkour room has smaller platforms and more precise timing.
The Strong Survive#053.speaker: Leap

The Strong Survive#054.src: ** Enables an optional secret fight with Adder on the second night.
The Strong Survive#054.speaker: Adder

The Strong Survive#055.src: ** Commander Ferreo is instead fought as The Iron Commander.
The Strong Survive#055.speaker: Tericen

The Strong Survive#056.src: ** Enables the effects of Adder, Tericen, Leap, and Resilience, and also grants the Iron Medallion necklace as a quest reward.
The Strong Survive#056.speaker: Cursed

The Strong Survive#057.src: Very funny... Now tell me what your real name is.
The Strong Survive#057.speaker: Uniform Tailor

The Strong Survive#058.src: Alright, this will only take a second or two.
The Strong Survive#058.speaker: Uniform Tailor

The Strong Survive#059.src: All done, here is your uniform recruit!
The Strong Survive#059.speaker: Uniform Tailor

The Strong Survive#060.src: Now go see Commander Ferreo, he is waiting for you in the next room.
The Strong Survive#060.speaker: Uniform Tailor

The Strong Survive#061.src: Go see Commander Ferreo, he's in the next room.
The Strong Survive#061.speaker: Uniform Tailor

The Strong Survive#062.src: I see you've been given your uniform. It looks good on you!
The Strong Survive#062.speaker: Secretary

The Strong Survive#064.src: Commander Ferreo is waiting for you in the next room.
The Strong Survive#064.speaker: Secretary

The Strong Survive#065.src: Once you are done speaking with him, you'll be hearing a speech from Sovereign Majin in the stage room!
The Strong Survive#065.speaker: Secretary

The Strong Survive#066.src: Recruits are separated by their divisions, their uniform colours reflect this.
The Strong Survive#066.speaker: Secretary

The Strong Survive#067.src: Those with red uniforms are from Auburn, cyan uniforms are from the Industrial district, white uniforms are in the Wings division...
The Strong Survive#067.speaker: Secretary

The Strong Survive#068.src: Green uniforms are in the {p} division, they are recruits selected from other regions based on a test that decides if they are suited for the dangerous conditions in the {p}...
The Strong Survive#068.speaker: Secretary

The Strong Survive#069.src: Since you are in the {p} division, your group leader is Recruiter Effal.
The Strong Survive#069.speaker: Secretary

The Strong Survive#070.src: {p} is the largest and most prestigious military training camp in Fruma, headed by the equally prestigious Commander Ferreo.
The Strong Survive#070.speaker: Secretary

The Strong Survive#071.src: Many of the most famous soldiers of Fruma have originated from here, you should be proud to be a part of our program!
The Strong Survive#071.speaker: Secretary

The Strong Survive#072.src: Most recruits already know this before coming to {p}... I suppose there is no shame in asking if you don't know.
The Strong Survive#072.speaker: Secretary

The Strong Survive#073.src: The Fruman military is composed of nine divisions, being seven regional divisions, the Constable division, and the Wings division.
The Strong Survive#073.speaker: Secretary

The Strong Survive#074.src: Yes, you heard that right, seven regional divisions not six. The seventh being the Xima division which recruits soldiers directly from the Auburn division, which is why most people lump them together.
The Strong Survive#074.speaker: Secretary

The Strong Survive#075.src: The Constable division has an authority level higher than all the regional divisions, and the Wings division has authority over both of them. Be careful not to step on their toes when you become a soldier!
The Strong Survive#075.speaker: Secretary

The Strong Survive#076.src: Within each division is a ranking system used to separate leadership roles. In ascending order of authority; there are soldiers, captains, commanders, and finally a single general that manages the commanders.
The Strong Survive#076.speaker: Secretary

The Strong Survive#077.src: The Wings division has some additional positions within it, like the Gendarmes. They're a group of Wings soldiers that only operate within Aelumia.
The Strong Survive#077.speaker: Secretary

The Strong Survive#078.src: Don't worry, this question is more common than you'd think.
The Strong Survive#078.speaker: Secretary

The Strong Survive#079.src: In about a month, if everything goes to plan, you and the rest of the recruits will attend a ceremony and officially become Fruman soldiers!
The Strong Survive#079.speaker: Secretary

The Strong Survive#080.src: From there, you'll work in a group with other {p} soldiers. If you are able to impress your superiors, you can be promoted to captain or even commander!
The Strong Survive#080.speaker: Secretary

The Strong Survive#081.src: Another thing that can happen if you demonstrate exception abilities is promotion to the Constable division or maybe even the Wings division!
The Strong Survive#081.speaker: Secretary

The Strong Survive#082.src: There truly is fame and glory waiting ahead of you. If you are able to prove yourself.
The Strong Survive#082.speaker: Secretary

The Strong Survive#083.src: Alright, good luck on your training!
The Strong Survive#083.speaker: Secretary

The Strong Survive#084.src: Speak with the secretary if you're lost.
The Strong Survive#084.speaker: Military Guard

The Strong Survive#085.src: You may not enter yet, talk to the commander and then enter the stage room across from us.
The Strong Survive#085.speaker: Military Guard

The Strong Survive#086.src: You may not enter yet, talk to Commander Ferreo.
The Strong Survive#086.speaker: Military Guard

The Strong Survive#087.src: I can't let you enter until you talk to Commander Ferreo.
The Strong Survive#087.speaker: Military Guard

The Strong Survive#088.src: You have you brought me Effal, this is not Perin.
The Strong Survive#088.speaker: Commander Ferreo

The Strong Survive#089.src: You will have to excuse me Commander, but I did not deem Perin as fit to be a recruit.
The Strong Survive#089.speaker: Recruiter Effal

The Strong Survive#090.src: The boy had done no training, he would not have lasted a day here!
The Strong Survive#090.speaker: Recruiter Effal

The Strong Survive#091.src: I told him this myself, and while I was reprimanding him... Erm...
The Strong Survive#091.speaker: Recruiter Effal

The Strong Survive#092.src: ... Had overheard our conversation and begged that I take them instead.
The Strong Survive#092.speaker: Recruiter Effal

The Strong Survive#093.src: Seeing that they looked more suitable than Perin, and hearing their reasoning as to why they should be a recruit, I decided to adhere to their request.
The Strong Survive#093.speaker: Recruiter Effal

The Strong Survive#094.src: So you deliberately acted against the directions given to you?
The Strong Survive#094.speaker: Commander Ferreo

The Strong Survive#095.src: Well... Yes... I-I truly apologize for violating the orders given to me...
The Strong Survive#095.speaker: Recruiter Effal

The Strong Survive#096.src: Do not go against what you are told to do again.
The Strong Survive#096.speaker: Commander Ferreo

The Strong Survive#097.src: Nevertheless, if what you say about Perin is true, perhaps it is for the best that he does not become a recruit.
The Strong Survive#097.speaker: Commander Ferreo

The Strong Survive#098.src: Welcome to {p}, recruit. Enter the room to the right so that we may begin the opening speech.
The Strong Survive#098.speaker: Commander Ferreo

The Strong Survive#099.src: Thank you Commander! Now, let me lead you to the stage!
The Strong Survive#099.speaker: Recruiter Effal

The Strong Survive#100.src: Listen to the speech from Sovereign Majin.

The Strong Survive#101.src: Shouldn't you be listening to a speech right now?
The Strong Survive#101.speaker: Secretary

The Strong Survive#102.src: You may not enter yet, enter the stage room across from us.
The Strong Survive#102.speaker: Military Guard

The Strong Survive#103.src: You may only enter after Sovereign Majin's speech.
The Strong Survive#103.speaker: Military Guard

The Strong Survive#104.src: There's no time for chit-chat, the speech is about to start!
The Strong Survive#104.speaker: Military Guard

The Strong Survive#105.src: Welcome recruits, to the start of your training in becoming a Fruman soldier.
The Strong Survive#105.speaker: Sovereign Majin

The Strong Survive#106.src: You have all been carefully chosen by a group of experienced recruiters.
The Strong Survive#106.speaker: Sovereign Majin

The Strong Survive#107.src: They have closely reviewed your performances in physical tests of strength and agility since you were children, and have decided that you belong here.
The Strong Survive#107.speaker: Sovereign Majin

The Strong Survive#108.src: Do not prove to me that they were wrong.
The Strong Survive#108.speaker: Sovereign Majin

The Strong Survive#109.src: Use the opportunities given to you to show us that you deserve to be amongst your superiors.
The Strong Survive#109.speaker: Sovereign Majin

The Strong Survive#110.src: Your instructors will expect the best from you, so you must show them the best. Those who refuse or are unable to do this have no place here.
The Strong Survive#110.speaker: Sovereign Majin

The Strong Survive#111.src: Your role will be the most important in Fruma. Ensuring the safety of the population is no small task, trust me.
The Strong Survive#111.speaker: Sovereign Majin

The Strong Survive#112.src: So, like I have, each of you must prove yourself worthy of being called a soldier of Fruma.
The Strong Survive#112.speaker: Sovereign Majin

The Strong Survive#113.src: Let my words serve as motivation for you during your training.
The Strong Survive#113.speaker: Sovereign Majin

The Strong Survive#114.src: We are thankful to Sovereign Majin for taking time out of his responsibilities to deliver the opening speech.
The Strong Survive#114.speaker: Commander Ferreo

The Strong Survive#115.src: Now we will be bringing you to your first training session of the day, I hope you all are ready.
The Strong Survive#115.speaker: Commander Ferreo

The Strong Survive#116.src: Each of you will be separated into groups depending on your division. For each challenge, your group will be paired with another group.
The Strong Survive#116.speaker: Commander Ferreo

The Strong Survive#117.src: The leaders of each region grouping will be the recruiter who originally sent you the invitation letter.
The Strong Survive#117.speaker: Commander Ferreo

The Strong Survive#118.src: They will be the ones leading you to where you're supposed to be for the first couple of days here, following an assigned schedule.
The Strong Survive#118.speaker: Commander Ferreo

The Strong Survive#119.src: You are expected to be at your designated area, on time and ready.
The Strong Survive#119.speaker: Commander Ferreo

The Strong Survive#120.src: However, if for whatever reason you get lost, go to the secretary at the main lobby desk and she will tell you where to go.
The Strong Survive#120.speaker: Commander Ferreo

The Strong Survive#121.src: Now, go convene with your recruiters in the main room to your left, then they will take you to your first training session.
The Strong Survive#121.speaker: Commander Ferreo

The Strong Survive#122.src: That was a pretty good speech, I was a bit nervous, but now I am ready to start the training!
The Strong Survive#122.speaker: Arnol

The Strong Survive#123.src: I'm Arnol, I come from the nobel {p} Tasa family, Fruma has done so much for us, so I am ready to help her.
The Strong Survive#123.speaker: Arnol

The Strong Survive#124.src: I'm glad that you're from the {p}. That means we're in the same group!
The Strong Survive#124.speaker: Arnol

The Strong Survive#125.src: How about you and I stick together during our training?
The Strong Survive#125.speaker: Arnol

The Strong Survive#126.src: My family tells me that recruits often end up very... competitive...
The Strong Survive#126.speaker: Arnol

The Strong Survive#127.src: So I think we can both benefit from sticking together, and watching each others' backs.
The Strong Survive#127.speaker: Arnol

The Strong Survive#128.src: Anyways, we should head to our group's leader, I think his name is Effal?
The Strong Survive#128.speaker: Arnol

The Strong Survive#129.src: Talk to Recruiter Effal then head to the challenge room at [-{~}, {~}, {~}].

The Strong Survive#130.src: Hey there recruit! Need help with anything?
The Strong Survive#130.speaker: Secretary

The Strong Survive#131.src: After corresponding with you recruiter, head to the room straight across as soon as you enter the next room then go down the stairs on the right.
The Strong Survive#131.speaker: Secretary

The Strong Survive#132.src: From there, head into the challenge room your team leader told you about.
The Strong Survive#132.speaker: Secretary

The Strong Survive#133.src: Good luck on your first challenge, I believe in you!
The Strong Survive#133.speaker: Secretary

The Strong Survive#134.src: Good luck with your training, recruit. But I'll warn you, Commander Ferreo is no pushover.
The Strong Survive#134.speaker: Military Guard

The Strong Survive#135.src: Do you need help with something recruit? Your team leader is Recruiter Effal, go see him for instructions.
The Strong Survive#135.speaker: Recruiter Alena

The Strong Survive#136.src: You know it's not too late to turn back. You risk losing more than just your pride here.
The Strong Survive#136.speaker: Robin

The Strong Survive#137.src: Definitely not going to happen. After hearing that speech from Sovereign Majin, I feel like I could take on the entire resistance!
The Strong Survive#137.speaker: Robyn

The Strong Survive#138.src: Are you nervous like me? We're about to start the training and I still don't feel ready.
The Strong Survive#138.speaker: Verdi

The Strong Survive#139.src: I shouldn't worry, if anything goes wrong, I know Recruiter Alena will be there to help.
The Strong Survive#139.speaker: Verdi

The Strong Survive#140.src: But at the same time, It's hard not to be scared...
The Strong Survive#140.speaker: Verdi

The Strong Survive#142.src: Ugh... How did Arnol end up here?...
The Strong Survive#142.speaker: Lynn

The Strong Survive#143.src: That speech from Sovereign Majin was amazing...
The Strong Survive#143.speaker: Priscilla

The Strong Survive#144.src: I was almost brought to tears... I wish with all my heart that I may serve under him one day!
The Strong Survive#144.speaker: Priscilla

The Strong Survive#145.src: Sorry, but I'm not your team leader, since your in the {p} group, your team leader is uhmm... Ah, it's Recruiter Effal.
The Strong Survive#145.speaker: Recruiter Ezero

The Strong Survive#146.src: I'm so glad to finally be out of the Roughworks. Although, after the training, we will have to go back...
The Strong Survive#146.speaker: Holger

The Strong Survive#147.src: I figured you'd be used to it after spending your whole life living there.
The Strong Survive#147.speaker: Matilda

The Strong Survive#148.src: I think Holger is just impressed by the luxuries of the {p}. I'd imagine even the slums here are fancier than the Roughworks.
The Strong Survive#148.speaker: Kerry

The Strong Survive#149.src: Excuse me, Ezero sir, is it true the soldiers around here call Commander Ferreo 'The Iron Commander'?
The Strong Survive#149.speaker: Wilton

The Strong Survive#150.src: I believe he used to go by that nickname in his younger years, he was quite the fearsome leader.
The Strong Survive#150.speaker: Recruiter Ezero

The Strong Survive#151.src: You should be careful not to get on his bad side... The last guy that did got exiled to Wynn...
The Strong Survive#151.speaker: Recruiter Ezero

The Strong Survive#153.src: Heh, I'm just messing with oyu kid, you don't have to worry about him, he's softened up a lot over the years.
The Strong Survive#153.speaker: Recruiter Ezero

The Strong Survive#154.src: I am not your team leader. Go find Recruiter Effal, the person wearing the same coloured clothes as you.
The Strong Survive#154.speaker: Recruiter Riva

The Strong Survive#155.src: Shouldn't be too hard to do, I'd think.
The Strong Survive#155.speaker: Recruiter Riva

The Strong Survive#156.src: Alright, time to put these skills to use! Are you ready for this, Katze?
The Strong Survive#156.speaker: Halbe

The Strong Survive#157.src: I'm ready! Let's show everyone we're the best!
The Strong Survive#157.speaker: Katze

The Strong Survive#158.src: Are you from the {p}? I recognize everyone in that group except you, strange...
The Strong Survive#158.speaker: Kyren

The Strong Survive#159.src: Well, just a word of advice, be careful when picking your friends, it means everything here.
The Strong Survive#159.speaker: Kyren

The Strong Survive#160.src: If you know the right people, you can climb the ranks quickly. But you must also have to have the abilities to go along with it of course.
The Strong Survive#160.speaker: Kyren

The Strong Survive#161.src: You look lost, don't worry, I can help you! Go find Recruiter Effal, he's wearing a yellow headband and is near the center of the room.
The Strong Survive#161.speaker: Recruiter Ollisy

The Strong Survive#163.src: How do you feel about being accepted into the {p} division? I am pretty excited about it, glad Recruiter Olissy noticed my value.
The Strong Survive#163.speaker: Yvonne

The Strong Survive#164.src: As someone from Auburn, I'm a bit unsure still, but the recruiters know what they are doing, so I will trust their judgement.
The Strong Survive#164.speaker: Madelen

The Strong Survive#165.src: I don't know much about the {p} either, but I guarantee we will be ready for whatever is in store for us there!
The Strong Survive#165.speaker: Yvonne

The Strong Survive#166.src: I'm not the person you're looking for, go see Recruiter Effal.
The Strong Survive#166.speaker: Recruiter Strumon

The Strong Survive#167.src: I have spent nearly my entire life training to become a soldier. I wonder how many other recruits here could say the same.
The Strong Survive#167.speaker: Adder

The Strong Survive#168.src: The Fruman military is in somewhat of a dire state right now, with resistance attacks becoming more brazen than seemingly ever.
The Strong Survive#168.speaker: Adder

The Strong Survive#169.src: The duty will fall to us to return things back to normalcy. I am up to the task, and I hope you are too.
The Strong Survive#169.speaker: Adder

The Strong Survive#170.src: Oh hey, you're from the {p}! I'm from Aelumia but I grew up in {p}.
The Strong Survive#170.speaker: Saldin

The Strong Survive#171.src: I was assigned to the Wings group though, I'm a bit worried about meeting those expectations...
The Strong Survive#171.speaker: Saldin

The Strong Survive#172.src: Heh, Oh well, that's what training is for, right?
The Strong Survive#172.speaker: Saldin

The Strong Survive#173.src: There you are. Didn't I tell you? Ah, never mind...
The Strong Survive#173.speaker: Recruiter Effal

The Strong Survive#174.src: Listen, remember that talk we had with Ferreo, how about that just stays between us ok?
The Strong Survive#174.speaker: Recruiter Effal

The Strong Survive#175.src: I better not see you gossiping to other recruits about it, that would make me very upset!
The Strong Survive#175.speaker: Recruiter Effal

The Strong Survive#176.src: The first test for our group is the shield challenge, everyone follow my lead.
The Strong Survive#176.speaker: Recruiter Effal

The Strong Survive#177.src: This area is only for soldiers and injured recruits, and well... You don't look injured.
The Strong Survive#177.speaker: Military Recruiter

The Strong Survive#178.src: Sorry recruit, only soldiers are allowed to enter this area.
The Strong Survive#178.speaker: Military Recruiter

The Strong Survive#179.src: Welcome recruits to the shield challenge.
The Strong Survive#179.speaker: Military Instructor

The Strong Survive#180.src: Defense is one of the most important aspects of combat. You should not expect yourself to be able to dodge every incoming attack.
The Strong Survive#180.speaker: Military Instructor

The Strong Survive#181.src: A shield can be an incredibly useful tool for a soldier, but holding them up constantly can often interfere with your mobility.
The Strong Survive#181.speaker: Military Instructor

The Strong Survive#182.src: Knowing when to hold up your shield to defend yourself against incoming arrows or attackers, is thus, a vital skill to learn.
