The Thanos Depository#019.dst: 你或許看過牠在我們城市上方的巢。牠平常不會傷害我們，但有一天牠突然闖進了這座金庫。
The Thanos Depository#019.speaker: Coulmis

The Thanos Depository#020.src: My great friend Atila has been leading a recon squad, he's discerned that she's nesting an egg.
The Thanos Depository#020.dst: 我的好友 Atila 一直帶著偵察小隊，他判斷牠正在孵一顆蛋。
The Thanos Depository#020.speaker: Coulmis

The Thanos Depository#021.src: We've tried at our greatest expenses to steal the egg, and bring it back to her nest, so that maybe she would leave... But, as you've heard, it's not going well.
The Thanos Depository#021.dst: 我們不惜代價想把那顆蛋偷出來、送回牠的巢，也許牠就會離開……但你也聽到了，進展並不順利。
The Thanos Depository#021.speaker: Coulmis

The Thanos Depository#022.src: I don't normally ask this of strangers, but we've run ourselves thin. Do you think you're up to help? I'll make sure it's all worth your trouble.
The Thanos Depository#022.dst: 我平常不會向陌生人開這種口，但我們實在人手耗盡了。你願意幫忙嗎？我一定會讓你的辛苦有所回報。
The Thanos Depository#022.speaker: Coulmis

The Thanos Depository#023.src: So you'll help!? Thank you so much! I'll make sure it's worth every moment!
The Thanos Depository#023.dst: 你願意幫！？太感謝了！我保證你花的每一刻都值得！
The Thanos Depository#023.speaker: Coulmis

The Thanos Depository#024.src: You'll have to go through this chamber behind me to reach the depository. Our only other way in is right where the dragon is...
The Thanos Depository#024.dst: 你得穿過我身後這座廳室才能抵達儲藏庫。另一條路正好就在那條龍待著的地方……
The Thanos Depository#024.speaker: Coulmis

The Thanos Depository#025.src: Atila knows some of the inner workings of the vault. I bid you good luck and will be praying for your success. Your courage will inspire {p}.
The Thanos Depository#025.dst: Atila 知道一些金庫內部的運作方式。祝你好運，我會為你的成功祈禱。你的勇氣會鼓舞整個 {p}。
The Thanos Depository#025.speaker: Coulmis

The Thanos Depository#026.src: Oh, so it wasn't meant to be I suppose...
The Thanos Depository#026.dst: 噢，看來這事終究是不成了……
The Thanos Depository#026.speaker: Coulmis

The Thanos Depository#027.src: Well, if we cross paths again, I'll always much appreciate your help... Back to the drawing board...
The Thanos Depository#027.dst: 好吧，如果我們日後再遇上，我依然會非常感謝你的協助……回頭再想辦法吧……
The Thanos Depository#027.speaker: Coulmis

The Thanos Depository#030.src: Find a way through the depository.

The Thanos Depository#031.src: Ride the minecarts to get further in to the depository

The Thanos Depository#032.src: Steal Ozoth's egg and escape the depository.
The Thanos Depository#032.dst: 偷走 Ozoth 的蛋並逃出儲藏庫。

The Thanos Depository#034.src: Oh-oh my gosh!! I took you for dead, and thought the dragon was sending me up a corpse!
The Thanos Depository#034.dst: 噢——我的天啊！！我還以為你死了，以為那條龍是把一具屍體送上來給我！
The Thanos Depository#034.speaker: Atila

The Thanos Depository#035.src: You really got it!? Hurry, then, the nest is up through this cave! Maybe {p} can finally be rid of its woes...
The Thanos Depository#035.dst: 你真的拿到了！？那快，巢就在這個洞穴上去的地方！也許 {p} 終於能擺脫這場麻煩了……
The Thanos Depository#035.speaker: Atila

The Thanos Depository#036.src: Place Ozoth's egg back in her nest at [{~},-{~}].
The Thanos Depository#036.dst: 把 Ozoth 的蛋放回牠的巢，座標 [{~},-{~}]。

The Thanos Depository#038.src: She's a beauty, isn't she? A monster though, nevertheless.
The Thanos Depository#038.dst: 牠很美，不是嗎？不過終究是頭怪物。
The Thanos Depository#038.speaker: Atila

The Thanos Depository#039.src: {u}! Over here... Atila told me the news, I came as fast as I could!
The Thanos Depository#039.dst: {u}！這邊……Atila 把消息告訴我了，我用最快的速度趕過來！
The Thanos Depository#039.speaker: Coulmis

The Thanos Depository#040.src: You're a hero, lad! With the dragon out of our city, {p} no longer has to live in fear.
The Thanos Depository#040.dst: 你是英雄，小子！那條龍離開我們的城市，{p} 再也不用活在恐懼裡了。
The Thanos Depository#040.speaker: Coulmis

The Thanos Depository#041.src: I've prepared your reward. The people of {p} will remember your contribution for years to come.
The Thanos Depository#041.dst: 你的報酬我準備好了。{p} 的人民會在往後的許多年裡記得你的貢獻。
The Thanos Depository#041.speaker: Coulmis

The Ultimate Weapon#001.src: I'm glad you came along, I could do with a little help if you're not too busy.
The Ultimate Weapon#001.speaker: Dodegar

The Ultimate Weapon#002.src: I'm Dodegar Bandysnoot, the world famous Hobbit swordsmith! Perhaps you've heard of me?
The Ultimate Weapon#002.speaker: Dodegar

The Ultimate Weapon#003.src: No? Oh... Well, I've had an idea about how I could make the best weapon that the world has ever seen!
The Ultimate Weapon#003.speaker: Dodegar

The Ultimate Weapon#004.src: But, I need some help getting the special resources to make it.
The Ultimate Weapon#004.speaker: Dodegar

The Ultimate Weapon#005.src: You'll help?! Excellent! We shall gather enough resources to make one for each of us!
The Ultimate Weapon#005.speaker: Dodegar

The Ultimate Weapon#006.src: So firstly, I need some living wood for the handle, [{~} Enchanted Stick] should be enough.
The Ultimate Weapon#006.speaker: Dodegar

The Ultimate Weapon#007.src: The wood sprites located across the river to the west, in a big tree trunk, have magical properties! The handle can then mold to the user's hand! One shouldn't be too hard to come across!
The Ultimate Weapon#007.speaker: Dodegar

The Ultimate Weapon#008.src: I hope you are prepared, this will be your best quest yet!
The Ultimate Weapon#008.speaker: Dodegar

The Ultimate Weapon#009.src: Collect [{~} Enchanted Stick] from Wood Sprites at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] and return them to Dodegar

The Ultimate Weapon#010.src: Wow! You got the wood I needed, thanks!
The Ultimate Weapon#010.speaker: Dodegar

The Ultimate Weapon#011.src: While I'm making the handle, could you help me with the blade?
The Ultimate Weapon#011.speaker: Dodegar

The Ultimate Weapon#012.src: Since we want this weapon to be as good as possible we need to find some sacred Hobbit metal!
The Ultimate Weapon#012.speaker: Dodegar

The Ultimate Weapon#013.src: The hobbit village, The Shiar, is really close! Follow the southern road. My brother Gogedar should be there!
The Ultimate Weapon#013.speaker: Dodegar

The Ultimate Weapon#014.src: Dodegar needs [{~} Sacred Hobbit Metal] from the Shiar at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

The Ultimate Weapon#015.src: My brother you say... Trying to create a weapon...
The Ultimate Weapon#015.speaker: Gogedar

The Ultimate Weapon#017.src: Oh he needs Sacred Hobbit Metal!?
The Ultimate Weapon#017.speaker: Gogedar

The Ultimate Weapon#019.src: Sorry can't help you. I don't really know what that is.
The Ultimate Weapon#019.speaker: Gogedar

The Ultimate Weapon#022.src: Dodegar? Does not really ring a bell I'm afraid.
The Ultimate Weapon#022.speaker: Togedar

The Ultimate Weapon#023.src: Oh! Gogedar's brother, why didn't you tell me that.
The Ultimate Weapon#023.speaker: Togedar

The Ultimate Weapon#024.src: Sacred Hobbit Metal... This is a metal forged by master blacksmith hobbits within our village. It is a bit expensive to get by but holds great potential, if used properly.
The Ultimate Weapon#024.speaker: Togedar

The Ultimate Weapon#026.src: I don't have any. Maybe ask my nephew's brother Alegdar?
The Ultimate Weapon#026.speaker: Togedar

The Ultimate Weapon#029.src: I actually don't know much about... anything.
The Ultimate Weapon#029.speaker: Alegdar

The Ultimate Weapon#030.src: I kind of just... stand around here.
The Ultimate Weapon#030.speaker: Alegdar

The Ultimate Weapon#031.src: Everyone I have ever met just calls me annoying and useless. So I decided to stop trying.
The Ultimate Weapon#031.speaker: Alegdar

The Ultimate Weapon#032.src: You know, life is hard. We all just have to fight through, and then eventually, we might become happy.
The Ultimate Weapon#032.speaker: Alegdar

The Ultimate Weapon#033.src: Right sorry... Ask Balegar for any information. He is way smarter.
The Ultimate Weapon#033.speaker: Alegdar

The Ultimate Weapon#035.src: My cousin's nephew's dad has had a rough year... I feel bad for him.
The Ultimate Weapon#035.speaker: Balegar

The Ultimate Weapon#037.src: I have nooooo clue about that metal. I heard it was just a valuable as a normal rock.
The Ultimate Weapon#037.speaker: Balegar

The Ultimate Weapon#038.src: Maybe my cousin Reyoretrsed knows anything about it.
The Ultimate Weapon#038.speaker: Balegar

The Ultimate Weapon#041.src: You are wondering how my name is pronounced? What a rude question.
The Ultimate Weapon#041.speaker: Reyoretrsed

The Ultimate Weapon#042.src: Ray-ore-tree-sed, obviously. What is a human doing here?
The Ultimate Weapon#042.speaker: Reyoretrsed

The Ultimate Weapon#043.src: You are wondering if I have Sacred whatever metal?
The Ultimate Weapon#043.speaker: Reyoretrsed

The Ultimate Weapon#044.src: I'm {~}. Now if you excuse me, I am busy standing still. Go bother Richard or something.
The Ultimate Weapon#044.speaker: Reyoretrsed

The Ultimate Weapon#046.src: I've been trying to tell you that I have what you need.
The Ultimate Weapon#046.speaker: Richard

The Ultimate Weapon#047.src: You humans really need to practice your communication skills, please.
The Ultimate Weapon#047.speaker: Richard

The Ultimate Weapon#048.src: Anyway, here. Take it! This metal is just a scam anyway, nothing special with it.
The Ultimate Weapon#048.speaker: Richard

The Ultimate Weapon#049.src: Return to Dodegar with the metal.

The Ultimate Weapon#050.src: I hope it wasn't too much of an issue to get!
The Ultimate Weapon#050.speaker: Dodegar

The Ultimate Weapon#051.src: ... I forgot a step. I can't attach a blade without a binder material.
The Ultimate Weapon#051.speaker: Dodegar

The Ultimate Weapon#052.src: I need the nectar of a native flower of the forest to attach it. [{~} Diplacus Aurantiacus] would do the trick.
The Ultimate Weapon#052.speaker: Dodegar

The Ultimate Weapon#053.src: Finding the flower can be rather difficult, here's a riddle on how to find it.
The Ultimate Weapon#053.speaker: Dodegar

The Ultimate Weapon#054.src: On the side of a hut, hidden inside a hole. Resting in a forest of light, without plight. Whatever that would mean.
The Ultimate Weapon#054.speaker: Dodegar

The Ultimate Weapon#055.src: Find the Diplacus Aurantiacus by following the riddle to [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

The Ultimate Weapon#056.src: Hold up! This feels waaay, toooo easy.
The Ultimate Weapon#056.speaker: Dodegar

The Ultimate Weapon#057.src: If I'm going to give you this amazingly, incredible, showstopping, crazy item particulary for free, you need to at least work for it!
The Ultimate Weapon#057.speaker: Dodegar

The Ultimate Weapon#060.src: This looks so much better! Anyway, bring me that flower now!
The Ultimate Weapon#060.speaker: Dodegar

The Ultimate Weapon#061.src: Talk to Dodegar with the Diplacus Aurantiacus.

The Ultimate Weapon#062.src: Took you a while, did it not?
The Ultimate Weapon#062.speaker: Dodegar

The Ultimate Weapon#063.src: It's starting to look pretty amazing! Just like it's supposed to I'm sure!
The Ultimate Weapon#063.speaker: Dodegar

The Ultimate Weapon#064.src: Maybe this will actually work out. Either way, last ingredient we need!
The Ultimate Weapon#064.speaker: Dodegar

The Ultimate Weapon#065.src: So to finalize and apply some magical properties to this uniquely amazing item we need something known as Luster Blood.
The Ultimate Weapon#065.speaker: Dodegar

The Ultimate Weapon#066.src: The only known creature in the west, probably in the whole world, if I'm being frank, is known as the Glow Dust Leaf Beetle of the Underworld, not sure where the name comes from.
The Ultimate Weapon#066.speaker: Dodegar

The Ultimate Weapon#067.src: I happen to know that this beetle lives in a cave in the eastern ravine thingy! If you walk straight east, you should stumble upon it, I promise!
The Ultimate Weapon#067.speaker: Dodegar

The Ultimate Weapon#068.src: Oh! Almost forgot to mention, about {~} Luster Blood is probably enough.
The Ultimate Weapon#068.speaker: Dodegar

The Ultimate Weapon#069.src: Find the cave at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] and bring back [{~} Luster Blood] and bring it back to Dodegar.

The Ultimate Weapon#070.src: Do not step any closer... Or I will be forced to obliterate you!

The Ultimate Weapon#071.src: The final component! It is finally here!
The Ultimate Weapon#071.speaker: Dodegar

The Ultimate Weapon#073.src: Do you see how it's glowing, sparkling and... and radiating!
The Ultimate Weapon#073.speaker: Dodegar

The Ultimate Weapon#074.src: You don't? Uhm... maybe you need glasses humie.
The Ultimate Weapon#074.speaker: Dodegar

The Ultimate Weapon#075.src: As promised! Here you go! Always happy to practice the art of weapon creation.
The Ultimate Weapon#075.speaker: Dodegar

The Worm Holes#000.src: Find out what's going on at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

The Worm Holes#001.src: Arrighty fellers, let's get this wrapped up now! 'ere's plenty more holes where this one came from!
The Worm Holes#001.speaker: Malo

The Worm Holes#003.src: The scaffolds are crackin'! Everyone, get offa there, now!!
The Worm Holes#003.speaker: Malo

The Worm Holes#005.src: Aw, hell... I knew this project was a bust from the start...there goes Willam and Clint cause a' this!
The Worm Holes#005.speaker: Malo

The Worm Holes#006.src: I gotta get someone tough enough to get down there...hm? Hey, a human! Git on over here!
The Worm Holes#006.speaker: Malo

The Worm Holes#007.src: I gotta ask, how much 'a that didja see, Wynn feller? Wasn't pretty, and I'm in charge a' them folks, so I gotta take responsibility fer that.
The Worm Holes#007.speaker: Malo

The Worm Holes#008.src: Th' mayor of {p} there saw these holes poppin' up, and hired us out to cover 'em up. Thing is, the ground's too unstable to build.
The Worm Holes#008.speaker: Malo

The Worm Holes#009.src: It's gettin' real worrying round here. They only started openin' up recently, and there've been quakes too. Feels like the place is gonna collapse!
The Worm Holes#009.speaker: Malo

The Worm Holes#010.src: I think we oughta head down there and figure out what 'n heck's goin' on, and you're the best armed outta any of us, being human 'n all.
The Worm Holes#010.speaker: Malo

The Worm Holes#011.src: Think y'all could head down 'n see if you can rustle up any leads? There's a path down just to the left of the hole.
The Worm Holes#011.speaker: Malo

The Worm Holes#012.src: Go down the hole and look for what's causing this and return to Malo at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] with proof.

The Worm Holes#013.src: What in tarnation...? The heck did you find down there, soldier?
The Worm Holes#013.speaker: Malo

The Worm Holes#014.src: Oh, it was just the skin, huh? Dang...was hopin' you'd've seen what it was, cause I got no clue 'bout this.
The Worm Holes#014.speaker: Malo

The Worm Holes#015.src: Urgh. Only gal I know who might have an idea 'bout this is that durn elf lady...
The Worm Holes#015.speaker: Malo

The Worm Holes#016.src: She's got purple hair and's been wanderin' round like she knows everything. Yeah, she's a bright penny but she ain't gotta be so uppity ta all of us 'bout it.
The Worm Holes#016.speaker: Malo

The Worm Holes#017.src: She put up a camp just east of here. She'll prob'ly react better to you than me, so I'll go to the authorities and see if they have any leads.
The Worm Holes#017.speaker: Malo

The Worm Holes#018.src: Look for Lari and ask what is going on at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

The Worm Holes#019.src: ...Haven’t we met? I have witnessed your presence in Gavel more than once.
The Worm Holes#019.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#020.src: I am Lari. I might have greeted you properly before if I were not so busy, which reminds me. You have a reason to be here, yes?
The Worm Holes#020.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#021.src: Hm...I believe I know what you have found, by your description. That dead skin too, is proof enough, I would say.
The Worm Holes#021.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#022.src: The creature which shed that skin is known as a Grootslang. Though large, they are rather peaceful. Gentle giants, I believe the saying is?
The Worm Holes#022.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#023.src: This horrid Decay...it affects their habitats underground. They are seeking shelter closer to the surface. I have been trying to scrub the Decay without success...
The Worm Holes#023.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#024.src: Wait... More holes appeared just today? There...there were deaths?! W-where, when?!
The Worm Holes#024.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#025.src: No, no...! I refuse to be responsible for any more deaths... Human, tell me your name, please.
The Worm Holes#025.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#026.src: {u}, then... Let us head to the site. {u}. I need to fix this... Please, help me get to the root of this problem so I may soothe the land's pain.
The Worm Holes#026.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#028.src: So this is the site... [Gavellian Spell]...
The Worm Holes#028.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#029.src: Here. Allow me to provide at least one person safe passage into the pit.
The Worm Holes#029.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#030.src: Have faith- Jump in. I will carry you down slowly.
The Worm Holes#030.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#031.src: Take the lead. If we can find any further evidence of the Grootslangs around here, it will aid in my understanding.
The Worm Holes#031.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#032.src: Hm? This wall looks like it's been disturbed recently...
The Worm Holes#032.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#033.src: I can hear it...but where is it crawling...?
The Worm Holes#033.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#034.src: That's the mother Wyrm! She must be what is making the holes. We need to follow her!
The Worm Holes#034.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#035.src: Never mind the spiders, we need to keep following the Wyrm!
The Worm Holes#035.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#036.src: Ah...ehm, {u}? I've... Um, this is...a bit difficult to say, but...
The Worm Holes#036.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#037.src: I...do not believe we need to fight, or to kill, here? The creatures are native to here, we are invading their space.
The Worm Holes#037.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#038.src: Why should they be attacked for merely existing in their territory? Even if they are animals, I believe that you can solve these problems without killing.
The Worm Holes#038.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#039.src: I...understand you may not have the same powers as myself... And I, ah...am not free of guilt, either. But I think you could stand to take a peaceful stance.
The Worm Holes#039.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#040.src: Even if I am alone on that front...though I understand you are taught differently where you come from. I do not envy you, though I still thank you for your aid thusfar.
The Worm Holes#040.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#041.src: Your methods are...disagreeable, but you still have a sense of right to you, I feel... Well, the tunnel diverges here. We'll need to split apart.
The Worm Holes#041.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#042.src: I'll go to the right, so you ought to continue to the left here. I will meet up with you again soon, hopefully.
The Worm Holes#042.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#045.src: Aah! {u}! Don't...don't make any sudden movements.
The Worm Holes#045.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#046.src: This Grootslang is uncharacteristically aggressive... She's scared, being so close to the surface. Stay behind me, please.
The Worm Holes#046.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#048.src: Do not approach it! The power of the Wyrm is far too much for you!
The Worm Holes#048.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#050.src: {u}!! You're unharmed, yes? She's scared and in pain!
The Worm Holes#050.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#051.src: I have to get it right this time... I'm going to talk her down, stay there!
The Worm Holes#051.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#052.src: You must be calm, I beg you. Retreat to the earth- You harm those above!
The Worm Holes#052.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#053.src: The earth rotting... I take full responsibility, but does the grass above not rot also?
The Worm Holes#053.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#054.src: I wish to soothe your pain, but you must allow me to aid you- You must listen!
The Worm Holes#054.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#055.src: What does this violence solve? Be calm, please!
The Worm Holes#055.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#056.src: {u}, it won't budge... There's something in its mind rejecting me. Distract it- but don't approach! It will kill you if you get close. Just...be loud!
The Worm Holes#056.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#059.src: Can you hear me?! I'll get her to...to...s-something! Spit you up, I don't know! Just...please, d-don't die!
The Worm Holes#059.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#060.src: W-We have... We have not laid a blow against you! It is not right for you to do the same!
The Worm Holes#060.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#061.src: You would wound and consume everything in your rage? Even knowing the consequences?
The Worm Holes#061.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#062.src: Your hunger cannot be sated with this fruitless destruction! I beg of you, let them out!
The Worm Holes#062.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#063.src: You know th- W-wait...where did you... AAAH!
The Worm Holes#063.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#065.src: I tried...w-why does no one listen to me? Why won't a-anything change for me?
The Worm Holes#065.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#066.src: She...she's been eating dark parasites. They're wracking her insides and h-hurting her head...
The Worm Holes#066.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#067.src: I...i-it's so d-dark... I c-can't breathe... This...th-this can't be the end...
The Worm Holes#067.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#068.src: I...n-no, I can't die in here... I-I'm needed still... You're n-needed still! I... I...
The Worm Holes#068.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#069.src: I n-need... Or... O-Or... C-Concentrate, Lari... You can do this...
The Worm Holes#069.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#071.src: LET US OUT! LET US OUT OF HERE! DON'T LET US DIE LIKE THIS! I'M BEGGING YOU, PLEASE!!
The Worm Holes#071.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#072.src: ...I...oh no... It's...d-d... I... I j-just... I just w-wanted out... Ohhh...n-no...
The Worm Holes#072.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#073.src: ...w-we're...leaving. I...I c-can't look at this any more...
The Worm Holes#073.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#075.src: I'm...I'm so sorry, {u}. If I'd...I don't... I don't even know what else I could have d-done...
The Worm Holes#075.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#076.src: There...it didn’t feel like there was...anything left to it... But, if I’d just been quicker, then... Would it...would it even have made a difference?
The Worm Holes#076.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#077.src: ...some savior I am... I need to be better, but what else even is there that...ugh, I'm going in circles...
The Worm Holes#077.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#079.src: ...I...I can't believe this. This is...does destiny just hate me? What have I done to deserve this?!
The Worm Holes#079.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#080.src: The Mother Wyrm laid eggs... Eggs infested with parasites! Every single one is going to be born berserk!!
The Worm Holes#080.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#081.src: You saw how strong the mother was...an infestation like this could cause the entire region of Gavel to collapse in a quake...
The Worm Holes#081.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#082.src: They...they need to be stopped, but...I can't do it. I c-can't kill... I'm sorry, I just can't!
The Worm Holes#082.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#083.src: Bring a group... Even Whelps can be a terror if they're enraged. Just...p-please, take care of this quickly.
The Worm Holes#083.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#084.src: You deserve the best... But that's more than I can give...so here. Take these. I'll move along.
The Worm Holes#084.speaker: Lari

Through the Pipes#000.src: Talk with the citizen in despair at .

Through the Pipes#001.src: H-Hey, you! Have you seen a raccoon anywhere?
Through the Pipes#001.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#002.src: I spent all my free time making a gift for Soosu, and that devil snatched it from me! It would be a shame if I never got the chance to give it to her...
Through the Pipes#002.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#003.src: This might be a big ask, but- do you think you could help me?
Through the Pipes#003.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#004.src: Y-You will? I knew there was still some good left in this world!
Through the Pipes#004.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#005.src: Right! Last time I saw that raccoon, it was running into an alleyway south of the town center. It can't have gone too far!
Through the Pipes#005.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#006.src: I will resume searching for that fool as well. Best of luck to you!
Through the Pipes#006.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#007.src: ...I get it. If you change your mind, come and talk with me again.
Through the Pipes#007.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#008.src: Yes! A raccoon! You've seen them before- surely? They're rampant around here!
Through the Pipes#008.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#010.src: You know, those furry gray creatures with the weird striped tails?
Through the Pipes#010.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#011.src: ...I hope you know what a raccoon is.
Through the Pipes#011.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#013.src: Oh- you're back! Are you able to help me now?
Through the Pipes#013.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#015.src: I really think it would be better if we split up to search, don't you agree?
Through the Pipes#015.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#016.src: If you forgot, you should try searching south of the town center. But you do you, I suppose...
Through the Pipes#016.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#019.src: Enter the drainage hole at to continue the search.

Through the Pipes#020.src: Dive deeper into the sewer network.

Through the Pipes#022.src: Find a way to get across the flooded section of the sewer.

Through the Pipes#023.src: Huh, is there someone down there?

Through the Pipes#025.src: Continue chasing the raccoon through the sewers.

Through the Pipes#026.src: You aren't getting away from me now!

Through the Pipes#027.src: Encounter a familiar face in the sewers.

Through the Pipes#028.src: Ah ha! I've got you now, thief!

Through the Pipes#032.src: {u}! You're here! I was wondering where you went!
Through the Pipes#032.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#033.src: I've been chasing that raccoon the whole time! What in the world have you been up to?
Through the Pipes#033.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#034.src: Whatever. I'm struggling to keep up the chase at this rate. But fortunately, I have just the thing that'll help you!
Through the Pipes#034.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#036.src: It's broken! How will I ever catch up with that crook at this rate?
Through the Pipes#036.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#037.src: ...Maybe this is all a lost cause. You can try fixing it, I guess, but it's not worth it.
Through the Pipes#037.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#038.src: I'm going that direction to see if I can catch that pest. You go the other way, we'll meet again soon.
Through the Pipes#038.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#039.src: Encounter the stranger in the sewers.

Through the Pipes#040.src: Ah ha! I've got you now, thief!

Through the Pipes#045.src: Who are you? What are you doing here?
Through the Pipes#045.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#046.src: Ah, exploring the sewers? That's fun! I've basically been to every corner of {p}'s sewers.
Through the Pipes#046.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#047.src: Say, is there any chance you stumbled upon that raccoon earlier? That pest snatched something of value from me!
Through the Pipes#047.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#048.src: I was making a gift for Sovereign Soosu, but then that fiend just ran off with it! Horrible, isn't it?
Through the Pipes#048.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#049.src: Especially with how soon the festival is... I wouldn't want to miss my only opportunity this year!
Through the Pipes#049.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#050.src: I could really use your help, and hey I have just the tool you'll want for exploring the sewers!
Through the Pipes#050.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#052.src: It's broken! How will I ever catch up with that crook at this rate?
Through the Pipes#052.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#053.src: ...Maybe this is all a lost cause. You can try fixing it, I guess, but it's not worth it.
Through the Pipes#053.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#054.src: I'm going that direction to see if I can catch that pest. What's your name... {u}? You go the other way, we'll meet again soon.
Through the Pipes#054.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#055.src: Find a safe way past the flooded rail tunnels.

Through the Pipes#056.src: Whew! I didn't mean to let go-
Through the Pipes#056.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#058.src: Perfect, I know where we are, and there isn't much further that foolish raccoon can run. We could corner it!
Through the Pipes#058.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#059.src: Now, the problem is, I have no idea how to traverse this next area. It's heavily flooded if I can recall.
Through the Pipes#059.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#060.src: {u}! OH NO! I didn't mean to drop that on you
Through the Pipes#060.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#061.src: W-why were you standing there? Out of all places?
Through the Pipes#061.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#062.src: ...Okay. You seem to be alright. Sorry, I didn't realize you were standing right there!
Through the Pipes#062.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#063.src: Alright, at least we're regrouped now. Try not to stand under any more heavy objects, alright?
Through the Pipes#063.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#064.src: Moving forward, the problem is, I have no idea how to traverse this next area. It's heavily flooded if I can recall.
Through the Pipes#064.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#065.src: You'll need to find some way for us to cross. Too many people have gotten the worst of diseases by wading through that water- eugh.
Through the Pipes#065.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#066.src: Right! Let me know when you figure something out. I'll scout around, never had an excuse to explore this area before!
Through the Pipes#066.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#067.src: Huh? What's all this stuff? Did someone forget their construction equipment?
Through the Pipes#067.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#068.src: I guess the maintenance crews never bother to pack up their equipment. Maybe you can use this stuff for something.
Through the Pipes#068.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#069.src: Check back in with me when you're done!
Through the Pipes#069.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#070.src: Navigate through the end of the sewer network with Fichu.

Through the Pipes#073.src: I'd appreciate it if you added a seat for me.
Through the Pipes#073.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#077.src: Bet no one's been here for a while.
Through the Pipes#077.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#078.src: Wonder where that raccoon is now...
Through the Pipes#078.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#079.src: Soosu needs to see that state of this place...
Through the Pipes#079.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#081.src: What else do you think we'll find?
Through the Pipes#081.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#082.src: I've heard a few stories about this place. Mostly bad ones...
Through the Pipes#082.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#083.src: I hope that raccoon hasn't gone too far...
Through the Pipes#083.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#086.src: This raft looks fragile, be careful!
Through the Pipes#086.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#091.src: You know what you're doing, right?
Through the Pipes#091.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#093.src: Ah! I almost fell out of my seat.
Through the Pipes#093.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#095.src: Are you even capable of not hitting something?
Through the Pipes#095.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#096.src: One more hit and I'm taking over!
Through the Pipes#096.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#097.src: I don't trust you sailing this thing!
Through the Pipes#097.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#099.src: It can't possibly be that hard!
Through the Pipes#099.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#100.src: Make sure to be careful, okay?
Through the Pipes#100.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#101.src: No wonder everyone avoids this place...
Through the Pipes#101.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#103.src: You know where you're going, right?
Through the Pipes#103.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#104.src: When I get that raccoon, oh man...
Through the Pipes#104.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#105.src: How long have I even spent chasing that fool...
Through the Pipes#105.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#107.src: Keep an eye out for dangers!
Through the Pipes#107.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#108.src: Make sure we're staying on track.
Through the Pipes#108.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#109.src: Maybe rats are better than raccoons after all.
Through the Pipes#109.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#110.src: I regret getting on this raft.
Through the Pipes#110.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#114.src: I cannot wait to get off...
Through the Pipes#114.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#116.src: I really don't want to insult you, but-
Through the Pipes#116.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#122.src: Ah! What will we do now?!
Through the Pipes#122.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#124.src: Hmm, is the raft broken? We haven't moved for a while.
Through the Pipes#124.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#125.src: Are you... going to have us move?
Through the Pipes#125.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#128.src: I'm not sure why you think this place is interesting enough to stop at.
Through the Pipes#128.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#132.src: The raccoon is probably long gone at this point, thanks to your delay.
Through the Pipes#132.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#135.src: How long were we waiting for?
Through the Pipes#135.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#136.src: Huh? What are you doing with that?!
Through the Pipes#136.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#137.src: You're going to sink us with that!
Through the Pipes#137.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#139.src: IS THAT AN EXPLOSIVE?! ARE YOU MAD!
Through the Pipes#139.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#140.src: HELP US! WE'RE GOING TO DROWN!
Through the Pipes#140.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#141.src: OH NO! GET ME OFF OF HERE!
Through the Pipes#141.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#144.src: Why did you think this was a good idea?!
Through the Pipes#144.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#145.src: I gotta get off this thing!
Through the Pipes#145.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#146.src: Hey- maybe we should've been a bit further away from that train?
Through the Pipes#146.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#149.src: Agh! Sorry, just got scared by that.
Through the Pipes#149.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#150.src: AHHHHH! THIS WAS A HORRIBLE IDEA!
Through the Pipes#150.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#151.src: OUT OF ALL ROUTES YOU TOOK, ONE OF THEM INCLUDED A TRAIN!
Through the Pipes#151.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#153.src: Huh? AH! THERE'S A TRAIN! GET OUT OF HERE!
Through the Pipes#153.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#156.src: YOU REALLY THINK THIS FLIMSY RAFT IS GOING TO SURVIVE A TRAIN?!
Through the Pipes#156.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#157.src: YOU FOOL! We barely missed being hit!
Through the Pipes#157.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#158.src: Oh my- we survived! YOU ARE AN IDIOT! DON'T DO THAT AGAIN!
Through the Pipes#158.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#159.src: This looks like the halfway point!
Through the Pipes#159.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#160.src: You'll need to find a way to open that gate, since I don't see any other way past.
Through the Pipes#160.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#161.src: If I'm remembering correctly, just past this gate should be our destination!
Through the Pipes#161.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#162.src: Phew, we survived. That was a bit rough, but at least we made it.
Through the Pipes#162.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#163.src: However, I think I'll definitely be avoiding boats for now...
Through the Pipes#163.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#164.src: We made it! You did a pretty good job navigating, I knew I could trust you!
Through the Pipes#164.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#165.src: Alright, let's chase down that raccoon once and for all!
Through the Pipes#165.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#166.src: I hope my prediction is right, and there really is no further it can run from here.
Through the Pipes#166.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#168.src: Huh?! LOOK! It's the raccoon, that's it!
Through the Pipes#168.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#171.src: Ah ha! Now you're cornered, you little imp!
Through the Pipes#171.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#172.src: Before you do anything, we need a way to take the gift back!
Through the Pipes#172.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#174.src: And look! We finally got the gift back! I knew we could do it.
Through the Pipes#174.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#175.src: Hopefully this is still intact after all of that...
Through the Pipes#175.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#176.src: It survived! Thank the queen! I don't know what I would do otherwise...
Through the Pipes#176.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#177.src: {u}, from the very start, you were a massive help. I cannot thank you enough for your efforts!
Through the Pipes#177.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#178.src: Without your help, I don't even know if I could have caught that raccoon on my own!
Through the Pipes#178.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#179.src: As a reward, I have an extra gift just for you! Thank you again for your incredible help!
Through the Pipes#179.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#180.src: And look! We finally got the gift back! I knew we could do it.
Through the Pipes#180.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#181.src: Hopefully this is still intact after all of that...
Through the Pipes#181.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#182.src: It survived! Thank the queen! I don't know what I would do otherwise...
Through the Pipes#182.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#183.src: {u}, from the very start, you were a massive help. I cannot thank you enough for your efforts!
Through the Pipes#183.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#184.src: Not only did you safely get us through a flooded tunnel with that creation of yours, but you came more prepared than I could have expected!
Through the Pipes#184.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#185.src: A cage... a ring to use as a distraction... and even a firecracker. Where did you even find all this stuff?
Through the Pipes#185.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#186.src: And on top of all of that, you found my art supplies bag! That bag itself is more important to me than the gift we were chasing after!
Through the Pipes#186.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#187.src: Speaking of that, I would like to give you Soosu's gift as a token of appreciation. I believe you're more deserving of it.
Through the Pipes#187.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#188.src: Don't worry, I've already brainstormed a better design. I think Soosu will like this next one even more!
Through the Pipes#188.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#189.src: Don't go so close! You might scare it off again!
Through the Pipes#189.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#190.src: Thank you again for the help! I couldn't have done it without you.
Through the Pipes#190.speaker: Fichu

Tower of Ascension (Quest)#002.src: I challenge you to reach the final floor!
Tower of Ascension (Quest)#002.dst: 我挑戰你，到達最高的樓層吧！
Tower of Ascension (Quest)#002.speaker: Ankou

Tower of Ascension (Quest)#003.src: Have you got what it takes to conquer it?
Tower of Ascension (Quest)#003.dst: 你會有實力去征服他們嗎？
Tower of Ascension (Quest)#003.speaker: Ankou

Tower of Ascension (Quest)#004.src: Perhaps you would like to know the layout of the tower first? Hehehehe...
Tower of Ascension (Quest)#004.dst: 也許你會想先知道這座塔的構造呢？嘿嘿嘿嘿...
Tower of Ascension (Quest)#004.speaker: Ankou

Tower of Ascension (Quest)#005.src: There are {~} floors in this tower, each with ten levels.
Tower of Ascension (Quest)#005.dst: 這座塔總共有 {~} 層，每層含有十個關卡。
Tower of Ascension (Quest)#005.speaker: Ankou

Tower of Ascension (Quest)#006.src: Each floor has nine regular levels and one boss level.
Tower of Ascension (Quest)#006.dst: 每一層都有九個普通關卡和一個首領關卡。
Tower of Ascension (Quest)#006.speaker: Ankou

Tower of Ascension (Quest)#007.src: To pass a regular level, you must collect five tokens from the challenge on that level, and one token from boss levels.
Tower of Ascension (Quest)#007.dst: 普通關卡需要打怪收集五個代幣，頭目關卡則要拿到一個代幣才能過關。
Tower of Ascension (Quest)#007.speaker: Ankou

Tower of Ascension (Quest)#008.src: After you beat a whole floor, you will return here and you can begin the next one...
Tower of Ascension (Quest)#008.dst: 成功打倒一個樓層後，你會回到這裏，可以開始下一層的挑戰...
Tower of Ascension (Quest)#008.speaker: Ankou

Tower of Ascension (Quest)#009.src: So, what do you say? Hehehe...
Tower of Ascension (Quest)#009.dst: 所以，你覺得如何呢？嘻嘻嘻...
Tower of Ascension (Quest)#009.speaker: Ankou

Tower of Ascension (Quest)#010.src: Turn left and head to the first floor...if you dare...
Tower of Ascension (Quest)#010.dst: 夠膽的話，就左轉開始你的第一層挑戰吧...
Tower of Ascension (Quest)#010.speaker: Ankou

Tower of Ascension (Quest)#011.src: Well done, adventurer, you have successfully completed this floor! You may proceed.
Tower of Ascension (Quest)#011.dst: 做得好啊，冒險者！你成功完成了這一層！你可以繼續了。
Tower of Ascension (Quest)#011.speaker: Floormaster

Tower of Ascension (Quest)#012.src: You have completed my tower, I see...
Tower of Ascension (Quest)#012.speaker: Ankou

Tower of Ascension (Quest)#013.src: Did you enjoy Death? Many challengers certainly did. Her power is... unmatched, hehehe...
Tower of Ascension (Quest)#013.dst: 你享受 Death 嗎？很多挑戰者非常享受呢，畢竟她的能力是...無與倫比的，嘻嘻嘻...
Tower of Ascension (Quest)#013.speaker: Ankou

Tower of Ascension (Quest)#014.src: And you... You are unlike all of them, yes? Few have managed to ascend these floors.
Tower of Ascension (Quest)#014.dst: 然而你...你與衆不同，對吧？很少人能晉升全部的樓層。
Tower of Ascension (Quest)#014.speaker: Ankou

Tower of Ascension (Quest)#015.src: A tower of madness, fueled by Death herself... Quite a challenge, yes?
Tower of Ascension (Quest)#015.dst: 一個由 Death 自己醖釀，瘋瘋癲癲的塔...是個不錯的挑戰，對吧？
Tower of Ascension (Quest)#015.speaker: Ankou

Tower of Ascension (Quest)#016.src: You have joined us now, champion... Few can claim this victory as their own. Fewer still have held their mind.
Tower of Ascension (Quest)#016.dst: 你成功加入我們了，冠軍...很少人能自行領取這個勝利，更少人還能維持理智。
Tower of Ascension (Quest)#016.speaker: Ankou

Tower of Ascension (Quest)#017.src: For this honor... A reward, for you. You have truly earned it... Hehehehe...
Tower of Ascension (Quest)#017.dst: 爲了紀念這個殊榮... 我將給予你一個獎品。你確實配得上它。嘻嘻嘻...
Tower of Ascension (Quest)#017.speaker: Ankou

Tribal Aggression#001.src: My tribes worries our own business, stranger.
Tribal Aggression#001.dst: 我的部族只管自己的事，陌生人。
Tribal Aggression#001.speaker: Caras

Tribal Aggression#002.src: Oh, my apologies, I did not realize you are a warrior of the province! We would be grateful of your help.
Tribal Aggression#002.dst: 哦，抱歉，我沒發現你是這個省的戰士！我們會很感激你的幫助。
Tribal Aggression#002.speaker: Caras

Tribal Aggression#003.src: Our sacred owl totem that we worship was stolen by the cunning Eagle Tribe many years ago. Its magical properties used to bring prosperity to our camp.
Tribal Aggression#003.dst: 我們所供奉的神聖貓頭鷹圖騰，多年前被狡猾的鷹族偷走了。它的魔力曾經為我們的營地帶來繁榮。
Tribal Aggression#003.speaker: Caras

Tribal Aggression#004.src: However, the Eagle tribe are not victorious, we possess their mystic eagle totem, but alas, I do not know who was the original thief.
Tribal Aggression#004.dst: 不過鷹族也沒佔到便宜，他們的神祕鷹圖騰在我們手上；只是唉，我也不知道最初動手的到底是誰。
Tribal Aggression#004.speaker: Caras

Tribal Aggression#005.src: We have been at war for years now, despite being neighbors. Without our totem, our rivalry will continue for ages and peace will never again be felt in our hearts.
Tribal Aggression#005.dst: 我們明明是鄰居，卻已經打了好多年。沒有那座圖騰，這場世仇就會沒完沒了，我們心裡永遠不會再有平靜。
Tribal Aggression#005.speaker: Caras

Tribal Aggression#006.src: Retrieve our totem, and the blessing of the Owl spirit will be with you.
Tribal Aggression#006.dst: 把我們的圖騰取回來，貓頭鷹之靈的祝福就會與你同在。
Tribal Aggression#006.speaker: Caras

Tribal Aggression#007.src: Now, enter the Eagle Camp across the river, you may have to search the camp, I'm sure they have hidden our totem!
Tribal Aggression#007.dst: 好，去河對岸的鷹族營地吧。你大概得把營地翻一遍，我確定他們把我們的圖騰藏起來了！
Tribal Aggression#007.speaker: Caras

Tribal Aggression#008.src: Enter the Eagle Camp and talk to Favian
Tribal Aggression#008.dst: 進入鷹族營地並跟 Favian 談話

Tribal Aggression#009.src: Greetings, what brings you to the noble Eagle tribe?
Tribal Aggression#009.dst: 你好，是什麼風把你吹來高貴的鷹族？
Tribal Aggression#009.speaker: Favian

Tribal Aggression#010.src: You seek the Owl totem? The cursed Owl tribe trying to retain their lost dignity again.
Tribal Aggression#010.dst: 你要找貓頭鷹圖騰？那群該死的梟族又想找回他們失去的顏面了。
Tribal Aggression#010.speaker: Favian

Tribal Aggression#011.src: Why should we give you their totem back? They stole our source of enlightenment all those years ago.
Tribal Aggression#011.dst: 我們憑什麼把他們的圖騰還你？當年是他們偷走了我們啟蒙的泉源。
Tribal Aggression#011.speaker: Favian

Tribal Aggression#012.src: Tell you what, if you can retrieve our Eagle Totem, I will allow you to go return the Owl totem.
Tribal Aggression#012.dst: 這樣吧，如果你能把我們的鷹圖騰取回來，我就准你把貓頭鷹圖騰帶回去。
Tribal Aggression#012.speaker: Favian

Tribal Aggression#013.src: I'm sure they hid the totem, but if you are able to find, I await your return!
Tribal Aggression#013.dst: 我相信他們把圖騰藏起來了，不過你要是找得到，我等你回來！
Tribal Aggression#013.speaker: Favian

Tribal Aggression#014.src: Bring back the Eagle Totem from the Owl Camp
Tribal Aggression#014.dst: 從梟族營地取回鷹圖騰

Tribal Aggression#015.src: Wonderful! You may now enter the cave to retrieve the blasted Owl totem.
Tribal Aggression#015.dst: 太好了！你現在可以進洞窟去取回那該死的貓頭鷹圖騰了。
Tribal Aggression#015.speaker: Favian

Tribal Aggression#016.src: Be careful, there are Eagle guardians in the cave, be prepared traveller.
Tribal Aggression#016.dst: 小心點，洞窟裡有鷹族守衛，做好準備，旅人。
Tribal Aggression#016.speaker: Favian

Tribal Aggression#017.src: Once you get the totem, you may return it to its original tribe.
Tribal Aggression#017.dst: 等你拿到圖騰，就可以把它送回原本的部族。
Tribal Aggression#017.speaker: Favian

Tribal Aggression#018.src: Hopefully, we two camps will never set foot on another's land in an attempt steal back the totems, and live in peace.
Tribal Aggression#018.dst: 但願我們兩個營地從此再也不必踏上對方的土地去搶圖騰，就這樣和平度日。
Tribal Aggression#018.speaker: Favian

Tribal Aggression#019.src: Anyways, hurry up, even the thought of the two totems sharing the same space makes me sick.
Tribal Aggression#019.dst: 總之，快去吧，光是想到那兩座圖騰共處一室我就渾身不舒服。
Tribal Aggression#019.speaker: Favian

Tribal Aggression#020.src: Retrieve the Owl Totem and return it to the Owl Camp
Tribal Aggression#020.dst: 取回貓頭鷹圖騰並送回梟族營地

Tribal Aggression#021.src: I-Is that, the totem? My, it has been a long time since the owl has been with me. Though I wonder if the Eagle and the Owl totem possess the same mystic powers.
Tribal Aggression#021.dst: 這、這是那座圖騰嗎？天啊，貓頭鷹離開我身邊已經好久了。不過我很好奇，鷹圖騰跟貓頭鷹圖騰是不是擁有同樣的神祕力量。
Tribal Aggression#021.speaker: Caras

Tribal Aggression#022.src: To think, such a long war could end so quickly and by the help of a single person.
Tribal Aggression#022.dst: 想不到這麼漫長的一場戰爭，竟然靠一個人的幫忙就這樣結束了。
Tribal Aggression#022.speaker: Caras

Tribal Aggression#023.src: Many thanks to you! I shall keep my promise, please accept this reward, and may the Owl be forever with you.
Tribal Aggression#023.dst: 萬分感謝！我會信守承諾，請收下這份謝禮，願貓頭鷹永遠與你同在。
Tribal Aggression#023.speaker: Caras

Troubled Tribesmen#002.src: Hey! Aren't these people fascinating? They sure smell bad, though! What? That Tribesman said my name?! Amazing! I've been trying to communicate with them for weeks.
Troubled Tribesmen#002.dst: 嘿！這些人是不是很迷人？不過他們是真的很臭！什麼？那個部落人叫了我的名字？！太驚人了！我花了好幾個禮拜想跟他們溝通。
Troubled Tribesmen#002.speaker: Krattson

Troubled Tribesmen#003.src: He sure seems like a distressed little fellow. He keeps pointing to that huge tree right there. A {p} keeper once told me it's possible to speak with them.
Troubled Tribesmen#003.dst: 他看起來像個很苦惱的小傢伙。他一直指著那邊那棵大樹。有個 {p} 的守護者跟我說過，是有辦法跟他們對話的。
Troubled Tribesmen#003.speaker: Krattson

Troubled Tribesmen#004.src: He told me that within the woods there is a Shaman who will grant certain people permission to speak their language. I did some traveling through the jungle and actually found him!
Troubled Tribesmen#004.dst: 他告訴我，林子裡有一位薩滿，會賜予某些人說他們語言的能力。我在叢林裡走了一趟，還真的找到他了！
Troubled Tribesmen#004.speaker: Krattson

Troubled Tribesmen#005.src: But despite my efforts, he just sat in silence with his eyes closed. He must of known I wasn't a threat because he was totally exposed. He had no interest in speaking with me, though.
Troubled Tribesmen#005.dst: 可是不管我怎麼努力，他就只是閉著眼睛坐在那裡。他一定知道我沒有威脅，因為他整個人毫無防備。不過他對跟我說話完全沒興趣。
Troubled Tribesmen#005.speaker: Krattson

Troubled Tribesmen#006.src: Say, who knows, maybe the Shaman will talk to you. It would greatly assist my research if you could help me talk to them. So why don't you give it a shot?
Troubled Tribesmen#006.dst: 欸，誰知道呢，說不定那位薩滿願意跟你說話。你要是能幫我跟他們搭上話，對我的研究會有很大的幫助。要不要試試看？
Troubled Tribesmen#006.speaker: Krattson

Troubled Tribesmen#007.src: Follow this path to the north. Keep going past the pond and the path will split to the West and to the East. Take the West path, and you will see the Shaman.
Troubled Tribesmen#007.dst: 順著這條路往北走。過了池塘之後路會分成東西兩條，走西邊那條，你就會看到那位薩滿。
Troubled Tribesmen#007.speaker: Krattson

Troubled Tribesmen#009.src: Oui ryja y bufanvim vaam ypuid oui, cdnyhkan. So baubma yna eh tyhkan. Bmayca, dyga drec yht ramb bas.
Troubled Tribesmen#009.dst: Oui ryja y bufanvim vaam ypuid oui, cdnyhkan. So baubma yna eh tyhkan. Bmayca, dyga drec yht ramb bas.
Troubled Tribesmen#009.speaker: Inrekei

Troubled Tribesmen#010.src: I have cast a spell on you. If you can understand me, you are pure of heart.
Troubled Tribesmen#010.dst: 我已對你施法。你若聽得懂我的話，代表你心地純淨。
Troubled Tribesmen#010.speaker: Inrekei

Troubled Tribesmen#011.src: This spell will allow those of true spirit to speak and comprehend our language. I have entrusted you with this because of my connection with our sacred tree, who we call Entamis.
Troubled Tribesmen#011.dst: 這道法術能讓心性真誠的人聽懂並說出我們的語言。我把它託付給你，是因為我與我們的聖樹相連——我們稱她為 Entamis。
Troubled Tribesmen#011.speaker: Inrekei

Troubled Tribesmen#012.src: I am the shaman of my tribe. I sit here every day with my eyes closed and carefully monitor Entamis' wavelengths. She has not been responding to my calls as of late...
Troubled Tribesmen#012.dst: 我是本部落的薩滿。我每天坐在這裡閉著眼，仔細聆聽 Entamis 的波動。可是她最近都沒有回應我的呼喚……
Troubled Tribesmen#012.speaker: Inrekei

Troubled Tribesmen#013.src: Dear human, your presence emits warmth and trust. Please go speak with my apprentice, Ka L'argwit. He is to take my place as shaman when I pass from this life.
Troubled Tribesmen#013.dst: 親愛的人類，你的氣息裡有溫暖與信任。請去找我的學徒 Ka L'argwit 談談。我離世之後，將由他接任薩滿。
Troubled Tribesmen#013.speaker: Inrekei

Troubled Tribesmen#014.src: He would know if anything is causing our beautiful tree discomfort. The spell I have cast on you will allow you to speak with him.
Troubled Tribesmen#014.dst: 如果有什麼讓我們美麗的聖樹不適，他會知道。我對你施的法術能讓你和他交談。
Troubled Tribesmen#014.speaker: Inrekei

Troubled Tribesmen#015.src: Now, please go seek out Ka L'argwit.
Troubled Tribesmen#015.dst: 好了，請去找 Ka L'argwit 吧。
Troubled Tribesmen#015.speaker: Inrekei

Troubled Tribesmen#016.dst: 回到 Ka L'argwit 身邊。

Troubled Tribesmen#018.src: Thank you for coming. We haven't but moments. The monster's name is Aenara. He's a fiendish monster of corruption.
Troubled Tribesmen#018.dst: 謝謝你來。我們沒有多少時間了。那頭怪物叫 Aenara，是一頭邪惡的腐化怪物。
Troubled Tribesmen#018.speaker: Entamis

Troubled Tribesmen#019.src: He unleashed egg pods that host a variety of magic draining insects. They are eating me alive and replacing my magic with evil magic. Soon I will die.
Troubled Tribesmen#019.dst: 牠釋放出許多卵囊，裡頭寄居著各式各樣吸食魔力的蟲。牠們正在把我一點一點吃掉，並用邪惡的魔力取代我的魔力。我很快就會死去。
Troubled Tribesmen#019.speaker: Entamis

Troubled Tribesmen#020.src: You mustn't let me be reborn a creature of evil...
Troubled Tribesmen#020.dst: 你絕不能讓我以邪惡之物的姿態重生……
Troubled Tribesmen#020.speaker: Entamis

Troubled Tribesmen#021.src: Kill Aenara and bring an Insect of Corruption to Shaman Inrekei.
Troubled Tribesmen#021.dst: 擊殺 Aenara，並把一隻腐化之蟲帶給薩滿 Inrekei。

Troubled Tribesmen#022.src: Hello again. I am grateful you returned. You don't need to say anything, though. I can no longer sense Entamis. I know she has died..
Troubled Tribesmen#022.dst: 又見面了。謝謝你回來。不過你什麼都不必說。我已經感覺不到 Entamis 了。我知道她已經死了……
Troubled Tribesmen#022.speaker: Inrekei

Troubled Tribesmen#023.src: You still have managed to prevent her corrupted magic to spread any further. And for that, my people are forever in your debt.
Troubled Tribesmen#023.dst: 但你仍然阻止了她的腐化魔力繼續擴散。為此，我的族人將永遠欠你一份情。
Troubled Tribesmen#023.speaker: Inrekei

Troubled Tribesmen#024.src: This insect appears to be the queen. I'll need to perform a ritual to kill it permanently. But never mind that, I can do that in my own time.
Troubled Tribesmen#024.dst: 這隻蟲看起來是蟲后。我得舉行一場儀式才能徹底殺死牠。不過這事不急，我自己找時間做就行。
Troubled Tribesmen#024.speaker: Inrekei

Troubled Tribesmen#025.src: Please take this. It is but a small gift. Your currency means nothing to us. In times of peril, few step forward and risk their lives to save those they do not know.
Troubled Tribesmen#025.dst: 請收下這個。這只是一份薄禮。你們的通貨對我們毫無意義。危難之際，願意挺身而出、為素不相識的人冒死的人，實在太少了。
Troubled Tribesmen#025.speaker: Inrekei

True Colours#000.src: Meet up with The Canopy at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

True Colours#001.src: {u}! Did you hear? They- they finished, um, sorting through the reports!
True Colours#001.speaker: Sui

True Colours#002.src: Azael says he has news about everyone from the Roughworks!
True Colours#002.speaker: Yusanu

True Colours#003.src: Indeed... indeed. Ehm... where to begin...
True Colours#003.speaker: Azael

True Colours#004.src: Outsiders, I would... temper your expectations.
True Colours#004.speaker: Fuhue

True Colours#006.src: I am afraid we are sorely lacking in good news. The Owls have returned with reports of a rather sudden influx of prisoners taken to Deraj Prison following the festival.
True Colours#006.speaker: Azael

True Colours#008.src: No... no, no, it- it can't be, there- there has to be another explanation...
True Colours#008.speaker: Sui

True Colours#009.src: Ah, Gravity's Monolith... it truly is a sight to behold, dark carved stone and burning crimson lights shining deep in the southern wastes...
True Colours#009.speaker: Rurie

True Colours#010.src: A shame it's inescapable, or I'd love to pay a visit. It's true, what they say- there is no escaping its pull once it gets a hold of you!
True Colours#010.speaker: Rurie

True Colours#011.src: I... I've, I've heard the rumors... are- are they really true?
True Colours#011.speaker: Sui

True Colours#012.src: As far as we can tell. We don't have a single record of a successful escape attempt. Supposedly, the Warden's blessing keeps the prisoners in line.
True Colours#012.speaker: Fuhue

True Colours#014.src: Cileon, goodness! There's no need for the dramatics! What they mean to say, dear friends, is that none who enter are ever heard from again!
True Colours#014.speaker: Rurie

True Colours#015.src: Gravity's Monolith, they call it... an inescapable pull, drawing you deeper and deeper into its clutches the more you try to break free!
True Colours#015.speaker: Rurie

True Colours#016.src: Oh, you're one to talk about dramatics. But he's right. I wouldn't get your hopes up.
True Colours#016.speaker: Fuhue

True Colours#017.src: Unfortunately, it would seem we also lack the details on who specifically has been sent there.
True Colours#017.speaker: Azael

True Colours#018.src: Sigh. Azael, sir, it's cruel to leave them in the dark. You need to tell them.
True Colours#018.speaker: Fuhue

True Colours#020.src: I suppose you are right, captain. It is regarding the older woman among your party... Syndra, was it?
True Colours#020.speaker: Azael

True Colours#021.src: It would seem that Her Majesty has made her into a statement.
True Colours#021.speaker: Azael

True Colours#023.src: She was publicly executed during the festival, as a way to send a message.
True Colours#023.speaker: Fuhue

True Colours#024.src: Subtle as a brick, aren't you?
True Colours#024.speaker: Rurie

True Colours#025.src: I apologize. This must be a shock. It is my understanding she was something of a leader to you all.
True Colours#025.speaker: Azael

True Colours#026.src: So it would seem. My, it has been an age since Her Majesty last performed such an act... how interesting, that she would deem it necessary.
True Colours#026.speaker: Azael

True Colours#027.src: But rest assured that her death will not be for nought. She fought like a true warrior, to the bitter end.
True Colours#027.speaker: Azael

True Colours#030.src: Yes, a fine idea, Cileon. Space - that we certainly can provide!
True Colours#030.speaker: Rurie

True Colours#031.src: Ugh. Fine. Captains, let's talk plans. Come on.
True Colours#031.speaker: Fuhue

True Colours#032.src: Talk to Sui and Yusanu at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

True Colours#034.src: I... I didn't think she could... how...?
True Colours#034.speaker: Yusanu

True Colours#035.src: She... she d-died, and we... w-we all got separated. She died and... she's d-dead. D-dead dead... dead. She's... dead.
True Colours#035.speaker: Sui

True Colours#036.src: And the others... to Deraj? What... what are we going to do now?
True Colours#036.speaker: Yusanu

True Colours#037.src: N-no, we... we can't. You... you heard Rurie. There's no escaping once they take you there...
True Colours#037.speaker: Sui

True Colours#038.src: I... I've lost too many people to th-that place. So many friends, c-captured and... and taken...
True Colours#038.speaker: Sui

True Colours#040.src: {u}, are you really considering this?! You can't just- just- throw yourself into a suicide mission!
True Colours#040.speaker: Yusanu

True Colours#041.src: ...fine. Fine! Just... make sure you c-come back. The three of us, we... we're all that's, ha, left.
True Colours#041.speaker: Sui

True Colours#043.src: I need to get back to work. Keep trying to align the resonances... maybe if I get it to work, it'll actually help us...
True Colours#043.speaker: Yusanu

True Colours#044.src: ...{u}, um. You should... tell Master Azael what you're doing. Before you... go.
True Colours#044.speaker: Sui

True Colours#045.src: Say good bye to Master Azael before heading to the Deraj Prison at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

True Colours#046.src: Stupid... resonance core. Pink, green, blue, white, gold... what am I supposed to even do with this?!
True Colours#046.speaker: Yusanu

True Colours#049.src: I must apologize once more for being so blunt with the news. I am often told I am lacking in that kind of sensitivity.
True Colours#049.speaker: Azael

True Colours#050.src: Worry not, that is what you have us captains for! In addition to all the, ah, other stuff we do!
True Colours#050.speaker: Rurie

True Colours#051.src: ... Say, are the other two... taking it well? I notice they haven't joined you.
True Colours#051.speaker: Rurie

True Colours#052.src: Pardon me? Did I hear that correctly? You did hear all I said about Gravity's Monolith, right? Inescapable pull... so on and so forth?
True Colours#052.speaker: Rurie

True Colours#053.src: Are you truly certain about this decision? Have you thought this through?
True Colours#053.speaker: Azael

True Colours#054.src: ... Well, if you truly wish to risk your life for a one in a million chance of a miracle, then who am I to interfere?
True Colours#054.speaker: Azael

True Colours#055.src: Ah, but might I? See, I have actually been plotting assorted plans for breaking in myself over the years! Though, of course, master Azael has always forbidden me from trying...
True Colours#055.speaker: Rurie

True Colours#057.src: Hmph! Good reason or not, the plots exist! Whether or not they are viable is anyone's guess... but nonetheless- would you allow me to join-
True Colours#057.speaker: Rurie

True Colours#058.src: Absolutely not. If they truly wish, the outsiders are permitted to throw their lives away. You, on the other hand, I cannot afford to lose.
True Colours#058.speaker: Azael

True Colours#059.src: Oh, you're no fun. Fine, fine, I will stay if I must. Well in that case, once you return, I will demand a full report on what it's like in there!
True Colours#059.speaker: Rurie

True Colours#060.src: What's the food like in there? How about entertainment? Perhaps even a dossier on that Warden, Oru? I can go on!
True Colours#060.speaker: Rurie

True Colours#061.src: Enough, Captain Rurie. {u}, there is a bridge in the south-eastern corner of the {p} that crosses directly to the prison's entrance.
True Colours#061.speaker: Azael

True Colours#062.src: If you truly intend on seeing this through, stay on guard. The bridge is typically guarded by dozens of soldiers.
True Colours#062.speaker: Azael

True Colours#063.src: Good luck on your adventure, new friend! Just remember, no point in dying over this, eh? No shame in turning back if the going gets tough!
True Colours#063.speaker: Rurie

True Colours#065.src: Ah, a prison break... what a shame I cannot join. Is there anything more fun than such a daring mission?
True Colours#065.speaker: Rurie

True Colours#066.src: Captain Rurie, I still need you to fill out many information reports. You have five of them to catch up on already.
True Colours#066.speaker: Azael

True Colours#067.src: Oh, paperwork... My greatest nemesis. Well, if I must!
True Colours#067.speaker: Rurie

True Colours#068.src: {u}. It's been... awhile since we've really had the chance to talk, hasn't it?
True Colours#068.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#069.src: They expected you might try the prison. I just... cleared out the guards temporarily. So we could have some privacy.
True Colours#069.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#070.src: You've probably heard as much already, but the prison isn't an option. Especially not from this side- there are guards everywhere.
True Colours#070.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#071.src: And even if you could get in... the Warden's not someone you want to mess with. Take it as a warning from a friend.
True Colours#071.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#072.src: I'd hope so! But being on different sides of this conflict makes that hard, doesn't it?
True Colours#072.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#073.src: And it's not like I'm the one who's been going on a killing spree through Fruma! I've heard what you did at {p}. Was that really necessary?
True Colours#073.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#074.src: Knock them out, then!! Use nonlethal force, if it's really necessary - I know you're capable of it!!
True Colours#074.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#075.src: And what do you mean by that?
True Colours#075.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#077.src: Yes! I have!! You're right, things are bad here in Fruma. I'm not blind to any of it. You of all people should know how deeply familiar I am with all the Crown has done!
True Colours#077.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#078.src: "Cursed..." Have you learned what it means by now? Horrible, uncontrollable power, so they say. None of them really believe it.
True Colours#078.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#079.src: Just a means to control the people, to keep all magic contained and monitored. I hate it! But I still agreed to this voluntarily, and you want to know why?
True Colours#079.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#080.src: Because in this position, I can actually DO something about it! They've given me authority, and yes there are obligations attached, but I can CHANGE things!
True Colours#080.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#081.src: ...of course, it's not like I've had the chance! From the moment I recovered from... from ascension, all I've been hearing about is what you've been up to!!
True Colours#081.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#082.src: Fighting your way back into the province, and for what? For me?! I didn't ASK you to do that!
True Colours#082.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#083.src: And aiding a resistance group? I- ugh, okay, look, I get it. I actually do. They... they seem like nice people. They do.
True Colours#083.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#084.src: ...I just wish it hadn't gone the way it did.
True Colours#084.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#085.src: I know! I know! But it was your side that instigated it!!
True Colours#085.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#086.src: And I did try to warn you! I didn't want that to happen, obviously! But... sigh. I didn't get to you quick enough.
True Colours#086.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#087.src: Look, I'm... I'm sorry. I wish nobody had to die. I wish a lot of things could have been handled differently.
True Colours#087.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#088.src: ...I've gotten off track. This isn't what I wanted to talk to you about at all.
True Colours#088.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#089.src: The crown has soldiers out looking for your group... you, specifically. Her Majesty wants to speak with you, to... explain things.
True Colours#089.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#090.src: I... I guess so. I guess you've finally made an impression on her.
True Colours#090.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#091.src: I now understand why that tournament was handled the way it was... but that doesn't mean I have to like it.
True Colours#091.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#092.src: Look... you should hear her out.
True Colours#092.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#094.src: She's like us, you know? She was... forced into a role she hated, trapped somewhere she couldn't escape. She was made into something entirely outside of her control.
True Colours#094.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#095.src: And eventually, she... she found a way out. Or, rather, she made her own way out. Clawed and pushed and fought for any possibility of freedom...
True Colours#095.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#096.src: She made Fruma, for herself, and- and yes! Yes, she's responsible for what happened to us! I know!! Trust me, I have not forgotten!!
True Colours#096.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#097.src: But... but it's so rare to find someone who understands. Who knows what it's like. Who- who forged her own path forward! If she could do it, then...
True Colours#097.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#099.src: I know you won't leave your friends. It's why I didn't bring the soldiers I was assigned... I was instructed to bring you in by force if you didn't come willingly, after all.
True Colours#099.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#100.src: I just... I need you to understand. Just as you have your reasons for what you've done, so do I.
True Colours#100.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#101.src: Sigh... You remember what she said, don't you? A ceaseless, meaningless war, fought by forces beyond our power?
True Colours#101.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#102.src: Haven't you seen the symptoms, the consequences? Light and Dark and the War they leave in their wake?
True Colours#102.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#103.src: If one side wins, everything ends. Fruma, Wynn, Gavel- nothing will matter if they get what they want.
True Colours#103.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#104.src: That's... what the tournament was for. She wanted someone powerful, who was from Fruma, but who had also seen... all of it.
True Colours#104.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#107.src: I'll let you get back to your friends. I'll even take my soldiers and leave. This one last time, I'll... I'll let you go.
True Colours#107.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#108.src: I have another warning for you, too. The Sovereign of the {p}- Gikyo... they know where the Canopy is hiding out. They're preparing an attack.
True Colours#108.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#109.src: You should have more than enough time to warn everybody this time around. I- I know what happened with Syndra was... was awful, but...
True Colours#109.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#110.src: ...if Gikyo captures you, your friends will wish what happens to them was as quick as what Her Majesty did. Trust me.
True Colours#110.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#111.src: Now... go. Save the friends you have left. While you still can.
True Colours#111.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#113.src: Not as much as you'd think. I've only just recovered enough to start doing things around here.
True Colours#113.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#114.src: Imagine my surprise when I found you were the one responsible for all the commotion. That you were even in Fruma in the first place!
True Colours#114.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#115.src: Sigh... look. They thought you might try the prison even though it isn't really an option. Especially not from this side there are guards everywhere.
True Colours#115.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#116.src: ...They thought you might try the prison even though it isn't really an option. Especially not from this side there are guards everywhere.
True Colours#116.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#117.src: Usually, at least. I've cleared them out temporarily, so that we could have some privacy.
True Colours#117.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#118.src: We didn't really get to talk back at the festival, after all. You... probably have questions.
True Colours#118.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#121.src: She mentioned it to you too, didn't she? That ceaseless war over our world, fought by forces beyond our power?
True Colours#121.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#122.src: I caught glimpses of it in Gavel... I'm sure you did too and more. Once you know what to look for, it's everywhere Light and Dark... and the War they leave in their wake.
True Colours#122.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#123.src: She says it's only because of their stalemate that they haven't done worse, and... I believe it.
True Colours#123.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#124.src: ...and there was the choice. Join her, and help ensure neither side in that war gets too much of an advantage... or... don't.
True Colours#124.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#125.src: To just leave it up to other people, and forget about it and live my life, and and how could I have possibly done that, knowing that that he's-
True Colours#125.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#127.src: At least, here... I could make a difference. Both in that war, and in Fruma.
True Colours#127.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#128.src: If I was in this position anyway... at least I could push for change.
True Colours#128.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#130.src: Not that that's made actually being in Fruma any easier, ha. Everything here is a reminder of... well. You know.
True Colours#130.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#131.src: ...I am. I'm not sure how to feel about it still, honestly.
True Colours#131.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#132.src: There's... two parts to it. Having authority and commanding soldiers, feels... strange. I don't know if I'll ever be used to it.
True Colours#132.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#133.src: I've never had that sort of power before. To be able to tell people what to do, and... have them just, do it.
True Colours#133.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#134.src: I have a voice that can actually push for change, and improve things, and... it feels unearned, in a way.
True Colours#134.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#135.src: I'm still the same as I was before! But now, with this title given to me, suddenly people will actually listen to me.
True Colours#135.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#136.src: ... I don't like that that's all it took.
True Colours#136.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#139.src: It's a strange feeling. Not... unpleasant, exactly, but not comfortable, either. A constant weight on my shoulder, reminding me of what I've signed up for.
True Colours#139.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#140.src: It's always there, a... a small push to react to things I haven't noticed yet, that I wouldn't notice without it.
True Colours#140.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#141.src: And the more focus I put on it, the stronger it gets. More overwhelming to keep track of, but... stronger.
True Colours#141.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#142.src: ...I try not to use it unless I have to.
True Colours#142.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#144.src: She mentioned it to you too, didn't she?
True Colours#144.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#145.src: That ceaseless war over our world, fought by forces beyond our power?
True Colours#145.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#146.src: I caught glimpses of it in Gavel... I'm sure you did too and more.
True Colours#146.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#147.src: She says it's only because of their stalemate that they haven't done worse, and... I believe it.
True Colours#147.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#148.src: ...and there was the choice. Join her, and help ensure neither side in that war gets too much of an advantage... or... don't.
True Colours#148.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#149.src: To just leave it up to other people, and forget about it and live my life, and and how could I have possibly done that, knowing that that he's
True Colours#149.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#151.src: At least, here... I could make a difference. Both in that war, and in Fruma.
True Colours#151.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#152.src: If I was in this position anyway... at least I could push for change.
True Colours#152.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#154.src: Not that that's made actually being in Fruma any easier, ha. Everything here is a reminder of... well. You know.
True Colours#154.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#155.src: …sigh. I thought… I thought I had it all figured out, but you being here is making things harder than I’d like.
True Colours#155.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#156.src: Ha. Well… sort of, but not really. You’ve learned what it really means by now, then? Horrible, uncontrollable power… so they say.
True Colours#156.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#157.src: It's all paper-thin, in the end. It's just a means to control the people, to keep all magic contained and monitored.
True Colours#157.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#158.src: ...and knowing that it was all manufactured, that there was never anything actually... wrong...
True Colours#158.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#159.src: To some extent, it's a relief but more than that it makes me angry. This was weighing on me for so long, and for it to mean... nothing, in the end?
True Colours#159.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#160.src: ...just another thing I want to change in Fruma. If I get the chance, that is.
True Colours#160.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#161.src: ...you being here is only making it harder for me to do anything about it of course.
True Colours#161.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#163.src: They didn’t want us here. We were… disposable soldiers, just a resource to keep Wynn standing.
True Colours#163.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#164.src: But now, all of a sudden… Now, they’ve changed their mind.
True Colours#164.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#165.src: But I can’t just… forget. I had my memories discarded, and was shipped off to Wynn, for something beyond my control.
True Colours#165.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#166.src: For something I’ve learned to appreciate over time. For something that was never really a curse!!
True Colours#166.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#168.src: I did some digging when I got here, you know? I went looking for anyone I might have known here, before……
True Colours#168.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#169.src: No one. Not a single person who knew me. Not a single person left to miss me, or even notice my absence!
True Colours#169.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#170.src: I had my self stripped away from me, and it doesn’t even matter! Because there was nothing here for me anyway!!
True Colours#170.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#172.src: I can’t imagine the same for Aledar. He must have had… someone.
True Colours#172.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#173.src: I guess it doesn’t matter. He’s gone anyway, isn’t he?
True Colours#173.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#174.src: Why? Because you've been causing the crown problems ever since you broke in.
True Colours#174.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#175.src: Nobody will listen to anything not related to you... and for good reason! You massacred a fort of soldiers, you've killed Sovereign Zhiraok twice now...
True Colours#175.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#177.src: Fine. You've killed Sovereign Zhiraok once, and... helped a second time...?
True Colours#177.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#178.src: ...okay. And that isn't to mention the plot to kill the Queen.
True Colours#178.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#179.src: I...ugh. I wish it hadn't gone the way it did.
True Colours#179.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#180.src: I know. I know. I tried to warn you, to get you to call it off, but...sigh. It doesn't matter now. It's already done.
True Colours#180.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#181.src: ...I'm sorry about the rest of your friends. The Leaves in the Wind. They... they seem like nice people.
True Colours#181.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#183.src: I've gotten off track. I had something I needed to tell you.
True Colours#183.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#184.src: The crown has soldiers out looking for you. Her Majesty wants to speak with you, to...explain things.
True Colours#184.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#185.src: I… I guess so. I guess you’ve finally made an impression on her.
True Colours#185.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#186.src: I now understand why that tournament was handled the way it was… but that doesn’t mean I have to like it.
True Colours#186.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#187.src: …I think you should hear her out, but that’s your choice to make. I just thought you should know.
True Colours#187.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#188.src: …okay. I can do that. Who first?
True Colours#188.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#189.src: ...me? I... I guess I'm one now, too. I'm still not sure how to feel about it, honestly. There's... two parts to it.
True Colours#189.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#190.src: Having authority and commanding soldiers, feels... strange. I don't know if I'll ever be used to it.
True Colours#190.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#191.src: I've never had that sort of power before. To be able to tell people what to do, and... have them just, do it.
True Colours#191.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#192.src: I have a voice that can actually push for change, and improve things, and... it feels unearned, in a way.
True Colours#192.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#193.src: I'm still the same as I was before! But now, with this title given to me, suddenly people will actually listen to me.
True Colours#193.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#194.src: ... I don't like that that's all it took.
True Colours#194.speaker: Sovereign Tasim
