Undersupply#098.src: The river flows, as well! It certainly is not yet the time of the month for another ration... Oh! It must have been that tourist! Perhaps they asked the manor to release some extra?
Undersupply#098.speaker: Merchant Risch

Undersupply#099.src: I'll get to open up the bar proper again! What a fine day this is. Say, stranger...
Undersupply#099.speaker: Barkeep Romu

Undersupply#100.src: So then! I have to figure this was you! Got the manor to let out a little extra, did you?
Undersupply#100.speaker: Barkeep Romu

Undersupply#101.src: They have risked life and limb to enter the dam and allow the water to flow freely. Show your thanks, and do not report them.
Undersupply#101.speaker: Butler Hayn

Undersupply#102.src: The masters have sent me to hand out compensation for your dangerous actions.
Undersupply#102.speaker: Butler Hayn

Undersupply#103.src: Wait, the ro- Why did you jump off th- The masters, wh- Are you from the manor?! Why did-
Undersupply#103.speaker: Merchant Risch

Undersupply#104.src: There was no more water for the masters to give. They have fixed the problem for all of us.
Undersupply#104.speaker: Butler Hayn

Undersupply#105.src: Even you were short? Gracious. Still...our gardens may now grow, our children may now drink... We can only give you our utmost thanks, stranger!
Undersupply#105.speaker: Merchant Risch

Undersupply#106.src: Thank ye traveler. I gotta get myself back to the bar. See ye around and stay safe!
Undersupply#106.speaker: Barkeep Romu

Undersupply#107.src: Did the butler just jump off the roof!? W-whatever, I have to get home! Thank you!
Undersupply#107.speaker: Mother Aris

Undersupply#108.src: The water helps out the manor too, eh? It can't be helped, atleast they deliver it around the whole forest.
Undersupply#108.speaker: Merchant Risch

Undersupply#109.src: They're pretty smart businessmen, I can understand the hustle. Maybe I'll ask them for advice some time soon!
Undersupply#109.speaker: Merchant Risch

Undersupply#110.src: I must be going now. The guards won't forgive you for slaying Balsura, but hopefully you can keep from being caught. Good luck.
Undersupply#110.speaker: Butler Hayn

Undersupply#111.src: Hey traveler, remember my promise? Discounted water for life! What do ye say? Want some?
Undersupply#111.speaker: Barkeep Romu

Undersupply#113.src: Pleasure doing business with ye! Jokes aside, thanks for all you've done.
Undersupply#113.speaker: Barkeep Romu

Undersupply#114.src: Guh, you must be pulling my leg...! ...Thanks for all you've done, traveler.
Undersupply#114.speaker: Barkeep Romu

Undersupply#115.src: Hey traveler, good work out there. Whenever the heat's off ye, come visit me!
Undersupply#115.speaker: Barkeep Romu

Undersupply#116.src: You're still around, traveler! Stay safe, please! I don't know what I would do if you were caught!
Undersupply#116.speaker: Mother Aris

Undersupply#117.src: Although, if you ever need some water, feel free to stop by!
Undersupply#117.speaker: Mother Aris

Undersupply#118.src: The water helps out the manor too, eh? It can't be helped, atleast they deliver it around the whole forest.
Undersupply#118.speaker: Merchant Risch

Undersupply#119.src: They're pretty smart businessmen, I can understand the hustle. Maybe I'll ask them for advice some time soon!
Undersupply#119.speaker: Merchant Risch

Undersupply#120.src: Hrm. I got so used to the stream being slow that I lost my last robe to the water flow. What a dilemma.
Undersupply#120.speaker: Duress

Undersupply#121.src: I really ought to put away that 'For Sale' sign so no one else gets confused...
Undersupply#121.speaker: Ryde

Undersupply#122.src: Fine work, indeed! I might welcome you with a cup of tea, but I cannot abide by 'scofflaws' such as yourself- wink, wink! Now away with you! Ah, haha!
Undersupply#122.speaker: Master Oshman

Undersupply#123.src: Hm. Hm, hm, hm... I should keep better track of the ledgers. If I had noticed earlier, petitioned earlier... But of course, a Nasin wouldn't have thought ahead... Hm...
Undersupply#123.speaker: Sir Hurlay

Undersupply#124.src: Stay out of trouble from now on. The beginning of strife is as when one lets out water.
Undersupply#124.speaker: Butler Hayn

Underwater#000.src: Talk to Omango located at the North of {p} at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

Underwater#001.src: Hi, my name is Omango. I am a resident of the {p} village, on top of the hill.
Underwater#001.dst: 嗨，我叫 Omango。我住在山丘上的 {p} 村。
Underwater#001.speaker: Omango

Underwater#002.src: As you may know, our people came to your land years ago, and this is the ship they used.
Underwater#002.dst: 你大概知道，我們的族人多年前來到你們這片土地，而這就是他們當年搭的船。
Underwater#002.speaker: Omango

Underwater#003.src: They brought lots of luxurious goods with them. Most of them got lost in the wreck.
Underwater#003.dst: 他們帶了大量的奢侈品過來。大部分都隨著船難沉沒了。
Underwater#003.speaker: Omango

Underwater#004.src: But recently, a small hole has opened in the shipwreck here. It is believed that fortune is hidden within it.
Underwater#004.dst: 不過最近這艘沉船上裂開了一個小洞。有人相信裡面藏著財寶。
Underwater#004.speaker: Omango

Underwater#005.src: Unfortunately, nobody has been able to explore it. It is too deep, no creature can survive underwater that long!
Underwater#005.dst: 可惜一直沒人能進去探。那裡太深了，沒有生物能在水下待那麼久！
Underwater#005.speaker: Omango

Underwater#006.src: However, my old friend Sayrr is a fisherman, and I know that he has a very special helmet...
Underwater#006.dst: 不過我的老朋友 Sayrr 是個漁夫，我知道他有一頂很特別的頭盔……
Underwater#006.speaker: Omango

Underwater#007.src: If you convince him to give you this helmet, and find the treasure, I'll give you a part of it!
Underwater#007.dst: 如果你能說服他把那頂頭盔給你，再把寶藏找出來，我分你一份！
Underwater#007.speaker: Omango

Underwater#008.src: Sayrr is out on his boat, but the cave next to me is a quick way over to where he does his fishing. Be careful on the way, though.
Underwater#008.dst: Sayrr 出海在他的船上，不過我旁邊這個洞窟是通往他釣魚那一帶的捷徑。路上小心點。
Underwater#008.speaker: Omango

Underwater#009.src: When you finally have the helmet, explore the ship and bring me back [{~} Ancient Treasure]. Good luck.
Underwater#009.dst: 等你拿到頭盔，就去探那艘船，幫我帶回 [{~} Ancient Treasure]。祝你好運。
Underwater#009.speaker: Omango

Underwater#010.src: Go through the cave at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] to find Sayrr on his boat on the other side
Underwater#010.dst: 穿過 [-{~1}, {~2}, -{~3}] 的洞窟，到另一頭找船上的 Sayrr

Underwater#011.src: Why ya looking at me like that? Is it cause I'm small, eh? I'll have you know that I caught fish that were twice your size!
Underwater#011.dst: 你幹嘛那樣看我？是因為我矮嗎，嗯？我告訴你，我釣過的魚有你兩倍大！
Underwater#011.speaker: Sayrr

Underwater#012.src: ...or, well, I used to be able to. Nothing's biting recently- wait a sec, why'd you hop on my boat anyways, stranger?
Underwater#012.dst: ……好啦，是以前釣得到。最近什麼都不上鉤——等等，話說回來，陌生人，你幹嘛跳上我的船？
Underwater#012.speaker: Sayrr

Underwater#013.src: Ahah! Yes, I still have that old breathing helmet. You want it? You'll have to do something for me first.
Underwater#013.dst: 啊哈！沒錯，那頂舊的呼吸頭盔我還留著。你想要？那你得先幫我做件事。
Underwater#013.speaker: Sayrr

Underwater#014.src: I'm sure you heard me, but the fish just aren't biting around here anymore! I need to make a living somehow! There's some fish in that cave, but...
Underwater#014.dst: 我剛才說了你也聽到了，這一帶的魚就是不上鉤了嘛！我總得討生活啊！那個洞窟裡是有些魚，可是……
Underwater#014.speaker: Sayrr

Underwater#015.src: ...it's a bit dangerous. Tell ya what, I'll give you my fishing rod, and you can go catch me, say, [{~} Gudgeon Meat] down there.
Underwater#015.dst: ……那裡有點危險。這樣吧，我把釣竿借你，你下去幫我釣個，嗯，[{~} Gudgeon Meat] 上來。
Underwater#015.speaker: Sayrr

Underwater#016.src: The helmet will be all yours after that.
Underwater#016.dst: 弄好之後，頭盔就是你的了。
Underwater#016.speaker: Sayrr

Underwater#017.src: Bring back [{~} Gudgeon Meat] found in the cave at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] to Sayrr
Underwater#017.dst: 到 [-{~1}, {~2}, -{~3}] 的洞窟釣到 [{~4} Gudgeon Meat] 帶回去給 Sayrr

Underwater#018.src: Ah! Welcome back! Any luck with the fish?
Underwater#018.dst: 啊！歡迎回來！魚釣得還順利嗎？
Underwater#018.speaker: Sayrr

Underwater#019.src: Great, and I'll thank you kindly. Here's your helmet, have fun with that.
Underwater#019.dst: 太好了，那真是謝謝你。頭盔給你，好好玩吧。
Underwater#019.speaker: Sayrr

Underwater#020.src: Explore the crashed ship for a lost treasure at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
Underwater#020.dst: 到 [-{~1}, {~2}, -{~3}] 探索那艘失事的船，找出失落的寶藏

Underwater#021.src: Break the crate and bring [{~} Old Treasure] to Omango at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
Underwater#021.dst: 打破木箱，把 [{~4} Old Treasure] 帶去 [-{~1}, {~2}, -{~3}] 給 Omango

Underwater#022.src: You got it! You found the treasure!
Underwater#022.dst: 你拿到了！你找到寶藏了！
Underwater#022.speaker: Omango

Underwater#023.src: As promised, here's your part of the loot.
Underwater#023.dst: 照約定，這是分你的那一份。
Underwater#023.speaker: Omango

Wrath of the Mummy#000.src: Talk to Ormrod in the desert of {p} at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Wrath of the Mummy#000.dst: 前往 {p} 沙漠的 [{~1}, {~2}, -{~3}] 與 Ormrod 對話。

Wrath of the Mummy#002.src: I live in this camp by choice. A curse follows me... and now trouble starts wherever I go. I left civilization and made camp in the desert, where I could do no more harm.
Wrath of the Mummy#002.dst: 我是自願住在這個營地的。有個詛咒跟著我……如今我走到哪，麻煩就跟到哪。我離開了文明，在沙漠裡紮營，這樣就不會再害到別人。
Wrath of the Mummy#002.speaker: Ormrod

Wrath of the Mummy#003.src: I do miss the comforts of {p} some days, though... you look like a learned adventurer. If I asked you to investigate this curse, perhaps you could help me rid myself of it?
Wrath of the Mummy#003.dst: 不過有些日子我還是會想念 {p} 的舒適……你看起來像個有見識的冒險者。如果我請你去調查這個詛咒，或許你能幫我擺脫它？
Wrath of the Mummy#003.speaker: Ormrod

Wrath of the Mummy#004.src: It all started when I discovered an old tomb in the North of the desert. Upon entering it, the ground started shaking and I heard inhuman screams coming from deeper within.
Wrath of the Mummy#004.dst: 一切都是從我在沙漠北邊發現一座古墓開始的。我一走進去，地面就開始震動，深處還傳來不像人的尖嘯。
Wrath of the Mummy#004.speaker: Ormrod

Wrath of the Mummy#005.src: I ran as fast as I could, learning later the tomb housed the remains of an ancient Mummy... which I accidentally awoke. If the Mummy could be put back to rest, perhaps the curse would go away.
Wrath of the Mummy#005.dst: 我拚了命地跑，後來才知道那座墓裡放著一具古代木乃伊的遺骸……而我不小心把它喚醒了。如果能讓那具木乃伊重新安息，詛咒或許就會消失。
Wrath of the Mummy#005.speaker: Ormrod

Wrath of the Mummy#006.src: I have heard of a scholar in {p}, Achper, who may know more about the tomb. I am reluctant to return to the city, in case my presence hurts anyone else.
Wrath of the Mummy#006.dst: 我聽說 {p} 有位學者叫 Achper，可能對那座墓知道得更多。我不太願意回城裡去，怕我的存在又害到別人。
Wrath of the Mummy#006.speaker: Ormrod

Wrath of the Mummy#007.src: If you would truly like to help, you should start by talking to him.
Wrath of the Mummy#007.dst: 你要是真心想幫忙，就先去找他談談吧。
Wrath of the Mummy#007.speaker: Ormrod

Wrath of the Mummy#008.src: Talk to Achper in {p} about the curse at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Wrath of the Mummy#008.dst: 前往 [{~1}, {~2}, -{~3}] 的 {p}，向 Achper 打聽那個詛咒。

Wrath of the Mummy#009.src: If I know about mummies? Of course! I've spent my entire life studying them!
Wrath of the Mummy#009.dst: 問我懂不懂木乃伊？那當然！我這輩子都在研究牠們！
Wrath of the Mummy#009.speaker: Achper

Wrath of the Mummy#010.src: They usually are very hard to reach, hidden in their tomb... and they don't like being disturbed.
Wrath of the Mummy#010.dst: 牠們通常很難接近，都藏在自己的墓裡……而且牠們很不喜歡被打擾。
Wrath of the Mummy#010.speaker: Achper

Wrath of the Mummy#011.src: I have heard of the curse that follows Ormrod, and the only way to remove its effects would be to kill the mummy.
Wrath of the Mummy#011.dst: 我聽說過跟著 Ormrod 的那個詛咒，要解除它的影響，唯一的辦法就是殺掉那具木乃伊。
Wrath of the Mummy#011.speaker: Achper

Wrath of the Mummy#012.src: The tomb lies in the North of the desert, but be very careful!
Wrath of the Mummy#012.dst: 那座墓在沙漠北邊，不過你千萬要小心！
Wrath of the Mummy#012.speaker: Achper

Wrath of the Mummy#013.src: Mummies aren't known to be weak... especially that one. It's demonic... pure evil, It's easily one of the most powerful specimens I've encountered.
Wrath of the Mummy#013.dst: 木乃伊向來不是什麼弱者……尤其是那一具。牠是惡魔性的……純粹的邪惡，輕輕鬆鬆就能排進我見過最強的幾具之一。
Wrath of the Mummy#013.speaker: Achper

Wrath of the Mummy#014.src: On top of that, the Creden Tibus bandit clan have been ransacking the tombs around the desert. You might run into trouble with them, so be prepared.
Wrath of the Mummy#014.dst: 除此之外，Creden Tibus 那個盜匪幫最近一直在洗劫沙漠周圍的墓穴。你可能會跟他們槓上，先做好準備。
Wrath of the Mummy#014.speaker: Achper

Wrath of the Mummy#015.src: Attempt to enter the Mummy's tomb at [{~}, {~}, -{~}]

Wrath of the Mummy#016.src: Stop! If you're thinking about looting the tomb, you're too late. The Creden Tibus have laid claim here, and you're not getting past.
Wrath of the Mummy#016.dst: 站住！你要是想來盜墓，那你來晚了。這裡已經被 Creden Tibus 佔了，你過不去的。
Wrath of the Mummy#016.speaker: Bandit

Wrath of the Mummy#017.src: Mummy? Curse? I don't know anything about that, but I can't let you in - how do I know you won't just grab the gold?
Wrath of the Mummy#017.dst: 木乃伊？詛咒？那些我一概不知，但我不能放你進去——我怎麼知道你不會順手把金子摸走？
Wrath of the Mummy#017.speaker: Bandit

Wrath of the Mummy#018.src: Unless... look. I've been waiting to get my hands on some pink wool, and the only shop that sells it has just been restocked.
Wrath of the Mummy#018.dst: 除非……這樣吧。我一直想弄到一些粉紅色羊毛，而唯一有賣的那家店剛好剛補完貨。
Wrath of the Mummy#018.speaker: Bandit

Wrath of the Mummy#019.src: Trouble is, the shop's over in {p} and I'm stuck guarding this tomb. If you go and grab me some before it sells out, I can look the other way.
Wrath of the Mummy#019.dst: 問題是那家店在 {p}，而我被綁在這裡守墓。你要是能趕在賣完之前幫我弄一些回來，我就睜一隻眼閉一隻眼。
Wrath of the Mummy#019.speaker: Bandit

Wrath of the Mummy#020.src: You can take my wagon over there, but you'll have to make your own way back. Give me [{~} Pink Wool] and I'll let you through.
Wrath of the Mummy#020.dst: 你可以搭我那邊的推車過去，不過回來得自己想辦法。把 [{~} 粉紅羊毛] 給我，我就放你過去。
Wrath of the Mummy#020.speaker: Bandit

Wrath of the Mummy#021.src: Use the bandit's wagon at [{~}, {~}, -{~}] to get to {p}.

Wrath of the Mummy#022.src: Bring back [{~} Pink Wool] to the bandit at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Wrath of the Mummy#023.src: Well, whaddya know? You got some Pink Wool! Okay, hand it here and I'll look the other way and let you into the tomb.
Wrath of the Mummy#023.dst: 嘿，瞧瞧這是什麼？你真的弄到粉紅羊毛了！好，交過來，我就當作沒看見，放你進墓裡。
Wrath of the Mummy#023.speaker: Bandit

Wrath of the Mummy#024.src: Just don't touch any of the gold, hmm? And if I were you, I wouldn't go in too deep.
Wrath of the Mummy#024.dst: 不過別碰任何金子，嗯？還有，換作是我，我不會往太深處走。
Wrath of the Mummy#024.speaker: Bandit

Wrath of the Mummy#025.src: The clan was going to explore further inside, but the sounds...
Wrath of the Mummy#025.dst: 幫裡本來打算往裡頭再探一探的，可是那些聲音……
Wrath of the Mummy#025.speaker: Bandit

Wrath of the Mummy#026.src: Anyway, I'll still let you inside if you want. Just remember, if anyone asks, this conversation never happened.
Wrath of the Mummy#026.dst: 總之，你想進去我還是會放你進去。只要記得，要是有人問起，這段對話從來沒發生過。
Wrath of the Mummy#026.speaker: Bandit

Wrath of the Mummy#027.src: Enter the tomb at [{~}, {~}, -{~}] and kill the Mummy.

Wrath of the Mummy#028.src: Bring [{~} Mummy's Bandage] to Ormrod at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Wrath of the Mummy#028.dst: 把 [{~} 木乃伊的繃帶] 帶到 [{~1}, {~2}, -{~3}] 交給 Ormrod。

Wrath of the Mummy#029.src: Hello, again... have you had any luck?
Wrath of the Mummy#029.dst: 你好，又見面了……有沒有什麼進展？
Wrath of the Mummy#029.speaker: Ormrod

Wrath of the Mummy#030.src: Those are the Mummy's bandages?! You did it? My curse is finally lifted!
Wrath of the Mummy#030.dst: 那些是木乃伊的繃帶？！你做到了？我的詛咒終於解除了！
Wrath of the Mummy#030.speaker: Ormrod

Wrath of the Mummy#031.src: I can't thank you enough! As a reward, take this rag I got from the Mummy when I entered the tomb.
Wrath of the Mummy#031.dst: 我真不知該怎麼謝你！當作報酬，這塊我進墓時從木乃伊身上拿到的破布給你。
Wrath of the Mummy#031.speaker: Ormrod

Wrath of the Mummy#032.src: I am not strong enough to wear it, but I'm sure you are! Take these emeralds too, that's the least I can do!
Wrath of the Mummy#032.dst: 我沒有那個力量穿戴它，但我相信你有！這些綠寶石也拿去，這是我最起碼能做的！
Wrath of the Mummy#032.speaker: Ormrod

WynnExcavation Site A#000.dst: 前往 [{~1}, {~2}, -{~3}] 與挖掘員 Vade 對話

WynnExcavation Site A#001.src: Oh, hey kid. Wanna make some money?
WynnExcavation Site A#001.speaker: Excavator Vade

WynnExcavation Site A#002.src: I need you to translate this ancient text.
WynnExcavation Site A#002.dst: 我要你把這段古文拿去翻譯。
WynnExcavation Site A#002.speaker: Excavator Vade

WynnExcavation Site A#003.src: Just run it down to the lab assistant, Tesha.
WynnExcavation Site A#003.dst: 把它送去給實驗室助理 Tesha 就行了。
WynnExcavation Site A#003.speaker: Excavator Vade

WynnExcavation Site A#004.src: I'd take it myself, but I'm far too important for grunt work! The lab is up there in the tent, and don't you dare damage the translation!
WynnExcavation Site A#004.dst: 我是可以自己跑一趟，可是我這麼重要的人怎麼能幹雜活！實驗室就在上面那頂帳篷裡，還有，你敢弄壞那份譯文試試看！
WynnExcavation Site A#004.speaker: Excavator Vade

WynnExcavation Site A#005.src: Bring the Ancient Writing to Tesha in the tents at [{~}, {~}, -{~}]
WynnExcavation Site A#005.dst: 把那份古代文書帶到 [{~1}, {~2}, -{~3}] 帳篷區交給 Tesha

WynnExcavation Site A#006.dst: 你好，歡迎來到 WynnExcavation 實驗室！
WynnExcavation Site A#006.speaker: Tesha

WynnExcavation Site A#007.dst: 哦，是 Vade 派你來的？
WynnExcavation Site A#007.speaker: Tesha

WynnExcavation Site A#008.src: Oh yes, the tablet I was waiting for!
WynnExcavation Site A#008.dst: 哦對，我等的就是這塊石板！
WynnExcavation Site A#008.speaker: Tesha

WynnExcavation Site A#010.src: Oh my! This is quite interesting..
WynnExcavation Site A#010.speaker: Tesha

WynnExcavation Site A#011.src: Here, let me finish this up...
WynnExcavation Site A#011.speaker: Tesha

WynnExcavation Site A#013.src: One tablet complete! Return it to Vade. Oh and don't read it!
WynnExcavation Site A#013.dst: 一塊石板搞定！拿回去給 Vade。哦，還有，別讀它！
WynnExcavation Site A#013.speaker: Tesha

WynnExcavation Site A#014.src: Return to Excavator Vade with the translated writing
WynnExcavation Site A#014.dst: 帶著譯好的文書回去找挖掘員 Vade

WynnExcavation Site A#016.src: Oh right, you're that kid I sent out!
WynnExcavation Site A#016.dst: 哦對，你就是我派出去的那個小鬼！
WynnExcavation Site A#016.speaker: Excavator Vade

WynnExcavation Site A#017.src: Well do you have the translated text or not?
WynnExcavation Site A#017.dst: 所以譯文你到底有沒有拿到？
WynnExcavation Site A#017.speaker: Excavator Vade

WynnExcavation Site A#018.src: You do! Brilliant! Let's take a look at that...
WynnExcavation Site A#018.dst: 你拿到了！太好了！我們來看看寫了什麼……
WynnExcavation Site A#018.speaker: Excavator Vade

WynnExcavation Site A#019.src: "Throw tribute an item to the wood that stands out, the right angle will open the way"
WynnExcavation Site A#019.dst: 「向那株突出的樹木獻上一件祭品，角度對了，路便會開」
WynnExcavation Site A#019.speaker: Excavator Vade

WynnExcavation Site A#020.src: I wonder if it is talking about inside the temple... Oh, uh, I forgot you were here. Stay out of this kid, it's grown up business!
WynnExcavation Site A#020.dst: 這說的該不會是神廟裡面吧……哦，呃，我忘了你還在。這事你別插手，小鬼，這是大人的事！
WynnExcavation Site A#020.speaker: Excavator Vade

WynnExcavation Site A#021.src: Solve this riddle in the tomb: "Throw tribute an item to the wood that stands out, the right angle will open the way"
WynnExcavation Site A#021.dst: 在墓中解開這則謎語：「向那株突出的樹木獻上一件祭品，角度對了，路便會開」

WynnExcavation Site A#023.src: Return and talk to Excavator Vade
WynnExcavation Site A#023.dst: 回去與挖掘員 Vade 對話

WynnExcavation Site A#024.src: Hey kid, did you just come from the tomb?
WynnExcavation Site A#024.dst: 嘿，小鬼，你剛才是從墓裡出來的？
WynnExcavation Site A#024.speaker: Excavator Vade

WynnExcavation Site A#025.src: I knew I shouldn't have been so lazy and got someone else to do the leg work!
WynnExcavation Site A#025.dst: 我就知道我不該偷懶找別人去跑腿！
WynnExcavation Site A#025.speaker: Excavator Vade

WynnExcavation Site A#026.src: Gosh, I can't tell my boss about this, he'll have my head! Literally! Wynn Excavation is not a group you want to betray, they are more powerful than you will ever know.
WynnExcavation Site A#026.dst: 天啊，這件事我不能讓上頭知道，他會要我的腦袋！我是說字面上的！WynnExcavation 不是你會想背叛的組織，他們的勢力遠超過你想像。
WynnExcavation Site A#026.speaker: Excavator Vade

WynnExcavation Site A#027.src: YOU'D BETTER NOT HAVE TAKEN ANYTHING! THAT IS OFFICIAL WYNNEXCAVATION PROPERTY!
WynnExcavation Site A#027.dst: 你最好什麼都沒拿走！那可是 WynnExcavation 的正式財產！
WynnExcavation Site A#027.speaker: Excavator Vade

WynnExcavation Site B#000.src: Bring the Yellow Crystal Shard to Excavator Lykron at [{~}, {~}, -{~}] The entrance to the cave is at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].
WynnExcavation Site B#000.dst: 把那塊黃色水晶碎片帶到 [{~1}, {~2}, -{~3}] 交給挖掘員 Lykron。洞窟入口在 [{~4}, {~5}, -{~6}]。

WynnExcavation Site B#001.src: Good day! You're the person that helped us out in the desert aren't you? Excellent! Just the person I need! Can you help me out with a problem I have?
WynnExcavation Site B#001.dst: 你好！你就是在沙漠幫過我們的那位吧？太好了！我正需要你這樣的人！可以幫我解決一個麻煩嗎？
WynnExcavation Site B#001.speaker: Excavator Lykron

WynnExcavation Site B#002.src: Perfect! You see, we are supposed to be searching for some of the... uhhh... long lost ruins of ancient Wynn, just like in the desert!
WynnExcavation Site B#002.dst: 太好了！你看，我們的工作是尋找那些……呃……古代 Wynn 失落已久的遺跡，就跟沙漠那邊一樣！
WynnExcavation Site B#002.speaker: Excavator Lykron

WynnExcavation Site B#003.src: However, it seems no progress has been made recently; my workers have stopped working!
WynnExcavation Site B#003.dst: 可是最近好像一點進展都沒有；我的工人全都不做事了！
WynnExcavation Site B#003.speaker: Excavator Lykron

WynnExcavation Site B#004.src: The problem is, there are strange creatures down at the bottom of the cave disturbing them.
WynnExcavation Site B#004.dst: 問題在於，洞窟底下有些奇怪的生物在干擾他們。
WynnExcavation Site B#004.speaker: Excavator Lykron

WynnExcavation Site B#005.src: I need you to go and kill them, but first you should go talk to one of my colleagues, he has more information for you.
WynnExcavation Site B#005.dst: 我需要你下去把牠們解決掉，不過你得先去找我的一位同事談談，他有更多資訊要給你。
WynnExcavation Site B#005.speaker: Excavator Lykron

WynnExcavation Site B#006.src: He is located directly at the bottom of the cave, go speak to him, go on now! Off you go!
WynnExcavation Site B#006.dst: 他就在洞窟的最底下，去找他吧，快去！出發！
WynnExcavation Site B#006.speaker: Excavator Lykron

WynnExcavation Site B#007.src: Investigate the depths of the cave

WynnExcavation Site B#008.src: We know what you stole from us in the desert! Take THIS! You won't be escaping this dead end any time soon!
WynnExcavation Site B#008.dst: 你在沙漠從我們手上偷了什麼，我們一清二楚！吃我這招！你這輩子別想從這條死路逃出去！
WynnExcavation Site B#008.speaker: Flendar

WynnExcavation Site B#012.src: This door is closed; the mine entrance behind it isn't open at this time.
WynnExcavation Site B#012.dst: 這扇門是關著的；後面的礦坑入口目前不開放。
WynnExcavation Site B#012.speaker: WynnExcavation Guard

WynnExcavation Site B#013.src: I'm here to make sure no one uses the passage while the archaeologist works.
WynnExcavation Site B#013.dst: 考古學家工作期間，我負責確保沒有人使用這條通道。
WynnExcavation Site B#013.speaker: WynnExcavation Guard

WynnExcavation Site B#014.src: You will have to find another exit if you want to get out!
WynnExcavation Site B#014.dst: 你想出去的話，得另外找出口！
WynnExcavation Site B#014.speaker: WynnExcavation Guard

WynnExcavation Site B#015.src: Baffling... What a puzzling situation I am in...
WynnExcavation Site B#015.dst: 費解……我怎麼會碰上這麼難解的狀況……
WynnExcavation Site B#015.speaker: WynnExcavation Archaeologist

WynnExcavation Site B#016.src: I cannot open this door for some reason...
WynnExcavation Site B#016.dst: 不知為何，我就是打不開這扇門……
WynnExcavation Site B#016.speaker: WynnExcavation Archaeologist

WynnExcavation Site B#017.src: We suspect the purple crystal is behind this door, but the descriptions in the scriptures don't match this door.
WynnExcavation Site B#017.dst: 我們推測紫水晶就在這扇門後面，可是經文上的描述跟這扇門對不上。
WynnExcavation Site B#017.speaker: WynnExcavation Archaeologist

WynnExcavation Site B#018.src: They seem to describe another door, but all our evidence says otherwise.
WynnExcavation Site B#018.dst: 經文寫的似乎是另一扇門，但我們手上所有的證據都指向這裡。
WynnExcavation Site B#018.speaker: WynnExcavation Archaeologist

WynnExcavation Site B#019.src: The scriptures also say something about hidden within the rocks... But we removed them all!
WynnExcavation Site B#019.dst: 經文還提到什麼「藏於岩石之中」……可是我們已經把石頭全清掉了！
WynnExcavation Site B#019.speaker: WynnExcavation Archaeologist

WynnExcavation Site B#020.src: Well, the writing isn't actually all that clear. It could mean virtually anything, I think one of these words means hippo! Guess we'll have to find out!
WynnExcavation Site B#020.dst: 話說回來，那段文字其實也沒多清楚。它幾乎可以解釋成任何意思，我看其中一個字大概是「河馬」！看來只能試了才知道！
WynnExcavation Site B#020.speaker: WynnExcavation Archaeologist

WynnExcavation Site B#021.src: Anyway, back to figuring out what needs to be done here... Wait, who are you, you're not an employee of WynnExcavation!
WynnExcavation Site B#021.dst: 總之，回來想想這裡到底該怎麼辦……等等，你是誰，你不是 WynnExcavation 的員工！
WynnExcavation Site B#021.speaker: WynnExcavation Archaeologist

WynnExcavation Site B#022.dst: 與挖掘員 Lykron 對話

WynnExcavation Site B#023.src: I have to admit, I'm impressed. I genuinely thought our plan would be successful. Who knew that dead end had a secret exit.
WynnExcavation Site B#023.dst: 我得承認，我很佩服。我原本真的以為我們的計畫會成功。誰想得到那條死路居然有祕密出口。
WynnExcavation Site B#023.speaker: Excavator Lykron

WynnExcavation Site B#024.src: Not me apparently. We know what you took in the desert, you were just some kid expected to do a delivery job, who knew you'd take a shard of the crystal.
WynnExcavation Site B#024.dst: 反正我是沒想到。你在沙漠拿了什麼，我們一清二楚；你不過是個被派去送東西的小鬼，誰料得到你會順走一塊水晶碎片。
WynnExcavation Site B#024.speaker: Excavator Lykron

WynnExcavation Site B#025.src: Don't pretend like you don't know what it is, you know as well as I do combining the four crystal shards is told to bring unlimited power!
WynnExcavation Site B#025.dst: 別裝作不知道那是什麼，你跟我一樣清楚——傳說把四塊水晶碎片合起來，就能帶來無窮的力量！
WynnExcavation Site B#025.speaker: Excavator Lykron

WynnExcavation Site B#026.src: You will not interfere any longer. The location of the remaining crystals are known only to us; the fire and leaf crystals are safe.
WynnExcavation Site B#026.dst: 你不會再有機會插手了。剩下那幾塊水晶的位置只有我們知道；火之水晶與葉之水晶都很安全。
WynnExcavation Site B#026.speaker: Excavator Lykron

WynnExcavation Site B#027.src: I see that tricking you isn't the way to defeating you. If we ever meet again, we'll be using force and upping our security. Now I never want to see you again. Our socie- I mean company, will not tolerate your interference again.
WynnExcavation Site B#027.dst: 看來要打倒你，靠騙是不行的。我們要是再見面，就會直接動武，而且會加強戒備。現在我再也不想看到你。我們的組——我是說公司，不會再容忍你的干預了。
WynnExcavation Site B#027.speaker: Excavator Lykron

WynnExcavation Site C#000.src: Talk to Excavator Placardus at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] (Requires shard from Site B)
WynnExcavation Site C#000.dst: 與挖掘者 Placardus 交談，座標 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]（需要 B 據點的碎片）

WynnExcavation Site C#001.src: All operations functional... Transportation on schedule... Oh. It's you. We've been looking for you.
WynnExcavation Site C#001.dst: 所有作業正常……運輸照表進行……噢。是你。我們一直在找你。
WynnExcavation Site C#001.speaker: Excavator Placardus

WynnExcavation Site C#002.src: Locating you was far harder than we thought, but here you are, having come right to us.
WynnExcavation Site C#002.dst: 要找到你比我們想的難得多，但你人就在這裡，自己送上門來了。
WynnExcavation Site C#002.speaker: Excavator Placardus

WynnExcavation Site C#003.src: Now you're here, I'm not sure what to say. But I feel I must explain, we at WynnExcavation apologise for all our previous encounters.
WynnExcavation Site C#003.dst: 你既然來了，我也不知道該說什麼好。但我覺得有必要說明：我們 WynnExcavation 為先前每一次的衝突向你致歉。
WynnExcavation Site C#003.speaker: Excavator Placardus

WynnExcavation Site C#004.src: We completely got off on the wrong foot. We are a company from Gavel which specialises in historic artifacts of great mystical importance.
WynnExcavation Site C#004.dst: 我們從一開始就徹底誤會彼此了。我們是來自 Gavel 的公司，專門處理具有重大神祕意義的歷史文物。
WynnExcavation Site C#004.speaker: Excavator Placardus

WynnExcavation Site C#005.src: After our encounter in {p}, we naturally thought you were a black market salesperson trying to steal pieces of the artifact for monetary gain.
WynnExcavation Site C#005.dst: 在 {p} 那次碰面之後，我們自然認定你是黑市商人，想偷走文物碎片換錢。
WynnExcavation Site C#005.speaker: Excavator Placardus

WynnExcavation Site C#006.src: So we instructed all of our employees in all of our sites to thwart you at any cost. Historical loss is a very important issue, especially with something so powerful.
WynnExcavation Site C#006.dst: 所以我們指示所有據點的員工不計代價阻止你。歷史文物的損失是非常嚴重的問題，何況是這麼強大的東西。
WynnExcavation Site C#006.speaker: Excavator Placardus

WynnExcavation Site C#007.src: But after hearing the stories of your travels in the province, we realised what had happened, and you mistook us for the enemy. This is obviously not the case.
WynnExcavation Site C#007.dst: 但聽過你在這片省份旅行的種種事蹟之後，我們才明白發生了什麼——你把我們當成了敵人。事實顯然並非如此。
WynnExcavation Site C#007.speaker: Excavator Placardus

WynnExcavation Site C#008.src: I hope this clears everything up between us and we can both move our separate ways, now if you'll excuse me, I have a meeting to attend.
WynnExcavation Site C#008.dst: 希望這能把我們之間的誤會說清楚，往後各走各的路。現在請恕我失陪，我還有個會議要出席。
WynnExcavation Site C#008.speaker: Excavator Placardus

WynnExcavation Site C#009.src: Infiltrate the Excavation Meeting. The meeting is held in a diamond-pickaxe room, the portal being located to the left of the entrance to a large lava cave.
WynnExcavation Site C#009.dst: 潛入挖掘會議。會議在一間有鑽石鎬的房間舉行，傳送門位於通往大型熔岩洞穴入口的左側。

WynnExcavation Site C#010.src: I'm sorry. This is a private meeting.
WynnExcavation Site C#010.dst: 抱歉。這是不公開的會議。
WynnExcavation Site C#010.speaker: Guard Klerodor

WynnExcavation Site C#011.src: It is only my first day on the job, so I can't let you in without a pass. Sorry.
WynnExcavation Site C#011.dst: 我今天才第一天上班，沒有通行證我不能放你進去。抱歉。
WynnExcavation Site C#011.speaker: Guard Klerodor

WynnExcavation Site C#012.src: The door will be locked shortly.
WynnExcavation Site C#012.speaker: Guard Klerodor

WynnExcavation Site C#014.src: Hello and welcome, senior members of Wynn Excavation Site C. May the dark's gaze forever watch over us. I want to update you on our progress thus far. The fire relic crystal has been largely intact in the heart of the volcano for many years.
WynnExcavation Site C#014.dst: 歡迎各位，Wynn Excavation C 據點的資深成員們。願黑暗的目光永遠注視著我們。我要向各位報告目前的進度。那枚火之遺物水晶多年來一直完好地留在火山中心。
WynnExcavation Site C#014.speaker: Chief Excavator Dranfor

WynnExcavation Site C#015.src: Removing it will most likely cause a chain reaction and make things difficult. Fortunately, a mage from the other side of the ocean is here to counter that. We can expect to have it moved and be shipped over to the undisclosed location any day now.
WynnExcavation Site C#015.dst: 把它取出來極可能引發連鎖反應，屆時會很麻煩。所幸有一位來自海洋另一端的法師到場處理這件事。我們可以預期它隨時會被移出，並運往那個未公開的地點。
WynnExcavation Site C#015.speaker: Chief Excavator Dranfor

WynnExcavation Site C#016.src: I would also like to inform you that the crystals removed from our possession from sites B and A have not been retrieved. However, the culprit should no longer be interested in our operations. The lost crystals did not harness any raw magic, thus are not essential to the overall scheme.
WynnExcavation Site C#016.dst: 我也要告知各位，先前從 B 與 A 據點被奪走的水晶尚未取回。不過那名犯人應該已經對我們的行動失去興趣。遺失的那幾枚並未蘊含原始魔力，因此對整體計畫並不關鍵。
WynnExcavation Site C#016.speaker: Chief Excavator Dranfor

WynnExcavation Site C#017.src: Now, our short term goals are to move our equipment out of the heart of the volcano and start moving the fire stone for assimilation at the concealed location. All senior officers are responsible for their quadrants. Let's get this done efficiently and discreetly.
WynnExcavation Site C#017.dst: 接下來的短期目標，是把設備移出火山中心，並開始將火之石運往隱蔽地點進行同化。所有資深幹部各自負責自己的區塊。我們要做得又快又不引人注意。
WynnExcavation Site C#017.speaker: Chief Excavator Dranfor

WynnExcavation Site C#019.src: The alarm has been set off! There is an unauthorized guest! Guards, seize them!
WynnExcavation Site C#019.dst: 警報響了！有未經授權的訪客！警衛，抓住他！
WynnExcavation Site C#019.speaker: Chief Excavator Dranfor

WynnExcavation Site C#021.src: Explore the area and search for the traitor
WynnExcavation Site C#021.dst: 探索這一帶，尋找那名叛徒

WynnExcavation Site C#022.src: You. You are the one they are worried about.
WynnExcavation Site C#022.dst: 你。就是你讓他們那麼緊張。

WynnExcavation Site C#023.src: I am Amadel, leader of the rebellion.
WynnExcavation Site C#023.dst: 我是 Amadel，反抗軍的首領。

WynnExcavation Site C#024.src: I know this is all a bit sudden, but I have some information you must hear.
WynnExcavation Site C#024.dst: 我知道這一切來得很突然，但有些事你必須聽。
WynnExcavation Site C#024.speaker: Traitor Amadel

WynnExcavation Site C#025.src: Everything you have been told is a lie. The Wynn Excavation “company” are not what they appear to be.
WynnExcavation Site C#025.dst: 你被告知的一切都是謊言。Wynn Excavation 這間「公司」並不是它表面上的樣子。
WynnExcavation Site C#025.speaker: Traitor Amadel

WynnExcavation Site C#026.src: They are using that as a front and their reach stretches further than I even know.
WynnExcavation Site C#026.dst: 那只是幌子，他們的觸手伸得比我所知道的還要遠。
WynnExcavation Site C#026.speaker: Traitor Amadel

WynnExcavation Site C#027.src: There is no higher authority than them, not even the kings. And their intentions are not good.
WynnExcavation Site C#027.dst: 沒有任何權力在他們之上，連國王都不是。而他們的意圖並不良善。
WynnExcavation Site C#027.speaker: Traitor Amadel

WynnExcavation Site C#028.src: They seek the ultimate power, a power hidden across Wynn by various civilizations over hundreds of years.
WynnExcavation Site C#028.dst: 他們追求的是終極的力量——那份力量被各個文明藏在 Wynn 各地，藏了數百年。
WynnExcavation Site C#028.speaker: Traitor Amadel

WynnExcavation Site C#029.src: They heard about it, and of course, began to gather the ingredients to create something that would lead them to total domination of the province.
WynnExcavation Site C#029.dst: 他們聽說了這件事，當然就開始蒐集材料，要造出某種能讓他們完全支配這片省份的東西。
WynnExcavation Site C#029.speaker: Traitor Amadel

WynnExcavation Site C#030.src: They've been on to me for some time. I can't tell you everything here, but first, you must gather parts of the crystal, like you did with the others. It is essential.
WynnExcavation Site C#030.dst: 他們盯上我有一段時間了。我沒辦法在這裡全部告訴你，但你必須先像前幾次那樣蒐集水晶的碎片。這件事非做不可。
WynnExcavation Site C#030.speaker: Traitor Amadel

WynnExcavation Site C#031.src: The crystal is in the cave just inside the volcano past the base. Hurry, they are all off duty at the moment, the cave to the heart of the volcano is clear. Act swiftly, and good luck.
WynnExcavation Site C#031.dst: 水晶就在基地過去、火山內側的那個洞穴裡。快去，他們現在全都不在崗位上，通往火山中心的洞穴是淨空的。動作快，祝你好運。
WynnExcavation Site C#031.speaker: Traitor Amadel

WynnExcavation Site C#032.src: Explore the depths of the volcano

WynnExcavation Site C#033.src: Escape the volcano with the crystal shard
WynnExcavation Site C#033.dst: 帶著水晶碎片逃出火山

WynnExcavation Site C#034.src: Report back to Excavator Placardus with a [Red Crystal Shard]
WynnExcavation Site C#034.dst: 帶著 [Red Crystal Shard] 回報挖掘者 Placardus

WynnExcavation Site C#035.src: You couldn't just take my polite word and leave it at that, could you?
WynnExcavation Site C#035.dst: 你就是沒辦法乖乖聽我把話說完然後走人，對吧？
WynnExcavation Site C#035.speaker: Excavator Placardus

WynnExcavation Site C#036.src: You had to go snooping around, meddle in things that are far beyond your comprehension. No matter. Something did come out of this, it would appear.
WynnExcavation Site C#036.dst: 你非得四處打探，插手那些遠超你理解範圍的事。無所謂。看來這件事倒也不是全無收穫。
WynnExcavation Site C#036.speaker: Excavator Placardus

WynnExcavation Site C#037.src: You were caught, conversing with Amadel, who we now know to be a traitor, thanks to you. There are eyes everywhere, young hero.
WynnExcavation Site C#037.dst: 你被逮到跟 Amadel 交談——多虧了你，我們現在知道他是叛徒。到處都有眼睛，年輕的英雄。
WynnExcavation Site C#037.speaker: Excavator Placardus

WynnExcavation Site C#038.src: I'm willing to bet he's already been... taken care of by senior staff.
WynnExcavation Site C#038.dst: 我敢打賭，他已經被資深幹部……處理掉了。
WynnExcavation Site C#038.speaker: Excavator Placardus

WynnExcavation Site C#039.src: We also now know you are operating in the dark. You know nothing of the crystals or their power, and you know not that even the crystals you possess are inconsequential to our plans.
WynnExcavation Site C#039.dst: 我們現在也知道你根本什麼都不清楚。你對水晶和它們的力量一無所知，更不知道你手上那幾枚對我們的計畫無足輕重。
WynnExcavation Site C#039.speaker: Excavator Placardus

WynnExcavation Site C#040.src: You're lucky you aren't dead. How you infiltrated us this far has shown nothing but beginner's luck for the province's new hero.
WynnExcavation Site C#040.dst: 你能活著就算走運。你能滲透到這一步，不過證明了這片省份的新英雄有點新手運罷了。
WynnExcavation Site C#040.speaker: Excavator Placardus

WynnExcavation Site C#041.src: I suggest you leave, before the guards get here and you meet the same fate as Amadel. Our power is limitless; armies, resources, even royalty are on our side. Our gaze is everpresent. Now, get out of my sight!
WynnExcavation Site C#041.dst: 我建議你離開，趁警衛還沒到、免得你落得跟 Amadel 一樣的下場。我們的力量沒有極限；軍隊、資源，甚至王室都站在我們這邊。我們的目光無所不在。現在，滾出我的視線！
WynnExcavation Site C#041.speaker: Excavator Placardus

WynnExcavation Site D#000.src: Talk to Royal Advisor Carlos in {p} Castle at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] (Requires shard from Site C)

WynnExcavation Site D#001.src: His majesty Lord King of {p} is indisposed at this moment.
WynnExcavation Site D#001.speaker: Royal Advisor Carlos

WynnExcavation Site D#002.src: He recieved a message and made his way frantically down to the panic room, which is somewhere inside of this throne room.
WynnExcavation Site D#002.speaker: Royal Advisor Carlos

WynnExcavation Site D#003.src: He hasn't been seen since. Only the King knows how to get into the panic room, but I've had my suspicions about it for a while now.
WynnExcavation Site D#003.speaker: Royal Advisor Carlos

WynnExcavation Site D#004.src: He seemed to be expecting someone, but I'm fed up of waiting.
WynnExcavation Site D#004.speaker: Royal Advisor Carlos

WynnExcavation Site D#005.src: I managed to hear a few things he was muttering to himself just before he disappeared, though.
WynnExcavation Site D#005.speaker: Royal Advisor Carlos

WynnExcavation Site D#006.src: He mentioned something about a fourth crystal... a green one.
WynnExcavation Site D#006.speaker: Royal Advisor Carlos

WynnExcavation Site D#007.src: And then he said "The order of the crystals will open the way".Maybe it's a clue as to how to find him?
WynnExcavation Site D#007.speaker: Royal Advisor Carlos

WynnExcavation Site D#008.src: Please, we need to find him, I'm sick of telling everyone he's indisposed!
WynnExcavation Site D#008.speaker: Royal Advisor Carlos

WynnExcavation Site D#009.src: Find the secret passageway inside of the throne room

WynnExcavation Site D#010.src: Oh my, a secret passage has opened up beneath the throne! Quickly, head inside!
WynnExcavation Site D#010.speaker: Royal Advisor Carlos

WynnExcavation Site D#013.src: I am impressed you managed to find me. Someone of my intellect is not normally found when he hasn't the intention of being so.
WynnExcavation Site D#013.speaker: King of Troms

WynnExcavation Site D#014.src: I suppose I at least owe you the truth for getting this far, not that it matters.
WynnExcavation Site D#014.speaker: King of Troms

WynnExcavation Site D#015.src: WynnExcavation, the Gavel company is a fake, a facade. It's not real....
WynnExcavation Site D#015.speaker: King of Troms

WynnExcavation Site D#016.src: It's actually a secret society run by the high and mighty of Gavel.
WynnExcavation Site D#016.speaker: King of Troms

WynnExcavation Site D#017.src: They have one goal, complete control.
WynnExcavation Site D#017.speaker: King of Troms

WynnExcavation Site D#018.src: You can't compete with them, kid. I tried to at first, but they had turned my inner circle before getting to me.
WynnExcavation Site D#018.speaker: King of Troms

WynnExcavation Site D#019.src: Though I cannot admit I fought hard, their ideals are admirable.
WynnExcavation Site D#019.speaker: King of Troms

WynnExcavation Site D#020.src: So I hope you will forgive me, I act only for the greater good of the world.
WynnExcavation Site D#020.speaker: King of Troms

WynnExcavation Site D#021.src: As you will not be leaving the city, I wish you a fond farewell. When you leave, you will be accused of treason and will be hunted. It is the only way...
WynnExcavation Site D#021.speaker: King of Troms

WynnExcavation Site D#023.src: Time is short, so I'll have to spare you the details, but let's just say I'm on your side.
WynnExcavation Site D#023.speaker: Troms Guard

WynnExcavation Site D#024.src: The King just placed you under arrest for treason. They've locked down the entire city.
WynnExcavation Site D#024.speaker: Troms Guard

WynnExcavation Site D#025.src: Both the front gate and the Passage are closed down. So we've created another exit for you.
WynnExcavation Site D#025.speaker: Troms Guard

WynnExcavation Site D#026.src: Just follow the path to your left around the city. Keep going until you see a villager next to a tunnel. We'll clear your name once you've escaped.
WynnExcavation Site D#026.speaker: Troms Guard

WynnExcavation Site D#027.src: You'll pass through the army headquarters on your way, so be prepared for a fight. I'm the only guard here to help you.
WynnExcavation Site D#027.speaker: Troms Guard

WynnExcavation Site D#028.src: Now run! We don't have another moment to waste!
WynnExcavation Site D#028.speaker: Troms Guard

WynnExcavation Site D#031.src: Take this, and run! You need to get out!

WynnExcavation Site D#032.src: Head to those coordinates, there is no time to explain, now go! I'll close the tunnel behind you.

WynnExcavation Site D#033.src: I'VE FOUND THE TRAITOR! THEY'RE OVER HERE!

WynnExcavation Site D#034.src: Head to the location on the note

WynnExcavation Site D#036.src: I'm sorry, I can't let you in there.
WynnExcavation Site D#036.speaker: Traitor Thomas

WynnExcavation Site D#037.src: I can't let you in there, not until you have proven you are truly on our side.
WynnExcavation Site D#037.speaker: Traitor Thomas

WynnExcavation Site D#038.src: We never know who to believe anymore. Unfortunately there is no way for you to prove your loyalty.
WynnExcavation Site D#038.speaker: Traitor Thomas

WynnExcavation Site D#039.src: Now if you would excuse me, I have to hunt for the lost map fragments of Dernel. I'm sure these eyes have something to do with it...
WynnExcavation Site D#039.speaker: Traitor Thomas

WynnExcavation Site D#040.src: Find the three map fragments by following the eyes and return to Thomas.

WynnExcavation Site D#041.src: I can't let you in, we're busy looking for an important document, I'm sure these eyes have something to do with it...
WynnExcavation Site D#041.speaker: Traitor Thomas

WynnExcavation Site D#042.src: Is that... The map fragments? You found them!
WynnExcavation Site D#042.speaker: Traitor Thomas

WynnExcavation Site D#043.src: Oh my, you better come in.
WynnExcavation Site D#043.speaker: Traitor Thomas

WynnExcavation Site D#044.src: There's not enough time! We need to combine those fragments with ours!
WynnExcavation Site D#044.speaker: Traitor Thomas

WynnExcavation Site D#048.src: Welcome, friend. I knew you would figure it all out.
WynnExcavation Site D#048.speaker: Traitor Amadel

WynnExcavation Site D#049.src: You must be surprised to see me. The excavation crew at site C tried very hard to kill me.
WynnExcavation Site D#049.speaker: Traitor Amadel

WynnExcavation Site D#050.src: They didn't succeed though. I got away, and I swiped a fragment of a map, and I found out what it's for.
WynnExcavation Site D#050.speaker: Traitor Amadel

WynnExcavation Site D#051.src: If you made it this far, you know Wynn Excavation are not what they seem. They want to harness Wynn's ancient power.
WynnExcavation Site D#051.speaker: Traitor Amadel

WynnExcavation Site D#052.src: They control our governments, authorities and seem to be {~} steps ahead of any of us that oppose them.
WynnExcavation Site D#052.speaker: Traitor Amadel

WynnExcavation Site D#053.src: That is, unless we're able to beat the excavationists to the last crystal.
WynnExcavation Site D#053.speaker: Traitor Amadel

WynnExcavation Site D#054.src: They cannot use a single shard of power without combining them all.
WynnExcavation Site D#054.speaker: Traitor Amadel

WynnExcavation Site D#055.src: Here, I've combined the map fragments behind me. It looks it's deep in the jungle, I wonder where...
WynnExcavation Site D#055.speaker: Traitor Amadel

WynnExcavation Site D#056.src: WynnExcavation have done really horrible things, and I used to help...
WynnExcavation Site D#056.speaker: Traitor Buice

WynnExcavation Site D#057.src: WynnExcavation will be destroyed, no matter what!
WynnExcavation Site D#057.speaker: Traitor Jaynar

WynnExcavation Site D#062.src: Oh my. It's you. I can't say I'm surprised to see you, we thought you might be stupid enough to come here.
WynnExcavation Site D#062.speaker: Excavator Admin Uci

WynnExcavation Site D#063.src: Stupid enough to come here, yet, smart enough to make it.
WynnExcavation Site D#063.speaker: Excavator Admin Uci

WynnExcavation Site D#064.src: You were at every site, taking shards and attempting to thwart us.
WynnExcavation Site D#064.speaker: Excavator Admin Uci

WynnExcavation Site D#065.src: This time we won, and you lost.
WynnExcavation Site D#065.speaker: Excavator Admin Uci

WynnExcavation Site D#066.src: What do your shards mean to us when we have all four crystals?
WynnExcavation Site D#066.speaker: Excavator Admin Uci

WynnExcavation Site D#068.src: The boss wants to speak to you, I don't recommend keeping him waiting, he's not a patient man.
WynnExcavation Site D#068.speaker: Excavator Admin Uci

WynnExcavation Site D#069.src: He'll be waiting for you, head through that door.
WynnExcavation Site D#069.speaker: Excavator Admin Uci

WynnExcavation Site D#070.src: My boss Uci is a bit of a mean guy, but hey the perks of minionship aren't bad!
WynnExcavation Site D#070.speaker: Excavator Sean

WynnExcavation Site D#071.src: This leads deeper into this dungeon, but it seems like it has to be activated from the other side.
WynnExcavation Site D#071.speaker: WynnExcavation Scientist Azure

WynnExcavation Site D#079.src: Well, well. Looks like you've finally made it.
WynnExcavation Site D#079.speaker: WynnExcavation Leader Amadel

WynnExcavation Site D#080.src: You might be a little shocked to see me here...
WynnExcavation Site D#080.speaker: WynnExcavation Leader Amadel

WynnExcavation Site D#082.src: You finding that old fool in the desert, you surviving that fall.
WynnExcavation Site D#082.speaker: WynnExcavation Leader Amadel

WynnExcavation Site D#083.src: You finding that notebook, and eventually meeting me.
WynnExcavation Site D#083.speaker: WynnExcavation Leader Amadel

WynnExcavation Site D#084.src: Everything that you have done has been planned by the mastermind behind this organisation, me.
WynnExcavation Site D#084.speaker: WynnExcavation Leader Amadel

WynnExcavation Site D#085.src: You don't get it, do you? We needed you. The otherworldly crystals are a powerful magic, but a dangerous one at that.
WynnExcavation Site D#085.speaker: WynnExcavation Leader Amadel

WynnExcavation Site D#086.src: We needed you, an unaware human with some form of pure intent to bring empowered shards here. Anyone else would have ran off with the shards, and turned against us. It's just how it all works. I don't expect you to understand.. Now. Enough talking.
WynnExcavation Site D#086.speaker: WynnExcavation Leader Amadel

WynnExcavation Site D#091.src: The crystals combine the power of the stars themselves.. an ultimate power... the power to reign over the entire WORLD!
WynnExcavation Site D#091.speaker: Corrupted Amadel

WynnExcavation Site D#093.src: I- I- I feel... unstoppable.. this power... will not aļ͢͠͠͡l̶̀͜͏͏ów me to lớ̀͠͝se..!!!
WynnExcavation Site D#093.speaker: Shadow Amadel

WynnExcavation Site D#095.src: DID YOU REALLY THINK YOU COULD WIN?!?! YOU ARE NOTHING COMPARED TO ME! NOTHING!! I WILL EXTERMINATE ALL LIFE, STARTING WITH YOU!! NOW, PERISH!!!
WynnExcavation Site D#095.speaker: Amadel

Zhight Island (Quest)#000.dst: 前往 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] 與 {p} 的 Zhight 交談

Zhight Island (Quest)#001.src: Hello, esteemed tourist sir or madame! I see you have found my illustrious resort, {p}!
Zhight Island (Quest)#001.dst: 您好，尊貴的觀光客先生或女士！看來您找到了我這座輝煌的度假勝地，{p}！
Zhight Island (Quest)#001.speaker: Zhight

Zhight Island (Quest)#002.src: Normally, you'd need a reservation to stay here, but our human visitors are ALWAYS welcome! Ehm...
Zhight Island (Quest)#002.dst: 照理說住這裡是要預約的，不過我們對人類訪客一向來者不拒！呃……
Zhight Island (Quest)#002.speaker: Zhight

Zhight Island (Quest)#003.src: ...w-well, actually...wait, no, it's nothing, nothing, friend! I guarantee you'll enjoy your stay here!
Zhight Island (Quest)#003.dst: ……那、那個，其實……等等，不，沒事沒事，朋友！我保證您在這裡會住得很愉快！
Zhight Island (Quest)#003.speaker: Zhight

Zhight Island (Quest)#004.src: Even if m-my usual supplies haven't arrived in weeks, I, um, I'm TOTALLY sure we can accommodate for you!
Zhight Island (Quest)#004.dst: 就算我、我平常的補給已經好幾週沒到了，我，嗯，我完全確定我們招待得起您！
Zhight Island (Quest)#004.speaker: Zhight

Zhight Island (Quest)#005.src: We can just...um...w-well, I won't impose on you, dearest most welcomest traveller, no sir! Or madame!
Zhight Island (Quest)#005.dst: 我們可以就……嗯……那、那個，我不會為難您的，最最尊貴最最受歡迎的旅人，絕對不會！先生！或者女士！
Zhight Island (Quest)#005.speaker: Zhight

Zhight Island (Quest)#006.src: B-But, if, perchance, you were to, um...happen to find my supplier, Phief, who hasn't come around in weeks the bas-
Zhight Island (Quest)#006.dst: 不、不過呢，假如您碰巧，嗯……剛好遇到我的供應商 Phief，那傢伙好幾週沒來了，那個混——
Zhight Island (Quest)#006.speaker: Zhight

Zhight Island (Quest)#007.src: I! I mean! Nothing, nothing! Just, ehm, our extra reliable supplier often stops by {p} for supplies...
Zhight Island (Quest)#007.dst: 我！我是說！沒事，沒事！只是，呃，我們超級可靠的供應商經常會到 {p} 補貨……
Zhight Island (Quest)#007.speaker: Zhight

Zhight Island (Quest)#008.src: S-So, if you just happen to stop by there after your lovely stay here, and tell him to get off his sorry butt and send me my supplies that'd be just peachy!
Zhight Island (Quest)#008.dst: 所、所以，如果您在這裡愉快地住完之後剛好路過那邊，請告訴他把屁股抬起來，把我的補給送過來，那就太好了！
Zhight Island (Quest)#008.speaker: Zhight

Zhight Island (Quest)#010.src: Hello there. I see Zhight has sent you, correct?
Zhight Island (Quest)#010.dst: 你好。我猜是 Zhight 派你來的，對吧？
Zhight Island (Quest)#010.speaker: Phief

Zhight Island (Quest)#011.src: I do hope he isn't mad at me. I fully intended to bring the supplies to him.
Zhight Island (Quest)#011.dst: 我真希望他別生我的氣。我是真心打算把補給送過去的。
Zhight Island (Quest)#011.speaker: Phief

Zhight Island (Quest)#012.src: But things took a turn for the worst quickly, and I no longer have access to my ship.
Zhight Island (Quest)#012.dst: 但情況很快就急轉直下，我的船現在不在我手上了。
Zhight Island (Quest)#012.speaker: Phief

Zhight Island (Quest)#013.src: A madman jumped onto my ship, overpowered me, and held me hostage!
Zhight Island (Quest)#013.dst: 有個瘋子跳上我的船，制伏了我，還把我扣為人質！
Zhight Island (Quest)#013.speaker: Phief

Zhight Island (Quest)#014.src: He was telling me how he wanted to "take back what was stolen from him", and it looked like he was heading to {p}.
Zhight Island (Quest)#014.dst: 他一直跟我說他要「把被偷走的東西拿回來」，看樣子他是朝 {p} 去了。
Zhight Island (Quest)#014.speaker: Phief

Zhight Island (Quest)#015.src: I have no clue whether he was deranged, paranoid, or if someone really did take something from him.
Zhight Island (Quest)#015.dst: 我不知道他是精神錯亂、被害妄想，還是真的有人拿了他的東西。
Zhight Island (Quest)#015.speaker: Phief

Zhight Island (Quest)#016.src: I am certain of one thing. Nobody is going to sail my boat but me. I took my first chance to escape, broke the controls.
Zhight Island (Quest)#016.dst: 有一件事我很確定。我的船除了我誰都別想開。我一逮到機會就跑，順手把操縱裝置弄壞了。
Zhight Island (Quest)#016.speaker: Phief

Zhight Island (Quest)#017.src: And I swam back to land, here. Problem is, I haven't exactly decided how I'll get the ship back for myself.
Zhight Island (Quest)#017.dst: 然後我游回岸上，就是這裡。問題是，我還沒想好要怎麼把船弄回來。
Zhight Island (Quest)#017.speaker: Phief

Zhight Island (Quest)#018.src: Maybe you can help me with that. The ship should still be stuck, due north of here. I'd love to get my sea legs back.
Zhight Island (Quest)#018.dst: 也許你能幫我這個忙。船應該還卡在正北方。我很想再踏上甲板。
Zhight Island (Quest)#018.speaker: Phief

Zhight Island (Quest)#019.src: Find Phief's ship, and return it to its rightful owner
Zhight Island (Quest)#019.dst: 找到 Phief 的船，把它還給它真正的主人

Zhight Island (Quest)#020.src: He told you what?! That fumbleknuckle...
Zhight Island (Quest)#020.dst: 他跟你這麼說的？！那個蠢貨……
Zhight Island (Quest)#020.speaker: Tirt

Zhight Island (Quest)#021.src: We didn't steal the ship from Phief, we were taking back what he stole from us years ago!
Zhight Island (Quest)#021.dst: 我們才沒有偷 Phief 的船，我們是把他多年前偷走的東西拿回來！
Zhight Island (Quest)#021.speaker: Tirt

Zhight Island (Quest)#022.src: He attacked us on our way home to {p}, kicked us off the boat, and sailed it to who-knows-where.
Zhight Island (Quest)#022.dst: 他在我們回 {p} 的路上襲擊我們，把我們踹下船，然後開著它跑得不知去向。
Zhight Island (Quest)#022.speaker: Tirt

Zhight Island (Quest)#023.src: We didn't think we would ever get it back, until we started seeing him sailing to that doofbumble Zhight.
Zhight Island (Quest)#023.dst: 我們本來以為再也拿不回來了，直到我們開始看見他航向那個呆子 Zhight 那邊。
Zhight Island (Quest)#023.speaker: Tirt

Zhight Island (Quest)#024.src: Luckily, he decided to claim an island so close to {p}, or else we would have never seen him.
Zhight Island (Quest)#024.dst: 幸好他挑了一座離 {p} 這麼近的島，不然我們永遠不會發現他。
Zhight Island (Quest)#024.speaker: Tirt

Zhight Island (Quest)#025.src: My father started following him with a small sailboat he made, and decided on the perfect place to attack.
Zhight Island (Quest)#025.dst: 我父親用他自己做的小帆船跟蹤他，選定了最完美的下手地點。
Zhight Island (Quest)#025.speaker: Tirt

Zhight Island (Quest)#026.src: But then Phief just had to throw a hissy fit and leave us stranded here.
Zhight Island (Quest)#026.dst: 結果 Phief 偏偏要鬧脾氣，把我們丟在這裡動彈不得。
Zhight Island (Quest)#026.speaker: Tirt

Zhight Island (Quest)#027.src: My father took a paddleboat back to {p} to gather supplies. He took the cargo the ship had with him.
Zhight Island (Quest)#027.dst: 我父親划著小船回 {p} 補給去了。他把船上的貨也一起帶走了。
Zhight Island (Quest)#027.speaker: Tirt

Zhight Island (Quest)#028.src: If you need that, you should go talk to him. His name is Czytash.
Zhight Island (Quest)#028.dst: 你要那些東西的話，該去找他談。他叫 Czytash。
Zhight Island (Quest)#028.speaker: Tirt

Zhight Island (Quest)#029.src: Get Zhight's supplies from Czytash at {p}
Zhight Island (Quest)#029.dst: 到 {p} 向 Czytash 取得 Zhight 的補給

Zhight Island (Quest)#030.src: Ah, yes, I did find plenty o' supplies on that ship.
Zhight Island (Quest)#030.dst: 啊，沒錯，我確實在那艘船上找到不少補給。
Zhight Island (Quest)#030.speaker: Czytash

Zhight Island (Quest)#031.src: I assumed it was more of Phief's thiefed goods, so I took it home to use it myself.
Zhight Island (Quest)#031.dst: 我當時以為那又是 Phief 偷來的贓物，就搬回家自己用了。
Zhight Island (Quest)#031.speaker: Czytash

Zhight Island (Quest)#032.src: It is Zhight's supplies you say?
Zhight Island (Quest)#032.dst: 你說那是 Zhight 的補給？
Zhight Island (Quest)#032.speaker: Czytash

Zhight Island (Quest)#033.src: Aye, of course it had to be that idiot's.
Zhight Island (Quest)#033.dst: 唉，當然只可能是那個蠢蛋的。
Zhight Island (Quest)#033.speaker: Czytash

Zhight Island (Quest)#034.src: I guess me thinking he's dumber'n a box o' rocks is no reason for me to let him starve... Here, take the crate.
Zhight Island (Quest)#034.dst: 我想我覺得他笨得像塊石頭，也不構成讓他餓死的理由……來，箱子拿去。
Zhight Island (Quest)#034.speaker: Czytash

Zhight Island (Quest)#035.src: I haven't opened it yet, so everything is left exactly how he ordered it.
Zhight Island (Quest)#035.dst: 我還沒開過，所以裡頭全照他訂的樣子擺著。
Zhight Island (Quest)#035.speaker: Czytash

Zhight Island (Quest)#036.src: I wonder what is on that numbskull's menu, that crate smelled rancid. Almost threw it off me boat.
Zhight Island (Quest)#036.dst: 真不知道那個笨蛋的菜單上有什麼，那箱子聞起來像壞掉了。我差點把它扔下船。
Zhight Island (Quest)#036.speaker: Czytash

Zhight Island (Quest)#037.src: Anyways, good luck on your adventure matey.
Zhight Island (Quest)#037.dst: 總之，祝你冒險順利，夥計。
Zhight Island (Quest)#037.speaker: Czytash

Zhight Island (Quest)#038.src: Sorry, what was that? My son?
Zhight Island (Quest)#038.speaker: Czytash

Zhight Island (Quest)#039.src: Ah, I figured it is about time he learned how to maneuver a boat. I fixed everything before I left.
Zhight Island (Quest)#039.dst: 啊，我想也該是他學學怎麼駕船的時候了。我走之前全都修好了。
Zhight Island (Quest)#039.speaker: Czytash

Zhight Island (Quest)#040.src: When he returns, he will return a man.
Zhight Island (Quest)#040.dst: 等他回來，他就是個男子漢了。
Zhight Island (Quest)#040.speaker: Czytash

Zhight Island (Quest)#041.src: Wait, why am I telling you this? Butt out of my personal life, and just bring the man his crate.
Zhight Island (Quest)#041.dst: 等等，我幹嘛跟你講這些？別管我的私事，把箱子送去給那個人就是了。
Zhight Island (Quest)#041.speaker: Czytash

Zhight Island (Quest)#043.src: Ahaaa, esteemed sir! Or madame! I can't actually tell under all that armour...
Zhight Island (Quest)#043.dst: 啊哈，尊貴的先生！或者女士！穿著那身盔甲我實在分不出來……
Zhight Island (Quest)#043.speaker: Zhight

Zhight Island (Quest)#044.src: ER! I MEAN! N-No trouble at all, esteemed visitor! We at {p} Resort are always welcoming!
Zhight Island (Quest)#044.dst: 呃！我是說！一點問題也沒有，尊貴的訪客！我們 {p} 度假村永遠歡迎您！
Zhight Island (Quest)#044.speaker: Zhight

Zhight Island (Quest)#045.src: ...wait, is that the... Oh my! The supply crate! You went out and found Phief?! What an upstanding fellow you are!
Zhight Island (Quest)#045.dst: ……等等，那是不是……我的天！補給箱！您真的去把 Phief 找出來了？！您真是個了不起的人！
Zhight Island (Quest)#045.speaker: Zhight

Zhight Island (Quest)#046.src: Wait, he was a boat thief? Well, good thing you've told me, we can't have pirates here at our resort! I'll blacklist him ASAP!
Zhight Island (Quest)#046.dst: 等等，他是個偷船賊？嗯，幸好您告訴了我，我們度假村可不能有海盜！我會立刻把他列入黑名單！
Zhight Island (Quest)#046.speaker: Zhight

Zhight Island (Quest)#047.src: You're only a visitor but you've been more help today than anyone else, really, I'm honestly in your debt.
Zhight Island (Quest)#047.dst: 您只是個訪客，今天卻幫了比任何人都多的忙，真的，我欠您一個人情。
Zhight Island (Quest)#047.speaker: Zhight

Zhight Island (Quest)#048.src: So here! The repairs at the Zhight Grand Exchange and Zhight Treasure Tour have just finished, so you can head in and see the fruits of your labor!
Zhight Island (Quest)#048.dst: 所以，請收下！Zhight 大交易所與 Zhight 尋寶之旅的整修剛剛完工，您可以進去看看您努力的成果！
Zhight Island (Quest)#048.speaker: Zhight

Zhight Island (Quest)#049.src: And, as a token of my thanks, some exclusive currency for our resort, Zhight Money, on the house and just for you! I hope you enjoy your stay!
Zhight Island (Quest)#049.dst: 還有，這是我的一點謝意，我們度假村的專屬貨幣，Zhight 幣，免費送給您一個人！祝您住得愉快！
Zhight Island (Quest)#049.speaker: Zhight
